Text:

<6.1>

||atha śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe ṣaṣṭhaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍaṃ prārabhyate||
||śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ||
oṃ namaḥ puruṣottamāya||
||atha skānde mahāpurāṇe ṣaṣṭhanāgarakhaṇḍaprārambhaḥ||
||vyāsa uvāca||
sa dhūrjaṭi jaṭājūṭo jāyatāṃ vijayāya vaḥ|
yatraikapalitabhrāṃtiṃ karotyadyāpi jāhnavī||6.1.1||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|
harasya pūjyate liṃgaṃ kasmādatanmahāmate
viśeṣātsaṃparityajya śeṣāṃgāni surāsuraiḥ||6.1.2||
tasmādetanmahābāho yathāvadvaktumarhasi|
sāṃprataṃ sūta kārtsnyena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ||6.1.3||
sūta uvāca|
praśnabhāro mahāneṣa yo bhavadbhirudāhṛtaḥ|
kīrtayiṣye tathāpyenaṃ namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuve||6.1.4||
ānartaviṣaye cāsti vanaṃ munijanāśrayam|
manojñaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ sarvartuphalitadrumam||6.1.5||
tatrāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ saumyasattvaniṣevitam||
asti tāpasasaṃkīrṇaṃ vedadhvanivirājitam||6.1.6||
abbhakṣairvāyubhakṣaiśca śīrṇaparṇāśibhistathā|
dantolūkhalibhirvipraiḥ sevitaṃ cāśmakuṭṭakaiḥ||6.1.7||
snānahomaparaiścaiva japasvādhyāyatatparaiḥ|
vānaprasthaistridaṇḍaiśca haṃsaiścāpi kuṭīcaraiḥ||6.1.8||
snātakairyatibhirdāntaistathā paṃcāgnisādhakaiḥ|
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhagavāṃstripurāṃtakaḥ||6.1.9||
satīviyogasaṃtapto bhramamāṇa itastataḥ|
tasminvane samāyātaḥ saumyasattvaniṣevite||6.1.10||
krīḍaṃti nakulā yatra sārdhaṃ sarpaiḥpraharṣitāḥ|
pañcānanāśca mātaṃgairvṛṣadaṃśāstathākhubhiḥ|
kākāḥ kauśikasaṃghaiśca vairabhāvavivarjitāḥ||6.1.11||
tataśca bhagavānrudro dṛṣṭvāśramapadaṃ tadā|
nagnaḥ kapālamādāya bhikṣārthaṃ praviveśa saḥ||6.1.12||
atha tasya samālokya rūpaṃ gātrasamudbhavam|
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ tāpasyaḥ sarvāḥ kāmavaśaṃ gatāḥ||6.1.13||
gṛhakarma parityajya guruśuśrūṣaṇāni ca|
mithaḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ cakruḥ sthānesthāne ca tāḥ sthitāḥ||6.1.14||
ekā sā kāpi dhanyā yā cakre tasyāvagūhanam|
viśrabdhā sarvagātreṣu tāpasasya mahātmanaḥ||6.1.15||
tathānyāḥ kautukāviṣṭā dhāvaṃtyaḥ sarvatodiśam|
dṛśyaṃte taṃ samuddiśya vistāritavilocanāḥ||6.1.16||
kāścidarddhānuliptāṃgyaḥ kāścidekāṃjitekṣaṇāḥ|
ardhasaṃyamitaiḥ kaiśaistathānyāstyaktabālakāḥ||6.1.17||
evamālokyamānaḥ sa kāminībhirmaheśvaraḥ|
babhrāma rājamārgeṇa bhikṣāṃ dehīti kīrtayan||6.1.18||
atha te munayo dṛṣṭvā taṃ tathā vigatāṃbaram|
kāmodbhavakaraṃstrīṇāṃ procuḥ kopāruṇekṣaṇāḥ||6.1.19||
yasmātpāpa tvayāsmākamāśramo'yaṃ viḍaṃbitaḥ|
tasmālliṃgaṃ patatvāśu tavaiva vasudhātale||6.1.20||
etasminnaṃtare bhūmau liṃgaṃ tasya papāta tat|
bhittvātha dharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ pātālaṃ praviveśa ha||6.1.21||
so'pi liṃgaparityakto lajjāyukto maheśvaraḥ|
gartāṃ gurvīṃ samāśritya bhrūṇarūpaḥ samāviśat||6.1.22||
atha liṃgasya pātena trailokyabhayaśaṃsinaḥ|
utpātā dāruṇāstasthuḥ sarvatra dvijasattamāḥ||6.1.23||
śīryate giriśṛṅgāṇi pataṃtyulkā divāpi ca|
tyajaṃti sāgarāḥ sarve maryādāṃ ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||6.1.24||
atha devagaṇāḥ sarve bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ|
śakraviṣṇumukhā jagmuryatra devaḥ pitāmahaḥ||6.1.25||
procuśca praṇatāḥ stutvā stotraiḥ suśrutisaṃbhavaiḥ|
trailokye sṛṣṭirūpaṃ yatkamalāsanasaṃsthitam||6.1.26||
kimidaṃ kimidaṃ deva vartate hyadharottaram|
trailokyaṃ sakalaṃ yena vyākulatvamupāgatam||6.1.27||
pralayasyeva cihnāni dṛśyaṃte padmasaṃbhava|
kiṃ sāṃpratamakāle'pi bhaviṣyati parikṣayaḥ||6.1.28||
sarveṣāṃ suramartyānāṃ daityānāṃ mantrakovidaḥ|
gatirbhayārtadehānāṃ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ||6.1.29||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devānāṃ caturānanaḥ|
uvāca suciraṃ dhyātvā jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā||6.1.30||
pralayasya na kālo'yaṃ sāṃprataṃ surasattamāḥ|
śṛṇudhvaṃ yannimittotthā mahotpātā bhavantyamī||6.1.31||
ṛṣibhiḥ pātitaṃ liṃgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ|
śāpenānartake deśe kalatrārthe mahātmabhiḥ||6.1.32||
tenaitadvyākulībhūtaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram|
tasmādgacchāmahe tatra yatra devo maheśvaraḥ||6.1.33||
yenāsmadvacanācchīghraṃ talliṃgaṃ nidadhāti saḥ|
no cedbhaviṣyati vyaktamakāle cāpi saṃkṣayaḥ|
trailokyasyāpi kṛtsnasya satyametanmayoditam||6.1.34||
atha devagaṇāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇupuraḥsarāḥ|
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevāstathāśvinau||6.1.35||
prajagmustvaritāstatra yatra devo maheśvaraḥ|
gartāmadhyagataḥ supto lajjayā parayā vṛtaḥ||6.1.36||
devā ūcuḥ|
namaste devadeveśa bhaktānāmabhayaprada|
namaste jagadādhāra śaśirājitaśekhara||6.1.37||
tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvamāpastvaṃ mahī vibho|
tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram||6.1.38||
tvaṃ pāsi ca suraśreṣṭha tathā nāśaṃ nayiṣyasi|
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ caturvaktrastvaṃ caṃdrastvaṃ divākaraḥ||6.1.39||
tvayā vinā mahādeva na kiṃcidiha vidyate|
api kṛtvā mahatpāpaṃ naro deva dharātale||6.1.40||
tava nāmāpi saṃkīrtya prayāti tridivālayam|
mahādeva mahādeva mahādeveti kīrtanāt||6.1.41||
koṭayo brahmahatyānāmagamyāgamakoṭayaḥ|
sadyaḥ pralayamāyāṃti mahādeveti kīrtanāt||6.1.42||
vipro yathā manuṣyāṇāṃ nadīnāṃ vā mahārṇavaḥ|
tathā tvaṃ sarvadevānāmādhipatye vyavasthitaḥ||6.1.43||
nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā caṃdraḥ pradīptānāṃ divākaraḥ|
tathā tvaṃ sarvadevānāmādhipatye vyavasthitaḥ||6.1.44||
dhātūnāṃ kāṃcanaṃ yadvadgaṃdharvāṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ|
tathā tvaṃ sarvadevānāmādhipatye vyavasthitaḥ||6.1.45||
oṣadhīnāṃ yathā sasyaṃ nagānāṃ hemaparvataḥ|
tathā tvaṃ sarvadevānāmādhipatye vyavasthitaḥ||6.1.46||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ naḥ sarveṣāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ vibho|
saṃdhāraya punarliṃgaṃ svakīyaṃ surasattama||6.1.47||
nocejjagattrayaṃ deva nūnaṃ nāśamamupeṣyati|
yadyetadbhūtale liṅgaṃ patati sthāsyati prabho||6.1.48||
sūta uvāca|
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavānbṛṣabhadhvajaḥ|
provāca praṇatānsarvāṃstāndevānvrīḍayānvitaḥ||6.1.49||
mayā satīviyogārtiyuktena surasattama|
liṃgametatparityaktaṃ śāpavyājāddvijanmanām||6.1.50||
ko'laṃ pātayituṃ liṃgaṃ mamaitadbhuvanatraye|
devo vā brāhmaṇo vāpi vettha yūyamapi sphuṭam||6.1.51||
tasmānnaiva dhariṣyāmi liṃgametaddharātalāt|
kimanena kariṣyāmi bhāryayā parivarjitaḥ||6.1.52||
devā ūcuḥ|
tava kāṃtā satī nāma yā mṛtā prāksurottama|
sā jātā menakāgarbhe gaurī nāma himācalāt||6.1.53||
bhaviṣyati punarbhāryā tavaiva tripurāṃtaka|
tasmālliṃgaṃ samādāya kuru kṣemaṃ divaukasām||6.1.54||
devadeva uvāca|
adyaprabhṛti me liṃgaṃ yadi devā dvijātayaḥ|
pūjayaṃti prayatnena tarhīdaṃ dhārayāmyaham||6.1.55||
brahmovāca|
ahaṃ tava svayaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayiṣyāmi śaṃkara|
tathānye vibudhāḥ sarve kiṃ punarbhuvi mānavāḥ||6.1.56||
tataḥ praviśya pātālaṃ devaiḥ sārdhaṃ pitāmahaḥ|
svayamevākarotpūjāṃ tasya liṃgasya bhaktitaḥ||6.1.57||
tasmādanaṃtaraṃ viṣṇuḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā|
tathānye vibudhāḥ sarve śakrādyāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ||6.1.58||
tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ pitāmahamidaṃ vacaḥ|
provāca vāsudevaṃ ca vinayāvanataṃ sthitam||6.1.59||
bhavadbhyāṃ parituṣṭo'smi tasmānmattaḥ pragṛhyatām|
varamiṣṭaṃ mahābhāgau yadyapi syātsudurlabham||6.1.60||
tāvūcatuḥ|
yadi tuṣṭosi deveśa tribhāgena samāśrayam|
āvābhyāṃ dehi liṃgena yenaikatrāśrayo bhavet||6.1.61||
sūta uvāca|
sa tatheti pratijñāya liṃgamādāya ca prabhuḥ|
sthāne niyojayāmāsa sarvadevādhipūjitam||6.1.62||
tato hāṭakamādāya tadākāraṃ pitāmahaḥ|
kṛtvā liṃgaṃ svayaṃ tatra sthāpayāmāsa harṣitaḥ||6.1.63||
provāca cātha bho viprāḥ sādhunādena nādayan|
lokatrayaṃ samastānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tridivaukasām||6.1.64||
mayā hyādyaṃ tvidaṃ liṃgaṃ hāṭakena vinirmitam|
khyātiṃ yāsyati sarvatra pātāle hāṭakeśvaram||6.1.65||
tathānye manujā ye ca hāṭakādīni bhaktitaḥ|
maṇimuktāsuratnaiśca kṛtvā liṃgāni kṛtsnaśaḥ||6.1.66||
trikālaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim|
mṛnmayaṃ saṃparityajya nīcadhātumayaṃ tathā||6.1.67||
evamuktvā caturvaktraḥ saha sarvairdivālayaiḥ|
jagāma tridivaṃ so'pi kailāsaṃ śaśiśekharaḥ||6.1.68||
etasmātkāraṇālliṃgaṃ pūjyate'tra surāsuraiḥ|
harasya cottamāṃgāni parityajya viśeṣataḥ||6.1.69||
tataḥ prabhṛti talliṃgaṃ svayaṃ brahmā vyavasthitaḥ|
bhagavānvāsudevaśca tena pūjyaṃ śivaṃ hi tat||6.1.70||
yastu pūjayate nityaṃ śraddhāyuktena cetasā|
tryaṃbakācyutabrahmādyāstena syuḥ pūjitāstrayaḥ||6.1.71||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śivaliṃgaṃ prapūjayet|
sparśayedīkṣayennityaṃ kīrtayecca dvijottamāḥ||6.1.72||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye liṃgotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||1||

<6.2>

sūta uvāca|
tasminnutpāṭite liṃge bhūtalāddvijasattamāḥ|
pātālājjāhnavītoyaṃ tena mārgeṇa niḥsṛtam|
sarvapāpaharaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam||6.2.1||
tatra svayamabhūtpūrvaṃ yattaddvijavarottamāḥ|
śṛṇudhvaṃ vadato me'dya lokavismayakārakam||6.2.2||
triśaṃkurnāma rājeṃdraścaṃḍālatvaṃ samāgataḥ|
tatra snātaḥ punarlebhe śarīraṃ pārthivocitam||6.2.3||
ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ|
caṃḍālatvaṃ kathaṃ prāptastriśaṃkurnṛpasattamaḥ|
etattvaṃ sarvamācakṣva vistarātsūtanandana||6.2.4||
sūta uvāca|
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm|
sarvapāpaharāṃ medhyāṃ triśaṃkunṛpasaṃbhavām||6.2.5||
sūryavaṃśodbhavaḥ pūrvaṃ triśaṃkuriti viśrutaḥ|
āsītpārthivaśārdūlaḥ śārdūlasamavikramaḥ||6.2.6||
vasiṣṭhasya muneḥ śiṣyo yajvā dānapatiḥ prabhuḥ|
teneṣṭaṃ ca makhaiḥ sarvairagniṣṭomādibhiḥ sadā||6.2.7||
saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaireva vatsaraṃ vatsaraṃ prati|
tathā dānāni sarvāṇi pradattāni mahātmanā||6.2.8||
brāhmaṇebhyo viśiṣṭebhyo dīnebhyaśca viśeṣataḥ|
vratāni ca pracīrṇāni rakṣitāḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ||6.2.9||
putravallālitā lokāḥ śatravaśca niṣūditāḥ|
bhrāṃtāni bhūtale yāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca|
tapasvibhyo yathākāmaṃ yacchatā vāṃchitaṃ dhanam||6.2.10||
kasyacittvatha kālasya vasiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ|
tena proktaḥ sabhāmadhye saṃsthito natipūrvakam||6.2.11||
triśaṃkuruvāca|
bhagavanyaṣṭumicchāmi tena yajñena sāṃpratam|
gamyate tridivaṃ yena saśarīreṇa satvaram||6.2.12||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me saṃbhārānāhara drutam|
tasya yajñasya siddhyarthaṃ yathārhānbrāhmaṇāṃstathā||6.2.13||
vasiṣṭha uvāca|
na sa kaścitkraturyena gamyate tridivaṃ nṛpa|
anenaiva śarīreṇa satyametadbravīmyaham||6.2.14||
agniṣṭomādayo yajñā ye proktāḥ prāksvayaṃbhuvā|
anyadehāṃtare svargaḥ prāpyate taiḥ kṛtairnṛpa||6.2.15||
yadi vā pṛthivīpāla tvayā yajñaprabhāvataḥ|
pārthivo vā dvijo vātha vaiśyo vānyataro'pi vā||6.2.16||
svayaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vāpi saṃjāto'tra dharātale|
svargaṃ gataḥ śarīreṇa sahitastatprakīrtaya||6.2.17||
triśaṃkuruvāca|
nāsādhyaṃ vidyate brahmaṃstavāhaṃ vedmi tattvataḥ|
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yathā syānmanasepsitam||6.2.18||
vasiṣṭha uvāca|
anṛtaṃ noktapūrvaṃ me svaireṣvapi hi jihvayā|
tasmānnāsti makhaḥ kaścitsatyaṃ tvaṃ yaṣṭumicchasi||6.2.19||
triśaṃkuruvāca|
yadi māṃ vipraśārdūla na tvaṃ yājayituṃ kṣamaḥ|
svargapradena yajñena vapuṣānena vai vibho||6.2.20||
tatkiṃ te tapasaḥ śaktyā brāhmaṇasya vicakṣaṇa|
aparaṃ śṛṇu me vākyaṃ yadbravīmi parisphuṭam|
śṛṇvatāṃ munivṛndānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ dvijottama||6.2.21||
yadi me na karoṣi tvaṃ vacanaṃ vadato'sakṛt|
tena yajñena yakṣye'haṃ tatkṛtvānyaṃ dvijaṃ gurum||6.2.22||
sūta uvāca|
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vasiṣṭho bhagavāṃstataḥ|
tamuvāca vihasyoccaiḥ kuruṣvaivaṃ mahīpate||6.2.23||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne triśaṃkuvasiṣṭhasaṃvādavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||2||

<6.3>

sūta uvāca|
tataḥ praṇamya bhūyaḥ sa vasiṣṭhaṃ munipuṃgavam|
yayau tatra sutāstasya yatra te śatasaṃkhyakāḥ||6.3.1||
tānapi prāha natvā sa tamevārthaṃ narādhipaḥ|
vasiṣṭhavacanaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tasya tairapi śaṃsitam||6.3.2||
tatastānsa punaḥ prāha yuṣmākaṃ janako'dhunā|
aśakto mā divaṃ netuṃ saśarīraṃ visarjitaḥ||6.3.3||
tasmādyadi na māṃ yūyaṃ yājayiṣyatha sāṃpratam|
parityajya kariṣyāmi śīghramanyaṃ purohitam||6.3.4||
yo māṃ yajñaprabhāvena nayiṣyati surālayam|
anenaiva śarīreṇa sahitaṃ guruputrakāḥ||6.3.5||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve te munisattamāḥ|
paraṃ kopaṃ samāviṣṭāstamūcuḥ paruṣākṣaraiḥ||6.3.6||
yasmāttvayā gurustyakto hitakṛtpāpavānasi|
tasmādbhavādhunā pāpa caṃḍālo lokaniṃditaḥ||6.3.7||
atha tadvacanāṃte sa tatkṣaṇātpṛthivīpatiḥ|
babhūvāṃtyajarūpāḍhyo vikṛtākāradehabhṛt||6.3.8||
yavamadhyaḥ kṛśagrīvaḥ piṃgākṣo bhugnanāsikaḥ|
kṛṣṇāṃgaḥ śaṃkuvarṇaśca durgaṃdhena samāvṛtaḥ||6.3.9||
athātmānaṃ samālokya vikṛtaṃ sa narādhipaḥ|
caṇḍāladharmiṇaṃ sadyo lajjayā'dhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ||6.3.10||
yāhiyāhīti vipraistairbhartsyamāno muhurmuhuḥ|
sarvataḥ sārameyaiśca kliśyamāno nirargalaiḥ|
kākakokilasaṃkāśo jīrṇavastrāvaguṃṭhitaḥ||6.3.11||
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa duḥkhena mahatā vṛtaḥ|
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ śāṃtirbhaviṣyati||6.3.12||
kiṃ mayaitatsumūrkheṇa vāṃchitaṃ durlabhaṃ padam|
tatprabhāvena vibhraṣṭaḥ kuladharmo'pi me svakaḥ||6.3.13||
kiṃ jalaṃ praviśāmyadya kiṃ vā dīptaṃ hutāśanam|
bhakṣayāmi viṣaṃ kiṃ vā kathaṃ syānmṛtyuradya me||6.3.14||
anena vapuṣā dārānvīkṣayiṣyāmi tānkatham|
tādṛśena śarīreṇa yābhiḥ saṃkrīḍitaṃ mayā||6.3.15||
kathaṃ putrāṃstathā pautrānsuhṛtsaṃbaṃdhibāṃdhavān|
vīkṣayiṣyāmi tānbhūyastathānyaṃ sevakaṃ janam||6.3.16||
ye mayā nirjitāḥ sarve ripavaḥ saṃgare purā||15||
te'dya māmīdṛśaṃ śrutvā harṣaṃ yāsyaṃti nirbhayāḥ||6.3.17||
ye mayā tarpitā dānairbrāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ|
te'dya māmīdṛśaṃ śrutvā saṃbhaviṣyaṃti duḥkhitāḥ||6.3.18||
tathā ye suhṛdo'bhīṣṭā nityaṃ mama hite ratāḥ|
kāmavasthāṃ prayāsyanti dṛṣṭvā māṃ sthitamīdṛśam||6.3.19||
bhadrajātyā gajā ye me madāndhāḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanāḥ|
mayā vinā mitho yuddhe kastānadya niyokṣyati||6.3.20||
aśvāstittirakalmāṣāḥ sudāṃtāḥ sādibhirdṛḍhaiḥ|
kastāṃścitrapadanyāsairniyāmyati mayā vinā||6.3.21||
tathā me bhṛtyavargāste kulīnā yuddhadurmadāḥ|
māṃ vinā kasya yāsyaṃti samīpe'dya suduḥkhitāḥ||6.3.22||
saṃkhyāhīnastathā kośastādṛṅme bahuratnabhāk|
kasya yāsyati saṃbhogaṃ mayā hīnastu rakṣitaḥ||6.3.23||
tathā me saṃkhyayā hīnaṃ dhānyaṃ gojāvikaṃ mahat|
bhaviṣyati kathaṃ hīnaṃ mayābhīṣṭaistu rakṣitam||6.3.24||
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ rājā sa vilapya ca duḥkhitaḥ|
jagāma nagarābhyāśaṃ padbhyāmeva śanaiḥśanaiḥ||6.3.25||
tato rātrau samāsādya svaṃ puraṃ janavarjitam|
dvāre sthitvā samāhūya putraṃ maṃtribhiranvitam||6.3.26||
kathayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ sarvaṃ śāpasamudbhavam|
dūre sthitaḥ sa putrāṇāṃ vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ||6.3.27||
vajrapātopamaṃ vākyaṃ te'pi tasya niśamya tat|
bāṣpaparyākulairāsyai ruruduḥ śokasaṃyutāḥ||6.3.28||
hā nātha hā mahārāja hā nityaṃ dharmavatsala|
tvayā hīnā bhaviṣyāmaḥ kathamadya suduḥkhitāḥ||6.3.29||
kimetadyujyate teṣāṃ vāsiṣṭhānāṃ durātmanām|
śāpaṃ daduḥ svayājyasya viśeṣādvinatasya ca||6.3.30||
te vayaṃ rājaśārdūla parityajya gṛhādikam|
antyajatvaṃ gamiṣyāmastvayā sārdhamasaṃśayam||6.3.31||
triśaṃkuruvāca|
bhaktiścedasti yuṣmākaṃ mamopari nirargala|
tanme putrasya maṃtritvaṃ sarve kuruta sāṃpratam||6.3.32||
hariścaṃdraḥ suputroyaṃ mama jyeṣṭhaḥ suvallabhaḥ|
niyojayadhvamavyagrāḥ padavyāṃ mama satvaram||6.3.33||
ahaṃ punaḥ kariṣyāmi yanme manasi saṃsthitam|
mṛtyuṃ vā saṃprayāsyāmi sadeho vā surālayam||6.3.34||
evamuktvā parityajya sarvāṃstānsa mahīpatiḥ|
jagāmāraṇyamāśritya padbhyāmeva śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||6.3.35||
tepi sanmaṃtriṇastūrṇaṃ putraṃ tasya susammatam|
rājye niyojayāsamāsurnādavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ||6.3.36||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne hariścandrarājyopalaṃbhonāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ||3||

<6.4>

sūta uvāca|
triśaṃkuriti saṃcintya viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim|
manasā suciraṃ kālaṃ tataścakre viniścayam||6.4.1||
viśvāmitraṃ parityajya nānyosti bhuvanatraye|
yaḥ kuryānme paritrāṇaṃ duḥkhādasmātsudāruṇāt||6.4.2||
kurukṣetraṃ samuddiśya pratasthe sa tataḥ param|
suśrāṃtaḥ kṣutpipāsārto mārgapṛcchāparāyaṇaḥ||6.4.3||
tataḥ kālena saṃprāpya kurukṣetraṃ sa pārthivaḥ|
yatnenānveṣayāmāsa viśvāmitrāśramaṃ tataḥ||6.4.4||
evaṃ cānveṣamāṇena tena bhūmibhṛtā tadā|
sudūrādeva saṃdṛṣṭaṃ nīladrumakadambakam||6.4.5||
upariṣṭādbakairhaṃsairbhramamāṇaiḥ samaṃtataḥ|
āṭibhirmadgubhiścaiva samantājjalapakṣibhiḥ||6.4.6||
sa matvā salilaṃ tatra pipāsārto mahīpatiḥ|
pratasthe satvaro hṛṣṭo jalavātahṛtaklamaḥ||6.4.7||
athāpaśyanmanohāri saumyasattvaniṣevitam|
āśramaṃ naditīrasthaṃ manaḥśokavināśanam||6.4.8||
puṣpitaiḥ phalitairvṛkṣaiḥ samaṃtātparivāritam|
vividhairmadhurārāvairnāditaṃ vihagottamaiḥ||6.4.9||
krīḍaṃti nakulāḥ sarpairūlūkā yatra vāyasaiḥ|
mūṣakairvṛṣadaṃśāśca dvīpino vividhairmṛgaiḥ||6.4.10||
athāpaśyannadītīre sa tapasvigaṇāvṛtam|
svādhyāyanirataṃ dāṃtaṃ viśvāmitraṃ taponidhinam||6.4.11||
tejasā tapasātīva dīpyamānamivānalam|
cīravalkalasaṃvītaṃ śālavṛkṣaṃ samāśritam||6.4.12||
atha gatvā sa rājendro dūrastho'pi praṇamya tam|
aṣṭāṃgena praṇāmena svanāma parikīrtayan||6.4.13||
tathānyānapi tacchiṣyānkṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ|
yathākramaṃ yathājyeṣṭhaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ||6.4.14||
dhūlidhūsaritāṃgaṃ taṃ te tu dṛṣṭvā mahīpatim|
caṃḍāla iti manvānāścihnairgātrasamudbhavaiḥ||6.4.15||
bhartsayāmāsurevātha vacanaiḥ paruṣākṣaraiḥ|
dhikchabdaiśca tathaivānye yāhiyāhīti cāsakṛt||6.4.16||
kastvaṃ pāpeha saṃprāpto munīnāmāśramottame|
vedadhvanisamākīrṇe sādhūnāmapi durlabhe||6.4.17||
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ yāvanna kaścittāpasastava|
dattvā śāpaṃ karotyāśu prāṇānāmapi saṃkṣayam||6.4.18||
triśaṃkuruvāca|
triśaṃkurnāma bhūpo'haṃ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ|
śapto vasiṣṭhaputraiśca caṃḍālatve niyojitaḥ||6.4.19||
so'haṃ śaraṇamāpannaḥ śāpamuktyai dvijottamāḥ|
viśvāmitraṃ jaganmitraṃ nānyā me'sti gatiḥ parā||6.4.20||
viśvāmitra uvāca|
vasiṣṭhasya bhavānyājyastatputrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ|
tatkasmādīdṛśe pāpe taistvamadya niyojitaḥ||6.4.21||
ko'parādhastvayā teṣāṃ kṛtaḥ pārthivasattama|
prāṇadrohaḥ kṛtaḥ kiṃ vā dāradharṣaṇasaṃbhavaḥ||6.4.22||
triśaṃkuruvāca|
anenaiva śarīreṇa svargāya gamanaṃ prati|
mayā saṃprārthito yajño vasiṣṭhānmunisattamāt||6.4.23||
tenoktaṃ na sa yajño'sti yena svarge pragamyate|
anenaiva śarīreṇa muktvā dehāṃtaraṃ nṛpa||6.4.24||
tacchrutvā sa mayā prokto yadi māṃ na nayiṣyati|
svargaṃ cānena kāyena sadyo yajñaprabhāvataḥ||6.4.25||
tadanyaṃ gurumevādya kartāhaṃ nāsti saṃśayaḥ|
etajjñātvā muniḥ prāha yatkṣemaṃ tatsamācara||6.4.26||
tato'haṃ tena saṃtyaktastatputrānprāpya niṣṭhurān|
proktavānatha tatsarvaṃ yadvasiṣṭhasya kīrtitam||6.4.27||
tatastaiḥ śokasaṃtaptaiḥ śaptosmi munisattama|
nītaścemāṃ daśāṃ pāpāṃ caṃḍālatve niyojitaḥ||6.4.28||
so'haṃ tvāṃ manasā dhyātvā sudūrādiharāgataḥ(?)|
āśāṃ garīyasīṃ kṛtvā kurukṣetre munīśvara||6.4.29||
nāsādhyaṃ vidyate kiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu te mune|
tasmātkuru pratīkāraṃ duḥkhitasya mamādhunā||6.4.30||
sūta uvāca|
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ|
vasiṣṭhaspardhayovāca munimadhye vyavasthitaḥ||6.4.31||
ahaṃ tvāṃ yājayiṣyāmi tena yajñena pārthiva|
gacchasi tridivaṃ yena iṣṭamātreṇa tatkṣaṇāt||6.4.32||
tvamevaṃ vihito bhūpa vāsiṣṭhairaṃtyajastu taiḥ|
mayā bhūyo'pi bhūpālaḥ kartavyo nātra saṃśayaḥ||6.4.33||
tasmādāgaccha bhūpāla tīrthayātrāṃ mayā saha|
kuru tīrthaprabhāveṇa yena tvaṃ syāḥ śuciḥ punaḥ||6.4.34||
tathā yajñakriyārhaśca caṃḍālatvavivarjitaḥ|
nāsti tatpātakaṃ yacca tīrthasnānānna naśyati||6.4.35||
sūta uvāca|
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā gādhiputro munīśvaraḥ|
triśaṃkuṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā tīrthayātrāmathāvrajat||6.4.36||
kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatyāṃ prabhāse kurujāṃgale|
pṛthūdake gayāśīrṣe naimiṣe puṣkaratraye||6.4.37||
vārāṇasyāṃ prayāge ca kedāre śravaṇe nade|
citrakūṭe ca gokarṇe śāligrāme'caleśvare||6.4.38||
śuklatīrthe surājyākhye dṛṣadvati nade śubhe|
athānyeṣu supuṇyeṣu tīrtheṣvāyataneṣu ca||6.4.39||
evaṃ tasya nareṃdrasya sārdhaṃ tena mahātmanā|
atikrāṃto mahānkālo bhramamāṇasya bhūtale||6.4.40||
mucyate na ca pāpena caṃḍālatvena sa dvijāḥ|
evaṃvidheṣu tīrtheṣu snātopi ca pṛthakpṛthak||6.4.41||
tataḥ kramātsamāyātaḥ so'rbudaṃ parvataṃ prati|
tatrāruhya samālokya pāpaghnamacaleśvaram||6.4.42||
yāvadāyatanāttasmānnirgacchati munīśvaraḥ|
tāvattenekṣito nāmamārkaṃḍo munisattamaḥ||6.4.43||
so'pi dṛṣṭvā jaganmitraṃ viśvāmitraṃ munīśvaram|
provācātha kutaḥ prāptaḥ sāṃprataṃ tvaṃ munīśvara||6.4.44||
ko'yaṃ tavānugo raudro dṛśyate cāṃtyajākṛtiḥ|
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva pṛcchato mama sanmune||6.4.45||
viśvāmitra uvāca|
eṣa pārthivaśārdūlastriśaṃkuriti viśrutaḥ|
vasiṣṭhasya sutairnītaścaṃḍālatvaṃ prakopataḥ||6.4.46||
mayā cāsya pratijñātaṃ saptadvīpavatīṃ mahīm|
prabhramiṣyāmyahaṃ yāvanmedhyatvaṃ tvamupeṣyasi||6.4.47||
bhrāṃto'haṃ bhūtale yāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca|
nacaiṣa medhyatāṃ prāptaḥ pariśrāṃtosmi sāṃpratam||6.4.48||
tasmātsarvāṃ mahīṃ tyaktvā lajjayā parayā yutaḥ|
dvīpānmahārṇavāṃstyaktvā saṃprayāsyāmyataḥ param||6.4.49||
mā vasiṣṭhasya putrāṇāmupahāsapadaṃ gataḥ|
pratijñārahito vipra satyamedbravīmyaham||6.4.50||
śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca|
yadyevaṃ muniśārdūla kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama|
saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ mā tyaktvā kutracidvraja||6.4.51||
etasmātparvatātkṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam|
asti nairṛtadigbhāge deśe cānartasaṃjñake||6.4.52||
tatrādyaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ hāṭakena surottamaiḥ|
yattatsaṃkīrtyate loke pātāle hāṭakeśvaram||6.4.53||
pātālajāhvītoyaṃ yatraivāsti dvijottama|
uddhṛte śaṃbhunā liṃge viniṣkrāṃtaṃ rasātalāt||6.4.54||
tatra praviśya yatnena pātālaṃ vasudhādhipaḥ|
karotu jāhnavītoye snānaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ||6.4.55||
paścātpaśyatu talliṃgaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam|
bhaviṣyati tataḥ śuddhaścaṃḍālatvavivarjitaḥ||6.4.56||
tvamapi prāpsyasi śreyaḥ paraṃ hṛdayasaṃsthitam|
tatonyadapi yatkiṃcittatraiva tapasi sthitaḥ||6.4.57||
sūta uvāca|
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ|
triśaṃkunā samāyukto gatastatra drutaṃ tataḥ||6.4.58||
pātāle devamārgeṇa praviśya nṛpasattamam|
triśaṃkuṃ snāpayāmāsa vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā||6.4.59||
snātamātrotha rājā sa hāṭakeśvadarśanāt|
caṃḍālatvena nirmukto babhūvārkasamadyutiḥ||6.4.60||
tatastaṃ sa muniḥ prāha praṇataṃ gatakalmaṣam|
diṣṭyā muktosi rājeṃdra caṃḍālatvena sāṃpratam||6.4.61||
diṣṭyā prāptaḥ paraṃ tejo diṣṭyā prāptaḥ paraṃ tapaḥ|
tasmādyajasva satreṇa vidhivaddakṣiṇāvatā||6.4.62||
yena saṃprāpsyase siddhiṃ nityaṃ yā hṛdaye sthitā|
tvatkṛte prārthayiṣyāmi svayaṃ gatvā pitāmaham||6.4.63||
makhāṃśaṃ sarvadevādyo yena gṛhṇāti te makhe|
tasmādatraiva saṃbhārānsarvānyajñasamudbhavān|
ānaya brahmalokācca yāvadāgamanaṃ mama||6.4.64||
bāḍhamityeva so'pyāha sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ|
pitāmahamupāgamya praṇipatyābravīdvacaḥ||6.4.65||
yājayiṣyāmyahaṃ bhūpaṃ triśaṃkuṃ prapitāmaha|
mānuṣeṇa śarīreṇa yena gacchati te padam||6.4.66||
tasmādāgaccha tatra tvaṃ yajñavāṭaṃ pitāmaha|
sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ śivaviṣṇupuraḥsaraiḥ||6.4.67||
pragṛhāṇa svahastena yajñabhāgaṃ yathocitam|
saśarīro divaṃ yāti yenāsau tvatprasādataḥ||6.4.68||
brahmovāca|
na yajñakarmaṇā svargaḥsvena kāyena labhyate|
muktvā dehāṃtaraṃ brahmaṃstasmānmaivaṃ vadasva mām||6.4.69||
vayamagnimukhāḥ sarve havirgṛhṇāmahe makhe|
vedoktavidhinā samyagyajamānahitāya vai||6.4.70||
tasmādvahnimukhe bhūyaḥ sa juhoti havirdvija|
tataḥ saṃprāpsyati svargaṃ tvatprasādādasaṃśayam||6.4.71||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasrayāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne viśvāmitrakṛtatriśaṃkuyājanopakramavarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ||4||

<6.5>

sūta uvāca|
tacchrutvā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ viśvāmitro ruṣānvitaḥ|
pitāmahamuvācedaṃ paśya me tapaso balam||6.5.1||
yājayitvā triśaṃkuṃ taṃ vidhivaddakṣiṇāvatā|
yajñenātrā(?) nayiṣyāmi paśyataste pitāmaha||6.5.2||
evamuktvā drutaṃ gatvā viśvāmitro dharātalam|
cakāra yājane yatnaṃ triśaṃkoḥ sumahātmanaḥ||6.5.3||
dadau dīkṣāṃ samāhūya brāhmaṇānvedapāragān|
yatrakarmocite kāle tasminneva vane śubhe||6.5.4||
babhūva sa svayaṃ dhīmānadhvaryuryajñakarmaṇi|
tasminhotā ca śāṃḍilyo brahmā gautama eva ca||6.5.5||
āgnīdhraścyavano nāma maitrāvaruṇaḥ kārmikaḥ|
udgātā yājñavalkyaśca pratihartā ca jaiminiḥ||6.5.6||
prastotā śaṃkuvarṇaśca tathonnetā ca gālavaḥ|
pulastyo brāhmaṇācchaṃsī hotā gargo munīśvaraḥ||6.5.7||
neṣṭā caiva tathātristu acchāvāko bhṛguḥ svayam|
tānsarvānṛtvijaścakre triśaṃkuḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ||6.5.8||
vāsobhirmukuṭaiścaiva keyūraiḥ samalaṃkṛtān|
kṛtvā keśaparityāgaṃ dadhatkṛṣṇājinaṃ tathā||6.5.9||
aiṇaśṛṅgasamāyuktaḥ payovrataparāyaṇaḥ|
dīrghasatrāya tānsarvānyojayāmāsa vai tataḥ||6.5.10||
evaṃ tasminpravṛtte ca dīrghasatre yathocite|
ājagmurbrāhmaṇā divyā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ||6.5.11||
tathānye tārkikāścaiva gṛhasthāḥ kautukānvitāḥ|
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇāścaiva ye cānye naṭanartakāḥ||6.5.12||
dīyatāṃ dīyatāmāśu eteṣāmetadeva hi|
bhujyatāṃbhujyatāṃ lokāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti||6.5.13||
ityeṣa ninadastatra śrūyate satataṃ mahān|
yajñavāṭe sadā tasminnānyaścaiva kadācana||6.5.14||
tatra sasyamayāḥ śailā dṛśyaṃte parikalpitāḥ|
suvarṇasya ca rūpyasya ratnānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ||6.5.15||
dānārthaṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāmasaṃkhyāścāpi dhenavaḥ|
tathaiva vājino dāṃtā madonmattā mahāgajāḥ||6.5.16||
samaṃtātkalpitāstatra dṛśyaṃte parvatopamāḥ|
vartamāne mahāyajñe tasminneva suvistare||6.5.17||
āhūtā yajñabhāgāya nābhigacchaṃti devatāḥ|
kevalaṃ vahnivaktreṇa tasya gṛhṇaṃti taddhaviḥ||6.5.18||
evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi yajatastasya bhūpateḥ|
vyatītāni na saṃprāptamabhīṣṭaṃ manasaḥ phalam||6.5.19||
tataścāvabhṛthasnānaṃ kṛtvā satrasamāptijam|
ṛtvijastarpayitvā tāndakṣiṇābhiryathārhataḥ||6.5.20||
visasarja samastāṃśca tathānyānapi saṃgatān|
saṃbaṃdhino vayasyāṃśca triśaṃkurmunisattamāḥ||6.5.21||
tataḥ provāca vinato viśvāmitraṃ munīśvaram|
sa bhūpo vrīḍayā yuktaḥ praṇipātapuraḥ saram||6.5.22||
tvatprasādānmayā prāptaṃ dīrghasatrasamudbhavam|
paripūrṇaphalaṃ brahmandurlabhaṃ sarvamānavaiḥ||6.5.23||
tathā jātiḥ punarlabdhā bhūyo naṣṭāpi sanmune|
tvatprasādena viprarṣe caṃḍālatvaṃ praṇāśitam||6.5.24||
paraṃ me duḥkhamevaikaṃ hṛdi śalyamivārpitam|
anenaiva śarīreṇa yanna prāptaṃ triviṣṭapam||6.5.25||
upahāsaṃ kariṣyaṃti vasiṣṭhasya sutā mune|
adya vyartha śramaṃ śrutvā māmaprāptaṃ triviṣṭapam||6.5.26||
tathā tadvacanaṃ satyaṃ vasiṣṭhasya vyavasthitam|
yattenoktaṃ na yajñena sadehairgamyate divi||6.5.27||
so'haṃ tapaḥ kariṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ vanamāśritaḥ|
na kariṣyāmi bhūyo'pi rājyaṃ putraniveditam||6.5.28||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne viśvāmitreṇa triśaṃkoḥ saśarīrasvargārohaṇāya dvādaśavārṣikayajñakaraṇaṃnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||

<6.6>

sūta uvāca|
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya triśaṃkormunipuṃgavaḥ|
viśvāmitro'bravīdvākyaṃ kiṃcillajjāsamanvitaḥ||6.6.1||
mā viṣādaṃ mahīpāla viṣaye'tra kariṣyasi|
anenaiva śarīreṇa tvāṃ nayiṣyāmyahaṃ divam||6.6.2||
tattatkarma kariṣyāmi svargārthe nṛpasattama|
tavābhīṣṭaṃ kariṣyāmi kiṃ vā yāsyāmi saṃkṣayam||6.6.3||
evamuktvā paraṃ kopaṃ kṛtvopari divaukasām|
uvāca ca tato raudraṃ pratyakṣaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ||6.6.4||
yathā mayā dvijatvaṃ hi svayamevārjitaṃ balāt|
tathā sṛṣṭiṃ kariṣyāmi svakīyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ||6.6.5||
tatastaṃ sa samālokya śaṃkaraṃ śaśiśekharam|
praṇamya vidhivadbhaktyā stutiṃ cakre mahāmuniḥ||6.6.6||
viśvāmitra uvāca|
jaya deva jayāciṃtya jaya pārvativallabha|
jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya kṛṣṇa jagadguro||6.6.7||
jayāciṃtya jayāmeya jayānaṃta jayācyuta|
jayāmara jayājeya jayāvyaya sureśvara||6.6.8||
jaya sarvaga sarveśa jaya sarvasurāśraya|
jaya sarvajanadhyeya jaya sarvāghanāśana||6.6.9||
tvaṃ dhātā ca vidhātā ca tvaṃ kartā tvaṃ ca rakṣakaḥ|
caturvidhasya deveśa bhūtagrāmasya śaṃkara||6.6.10||
yathā tilasthitaṃ tailaṃ yathā dadhigataṃ ghṛtam|
tathaivādhiṣṭhitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tvayā guptena vai jagat||6.6.11||
tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ hṛṣīkeśastvaṃ śakrastvaṃ hutāśanaḥ|
tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvamindustvaṃ divākaraḥ||6.6.12||
athavā bahunoktena kiṃ stavena tava prabho|
samāsādeva vakṣyāmi vibhūtiṃ śrutinoditām||6.6.13||
yatkiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ vibho|
tatsarvaṃ bhavatā vyāptaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ havyabhujā yathā||6.6.14||
śrībhagavānuvāca|
parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te varaṃ prārthaya sanmune|
yatte hṛdi sthitaṃ nityaṃ sarvaṃ dāsyāmyasaṃśayam||6.6.15||
viśvāmitra uvāca|
yadi tuṣṭosi deveśa yadi deyo varo mama|
tanme syātsṛṣṭimāhātmyaṃ tvatprasādānmaheśvara||6.6.16||
evamastviti taṃ coktvā bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ|
sarvairgaṇaiḥ samāyuktastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ||6.6.17||
viśvāmitro'pi tatraiva sthito dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ|
cakre caturvidhāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ sparddhayā haṃsagāminaḥ||6.6.18||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvakṣetramāhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne viśvāmitravaralabdhirnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||

<6.7>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ dhyāyamānena jalamāviśya kāmyayā ||
sṛṣṭaṃ saṃdhyādvayaṃ tacca dṛśyate'dyāpi vai dvijāḥ || 1 ||
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sṛṣṭāstena mahātmanā ||
vaimānikāśca ye kecinnakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā || 2 ||
manuṣyoragarakṣāṃsi vīrudho vṛkṣasaṃyutāḥ ||
saptarṣayo dhruvādyāśca ye cānye gaganecarāḥ || 3 ||
evaṃ hi bhagavānsṛṣṭvā viśvāmitraḥ sa manyumān ||
svakīyeṣvatha kṛtyeṣu yojayāmāsa tāṃstataḥ || 4 ||
etasminneva kāle tu dvau sūryo yugapaddivi ||
uditau rātrināthau ca jātāśca dviguṇā grahāḥ ||
dviguṇāni ca bhānyeva saha saptarṣibhirdvijāḥ || 5 ||
evaṃ viyati te sarve sparddhamānāḥ parasparam ||
dṛśyaṃte dviguṇībhūtā janavibhramakārakāḥ || 6 ||
etasminnantare śakraḥ saha sarverdivālayaiḥ ||
jagāma tatra yatrāste bhagavānkamalāsanaḥ || 7
provācātha praṇamyoccaiḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||
stutiṃ kṛtvā suraiḥ sārdhaṃ vedoktaiḥ stavanairdvijāḥ || 8 ||
sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā suraśreṣṭha viśvāmitreṇa sāṃpratam ||
manuṣyayakṣasarpāṇāṃ devagaṃdharvarakṣasām || 9 ||
tasmādvāraya taṃ gatvā svayameva pitāmaha ||
yāvanna vyāpyate sarvaṃ tatsaṣṭyedaṃ carācaram || 10
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tenaiva sahito vidhiḥ ||
gatvovāca jaganmitraṃ viśvāmitraṃ munīśvaram || 11 ||
nivṛttiṃ kuru viprarṣe sāṃprataṃ vacanānmama ||
sṛṣṭairyāvanna naśyaṃti sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 12 || ||
viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
anenaiva śarīreṇa triśaṃkurnṛpasattamaḥ||
yadi gacchati te loke tatsṛṣṭiṃ na karomyaham || 13 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
eṣa gacchatu bhūpālo mayā saha triviṣṭapam ||
anenaiva śarīreṇa tvatprasādānmunīśvara || 14
virāmaṃ kuru sṛṣṭestvaṃ naitadanyaḥ kariṣyati ||
na kṛtaṃ kenacilloke tatkarma bhavatā kṛtam|| 15 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
yanmayā kopayuktena kṛteyaṃ sṛṣṭirabjaja ||
tatkṣatavyaṃ tvayā deva sarvalokapitāmaha ||16||
tathā'kṣayāstu me deva sṛṣṭistava prasādataḥ ||
yā kṛtā na kariṣyāmi bhūyo 'nyāṃ padmasaṃbhava || 17 ||
|| vrahmovāca || ||
bhaviṣyati dhruvā vipra sṛṣṭiryā bhavatā kṛtā ||
paraṃ sarveṣu kṛtyeṣu yajñārhā na bhaviṣyati || 18 || 
evamuktvā samādāya triśaṃkuṃ prapitāmahaḥ ||
brahmalokaṃ gato hṛṣṭo munistatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || 19 ||
iti skānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhenāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne triśaṃkusvargaprāptivarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||

<6.8>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ svargamanuprāpte triśaṃkau nṛpasattame ||
saśarīre dvijaśreṣṭhā viśvāmitrasamudyamāt || 6.8.1 ||
tattīrthaṃ khyātimāyātaṃ samaste bhuvanatraye ||
tataḥprasūti lokānāṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam || 2 ||
aspṛṣṭaṃ kalidoṣeṇa tathānyairupapātakaiḥ ||
brahmahatyādikaiścaivatripurāreḥ prabhāvataḥ || 3 ||
yastatra tyajati prāṇāñchraddhā yuktena cetasā ||
sa mokṣamāpnuyānmartyo yadyapi syātsupāpakṛt || 4 ||
kṛmipakṣipataṃgā ye paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ ||
te'pi tatra mṛtā yāṃti śivalokamasaṃśayam|| 5 ||
snānaṃ ye tatra kurvaṃti śraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
triśaṃkuriva te svarge prayāṃtyapi vidharmiṇaḥ || 6 ||
gharmārttā vā tṛṣārtā vā ye'vagāhaṃti tajjalam||
te'pi yāṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 7 ||
viśvāmitro'pi taddṛṣṭvā tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam ||
kurukṣetraṃ parityajya tatra vāsamathākarot|| 8 ||
tathānye munayaḥ śāṃtāstyaktvā tīrthāni dūrataḥ||
tatrāśramapadaṃ kṛtvā prayātāḥ paramaṃ padam || 9 ||
tathaiva manujāḥ sarve dūrādāgatya satvarāḥ ||
tatra snātvā divaṃ yāṃti kṛtvā pāpaśatānyapi || 6.8.10 ||
evaṃ tasya prabhāveṇa tīrthasya dvijasattamāḥ ||
gacchamāneṣu lokeṣu sukhena tridivālayam || 11 ||
agniṣṭomādikā sarvāḥ samucchedaṃ gatāḥ kriyāḥ ||
na kaścidyajate martyo na vrataṃ kurute naraḥ || 12 ||
na yacchati tathā dānaṃ na ca tīrthaṃ niṣevate ||
kevalaṃ kurute snānaṃ liṃgabhede samāhitaḥ || 13 ||
tataḥ pragacchati svargaṃ vimānavaramāśritaḥ || 14 ||
tataḥ prapūritāḥ sarve svargalokā narairdvijāḥ ||
brahmaviṣṇuśivendrādīnspardhamānaiḥ surottamān || 15 ||
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve yajñabhāgavivarjitāḥ ||
kṛcchraṃ paramanuprāptā mantraṃ cakruḥ parasparam||16||
hāṭakeśvaramāhātmyātsvargalokaḥ prapūritaḥ ||
ūrdhvabāhubhirākīrṇaḥ spardhamānaiḥ samaṃtataḥ || 17 ||
tasmāttatkriyatāṃ karma yenocchedaṃ pragacchati ||
tīrthameddharāpṛṣṭhe hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam|| 18 ||
tataḥ saṃvartako vāyuḥ śakrādeśātsamaṃtataḥ ||
tatkṣetraṃ pūrayāmāsa pāṃsubhirdvijasattamāḥ || 19 ||
evaṃ nāśamanuprāpte tasmiṃstīrthe sthaloccaye ||
jāte jātāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā bhūyo'pi kratusaṃbhavāḥ || 6.8.20 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā valmīkaḥ samapadyata ||
tasminkṣetre sa pātāle saṃprayātaḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 21 ||
atha pātālato nāgāstena mārgeṇa kautukāt ||
martyalokaṃ samāyāṃti bhramaṃti ca dharātale||22||
tatra te mānavānbhogānbhuktvā caiva yathecchayā||
punarniryāṃti tenaiva mārgeṇa nijamaṃdiram||23||
tato nāgabilaḥ khyātaḥ sa sarvasmindharātale ||
gatāgatena nāgānāṃ sa valmīko dvijottamāḥ || 24 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ||
brahmahatyāsamopeto nistejāḥ samapadyata || 25 ||
tataḥ pitāmahādeśaṃ labdhvā mārgeṇa tena saḥ ||
praviśya cekṣayāmāsa pātāle hāṭa keśvaram || 26 ||
athā'bhūtpāpanirmuktastatkṣaṇāttasya darśanāt||
tejasā ca samāyuktaḥ punaḥ prāpa triviṣṭapam || 27 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā tatprabhāvaṃ talliṃgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ ||
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñasya bhayaṃ cakre narodbhavam || 28 ||
yadi kaścitpumānatra triśaṃkuriva bhūpatiḥ ||
pūjayiṣyati talliṃgaṃ vipāpmā śraddhayā saha || 29 ||
yāpayiṣyati tannūnaṃ māmasmāttridaśālayāt ||
tasmātsaṃpūrayāmyenaṃ mārgaṃ pātā lasaṃbhavam || 6.8.30 ||
tataśca tvarayā yukto raktaśṛṃgaṃ nagottamam ||
pracikṣepa bile tasminsvayameva śatakratuḥ || 31 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
brahmahatyā kathaṃ jātā devendrasya mahātmanaḥ ||
kasminkāle ca sarvaṃ no vistarātsūta kīrtaya || 32 ||
raktaśṛṃgo giriḥ ko'yaṃ saṃkṣiptastatra tena yaḥ ||
mānuṣāṇāṃ bhayaṃ tasya katamasya śacīpateḥ || 33 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
purā tvaṣṭrā dvijaśreṣṭhā hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutā ||
vivāhitā ramānāma śreṣṭharūpaguṇānvitā || 34 ||
atha tasyā yayau kālaḥ suprabhūtaḥ sutaṃ vinā ||
tato vairāgyasaṃpannā sutārthaṃ tapasi sthitā || 35 ||
dhyāyamānā surādhīśaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram ||
balipūjopahāreṇa samyakchraddhāsamanvitā || 36 ||
niyatā niyatāhārā snānajapyaparāyaṇā ||
yacchamānā dvijāgryebhyo dānāni vividhāni ca || 37 ||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tasyāstuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ||
uvāca varado'smīti vṛṇuṣva yadabhīpsitam || 38 ||
sā vavre mama putro'stu bhagavaṃstvatprasādataḥ ||
śūraḥ śastrairavadhyaśca vipradānavarūpadhṛk || 39 ||
vedādhyayana saṃpanno yajñakarmasamudyataḥ ||
tejasā yaśasā khyātaḥ sarveṣāmapi dehinām || 6.8.40 ||
|| bhagavānuvāca || ||
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ putraste balavānsudhīḥ ||
avadhyaḥ sarvaśastrāṇāṃ mahātejobhiranvitaḥ || 41 ||
yajvā dānapatiḥ śūro vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ||
brāhmaṇoktāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kariṣyati sa kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
ajeyaḥ saṃgare caiva kṛtsnairapi surāsuraiḥ || 42 ||
evamuktvā sa deveśastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
ṛtau sāpi dadhe garbhaṃ sakāśādviśvakarmaṇaḥ || || 43 ||
tataśca suṣuve putraṃ daśame māsi śobhanam ||
dvādaśārkapratīkāśaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 44 ||
tasya cakre pitā nāma prāpte dvādaśame dine ||
prasiddhaṃ vṛtra ityeva pūjayitvā dvijottamān || 45 ||
athāsau vavṛdhe bālaḥ śuklapakṣe yathoḍurāṭ ||
pitṛmātṛkṛtānaṃdo bandhuvargeṇa lālitaḥ || 46||
tato'sya pradadau kāle vrataṃ viprajanocitam ||
samabhyetya svayaṃ śukro dānavasyāpi saṃdvijaḥ || 47 ||
sa cāpi caturo vedānbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ ||
vedāṃgaiḥ sahitānvṛtraḥ papāṭha guruvatsalaḥ || 48 ||
tato yauvanamāsādya bhūmipālānaśeṣataḥ ||
jitvā dharāṃ vaśe cakre pātālaṃ tadanaṃta ram|| 49 ||
tataśceṃdrajayākāṃkṣī samāsāya surālayam ||
sahasrākṣamukhāndevānyuddhe cakre parāṅmukhān || 6.8.50 ||
atha tena samaṃ vajrī cakre'ṣṭādaśa saṃyugān||
ekasminnapi no lebhe vijayaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 51 ||
hataśeṣaiḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ sarvāṃgakṣatavikṣataiḥ ||
tato jagāma vitrasto brahmalokaṃ divā layāt|| 52 ||
vṛtro'pi bubhuje kṛtsnaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ||
śākraṃ padaṃ samāsthāya nihatāśeṣakaṃṭakam || 53 ||
yajñabhāgabhujaścakre dānavānbala garvitān ||
devasthāneṣu sarveṣu yathokteṣu mahābalaḥ || 54 ||
evaṃ trailokyarājye'pi labdhe tasya dvijottamāḥ ||
na saṃtoṣaśca saṃjajñe brahmalokābhi kāṃkṣayā || 55 ||
tataḥ śukraṃ samāhūya provāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ ||
vinayāvanato bhūtvā caturbhiḥ sacivaiḥ saha || 56 ||
|| vṛtra uvāca || ||
brahmalokaṃ gataḥ śakro bhayādgurukulodvaha ||
kathaṃ gatirbhavettatra mama brūhi yathātatham || 57 ||
yena śakraṃ viraṃciṃ ca sūdayiṣye tathākhilam ||
tubhyaṃ dattvā brahma lokaṃ bhokṣyāmi tridivaṃ svayam || 58 ||
|| śukra uvāca || ||
na gatirvidyate tatra tava dānavasattama ||
tasmāttrailokyarājyena saṃtoṣaṃ kartuma rhasi || 59 ||
|| vṛtra uvāca || ||
yāvattiṣṭhati sutrāmā tāvannāsti sukhaṃ mama ||
tasmānniṣkaṃṭakārthāya yatiṣye'haṃ dvijottama || 6.8.60 ||
kathaṃ śakrasya saṃjātā gatistatra bhṛgūdvaha ||
na bhaviṣyati me brūhi kathaṃ sā'dya mahāmate || 61 ||
|| śukra uvāca || ||
tena pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ naimiṣe dānavottama ||
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṃtaṃ dhyāyamānena śaṃkaram|| 62 ||
tatprabhāvādgatistasya tatra jātā sadaiva hi ||
sabhṛtyaparivārasya nānyadastīha kāraṇam|| 63 ||
yo'nyo'pi naimiṣāraṇye tadrūpaṃ kurute tapaḥ ||
brahmaloke gatistasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 64 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā satvaraṃ gatvā naimiṣaṃ tīrthamuttamam ||
tapaścakre tatastīvraṃ dhyāyamāno maheśvaram || 65 ||
trailokyarakṣaṇārthāya saṃnirūpya danūtta mān||
mahābalasamopetāñchakrādhikaparākramān || 66 ||
varṣāsvākāśasthāyī sa hemante salilāśrayaḥ ||
paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme sa vabhūvā nilāśanaḥ || 67 ||
evaṃ tasya vratasthasya jagmurvarṣaśatāni ca ||
tatra bhītāstato devā brahmaviṣṇupuraḥsarāḥ || 68 ||
cakruśca satataṃ maṃtraṃ tadvināśāya kevalam ||
vīkṣayaṃti ca cchidrāṇi na ca paśyaṃti duḥkhitāḥ || 69 ||
athābravītsvayaṃ viṣṇuściraṃ niścitya cetasā ||
vadhopāyaṃ samālokya vṛtrasya pramudānvitaḥ | 6.8.70 ||
|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||
tasya śakra vadhopāyo mayā jñāto'dhunā dhruvam ||
tacchrutvā kuru śīghraṃ tvamupāyo nāsti kaścana || 71 ||
avadhyaḥ sarvaśastrāṇāṃ sa kṛtaḥ śūlapāṇinā ||
tasmādasthimayaṃ vajraṃ tadvadhārthaṃ nirūpaya || 72 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
asthibhiḥ kasya jīvasya vajraṃ deva bhaviṣyati ||
gajasya śarabhasyātha kiṃ vānyasya vadasva me || 73 ||
|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||
śatahastapramāṇaṃ tatṣaḍasri ca surādhipa ||
madhye kṣāmaṃ tu pārśvābhyāṃ sthūlaṃ raudrasamākṛti || 74 ||
|| iṃdra uvāca || ||
na tādṛgdṛśyate sattvaṃ trailokyepi sureśvara ||
yasyāsthibhirvidhīyeta vajamevaṃvidhākṛti || 75 ||
|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||
dadhīcirnāma vipro'sti tapaḥ paramamā sthitaḥ ||
dviguṇaṃ ca tathā dīrghaḥ sarasvatyāṃ kṛtāśramaḥ || 76 ||
taṃ gatvā prārthayāśu tvaṃ svānyasthīni pradāsyati ||
nādeyaṃ vidyate kiṃcittasya saṃprārthitasya hi || 77 |
tataḥ śakraḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ gatvā tasya tadāśramam ||
prācīsarasvatītīre puṣkare dvijasattamāḥ || 79 |
atha devānsamā lokya saṃprāptānnijamaṃdire ||
dadhīciḥ saṃprahṛṣṭātmā satvaraḥ saṃmukhaṃ yayau || 79 ||
sa praṇamya sahasrākṣaṃ tathānyānapi sanmuniḥ ||
arghyādibhistataḥ pūjāṃ cakre teṣāṃ tataḥ param || 6.8.80 ||
tataḥ provāca hṛṣṭātmā vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ ||
svayameva sahasrākṣaṃ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ || 81 || ||
|| dadhīciruvāca || ||
kimarthamāgatā devāḥ kṛtyaṃ cāśu nivedyatām ||
dhanyo'hamāgato yasya gṛhe tvaṃ balasūdana || 82 ||
|| śakra uvāca || ||
vṛtreṇa nirjitāḥ sarve vayaṃ brāhmaṇasattama ||
sa vadhyo nahi śastrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ varapuṣṭitaḥ | 83 ||
so'sthisaṃbhavavajrasya vadhyaḥ syādabravīddhariḥ||
śatahastapramāṇasya na ca jīvosti tādṛśaḥ || 84 ||
tvāṃ muktvā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha tasmādasthīni yaccha naḥ ||
svakīyāni bhavedyena vajraṃ tasya vināśakam || 85 ||
kuru kṛtyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha devānāmārtināśanam ||
anyathā vibudhāḥ sarve nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ || 86 ||
|| sūta uvāca ||
tacchrutvā saṃprahṛṣṭātmā dadhīcirbhagavānmuniḥ ||
atyajajjīvitaṃ teṣāṃ hitārthāya divaukasām || 87 ||
tato devāḥ prahṛṣṭāste gṛhītvāsthīni kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
tataścakrurmahāvajraṃ yādṛśaṃ viṣṇunoditam || 88 ||
atha śakrastadādāya naimiṣābhimukho yayau ||
bhayena mahatā yukto vepamāno niśāgame || 89 ||
tatra dhyānasthitaṃ vṛtraṃ dūrasthastridaśādhipaḥ ||
vajreṇa tāḍayāmāsa palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ || 6.8.90 ||
so'pi vajaprahāreṇa bhasmasātsama padyata ||
vṛtro dānavaśārdūlo vahniṃ prāpya pataṃgavat || 91 ||
śakro'pi bhayasaṃtrasto gatvā sāgaramadhyagam ||
parvataṃ sudurārohaṃ tuṃgaśṛṃgaṃ samāśritaḥ || || 92 ||
na jānāti hataṃ vṛtraṃ vajraghātena tena tam ||
kevalaṃ vīkṣate mārgaṃ vṛtrāgamanasaṃbhavam || 93 ||
etasminnaṃtare devāḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhāḥ |
sūtraṃ vinihataṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭuvustridaśādhipam || 94 ||
na jānaṃti bhayānnaṣṭaṃ tasminsāgaraparvate |
anviṣya cirakālena kṛcchrātsaṃprāpya taṃ tataḥ|| 95 ||
vīkṣāṃcakruḥ samāsīnaṃ viṣame girigahvare ||
tejohīnaṃ tathā dīnaṃ brahmahatyāpariplutam || 96 ||
gātradurgaṃdhitāsaṃgaiḥ pūrayantaṃ diśo daśa || 97 ||
athovāca caturvaktro dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ tathāvidham ||
samastāndevasaṃghātāndūrasthaḥ pāpaśaṃkayā || 98 ||
śakro'yaṃ vibudhaśreṣṭhā brahmahatyāpariplutaḥ |
tasmātattyājyaḥ sudūreṇa no cetpāpamavāpsyatha || 99 ||
paśyadhvaṃ sarvaliṃgāni brahmahatyānvitāni ca ||
asya gātreṣu dṛśyaṃte tasmādgacchāmahe divi || 6.8.100 ||
pitāmahamukhāndṛṣṭvā devānprāptānsurādhipaḥ ||
parāṅmukhānakasmācca saṃjātānvismayānvitaḥ || 101 ||
tataḥ provāca saṃbhrāṃtaḥ kimidaṃ gamyate surāḥ ||
dṛṣṭvāpi māmanābhāṣya kaccitkṣemaṃ gṛhe mama || 102 ||
kaccitsa nihatastena mama vajreṇa dānavaḥ ||
kaccinna māṃ sa yuddhārthamanveṣa yati durmatiḥ || 103 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
nihataḥ sa tvayā śakra tena vajreṇa dānavaḥ ||
gato mṛtyuvaśaṃ pāpo na bhayaṃ kartumarhasi || 104 ||
paraṃ tasya vadhājjātā brahmahatyā sugarhitā ||
tava śakra na tenādya spṛśāmo'spṛśyatāṃ gatam || 105 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
mayā vinihatāḥ pūrvaṃ bahavaḥ kila dānavāḥ ||
brahmahatyā na saṃjātā mama hatyādhunā katham || 106 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
te tvayā nihatā yuddhe kṣātradharmeṇa vāsava ||
viśuddhā dānavāḥ sarve tena jātaṃ na pātakam || 107 ||
eṣa yajñopavītāḍhyo viśeṣāttapasi sthitaḥ|
chalena nihataḥ śakra tena tvaṃ pāpasaṃyutaḥ || 108 || ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
jānāmyahaṃ caturvaktra svaṃ kāyaṃ pāpasaṃyutam ||
cihnairbrahmavadhodbhūtaistasmācchuddhiṃ vadasva me || 109 ||
yayā yāti drutaṃ pāpaṃ brahmahatyāsamudbhavam ||
spṛśyo bhavāmi sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ prapitāmaha || 6.8.110 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
tīrthayātrāṃ suraśreṣṭha tadarthaṃ kartumarhasi |
tayā vinā na te pāpaṃ nāśamāyāti kṛtsnaśaḥ || 111 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatastadvacanācchakrastīrthayātrāparāyaṇaḥ ||
babhrāma sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ snānaṃ kurvanpṛthakpṛthak || 112 ||
tīrtheṣu suprasiddheṣu nadīnadayuteṣu ca ||
vārāṇasyāṃ prayāge ca prabhāse kurujāṃgale || 113 ||
tathānyeṣu sahasrākṣo vipāpmā na vyajāyata ||
tato vairāgyamāpannaścintayāmāsa cetasi ||14||
ahaṃ snātaḥ samasteṣu tīrtheṣu dharaṇītale||
na ca pāpena nirmuktaḥ kiṃ karomi ca sāṃpratam || 115 ||
kiṃ patāmi gireḥ śṛṃgādviṣaṃ vā bhakṣayāmi kim ||
trailokyarājyavibhraṣṭo nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe || 116 ||
evaṃ vairāgyamāpanno girimāruhya vāsavaḥ ||
yāvatkṣipati cātmānaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ | 117 ||
tāvaddevotthitā vāṇī gaganāddvijasattamāḥ ||
mā śakra sāhasaṃ kārṣīrvairāgyaṃ prāpya cetasi || 118 ||
tvayā rājyaṃ prakartavyaṃ svarge'dyāpi yugāṣṭakam ||
tasmātpāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ śṛṇu śakra samā hitaḥ || 119 ||
kuruṣva vacanaṃ śīghraṃ bhāvanīyaṃ na cānyathā ||
yattvayā pāṃsubhiḥ pūrvaṃ vivaraṃ paripūritaḥ || 6.8.120 ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yatra devaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ ||
tatra nāgabilo jāto valmīkāttridaśādhipa || 121 ||
yena nāgā dharāpṛṣṭhe nirgacchaṃti vrajaṃti ca ||
tena mārgeṇa gatvā tvaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram ||
snātvā pātālagaṃgāyāṃ pūjayasva maheśvaram || 122 ||
tataḥ pāpavinirmukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ||
saṃprāpsyasi ca bhūyo'pi devarājyamakaṇṭakam || 123 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha śakraḥ samākarṇya tāṃ giraṃ gaganotthitām ||
jagāma satvaraṃ tatra yatra nāgabilaḥ sa ca || 124 ||
tataḥ praviśya pātālaṃ gaṃgātoyapariplutaḥ ||
pūjayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam || 125 ||
atha tasya kṣaṇājjātaṃ śarīraṃ malavarjitam ||
durgandhaśca gato nāśaṃ tejovṛddhirbabhūva ha || 126 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptā brahmaviṣṇumukhāḥ surāḥ ||
procuśca devarājaṃ taṃ muktapāpaṃ praharṣitāḥ || 127 ||
prāptastu medhyatāṃ śakra vimukto brahmahatyayā ||
tasmādāgaccha gacchāmaḥ sahitāstridaśālayam || 128 ||
etannāga bilaṃ śakra punaḥ pūraya pāṃsubhiḥ ||
no cedāgatya cānena mānuṣāḥ siddhihetavaḥ || 129 ||
etalliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya snātvā bhāgīrathījale ||
api pāpasamāyuktā yāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim || 6.8.130 ||
tataste tridaśāḥ sarve sa ca devaṃ śatakratuḥ ||
praṇipatya punaḥ proccaiḥ prajagmustridaśālayam ||131||
tato jajñe mahāṃstatra svarge vṛtravadhotsavaḥ ||
devendratvamanuprāpte punaḥ śakre dvijottamāḥ || 132 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhavam ||
māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam || 133 ||
yaścaitatkīrtayedbhaktyā śṛṇoti ca samāhitaḥ ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam|| 134 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vṛtravadhavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || cha ||

<6.9>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha śakraḥ samāhūya proce saṃvartakānilam ||
hāṭakeśvarajekṣetre mahānnāgabilo'sti vai || 1 ||
taṃ pūraya mamādeśāddrutaṃ gatvā'bhipāṃsubhiḥ ||
yena na syādgatistatra kasyacinmṛtyudharmiṇaḥ ||2||
|| vāyuruvāca || ||
tavādeśānmayā pūrvaṃ pūrito vivaro yadā ||
liṃgodbhavastadā śāpaḥ pradatto me purāriṇā || 3 ||
yasmālliṃgaṃ mamaitadvai tvayā pāṃsubhirāvṛtam ||
tasmātsamānadharmā tvaṃ gandhavāho bhaviṣyasi || 4 |
yadvatkarpūrajaṃ gandhaṃ samagraṃ tvaṃ hi vakṣyasi ||
amedhyasaṃbhavaṃ tadvanmama vākyādasaṃśayam ||5||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me viditvaitatsureśvara ||
kṛtye'sminsma ryatāmanyastripurārerbibhemyaham ||6||
tataḥ saṃciṃtayāmāsa pūraṇaṃ tridaśādhipaḥ ||
tasya nāgabilasyaiva naiva kiṃcidavaikṣata ||7||
tatastaṃ prāha devejyaḥsvaya meva śatakratum ||
kasmāttvaṃ vyākulībhūtaḥ kṛtye'smiṃstridaśādhipa || 8 ||
asti parvatamukhyo'tra nāmnā khyāto himālayaḥ ||
tasya putratrayaṃ jātaṃ tacca śakra śṛṇuṣva me || 9 ||
mainākaḥ prathamaḥ prokto dvitīyo naṃdivardhanaḥ||
raktaśṛṃgastṛtīyastu parvataḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 6.9.10 ||
sa mainākaḥ samudrāṃtaḥ praviṣṭaḥ śakra te bhayāt ||
pakṣābhyāṃ sahito'dyāpi sa tatraiva vyavasthitaḥ || 11 ||
naṃdivardhana ityeṣa dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
vasiṣṭhāśramajo randhraste na kṛtsnaḥ prapūritaḥ || 12 ||
himācalasamādeśādvasiṣṭhasya ca sanmuneḥ ||
devabhūmiṃ parityajya sa gatastatra satvaram || 13 ||
tṛtīyastiṣṭhate'dyāpi raktaśṛṃgaḥ smṛto'tra yaḥ ||
tamānaya sahasrākṣa bilaṃ sārpaṃ prapūraya || 14 ||
nānyathā pūrituṃ śakyo bilo'yaṃ tridaśādhipa ||
taṃ muktvā parvata śreṣṭhaṃ satyametanmayoditam || 15 ||
|| sūta uvāca ||
tacchrutvā devapūjyasya vacanaṃ tridaśādhipaḥ ||
jagāma satvaraṃ tatra sa yatrāste himālayaḥ || || 16 ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ gatvā sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ ||
himācalaṃ giriśreṣṭhaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam || 17 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mahānnāgabilaḥ sthitaḥ ||
tena gatvā narā devaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram || 18 ||
pūjayiṣyaṃti ye kecidapi pāpaparāyaṇāḥ ||
mayā sārdhaṃ kariṣyaṃti tataḥ sparddhāṃ nagottama || 19 ||
tasmātputramimaṃ tatra raktaśṛṃgaṃ himālaya ||
preṣayasva bilo yena pūryate so'hisaṃbhavaḥ || 6.9.20 ||
kuruṣva tvaṃ mamātithyaṃ gṛhaprāptasya parvata ||
ātmaputrapradānena kīrtiṃ prāpsyasyalaukikīm || 21 ||
bāḍhamityeva so'pyuktvā pūjayitvā ca devapam ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ putraṃ raktaśṛṃgaṃ himālayaḥ || 22 ||
tavārthāya sahasrākṣaḥ putra prāpto mamāṃtikam ||
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ tatra yatra nāgabilaḥ sthitaḥ || 23 ||
pūrayitvā mamādeśāttaṃ tvaṃ śakrasya kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
sukhī bhava sahānena tathānyaiḥ surasattamaiḥ || 24 ||
|| raktaśṛṃga uvāca || ||
nāhaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi martya bhūmau kathaṃcana ||
yatra kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā rūkṣāḥ phalavivarjitāḥ || 25 ||
na siddhā na ca gaṃdharvā na devā na ca kiṃnarāḥ ||
na ca tīrthāni ramyāṇi na nadyo vimalodakāḥ || 26 ||
tathā pāpasamācārā manuṣyāḥ śīlavarjitāḥ ||
duṣṭacittāḥ sadā sarve tiryagyonigatā api || 27 ||
tathā mama nagaśreṣṭha pakṣau dvāvapi kartitau ||
śakreṇa tena no śaktirgaṃtumasti kathaṃcana || 28 ||
tasmātkaṃcitsahasrākṣa upāyaṃ tatkṛte param ||
ciṃtayatveva māṃ muktvā satyametanmayoditam || 29 ||
|| śakra uvāca|| ||
aha tvāṃ tatra neṣyāmi svahastena vidāritam ||
tatrāpi suśubhā vṛkṣā bhaviṣyaṃti tavāśrayāḥ || 6.9.30 ||
tathā puṇyāni tīrthāni devatāyatanāni ca ||
samaṃtātte bhaviṣyaṃti munīnāmāśramāstathā || 31 ||
atrasthasya prabhāvo yastava parvata naṃdana ||
madvākyāttatra saṃsthasya koṭisaṃkhyo bhaviṣyati || 32 ||
tathā ye mānavāstatra pāpātmāno'pi bhūtale ||
vipāpmāno bhaviṣyaṃti sahasā tava darśanāt || 33 ||
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ tatra mayā sārdhaṃ nagātmaja ||
na cedvajraprahāreṇa kariṣyāmi sahasradhā || 34 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā raktaśṛṃgo bhayānvitaḥ||
praviṣṭaḥ sahasāgatya tasminnāgabile gataḥ || 35 ||
nimagno brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā nāsāgraṃ yāvadeva hi ||
śṛṃgairmanoramaistuṃ gaiḥ samagraiḥ sahitastadā ||
vṛkṣagulmalatākīrṇai ramyapakṣiniṣevitaiḥ || 36 ||
evaṃ saṃsthāpya taṃ śakro himācalasutaṃ nagam ||
tataḥ provāca sahṛṣṭo varo mattaḥ pragṛhyatām || 37 ||
|| raktaśṛṃga uvāca || ||
eṣa eva varo'smākaṃ yattvaṃ tuṣṭaḥ sureśvara ||
kiṃ vareṇa kariṣyāmi tvatprasādādahaṃ sukhī || 38 || ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syādapi svapne nagātmaja ||
kiṃ punardarśane jāte kṛte kṛtye viśeṣataḥ||39||
|| raktaśṛṃga uvāca || ||
avaśyaṃ yadi deyo me varaḥ sarvasurādhipa ||
vibhavo me dvijārthāya sarvaḥ syātsarvadā vibho ||6.9.40||
|| indra uvāca || ||
bhaviṣyati mahīpālaścamatkāra iti smṛtaḥ ||
tava mūrdhani viprārthaṃ sa puraṃ sthāpayiṣyati || 41 ||
tatra brāhmaṇaśārdūlā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ||
vibhavaṃ tava niḥśeṣaṃ bhajiṣyaṃti praharṣitāḥ || 42 ||
tathāhaṃ caitramāsasya caturdaśyāṃ nagātmaja||
kṛṣṇāyāṃ svayamāgatya śṛṃge mukhyatame tava||43||
pūjayiṣyāmi deveśaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ||
sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ tathā kiṃnaraguhyakaiḥ ||44||
tamekaṃ divasaṃ cātra śṛṃge tava haraḥ svayam||
asmābhiḥ sahitastuṣṭo nivāsaṃ prakariṣyati || 45 ||
prabhāvastena te mukhya strailokye'pi bhaviṣyati ||
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ tridivālayam||46||
|| sūta uvāca ||
evamuktvā sahasrākṣastataḥ prāptastriviṣṭapam||
raktaśṛṃgo'pi tasthau ca vyāpya nāgabilaṃ tadā ||47||
tasyopari sumukhyāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ||
saṃjātāni munīnāṃ ca saṃjātāśca tathā''śramāḥ || ||48||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgabilapūrtivarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ||9||

<6.10>

|| sūta uvāca ||
ānarttādhipatirbhūpaścamatkāra iti smṛtaḥ ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptastatra haṃtuṃ vane mṛgān ||1||
sa dadarśa mṛgīṃ dūrānniścalāṃgīṃ taroradhaḥ ||
stanaṃ sutāya yacchaṃtīṃ viśvastāmakutobhayām || 2 ||
atha tāṃ pārthivastūrṇaṃ śareṇānataparvaṇā ||
jaghānākarṇakṛṣṭena marmasthāne praharṣitaḥ || 3 ||
sahasā sā hatā tena gārddhrapatreṇa patriṇā ||
diśo vilokayāmāsa samaṃtādvyathayārditā || 4 ||
atha dṛṣṭvā mahīpālaṃ nātidūre dhanurdharam ||
provācāśrupariklinnavadanā sutavatsalā || 5 ||
|| mṛgyuvāca || ||
ayuktaṃ pṛthivīpāla yattvayaitadanuṣṭhitam ||
hatā'haṃ bālavatsā'dya śareṇānataparvaṇā ||6||
nā'haṃ śocāmi bhūpāla maraṇaṃ svaśarīragam ||
yathemaṃ vālakaṃ dīnaṃ kṣīrāsvādanalaṃpaṭam || 7 ||
yasmāttvayedṛśaṃ karma nirdayaṃ samanuṣṭhitam ||
kuṣṭhavyādhisamāyuktastasmātsadyo bhaviṣyasi || 8 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
svadharma eṣa bhūpānāṃ kurvaṃti mṛgasaṃkṣayam ||
tasmātsvadharmasaṃyuktaṃ na māṃ tvaṃ śaptumarhasi || 9 ||
|| mṛgyuvāca || ||
satyametanmahīpāla yattvayā parikīrtitam ||
kṣattriyāṇāṃ vadhārthāya mṛgāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā || 6.10.10||
paraṃ tena vidhisteṣāṃkṛto yastaṃ mahīpate ||
śṛṇuṣvā'vahito bhūtvā vadaṃtyā mama sāṃpratam || 11 ||
suptaṃ maithunasaṃyuktaṃ stanapānakriyodyatam ||
hatvā mṛgaṃ jalāsaktaṃ naraḥ pāpena lipyate || 12 ||
etasmātkāraṇācchāpastava datto mayā nṛpa ||
na kāmato na mṛtyorvā satyenātmānamālabhe || 13 ||
evamuktvā mṛgī prāṇānsā mumoca vyathānvitā ||
kuṣṭhavyādhisamāyuktaḥ so'pi rājā babhūva ha || 14 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā kuṣṭhasaṃyuktaṃ pārthivaḥ svaṃ kalevaram||
tataḥ svānsevakānāha samāhūya suduḥkhitaḥ || 15 ||
ahaṃ tapaścariṣyāmi pūjayiṣyāmi śaṃkaram ||
tāvadyāvatpraṇāśo me kuṣṭhavyādherbhaviṣyati || 16 ||
yatkiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu prārthayaṃti narāḥ sukham ||
tatsarvaṃ tapasā sādhyaṃ tasmātkāryaṃ mayā tapaḥ || 17 || adhunaiko'hamaikāhamekaikasminvanaspatau ||
caranbhaikṣaṃ tu niyamaiścariṣyāmi dharātale||18||
pāṃsunā samavacchanne śūnyāgāre pratiśrayaḥ ||
vṛkṣamūlanikete vā muktasarvapriyāpriyaḥ ||19||

tatrā'sau snānamātreṇa tatkṣaṇātpārthivotamaḥ ||
kuṣṭhavyādhivi nirmuktaḥ saṃjātaḥ sumahādyutiḥ || 24 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śaṃkhatīrthamāhātmye camatkāranṛpatikuṣṭhanivṛttivṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| brāhmaṇā ūtruḥ || ||

tato harṣaṃ paraṃ gatvā praṇipatya ca taṃ bhuvi ||
kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ sa mene pārthivottamaḥ || 25 ||
adyāpi dṛśyate chāyā tādṛgrūpā sadā hi sā ||
tasya liṃgasya viprendrā jātā vismayakāriṇī || 26 ||
ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare mṛtyuryasya syādbhuvi bho dvijāḥ ||
na sa paśyati tāṃ chāyāmeṣo'nyaḥ pratyayaḥ paraḥ || 27 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra sarvadaiva vyavasthitaḥ ||
acaleśvararūpeṇa camatkārapurāṃtike || 28 ||
niścalatvena deveśohyaṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu madhyamaḥ ||
kṣetrāṇāṃ vasate tatra tasya vākyānmaheśvaraḥ || 29 ||
tena tatpāvanaṃ kṣetraṃ sarveṣāmiha kīrtitam ||
kāmadaṃ muktidaṃ caiva jāyate sarvadehinām || 6.13.30 ||
tathānyadapi yadvṛttaṃ vṛttāṃtaṃ tatprabhāvajam ||
tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 31 ||
acaleśvaramāhātmyāttasminkṣetre narā drutam||
vāṃchitaṃ manasaḥ sarve labhaṃte sakalaṃ phalam || 32 ||
svargameke pare mokṣaṃ dhanadhānyasutāṃstathā ||
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya pūjayedacaleśvaram||
taṃtaṃ sa labhate martyaḥ svalpāyāsena ca drutam || 33 ||
atha dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaḥ sarve pāpanarā bhuvi ||
svargaṃ yāṃti tathā mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti ca sammukham || 34 ||
tataḥ krodhaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca lobhaṃ dveṣaṃ bhayaṃ ratim ||
mohaṃ ca vyasanaṃ durgaṃ matsaraṃ rāgameva ca || 35 ||
sarvānmūrtānsamāhūya tataḥ provāca sādaram||
svayameva sahasrākṣo rahasye dvijasattamāḥ || 36 |
naro vā yadi vā nārī camatkārapuraṃ prati ||
yo gacchati dharāpṛṣṭhe yuṣmābhirvārya eva saḥ || 37 ||
tatraiva vasamāno'pi yo gacchedacaleśvaram ||
madvākyātsa viśeṣeṇa sarvairvāryaḥ prayatnataḥ || 38 ||
te tatheti pratijñāya gatvā śakrasya śāsanāt ||
cakrustataḥ samucchinnaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ gataṃ bhuvi || 39 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātamākhyānaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
acaleśvaradevasya tasminkṣetre nivāsinaḥ || 6.13.40 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'caleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśodhyāyaḥ || || 13 || || ||

<6.14>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
yadanyattatra sañjātamāścaryaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
tadahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam || 1 ||
camatkārapure kaścidvaiśyajātisamudbhavaḥ ||
babhūva puruṣo mūko daridreṇa samanvitaḥ || 2 ||
yo dauḥsthyātsarvalokānāṃ karoti paśurakṣaṇam ||
kuṭumbabharaṇārthāya saṃtuṣṭo yenakenacit || 3 ||
kadācidrakṣatastasya paśūṃstānvanabhūmiṣu ||
paśureko viniṣkrāṃtaḥ svayūthāttṛṇalobhataḥ ||4||
kṛṣṇa pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ caitramāse dvijottamāḥ ||
na tadā lakṣitastena gacchamāno yadṛcchayā || 5 ||
atha yāvadgṛhaṃ prāptaḥ sa mūkaḥ paśupālakaḥ ||
tāvattasya ca goḥ svāmī bhartsayansamupāgataḥ || 6 ||
kiṃ pāpa na samāyātaḥ paśureko'dya no yathā ||
nūnaṃ tvayā hataḥ so'pi vikrīto'pihito'thavā ||
tasmā dānaya me kṣipraṃ nirāhāro'pi gāṃ tvarāt || 7 ||
tacchrutvā bhayasaṃtrastaḥ sa mūkaḥ paśupālakaḥ ||
niṣkrāṃto yaṣṭimādāya nirāhāro'pi mandirāt || || 8 ||
tato'raṇyaṃ samāsādya vīkṣāṃcakre samaṃtataḥ ||
sūkṣmadṛṣṭyā sa durgāṇi gahanāni vanāni ca | 9 ||
atha tena kvaciddṛṣṭaṃ padaṃ tasya paśoḥ sphuṭam ||
aṭavyāṃ bhramamāṇena parijñātaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ || 6.14.10 ||
tataśca tatpadānveṣī sa jagāma vanādvanam ||
camatkārapurasyāsya samaṃtāddvijasatta māḥ || 11 ||
evaṃ pradakṣiṇā tasya jātā paśudidṛkṣayā ||
sthānasya caiva nirveśe paśoścāpidvijottamāḥ || 12 ||
pradakṣiṇāvasāne ca paśurlabdho hi tena saḥ ||
niśāṃte'tha gṛhaṃ nītvā svāmine viniveditaḥ || 13 ||
caitre puṇyatame māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm ||
kṣetre puṇyatame devāstīrthānyā yāṃti sarvaśaḥ || 14 ||
evamajñānabhāvena kṛtā tābhyāṃ pradakṣiṇā ||
paśupālapaśubhyāṃ vai supuṇye tatra vāsare || 15 ||
nirāhārasya mūkasya sāhārasya paśostathā || 16 ||
vinā snānena bhakṣācca daivāddvijavarottamāḥ ||
tataḥ kāle vyatikrāṃte kiyanmātre svakarmataḥ ||
ubhau paṃcatvamāpannau pṛthaktvenāyuṣaḥ kṣaye || 17 ||
tataśca paśupālastu daśārṇādhipateḥ sutaḥ ||
saṃjātastatprabhāvena pūrvajātimanusmaran || 18 ||
so'pi jajñe paśustasya sacivo dvijasattamāḥ |
jātismaro yathā rājā sarvadā nṛpasaṃmataḥ||19||
athāgatya sa rājeṃdrastenaiva saha maṃtriṇā ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ purastasyāḥ pradakṣiṇām || 6.14.20 ||
cakre saṃvatsarasyāṃte śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ||
nirāhāraśca maunena padātirdvijasattamāḥ || 21 ||
ekadā tatra cā''yātā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ||
tīrthe pāpahare puṇye viśvāmitrasamudbhave || 22 ||
yājñavalkyo bharadvājaḥ śunaḥśepo'tha gālavaḥ ||
devalo bhāgurirdhaumyaḥ kaśya paścyavano bhṛguḥ || 23 ||
tathānye śaṃsitā''tmāno brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ ||
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tasminkṣetre samāgatāḥ || 24 ||
tāndṛṣṭvā sa mahīpālaḥ praṇipatya kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||
yathājyeṣṭhaṃ yathāśreṣṭhaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 25 ||
tatasteṣāṃ sa madhye ca saṃniviṣṭo mahīpatiḥ ||
tathāgataḥ sa bhūpālaḥ sarvai staiścābhinaṃditaḥ || 26 ||
tataścakruḥ kathā divyā munayaste mahīpateḥ |
purato munimukhyānāṃ caritāni mahātmanām || 27 ||
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ dharmaśāstrasamudbhavāḥ ||
ānaṃdaṃ tasya rājarṣerjanayaṃto dvijottamāḥ || 28 ||
atha kvā'pi kathāṃte sa pārthivastairmaharṣibhiḥ ||
pṛṣṭaḥ kautūhalāviṣṭairdattvā śrautīstadāśiṣaḥ || 29 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
varṣevarṣe mahīpāla tvamatrā''gatya yatnataḥ ||
karoṣi maṃtriṇā sārdhaṃ purasyā'sya pradakṣiṇām || || 6.14.30 ||
asminkṣetre sutīrthāni saṃti pārthivasattama ||
tathā'nyāni prasiddhāni devatāyatanāni ca | 31 ||
ādarasteṣu vai rājannāsti svalpo 'pi karhicit ||
etannaḥ kautukaṃ jātaṃ na cedguhyaṃ prakīrtaya || 32 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vinayā'vanataḥ sthitaḥ ||
sa provāca vaco bhūpaḥ kiṃcidvrīḍāsamanvitaḥ||33||
yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijaśreṣṭhā yuṣmābhiḥ sāṃprataṃ mama ||
tadguhyaṃ na mayā''khyātaṃ kasyaciddharaṇītale ||34||
tathā'pi hi prakartavyaṃ yuṣmākaṃ satyameva hi ||
api guhyatamaṃ cetsyācchṛṇvaṃtu munisattamāḥ || 35 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa pūrvajātisamudbhavam ||
vṛttāṃtaṃ tanmunīṃdrāṇāṃ teṣāṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ || 36 ||
yathā naṣṭaḥ paśustasya kṛtā yadvadavekṣaṇā ||
yathā pradakṣiṇā jātā camatkārapurasya tu | 37 ||
jātismṛtiryathā jātā prāktanī tatprabhāvataḥ ||
rājyaprāptirvibhūtiśca tatheṣṭāptiḥ padepade || 38 ||
tacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve prahṛṣṭāḥ pṛthivīpateḥ ||
āśīrvādānbahūndattvā sādhusādhviti cā'bruvan || 39 ||
samutthāya tataścakruḥ purastasyāḥ pradakṣiṇām ||
yathoktavidhinā sarve śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ || 6.14.40 ||
gatāśca paramāṃ siddhiṃ tatprabhāvātsudurlabhām ||
japayajñapradānairyā tīrthasevādikairapi || 41 ||
so'pi rājā sa mantrī ca jātau vaimānikau surau ||
adyā'pi tau hi dṛśyete tārārūpau nabhastale || 42 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye camatkārapurapradakṣiṇāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||

<6.15>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kimetatkāraṇaṃ sūta yenaitatprāpyate nṛbhiḥ ||
śreyaḥ paraṃ purasyā'sya sakṛtkṛtvā pradakṣiṇām || 1 ||
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate ||
atra kautūhalaṃ jātaṃ sarvaṃ tvaṃ vetsyaśeṣataḥ || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
raktaśṛṃga iti khyāto yaḥ sa parvatasattamaḥ ||
tatprabhāvādiha śreyo labhyate dvijasattamāḥ || 3 ||
tatra kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ caitramāse sadaiva hi ||
samāśrayaṃ prakurvaṃti brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ || 4 ||
sarve devāśca tīrthāni sarvāṇyāya tanāni ca ||
tathā nadyaḥ samudrāśca yaccānyadapi pāvanam || 5 ||
tatsarvaṃ vāsare tasminsāṃnidhyaṃ tatra parvate ||
raktaśṛṃge karotyeva tasyā''deśācchata kratoḥ || 6 ||
yadeṃdreṇa samānītastasmindeśe sa parvataḥ ||
tadā prokto dine devāḥ sameṣyaṃti tavāṃtikam || 7 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyā nyāyatanāni ca ||
camatkārapuraṃ tasya mukhyaśṛṃge vyavasthitam ||
tena tatprāpyate śreyaḥ sakṛtkṛtvā pradakṣiṇām || 8 ||
tasmindine ca yatkiṃciddīyate dānamādarāt ||
tadakṣayaṃ bhavedviprā yāvaccaṃdradivākarau || 9 ||
paramānnena yaḥ kaścidbrāhmaṇānbhojayennaraḥ||
pitṝnuddiśya sadbhaktyā sa gayāphalamāpnuyāt || 6.15.10 ||
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyankurute'tra pradakṣiṇām||
sa taṃ kāmamavāpnoti niṣkāmo muktimānbhavet || 11 ||
yastu sopaskarāṃ dhenuṃ pradadyādbrāhmaṇottame ||
saṃpūrṇapṛthivīdānaphalamāpnoti puṣkalam || 12 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ||
pradakṣiṇākṛtaṃ śreyo yathā saṃprāpyate nṛbhiḥ || 13 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryā tasya pradakṣiṇā ||
purasya caitrakṛṣṇāyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ samāhitaiḥ || 14 ||
upavāsaparaiḥ śāṃtairmaunavrataparāyaṇaiḥ ||
śucibhiḥ śuklavastraiśca rāgadveṣavivarjitaiḥ || 15 ||
mūkatvātpaśupālasya maunaṃ jātaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
paśoravācakatvācca hyanayoḥ śraddhayā vinā || 16 ||
upavāsaśca saṃjātaḥ paśupālasya tasya ca ||
bhayena paśusaktasya svāminaḥ śraddhayā na tu || 17 ||
saṃjātā bhramamā ṇasya paśorarthe pradakṣiṇā |
tathā'pi tādṛśaṃ jātamubhābhyāṃ phalamuttamam || 18 ||
yaḥ punaḥ śraddhayopeta upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ||
maunena kurute martyaḥ purasyā'sya pradakṣiṇām ||
daśārṇādhipavatsvarge sa vimānacaro bhavet || 19 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāharasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye camatkārapurapradakṣiṇāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||15||

<6.16>

|| || sūta uvāca || ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tyaktvā'nyā nikhilāḥ kriyāḥ ||
raktaśṛṃgasya sāṃnidhyaṃ sevanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 1 ||
kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ kriyākāṃḍaiḥ kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ vratairapi ||
tatkṣetraṃ sevayedbhaktyā hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhavam ||2||
agniṣṭomādayo yajñāḥ sarve saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāḥ ||
tasya kṣetrasya purataḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 3 ||
cāndrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā sāṃtapanāni ca ||
tasya kṣetrasya purataḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm||4||
prabhāsādyāni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritastathā ||
tasya kṣetrasya purataḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm||5||
bhūmidānāni sarvāṇi dharmāḥ sarve dayādikāḥ||
tasya kṣetrasya purataḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm||6||
tatra rājarṣayaḥ pūrvaṃ prabhūtāḥ siddhimāgatāḥ ||
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarpāḥ siṃhavyāghrā mṛgādayaḥ ||7||
tatra kālavaśānnaṣṭāste'pi prāptā divālayam ||
yastatra vratahīno'pi kṛṣikarmarato'pi vā ||9||
nivāsaṃ kurute viprā mṛtastatra divaṃ vrajet ||
kiṃvā ca bahunoktena bhūyobhūyo dvijottamāḥ ||9||
śrūyatāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ tasya kṣetrasya saṃbhavam ||
punaṃti kṣetratīrthāni saṃvāsādiha mānavān || 6.16.10 ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ punāti smaraṇādapi ||
kiṃ punardarśanādviprāḥ sparśanācca viśeṣataḥ || 11 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye raktaśṛṅgasāṃnidhyasevanaphalaśraiṣṭhyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo' dhyāyaḥ||16||

<6.17>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
camatkārapurotpattiḥ śrutā tvatto mahāmate ||
tatkṣetrasya pramāṇaṃ yattadasmākaṃ prakīrtaya ||1||
yāni tatra ca puṇyāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ||
sahitāni prabhāveṇa tāni sarvāṇi kīrtaya || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
pañcakrośapramāṇena kṣetraṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
āyāmavyāsataścaiva camatkārapurottamam || 3 ||
prācyāṃ tasya gayāśīrṣaṃ paścimena hareḥ padam ||
dakṣiṇottarayoścaiva gokarṇeśvarasaṃjñitau ||4||
hāṭakeśvara saṃjñaṃ tu pūrvamāsīddvijottamāḥ ||
tatkṣetraṃ prathitaṃ loke sarvapātakanāśanam || 5 ||
yataḥ prabhṛti viprebhyo dattaṃ tena mahātmanā ||
camatkāreṇa tatsthānaṃ nāmnā khyātiṃ tato gatam || 6 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ tasya pūrve gayāśiraḥ ||
māhātmyaṃ tasya no brūhi sūtaputra savistaram || 7 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
āsīdvidūrathonāma haihayādhipatiḥ purā ||
yo vai dānapatirdakṣaḥ śatrupakṣakṣayāvahaḥ || 8 ||
sa kadācinmṛgānhaṃtuṃ nṛpaḥ senāvṛto yayau ||
nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇaṃ vanaṃ śvāpadasaṃkulam || 9 ||
sa jaghāna mṛgāṃstatra śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ ||
mahiṣāṃścavarāhāṃśca tarakṣūñcchambarānrurūn || 6.17.10 ||
siṃhānvyāghrāngajānmattāñcchataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||
atha tena mṛgo viddhaḥ śareṇā''nataparvaṇā || 11 ||
na papāta dharāpṛṣṭhe saśaro dudruve drutam||
tataḥ sa kautukāviṣṭastasya pṛṣṭhe hayottamam ||
prerayāmāsa vegena manomārutavegadhṛk || 12 ||
tataḥ sainyaṃ samutsajya mṛgaṃ lipsurmahīpatiḥ ||
anyadvanāṃtaraṃ prāpto raudraṃ cittabhayāvaham || 13 ||
kaṇṭakībadarīprāyaṃ śālmalīvanasaṃkulam ||
tathānyaiḥ kaṇṭakākīrṇai rūkṣai rvṛkṣaiḥ samanvitam || 14 ||
tatra rūkṣā'khilā bhūmirnirjalā tamasā vṛtā ||
cīrikolūkagṛdhāḍhyā śīrṣacchāyāvivarjitā || 15 ||
grīṣme madhyagate sūrye mṛgākṛṣṭaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ||
dūrādhvānaṃ jagāmā'tha prāsapāṇirvarāśvagaḥ || 16 ||
tena tasyānugā bhṛtyāḥ sarve suśrāṃtavāhanāḥ ||
kṣutpipāsākulāḥ śrāṃtāḥ sthāne sthāne samāśritāḥ || 17 ||
siṃhavyāghraistathā cānyaiḥ patitā naṣṭacetanāḥ ||
bhakṣyaṃte cetayanto'pi tathā'nye calanākṣamāḥ || 18 ||
tataḥ so'pi mahīpālaḥ kṣutpipāsāsamākulaḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā tadvyasanaṃ prāptamātmanaḥ sevakaiḥ samam || 19 ||
kāṃtārasyāṃtamanvicchanprerayāmāsa taṃ hayam||
jātyaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ kaśāghātaiḥ pratāḍayan || 6.17.20 ||
tataḥ sa nṛpatistena vāyuvegena vājinā ||
nīto dūraṃ durgamārgaṃ sarvajaṃtuvivarjitam || 21 ||
evaṃ tasya narendrasya kāṃdiśīke'navasthite ||
so'śvo'pataddharāpṛṣṭhe so'pyadhastātturaṃgamāt || 22 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vidūrathamṛgayāvarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || || cha || ||

<6.18>

sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ so'pi mahīpālaḥ kṣutpipāmāsamākulaḥ ||
papāta dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe padbhyāṃ gatvā vanāṃtaram || 1 ||
athā'paśyadviyatsthānātsa trīnpretānsu dāruṇān ||
ūrdhvakeśānsuraktākṣānkṛṣṇadantānkṛśodarān || 2 ||
tāndṛṣṭvā bhayasaṃtrasto viśeṣeṇa sa bhūpatiḥ ||
nirāśo jīvite kṛcchrādidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 3 ||
ke yūyaṃ vikṛtākārā mayā dṛṣṭā na karhicit ||
evaṃvidhā nṛloke'tra bhramatā prāgvibhīṣaṇāḥ || 4 ||
vidūratho narendro'haṃ kṣutpipāsātipīḍitaḥ ||
mṛgalipsuriha prāpto vane jantuvivarjite || 5 ||
tatasteṣāṃ tu yo jyeṣṭho māṃsādaḥ pratyuvāca tam ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ | 6 ||
vayaṃ pretā mahārāja nivasāmo'tra kānane ||
svakarmajanitāddoṣādduḥkhena mahatā vṛtāḥ || 7 ||
ahaṃ māṃsādakonāma dvitīyo'yaṃ vidaivataḥ ||
kṛtaghnaśca tṛtīyastu trayāṇāmeṣa pāpakṛt || 8 |
||rājovāca || ||
sarveṣāṃ dehi nāṃ nāma jāyate pitṛmātṛjam ||
kimetatkāraṇaṃ yena sarve yūyaṃ svanāmakāḥ || 9 ||
tacchrutvā prāha māṃsādaḥ karmanāmāni pārthiva ||
mithaḥ kṛtāni saṃjñārthamasmābhiḥ svayameva hi | 6.18.10 ||
śṛṇuṣvā'vahito bhūtvā sarveṣāṃ naḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||
karmaṇā yena saṃjātaṃ pretatvamiha bhūmipa || 11 ||
vayaṃ hi brāhmaṇā jātyā vaidiśākhye pure nṛpa ||
devarātasya viprasya gṛhe jātā mahātmanaḥ || 12 ||
nāstikā bhinnamaryādāḥ paradāraratāḥ sadā ||
pāpa karmaratāstatra śubhakarmavivarjitāḥ || 13 ||
jihvālaulyaprasaṃgena mayā bhuktaṃ sadā''miṣam ||
tena me karmajaṃ nāma māṃsādākhyaṃ vyavasthitam || 14 ||
dvitīyo'yaṃ mahārāja yastiṣṭhati tavā'grataḥ ||
anenā'nnaṃ sadā bhuktamakṛtvā devatārcanam || 15 ||
tena karmavipākena pretayoniṃ samāśritaḥ ||
vidaivata iti khyāto dvitīyo'yaṃ supāpakṛt || 16 ||
sadaivā'nuṣṭhitā'nena supāpena kṛtaghnatā ||
kṛtaghnaḥ procyate tena karmaṇā nṛpasattama || 17 || ||
|| rājovāca || ||
āhāreṇa nṛloke'sminsarve jīvanti jantavaḥ ||
yuṣmākaṃ katamo yo'tra procyatāṃ me savistaram || 18 ||
|| māṃsāda uvāca || ||
bhojyakāle gṛhe yatra strīṇāṃ yuddhaṃ pravartate |
api mantrauṣadhīprāyaṃ pretā bhuṃjati tatra hi || 19 ||
bhujyate yatra bhūpāla veṃśvadevaṃ vinā naraiḥ ||
pākasyāgramadattvā ca pretā bhuṃjati tatra ca || 6.18.20 ||
rātrau yatkriyate śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ vā parvavarjitam||
tatsarvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla pretānāṃ bhojanaṃ bhavet|| || 21 ||
yasminno mārjanaṃ harmye kriyate nopalepanam ||
na māṃgalyaṃ ca satkāraḥ pretā bhuṃjati tatra hi || 22 ||
bhinnabhāṇḍaparityāgo yatra na kriyate gṛhe ||
na ca vedadhvaniryatra pretā bhuñjaṃti tatra hi ||23||
yacchrāddhaṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ ca vā nṛpa ||
tathā rajasvalādṛṣṭaṃ tadasmākaṃ prajāyate||24||
hīnāṃgā hyadhikāṃgā vā yasmiñcchrāddhe dvijātayaḥ ||
bhuṃjate vṛṣalīnāthāstadasmākaṃ prajāyate || 25 ||
atithiryatra saṃprāptaḥ śrāddhakāla upasthite ||
apūjito gṛhādyāti tacchrāddhaṃ pretatṛptidam ||26||
kiṃ vā te bahunoktena śṛṇu saṃkṣepato nṛpa ||
asmākaṃ bhojanaṃ nityaṃ yattvaṃ śrutvā vigarhasi ||27||
yadannaṃ keśasūtrāsthiśleṣmādibhirupaplutam ||
hīnajātyaiśca saṃspṛṣṭaṃ tadasmākaṃ prajāyate || 28 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
kena karmavipākena pretatvaṃ jāyate nṛṇām||
etanme sarvamācakṣva māṃsāda mama pṛcchataḥ ||29||
|| māṃsāda uvāca || ||
yo bhavenmānavaḥ kṣudrastathā paiśunyasūcakaḥ ||
mṛṣṭamāṃsāśane saktaḥ sa preto jāyate naraḥ ||6.18.30||
akṛtvā devakāryaṃ ca tathā ca pitṛtarpaṇam||
yo'śnātyadattvā bhṛtyebhyaḥ sa preto jāyate naraḥ ||31||
paradārarataścaiva paravittāpahārakaḥ ||
parāpavādasaṃtuṣṭaḥ sa preto jāyate naraḥ ||32||
kanyāṃ yacchati vṛddhāya nīcāya dhanalipsayā ||
kurūpāya kuśīlāya sa preto jāyate naraḥ || 33 ||
kule jātāṃ vinītāṃ ca dharmapatnīṃ sukhocchritām ||
yastyajeddoṣanirmuktāṃ sa preto jāyate naraḥ || 34 ||
devastrīguruvittāni yo gṛhītvā na yacchati ||
viśeṣādbrāhmaṇasvaṃ ca sa preto jāyate naraḥ || 35 ||
paravyasanasaṃtuṣṭaḥ kṛtaghno gurutalpagaḥ ||
dūṣako devaviprāṇāṃ sa preto jāyate naraḥ || 36 ||
dīyamānasya vittasya brāhmaṇebhyaḥ supāpakṛt ||
vighnamārabhate yastu sa preto jāyate naraḥ || 37 ||
śūdrānnenodarasthena brāhmaṇo mriyate yadi ||
sa preto jāyate rājanyadyapi syātṣaḍaṃgavit || 38 ||
kuladeśocitaṃ dharmaṃ yastyaktvā'nyatsamācaret ||
kāmādvā yadi vā lobhātsa preto jāyate naraḥ || 39 ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā pārthivasattama ||
yena karmavipākena pretaḥ saṃjāyate naraḥ || 6.18.40 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
kṛtena karmaṇā yena na preto jāyate naraḥ ||
tanme kīrtaya māṃsāda vistareṇa viśeṣataḥ || 41 ||
|| māṃsāda uvāca || ||
mātṛvatparadārānyaḥ paradravyāṇi loṣṭavat ||
yaḥ paśyatyātmavajjaṃtūnna preto jāyate naraḥ || 42 ||
annadānaparo nityaṃ viśeṣeṇātithipriyaḥ ||
svādhyāyavrataśīlo yo na preto jāyate naraḥ || 43 ||
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanaḥ ||
samo mānāpamāneṣu na preto jāyate naraḥ || 44 ||
dānadharmapravṛttānāṃ dharmamārgā nuyāyinām ||
protsāhaṃ vardhayedyastu na preto jāyate naraḥ || 49 ||
yūkāmatkuṇadaṃśādīnsarvasattvāni yo naraḥ ||
putravatpālayennityaṃ na preto jāyate naraḥ || 46 ||
sadā yajñakriyopetaḥ sadā tīrthaparāyaṇaḥ ||
śāstraśravaṇasaṃyukto na preto jāyate naraḥ || 47 ||
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāmārāmāṇāṃ viśe ṣataḥ ||
āropakaḥ prapāṇāṃ ca na preto jāyate naraḥ || 48 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ svaguhyaṃ vasudhādhipa ||
nirviṇṇāḥ pretabhāvena tasmāttvaṃ no gatirbhava || 49 ||
gatvā gayāśiraḥ puṇyamekaikasya pṛthakpṛthak ||
śrāddhaṃ dehi mahīpāla trayāṇāmapi sādaram || 6.18.50 ||
pretatvaṃ yāti yenedaṃ tvatpra sādātsudāruṇam ||
nā'nyathā muktirasmākaṃ bhaviṣyati kathaṃcana || 51 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
īdṛgjātismṛtiryasyāṃ pretayonau ca khe gatiḥ ||
dharmādharmaparijñānaṃ tacca kasmātpraniṃdasi || 52 ||
|| māṃsāda uvāca || ||
pretayoniriyaṃ rājannavamī devasaṃjñitā ||
guṇatrayasamāyuktā śeṣairdoṣaiḥ samaṃtataḥ || 53 ||
ekā jātismṛtiḥ samyagasyāmevaprajāyate ||
khecaratvaṃ tathaivānyaddharmādharmaviniścayaḥ || 54 ||
etadguṇatrayaṃ proktaṃ pretayonau nṛpottama ||
doṣānapi ca te vacmi tāñcchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ || 55 ||
yadi tāvadvanādasmādyāmonyatra vayaṃ nṛpa ||
adṛṣṭamudgarāghātairnūnaṃ hanyāmahe tataḥ || || 56 ||
tathā dharmakriyāḥ sarvā mānuṣāṇāmudāhṛtāḥ ||
na pretānāṃ na devānāṃ nānyeṣāṃ mānuṣaṃ vinā || 57 ||
paśyāmo dūrato rājañjalapūrṇāñjalā śayān ||
pipāsākulitāḥ śrāṃtā bhāskare vṛṣasaṃsthite || 58 ||
gacchāmaḥ saṃnidhau teṣāṃ yadi pārthivasatama ||
adṛṣṭamudgarāghātairvayaṃ hanyāmahe tataḥ || 59 ||
tathā rasavatī siddhāḥ paśyāmo dūrasaṃsthitāḥ ||
kṣudhāviṣṭā gṛhasthānāṃ gṛheṣu vividhā nṛpa || 6.18.60 ||
tathā suphalino vṛkṣānkalapakṣibhirāvṛtān ||
snigdhānsacchāyayopetānsevituṃ na labhāmahe || 61 ||
kiṃvā te bahunoktena yadyatkarma vigarhitam ||
kleśadaṃ ca tadasmākaṃ svayamevopatiṣṭhate || 62 ||
na cchidreṇa vinā'smākaṃ prāṇayātrā prajāyate ||
na jalāni na ca cchāyā na yānaṃ na ca vāhanam || 63 ||
etasmātkāraṇānnityaṃ bhramāmaśchidrahetave ||
prāpte rātrimukhe rājanna prātarna ca vāsare || 64 ||
yattvaṃ śaṃsasi cā'smākaṃ khecaratvaṃ mahīpate ||
vyarthaṃ tadapi na śreyaḥ śṛṇu tatrāpi kāraṇam || 65 ||
kriyate khecaratvena kiṃkiṃ dharmaṃ viniścayaiḥ ||
yato na sidhyate mokṣo jāti smṛtyādikaṃ tathā || 66 ||
tasmāddoṣādime rājanguṇā yadyapi kīrtitāḥ ||
pretānāṃ yānsamāśritya kācitsiddhirna jāyate || 67 ||
viṣādo jāyate bhūyo guṇairetairnarādhipa ||
aśaktāḥ pretayogādvai sarvasya śubhakarmaṇaḥ || 68 ||
|| rājovāca | ||
yadi yāsyāmi bhūyo'haṃ gṛhamasmānmahāvanāt ||
tatkariṣyāmi sarveṣāṃ gayāśrāddhamasaṃśayam || 69 ||

apyātmadehadānena satyenātmānamālabhe || || 6.18.70 ||
yasmāddhṛdgataśaṃkā me hṛtā yuṣmābhiradya vai ||
yena tatprāpya yuṣmākamupakāraṃ karomyaham || 71 ||
|| māṃsāda uvāca || ||
itaḥ sthānānmahārāja nātidūre jalāśayaḥ |

|| sūta uvāca || ||
athāsau nṛpaśārdūlaḥ samutthāya śanaiḥśanaiḥ ||
saumyāṃ diśaṃ samuddiśya pratasthe sa tu duḥkhitaḥ || 74 ||
evaṃ pragacchatā tena kṣutpipāsākulena ca |
adūrādeva saṃdṛṣṭaṃ nīlaṃ drumakadaṃbakam ||
bhramamāṇairbakairhaṃsaiḥ sārasairmadgubhistathā ||76||
sa gatvā salilaṃ tatra tadvātena mahīpatiḥ ||
āhūta iva śītena prayayau tvarayānvitaḥ || 76 ||
athā'paśyanmanohāri saumyasattvaniṣevitam ||
āśramaṃ hradatīrasthaṃ tāpasaiḥ sarvato vṛtam || 77 ||
puṣpitaiḥ phalitairvṛkṣaiḥ samaṃtātpariveṣṭitam ||

tatrāpaśyannagādhastāttapasvigaṇasevitam ||
śivadharmaparaṃ śāṃtaṃ jaiminiṃ munisattamam|| 79 |

tathānyānapi tacchiṣyānnipapāta dharātale || 6.18.80 ||
te dṛṣṭvā'dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ taṃ rājalakṣaṇalakṣitam||
dhūlidhūsaritāṃgaṃ ca bhasmāvṛtamivācalam || 81 ||
manyamānā mahīpālaṃ vismayotphullalocanāḥ ||
procuśca madhurairvākyairāśīrvādapuraḥsaraiḥ || 82 ||
kutastvamanusaṃprāpto vane'smiñjanavarjite ||
ekākī sukumārāṃgaḥ padātiḥ śramavihvalaḥ || 93 ||
pārthivasyeva liṃgāni dṛśyaṃte tava bhūriśaḥ ||
na vidmo niścayaṃ tasmādvadāgamanakāraṇam || 84 ||
athovāca nṛpaḥ kṛcchrātpipāsā māṃ prabādhate ||
tasmādvadata pānīyaṃ yatpītvā kīrtayāmyaham || 85 ||
tatastairdarśitaṃ toyaṃ samīpe yanmahīpateḥ ||
so'pi pītvā'vagāhyātha vitṛṣṇaḥ samapadyata || 86 ||
tataḥ phalāni pakvāni tarūṇāṃ patitānyadhaḥ ||
sumṛṣṭāni samādāya bhakṣayāmāsa vāṃchayā || 87 ||
tatastṛptiṃ parāṃ prāpya gatvā jaiminisaṃnidhau ||
upaviṣṭaḥ praṇamyoccaistathānyāṃśca munīnkramāt || 88 ||
uvāca ca nijāṃ vārtāṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||
sa pṛṣṭastāpasaiḥ sarvaiḥ suvismayasamanvitaiḥ || 89 ||
vidūratho mahīpo'haṃ māhiṣmatyāṃ kṛtāspadaḥ ||
mṛgalipsurvane ghore praviṣṭaḥ sainikaiḥ saha || 6.18.90 ||
tato me bhramamāṇasya praṇaṣṭāḥ sarvasainikāḥ ||
gulmairaṃtaritāścā'nye na jāne'haṃ kathaṃ sthitāḥ || 91 ||
āsīddhayo mamā'dhastājjātyaḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ ||
so'pi karmavipākena pañcatvaṃ samupasthitaḥ || 92 ||
bhramamāṇastvahaṃ prāpta āyuḥśeṣatayātra ca ||
tadbrūta kaḥ pradeśo'yaṃ kiyaddūre ca me purī || 93 ||
tataste tāpasāḥ procurvidmahe na vayaṃ purīm ||
tvāṃ ca deśaṃ ca te rājanko'yaṃ deśaśca kīrtyate || 94 ||
narendrairnaiva naḥ kāryaṃ na diśairna purairnṛpa ||
vanecarā vayaṃ nityaṃ śivārādhanatatparāḥ || 95 ||
sarve śīrṇāni vṛkṣāṇāṃ puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ||
bhakṣayāmo'tha patrāṇi śarī rasthitihetunā || 96 ||
mānuṣaiḥ saha saṃsargaṃ saṃbhāṣaṃ ca narādhipa ||
na kurmo na ca paśyāmo gacchāmo'nyatra dūrataḥ || 97 ||
ekaikasya tarormūle divasaṃ vā dinadvayam||
tiṣṭhāmo na bhavedyena mamatvaṃ tatsamudbhavam ||98||
kāraṇāttava rājeṃdra niśāmetāṃ vanaspatau ||
neṣyāmo'nyatra yāsyāmaḥ prabhā te'nyatra kānane || 99 ||
ekākinaṃ padātiṃ ca viśastraṃ śramavihvalam ||
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūpate'smākaṃ dayā jātā tato'dhikā ||6.18.100||
ekākī pārthivendro'yaṃ neṣyati ca kathaṃ niśām ||
vane'sminmaṃtrayitvaivaṃ tato'traiva vyavasthitāḥ || 101 ||
tasmādatraiva neṣyāmaḥ sametāḥ śarvarīmimām||
gaṃtavyaṃ prātarutthāya tataḥ sarvairyadṛcchayā 102 ||
evaṃ saṃvadatāṃ teṣāṃ bhagavāṃstīkṣṇadīdhitiḥ ||
astācalamanuprāptaḥ kuṃkumakṣodasaṃnibhaḥ || 103 ||
atha tāstāpasānrājā provāca praṇataḥ sthitaḥ ||
saṃdhyākālaḥ samāyātaḥ sāṃprataṃ munisattamāḥ ||
tasmātsaṃdhyāvidhiḥ kāryaḥ sarvaireva yathocitaḥ || 104 ||
atha te munayaḥ sarve sa ca rājā tathā dvijāḥ ||
cakruḥ sāyaṃtanaṃ karma yathoddiṣṭaṃ purātanaiḥ || 105 ||
kāmibhiḥ kāminīlokaiḥ priyoktairabhivāṃ chitā ||
asatstrībhirviśeṣeṇa saṃprāptā rajanī tataḥ || 106 ||
pīyūṣārṇavaveleva viṣavṛkṣalateva ca ||
ulūkaiścakravākaiśca yugapadyā vilokyate || 107||
ulūkā rākṣasāścaurāḥ kāminaḥ kulaṭāṃ'ganāḥ ||
yāṃ vāṃchaṃti sadā sotkāḥ suvṛṣṭimiva karṣukāḥ || 108 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye māṃsādavacanādṛṣyāśramapadaṃ prāptasya vidūrathasya munibhiḥ saha saṃvādapūrvakasāṃyatanakarmādividhānavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptāstasya bhūpasya sevakāḥ ||
kecicca daivayo gena śvāpadairardhabhakṣitāḥ || 1 ||
kṣutpipāsāturā dīnā duḥkhena mahatā'nvitāḥ ||
padapaddhatimārgeṇa yena yātaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ || 2 ||
te dṛṣṭvā pārthivaṃ tatra diṣṭyādiṣṭyeti sādaram ||
bruvaṃtaḥ pādayostasya patitā harṣasaṃyutāḥ || 3 ||
tatastasya narendrasya vyasanaṃ sainyasaṃbhavam ||
procuścaiva yathādṛṣṭama nubhūtaṃ yathāśrutam ||4||
atha te tāpasāḥ sarve sa ca rājā sasevakaḥ ||
prasuptāḥ pādapasyādhaḥ parṇānyāstīryabhūtale ||5||
tatasteṣāṃ prasuptānāṃ sarveṣāṃ tatra kānane ||
atikrāṃtā sukhenaiva rajanī sā mahātmanām || 6 ||
tataḥ sa prātarutthāya kṛtapūrvāhṇikakriyaḥ ||
taṃ muniṃ praṇipatyoccairanujñāpya muhu rmuhuḥ || 7 ||
nijaistaiḥ sevakaiḥ sārdhaṃ prasthitaḥ svapurīṃ prati ||
māhiṣmatīṃ samuddiśya dṛṣṭvā mārge śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 8 ||
tato nijagṛhaṃ prāpya kañci tkālaṃ mahīpatiḥ ||
viśramya prayayau paścāttūrṇaṃ puṇyaṃ gayāśiraḥ || 9 ||
tacca kālena saṃprāpya snātvā dhautāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ||
māṃsādāya dadau śrāddhaṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 6.19.10 ||
athā'sau pṛthivīpālaḥ svapnāṃte ca dadarśa tam ||
divyamālyāṃbaradharaṃ divyagaṃdhānulepanam ||
vimānavaramārūḍhaṃ stūyamānaṃ ca kiṃnaraiḥ || 11 ||
|| māṃsāda uvāca || ||
prasādāttava bhūpāla mukto'haṃ pretayonitaḥ ||
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ tridivā layam|| 12 ||
tataḥ sa prātarutthāya harṣāviṣṭo mahīpatiḥ ||
vidaivataṃ samuddiśya cakre śrāddhaṃ yathocitam || 13
so'pi tenaiva rūpeṇa tasya saṃdarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
svapnāṃ'te bhūmipālasya tadvaccoktvā divaṃ gataḥ || 14 ||
tataḥ prātastṛtīye'hni kṛtaghnasya mahīpatiḥ ||
cakre śrāddhaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 15 ||
tataḥ so'pi samāyātastasya svapne mahīpateḥ ||
tenaiva pretarūpeṇa duḥkhena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 16 ||
|| kṛtaghna uvāca ||
na me gatirmahārāja saṃjātā pāpakarmiṇaḥ ||
taḍāgavittacaurasya kṛtaghnasya tathaiva ca || 17 ||
tasmātsaṃjāyate muktiryathā me pārthivottama ||
tathaiva tvaṃ kuruṣyā'dya satyavākyaparo bhava || 18 ||
satyameva paraṃ brahma satyameva paraṃ tapaḥ ||
satyameva paraṃ jñānaṃ satyameva paraṃ śrutam || 19 ||
satyena vāyu rvahati satyena tapate raviḥ ||
sāgaraḥ satyavākyena maryādāṃ na vilaṃghayet || 6.19.20 ||
tīrthasevā tapo dānaṃ svādhyāyo gurusevanam ||
sarvaṃ satyavihīnasya vyarthaṃ saṃjāyate yataḥ || 21 ||
