tulāyāṃ kautukāddevairjātaṃ tatra ṛtaṃ guru || 22 ||
tasmātsatyaṃ puraskṛtya māṃ tāraya mahāmate ||
etatte paramaṃ śreyastapaso'pi bhaviṣyati || 23 ||
|| vidūratha uvāca || ||
kathaṃ te jāyate muktirvada me preta satvaram ||
karomi yena tatkarma yadyapi syātsuduṣkaram ḥ| 24 ||
|| preta uvāca || ||
camatkārapure bhūpa śrīkṣetre hāṭakeśvare ||
āste pāṃsubhirācchannaṃ kalerbhītaṃ gayāśiraḥ || 25 ||
adhastātplakṣavṛkṣasya darbhasthānaiḥ samaṃtataḥ ||
kālaśākaistathānekaistilaiścāraṇyasaṃbhavaiḥ || || 26 ||
tatra gatvā tilaistaistvaṃ taiḥ śākaistaiḥ kuśaistathā ||
śrāddhaṃ dehi drutaṃ yena muktiḥ saṃjāyate mama || 27 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa dīnasya dayānvitaḥ||
jagāma tatra yatrā''ste sa vṛkṣaḥ plakṣasaṃjñakaḥ|| 28 ||
dṛṣṭvā śākāṃstilāṃstāṃstu darbhāṃstena yathoditān||
akhanattatra deśe ca jalārthe laghu kūpikām || 29 ||
tataḥ kṛtaghnamuddiśya śrāddhaṃ cakre yathoditam ||
ānīya brāhmaṇāñchreṣṭhānvedavedāṃgapāragān || 6.19.3. ||
kṛtamātre tataḥ śrāddhe divya rūpadharaḥ pumān||
vimānavaramārūḍho vidūrathamathā'bravīt || 31 ||
mukto'haṃ tvatprasādācca pretatvāddāruṇādvibho ||
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ tridaśālayam || 32 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ prabhṛti sā tatra kūpikā khyātimāgatā ||
pitṝṇāṃ puṣṭidā nityaṃ gayāśīrṣasamudbhavā|| 33 ||
pretapakṣasya darśāyāṃ yastasyāṃ śrāddhamācaret ||
kālaśākena vipreṃdrāstathāraṇyodbhavaistilaiḥ || 34 ||
kṛṃtitaiśca tathā darbhaiḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
sa prāpnoti phalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ kṛtaghnapretatīrthataḥ || 35 ||
agniṣvāttāḥ pitṛgaṇāstathā barhiṣadaśca ye ||
tatra saṃnihitā nityamājyapāḥ somapāstathā || 36 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ tatra samācaret ||
kāle vā
yadi vā'kāle pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭaye sadā || 37 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye māṃsādādipretatrayasya vidūrathakṛtaśrāddhadvārā muktidāne pitṛkūpikātīrthamā hātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || || cha || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatra dāśarathī rāmo vanavāsāya dīkṣitaḥ ||
bhramamāṇo dharāpṛṣṭhe sītālakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ || 1 ||
samā''yāto dvijaśreṣṭhā yatra sā pitṛkūpikā ||
tṛṣārtaśca śramārtaśca niṣasāda dharātale || 2 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāpto bhagavāndinanāyakaḥ ||
astācalaṃ japāpuṣpasannibho dvijasattamāḥ || 3 ||
tataḥ plakṣanagādhastātparṇānyāstīrya bhūtale ||
sāyaṃtanaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā suṣvāpa raghunandanaḥ || 4 ||
athā'valokayāmāsa svapne daśarathaṃ nṛpam ||
yadvatpūrvaṃ priyā''lāpasaṃsaktaṃ hṛṣṭamānasam || 5 ||

|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||

nīvāraiḥ śāka mūlaiśca tathā'raṇyodbhavaistilaiḥ || 11 ||
athaivāmantrayāmāsa tānviprānraghusattamaḥ ||
śrāddheṣu śraddhayā yuktaḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti || 12 ||

gatāḥ sarve susaṃhṛṣṭā svakīyānāśramānprati va 13 ||
atha teṣu prayāteṣu brāhmaṇeṣu raghūttamaḥ ||
provāca lakṣmaṇaṃ pārśve vinayāvanataṃ sthitam || 14 ||
śākamūlaphalānyāśu śrāddhārthaṃ samupānaya ||
saumitrānaya vaidehī svayaṃ pacati bhāminī || 15 ||
tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇastūrṇaṃ jagāmā'raṇyameva hi ||
śrāddhārthamānināyā''śu phalāni vividhāni ca || 16 ||
dhātrīphalāni cā''mrāṇi cirbhaṭānīṃ gudāni ca ||
karīrāṇi kapitthāni tathaivā'nyāni bhūriśaḥ || 17 ||
tataśca pācayāmāsa tadarthe janakodbhavā ||
rāmādeśātsvayaṃ sādhvī vinayena samanvitā || 18 ||
tataśca kutape prāpte kāle te dvijasattamāḥ ||
kṛtāhnikāḥ samāyātā rāmabhaktisamanvitāḥ || 19 ||
etasminnaṃtare sītā plakṣavṛkṣāṃtare sthitā||
ātmānaṃ gopayāmāsa yathā vetti na rāghavaḥ||6.20.20
sa tāṃ sīteti sīteti vyāhṛtyātha muhurmuhuḥ||
strīdharmiṇīti matvā tu lakṣmaṇaṃ cedamabravīt || 21 ||
vatsa lakṣmaṇa śuśrūṣāṃ viprāṇāṃ śrāddhasaṃbhavām||
pādaprakṣālanādyāṃ tvaṃ yathāvatkartumarhasi || 22 ||
bāḍhamityeva saṃprokto lakṣmaṇaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||
cakre sarvaṃ tathā karma yathā nārī vicakṣaṇā || 23 ||
tato nirvartite śrāddhe brāhmaṇeṣu gateṣvatha ||
janakasya sutā sādhvī tatkṣaṇātsamupasthitā || 24 ||

provāca paruṣairvākyairbhartsamāno muhurmuhuḥ|| 25 ||
āyāteṣu dvijāteṣu śrāddhakāla upasthite ||
kva gatā vada pāpe tvaṃ māṃ parityajya dūrataḥ || 26 ||
naitadyuktaṃ kulastrīṇāṃ viśeṣādatra kānane ||
vihartuṃ dūrataḥ śūnye tasmāttyājyā'si maithili || 27 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhītā sā janakodbhavā ||
uvāca vepamānāṃgī praskhalaṃtyā girā tataḥ || 28 ||
na māmarhasi kārye'smingarhituṃ raghusattama ||
yasmādahamatikrāntā sthānādasmācchraṇuṣva tat || 29 ||
pitā tava mayā dṛṣṭaḥ sākṣāddaśarathaḥ svayam ||

pituḥ pitāmaho'nyasya tṛtīyasya raghūttama ||
trayāṇāṃ ca tathānyeṣāṃ trayo'nye nṛpasaṃnibhāḥ || 31 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ mayā dṛṣṭāḥ śarīrasthāḥ suharṣitāḥ ||

|| lakṣmaṇa uvāca || ||

|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || ||

|| rāma uvāca || ||

|| lakṣmaṇa uvāca || ||

|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || ||

|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||

|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||

evaṃ tasya vratasthasya ṣaṇmāsā divasaistribhiḥ ||
hīnāḥ syurbrāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ namaskāraparasya ca || 19 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptā agni tīrthaparāyaṇāḥ ||
saptarṣayaḥ sthito yatra mārkaṃḍo dhṛtamekhalaḥ || 19 ||
tāndṛṣṭvā sa munīnsarvānnamaścakre muneḥ sutaḥ ||
dīrghāyurbhava tairuktaḥ sarvairapi pṛthakpṛthak || 6.21.20 ||
atha taṃ bālabhāvena kautukādbrahmacāriṇaḥ ||
ciraṃ dṛṣṭvā'bravīdvākyaṃ vasiṣṭho munipuṃgavaḥ || 21 ||
sarvaireṣa śiśuḥ prokto dīrghā yuriti sādaram||
tṛtīye'hni punaḥ prāṇāṃstyakṣyatyayamasaṃśayaḥ || 22 ||
tanna yuktaṃ bhavedīdṛgasmākaṃ vacanaṃ dvijāḥ ||
tasmāttatkriyatāṃ karma yenāyaṃ syāccirāyudhṛk || 23 ||
tato mithaḥ samālocya sarve te munipuṃgavāḥ ||
procurna jīvanopāyo bhavenmuktvā pitāmaham || 24 ||
tasmāttasya puro nītvā bālo'yaṃ kṣīṇajīvitaḥ ||
kriyatāṃ tasya vākyena yathā syāccirajīvabhāk || 25 ||
tatastu te samādāya satvaraṃ brahmacāriṇam ||
brahmalokaṃ samājagmustyaktvā tīrthaparākramam || 26 ||
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ devaṃ vedoktaiḥ stavanairdvijāḥ ||
stutvā'tha saṃvidhe tasya niṣedustadanantaram || 27 ||
teṣāmanaṃtaraṃ so'pi namaścakre pitāmaham ||
bālaḥ proktaśca dīrghāyurbhaveti ca svayaṃbhuvā || 28 ||
athovāca munīnsarvānviśrāṃtānpadmayonijaḥ ||
kuto yūyaṃ samāyātāḥ sāṃprataṃ kena hetunā || 29 ||
procyatāṃ cāpi yatkṛtyaṃ yuṣmākaṃ kriyate'dhunā ||
madgṛhe saṃprayātānāṃ ko'yaṃ bālo'pi sadvratī || 6.21.30 ||
|| munaya ūcuḥ || ||
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena bhramamāṇā mahītalam ḥ|
camatkārapurābhyāśe vayaṃ prāptāḥ pitāmaha || 31 ||
tatrānena vayaṃ deva bālakenā'bhivāditāḥ ||
kramātsarverapi prokto dīrghāyuriti sādaram || 32 ||
etasya tu punaḥ śeṣamāyuṣo divasatra yam ||
vidyate vibudhaśreṣṭha vrīḍitāstena vai vayam || 33 ||
tataścainaṃ samādāya vayaṃ prāptāstavāṃtikam ||
bhavatā'pi tathā prokto dīrdhāyu rbālako'stvayam || 34 ||
tasmādyathā vayaṃ satyā bhavatā saha padmaja ||
bhavāma kuru tatkṛtyametasmādāgatā vayam || 35 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ padmasaṃbhavaḥ ||
provāca prahasanvākyaṃ samādāya ca bālakam || 36 ||
matprasādādayaṃ bālojarāmṛtyuvi varjitaḥ ||
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho vedavidyāvicakṣaṇaḥ || 37 ||
tasmātprāgdharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ vrajadhvaṃ munisattamāḥ ||
bālamenaṃ samādāya tasminnevāsya maṃdiraṃ || 38 ||
yāvadasya pitā vṛddhaḥ putradarśanavihvalaḥ ||
na yāti nidhanaṃ sārdhaṃ dharmapatnyā dvijottamāḥ || 39. ||
athā''yātāśca taṃ bālaṃ sarve te muni sattamāḥ ||
āgatya vasudhāpṛṣṭhaṃ tasyaivāśramasaṃnidhau || 6.21.40 ||
amuṃcannagnitīrthe taṃ samābhāṣya tataḥ param ||
tīrthayātrākṛte paścājjagmuranyatra satvaram || || 41 ||
etasminnaṃtare vipro mṛkaṃḍaḥ sutavatsalaḥ ||
nāpaśyatsvasutaṃ paścādvilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ || 42 ||
aho me tanayo'bhīṣṭaḥ kathamadya na dṛśyate||
kūpāṃtaḥ patitaḥ kiṃ nu kiṃ vyālairvā nipātitaḥ || 43 ||
kṛtvā māṃ duḥkhasaṃtaptaṃ mātaraṃ cāpi putrakaḥ ||
prasthito dīrghamadhvānaṃ viruddhaṃ kṛtavānvidhiḥ || || 44 ||
paśya brāhmaṇi pāpena mayā duṣkṛtakāriṇā ||
na bālasya mukhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ prasthitasya yamālaye ||45||
kathitaṃ jñāninā tena mama pūrvaṃ mahātma nā ||
ṣaṅbhirmāsaiḥ sutaste'yaṃ dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyati || 46 ||
so'haṃ putrasya duḥkhena sādhayiṣye hutāśanam ||
yāvacchokāgninā kāyo dahyate na varāna ne || 47 ||
|| brāhmaṇyuvāca || ||
mamāpi matametaddhi yattvayā parikīrtitam ||
tatkiṃ cirayasi brahmañchīghraṃ dārūṇi cānaya || 48 ||
yenā'haṃ bhavatā sārdhaṃ pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam ||
putraśokena saṃtaptā subhṛśaṃ duḥkhaśāṃtaye || 49 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ tayoḥ pravadatordaṃpatyordvija sattamāḥ ||
ājagāmā'tha saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sa bālaḥ sannidhiṃ tayoḥ || 6.21.50 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇo hṛṣṭo brāhmaṇyā sahitastadā ||
ānaṃdāśruplutākṣo'tha sammukha stamupādravat || 51 ||
bhūyobhūyaḥ pariṣvajya sabhāryaḥ pṛṣṭavāṃstadā ||
kva gataḥ svāśramādvatsa cirātkasmādihā''gataḥ|| 52 ||
śokārṇave parikṣipya māṃ sabhāryaṃ vayo'dhikam ||
tanmā putraka bhūyastvamīdṛkkarma kariṣyasi || 53 ||
|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || ||
atrā'dya munayaḥ prāptā mayā te cābhivāditāḥ ||
krameṇa vinayāttāta smaramāṇena te vacaḥ || 54
dīrghāyurbhava tairuktaḥ sarvaireva dvijottamaiḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā māṃ vismayāviṣṭairbālakaṃ vratinaṃ vibho || 55 ||
atha tāta samālokya teṣāṃ madhyagato muniḥ ||
vasiṣṭhastānmunīnsarvānprovāca prahasanniva || 56 ||
|| vasiṣṭha uvāca || ||
dīrghāyurbhava yaḥ prokto yuṣmābhirmunipuṃgavāḥ ||
tṛtīye divase so'yaṃ bālaḥ paṃcatvameṣyati || 57 ||
tataste munayo bhītā asatyāttāta tatkṣaṇāt ||
samādāya yayustatra yatra brahmā vyavasthitaḥ || 58 ||
namaskṛtena tenā'pi prokto'haṃ padmayoninā ||
dīrghāyurbhava pṛṣṭaśca kutastvamiha cāgataḥ 59 ||
atha tairmunibhiḥ sarvairvṛttāṃtaṃ tasya kīrtitam||
āśīrvādodbhavaṃ proktaṃ tato vayamihāgatāḥ|| 6.21.60 ||
yathā'yaṃ bālako deva tvatprasādātpitāmaha ||
dīrghāyurjāyate loke tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi || 61 ||
tato'haṃ brahmaṇā tāta jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ ||
vihitaḥ preṣitastūrṇaṃ svagṛhaṃ prati taiḥ samam || 62 ||
te tu māṃ munayotraiva pramucyāśramasannidhau ||
snānārthaṃ viviśuḥ sarve hrade'traiva suśobhane || 63 ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya mṛkaṃḍo harṣasaṃyutaḥ ||
prayayau satvaraṃ tatra yatra te munayaḥ sthitāḥ || 64 ||
praṇamya tānmunīnsarvānkṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||
provāca vaḥ prasādena kulaṃ me vṛddhimāgatam || 65 ||
sādhu proktamidaṃ kaiścidācāryairmunisattamāḥ ||
sādhulokaṃ samāśritya vikhyātaṃ ca jagattraye || 66 ||
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthabhūtā hi sādhavaḥ ||
tīrthaṃ phalati kālena sadyaḥ sādhusamāgamaḥ || 67 ||
tasmādatithayaḥ prāptā yūyaṃ sarve'dya me gṛham ||
prakaromi kimātithyaṃ procyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 68 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
etadeva mune'smākamātithyaṃ koṭisaṃmitam ||
alpāyurapi te bālo yajjāto mṛtyuvarjitaḥ || 69 ||
|| mṛkaṇḍa uvāca || ||
mṛtyunā''liṃgitaṃ bālamasmadīyaṃ munīśvarāḥ ||
bhavadbhiradya saṃrakṣya kulaṃ kṛtsnaṃ samuddhṛtam || 6.21.70 ||
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate tathā ||
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nā'sti niṣkṛtiḥ || 71 ||
tasmātkṛtaghnatādoṣo na syānmama munīśvarāḥ ||
yathā kāryaṃ bhavadbhiśca tathā sarvairna saṃśayaḥ || 72 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadi pratyupakārāya manyase tvaṃ dvijottama ||
gṛhaṃ kuruṣva no vākyāddevasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || 73 ||
yenā'yaṃ bālakaste'dya kṛto mṛtyuvivarjitaḥ ||
tasmātsthāpaya tīrthena devaṃ taṃ prapitāmaham||74||
putreṇa sahitaḥ paścādārādhaya divāniśam||
vayameva tvayā sārdhaṃ taṃ ca devaṃ pitāmaham||75||
nityaṃ prapūjayiṣyāmastathānye'pi dvijottamāḥ||
bālenā'nena sārdhaṃ te sakhyamatra sthitaṃ yataḥ||
bālasakhyamiti khyātaṃ nāmnā tena bhaviṣyati||76||
tīrthamanyairiti khyātaṃ bālakānāṃ hitāvaham||
rogārtānāṃ bhayārtānāmasmākaṃ vacanātsadā||77||
asmiṃstīrthe śiśuṃ lokāḥ snāpayiṣyaṃti ye dvija||
rogārtaṃ vā bhayārtaṃ vā pīḍitaṃ vā grahādibhiḥ||78||
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ ||
pitāmahaprasādena tathā'smadvacanāddvija || 79 ||
ye punarmānuṣā vipra niṣkāmāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ ||
snānamātraṃ kariṣyaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim|| 6.21.80 ||
evamuktvātha te sarve munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ||
tamāmaṃtrya muniṃ jagmustīrthānyanyāni satvarāḥ || 81 ||
mṛkaṇḍo'pi saputraśca tasminsthāne pitāmaham ||
sthāpayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭo jyeṣṭhe jyeṣṭhāsthite vidhau || 82 ||
tataścā''rādhayāmāsa divārātramataṃdritaḥ ||
saputraḥ śraddhayā yuktaḥ saṃprāptaśca parāṃ gatim || 83 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ bālasakhyamiti smṛtam||
pāvanaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ bālānāṃ roganāśanam|| 84 ||
jyeṣṭhe jyeṣṭhāsu yo bālastatra snānaṃ samācaret ||
na sa pīḍāmavāpnoti yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ || 85 ||
grahabhūtapiśācānāṃ śākinīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
agamyaḥ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ tathā'nyeṣāṃ prajāyate ||86||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bālasakhyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| || 21 || || dha ||

<6.22>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ tīrthe śakrasamudravam||
svāmidrohakṛtātpāpānnirmukto yatra lakṣmaṇaḥ || 1 ||
kathaṃ tatra purā śakraḥ svāmidrohasamudbhavāt ||
pātakādeva nirmuktaḥ kasminkāle ca sūtaja||2||
kasmādditermahendreṇa kṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ tathāvidham ||
yena saṃsūdito garbhaḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada ||3||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
brahmaṇo dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhājjajñe dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
sa ca saṃjanayāmāsa pacāśatkanyakāḥ śubhāḥ ||4||
dadau ca daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa ||
divyena vidhinā dakṣaḥ saptaviṃśatimiṃdave || 5 ||
aditiśca ditiścaiva dve bhārye mukhyatāṃ gate ||
kaśyapasya dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prāṇebhyo'pi priye sadā || 6 ||
tataḥ sa janayāmāsa devāñcchakrapuraḥsarān||
adityāṃ caiva daityāṃśca dityāṃ sa balavattarān ||7||
teṣāṃ trailokyarājyārthaṃ mitho jajñe mahāhavaḥ ||
tatra śakreṇa te daityāḥ saṃgrāme vinipātitāḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ śokaparā cakre ditirvratamanuttamam ||
putrārthaṃ niyamopetā kṣetre'traiva samāhitā || 9 ||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tasyāstuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ||
uvāca parituṣṭo'smi varaṃ prārthaya vāṃchitam || 6.22.10 ||
sā'bravīdyadi me tuṣṭastvaṃ deva śaśiśekhara ||
tatputraṃ dehi devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ balavattaram||
yajñabhāgaprabhoktāraṃ devānāṃ darpanāśanam || 11 ||
avadhyaṃ saṃgare pūrvaiḥ sarvaidevaiḥ savāsavaiḥ ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya jagāmādarśanaṃ haraḥ || 12 ||
ditiścaivā'dadhādgarbhaṃ kaśyapānmunipuṃgavāt ||
tataḥ śakro bhayaṃ cakre jñātvā taṃ garbhasaṃbhavam||
vadato munimukhyasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || 13 ||
tato duṣṭāṃ matiṃ kṛtvā tasya garbhasya nāśane ||
cakre tasyāḥ sa śuśrūṣāṃ divārātramataṃdritaḥ || 14 ||
chidramanveṣamāṇastu susūkṣmamapi ca dvijāḥ ||
na tasyā labhate kvā'pi gatā māsā navaiva tu || 15 ||
tataśca daśame māsi saṃprāpte prasavodbhave ||
garbhālasā niśāvaktre suptā sā dakṣiṇāmukhī || 16 ||
nidrāvaśaṃ tu saṃprāptā visaṃjñā samapadyata||
śakrahastāvamardotthapādasaukhyena niścalā || 17 ||
tāṃ visaṃjñāmatho vīkṣya tyaktvā pādau śatakratuḥ ||
praviveśodaraṃ tasyāstīkṣṇaṃ śastraṃ kare dadhat ||
tenā'sau saptadhā cake garbhaṃ śastreṇa devapaḥ || 18 ||
athā'paśyatkṣaṇātsapta vālakānpūrṇavigrahān ||
tatastānapi saptaiva saptadhā kṛtavānhariḥ || 19 ||
jātā ekonapañcāśadatha tatraiva bālakāḥ ||
tāndṛṣṭvā vṛddhimāpannāṃstato bhītaḥ śatakratuḥ ||
niścakrāmodarātūrṇaṃ dityā yāvanna lakṣitaḥ || 6.22.20 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṃḍale ||
ditiḥ saṃjanayāmāsa saptadhā sapta bālakān|| 21 ||
tato'bhyetya sahasrākṣo durgaṃdhena samāvṛtaḥ ||
nistejā mlānavaktraśca lajjayā' dhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 22 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ śakraṃ ditiḥ provāca sādaram ||
praṇataṃ saṃsthitaṃ pārśve bhayavyākulacetasam || 23 ||
kiṃ tvaṃ śakra niru tsāhastejodyutivivarjitaḥ ||
śarīrāttava durgandhaḥ kasmādīdṛkprajāyate || 24 ||
kiṃ tvayā nihato viprogururvābālako'thavā ||
nārī vā yena te naṣṭaṃ tejo gātrasamudbhavam || 25 ||
hato nakhāṃbhasā vā tvaṃ ghṛṣṭaḥ śūrpānilena ca ||
ajāmārjanikotthaiścarajobhirvā samāśritaḥ || 26 ||
|| śakra uvāca || ||
satyametanmahābhāge yattvayokto'smi sāṃpratam ||
rātrau praviṣṭaḥ suptāyā jaṭhare tava pāpakṛt || 27 ||
kṛntaścaikonapañcāśatkṛtvo garbho mayā śubhe ||
tāvanmātrāstato jātā bālakāḥ sarva eva te || 28 ||
tato bhītyā viniṣkrāntastvayā devi na lakṣitaḥ ||
etasmātkāraṇājjātā tejohāniranindite || 29 ||
|| ditiruvāca || ||
yasmātsatyaṃ tvayā proktaṃ purato mama devapa ||
tasmātprārthaya mattastvaṃ varaṃ yanmanasepsi tam || 6.22.30 ||
|| śakra uvāca || ||
ete tava sutā devi cchidyamānā mayāsinā ||
rudanto vāritā mandaṃ mā rudantu muhurmuhuḥ || 31 ||
maruto nāmavikhyātāstasmātsaṃtujagatraye ||
daityabhāvavinirmuktā madvidheyā mama priyāḥ || 32 ||
yajñabhāgabhujaḥ sarve bhaviṣyaṃti mayā saha ||
yasmādetanmayā tīrthaṃ bālakaistava maṃḍitam || 33 ||
bahubhiryāsyati khyātiṃ bālamaṃḍanamityataḥ ||
yā ca strī garbhasaṃyuktā snānaṃ bhaktyā kariṣyīta ||
na bhaviṣyaṃti chidrāṇi tasyā garbhe kathaṃcana || 34 ||
prāpte prasavakāle tu yā jalaṃ prāśayiṣyati ||
tīrthasyāsya sukhenaiva prasaviṣyati sā sutam || 35 || ||
|| ditiruvāca || ||
tavocchedāya deveśa yācitaḥ prāṅmayā haraḥ ||
ekaṃ deva sutaṃ dehi sarvadevanibarhaṇam || 36 ||
tvayā caikonapaṃcāśatprakāraḥ sa vinirmitaḥ ||
yasmādṛtaṃ tvayā proktaṃ tasmādetadbhaviṣyati || 37 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ prabhṛti te jātā maruto vibudhaiḥ samam ||
yajñabhāgasya bhoktāro diteḥ śakrasya śāsanāt || 38||
atha prāha sahasrākṣo devācāryaṃ bṛhaspatim ||
māturdrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kathaṃ yāsyati saṃkṣa yam|| 39 ||
|| bṛhaspatiruvāca || ||
atraiva kuru devendra tapaḥ pāpaviśuddhaye ||
tīrthe yatra kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sarvapātakanāśane ||6.22.40||
na yajñairna ca dānena nānyaistīrthasamāśrayaiḥ ||
māturdrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśaṃ yāti puraṃdara ||
evametatparityajya tīrthaṃ mātustavā''śrayam ||41||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatastūrṇaṃ saha sākṣaḥ sahasrākṣeśasaṃjñitam ||
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa svayameva dvijottamāḥ || 42 ||
trikālaṃ pūjayāmāsapuṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ||
tathānyairbalisatkā rairgītairnṛtyaiḥpṛthagvidhaiḥ || 43 ||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tuṣṭastasya maheśvaraḥ ||
provāca varado'smīti śakra prārthaya vāṃchitam || 44 ||
|| śakra uvāca ||
māturdrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yātu me tripurāṃtaka ||
tathā'nyeṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ye'tra tvāṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ ||
pūjayiṣyaṃti sadbhaktyā snānaṃ kṛtvā samāhitāḥ || 45 || ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya jagāmādarśanaṃ haraḥ ||
śakro'pi rahitaḥ pāpairjagāma tridaśālayam || 46 ||
evaṃ tatra samutpannaṃ tīrthaṃ tadbālamaṃḍanam ||
svāmidrohakṛtātpāpānmucyaṃte yatra mānavāḥ || 47 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ bālamaṃḍanasaṃbhavam ||
māhātmyaṃ tu dvija śreṣṭhāḥ śṛṇudhvamatha sādaram || 48 ||
āśvinasya site pakṣe daśamyādi yathākramam ||
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ yāvatpaṃcadaśī tithiḥ || 49 ||
tīrthānāṃ sa hi sarveṣāṃ snānajaṃ labhate phalam ||
śrāddhasya karaṇādvāpi vājimedhaphalaṃ dvijāḥ || 6.22.50 ||
tasminkāle sahasrākṣaḥ samāgacchati bhūtale ||
bhāgānāṃ martyajātānāṃ sevanāya sadaiva hi || 51 ||
yāvadbhūmitale śakrastiṣṭhatyevaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
tīrthe tīrthāni sarvāṇi tāvattiṣṭhanti tatra vai||52||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tasminkāle viśeṣataḥ ||
snātvā tatra śubhe tīrthai śakreśvaramathā'rcayet || 53 ||
atra ślokau purā gītau nāradaina sura ṣiṃṇā||
śṛṇvaṃtu munayaḥ sarve kīrtyamānau mayā hi tau || 54 ||
bālamaṃḍanake snātvā śakreśvaramathekṣayet ||
yaḥ pumānāśvine māsi prāpte śravaṇa pañcake ||
sa pāpairmucyate sarvairājanmamaraṇādbhuvi || 55 ||
prabhāvāttasya tīrthasya satyametaddvijottamāḥ || 56 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bālamaṇḍanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||22||

<6.23>

sūta uvāca||
tasyaiva paścime bhāge mṛgatīrthamanuttamam||
asti puṇyatamaṃ khyātaṃ samaste dharaṇītale||1||
tatra ye mānavāstīrthe samyakchraddhāsamanvitāḥ ||
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ snānaṃ kurvaṃtibhāskare || 2 ||
madhye sthite na te yāṃti tiryagyonau kathaṃcana ||
api pāpasamopetā doṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitāḥ || 3 ||
kṛtaghnā nāstikāścaurā maryādābhedakāstathā ||
snātā ye tatra sattīrthe te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim ||
vimānavaramārūḍhāḥ stūyamānāśca kiṃnaraiḥ || 4 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
mṛgatīrthaṃ kathaṃ tatra saṃjātaṃ sūtanaṃdana ||
kiṃ prabhāvaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || || 5 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
pūrvaṃ tatra mahāraṇye nānāmṛgagaṇāvṛte ||
nānāvihaṃgasaṃghuṣṭe nānāvṛkṣasamākule || 6 ||
samāyātā mahāraudrā lubdha kāścāpapāṇayaḥ ||
kṛṣṇāṃgā bhramamāṇāste yamadūtā ivā'pare || 7 ||
etasminnaṃtare dṛṣṭaṃ mṛgayūthaṃ taroradhaḥ ||
upaviṣṭaṃ suviśrabdhaṃ taistadā dvija sattamāḥ || 8 ||
atha tām̐llubdhakāndṛṣṭvā dūrato'pi bhayāturāḥ ||
palāyanaparāḥ sarve mṛgā jagmurdrutaṃ tataḥ || 9 ||
atha te sannidhau dṛṣṭvā gaṃbhīraṃ salilāśayam ||
praviṣṭā hariṇāḥ sarve bhayārtāḥ śarapīḍitāḥ || 6.23.10 ||
tatastatsalilasyāṃtaste mṛgāḥ sarva eva hi ||
mānuṣatvamanuprāptāstatprabhāvā ddvijottamāḥ || 11 ||
atha tānmānuṣībhūtānpapracchurlubdhakā mṛgān||
mṛgayūthaṃ samāyātaṃ mārgeṇānena sāṃpratam ||
kena mārgeṇa niryātaṃ tasmādvadata mā ciram || 12 ||
|| mānuṣā ūcuḥ || ||
vayaṃ te hariṇāḥ sarve mānuṣatvaṃ sudurlabham ||
tīrthasyā'sya prabhāvena prāptāḥ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 13 ||
tacchrutvā vismayāviṣṭāstataste lubdhakā drutam ||
tyaktvā dhanūṃṣi bāṇāṃśca snānaṃ tatra pracakrire ||14||
snānamātrāttataḥ sarve divyamālyānulepanāḥ ||
divyagātradharā sarve saṃjātāḥ pārthivottamāḥ || 15 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
atyāścaryamidaṃ sūta yattvayā parikīrtitam ||
snānamātreṇa te prāptā lubdhakāstādṛśaṃ vapuḥ || 16 ||
tathā mānuṣyamāpannā mṛgāstoyāvagāhanāt ||
tatkathaṃ medinīpṛṣṭhe tattīrthaṃ saṃbabhūva ha || 17 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
liṃgabhedodbhavaṃ toyaṃ yatpurā vaḥ prakīrtitam ||
ācchannaṃ pāṃsubhiḥ kṛtsnaṃ vāyunā śakraśāsanāt || 18 ||
valmīkaraṃdhramāsādya tanniṣkrāṃtaṃ punardvijāḥ ||
kālena mahatā tatra pradeśe svalpameva hi || 19 ||
yatra snātaḥ purā sadyastriśaṃkuḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
divyaṃ vapuḥ punaḥ prāpta ścaṃḍālatvena saṃsthitaḥ || 6.23.20 ||
etasmātkāraṇāttatra snātāḥ sāraṃgalubdhakāḥ ||
sarve pāpavinirmuktāḥ saṃprāptāḥ paramaṃ vapuḥ || 21 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mṛgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmatrayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || ||cha|| || 

<6.24>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatra viṣṇupadaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tīrthe śubhe sthitam ||
aparaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 ||
ayane dakṣiṇe prāpte yastatpūjya samāhitaḥ ||
nivedayettathātmānaṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 2 ||
sa mṛto'pyayane yāmye tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||
prāpnoti nātra saṃdehastatprabhāvāddvijottamāḥ || 3 ||
tathā caivottare prāpte pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ||
samyaṅnivedayedbhaktyā ātmānaṃ yaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
so'pi viṣṇoḥ padaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpya saṃjāyate sukhī || 4 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kathaṃ tatra padaṃ jātaṃ viṣṇoravyaktajanmanaḥ ||
kathaṃ nivedyate tatra samyagātmā' yanadvaye || 5 ||
tasmindṛṣṭe'thavā spṛṣṭe yatphalaṃ labhyate naraiḥ ||
tatsarvaṃ sūtaja brūhi paraṃ kautṛhalaṃ hi naḥ || 6 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
balirbaddho yadā tena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ||
tadā kramaistribhirvyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 7 ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre saṃnyastaḥ prathamaḥ kramaḥ ||
maharloke dvitī yastu tadā tena mahātmanā || 8 ||
tṛtīyasya samudyogaṃ yadā cakre sa cakradhṛk ||
tadā bhinnaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā brahmāṃḍaṃ laghutāṃ gatam || 9 ||
pādāgreṇātha saṃbhinne brahmāṃḍe nirmalaṃ jalam ||
aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa saṃprāptaṃ krameṇa dharaṇītale || 6.24.10 ||
brahmalokaṃ tadā kṛtsnaṃ plāvayitvā jalaṃ hi tat ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ kundendusadṛśadyuti ||
matsyakacchapasaṃkīrṇaṃ grāhayūthaiḥ samākulam || 11 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti sā loke gaṃgā viṣṇupadī smṛtā ||
pavitramapi tatkṣetraṃ nayantī sā pavitratām || 12 ||
evaṃ viṣṇoḥ padaṃ tatra saṃjātaṃ munisattamāḥ ||
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṃsāṃ tadā viṣṇupadī smṛtā || 13 ||
yastasyāṃ śraddhayā yuktaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā yathoditam ||
sparśayettatpadaṃ viṣṇoḥ sa yāti paramaṃ padam || 14 ||
yastatrakurute śrāddhaṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
snātvā viṣṇupadītoye gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ labhet || 15 ||
māghamāse naraḥ snānaṃ prātarutthāya tatra yaḥ ||
karoti satataṃ martyaḥ sa prayāgaphalaṃ labhet || 16 ||
athavā vatsaraṃ yāvatkṣaṇaṃ kṛtvātra bhaktitaḥ ||
tatra snānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryātsa muktiṃ labhate naraḥ || 17 ||
yasyāsthīni jale tatra kṣipyaṃte manujasya ca ||
api pāpa samācāraḥ sa prāpnoti parāṃ gatim || 18 ||
api pakṣipataṃgā ye paśavaḥ kṛmayo mṛgāḥ ||
praviṣṭāḥ salile tasmiṃstṛṣārtā bhaktivarjitāḥ || 19 ||
te'pi pāpavinirmuktā dehāṃte cātidurlabham ||
cakriṇastatpadaṃ yāṃti jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 6.24.20 ||
kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayopetāḥ parvakāla upasthite ||
dattvā dānaṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ narā vedavidāṃ dvijāḥ || 21 ||
tatra gāthā purā gītā nāradena maharṣiṇā ||
viṣṇupadyāḥ samālokya prabhāvaṃ pāpanāśanam || 22 ||
kiṃ vratairniyamairvāpi tapobhirvividhairmakhaiḥ ||
kṛtairviṣṇupadītoye saṃsthite dharaṇītale || 23 ||
ekaḥ sarveṣu tīrtheṣu snānaṃ martyaḥ samācaret ||
eko viṣṇupadītoye snāti dvābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 24 ||
eko dānāni sarvāṇi brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati ||
eko viṣṇupadītoye snāti dvābhyāṃ samaṃ hi tat || 25 ||
pañcāgnisādhako grīṣme varṣāsvākāśamāśritaḥ ||
jalāśrayaśca hemaṃta ekaḥ syātpuruṣaḥ kṣitau || 26 ||
anyo viṣṇupadītoye snātvā viṣṇupadaṃ spṛśet ||
tāvubhāvapi nirdiṣṭau samau puruṣasattamau || 27 ||
ekāṃtaropavāsī ya ekaḥ syājjīvitā vadhi ||
ekoviṣṇupadītoye snāti dvābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 28 ||
trirātropoṣitastveko yāvadvarṣaśataṃ naraḥ ||
eko viṣṇupadītoye snāti dvābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 29 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā muniśreṣṭho nārado dvijasattamāḥ ||
virarāma munīnāṃ sa bahūnāṃ purato'sakṛt || 6.24.30 ||
tasmātsarva prayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācareta ||
saṃspṛśecca padaṃ viṣṇorya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ || 31 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadetadbhavatā proktamātmānaṃ vinivedayet ||
viṣṇoḥ padasya saṃprāpte ayane dakṣiṇottare || 32 ||
tatkena vidhinā sūta mantraiśca vada satvaram ||
vayaṃ yena ca tatkurmaḥ sarvaṃ bhaktisamanvitāḥ || 33 ||
|| sūta uvāca ||
dakṣiṇe cottare cāpi saṃprāpte cāyanadvaye ||
pūjayitvā padaṃ viṣṇorimaṃ mantramudīrayet || 34 ||
ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare mṛtyuryadyakasmādbhavenmama ||
tatte padaṃ gatirme syādahaṃ te bhṛtyatāṃ gataḥ || 35 ||
evaṃ procya hariṃ paścātpūjayedbrāhmaṇāṃstataḥ ||
atha taiḥ samamaśnīyāttataḥ prāpnoti sadgatim || 36 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye viṣṇupadītīrthotpattivarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || || cha ||

<6.25>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatrāścaryamabhūtpūrvaṃ yattadbrāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
tadvo'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi gaṃgāmāhātmyasaṃbhavam || 1 ||
camatkārapure vipraḥ purāsītsaṃśitavrataḥ ||
caṃḍaśarmeti vikhyāto rūpaudāryaguṇānvitaḥ || 2 ||
sa yadā yauvanopetastadā veśyānurāgakṛt ||
śrotriyo'pyabhavadvipro yauvanodbhārapīḍitaḥ || 3 ||
sa kadācinniśīthe'tha tṛṣārtaśca samutthitaḥ ||
prārthayāmāsa tāṃ veśyāṃ pānīyaṃ pātumutsahe || 4 ||
atha sā salilabhrāṃtyā karakaṃ madyasaṃbhavam ||
samādāya dadau pānaṃ tasmai nidrākulāya ca || 5 ||
mukhamadhyagate madye so'pi tāṃ kopasaṃyutaḥ||
veśyāṃ prabhartsayāmāsa dhigdhikśabdairmuhurmuhuḥ ||6||
kimidaṃkimidaṃ pāpe tvayā karma vigarhitam ||
kṛtaṃ yanmukhamadhye me prakṣiptā niṃditā surā || 7 ||
brāhmaṇyamadya me naṣṭaṃ madyapānādasaṃśayam ||
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣyāmi tasmādātmaviśuddhaye || 8 ||
evamuktvā viniṣkramya tadgṛhādduḥkhasaṃyutaḥ ||
rurodātha tadā gatvā karuṇaṃ nirjane vane || 9 ||
tataḥ prabhātavelāyāṃ snātvā vastrasamanvitaḥ ||
tyaktvā gātrasya romāṇi samastāni dvijottamāḥ || 6.25.10 ||
saṃprāpto vipramukhyānāṃ sabhā yatra vyavasthitā ||
paṭhaṃti sarvaśāstrāṇi vedāṃtāni ca kṛtsnaśaḥ || 11 ||
athāsau praṇipatyoccaiḥ provāca dvijasattamān||
jalabhrāṃtyā surā pītā mayā kuruta nigraham || 12 ||
atha te dharmaśāstrāṇi pravicārya punaḥpunaḥ ||
tamūcurbrāhmaṇāḥ sarve prāyaścittakṛte sthitam|| 13 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ ||
ajñānājjñānato vāpi surāṃ cedbrāhmaṇaḥ pibet||
agnivarṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā tāvanmātraṃviśu dhyati || 14 ||
sa tvaṃ vāṃchasi cecchuddhimagnivarṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ piba ||
yāvanmātrā surā pītā tāvanmātraṃ viśuddhaye || 15 ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya ghṛtamādāya tatkṣaṇāt ||
cakre vahnisamaṃ yāvatpānārthaṃ dvijasattamāḥ|| 16 ||
tāvattasya pitā prāptaḥ śrutvā vārtāṃ sabhāryakaḥ ||
kimidaṃ kimidaṃ putra bruvāṇo duḥkha saṃyutaḥ ||
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇo dīno vāṣpagadgadayā girā || 17 ||
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa sarvarātrisamudbhavam||
vṛttāṃtaṃ tacca viprāṇāṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathocitam || 18||
atha sa brāhmaṇānprāha sarvāṃstāndvijasattamāḥ ||
prāyaścittaṃ sutāyāsmai mamānyatsaṃpradīyatām ||19||
saṃcintya dharmaśāstrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
sarvasvamapi dāsyāmi putrahetorasaṃśayam || 6.25.20 ||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhūyobhūyaśca sādaram ||
viciṃtya dharmaśāstrāṇi tamūcurmunisattamāḥ || 21||
nānyadasti surāpāne prāyaścittaṃ dvijanmanām ||
mauṃjīhomaṃ vinā vipra yadyuktaṃ tatsamācara ||22||
tataḥ sa svasutaṃ prāha naiva tvaṃ kartumarhasi ||
yaccha dānāni viprebhyastīrthayātrāṃ samācara || 23 ||
tataḥ śuddhiṃ samāpnoṣi kramānniyamasaṃyutaḥ ||
vrataiśca vividhaiścīrṇaiḥ satyametadbravīmyaham || 24 ||
na brāhmaṇasamādiṣṭaṃ prāyaścitta viśuddhaye || 25 ||
|| putra uvāca || ||
etanmama mahābhāgā yadbruvaṃti vratādikam ||
tasmātkāryo mayā tāta mauṃjīhomo na saṃśayaḥ || 26 ||
yanmayā tu kṛtaṃ bālye tatsarvaṃ kṣaṃtumarhasi || 27 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya taṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā sa pitā sutavatsalaḥ ||
sarvasvaṃ pradadau ruṣṭo maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ || 28 ||
sā'pi tasya satī bhāryā kṛtvā mṛtyuviniścayam ||
tamuvāca sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ dattvā gṛhādikam|| 29 ||
āvābhyāṃ saṃpraviṣṭābhyāṃ vahnau putra tatastadā ||
mauṃjīhomastvayā kāryo māṃ tātaṃ yadi manyase || 6.25.30 ||
tatastau dampatī hṛṣṭau yāvadvahnisamīpagau ||
saṃjātau maraṇārthāya sa ca tābhyāṃ samudbhavaḥ || 31 ||
tāvatprāpto munirnāma śāṃḍilyo vedapāragaḥ ||
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tatra deśe dvijottamāḥ || 32 ||
sa vṛttāṃtaṃ samākarṇya kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ ||
abravīdbrāhmaṇānsarvānbhartsamāno muhurmuhuḥ || 33 ||
aho mūḍhatamā yūyaṃ yadetadbrāhmaṇatrayam ||
vṛthā mṛtyumavāpnoti nigrahe sugame sati||34||
atra kātyāyanenoktaṃ yadvacaḥ sumahātmanā ||
tacchṛṇvantu dvijāḥ sarve prāyaścittī tathāpyayam || 35 ||
cāṃdrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā sāṃtapanāni ca ||
prāyaścittāni dīyaṃte yatra gaṃgā na vidyate || 36 ||
atra viṣṇupadī gaṃgā tatkṣetre tu dvijottamāḥ ||
tasyāṃ snānaṃ karotveṣa tataḥ śuddhimavāpsyati || 37 ||
mauṃjīhomaḥ pramāṇaṃ syānmunivākyena cedbhavet ||
tadetadapi vākyaṃ hi kātyāyanamuneḥ sphuṭam || 38 ||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve harṣeṇa mahatānvitāḥ ||
sādhusādhviti taṃ procya procuḥ satyamidaṃ mune || 39 ||
tataḥ prabodhya taṃ vipraṃ ninyustatra dvijottamāḥ ||
yatra viṣṇupadī gaṃgā svayameva vyavasthitā || 6.25.40 ||
tatra sa brāhmaṇo yāvadgaṃgātoyasamudbhavam ||
gaṃḍūṣaṃ kurute vaktre tāvacchuddho babhūva saḥ ||
udarādakhilaṃ toyaṃ niṣkrāṃtaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 41 ||
tato'vagāhate yāvattasyāstoyaṃ suśobhanam ||
tāvadākāśasaṃbhūtā gambhīrovāca bhāratī || 42 ||
śuddho'yaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sākṣādviṣṇupadyāḥ samāgamāt ||
snānādācamanādeva tasmādyātu gṛhaṃ nijam || || 43 ||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve caṃḍaśarmādayaśca ye ||
diṣṭyādiṣṭyeti jalpantaḥ svāni harmyāṇi bhejire || 44 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ prabhāvā sā viprā gaṃgā viṣṇupadī sthitā ||
tasya kṣetrasya sīmāṃte paścime pāpanāśinī || 45 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ viṣṇupadyāḥ samudbhavam ||
māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam || 46 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye viṣṇupadīgaṃgāmāhāmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 || || cha ||

<6.26>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
yatpūrvāparasīmāntaṃ tanmayā saṃprakīrtitam ||
dakṣiṇottarasaṃbhūtaṃ tadvo vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam || 1 ||
asti bhūbhitale khyātā madhurākhyā mahāpurī ||
nānāviprasa mākīrṇā yamunātaṭasaṃśrayā || 2 ||
tasyāmāsīddvijaśreṣṭho gokarṇa iti viśrutaḥ ||
vedādhyayanasaṃpannaḥ sarvaśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ || 3 ||
athāparo'sti tannāmā tatra vipro vayo'nvitaḥ ||
so'pi ca brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvavidyāsu pāragaḥ || 4 ||
kasyacittvathakālasya yamaḥ prāha svakiṃkaram ||
ūrdhvakeśaṃ suraktākṣaṃ kṛṣṇadantaṃ bhayānakam || 5 ||
adya gaccha drutaṃ dūta mathurākhyāṃ mahāpurīm ||
ānayasva dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ tasyāṃ gokarṇasaṃjñakam || 6 ||
tasyāyuṣaḥ kṣayo jāto madhyāhne'dyatane dine ||
tyājyo'nyo'sti ca tatraiva cirāyustādṛśo dvijaḥ || 7 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha dūto drutaṃ gatvā tāṃ purīṃ yamaśāsanāt ||
vibhramādānayāmāsa gokarṇaṃ ca cirāyuṣam|| 8 ||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā yamaḥ provāca kiṃkaram ||
dīrghāyureṣa ānīto dhikpāpa kimidaṃ kṛtam ||9||
tasmātprāpaya tatraiva yāvadasya ca bandhubhiḥ ||
no gātraṃ dahyate śokātsusamiddhena vahninā || 6.26.10 ||
|| || brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
nāhaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi diṣṭyā prāptosmi teṃ'tikam||
vāṃchamānaḥ sadā mṛtyuṃ dāridryeṇa kadarthitaḥ || 11 ||
|| yama uvāca || ||
nimiṣeṇāpino martyamānayāmi mahītalāt ||
āyuḥśeṣeṇa viprendra pūrṇenātha tyajāmi na|| 12 ||
tata eva hi me nāma dharmarāja iti smṛtam||
samatvātsarvajaṃtūnāṃ pakṣapātavivarjanāt || 13 ||
tasmādgaccha gṛhaṃ vipra yāvadgātraṃ na dahyate ||
baṃdhubhistava śokārtairnādhunā tatra te sthitiḥ || 14 ||
prārthayasva mano'bhīṣṭaṃ varaṃ brāhmaṇasattama ||
na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syātkathaṃcidapi dehinām || 15 ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
avaśyaṃ yadi gaṃtavyaṃ mayā deva gṛhaṃ punaḥ ||
tanmamācakṣva pṛcchāmi varaścaiṣa bhavenmama || 16 ||
ete ye narakā raudrāḥ sevitāḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ ||
dṛśyaṃte vada kaḥ kena karmaṇā sevyate janaiḥ || 17 ||
|| yama uvāca || ||
asaṃkhyā narakā vipra yathā prāṇigaṇāḥ kṣitau ||
kṛtsnaśaḥ kathituṃ śakyā naivavarṣaśatairapi || 18 ||
kīrtayiṣyāmi teṣāṃ te prādhānyena dvijottama ||
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyā ye pāpilokakṛte kṛtāḥ || 19 ||
ādyo'yaṃ rauravo nāma narako dvijasattama ||
prataptatailakuṃbheṣu pacyaṃte yatra jaṃtavaḥ || 6.26.20 ||
hā mātastāta putreti prakurvaṃti sudāruṇam||
parapākaratāḥ kṣudrāḥ paradravyā pahārakāḥ || 21 ||
dvitīya eṣa vipreṃdra mahārauravasaṃjñitaḥ ||
kṛtaghnaiḥ sevyate nityaṃ tathā ca gurutalpagaiḥ||22 ||
rorūyamāṇairdāhārtaiḥ pacyamānai rhavirbhujā ||
khaṃḍaśaḥ kriyamāṇaiśca tīkṣṇaśastrairanekadhā || 23 ||
tṛtīyoṃ'dhatamonāma narakaḥ subhayāvahaḥ ||
atra ye puruṣā yāṃti tāṃśca vakṣyāmi sudvija || 24 ||
duṣṭena cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭāḥ paradārā narādhamaiḥ ||
sulohāsyāḥ khagāsteṣāṃ haraṃtyatra vilocane || 29 ||
caturtho'yaṃ prataptākhyo narakaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ ||
atra te yātanāṃ bhuktvā tathā śuddhā bhavaṃti ca || 26 ||
yaiḥ kṛtā satataṃ niṃdā gurudevatapasvi nām||
teṣāmutpāṭyate jihvā jātājātā'tra bhūriśaḥ || 27 ||
eṣo'nyaḥ paṃcamo nāma suprasiddho vidārakaḥ ||
mitradroharatāścātra cchidyaṃte karapatrakaiḥ || 28 ||
prataptavālukāpūrṇo dhmāyate yaśca vahninā ||
nikumbha iti vikhyātaḥ ṣaṣṭho lokabhayāvahaḥ || 29 ||
prāṇāṃtikaṃ purā dattaṃ yairduḥkhaṃ prāṇināṃ naraiḥ ||
aparādhaṃ vinā te'tra pacyaṃte vālukotkaraiḥ || 6.26.30 ||
bībhatsuriti vikhyātaḥ saptamo narakādhamaḥ ||
mūtrāmedhya samākīrṇaḥ samaṃtādatigarhitaḥ || 31 ||
rājagāmi ca paiśunyaṃ yaiḥ kṛtaṃ sudurātmabhiḥ ||
amedhyapūrṇavaktrāste dhāryaṃte'tra narādhamāḥ || 32 ||
kutsitonāma vikhyāto dvijāyaṃ cāṣṭamo'dhamaḥ ||
śleṣmamūtrābhisaṃpūrṇaistathā gandhaiśca kutsitaiḥ || 33 ||
gurudevātithibhyaśca svabhṛtyebhyo viśeṣataḥ ||
adattvā bhojanaṃ yaistu kṛtaṃ te'tra vyavasthitāḥ || 34 ||
eṣa durgamanāmā ca navamo dvijasattama ||
tīkṣṇakaṃṭakasaṃkīrṇaḥ sarpavṛścikasaṃkulaḥ || || 35 ||
ekasārthaprayātāya kṣutkṣāmāyāvasīdate ||
adattvā bhojanaṃ yaiśca kṛtaṃ te'tra vyavasthitāḥ || 36 ||
daśamo'yaṃ suvikhyāto narako nāmaduḥ sahaḥ ||
taptalohamayaiḥ staṃbhaiḥ samaṃtātparivāritaḥ || 37 ||
ye pāpāḥ paradāreṣu raktā miṣṭāmiṣeṣu vā ||
taptalohamayānstaṃbhāṃste'trāliṃgaṃti mānavāḥ || || 38 ||
ekādaśo'paraścāyamākarṣākhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
narako vipraśārdūla taptasaṃdaṃśasaṃkulaḥ || 39 ||
strīvipragurudevānāṃ vittaṃ cāśnaṃti ye narāḥ ||
saṃdaṃśairapi kṛṣyaṃte tatra taptaiḥ samaṃtataḥ || 6.26.40 ||
saṃdaṃśo dvādaśaścāyaṃ tathā'bhakṣyaprabhakṣakāḥ ||
lohadaṃtamukhairgṛdhairbhakṣyaṃte'tra narādhamāḥ || 41 ||
eṣa trayodaśonāma suvikhyāto niyaṃtrakaḥ ||
samaṃtātkṛmibhirvyāptastathā ca dṛḍhabandhanaiḥ || 42 ||
nyāsāpahārakāḥ pāpāstatra baddhāśca baṃdhanaiḥ ||
kṛmivṛścika kīṭādyairbhakṣyate dvijasattama || 43 ||
tathā caturdaśonāma narako'dhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ ||
narakāṇāṃ samastānāmeṣa raudratamākṛtiḥ || 44 ||
atra cādhomukhā baddhā vṛkṣaśākhāvalaṃbitāḥ ||
pacyaṃte vahninā'dhastādbrahmaghnā ye ca mānavāḥ || 45 ||
yūkāmatkuṇadaṃśādyaiḥ saṃkīrṇo'yaṃ dvijottama ||
narako bhīṣaṇo nāma khyātaḥ pañcadaśo mahān || 46 ||
kūṭasākṣyaratānāṃ ca tathaivānṛtavādinām ||
atrāśrayo mayā dattastathānyeṣāṃ kukarmiṇām || 47 ||
eṣa ṣoḍaśa uddiṣṭo narako nāma kṣudradaḥ ||
yudhārtairmānavairvyāptaḥ samaṃtāddvijasattama ||49||
mṛṣṭamāṃsāni yaiḥ pāpairbhakṣitāni dvijanmabhiḥ ||
kṣudhārtāste nijaṃ kāyaṃ bhakṣayaṃtyatra saṃsthitāḥ || 49 ||
tathā saptadaśaścāyaṃ kṣārākhyo narakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
sukṣāreṇa samākīrṇaḥ sarvaprāṇibhayāvahaḥ || 6.26.50 ||
vratabhaṃgakarā ye ca ye ca pāṣaṇḍino narāḥ ||
te'trāgatya śitaiḥ śastraiḥ piṣyaṃte pāpakṛttamāḥ || 51 ||
eṣa cāṣṭādaśo nāma kathitaśca nidāghakaḥ ||
jvalitāṃgārasaṃkīrṇo duḥsevyaḥ sarvadehinām || 52 ||
dūṣayaṃti ca ye śāstraṃ kāvyaṃ vipraṃ ca kanyakām ||
aṃgārāṃtaḥ sthitāte'tra dhriyaṃte mānavā dvija || || 53 ||
ekonaviṃśatiścāyaṃ prakhyātaḥ kūṭaśālmaliḥ ||
sutīkṣṇakaṃṭakākīrṇaḥ samaṃtāddvijasattama || 54 ||
nāstikā bhinnamaryādā ye ca viprasya ghātakāḥ ||
te sarve'tra narā nityamāruhaṃti pataṃti ca ||95||
eṣa viṃśatimo nāma narako dvijasattama ||
asipatravanākhyaśca kaṣṭasevyo durātmabhiḥ || || 56 ||
atra yāṃti narā vipra pararaṃdhranirīkṣakāḥ ||
kūṭakarmaratā ye ca śāstravikrayakārakāḥ || 57 ||
ekaviṃśatimā caiṣā nāmnā vaitaraṇī nadī ||
sarvaireva narairgamyā dharmapāpānuyāyibhiḥ || 58 ||
mṛtyukāle samutpanne dhenuṃ yacchaṃti ye narāḥ ||
tasyā lāṃgūlamāśritya tārayaṃti sukhena ca || 59 ||
adattvā gāṃ ca ye martyā mriyaṃte dvijasattama ||
tīrtvā hastādibhirdurgā ta imāṃ saṃtaraṃti ca || 6.26.60||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottama ||
vistareṇa tava prītyā svarūpaṃ narakodbhavam||61||
tasmādgaccha gṛhaṃ śīghraṃ yāvadgātraṃ na dahyate||
bandhubhistava śokārtairgṛhītvā vāṃchitaṃ dhanam || 62 || ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
yadi deva mayā samyaggaṃtavyaṃ nijamaṃdiram ||
tadbrūhi karmaṇā yena narakaṃ yāti no naraḥ || 63 ||
|| yama uvāca || || ||
tīrthayātrāparo nityaṃ devatātithipūjakaḥ ||
brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca na yāti narakaṃ naraḥ || 64 ||
paropakārasaṃyukto nityaṃ japaparāyaṇaḥ ||
svādhyāyanirataścaiva na yāti narakaṃ dvija || 65 ||
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca ||
yaḥ karoti naro nityaṃ narakaṃ na sa paśyati || 66 ||
hemaṃte vahnido yaḥ syāttathā grīṣme jalapradaḥ ||
varṣāsvāśrayado yaśca narakaṃ na sa paśyati || 67 ||
vratopavāsasaṃyuktaḥ śāṃtātmā vijiteṃdriyaḥ ||
brahmacārī sadā dhyānī narakaṃ yāti no naraḥ || 68 ||
annaprado naro yaḥ syādviśeṣeṇa tilapradaḥ ||
ahiṃsānirataścaiva narakaṃ na sa paśyati ||69||
vedādhyayanasaṃpannaḥ śāstrāsaktaḥ sumṛṣṭavāk ||
dharmākhyānaparo nityaṃ narakaṃ na sa paśyati || 6.26.70 ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
etanmūrkho'pi jānāti śubhakarmakaraḥ pumān ||
na yāti narakaṃ svarge tathā pāpakriyārataḥ || 71 ||
tasmādaśubhakarmāpi karmaṇā yena pātakam ||
svalpenāpi nihantyāśu yāti svargaṃ narastataḥ || 72 ||
tanmebrūhi suraśreṣṭha vrataṃ niyamameva vā ||
tīrthaṃ vā japahomaṃ vā sarvalokasukhāvaham || 73 ||
|| yama uvāca || ||
atra te sumahadguhyaṃ kīrtayiṣye dvijottadha ||
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena vacanānmama sarvadā ||74||
mahāpātakayukto'pi puruṣo yena karmaṇā ||
anuṣṭhitena no yāti narakaṃ kleśakārakam|| 75 ||
ānartaviṣaye ramyaṃ sarvatīrthamayaṃ śubham ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ mahāpātakanāśanam||76||
tatraikamapi māsārdhaṃ yo bhaktyā pūjayeddharam||
sa sarvapāpayukto'pi śivaloke mahīyate || 77 ||
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gatvā tvamārādhaya śaṃkaram ||
yena gacchasi nirvāṇaṃ daśabhiḥ puruṣaiḥ saha|| 78 ||
||sūta uvāca|| ||
upadeśaṃ samākarṇya sa yadā prasthito gṛham||
dharmarājasya saṃhaṣṭo madhurāṃ nagarīṃ prati ||79||
tāvaddvitīyaṃ go karṇaṃ dūta ādāya saṃgataḥ ||
darśayāmāsa dhṛtvāgre dharmarājasya satvaram || 6.26.80 ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ dūtaṃ dharmarājaḥ praharṣitaḥ ||
gokarṇaṃ purato dṛṣṭvā dvitīyaṃ prasthitaṃ gṛham ||81||
yasmātkālātyayaṃ kṛtvā''nīto'yaṃ brāhmaṇastvayā ||
tasmādenamapi kṣipraṃ dvitīyena samaṃ tyaja ||82||
tatastau tatkṣaṇānmuktau gokarṇau brāhmaṇau samam ||
svaṃsvaṃ kalevaraṃ prāpya sahasātha samanvitau || 83 ||
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa gokarṇaḥ prathamo dvijaḥ ||
yamopadeśasaṃjuṣṭo dvitīyāya savistaram || 84 ||
tato gṛhaṃ parityajya gokarṇau dvāvapi sthitau ||
devatāyatanairvyāptaṃ kṣetraṃ dṛṣṭvā'khilaṃ tataḥ || 85 ||
liṃge saṃsthāpite tābhyāṃ sīmāṃte dakṣiṇottare ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ saṃprāpya tapasi drutam || 86 ||
tataḥ śivaṃ samārādhya tapaḥ kṛtvā yathocitam ||
saśarīrau divaṃ prāptau tatprabhāvādvijottamāḥ || 87 ||
tābhyāṃ mārgacaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ jāgaraḥ kṛtaḥ ||
yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā sa gacchati śivālayam || 88 ||
aputro labhate putrāndhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt ||
niṣkāmastu punarmokṣaṃ naro yāti na saṃśayaḥ || 89 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ sīmāṃtaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
kṣetrasyāsya pramāṇaṃ ca vistareṇa caturdiśam || 6.26.90 ||
atrāṃtare narā ye ca nivasaṃti dvijottamāḥ ||
kṛṣikarmodyatāścāpi yāṃti te paramāṃ gatim ||
kiṃ punarniyatātmānaḥ śāṃtā dāṃtā jiteṃdriyāḥ || 91 ||
api kīṭapataṃgā ye paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ ||
tasminkṣetre mṛtā yāṃti svargalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 92 ||
kiṃ punarye narāstatra kṛtvā prāyopaveśanam ||
saṃnyastāḥ śraddhayopetā hṛdayasthe janārdane || 93 ||
tasmātsarva prayatnena tatkṣetraṃ sevyameva hi ||
viśeṣeṇa kalau prāpte yuge pāpasamāvṛte || 94 ||
punaṃti snānadānābhyāṃ sarvatīrthānyasaṃśayam ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ punarvāsātpunāti ca || 95 ||
vāpīkūpataḍāgeṣu yatrayatra jalaṃ dvijāḥ ||
tatratatra naraḥ snātaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 96 ||
kiṃ yrajñaiḥ kiṃ vṛthā dānaiḥ ka vrataiḥ kiṃ japairapi ||
varaṃ tatra kṛto vāsaḥ kṣetre svargamabhīpsubhiḥ || 97 ||
etatpavitramāyuṣyaṃ māṃgalyaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
hāṭakeśvarajakṣetramāhātmyaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sadā || 98 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gokarṇatīrthamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || || cha ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
caturyugasvarūpaṃ tu māhātmyaṃ caiva sūtaja ||
pramāṇaṃ vada kārtsnyena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
imamarthaṃ purā pṛṣṭo vāsavena bṛhaspatiḥ ||
yathā provāca vipreṃdrāstadvo vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam || 2 ||
purā śakraṃ samāsīnaṃ sabhāyāṃ tridaśaiḥ saha ||
saha śacyā mahātmānamupāsāṃcakrire surāḥ || 3 ||
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva siddhavidyādharāśca ye ||
guhyakāḥ kiṃnarā daityā rākṣasā uragāstathā || 4 ||
kalāḥ kāṣṭhānimeṣāśca nakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā ||
sāṃgā vedāstathā mūrtāstīrthānyāyatanāni ca || 5 ||
tathā cakruḥ kathāścitrā devadānavarakṣasām ||
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ brahmarṣīṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 6 ||
kasmiṃścidatha saṃprāpte prastāve tridaśeśvaraḥ ||
papraccha vinayopeto vipraśreṣṭhaṃ bṛhaspatim || 7 ||
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi pramāṇaṃ yugasaṃbhavam ||
māhātmyaṃ ca svarūpaṃ ca yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 8 ||
|| bṛhaspati ruvāca || ||
ahaṃ te kīrtayiṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ yugasaṃbhavam ||
yatpramāṇaṃ svarūpaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvāvahitaḥ sthitaḥ || 9 ||
aṣṭāviṃśatisahasrāṇi lakṣāḥ saptadaśaiva tu ||
pramāṇena kṛtaṃ proktaṃ yatra śuklo janārdanaḥ||6.27.10||
catuṣpādastathā dharmaḥ susaṃpūrṇā vasundharā ||
kāmakrodhavinirmuktā bhayadveṣavivarjitāḥ||11||
janāścirāyuṣastatra śāntātmāno jitendriyāḥ ||
pañcatālapramāṇāśca dīptimanto bahuśrutāḥ || 12 ||
tatra ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ bālatvaṃ jāyate nṛṇām ||
tataśca yauvanaṃ proktaṃ dvātriṃśadyāvadeva hi || 13 ||
tataḥ paraṃ ca vārddhakyaṃ śanaiḥ saṃjāyate nṛṇām||
lakṣāṃte paramaṃ yāvadanyeṣāmadhikaṃ kvacit || 14 ||
tatra sattvāśca ye kecitpaśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ ||
daivīṃ vācaṃ prajalpaṃti na virodhaṃ vrajaṃti ca ||15||
krīḍaṃti nakulaiḥ sarpā biḍālā mūṣakaiḥ samam ||
pañcānanairmṛgā nityamulūkāścāpi vāyasaiḥ ||16||
akṛṣṭā ca mahī sasyaṃ janayatyati bhūriśaḥ ||
vrīhimudgayavaprāyaṃ susvādu balavṛddhidam ||17||
sarvartuphalino vṛkṣāḥ sapuṣpaphaladhāriṇaḥ ||
supatrāḥ kaṃṭakairhīnāḥ kalpapādapasaṃnibhāḥ||18||
dhenavaśca prayacchaṃti vāṃchitaṃ svādu satpayaḥ ||
sarveṣvapi hi kāleṣu bhūri sarppiḥpradaṃ nṛṇām|| 19 ||
na tatra vidhavā nārī jāyate na ca durbhagā ||
kākavaṃdhyā sutairhīnā na ca śīlavivarjitā ||6.27.20||
yathājanma tathā mṛtyuḥ kramātsaṃjāyate nṛṇām ||
na vīkṣate pitā putraṃ mṛtaṃ kvāpi kadācana || 21 ||
na pretatvaṃ ca lokānāṃ mṛtānāṃ tatra jāyate ||
na cāpi narake vāso na ca rogavyathā kvacit || 22 ||
vedāṃtagā dvijāḥ sarve nityaṃ svādhyāyaśīlinaḥ ||
vedavyākhyānasaṃhṛṣṭā brahmajñānavicakṣaṇāḥ || 23 ||
kṣatriyāścāpi bhūpālamekaṃ kṛtvā subhaktitaḥ ||
tadādeśātprabhuṃjaṃti mahīṃ dharmeṇa nityaśaḥ ||24||
vaiśyā vaiśyajanārhāṇi cakruḥ karmāṇi bhūriśaḥ ||
paśupālanapūrvāṇi krayavikrayajāni ca || 25 ||
muktvaikāṃ dvijaśuśrūṣā na śūdrāstatra cakrire ||
kiṃcitkarma suraśreṣṭha śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ || 26 ||
na tatra cāṃtyajo jajñe na ca saṃkarasaṃbhavaḥ ||
nāpavitro na varṇānāṃ pañcamo dṛśyate bhuvi || 27 ||
yajanaṃ yājanaṃ dānaṃ vrataṃ niyama eva ca ||
tīrthayātrāṃ narāstatra niṣkāmā eva kurvate || 28 ||
evaṃvidhaṃ sahasrākṣa mayā te parikīrtitam ||
ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham || 29 ||
tatastretāyugaṃ nāma dvitīyaṃ saṃpravartate ||
varṣāṇāṃ ṣaṇṇavatyāḍhyā lakṣā dvādaśa saṃkhyayā || 6.27.30 ||
so'pi sākṣājagannāthaḥ śvetadvīpāśrayāśritaḥ ||
tatra raktatvamāyāti bhaga vāngaruḍadhvajaḥ || 31 ||
tripādastatra dharmaḥ syātpādenaikena pātakam ||
tenāpi jāyate sparddhā varṇānāmitaretaram || 32 ||
tataḥ phalāni vāṃchaṃti tīrthayātrodbhavāni te ||
vratānāṃ niyamānāṃ ca svargavāsādihetavaḥ || 33 ||
tataḥ kāmavaśānmohaṃ sarve gacchaṃti mānavāḥ ||
mohāddrohaṃ tato gatvā pāpaṃ kurvaṃtyanukramāt || 34 ||
tatastu rauravādīni narakāṇi yamaḥ svayam ||
sajjīkaroti devendra hyekaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā || 35 ||
karmānusāratastāni sevayaṃti narādhamāḥ ||
kecidanye mahendrādilokānmokṣaṃ tathā pare || 36 ||
trividhāḥ puruṣāstatra śreṣṭhāścādhamamadhyamāḥ ||
trividhāni ca karmāṇi prakurvaṃti sureśvara || 37 ||
unnatāstālamātreṇa tejovīryasamanvitāḥ ||
cakruśca kṛṣikarmāṇi vaiśyāścaivānnalipsayā || 38 ||
uptakṣetraṃ sakṛccāpi saptavāraṃ lunaṃti te ||
yathartu phalino vṛkṣā yathartu kusumānvitāḥ || 39 ||
yathartu patrasaṃyuktāstatra syuḥ sumanoharāḥ ||
agniṣṭomādikā yajñāḥ pravartaṃte sahasraśaḥ || 6.27.40 ||
itaretarasaṃspardhaiḥ kriyamāṇā nṛpottamaiḥ ||
brāhmaṇaiśca suraśreṣṭha svargalokamabhīpsubhiḥ || 41 ||
tīrthayātrāṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ niyamaṃ saṃyamaṃ tathā ||
paralokamabhīpsaṃtastatra kurvaṃti mānavāḥ || 42 ||
sahasreṇa tu varṣāṇāṃ tatra syādyauvanaṃ nṛṇām ||
sahasrapañcakaṃ yāvadūrdhvaṃ vārddhaka mucyate || 43 ||
rajakaścarmakāraśca naṭo buruḍa eva ca ||
kaivarttamedabhillāśca caṃḍālāḥ śūdramānavāḥ || 44 ||
saṃbhavaṃti yuge tasminyo nisaṃsargato vibho ||
tathānye saṃkhyayā hīnā etebhyo niṃditā narāḥ || 458 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
utpattiḥ kathameteṣāmaṃtyajānāṃ dvijo ttama ||
yathāvadvada kārtsnyena atra kautūhalaṃ mahat || 46 ||
|| bṛhaspatiruvāca || ||
eteṣāmaṣṭadhā sṛṣṭirjāyateṃ'tyajasaṃbhavā ||
yoni doṣātsuraśreṣṭha jātervakṣyāmyahaṃ sphuṭam || 47 ||
brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyājjātaḥ sūta ityabhidhīyate ||
sūtena rajakaścaiva rajakena ca carmakṛt || || 48 ||
carmakāreṇa saṃjajñe naṭaścāṃtyajasaṃjñakaḥ ||
catvāraḥ kṣetrasaṃbhūtā ete kṣetre dvijanmanām || 49 ||
tathā ca māgadho jajñe vaiśyena dvijasaṃbhave ||
kṣetre māgadhavīryeṇa buruḍo maruduttama || 6.27.50 ||
buruḍena ca kaivartaḥ kaivartena ca medakaḥ ||
catvāro vaiśyasaṃbhūtā ete kṣetre dvijanmanām ||
prajāyante suraśreṣṭha savakarmasu garhitāḥ || 51 ||
tathā śūdreṇa saṃjajñe brāhmaṇyāṃ surasattama ||
bhillākhyaścāpi bhillena caṃḍālaśca prajāyate || 52 ||
etau dvāvapi śūdreṇa bhavato dvijasaṃbhave ||
kṣetre sarvasurādhīśa satyametanmayoditam || 53 ||
etattretāyuge proktaṃ mayā te surasattama ||
ākarṇaya prayatnena dvāparasyādhunā sthitim || 54 ||
lakṣāṣṭakapramāṇena tadyugaṃ parikīrtitam ||
catuḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ parisaṃ khyayā ||
kapiśo jāyate tatra bhagavāngaruḍadhvajaḥ || 55 ||
dvau pādau caiva dharmasya dvau pāpasya vyavasthitau ||
tatra syādyauvanaṃ nṛṇāṃ gate varṣaśate' khile || 56 ||
tato'nyaiḥ samatikrāṃtairvārdhakyaṃ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ ||
tatra satyānṛtā lokā devā bhūpāstathā pare || 57 ||
nāryaścāpi suraśreṣṭha tatsva rūpāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
paṃcahastapramāṇena caturhastāstathā paraṃ || 58 ||
nātirūpeṇa saṃyuktā na ca rūpavivarjitāḥ ||
avyaktajalpakāścāpi paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ || 59 ||
nātipuṣpaphalairyuktā vṛkṣāścāpisureśvara ||
sasyāni tāni jāyante tatra coptānikarṣukaiḥ || 6.27.60 ||
varṣaṃti jaladāḥ kāmaṃ bhavantyoṣadhayo'khilāḥ ||
yatkiṃcidbhūtale jñānaṃ śāstraṃ vā surasattama ||
tattatra samabhāvena na satyaṃ naiva cānṛtam || 61 ||
tīrthānāṃ ca makhānāṃ ca dvāpare surasattama ||
phalaṃ bhāvānurūpeṇa dānānāṃ ca prajāyate || 62 ||
etattava samākhyātaṃ yugaṃ dvāparasaṃjñakam ||
mayā sarvaṃ surādhīśa yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathā śrutam || 63 ||
śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā vadato mama sāṃpratam ||
raudraṃ kaliyugaṃnāma yatra kṛṣṇo janārdanaḥ || 64 ||
dvātriṃśacca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ kathitaṃ vibho ||
tathā lakṣacatuṣkeṇa sādhulokavivarjitam ||65||
tatraikapādayuktaśca dharmaḥ pāpaṃ tribhiḥ smṛtam ||
pūrvārdhebhyaḥ paraṃ sarvaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati pāta kam || 66 ||
na śṛṇvaṃti pituḥ putrā na snuṣā bhrātaro na ca ||
na bhṛtyā na kalatrāṇi yatra dveṣaḥ parasparam || 67 ||
yatra ṣoḍaśame varṣe narāḥ palita yauvanāḥ ||
tatra dvādaśame varṣe garbhaṃ dhāsyati cāṃganā || 68 ||
āyuḥ paraṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ śatasaṃkhyaṃ sureśvara ||
nāgānāṃ ca tarūṇāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ yatra nādhikam || 69 ||
dvātriṃśaddhayamukhyānāṃ caturviṃśatiḥ kharoṣṭrayoḥ ||
ajānāṃ ṣoḍaśa proktaṃ śunāṃ dvādaśasaṃkhyayā || 6.27.70 ||
catuṣpadānāmanyeṣāṃ viṃśatiḥ paṃcabhiryutā ||
yatra kākāśca gṛdhrāśca kauśikāścirajīvinaḥ || 71 ||
tathā pāpaparā lokā duḥsthitāśca viśeṣataḥ ||
tathā kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā rūkṣāḥ puṣpaphalacyutāḥ ||
sevitāste'pi gṛdhrādyairyatra cchāyāvivarjitāḥ || 72 ||
yatra dharmo hyadharmeṇa pīḍyate surasattama ||
asatyena tathā satyaṃ bhūpāścauraiḥ sadaiva tu || 73 ||
guravaśca tathā śiṣyaiḥ strībhiśca puruṣādhamāḥ ||
svāmino bhṛtyavargaiśca mūrkhaiścāpi bahuśrutāḥ || 74 ||
yatra sīdaṃti dharmiṣṭhā narāḥ satyaparāyaṇāḥ ||
dāntā vivekinaḥ śāntāstathā parahite ratāḥ || 75 ||
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva tathā pīḍā mahādbhutā ||
sadaiva saṃsthitā yatra sādhupīḍanavāṃchayā || 76 ||
alpāyuṣastathā martyā jāyaṃte varṇasaṃkarāt ||
ye kecana prajīvaṃti duḥkhena te samanvitāḥ ||77||
na varṣati ghanaḥ kāle saṃprāpte'pi yathocite ||
na sasyaṃ syātsuvṛṣṭepi karṣukasyāpi vāṃchitam || 78 ||
na ca kṣīrapradā gāvo yadyapi syuḥ supoṣitāḥ ||
na bhavaṃti prabhū tāśca yatnenāpi surakṣitāḥ || 79 || ||
āvikānāṃ tathoṣṭrīṇāṃ yatra kṣīrapraśaṃsakāḥ ||
lokā bhavaṃti niḥśrīkāstathā ye ca malimlucāḥ ||6.27.80 ||
tathā tapasvinaḥ śūdrāḥ śūdrā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ ||
śūdrā vedavicārajñā yajñakarmaṇi codyatāḥ || 81 ||
śūdrāḥ pratigrahītāraḥ śūdrā dānapradāstathā ||
śūdrāścāpi tathā vandyāḥ śadrāstīrtheṣu saṃsthitāḥ || 82 ||
paṃcagartānkhanaṃtyeva mṛtyukāle narādhamāḥ ||
śirasā hastapādābhyāṃ mohātsaṃnaṣṭacetanāḥ || 83 ||
vedavikrayakartāro brāhmaṇāḥ śaucavarjitāḥ || 84 ||
svādhyāyarahitāścaiva śūdrānnaniratāḥ sadā ||
asatpratigrahāḥ prāyo jihvālaulyasamutsukāḥ || 85 ||
pākhaṃḍino vikarmasthāḥ paradāropajīvinaḥ||
kāryakāraṇamāśritya yatra snehaḥ prajāyate||86||
na svabhāvātsahasrākṣa kathaṃcidapi dehinām||
yāsyaṃti mlecchabhāvaṃ ca sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ||87||
naṣṭotsavāvidharmāṇo nityaṃ saṃkarakārakāḥ||
sārdhahastatrayāḥ pūrvaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti yugāditaḥ||88||
tato hrāsaṃ prayāsyaṃti vṛddhiṃ yāti kalau yuge ||
bhaviṣyanti tataścāṃte manuṣyā bilaśāyinaḥ || 89 ||
alpatvāddurlabhatvācca aśaktā gṛhakarmaṇi ||
bhaviṣyaṃtyaphalā yajñāstathā vedavratāni ca || 6.27.90 ||
niyamāḥ saṃyamāḥ sarve maṃtravādāstathaiva ca ||
tīrthāni mlecchasaṃsparśāddūṣitāni śatakrato || || 91 ||
svasvabhāvavihīnāni hīnāni ca tathā jalaiḥ ||
kutsitā maṃtravādā ye kutsitāśca tapasvinaḥ || 92 ||
tatra te saṃbhaviṣyaṃti kutsitā ye ca mānavāḥ ||
kulīnamapi saṃtyajya varaṃ rūpavayonvitam || 93 ||
vittalobhātpradāsyaṃti kutsitāya narāḥ sutām ||
kanyakāḥ prasaviṣyaṃti kanyakāḥ suratotsukāḥ || 94 ||
kanyakāḥ prakariṣyaṃti puruṣaiḥ saha saṃgatim ||
bhartāraṃ vaṃcayiṣyaṃti kulīnā api yoṣitaḥ || 95 ||
sarvakṛtyeṣu duḥśīlāḥ| suyatnenāpi rakṣitāḥ ||
nirdayāścāpi bhūpālāḥ pīḍayiṣyaṃti karṣukān || 96 ||
pīḍayiṣyaṃti nirdoṣānvittalobhādasaṃśayam ||
vadhārhamapi saṃprāpya vittalobhānmalimlucam || 97 ||
saṃtyakṣyaṃti yuge tasminprāṇidrohe'pi vartinam ||
kṣātradharmaṃ parityajya kariṣyaṃti tathā raṇam || 98 ||
|| bṛhaspatiruvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yugānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mayā ||
pramāṇaṃ ca suraśreṣṭha caturṇāmapyasaṃśayam || 99 ||
yaścaitatkīrtayenmartyaḥ sadaiva susā māhitaḥ ||
sa nūnaṃ mucyate pāpādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt || 6.27.100 ||
śṛṇuyādvā naro yaśca śraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
so'pi mucyenna sandehaḥ pāpācca divasodbhavāt || 101 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye caturyugasvarūpavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || || cha || 

<6.28>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasyāṃ devasabhāyāṃ ca saṃsthitā ye dvijottamāḥ ||
prabhāsādīni tīrthāni mūrtāni sakalāni ca || 1 ||
tāni śrutvā vacastasya devācāryasya tādṛśam ||
bhayaṃ kṛtvā mahaccitte procuśca tridiveśvaram || 2 ||
yadyevaṃ devadeveśa bhaviṣya tyaśubhaṃ yugam ||
vayaṃ nāśaṃ sameṣyāmo na sthāsyāmo jagattraye || 3 ||
puraṃdarādya cāsmākaṃ sthānaṃ kiṃcitpradarśaya ||
tasmātkīrtaya naḥ sthānaṃ kiṃcitkvāpi puraṃdara || 4 ||
yadāśritya nayiṣyāmo raudraṃ kaliyugaṃ vibho ||
aspṛṣṭāni narairmlecchaiḥ prabhāvasahitāni ca ||
pātāle svargaloke vā martye vā surasattama || 5 ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṛpāviṣṭaḥ śatakratuḥ ||
provāca brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ bhūya eva bṛhaspatim || 6 ||
aspṛṣṭaṃ kalinā sthānaṃ kiṃci dvada bṛhaspate ||
samāśrayāya tīrthānāṃ yadi vetsi jagattraye || 7 ||
śakrasya tadvacaḥ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā vṛhaspatiḥ ||
tatra provāca tīrthāni bhayā dbhītāni harṣayan|| 8 ||
hāṭakeśvaramityuktamasti kṣetramanuttamam ||
liṃgasya patanājjātaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ || 9 ||
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā ||
triśaṃkorbhūmipālasya kṛte tīrthe mahātmanā || 6.28.10 ||
yatra sthitvā sabhūpālastriśaṃkuḥ pāpavarjitaḥ ||
caṇḍālatvaṃ parityajya sadeha stridivaṃ gataḥ || 11 ||
yatra śakrasamādeśātpūritaṃ pāṃsubhiḥ purā ||
saṃvartakena raudreṇa vāyunā tīrthamuttamam || 12 ||
yatra rakṣatyadhastācca sa svayaṃ hāṭakeśvaraḥ ||
upariṣṭātpradeśaṃ ca kalau devo'caleśvaraḥ || 13 ||
hāṭakeśvaramāhātmyādaspṛṣṭaṃ kalinā hi tat ||
paṃcakrośapramāṇena acaleśvarajena ca || 14 ||
tasmāsvāṃśena gacchaṃtu tatra tīrthānyaśeṣataḥ ||
teṣāṃ kalibhayaṃ śakra naiva tatrāstyasaṃśayam || 15 ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya sarvatīrthāni tatkṣaṇāt ||
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tatkṣetraṃ jagmurdvijottamāḥ || 16 ||
yajñopavītamātrāṇi kṛtvā sthānāni cātmanaḥ ||
kṣetramāsādayāmāsustatsarvahi dvijottamāḥ || 17 ||
etasmātkāraṇājāta kṣetraṃ puṇyatamaṃ hi tat ||
hāṭakeśvaradevasya mahāpātakanāśanam || 18 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
atyāścaryamidaṃ sūta yattvayaitadudāhṛtam ||
saṃgamaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ kṣetre tatra prakīrtitam || 19 ||
tāvanmātraprabhāvāṇi tatsthāni prabhavaṃti kim ||
tāni tīrthāni no brūhi vistareṇa mahāmate || 6.28.20 ||
nāmataḥ sthānataścaiva tathā caiva prabhāvataḥ ||
sarvāṇyapimahābhāga paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || || 21 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca tīrthānāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ vyāpya sarvaṃ vyavasthitāḥ || || 22 ||
na teṣāṃ kīrtanaṃ śakyaṃ kartuṃ varṣaśatairapi ||
tathā svāyaṃbhuvasyādau kalpasya prathamasya ca || 23 ||
kṛtaḥ samāśrayastatra kṣetre tīrthaiḥ śubhāvahe ||
bahutvādatha kālasya bahūni dvijasattamāḥ || 24 ||
ucchedaṃ saṃprayātāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ||
yānyahaṃ veda kārtsnyena prabhāvasahitāni ca ||
tāni vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 25 ||
yeṣāṃ saṃśravaṇādeva naraḥ pāpātpramucyate
dhyānātsnānāttathā dānātsparśanādvijasattamāḥ || 26 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye hāṭakeśvarakṣetre sarvatīrthasamāśrayavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || || cha ||

<6.29>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sarveṣu tīrtheṣu saṃsthiteṣu dvijottamāḥ ||
tatkṣetraṃ khyātimāpannaṃ samaste dharaṇītale || 1 ||
samastebhyastato'dūrānmunayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ||
saṃśrayaṃti tato bhūpāstapo'rthaṃ jarayā'nvitāḥ || 2 ||
tathā te liṃgino dāntāḥ siddhikāmāḥ samaṃtataḥ ||
samāśrayaṃti tatkṣetraṃ savartīrthasamā śrayam || 3 ||
tatra siddheśvaraṃnāma liṃgamasti dvijottamāḥ ||
sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ svayaṃ siddhipradāyakam|| 4 ||
nirvidya bhūtale śarvaḥ sarvavyāpī sadā śivaḥ ||
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñe'sminkṣetre devaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ || 5 ||
liṃgarūpeṇa bhagavānprādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ||
smaraṇāddarśanāccaiva sarvasiddhipradaḥ sadā ||6||
siddhenārādhito yasmāttasmātsiddheśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||
tasyaiva varadānāddhi atraivāvasthito haraḥ || 7 ||
yastaṃ paśyati sadbhaktyā śuciḥ spṛśati vā naraḥ ||
vāṃchitaṃ labhate sadyo yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 8 ||
tatra siddhiṃ gatāḥ pūrvaṃ śataśaḥ puruṣā bhuvi ||
darśanātsparśanāccānye praṇāmādapare narāḥ || 9 ||
dakṣiṇāmūrtimāsādya mantraṃ tasya ṣaḍakṣaram ||
yo japecchraddhayopetastasyāyuḥ saṃpravardhate || 6.29.10 ||
yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ japenmatraṃ tāvatsaṃkhyānyahāni saḥ ||
āyuṣaḥ parato martyo jīvate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || atyāścaryamidaṃ sūta yattvayā parikīrtitam ||
āyuṣo'pyadhikaṃ martyo jīvate yadi mānavaḥ || 12 ||
|| sūta uvāca | ||
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi svayameva mayā śrutam ||
vadatastatsamuddiśya yadvatsasya mahātmanaḥ || 13 ||
purā me vasamānasya purato'tra piturgṛhe ||
āyātaḥ sa munistatra vatso nāma mahādyutiḥ || 14 ||
vahamāno yuvāvasthāṃ dvādaśārkasa madyutiḥ ||
aṃgaiḥ sarvaistu rūpāḍhyaḥ kāmadeva ivāparaḥ || 15 ||
matpitrā sa tadā dṛṣṭastato bhaktyā'bhivāditaḥ ||
arghyaṃ dattvā tataḥ prokto viśrāṃto vinayena ca || 16 ||
svāgataṃ tava vipreṃdra kutastvamiha cāgataḥ ||
ādeśo dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ kiṃ karomi yathocitam || 17 ||
|| vatsa uvāca || ||
tavāśramapade sūta cāturmāsyasamudbhavam ||
kartumicchāmyanuṣṭhānaṃ śuśrūṣāṃ cetkaroṣi me || 18 ||
|| lomaharṣaṇa uvāca || ||
evaṃ vipra kariṣyāmi tavādeśamasaṃśayam ||
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yastvaṃ me gṛhamāgataḥ || 19 ||
evamuktātha māmāha sa pitā dvijasattamāḥ ||
tvayā vatsasya kartavyā śuśrūṣā nityameva hi || 6.29.20 ||
tato'haṃ vinayopetastasya kṛtyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
karomi sa ca me rātrau citrāḥ kīrtayate kathāḥ || 21 ||
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ devadānavarakṣasām ||
dvīpānāṃ parvatānāṃ ca svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasraśaḥ || 22 ||
ekadā tu mayā pṛṣṭaḥ kathāṃte prāpya kautukam ||
vismayāviṣṭacittena sa dvijo dvijasattamāḥ || 23 ||
bhagavansukumāraṃ te śarīraṃ prathamaṃ vayaḥ ||
dvīpānāṃ ca karoṣi tvaṃ kathā ścitrāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 24 ||
kathaṃ sarvaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ sasamudraṃ nirīkṣitam ||
svalpena vayasā tāta (?) vistarato vada || 25 ||
tvayā ye kīrtitā dvīpāḥ samudrāḥ parvatāstathā ||
manasāpi na śakyāste gantuṃ martyaiḥ kathaṃcana || 26 ||
atra kautūhalaṃ jātamaśraddheyaṃ vacastathā ||
śrutvā śraddheyavākyasya tasmātsatyaṃ prakīrtaya || 27 ||
tapasaḥ kiṃ prabhāvo'yaṃ kiṃ vā maṃtraparākramaḥ ||
yena pṛthvītalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ munīśvara || 28 ||
kiṃ vā devaprasādastu tavauṣadhikṛto'thavā ||
tacca puṇyatamaṃ tāta tvaṃ me brūhi savistaram || 29 ||
atha māṃ sa muniḥ prāha vihasya munisattamāḥ ||
satyametattvayā jñātaṃ mama maṃtraparākramam || 6.29.30 ||
sadāhamaṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ sahasraṃ śivasannidhau ||
japāmi śivamaṃtrasya ṣaḍakṣaramitasya ca || 31 ||
trikālaṃ tena me jātaṃ susthiraṃ yauvanaṃ mune ||
atītānāgataṃ jñānaṃ jīvitaṃ ca sukhodayam || 32 ||
mama varṣasahasrāṇi bahūni prayutāni ca ||
saṃjātāni mahābhāga dṛśyate prathamaṃ vayaḥ || 33 ||
atra te kīrtayiṣyāmi vistareṇa mahāmate ||
yathā siddhirmayā prāptā prasādācchaṃkarasya ca || 34 ||
ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇo nāmnā vatsaḥ khyāto mahītale ||
nānāśāstrakṛtābhyāsaḥ purā''saṃ vedapāragaḥ || 35 ||
etasminneva kāle tu menakā ca varāpsarāḥ ||
vasaṃtasamaye prāptā martyaloke yadṛcchayā || 36 ||
sā gatā bhramamāṇātha kāmyakaṃnāma tadvanam ||
mattakokilanādāḍhyaṃ manojñadrumasaṃ kulam || 37 ||
yatrāste muniśārdūlo devarāta iti smṛtaḥ ||
vratasvādhyāyasaṃpannastapasā dhvastakilviṣaḥ || 38 ||
upaviṣṭo nadītīre devatārccāparā yaṇaḥ ||
śraddhayā parayā yukta ekākī nirjane vane || 39 ||
atha sā paśyatastasya vivastrā prāviśajjalam ||
divyarūpasamopetā gharmārtā varavarṇinī || || 6.29.40 ||
atha tasya munīṃdrasya retaścaskanda tatkṣaṇāt ||
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ cārusarvāṃgīṃ jalamadhyaṃ samāśritām || 41 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptā sāraṃgī supipā sitā ||
jalamiśraṃ tayā retaḥ pītaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ || 42 ||
atha sā'pi dadhe garbhaṃ mānuṣaṃ vai prabhāvataḥ ||
amogharetaso māse suṣuve daśame tataḥ||43||
janayāmāsa dīptāṃgī kanyāṃ padmadalekṣaṇām ||
tasminneva jale puṇye devarātāśramaṃ prati || 44 ||
atha tāṃ sa munirjñātvā svajñānena svavīryajām ||
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo jagrāha ca pupoṣa ca || 45 ||
snehena mahatā yuktaḥ kṛtakautukamaṃgalaḥ ||
rakṣamāṇo vane caināṃ śvāpadebhyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 46 ||
ājahāra sumṛṣṭāni tatkṛte suphalāni saḥ ||
svayaṃ gatvā sudūraṃ ca kānane śvāpadākule || 47 ||
tatrasthā vavṛdhe sā ca nāmnā khyātā mṛgāvatī ||
śuklapakṣe yathā vyomni kaleva śaśalakṣmaṇaḥ || 48 ||
atha sā bhramamāṇena mayā dṛṣṭā mṛgekṣaṇā ||
tato'haṃ kāmabāṇena tatkṣaṇāttāḍito hṛdi || || 49 ||
vijñāya ca kumārīṃ tāṃ savarṇāṃ cāruhāsinīm ||
ādareṇa gṛhaṃ gatvā sa muniryācitastataḥ || 6.29.50 ||
prayacchaināṃ mama brahmanpatnyarthaṃ nija kanyakām ||
yathātmā poṣayiṣyāmi bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ || 51 ||
tatastena pradattā me tatkṣaṇādeva sundarī ||
vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena nakṣatre bhaga daivate || 52 ||
tataḥ katipayāhasya mayoḍhā sā suvismitā ||
sakhījanasamāyuktā phalārthaṃ nirgatā vane || 53 ||
atha vīrudhasaṃchanne vane tasmi nsusaṃsthite ||
tayā nyastaṃ padaṃ mūrdhni tṛṇācchannasya bhoginaḥ || 54 ||
sā daṣṭā sahasā tena patitā vasudhātale ||
viṣārditā gataprāṇā tatkṣaṇādeva bhāminī || 55 ||
atha sakhyaḥ samāgatya tasyā duḥkhena duḥkhitāḥ ||
śaśaṃsustā yathāvṛttaṃ rudantyo mama sūtaja || 56 ||
tato'haṃ satvaraṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ patitāṃ bhuvi ||
vilāpānkṛtavāndīno ruditaṃ karuṇasvaram || 57 ||
iyaṃ me suviśālākṣī manaḥprāṇasamā priyā ||
mṛtā bhūmau yayā hīno nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe || 58 ||
so'hamadya gamiṣyāmi paralokaṃ sahānayā ||
priyārahitaharmyasya jīvitasya ca kiṃ phalam || 59 ||
putrapautravadhūbhiśca bhṛtyavargayutasya ca ||
patnīhīnāni no rejurgṛhāṇi gṛhamedhinām || 6.29.60 ||
yadīyaṃ karṇanetrāṃtā tanvaṃgī madhurasvarā||
na jīvati pṛthuśroṇī mariṣye' hamasaṃśayam || 61 ||
evaṃ vilapamānasya mama sūta kulodvaha ||
āgatāḥ suhṛdaḥ sarve ruruduste'pi duḥkhitāḥ || 62 ||
ruditvā suciraṃ tatra taiḥ samaṃ mahatīṃ citām ||
kṛtvā tāṃ saṃnidhāyātha pradatto havyavāhanaḥ || 63 ||
tata ādāya māṃ kṛcchrānninyuśca svagṛhaṃ prati ||
rudantaṃ praskhalantaṃ ca muhyamānaṃ padepade || 64 ||
tato niśāvaśeṣe'hamutthāya tvarayā'nvitaḥ ||
kāṃtāduḥkhaparītātmā gato'raṇyaṃ tadeva hi || 65 ||
kāmenonmattatāṃ prāpto bhramamāṇa itastataḥ ||
vilapanneva duḥkhārto vane janavivarjite || 66 ||
kva gatāsi viśālākṣi vijane'sminvihāya mām ||
nāhaṃ gṛhaṃ gamiṣyāmi mama duḥkhāya nirdayaḥ || 67 ||
eṣo'ruṇakarasparśātsvābhāṃ tyajati caṃdramāḥ ||
niśākṣaye nirutsāho yathāhaṃ vidhinā kṛtaḥ || 68 ||
ayaṃ tanuḥ samāyāti savitā raktamaṃḍalaḥ||
nigadiṣyati me vārtāṃ nūnaṃ kaccittvadudbhavām || 69 ||
gaganaṃ vyāpayansūryaḥ saṃtāpayati māṃ bhṛśam ||
bāhye cābhyaṃtare kāmaḥ kathaṃ vakṣyāmi jīvitam || 6.29.70 ||
karīṃdaḥ svayamabhyeti tatkucābhau samudvahan ||
kumbhau gatvā tu pṛcchāmi yadi śaṃsati tāṃ priyām || 71 ||
evaṃ pralapamānasya mama moho mahānabhūt ||
bhāskarāṃśuprataptasya madanākulitasya ca || 72 ||
yaṃyaṃ paśyāmi tatrāhaṃ bhramamāṇo mahāvane ||
vṛkṣaṃ vā prāṇino vāpi taṃtaṃ pṛcchāmi mohataḥ || 73 ||
tvaddaṃtamusalaprakhyaṃ yasyā ūruyugaṃ gaja ||
tāṃ bālāṃ vada ceddṛṣṭā dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari || 74
tvayā jaṃbūka ceddṛṣṭā biṃbāphalanibhādharā ||
dayitā mama tadbrūhi śreyaste bhavitā mahat || 75 ||
athavā bilva śaṃsa tvaṃ yadi bilvopamastanī ||
bhramamāṇā vane dṛṣṭā mama prāṇasamā priyā ||76||
tvatpuṣpasadṛśāṃgī sā mama bhāryā manasvinī ||
sa tvaṃ caṃpaka jānīṣe yadi tvaṃ śaṃsa me drutam ||77||
madhūka tava puṣpeṇa dayitāyāḥ samau śubhau ||
kapolau pāṃḍuracchāyau dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ smṛtimāgatau ||78||
kadalīstaṃbha suvyaktaṃ priyāyāśca sukomalau ||
ūrū tvatto'pi tanvaṃgyāḥ satyenātmānamālabhe ||79||
bhobho mṛga na me bhāryā tvayā dṛṣṭā'tra kānane ||
tvatsame locane spaṣṭe kajjalena samāvṛte || 6.29.80 ||
tṛṇādo'pi suvṛddho'pi vane vṛddho'pi yaḥ paśuḥ ||
so'pi kāṃtāparityakto na mṛgo ramate kṣaṇam||81||
kāṃtāyāḥ purato nityaṃ vidhatteṃ'gaṃ kalāpakṛt ||
vihaṃgayoni jāto'pi vṛddhyarthaṃ puṣpadhanvanaḥ||82||
yo'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate haṃso haṃsīmanusmaratyasau ||
gatistādṛṅna cāpyasya matpriyāyāśca yādṛśī ||83||
eka eva sudhanyo'yaṃ cakravāko vihaṃgamaḥ ||
muhūrtamapi yo'bhīṣṭāṃ na tyajeccakravākikām || 84 ||
ya eṣa śrūyate rāvo vibhramaṃ janayanmama ||
kiṃvā pikasamuttho 'yaṃ kiṃ vā me dayitodbhavaḥ|| 85 ||
māṃ dṛṣṭvā'yaṃ mṛgo yāti taṃ mṛgī yāti pṛṣṭhataḥ ||
dhāvamānā mamāpyevamanuyāti purā priyā ||86||
vāraṇo'yaṃ priyāṃ kāṃtāmanurāgānuyāyinīm ||
sparśayatyagrahastena mama saṃsmārayanpriyāma || 87 ||
hā priye mṛgaśāvākṣi taptakāṃcanasaṃnibhe ||
kathaṃ māṃ na vijānāsi bhramaṃtamiha kānane || 88 ||
kva sā bhaktiḥ kva sā prītiḥ kva sā tuṣṭiḥ kva sā dayā ||
nigadantaṃ sudīnaṃ māṃ saṃbhāṣayasi no yataḥ || 89 ||
evaṃ pralapamānasya mama prāptāḥ suhṛjjanāḥ ||
anveṣaṃtaḥ padaṃ tatra vaneṣu viṣameṣu ca || 6.29.90 ||
tatastaiḥ koparaktākṣaiḥ prokto'haṃ sūtanaṃdana ||
bhartsadbhiḥ paruṣairvākyairdhiktvāṃ kāmamayādhunā || 91 ||

nāyamatyaṃtasaṃvāsaḥ kasyacitkenacitsaha ||
api svena śarīreṇa kimutānyairvṛthā janaiḥ || 95 ||
mṛtaṃ vā yadi vā naṣṭaṃ yotītamanuśocati ||

adyaprabhṛti cennāhaṃ sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam ||

yacca nikṣepahartṝṇāṃ yacca viśvāsaghātinām ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 101 ||
yatpāpaṃ sādhuniṃdāyāṃ mātāpitṛvadhe ca yat ||

tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 103 ||

tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 104 ||

tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 105 ||

vratabhaṃgena yatpāpaṃ vratināṃ niṃdayāpi yat ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 107 ||
yatpāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ mṛṣṭamāṃsāśināṃ ca yat ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 108 ||
vṛkṣaccheda prasaktānāṃ yatpāpaṃ śalyakāriṇām ||

pākhaṃḍināṃ ca yatpāpaṃ nāstikānāṃ ca yadbhavet ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 6.29.110 ||
māṃsamadyaprasaktānāṃ yatpāpaṃ viṭabhojinām ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 111 ||
mṛṣāvādaprasaktānāṃ pararaṃdhrāvalokinām ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 112 ||
yatpāpaṃ sākṣyakartṛṇāṃ dhānyasaṃgrahakāriṇām ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 113 ||

tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 114 ||
nityaṃ preṣaṇakartṝṇāṃ yatpāpaṃ madhujīvinām ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || || 115 ||
adṛṣṭadevavaktrāṇāṃ yatpāpaṃ matsyajīvinām ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 116 ||

bhayādvā yadi vā lobhāddveṣādvā kāmato'pi vā || 117 ||

tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 118 ||

tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 119 ||
vidyāvikrayakartṝṇāṃ yatpāpaṃ samudāhṛtam ||
tanme syādyadi no hanmi sarpaṃ dṛṣṭivaśaṃ gatam || 6.29.120 ||
evaṃ mayā pratijñāya kopāviṣṭena sūtaja ||
gṛhīto laguḍaḥ sthūlo vadhārthaṃ pavanāśinām || 121 ||
tataḥprabhṛtyahaṃ bhūmau bhramāmi laguḍāyudhaḥ ||

adya tvāmapi neṣyāmi vaivasvatagṛhaṃ prati ||
hatvā daṃḍaprahāreṇa tasmādiṣṭatamaṃ smara ||128||
tataḥ sa māṃ punaḥ prāha bhayena mahatāvṛtaḥ||
śṛṇu tāvadvaco'smākaṃ tataḥ kuru yathocitam ||129||
anye te pannagā vipra ye daśaṃtīha mānavān ||
vayaṃ salilasaṃbhūtā nirviṣāḥ sarparūpiṇaḥ || 6.29.130 ||
evaṃ prajalpamāno'pi sa daṃḍena mayā hataḥ ||
sūta tatsūdanārthāya nirvikalpena cetasā || 131 ||
athāsau laguḍasparśāttatkṣaṇādeva pannagaḥ||

uktavāṃstaṃ praṇamyoccaiḥ kṣamyatāmiti sādaram || 133 ||
ko bhavānkimidaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtaṃ sarpamayaṃ vibho ||

ahamāsaṃ purā vipra camatkārapurottame ||
yuvā paramatejasvī dhanavānsusamṛddhibhāk || 136 ||

ekāhārā nirāhārā vāyubhakṣāstathāpare ||

upāviṣṭāḥ purastasya kathāścakruḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ || 142 ||
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ devendrāṇāṃ ca harṣitāḥ ||
dayādharmasamopetāstathānye'pi ca bhūriśaḥ || 143 ||
kecittatra pranṛtyaṃti gāyaṃti ca tathā'pare ||
sādhavo bhaktisaṃyuktā vādyaṃ cakruśca bhūriśaḥ ||194||

āgato bahubhiḥ sārdhamahaṃ yauvanagarvitaḥ || 146 ||
śivadarśanavidveṣī tamasā saṃvṛtāśayaḥ ||
yātrotsava vināśāya prerito'nyaiḥ sudurjanaiḥ || 147 ||
jalasarpaṃ samādāya sudīrghaṃ bhīṣaṇākṛtim ||
