tatrāsīttāpaso nāmnā suprabhaḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ ||
samādhisthaḥ suśiṣyāḍhyastapasā dagdhakilbiṣaḥ || 6.29.150 ||
niṣkaṃpāṃ sudṛḍhāmṛjvīṃ nātistabdhāṃ na kuṃcitām ||
grīvāṃ dadhatsthirāṃ yatnādgātrayaṣṭiṃ ca sarvataḥ || 151 ||
saṃpaśyannāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan ||
tālumadhyagatenaiva jihvāgreṇācalena ca || 152 ||
āvartapaṃkajāṃtaḥsthamaṣṭapatra madhomukham||
tanmadhyakarṇikāsaṃsthaṃ saṃpaśyanravimaṃḍalam ||153||
tasyāpi madhyataścānyaṃ naramaṃguṣṭhamātrakam ||
dvādaśārkapratīkāśamapratarkyatamākṛtim||154||
paśyanpadmāsanasthaṃ ca vaidanāthaṃ maheśvaram||
yamakṣaraṃ vadaṃtyeva sarvagaṃ sarvavedinam || 155 ||
aniṃdyaṃ cāpyabhedyaṃ ca jarāmaraṇavarjitam ||
pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgo yoganidrāvaśaṃgataḥ || 156 ||
ānaṃdāśrupariklinnaḥ saṃniruddheṃdriyākṛtiḥ ||
kuṃbhayitvodarāṃtaḥsthaṃ svabhyāsādvāyupañcakam ||157||
aṃguṣṭhatarjanīyogaṃ kṛtvā hṛdayasaṃgatam ||
evaṃ tatropaviṣṭasya sa sarpastasya vigraham || 158 ||
veṣṭayāmāsa bhogena niścalasya mahātmanaḥ ||
etasminnaṃtare śiṣyastasyāsītsutapo'nvitaḥ || 159 ||
śrīvardhanaitikhyāto nānāśāstrakṛtaśramaḥ ||
sa dṛṣṭvā sarpabhogena samaṃtādveṣṭitaṃ gurum || 6.29.160 ||
nātidūrasthitaṃ māṃ ca jñātvā tatkarmakāriṇam||
uvāca paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ || 161 ||
sphuratādharayugmena bāṣpagadgadayā girā ||
mayā cetsutapastaptaṃ guruśuśrūṣayā sadā || 162 ||
nirvikalpena cittena yadi dhyāto maheśvaraḥ ||
tena satyena duṣṭo'yaṃ pāpātmā brāhmaṇādhamaḥ ||
īdṛkkāyo bhavatvāśu gururme yena dharṣitaḥ || 163 ||
athāhaṃ sarpatāṃ prāptastatkṣaṇādeva dāruṇām ||
paśyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ vadatāṃ sādhusādhviti || 164 ||
atha gatvā samādheḥ sa paryaṃtaṃ saṃyato muniḥ ||
dadarśa nija gātrasthaṃ dvijihvaṃ dāruṇākṛtim || 165 ||
atha sarpākṛtiṃ māṃ ca duḥkhena mahatānvitam ||
taṭasthaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tathā sarvajanaṃ tadā ||166 ||
tato vijñāya tatsarvaṃ sa munirjñānacakṣuṣā ||
abravītkṛpāyāviṣṭaḥ śiṣyaṃ śrīvardhanaṃ ruṣā ||167 ||
na me priyaṃ kṛtaṃ śiṣya tvayaitatkarma kurvatā||
śapatā brāhmaṇaṃ dīnaṃnaiṣa dharmastapasvinām||168||
samo māne'pamāne ca samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanaḥ||
tapasvī siddhimāyāti suhṛcchatrusamākṛtiḥ||169||
tasmādajānatā vatsa śapto'yaṃ brāhmaṇastvayā||
bālyabhāvātprasādo'sya bhūyoyukto mamājñayā|| 6.29.170 ||
atha śrīvardhanaḥ prāha praṇipatya nijaṃ gurum ||
amarṣavaśamāpannaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ || 171 ||
ajñānādyadivā jñānānmayā yadvyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ ||
tattathaiva na saṃdehastasmānmaunaṃ guro kuru || 172 ||
na mṛṣā vacanaṃ proktaṃ svaireṇāpi guro mayā ||
kiṃ punaryattavārthāya tasmānmaunaṃ samācara || 173 ||
paścādudayate sūryaḥ śoṣaṃ yāti mahārṇavaḥ ||
api meruśca śīryeta na me syādanyathā vacaḥ || 174 ||
tamuvāca guruḥ śiṣyaṃ sa punaḥ ślakṣṇayā girā ||
jānāmyahaṃ na te vāṇī kathaṃcijjāyate'nyathā || 175 ||
sadā śiṣyo vayaḥsthopi śāsanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||
kiṃ punarbāla eva tvaṃ tena tvāṃ vacmi bhūriśaḥ || 176 ||
dharmaṃ na vyayate ko'pi munīnāṃ pūrvasaṃcitam ||
tapodharmavihīnānāṃ gatisteṣāṃ na vidyate || 177 ||
kṣamaikā siddhidā proktā yatīnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
tasmātkṣamāṃ puraskṛtya vartitavyaṃ tapasvibhiḥ || 178 ||
na pāpaṃ prati pāpaḥ syādbuddhireṣā sanātanī||
ātmanaiva hataḥ pāpo yaḥ pāpaṃ tu samācaret||179||
dagdhaḥ sa dahate bhūyo hatamevanihaṃti ca||
samyagjñānaparityakto yaḥ pāpe pāpamācaret||6.29.180||
upakāriṣu yaḥ sādhuḥ sādhutve tasya ko guṇaḥ||
apakāriṣu yaḥ sādhuḥ kīrtyate janaiḥ|| 181||
evamuktvā sa taṃ śiṣyaṃ tato māmidamabravīt ||
dayayā parayā yuktaḥ suvrataḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ || 182 ||
nānyathā vacanaṃ bhāvi mama śiṣyasya pannaga ||
kañcitkālaṃ pratīkṣasva tasmātsarpavapuḥsthitaḥ || 183 ||
|| sarpa uvāca || ||
kasminkāle muniśreṣṭha śāpo me'stamupaiṣyati ||
prasādaṃ kuru dīnasya śāpasyājñāninastathā || 184 ||
|| suvrata uvāca || ||
muhūrtamapi gītādi yaḥ karoti śivālaye ||
na tasya śakyate kartuṃ saṃkhyā dharmasya bhadraka || 185 ||
muhūrtamapi yo vighnaṃ karoti ca mahotsave ||
tasya pāpasya no saṃkhyā kartuṃ śakyā hi kenacit || 186 ||
tasmāttvaṃ pāpako vipro naiva muktimavāpsyasi ||
vārtāsaṃgena durbuddhe tasmācchṛṇu vaco mama ||187||
śaivaṃ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ yojapecchraddhayānvitaḥ ||
api brahmavadhā tpāpaṃ jātaṃ tasya praṇaśyati || 188 ||
daśabhirdinajaṃ pāpaṃ viṃśatyā vatsarodbhavam ||
ṣaḍakṣarasya jāpyena pāpaṃ kṣālayate naraḥ || 189 ||
tasmāttvaṃ jalamadhyasthastaṃ maṃtraṃ japa sādaram ||
yena pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti kṛtamapyanyajanmani || 6.29.190 ||
yadā tvāṃ jalamadhyasthaṃ vatsonāma dvijo ruṣā ||
tāḍayiṣyati daṇḍena tadā mokṣamavāpsyasi || 191 ||
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ sarpa sthānādasmājjalāśaye ||
kiñcidiṣṭaṃ mayā prokto virarāma sa sanmuniḥ || 192 ||
tato'haṃ duḥkhasaṃyuktaḥ saṃprāpto'tra jalāśaye ||
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ japanmantraṃ nityameva vyavasthitaḥ || 193 ||
tvatprasādādahaṃ muktaḥ sarpatvādbrāhmaṇottama ||
kiṃ karomi priyaṃ te'dya tasmācchīghrataraṃ vada || 194 ||
vatsonāma na sandehaḥ sa tvaṃ yaḥ kīrtito mama ||
suvratena vimānaṃ me paśyaitadupasarpati || 195 ||
tataḥ prokto mayā samyaksa sarpo divyarūpadhṛk ||
bhagavannupadeśaṃ me kiñciddehi śubhāva ham || 196 ||
yena no jāyate duḥkhaṃ priyalopasamudbhavam ||
na dāridyaṃ na ca vyādhirna ca śatruparābhavaḥ || 197 ||
athovāca sa māṃ bhūyaḥ sotsukaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||
praśnabhāraḥ samākhyātastvayā mama dvijottama || 198 ||
na caitacchakyate vaktuṃ vimāne samupasthite ||
vistarāttu tato vacmi saṃkṣepeṇa tava dvija || 199 ||
śaivaḥ ṣaḍakṣaro mantro nṛṇāmaśubhahārakaḥ ||
sa tvayā śaktito vipra japanīyo divāniśam || || 6.29.200 ||
tataḥ prāpsyatyasaṃdigdhaṃ yadyadvāṃchasi cetasā ||
svargaṃ vā yadi vā mokṣaṃ vimuktaḥ sarvapātakaiḥ || 201 ||
mayā hi sumahatpāpaṃ sarvadā samanuṣṭhitam ||
tatrāpi maṃtramāhātmyātprāptā lokā mahodayāḥ || 202 ||
eko dānāni sarvāṇi yacchati śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ japenmaṃtramanyastābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 203 ||
sarvatīrthābhiṣekaṃ ca kurute'nyo naro dvija ||
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ japenmaṃtramanyastābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 204 ||
cāṃdrāyaṇasahasraṃ tu kurute'nyo yathocitam ||
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ japedanyo maṃtraṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 205 ||
varṣāsvākāśaśāyī ca hemaṃte salilāśayaḥ ||
pañcāgnisādhako grīṣme yāvadvarṣaśataṃ naraḥ || 206 ||
anyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ śuciḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
japedaharniśaṃ martyaḥ phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam || || 207 ||
pitṛpakṣe sadā caiko gayāyāṃ śrāddhamācaret ||
anyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japettābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 208 ||
gosahasraṃ dadātyekaḥ kārtikyāṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare ||
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ japenmaṃtramanyastābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 209 ||
saṃnihityāṃ naraḥ snāti rāhugraste divākare ||
eko anyastu japenmantraṃ ṣaḍarṇaṃ tulyameva tat || 6.29.210 ||
some somagrahe'nyastu somanāthaṃ prapaśyati ||
anyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japettābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 211 ||
ekaścaṇḍīśvaraṃ paśyedayane cottare naraḥ ||
anyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japettābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 212 ||
bhṛgupātaṃ patedekaḥ kedāraṃ vīkṣya bhaktitaḥ ||
anyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ japettābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 213 ||
karīṣaṃ sādhayedanyo dattvā sarvasvamāditaḥ ||
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ japenmaṃtramanyastābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 214 ||
sarva saṃgaparityāgaṃ kṛtvaiko jñānamāpnuyāt ||
anyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mantraṃ japettābhyāṃ samaṃ phalam || 215 ||
etatte paramaṃ guhyaṃ mayā vipra prakīrtitam ||
nāstikāya na dātavyaṃ bhaktihīnāya naiva ca || 216 ||
tathānyadapi vakṣyāmi hitabuddhyā dvijottama ||
mama vākyaṃ kuruṣvādya yadīcchasi parāṃ gatim|| 217 ||
ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ sarvavede prakīrtitaḥ ||
brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa tasmātsarpavadhaṃ tyaja || 218||
ahiṃsakāni bhūtāni yo hinasti sunirdayaḥ ||
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 219 ||
carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāmabhayaṃ yaḥ prayacchati ||
sarvadā sarvasaukhyāḍhyo jāyate divi ceha ca || 6.29.220 ||
nāsti bhargasamo devo nāsti gaṃgāsamā nadī ||
nāsti hiṃsāsamaṃ pāpaṃ nāsti dharmo dayāparaḥ || 221 ||
athāhamabruvaṃ taṃ ca tacchrutvā tasya jalpitam ||
ahiṃsālakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ paralokabhayāturaḥ || 222 ||
manyate vṛddhalokānāmetadvākyaṃ śrutaṃ mayā ||
bhūpaterneva doṣaḥ syādvane vyāpāditairmṛgaiḥ || 223 |
pravadaṃti tathā vaidyā vaidyaśāstravicakṣaṇāḥ ||
bhavaṃti puṣṭisaṃyukā māṃsādāścirajīvinaḥ || 224 ||
tadatra viṣaye brūhi paraṃ niḥśreyasaṃ vacaḥ ||
sarvaṃ kartāsmyasaṃdigdhaṃ tava vaktrādvinirgatam || 225 ||
atha māṃ sa punaḥ prāha vada maivaṃ dvijottama ||
matametada sādhūnāṃ pāpānāṃ māṃsagṛddhinām || 226 ||
aho śocyatamā loke pāpātmānaḥ sunirdayāḥ ||
sarvadoṣākaraṃ māṃsaṃ mūḍhāḥ svādaṃti ye narāḥ || 227 ||
na māṃsamāyuṣo heturārogyasya balasya vā ||
sarvametadasatyaṃ syācchraṇuṣvādya nidarśanam || 228 ||
māṃsāśino'pi dṛśyaṃte rogārtā durbalāstathā ||
svalpāyuṣaśca matvaivaṃ māṃsaṃ varjaya dūrataḥ || 229 ||
amāṃsādā api kṣmāyāṃ dṛśyaṃte rogavarjitāḥ ||
cirāyuṣaśca pīnāṃgāsta smānmāṃsaṃ vivarjayet || 6.29.230 ||
yo bhakṣayati māṃsāni sattvānāṃ jīvitaiṣiṇām ||
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tatrastho bhakṣyate ca taiḥ || 231 ||
na hi māṃsaṃ tṛṇātkāṣṭhādupalādapi jāyate ||
hate jaṃtau bhavenmāṃsaṃ tasmāttatparivarjayet || 232 ||
etadeva hi dṛṣṭāṃtaṃ māṃsasya parivarjane ||
yadaṃgaṃ hriyate svaṃ ca kaṃṭakenāpi vikṣatam ||233||
ātmaupamyena bhūtāni tasmātsarvāṇi paṃḍitaiḥ ||
draṣṭavyāni na hiṃsyāni rakṣaṇīyāni śaktitaḥ || 234 ||
haṃtā caivānumaṃtā ca viśastā krayavikrayī ||
saṃskartā copahartā ca khādakaścāṣṭa ghātakāḥ || 235 ||
dhanena krayakṛddhaṃti bhakṣaṇena ca khādakaḥ ||
ghātako vadhabaṃdhābhyāmityanyastrividho vadhaḥ || 236 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā yo hinasti na kiṃcana ||
sa prāpnoti paraṃ sthānaṃ jarā maraṇavarjitam || 237 ||
śākamūlaphalāhāro brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ||
na tasya phalamāpnoti yadi hiṃsāparo naraḥ || 238 ||
eko varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tapastapati dustaram ||
ahiṃsānirato yastu tayoḥ śreṣṭho dayānvitaḥ || 239 ||
yaṃyaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ duṣprāpamapi mānavaḥ ||
taṃ tamāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ yadi syātsudayānvitaḥ || 6.29.240 ||
kāmagena vimānena divyastrīśatasevitaḥ ||
devavanmodate svarge savabhūtābhayapradaḥ || 241 ||
evamuktvā mahātmā sa paśyato mama sūtaja ||
vimānavaramāruhya gataśca tridivālayam || 242 ||
gandharvairgīyamānastu stūyamānaśca kinnaraiḥ ||
ṣaḍakṣarasya maṃtrasya māhātmye na mahāmate || 243 ||
tasmingate tadā svargaṃ duḥkhaṃ me samupasthitam ||
smṛtvā pūrvaṃ hatānsarpānbhagnagātro'bhavaṃ tadā || 244 ||
tato'haṃ kṛtavāṃstatra vipralāpānanekaśaḥ ||
svakarmabhayasaṃtrastastasminneva mahāvane || 245 ||
aho mayā nṛśaṃsena bahavaḥ prāṇino hatāḥ ||
ninditaśca mahādevo nara kārtirbhaviṣyati || 246 ||
so'haṃ hiṃsāṃ parityajya cariṣyāmi mahattapaḥ ||
śivadīkṣāṃ samāsādya pūjayiṣye maheśvaram || 247 ||
yatkiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu prārthayaṃti narāḥ sukham ||
tatsarvaṃ tapasā sādhyaṃ tasmātkāryaṃ mayā tapaḥ || 248 ||
adhunaiko'hamekāhamekaikasminvanaspatau ||
caranbhaikṣaṃ munirmaunī cariṣyāmyāśramānimān || 249 ||
pāṃsunā samavacchannaḥ śūnyāgārapratiśrayaḥ ||
vṛkṣamūlaniketo vā tyaktasarvapriyāpriyaḥ || 6.29.250 ||
evaṃ vilapya yatnena mayā sūtakulodvaha ||
gṛhītaṃ bhaktiyuktena śivadīkṣāvrataṃ tataḥ || 251 ||
ṣaḍakṣarasya maṃtrasya ayutaṃ prajapāmyaham ||
trisandhyaṃ śraddhayā yuktaḥ siddheśvarasamīpataḥ || 252 ||
tatprabhāvena me sthairyaṃ saṃjātaṃ yauvanodbhavam ||
tathā lokātaṃrajñānaṃ khecaratvaṃ ca sūtaja || 253 ||
siddheśvaraṃ prayāsyāmi dvāparāṃte hyavasthite ||
sadāśivaṃ prayāsyāmi satyametanmayoditam || 254 ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā sūtaja mokṣadam ||
ṣaḍakṣarasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 255 ||
yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
ājanmamaraṇātpāpātso'pi mucyeta mānavaḥ || 256 ||
tasmāttvaṃ hi mahābhāga mantramenaṃ sadā japa ||
saṃprāpsyasi parānkāmānmanasā vāṃchitānsadā || 257 ||
sūta uvāca || ||
etacchrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ sakāśāttasya sadguroḥ ||
ṣaḍakṣarasya māhātmyaṃ yadyuṣmākaṃ prakīrtitam || 258 ||
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ śatrupakṣakṣayāvaham ||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nityaṃ sarvakāmābhayapradam || 259 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye ṣaḍakṣaramantramāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || || dha ||

<6.30>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
toṣitaḥ kena siddhena tatra siddheśvaro vibhuḥ ||
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva vistarātsūtanandana || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
āsītsiddhādhiponāma purā haṃsa hati smṛtaḥ ||
anapatyatayā tasya kālaścakrāma bhūriśaḥ || 2 ||
tataścintā prapannaḥ sa gatvā devapurohitam ||
papracchāgirasaḥ putraṃ vipraśreṣṭhaṃ bṛhaspatim || 3 ||
bhagavaṃścānapatyasya vārddhakaṃ me samāgatam ||
tasmādapatyalābhāya mamopāyaṃ prakīrtaya || 4 ||
tīrthayātrāṃ vrataṃ vāpi śāṃtikaṃ vā dvijottama ||
yena syātsaṃtatiḥ śīghraṃ tvatprasādādbṛhaspate || 5 ||
bṛhaspatiściraṃ dhyātvā siddhaṃ prāha tataḥ param ||
camatkārapuraṃ kṣetraṃ gatvā tatra tapaḥ kuru || 6 ||
tataḥ prāpsyasi satputraṃ vaṃśoddhārakṣamaṃ śubham ||
nānyaṃ paśyāmi siddheśa sutopāyaṃ śubhāvaham || 7 ||
tatastatkṣetramāsādya sa siddhaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
liṃgaṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa yathoktavidhinā svayam || 8 ||
tataścārādhayāmāsa divānaktamataṃdritaḥ ||
bali pūjopahāreṇa gītavādyocchrayādibhiḥ || 9 ||
cāṃdrāyaṇaistathā kṛcchraiḥ pārākairdvijasattamāḥ ||
tathā māsopavāsaiśca toṣayāmāsa śaṃkaram || 6.30.10 ||
tato varṣasahasrābhyāṃ tasya tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ||
provāca darśanaṃ gatvā vṛṣārūḍhaḥ sahomayā || 11 ||
haṃsādya tava tuṣṭo'haṃ tasmātprārthaya vāṃchitam ||
ahaṃ te saṃpradāsyāmi duṣprāpyamapi niścitam || 12 ||
|| haṃsa uvāca || ||
apatyārthaṃ samāraṃbho mayā'dya vihitaḥ purā ||
tasmāttvaṃ dehi me putrānvaṃśoddhārakṣa mānvibho || 13 ||
tvayā caiva sadā liṃge stheyamatra surottama ||
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ sarvalokahitārthataḥ || 14 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca ||
adyaprabhṛti liṃgesminnāśrayo me bhaviṣyati ||
tava vākyena siddheśa satyametanmayoditam ||15||
yo māmatra sthitaṃ martyaḥ pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ ||
tasyāhaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi cittasthaṃ sakalaṃ phalam || 16 ||
yo me liṃgasya yāmyāśāṃ sthitvā maṃtraṃ japiṣyati ||
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ pradāsyāmi tasyāyuṣyaṃ sutānvitam || 17 ||
evamuktvā mahādevastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
haṃso'pi ca gṛhaṃ gatvā putrānāpa mahodayān|| 18 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena talliṃgaṃ yatnato dvijāḥ ||
sparśanīyaṃ ca pūjyaṃ ca namaskāryaṃ prayatnataḥ || 19 ||
ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa kīrtanīyaṃ ca śaktitaḥ ||
vāṃchadbhirvāṃchitānkāmāndurlabhāṃstridaśairapi ||6.30.20||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| pūjāmaṃtraḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
agastyasyāśramo'nyosti tathā tatra dvijottamāḥ ||
yatra tiṣṭhati viśvātmā svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ || 1 ||
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ caitramāse divākaraḥ ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

yasya sānuṣu muṃcaṃto bhāṃti puṣpāṇi pādapāḥ ||
vāyuvegavaśānnūnaṃ nīraugha nīradā iva || 9 ||
yasminnānāmṛgā bhāṃti dhāvamānā itastataḥ ||
kalatraputrapuṣṭyarthaṃ lobhārthaṃ mānavā iva || || 6.33.10 ||

|| bhāskara uvāca || ||
na vayaṃ śraddhayā tasya gireḥ kurmaḥ pradakṣiṇām ||
eṣa me vihitaḥ panthā yenedaṃ vihitaṃ jagat || 16 ||
tasya tuṃgāni śṛṃgāṇi vyāpya khaṃ saṃśritāni ca ||
tena saṃjāyate tasya balādeva prada kṣiṇā || 17 ||
etacchrutvā viśeṣeṇa saṃkruddho viṃdhyaparvataḥ ||
provāca paśya bhāno tvaṃ tarhi tuṃgatvamadya me ||
rurodhātha nabhomārgaṃ yena gacchati bhāskaraḥ || 18 ||
atha ruddhaṃ samālokya mārgaṃ vāsaranāyakaḥ ||
cintayāmāsa citte sve sāṃprataṃ kiṃ karomyaham || 19 ||

|| bhāskara uvāca || ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramā hātmye'gastyāśramamāhātmye'gastyakṛtasamudraprāśanavṛttānte devāsurasaṃgrāmavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || || cha ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| devā ūcuḥ || ||

yasmāccitrāṇi pīṭhāni tvayānītāni tatra hi ||
tasmāccitreśvaraṃ nāma pīṭhamekaṃ bhaviṣyati || 55 ||
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya tatra pūjāṃ kariṣyati ||
yoginīnāṃ ca vidyānāṃ mātṝṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 56 ||
taṃtaṃ kāmaṃ naraḥ śīghraṃ saṃprāpsyati mahāmune ||
asmākaṃ varadānena yadyapi syātsupāpakṛt|| 57 ||
evamuktvā surāḥ sarve tamāmantrya munīśvaram ||
gatāstriviṣṭapaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ so'pyagastyaḥ svamāśramam || 58 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yathā sa payasāṃnidhiḥ ||
agastyena purā pīto devakāryaprasiddhaye || 59 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'gastyakṛtasamudra prāśanavṛttāṃte'gastyāhūtapīṭhasamūhasya devaiścitreśvarapīṭhanāmapūrvakavarapradānavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 || 

<6.36>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
citreśvaramidaṃ pīṭhamagastyamuninirmitam ||
yatpramāṇaṃ yatprabhāvaṃ tadasmākaṃ prakīrtaya || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya pīṭhasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ no śakyate dvijāḥ ||
sahasreṇāpi varṣāṇāṃ mukhānāmayutairapi || 2 ||
tatra siddhimanuprāptāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||
anudhyānasamāyuktā yoginaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || 3 ||
anyapīṭheṣu yā siddhirvarṣānuṣṭhānato bhavet ||
dinenaikena tāṃ siddhiṃ labhaṃte yogino dhruvam || 4 ||
yastatrātha rvaṇānmaṃtrāñjapecchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
teṣāmarthodbhavaṃ kṛtsnaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti sa dhruvam || 5 ||
putrakāmo narastatra puṃliṃgānyo japennaraḥ ||
sa labhetepsitānputrānyadyapi syājjarānvitaḥ || 6 ||
garbhopaniṣadaṃ tatra putrakāmo japennaraḥ ||
api vandhyāprasaṃgena syātsa putrasamanvitaḥ || 7 ||
śatrulokavināśāya yo japecchatarudriyam ||
tasminpīṭhe'rayastasya sadyo gacchaṃti saṃkṣayam || 8 ||
bhūtapretapiśācādirakṣārthaṃ tatra mānavaḥ ||
yo japedvāmadevyaṃ ca sa syāddhi nirupadravaḥ || 9 ||
ko'dāditi narastatra kanyārthaṃ yo japedṛcam ||
yāṃ kanyāṃ dhyāyamānastu sa tāṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 6.36.10 ||
yo bhūpālaprasādārthamimaṃ devā niśaṃ japet ||
nirargalaḥ prasādaḥ syāttasya pārthivasaṃbhavaḥ || 11 ||
svastrīsnehakṛteyastu taṃ patnībhiriti dvijāḥ ||
japedbhāryā bhavetsādhvī tasya sā snehavatsalā || 12 ||
yo lokānugrahārthāya japedaditirityapi ||
tasya lokānurāgaḥ syātsalābhaśca viśeṣataḥ || || 13 ||
vittārthī yo japettatra śrīsūktaṃ manujo dvijāḥ ||
sarvatastasya vittāni samāgacchaṃtyanekaśaḥ || 14 |
bhūmīti yo japetsāma bhūmyarthaṃ tatra mānavaḥ ||
sa bhavedbhūpatirnūnaṃ nīcajātirapi dhruvam ||15||
japedrathaṃtaraṃ sāma yānārthaṃ tatra yo naraḥ ||
sa prāpnoti hi yānāni śīghragāni śubhāni ca || 16 ||
gajārthī yo japettatra gaṇānāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
sa prāpnoti gajānmartyo madaplāvitabhūtalān || 17 ||
na tadrakṣeti yo mantraṃ japedra kṣākṛte naraḥ ||
tasya syātsarvato rakṣā sameṣu viṣameṣu ca || 18 ||
saptarṣaya iti śreṣṭhāṃ yo japettu samāhitaḥ ||
ṛcaṃ rogavināśāya sa rogaiḥ pari mucyate || 19 ||
yadubhī yo japettatra grahapīḍārdito janaḥ ||
sānukūlā grahāstasya prabhavaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 6.36.20 ||
bhūtapīḍārdito yaśca bṛhatsāma japennaraḥ ||
pitṛvajjāyate tasya sa bhūto'pyaṃtako'pi cet || 21 ||
yātrāsiddhikṛte yaśca japetsūktaṃ ca śākunam ||
tasya saṃsidhyate yātrā yadyapi syādakiṃcanaḥ || 22 ||
sarpanāśāya yastatra sārpasūktaṃ japennaraḥ ||
na tasya maṃdire sarpāḥ praviśaṃti kathaṃcana || 23 ||
viṣanāśāya yastatra japecchra ddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
uttiṣṭheti viṣaṃ sadyastasya nāśaṃ prayāsyati || 24 ||
sthāvarajagamaṃ vāpi kṛtrimaṃ yadi vā viṣam ||
tasya nāmnā viniryāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 25 ||
vyāghrasāma japedyastu tatra śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
tasya vyāghrādayo vyālā jāyaṃte saumyacetasaḥ || 26 ||
kṛṣikarmaprasi ddhyarthaṃ yo japellāṃgalāni ca ||
vṛṣṭihīne'pi loke'sminkṛṣistasya prasidhyati || 27 ||
ītināśāya tatraiva japeddevavrataṃ naraḥ ||
tataḥ saṃkīrttanā deva ītayo yāṃti saṃkṣayam || 28 ||
anāvṛṣṭihate loke paṃceṃdraṃ tatra yo japet ||
tasya hastakṛte home tanmaṃtraiḥ syājjalāgamaḥ || 29 ||
daṃṣṭrābhyā miti yastatra naraścaurārditaḥ paṭhet ||
nopadravo bhavettasya kadāciccaurasaṃbhavaḥ || 6.36.30 ||
vivādārthaṃ japedyastu saṃsṛṣṭamiti tatra ca ||
vivāde vijaya stasya pāpasyāpi prajāyate || 31 ||
yo ripūccāṭanārthāya naro rudraśiro japet ||
tasya te ripavo yāṃti deśaṃ tyaktvā kubuddhitaḥ || 32 ||
mohanāya ripūṇāṃ ca yo japedviṣṇusaṃhitām ||
tasya mohābhibhūtāste jāyaṃte ripavo dhruvam || 33 ||
vaśīkaraṇahetoryaḥ kūṣmāṃḍīḥ prajapennaraḥ ||
śatravo'pi vaśe tasya kiṃ punaḥ pramadādayaḥ || 34 ||
yaḥ staṃbhāya ripūṇāṃ vai prājāpatyaṃ ca vāruṇam ||
maṃtraṃ japeddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ samyakchraddhāparāyaṇaḥ ||
maṃtrasaṃstaṃbhitāstasya jāyaṃte sarvaśatravaḥ || 35 ||
japetkālī karālīti yaḥ śoṣāya naro dvijāḥ ||
sa śoṣayati tatkṛtsnaṃ yaccitte dhārayennaraḥ || 36 ||
eṣa maṃtrastadā japto hyagastyena mahātmanā||
yatprabhāvānnadīnāthastena saṃśoṣito dhruvam || 37 ||
etatprabhāvaṃ yatpīṭhaṃ maṃtrāṇāṃ siddhikārakam||
aihikānāṃ phalānāṃ ca tanmayā vaḥ prakīrtitam || 38 ||
yo vāṃchati punaḥ svargaṃ sa tatra dvijasattamāḥ ||
snānaṃ karotu dānaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ || 39 ||
atha vāṃchati yo mokṣaṃ virakto bhavasāgarāt ||
niṣkāmastatra saṃtuṣṭastapastapyetsubuddhimān || 6.36.40 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
maṃtrajāpyasya māhātmyaṃ yattvayā naḥ prakīrtitam||
tatkathaṃ siddhimāyāti maṃtrajāpyaṃ hi sūtaja || 41 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atra tatkathayiṣyāmi yanmayā pitṛtaḥ śrutam ||
vadato brāhmaṇeṃdrasya purā durvāsaso muneḥ || 42 ||
tena pūrvaṃ pitā'smākaṃ pṛṣṭo durvāsasā dvijāḥ ||
maṃtravādakṛte yacca śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 43 || ||
|| durvāsā uvāca || ||
sādhayiṣyāmyahaṃ mantramabhīṣṭaṃ kamapi vratī ||
tasya siddhikṛte brūhi vidhānaṃ śāstrasaṃbhavam || 44 ||
|| lomaharṣaṇa uvāca || ||
maṃtrāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ kaṣṭaṃ sarveṣāmapi sanmune ||
pratyavāyasamopetaṃ bahucchidrasamākulam||45||
tasmānmaṃtrakṛte siddhiṃ yadi tvaṃ vāṃchasi dvija||
camatkārapure kṣetre tatra tvaṃ gaṃtumarhasi || 46 ||
tatra citreśvarīpīṭhamagastyena vinirmitam ||
sadyaḥ siddhikaraṃ proktaṃ mantrāṇāṃ hṛdi vartinām ||47 ||
na tatra jāyate chidraṃ pratyavāyo na ca dvija ||
nāsiddhirvaradānena sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām || 48 ||
cāturyuṃgyaṃ hi tatpīṭhaṃ sthitānāṃ siddhimāha ret ||
yugānurūpataḥ sadyastato vakṣyāmyahaṃ dvija || 49 ||
yo yaṃ sādhayituṃ mantramicchati dvijasattama ||
sa tasya pūrvamevātha lakṣamekaṃ japennaraḥ || || 6.36.50 ||
tato bhavati saṃsiddho maṃtrārhaḥ sa naraḥ śuciḥ ||
japedbrāhmaṇaśārdūla tato lakṣacatuṣṭayam ||
daśāṃśena tu homaḥ syātsusamiddhe hutāśane || || 51 ||
tatastu jāyate siddhirnūnaṃ tanmaṃtrasaṃbhavā ||
tatra saumyeṣu kṛtyeṣu homaḥ siddhārthakaiḥ sitaiḥ || 52 ||
jātīpuṣpaiśca viprendra smṛto brāhmaṇa bhojanaiḥ ||
tathā raudreṣu kṛtyeṣu raktapuṣpaiḥ saguggulaiḥ 0||
tarpaṇaiḥ kanyakānāṃ ca homaḥ syātsa phalapradaḥ || 53 ||
etatkṛtayuge proktaṃ maṃtrasādhanamutta mam ||
sarveṣāṃ sādhakānāṃ ca mayā proktaṃ dvijottama || 54 ||
etattretāyuge proktaṃ pādonaṃ mantrasādhanam ||
yugmārdhaṃ dvāpare kāryaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ kalau yuge || 55 ||
evaṃ tatra samāsādya siddhiṃ maṃtrasamudbhavām ||
tatra pīṭhe tataḥ kṛtyaṃ sādhayetsvecchayā naraḥ || 56 ||
śāpānugrahasāmarthyasaṃyutasteja sā'nvitaḥ ||
ajeyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sādhūnāṃ saṃmatastathā || 57 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā sa munistasya piturmama vaco'khilam ||
tataścitreśvaraṃ pīṭhaṃ samāyāto'tha sanmuniḥ || 58 ||
tatra saṃsādhayāmāsa sarvānmaṃtrānyathākramam ||
vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ|| 59 ||
iti saṃsiddhamaṃtraḥ sa camatkārapuraṃ gataḥ ||
viprāṇāṃ prārthanārthāya bhūmikhaṃḍakṛte dvijāḥ || 6.36.60 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahapurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye citreśvarīpīṭhamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 || || a ||

<6.37>

|| sūta uvāca ||
athāpaśyatsa viprāṇāṃ vṛndaṃ vṛndārakopamam||
saṃniviṣṭaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe līlābhāji dvijottamāḥ||1||
eke vedavidastatra vedavyākhyānatatparāḥ||
parasparaṃ susaṃkruddhā vivadaṃti jigīṣavaḥ || 2 ||
yajñavidyāvido'nye'pi yajñākhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ||
tatra viprāḥ pradṛśyaṃte śataśo brahmavādinaḥ || 3 ||
anye brāhmaṇaśārdūlā vedāṃgeṣu vicakṣaṇāḥ ||
pravadaṃti ca saṃdehānvṛndānāmagrataḥ sthitāḥ || 4 ||
vedābhyāsaparāścānye tāranādena sarvaśaḥ ||
nādayaṃto diśāṃ cakraṃ tatra samyagdvijottamāḥ || 5 ||
anye kautūhalāviṣṭāḥ saṃcarānviṣamānmithaḥ ||
papracchurjahasuścānye jñātvā mārgapravartinam || 6 ||
smṛtivādaparāścānye tathānye śrutipāṭhakāḥ ||
saṃdehānsmṛtijānanye pṛcchaṃti ca parasparam || 7 ||
kīrtayaṃti tathā cānye purāṇaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||
vṛddhānāṃ puratastatra sabhāmadhye vyavasthitāḥ || 8 ||
atha tānsa munirdṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇānsaṃśitavratān ||
abhivādya tataḥ prāha sādaraṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 9 ||
mama buddhiḥ samutpannā śambhorāyatanaṃ prati ||
kartuṃ brāhmaṇaśārdūlāstasmātsthānaṃ pradarśyatām || 6.37.10 ||
tavāhaṃ devadevasya śambhoḥ prāsādamuttamam ||
vidhāyārādhayiṣyāmi tameva vṛṣabhadhvajam || 11 ||
sa evaṃ jalpamāno'pi muhurmuhurataṃdritaḥ ||
na teṣāmuttaraṃ lebhe śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham || 12 ||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā samunistāndvijottamān ||
śaśāpa tāraśabdena yathā śṛṇvaṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ || 13 ||
|| durvāsā uvāca || ||
vidyāmado dhanamadastṛtīyo'bhijanodbhavaḥ ||
ete madāvaliptānāmeta eva satāṃ damāḥ || 14 ||
tatra ye'pi hi yuṣmākaṃ madā eva vyavasthitāḥ ||
yatastato'nvaye'pyevaṃ bhaviṣyati madānvitāḥ || 15 ||
sadā sauhṛdanirmuktāḥ pitaro'pi sutaiḥ saha ||
bhaviṣyaṃti pure hyasminkiṃ punarbāṃdhavādayaḥ || 16 ||
evamuktvā sa viprendro nivṛttastadanantaram ||
apamānaṃ paraṃ prāpya brāhmaṇānāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 17 ||
atha tanmadhyago vipra āsīdvṛddhatamaḥ sudhīḥ ||
suśīla iti vikhyāto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || 18 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā taṃ muniṃ kruddhaṃ gacchaṃtamapamānitam ||
satvaraṃ prayayau pṛṣṭhe tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti ca bruvan|| 19 ||
athāsādya gataṃ dūraṃ praṇipatya muniṃ ca saḥ ||
provāca kṣamyatāṃ vipra viprāṇāṃ vacanānmama || 6.37.20 ||
etaiḥ svādhyāyasaṃpannairna śrutaṃ vacanaṃ tava ||
nottaraṃ tena saṃdattaṃ satyametadbravīmyaham || 21 ||
tasmādbhūmirmayā dattā śaṃbhuharmyakṛte tava ||
asminsthāne dvijaśreṣṭha prāsādaṃ kartumarhasi || 22 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā durvāsā harṣasaṃyutaḥ ||
kṣitidānodbhavāṃ cakre svasti brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
prāsādaṃ nirmame paścāttasya vākye vyavasthitaḥ || 23 ||
atha te brāhmaṇā jñātvā suśīlena vasundharā ||
devatāyatanārthāya dattā tasmai tapasvine || 24 ||
sarve kopasamāyuktāḥ suśīlaṃ prati te dvijāḥ || 25 ||
tataḥ procuḥ samāsādya yena śaptā durātmanā ||
vayaṃ tasmai tvayā dattā prāsādārthaṃ vasundharā || 26 ||
tasmāttvamapi cāsmākaṃ bāhya eva bhaviṣyasi ||
suśīlo'pi hi duḥśīlo nāmnā saṃkīrtyase budhaiḥ || 27 ||
eṣo'pi tāpaso duṣṭo yaḥ karoti śivālayam ||
naiva tasya bhavetsiddhiścāpi varṣaśatairapi || 28 ||
tathā kīrtikṛtāṃ loke kīrtanaṃ kriyate naraiḥ ||
tataḥ saṃpaśyatāṃ cāsya kīrtirnāsya tu durmateḥ || || 29 ||
eṣa duḥśīlasaṃjño vai tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati ||
prāsādo nāmamātreṇa na saṃpūrṇaḥ kadācana || 6.37.30 ||
yasmātsauhṛdanirmuktāḥ kṛtāstena vayaṃ dvijāḥ ||
madaistribhiḥ samāyuktāḥ sarvānvayasamanvitāḥ || 31 ||
tasmādeṣo'pi pāpātmā bhaviṣyati sa kopabhāk ||
taptaṃ taptaṃ tapo yena saṃprayāsyati saṃkṣayam|| 32 ||
evamuktvātha te viprāḥ kopasaṃraktalocanāḥ ||
duḥśīlaṃ saṃparityajya praviṣṭāḥ svapure tataḥ || 33 ||
duḥśīlo'pi bahiścakre gṛhaṃ tasya purasya ca ||
devaśarmā yathāpūrvaṃ saṃtyaktaḥ puravāsibhiḥ || 34 ||
tasyānvaye'pi ye jātāste bāhyāḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ ||
bāhyāḥ kriyāsu sarvāsu sarveṣāṃ puravāsinām || 35 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ teṣu dvijeṃdreṣu śāpaṃ dattvā gateṣu ca ||
durvāsāḥ prāha duḥśīlaṃ kopasaṃraktalo canaḥ || 36 ||
mama siddhiṃ gatā maṃtrāḥ samarthāḥ śatrusaṃkṣaye ||
ātharvaṇāstathā cānye vedatrayasamudbhavāḥ || 37 ||
tasmādetatpuraṃ kṛtsnaṃ paśupakṣi samanvitam ||
nāśamadya nayiṣyāmi yathā śatrorhi duṣṭakaḥ || 38 ||
|| duḥśīla uvāca || ||
naitadyuktaṃ naraśreṣṭha tava kartuṃ kathaṃcana ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ kṛte karma brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ || 39 ||
nighnaṃto vā śapaṃto vā vadaṃto vāpi niṣṭhuram ||
pūjanīyāḥ sadā viprā divyām̐llokānabhīpsubhiḥ || 6.37.40 ||
brāhmaṇairnirjitairmene ya ātmānaṃ jayānvitam ||
tāmisrādiṣu ghoreṣu narakeṣu sa pacyate || 41 ||
ātmanaśca parābhūtiṃ tasmādviprātsaheta vai ||
ya icchedvasatiṃ svarge śāśvatīṃ dvijasattama || 42 ||
eteṣāṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ kṣetre siddhiṃ samāgatāḥ ||
maṃtrāste tatkathaṃ nāśaṃ tvameteṣāṃ kariṣyasi || 43 ||
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavate tathā ||
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ || || 44 ||
tasmātkopo na kartavyaḥ kṣetre cātra vyavasthitaiḥ ||
kṣamāṃ kuru muniśreṣṭha kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ||45 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya tatra kṛtvāvasattapaḥ ||
prāptaśca paramāṃ siddhiṃ durlabhāṃ tridaśairapi || 46 ||
duḥśīlākhyaḥ kṣitau so'pi prāsādaḥ khyāti māgataḥ ||
yasya saṃdarśanādeva naraḥ pāpātpramucyate || 47 ||
tasya madhyagataṃ liṃgaṃ śuklāṣṭamyāṃ sadā naraḥ ||
yaḥ paśyati kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā narakaṃ sa na paśyati || 48 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye duḥśīlākhyaprāsādotpatti varṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 || || cha ||

<6.38>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatraiva sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ dhundhumāreṇa bhūbhujā ||
sarvaratnamayaṃ kṛtvā prāsādaṃ sumanoharam || 1 ||
tatra kṛtvā''śramaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tapastepe sudāruṇam ||
yatprabhāvādayaṃ devastasmim̐lliṅge vyavasthitaḥ || 2 ||
tasya saṃnihitā vāpī kṛtā tena mahātmanā ||
sunirmalajalāpūrṇā sarvatīrthopamā śubhā || 3 ||
dhundhumāreśvaraṃ paśyettatra snātvā narottamaḥ ||
na sa paśyati durgāṇi narakāṇi yamālaye || 4 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
dhuṃdhumāro mahīpālaḥ kasminvaṃśe babhūva saḥ ||
kasminkāle tapastaptaṃ tenātra sumahātmanā || 5 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sūryavaṃśasamudbhūto bṛhadaśvasuto balī ||
khyātaḥ kuvalayāśveti dhaṃdhumārastathaiva saḥ || 6 ||
tena dhundhurmahādaityo nihato marujāṃgale ||
dhundhumāraḥ smṛtastena vikhyāto bhuvanatraye || 7 ||
camatkārapuraṃ kṣetraṃ sa gatvā pāvanaṃ mahat ||
tapastepe vayoṃ'te ca dhyāyamāno maheśvaram || 8 ||
saṃsthāpya sumahalliṃgaṃ prāsāde ratnamaṃḍite ||
balipūjopahārādyaiḥ puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ || 9 ||
tatastasya mahādevaḥ svayameva maheśvaraḥ ||
pratyakṣo'bhūdvṛṣārūḍho gauryā saha tathā gaṇaiḥ || 6.38.10 ||
uvāca varado'smīti prārthayasva yathepsitam ||
sarvaṃ te'haṃ pradāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 11 || ||
dhundhumāra uvāca || ||
yadi deyo varo'smākaṃ tvayā sarvasureśvara ||
saṃnidhānaṃ prakartavyaṃ liṃge'sminvṛṣabhadhvaja || 12 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
caitre śuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāṃnidhyaṃ nṛpasattama ||
ahaṃ sadā kariṣyāmi gauryā sārdhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 13 ||
tatra vāpyāṃ naraḥ snātvā yo māṃ saṃpūjayiṣyati ||
liṃge'sminsaṃsthitaṃ bhūpa mama lokaṃ sa yāsyati || 14 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
so'pi rājā prahṛṣṭā tmā sthitastatraiva muktibhāk || 15 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dhundhumāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśo adhyāyaḥ || 38 || || cha ||

<6.39>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasyaivottaradigbhāge dhundhumāreśvarasya ca ||
yayātinā nareṃdreṇa sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam || 1 ||
devayānyā tathānyacca tathā śarmiṣṭhayā dvijāḥ ||
bhāryayā bhūpatestasya sarvakāmaphalapradam || 2 ||
sa yadā sarvabhogānāṃ tṛptiṃ prāpto dvijottamāḥ ||
tadā putrasya rājyaṃ svaṃ vapuścaiva nyavedayat ||3||
jarāmādāya tadgātrādbhāryābhyāṃ sahitastadā ||
papraccha vinayopeto mārkaṃḍaṃ munisattamam || 4 ||
bhagavansarvatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ ca vadasva me ||
yatpradhānaṃ pavitraṃ yattadasmākaṃ prakīrtaya || 5 || ||
|| śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca || ||
kṣetrāṇāmiha sarveṣāṃ tīrthaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtam ||
camatkārapuraṃ kṣetraṃ sāṃprataṃ pratibhāti naḥ || 6 ||
yatra viṣṇupadī gaṃgā jaṃtūnāṃ pāpanāśinī ||
svayaṃ sthitā nṛpaśreṣṭha tathā devā harādayaḥ || 7 ||
tathānyāni ca tīrthāni yāni saṃti dharātale ||
teṣāṃ yatra ca sāṃnidhyaṃ sarvadā nṛpasattama || 8 ||
śilā yatra dvipañcāśaddhastānāṃ parisaṃkhyayā ||
pitāmahena nirmuktā pramodāya dvijanmanām || 9 ||
yadanyatra śubhaṃ karma varṣeṇaikena sidhyati ||
tattatra divasenāpi siddhiṃ yāti kṣitīśvara || 6.39.10 ||
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gatvā tapaḥ kuru mahīpate ||
yena prāpsyasi cittasthām̐llokānbhāryāsamanvitaḥ || 11 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa rājā nahuṣātmajaḥ ||
camatkārapure kṣetre bhāryābhyāṃ sahito yayau || 12 ||
tataḥ saṃsthāpya talliṃgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||
samyagārādhayāmāsa śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || 13 ||
tatastasya prabhāvena bhāryābhyāṃ sahito nṛpaḥ ||
vimānavaramārūḍho jagāma tridivālayam || 14 ||
kinnarairgīyamānaśca stūyamānaśca cāraṇaiḥ ||
sparddhamānaḥ samaṃ devairdvādaśārkasamaprabhaḥ || 15 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yayātīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| || 39 || || cha ||

<6.40>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadeṣā bhavatā proktā brāhmī tatra mahāśilā ||
mokṣadā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ tathā pātakanāśinī || 1 ||
sā kathaṃ sthāpitā tatra kiṃprabhāvā ca sūtaja ||
etanno brūhi niḥśeṣaṃ na hi tṛpyāmahe vayam || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
brahmalokaniviṣṭasya brahmaṇo' vyaktajanmanaḥ ||
purā'bhūnmahatī cintā tīrthayātrāsamudbhavā || 3 ||
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ saṃti tīrthāni bhūtale ||
muktvā māṃ tanmayā kāryaṃ tīrthamekaṃ dharātale || 4 ||
yatra trikālamāsādya karma saṃdhyāsamudbhavam ||
martyalokaṃ samāsādya karomi tadanaṃtaram || 5 ||
tathānyadapi yatkiñcitkarma dharmyaṃ hitāvaham ||
tatkaromi yathānye'pi cakrurdevāḥ śivādayaḥ || 6 ||
na svarge'sti hi kṛtyānāmadhikāro'tra kaścana ||
śubhānāṃ karmaṇāmeva kevalaṃ bhujyate phalam || 7 ||
tasmādyatra dharāpṛṣṭhe śileyaṃ nipatiṣyati ||
trisaṃdhyaṃ tatra gantavyamanuṣṭhānārthameva hi || 8 ||
evamuktvā suvistīrṇāṃ śilāṃ tāmā sanodbhavām ||
pracikṣepa dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ samuddiśya pitāmahaḥ || 9 ||
atha sā patitā bhūmau sarvaratnamayī śilā ||
camatkārapure kṣetre sarvakṣetramahodaye || 6.40.10 ||
tata āgatya lokeśaḥ svayameva dharātalam ||
tatkṣetraṃ vīkṣayāmāsa vyāptaṃ tīrthaiḥ samantataḥ || 11 ||
tataḥ puṇyatame deśe dṛṣṭvā tāṃ samupasthitām ||
śilāmānaṃdamāpannaḥ provāca tadanantaram || 12 ||
aho dhanyatamo matto nānyo'sti bhuvanatraye ||
sarvatīrthamaye kṣetre yato jātātra saṃsthitiḥ ||13||
salilena vinā yasmānna kriyā saṃpravartate ||
tasmādatra mayā kāryaḥ śucitoyo mahāhradaḥ || 14 ||
tataḥ saṃciṃtayāmāsa svasutāṃ ca sarasvatīm ||
jana saṃsparśabhītyā ca pātālatalavāhinīm || 15 ||
atha bhūmitalaṃ bhittvā prādurbhūtā mahānadī ||
tāṃ śilāmamalaistoyaiḥ kṣālayantī samaṃtataḥ || 16 ||
atha mūrtimatī bhūtvā provāca prapitāmaham ||
kimarthaṃ saṃsmṛtā devamamādeśaḥ pradīyatām||17||
|| brahmovāca || ||
tvayātraiva sadā stheyaṃ śilāyāṃ mama saṃnidhau ||
saṃdhyātraye'pi tvattoyairyena kṛtyaṃ karomyaham || 18 ||
tathā ye mānavāḥ snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti jale tava ||
te yāsyaṃti parāṃ siddhiṃ durlabhāṃ devā mānuṣaiḥ || 19 ||
|| sarasvatyuvāca || ||
ahaṃ kanyā suraśreṣṭha pātālatalavāhinī ||
janasparśabhayādbhītā nāgacchāmi mahītale || 6.40.20 ||
tavādeśo'nyathā naiva mayā kāryaḥ kathaṃcana ||
evaṃ matvā suraśreṣṭha yadyuktaṃ tatsamācara || 21 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
tavārthe kalpayiṣyāmi sthāne'traiva mahāhradam ||
agamyaṃ sarvamartyānāṃ tatra tvaṃ sthātumarhasi || 22 ||
evamuktvā sa deveśaścakhāna ca mahāhradam ||
tataḥ sarasvatī tatra svasthānamakaro datha || 23 ||
tato dṛṣṭiviṣānsarpānādideśa pitāmahaḥ ||
yuṣmābhiḥ sarvadā stheyaṃ hradesmiñchāsanānmama || 24 ||
yathā sarasvatīṃ martyā na spṛśaṃti kathaṃcana ||
bhavadbhiḥ sarvathā kāryaṃ tathā pannagasattamāḥ || 25 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ brahmā vyavasthāpya tatra kṣetre sarasvatīm ||
tāṃ ca citraśilāṃ madhye brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha || 26 ||
atha maṃkaṇakonāma maharṣiḥ saṃśitavrataḥ ||
kṣetre tatra samāyāto viṣavidyāvicakṣaṇaḥ || 27 ||
sakramādbhramamāṇastu tasminsarpābhirakṣite ||
taṃ muniṃ veṣṭayāmāsurbabandhuścaiva pāśakaiḥ || 28 ||
so'pi vidyābalātsarpānnirviṣāṃstāṃścakāraha ||
tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā kṛtvā ca pitṛtarpaṇam ||
niṣkrāṃtaḥ salilāttasmātkṛtakṛtyo mudānvitaḥ || 29 ||
tataścakre muniryāvatsamyakkuśaparigraham ||
darbhāgreṇāsya hastāgraṃ pāṭitaṃ tāvadeva hi || 6.40.30 ||
atha tasmātkṣatājjātastasya śākaraso mahān ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa viśeṣeṇa harṣito vismayānvitaḥ || 31 ||
siddho'hamiti vijñāya nṛtyaṃ cakre tataḥ param ||
brāhmīṃ śilāṃ samāruhya ānaṃdāśrupariplutaḥ || 32 ||
athaivaṃ nṛtyamānasya munestasya mahātmanaḥ ||
lāsyaṃ cakre tataḥ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || 33 ||
camatkārapuraṃ kṛtsnaṃ bhagnaṃ naṣṭā dvijottamāḥ ||
prāsādairdhvaṃsitaistatra hāhākāro mahānabhūt ||34||
]tato devagaṇāḥ sarve taddṛṣṭvā tasya ceṣṭitam||
lāsyasya vāraṇārthāya procurvṛṣabhavāhanam|| 35 ||
anena nṛtyamānena jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ||
nṛtyaṃ karoti deveśa tasmādgatvā nivāraya || 36 ||
nānyaḥ śaktaḥ suraśreṣṭha munimenaṃ kathaṃcana ||
niṣedhayitumīśāna tataḥ kuru jagaddhitam || 37 ||
atha teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
kṛtvā rūpaṃ dvijeṃdrasya tatsakāśamupādravat || 38 ||
abravīcca mune kasmāttvayaitannṛtyate'dhunā ||
tasmātkāryaṃ vadāśu tvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 39 ||
evamuktaḥ sa vipreṃdraḥ śaṃkareṇa dvijottamāḥ ||
hastaṃ saṃdarśayāmāsa tasya śākarasānvitam || 6.40.40 ||
kiṃ napaśyasi me brahmankarācchākaraso mahān||
saṃjātaḥ kṣatavaktreṇa tasmātsiddhirupasthitā || 41 ||
etasmātkāraṇādvipra nṛtyametatkaromyaham||
ānaṃdaṃ paramaṃ prāpya siddhijaṃ siddhasattama || 42 ||
evaṃ tu vadatastasya bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
aṃguṣṭhaṃ tāḍayāmāsa svāṃgulyagreṇa tatkṣaṇāt || 43 ||
niścakrāma tato bhasma himasphaṭikasaṃnibham||
kṣatāgrātsahasā tasya mahāvismayakārakam|| 44 ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ vipraṃ sa devo dvijasattamāḥ ||
yasyāṃguṣṭhāgrato mahyaṃ niṣkrāṃtaṃ bhasma pāṃḍuram || 45 ||
tathāpyahaṃ muniśreṣṭha na nṛtyaṃ kartumutsahe ||
tvaṃ punarnṛtyase kasmādapi śākarasekṣaṇāt|| || 46 ||
virāmaṃ kuru tasmāttvaṃ nṛtyādasmādvigarhitāt ||
tapaḥ kṣarati viprendra nṛtyagītāddvijanmanaḥ || 47 ||
athāsau tatsamudvīkṣya kṣatādbhasmavisarjanam ||
nṛtyaṃ vrīḍānvitastyaktvā tasya cakre namaskṛtim || 40 ||
abravīttvāmahaṃ manye nānyaṃ devānmaheśvarāt ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yathā na syāttapaḥkṣatiḥ || 49 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
tapaste matprasādena vṛddhiṃ śasyati nityaśaḥ ||
sthāne'tra bhavatā sārdhamahaṃ sthāsyāmi sarvadā || 6.40.50 ||
ānanditena bhavatā prārthito'haṃ yato mune ||
ānandeśvarasaṃjñastu khyātiṃ yāsyāmi bhūtale ||
etatpuraṃ ca me nāmnā ānandākhyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 51 ||
evamuktvā mahādevo gataścādarśanaṃ tataḥ ||
so'pi maṃkaṇakastatra tapastepe munīśvaraḥ || 52 ||
atha te pannagāḥ procuḥ praṇipatya munīśvaram||
bhagavannirviṣāḥ sarve vayaṃ hi bhavatā kṛtāḥ || 93 ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ no yathā syāddāruṇaṃ viṣam ||
no cedvayaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ sarvaloka parābhavam|| 54 ||
|| maṃkaṇaka uvāca || ||
anṛtaṃ na mayā proktaṃ svaireṇāpi kadācana ||
tasmādevaṃvidhāḥ sarve jalasarpā bhaviṣyatha || 55 || ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥprabhṛti saṃjātā jalasarpā mahītale ||
tadvadrūpā dvijihvāśca kevalaṃ viṣavarjitāḥ || 56 ||
atha tasminhrade martyāḥ snātvā sārasvate śubhe ||
spṛṣṭvā citraśilāṃ tāṃ ca prayāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 57 ||
atha bhītaḥ sahasrākṣo gatvā devaṃ pitāmaham ||
yamena sahitastūrṇaṃ provācedaṃ vacastadā || 58 ||
tvatprasādātsamudvīkṣya gacchaṃti manujā divam ||
pitāmaha mahātīrthaṃ yattvayā vihitaṃ kṣitau ||
sārasvataṃ narāstatra snātvā yāṃti triviṣṭapam || 59 ||
api pāpasamācārāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ ||
tatra snātvā śilāṃ spṛṣṭvā tadaivāyāṃti sadgatim|| 6.40.60 ||
|| yama uvāca || ||
apramāṇaṃ vibho karma saṃprayātaṃ mamocitam ||
śubhāśubhaparijñānaṃ sarveṣāmeva dehinām || 61 ||
tasmāttyaja tvaṃ māṃ deva yadvā tattīrthamuttamam||
yatprabhāvājjanairhīnāḥ saṃjātā narakā mama || 62 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā yamasya prapitāmahaḥ ||
prāha pārśvasthitaṃ śakraṃ tattīrthaṃ naya saṃkṣayam || 63 ||
tataḥ śakro hradaṃ gatvā pūrayāmāsa pāṃsubhiḥ ||
hradaṃ sārasvataṃ taṃ ca tāṃ ca citraśilāṃ dvijāḥ || 64 ||
adyāpi manujaḥ samyakta sminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ ||
yaḥ karoti tapaścaryāṃ sa śīghaṃ siddhimāpnuyāt || 65 ||
so'pi maṃkaṇakastatra sārddhaṃ devena śaṃbhunā ||
tiṣṭhatyadyāpi vipreṃdra pūritaṃ caiva pāṃsubhiḥ || 66 ||
liṃgaṃ maṃkaṇakanyastaṃ tatrāsti sumahodayam ||
tatspṛṣṭvā mānavāḥ pāpairmucyaṃte dvijasattamāḥ || 67 ||
māgha śuklacaturdaśyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ||
sa pāpairapi saṃyuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 68 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye citraśilāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 || || cha ||

<6.41>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasyaivottaradigbhāge devasya jalaśāyinaḥ ||
sthānamasti suvikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 ||
yastatpūjayate bhaktyā śayane bodhane hareḥ ||
upavāsaparo bhūtvā sa gacchedvaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 2 ||

tasyāṃ yaḥ pūjayettatra taṃ devaṃ jalaśāyinam||
śāstroktena vidhānena sa gacchati hareḥ padam || 4 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
jalaśāyī kathaṃ tatra saṃprāptaḥ sūtanandana ||
pūjyate vidhinā kena tatsarvaṃ vistarādvada || 5 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
purāsīdbāṣkalirnāma dānavendro mahābalaḥ ||
ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām || 6 ||
athāsau bhūtalaṃ sarvaṃ vaśīkṛtvā mahābalaḥ ||
tato daityagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ jagāma tridaśālayam || 7 ||
tatrābhavanmahāyuddhaṃ devāsuravināśakam ||

tato varṣasahasrāṃte daśame samupasthite ||

tataḥ svargaṃ parityajya sarvadevagaṇaiḥ saha ||

tasya devasya sadbhaktāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 13 ||

kaccitkṣemaṃ sahasrākṣa sāṃprataṃ bhuvanatraye ||

|| śakra uvāca || ||
bāṣkalirnāma detyendro haralabdhavaro balī ||
ajeyaḥ saṃgare devaistenāhaṃ vijito raṇe || 15 ||
saṃsthitiśca kṛtā svarge sāṃprataṃ madhu sūdana ||
tenaiṣa śaraṇaṃ prāpto devaiḥ sārddhaṃ surottama || 16 ||
hiraṇyākṣabhayāddevā hiraṇyakaśipoḥ purā ||

tasmādasmādapi trāhi dānavādbalavattarāt ||
