|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
ahaṃ taṃ nigrahīṣyāmi saṃprāpte samaye svayam||
tasmāttvaṃ samayaṃyāvatkuru śakra tapo mahat || 19 ||
yena te jāyate śaktistapovīryeṇa vāsava ||
vadhāya tasya daityasya balayuktasya bāṣkaleḥ || 6.41.20 ||
|| śakra uvāca || ||
kasminkṣetre jagannātha karomi sumahattapaḥ ||
tasya daityasya nāśārthaṃ tada smākaṃ prakīrtaya || 21 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ provācātha puraṃdaram ||
ciraṃ manasi niścitya kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni ca || 22 ||
camatkārapuraṃ kṣetraṃ śakra siddhipradāyakam ||
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gatvā tadvadhārthaṃ tapaḥ kuru || 23 ||
|| śakra uvāca || ||
na vayaṃ bhavatā hīnā yāsyāmo'nyatra keśava ||
bāṣkalerdānavendrasya bhayādbhītāḥ kathaṃcana || 24 ||
tasmādāgaccha tatra tvaṃ svayameva sureśvara ||
tvayā saṃrakṣito yena karomi sumahattapaḥ || 26 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ sa bhagavānviṣṇustathetyuktvā suraiḥ saha ||
camatkārapuraṃ kṣetramājagāma saha śriyā || || 26 ||
atha devagaṇāḥ sarve tatra gatvā tadā''śramān ||
cakruḥ pṛthakpṛthagghṛṣṭāstapo'rthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ || 27 ||
vāsudevo'pi saṃsmṛtya kṣīrodaṃ tatra sāgaram ||
ānināyāśu vistīrṇaṃ hrade tasminpurātane || 28 ||
cakāra śayanaṃ tatra śvetadvīpe yathā purā ||
stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ samaṃtādvinayānvitaiḥ || 29 ||
athāṣāḍhasya saṃprāpte dvitīyādivase śubhe ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe sahasrākṣaṃ svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ ||
provāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ bāṣpavyākula locanam || 6.41.30 ||
|| bṛhaspatiruvāca || ||
aśūnyaśayanānāma dvitīyādya puraṃdara ||
atīva dayitā viṣṇoḥ prasuptasya jalāśaye || 31 ||
asyāṃ saṃpūjito viṣṇuryāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam ||
dadāti sakalānkāmāndhyātaścetasi sarvadā ||
śāstroktavidhinā samyagvratastho jalaśāyinam || 32 ||
evaṃ sa caturo māsāndvitīyādivase harim ||
pūjayitvā sahasrākṣastejasā sahito'bhavat || 33 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tejasā yuktaṃ parituṣṭo janārdanaḥ ||
provāca śakra gacchādya vadhārthaṃ tasya bāṣkaleḥ ||
sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ vijayaste bhaviṣyati || 34 ||
|| śakra uvāca || ||
bibhemi tasya devāhaṃ dānavendrasya durmateḥ ||
tvayā vinā na gacchāmi sārdhaṃ sarvaiḥ surairapi || 35 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
tvayā saha sahasrākṣa cakrametatsudarśanam ||
gamiṣyati vadhārthāya madīyaṃ suravidviṣām || 36 ||
evamuktvā hariścakraṃ pramumoca sudarśanam ||
vadhārthaṃ dānavendrāṇāṃ śakreṇa sahitaṃ tadā || 37 ||
śakro'pi sahitastena gatvā cakreṇa kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
sarvānutsādayāmāsa dānavānraṇamūrdhani || 38 ||
sa cāpi bāṣkalistena cchinnaścakreṇa kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
papāta dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe vajrāhata ivācalaḥ || 39 ||
tathānye bahavaḥ śūrā dānavā baladarpitāḥ ||
hatvā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ bhūyaḥ prāptaṃ hareḥ karam|| 6.41.40 ||
te'pi śakrādayo devāḥ prahṛṣṭā gatasaṃśayāḥ ||
bhūyo viṣṇuṃ sametyātha procurnatvā tataḥ param || 41
prabhāvāttava deveśa hatāḥ sarve'marārayaḥ ||
prāptaṃ trailokyarājyaṃ ca bhūyo nihatakaṃṭakam || 42 ||
tasmātkīrtaya yatkṛtyaṃ tacca śreyaskaraṃ mama ||
sadā syātpuṃḍarīkākṣa tathā śatrubhayāvaham || 43 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
mayātraiva sadā stheyaṃ rūpeṇānena vāsava ||
sarvalokahitārthāya hrade puṇya jalāśraye || 44||
tvayā tasmātsamāgamya cāturmāsyaṃ śacīpate ||
prayatnena prakartavyamaśūnyaśayanaṃ vratam || 45 ||
na bhavaṃti sahasrākṣa yena te pari paṃthinaḥ ||
tathābhīṣṭaphalāvāptirmatprasādādasaṃśayam || 46 ||
anyo'pi yo naro bhaktyā pūjayiṣyati māmiha ||
saṃprāpsyati sa tām̐llokāndurlabhāṃstri daśairapi || 47 ||
tasmādgaccha sahasrākṣa kuru rājyaṃ triviṣṭape ||
bhūyo'pyatraiva deveśa draṣṭavyo'smi na saṃśayaḥ ||
kāryakāle samāyāte śvetadvīpe yathā tathā || 48 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ dṛṣṭvā prajagāma śatakratuḥ ||
vāsudevo'pi tatraiva sthito lokahitāya ca || 49 ||
evaṃ tatra dvijaśreṣṭhā jalaśāyī janārdanaḥ ||
sarvalokahitārthāya saṃsthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 6.41.50 ||
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ||
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 51 ||
tathā devagaṇaiḥ sarvairdvārakā tatra sā kṛtā ||
saṃpūjya tu narā yāṃti cāturmāsye triviṣṭapam || 52 ||
śeṣakāle'pi cittasthānkāmānmartyaḥ samāpnuyāt ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjyā sā dvārakā naraiḥ ||
sarveṣvapi hi kāleṣu cātumāsye viśeṣataḥ || 53 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ||
ākhyānaṃ devadevasya supuṇyaṃ jalaśāyinaḥ || 54 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye jalaśāyyutpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 || || cha ||

<6.42>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
viśvāmitrasamudbhūtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tatrāparaṃ śubham ||
saṃtiṣṭhate dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvakāmapradāyakam || 1 ||
tatra caitratṛtīyāyāṃ kṛte snāne bhavennaraḥ ||
divyarūpadharaḥ sākṣātkāmo'nyo dvijasattamāḥ || 2 ||
nārī vā śraddhayopetā tatra snātvā prajāvatī ||
bhavetsaubhāgyasaṃyuktā spṛhaṇīyatamā kṣitau || 3 || ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
tīrthaṃ tasya munestatra kasminkāle vyavasthitam ||
nirmalaṃ kena niḥśeṣaṃ vada tvaṃ sūtanaṃdana || 4 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatrāsti nirjharaḥ pūrvaṃ sāmānyo dvijasattamāḥ ||
avadhūto dharāpṛṣṭhe māhātmyena vyavasthitaḥ || 5 ||
yatra devanadī gaṃgā svayameva vyavasthitā ||
yasyāṃ snātaḥ pumānsadyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 6 ||
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya bhāvitaḥ ||
tadakṣayaṃ bhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam || 7 ||
yatkiṃciddīyata dānaṃ tasmiṃstīrthavare dvijāḥ ||
hutajapyādikaṃ caiva tadanaṃtaphalaṃ bhavet || 8 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya mṛgī vyādhaśarāhatā ||
praviṣṭā salile tasmiṃstatra pañcatvamāgatā || 9 ||
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ madhyāhne dvijasattamāḥ ||
nakṣatre yamadaivatye mārtaṃḍasya ca vāsare || 6.42.10 ||
atha tattoyamāhātmyānmenakānāma sā'bhavat ||
apsarāstridaśeṃdrasya samaṃtāccāruhāsinī || 11 ||
smaramāṇā'tha sā tasya prabhāvaṃ varavarṇinī ||
tīrthamāgatya sadbhaktyā snānaṃ tatra samācarat ||
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ yāmarkṣe sūryavāsare || 12 ||
ekadā divase tasminbhramamāṇo munīśvaraḥ ||
viśvāmitra iti khyātastatrāyātastapo'nvitaḥ || 13 ||
sā'pi svargātsamāyātā devatādarśanārthataḥ ||
pūjayitvātha taṃ devaṃ prasthitā tridivaṃ prati || 14 ||
sā dṛṣṭvā taṃ muniṃ tatra bhramamāṇamitastataḥ ||
yauvanasthaṃ surūpāḍhyaṃ paṃcabāṇamivāparam|| 15 ||
vrataprabhāvajairvyāptaṃ tejobhirbhāskaraṃ yathā ||
bālyātprabhṛti cīrṇena tapasā dagdhakilbiṣam|| 16 ||
sā tasya darśanādeva kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ||
sānaṃdāḥ suratārthāya samīpaṃ samupādravat || 17 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā'dṛṣṭapūrvāṃ tāṃ mārgapṛcchākṛte tataḥ ||
sammukhaḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || 18 ||
uvāca deśaṃ tāṃ pṛcchanstrīdharmāṃśca viśeṣataḥ ||
śubhalābho'stu te bhadre manasā karmaṇā girā || 19 ||
sadaiva vāsudevasya bhaktiścāvyabhicāriṇī||
kaccittvaṃ vartase putri patipādaparāyaṇā ||
cāritravinayopetā sarvadā priyavādinī || 6.42.20 ||
kaccittvaṃ sarvadābhīṣṭā patyurdānaistathārccanaiḥ ||
baṃdhūnsvamitravargaṃ ca tatpuraḥ pṛṣṭhatopi vā || 21 ||
kaccidbhartari saṃsupte tvaṃ niśavaśameṣyasi||
utthānamaprabuddhe ca karoṣi varavarṇini || 22 ||
kaccitprātaḥ samutthāya karoṣi gṛhamārjanam ||
svayameva varārohe maṇḍanaṃ copamaṇḍanam|| 23 ||
kaccidevānnamaskṛtya guruṃ ca tadanaṃtaram ||
karoṣi tvaṃ prāṇayātrāṃ dattvānnaṃ śaktito jalam || 24 ||
kaccidastaṃgate sūrye nānnamaśnāsi bhābhini ||
adattvā vā svabhṛtyebhyaḥ sādhubhyaśca viśeṣataḥ || 25 ||
kaccitpibasi pānīyaṃ saptavāraviśodhitam ||
nibiḍena svavastreṇa pālayaṃtī jalodbhavān|| 26.||
kacciddayāsamopetā gātrakleśakarānapi ||
yūkāmatkuṇadaṃśādīnputravatparirakṣasi|| 27 ||
kaccitsādhumukhānnityaṃ śivadharmaṃ subhaktitaḥ ||
śṛṇoṣi bhaktito bhadre prakaroṣi ca sādaram || 28 ||
kvacicchrutvā''gamaṃ puṇyaṃ prakaroṣi ca pūjanam||
śāstrasya vācakasyāpi vyākhyātuśca viśeṣataḥ || 29 ||
kaccitpurāṇaśāstrāṇi praṇītāni janeśvaraiḥ ||
saṃlekhyākṣararamyāṇi sādhubhyaḥ saṃprayacchasi || 6.42.30 ||
yaḥ śrutvā sarva śāstrāṇi niṣkrayaṃ na prayacchati ||
śāstracauraḥ sa vijñeyo na caivāpnoti tatphalam || 31 ||
kaccicchivālaye nṛtyagītavādyādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||
balipūjopahārāṃśca tvaṃ karoṣi ca śaktitaḥ || 32 ||
kaccitprāvaraṇaṃ vastraṃ subhage sarvameva ca ||
saṃprayacchasi sādhubhyaḥ praṇipātapuraḥsaram || 33 ||
vṛthā paryaṭanaṃ nityaṃ kaccinna paramaṃdire ||
tvaṃ karoṣi viśālākṣi viśeṣeṇa niśāgame || 34 ||
kaccinnāśnāsi bhadre tvaṃ svabhartari bubhukṣite ||
ājñābhaṃgaṃ prayatnena kaccittatra prarakṣasi || 35 ||
kaccitprakupite kāṃte nottarāṇi prayacchasi ||
tasyakopapraṇāśārṣaṃ priyaṃ kaccicca jalpasi || 36 ||
kaccittvaṃ proṣite kāṃte malināṃbaradhāriṇī ||
jāyase ca tathā dīnā vivarṇavadanā kṛśā || 37 ||
kaccinmaṃdirapṛṣṭhe tvaṃ na dhatse bhinnabhājanam ||
ucchiṣṭaṃ vā janaistyaktamapi kāryopakārakam || 39 ||
kaccidvrajasi no rātrau jāgareṣu kathāsu ca ||
nirjhareṣu vivikteṣu pulineṣu vaneṣu ca || 39 ||
kaccinna kuruṣe maitrīṃ baṃdhakībhiḥ samaṃ śubhe ||
dhātrībhirmālikastrībhī rajakībhiśca bhāmini || 6.42.40 ||
kañciddadhāsi nityaṃ tvaṃ mukhaṃ kuṃkumaraṃjitam ||
śiraḥ puṣpasamākīrṇaṃ netre kajjalaraṃjite || 41 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye viśvāmitrakuṇḍotpattivṛttānte viśvāmitramenakāsamāgamavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśo dhyāyaḥ || 42 || || cha ||

<6.43>

|| menakovāca || ||
anyāstā nāyikā vipra yāsāṃ dharmastvayoditaḥ ||
svecchācāravihāriṇyo vayaṃ veśyā divaukasām || 1 ||
sa tvaṃ vada mahābhāga kasmāddeśātsamāgataḥ ||
mama cittaharo vāpi tīrthe dharmiṣṭhasaṃśraye || 2 ||
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ mahābhāga kāmadeva samākṛtim ||
pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgī kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā || 3 ||
tasmādbhajasva māṃ raktāṃ no cedyāsyāmi saṃkṣayam ||
kāmabāṇapradagdhā vai puro'pi tava tāpasa ||
tataḥ strīvadhapāpena lipyase tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 4 ||
|| tāpasa uvāca || ||
vayaṃ vratadharāḥ subhru brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ ||
mūrkhāḥ kāmavidhau bhadre niratāḥ śivaśāsane || 5 ||
sarveṣāṃ vratināṃ mūlaṃ brahmacaryamudāhṛtam ||
viśeṣācchivabhaktānāmevaṃ bhūyo vidhāsyasi || 6 ||
api varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ yattapaḥ kurute vratī ||
sakṛtstrīsaṃgamānnāśaṃ yāti pāśupatasya ca || 7 ||
māṃ ca pāśupataṃ lubdhā kasmāttvaṃ bhīru bhāṣase ||
īdṛkpāpatamaṃ karma garhitaṃ śivaśāsane || 8 ||
yaḥ strīṃ bhajati pāpātmā vṛthā pāśupatavratī ||
so'tītāndaśa cādhāya puruṣānnarake pacet || 9 ||
āstāṃ tāvatsamā saṃgaṃ saṃsparśaṃ ca varānane ||
saṃbhāṣamapi pāpāya strībhiḥ pāśupatasya ca || 6.43.10 ||
tasmād drutataraṃ gaccha sthānādasmādvarāṃgane ||
yatrāvāpsyasi cābhīṣṭaṃ tatra tvaṃ gantumarhasi || 11 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye viśvāmitrakuṇḍotpattivṛttānte viśvāmitramenakāsaṃvādavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 || || cha ||

<6.44>

|| menakovāca || ||
nūnaṃ hi kāmadharme tvaṃ na pravīṇo mahādyute ||
tena māmīdṛśairvākyairnivārayasi rāgiṇīm || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktastato bhūyo viśvāmitro'bravīdidam ||
kopena mahatā yukto niḥspṛhastatparigrahe || 2 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
tvaṃ jīva gaccha vā mṛtyuṃ nāhaṃ kartāsmi te vacaḥ ||
vratanāśāttu yatpāpamadhikaṃ strīvadhādbhavet || 3 ||
prāyaścittaṃ budhairuktaṃ vratināṃ strīvadhe kṛte ||
na saṃgāttu punastāsāṃ tasmāttvaṃ gantumarhasi || 4 ||
na kevalaṃ vratopetāḥ strīsaṃgātpāpamāpnuyuḥ ||
vratabāhyā api narāḥ saktāḥ strīṣu pataṃtyadhaḥ || 5 ||
saṃsārabhramaṇaṃ nārī prathamepi samāgame ||
vahnipradakṣiṇā vyājanyāyenaiva pradarśayet || 6 ||
tasmātstrībhiḥ samaṃ prājñaḥ saṃbhāṣāmapi varjayet ||
āstāṃ tāvatsamāsaṃgaṃ ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ ||7 ||
aṃgāra sadṛśā nārī ghṛtakuṃbhasamaḥ pumān ||
asparśāddṛḍhatāmeti tatsaṃparkādvilīyate || 8 ||
striyo mūlamanarthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi ||
tasmāttyājyā sudūreṇa tāḥ svargasya nirodhakāḥ || 9 ||
kulīnā vittavatyaśca nāthavatyo'pi yoṣitaḥ ||
ekasminnaṃtare rāgaṃ kurvaṃtyetāḥ sucañcalāḥ ||6.44.10||
na strībhyaḥ kiṃcidanyaddhi pāpāya vidyate bhuvi ||
yāsāṃ saṃgasamāsādya saṃsāre bhramate janaḥ ||11||
nīco'pi kurute sevāṃ yastāsāṃ vijaneṣvatha ||
virūpaṃ vāpi nīcaṃ vā taṃ sevante hi tāḥ striyaḥ || 12 ||
anarthatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhayātparijanasya ca ||
maryādāyāmamaryādāḥ striyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu || 13 ||
||sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ saṃbhartsitā tena menakā kopasaṃyutā ||
śaśāpa taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ sphuramāṇoṣṭhasaṃpuṭā || 14 ||
yasmāttvayā parityaktā sakāmāhaṃ sudurmate||
tyajatā kāmajaṃ dharmaṃ tasmācchāpaṃ gṛhāṇa me || 15 ||
adyaiva bhava duburddhe valīpalitasaṃyutaḥ ||
jarājarjjaritāṃgaśca tucchadṛṣṭirviraṃgitaḥ || 16 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
uktamātre tu vacane tatkṣaṇānmunisattamaḥ ||
babhūva tādṛśaḥ sadyastayā yādṛkprakīrtitaḥ || 17 ||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā so'pi tāṃ śaptumudyataḥ ||
kamaṇḍalorjalaṃ gṛhya saṃtāpādraktalocanaḥ || 18 ||
nirdoṣo'pi tvayā yasmācchapto'haṃ gaṇikādhame ||
tasmādbhava tvamapyāśu jarājarjaritāṃgikā || 19 ||
sāpi tadvacanātsadyastādṛgrūpā vyajāyata ||
yādṛśo'sau muniśreṣṭho valīpalitagātrabhṛt || 6.44.20 ||
atha tādṛksvarūpeṇa snātā tatra jalā śaye ||
bhūyo'pi tādṛśī jātā yādṛśī saṃsthitā purā || 21 ||
taddṛṣṭvā paramāścaryamatīva tvarayānvitaḥ||
so'pi tatrākarotsnānaṃ saṃjātaśca yathā purā || 22 ||
tatastau tīrthamāhātmyādrūpaudāryaguṇānvitau ||
mitha āmaṃtrya saṃhṛṣṭau gatau deśaṃ yathepsitam || 23 ||
evaṃ tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ vijñāya bhagavānṛṣiḥ ||
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa devadevasya śūlinaḥ || 24 ||
tapaścakāra sumahattasmiṃstīrthavare tadā ||
kuśastambena kṛtavāṃstatsaro vipulaṃ vibhuḥ || || 25 ||
tatra snātvā naro yastu pūjayelliṃgamuttamam ||
viśvāmitreśvaraṃ khyātaṃ sa gacchecchivamaṃdiram || 26 ||
adyāpi dṛśyate tatra gaṃgodakasamaṃ jalam ||
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam || 27 ||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
sa devalokamāsādya pitṛbhiḥ saha modate ||28||
tataḥprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khyātiṃ prāptaṃ mahītale ||
pātāle svargaloke ca rūpaudāryapradaṃ nṛṇām || 29 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ||
viśvāmitreśa māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 6.44.30 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe śrīhāṭakevarakṣetramāhātmye viśvāmitrakuṇḍotpatti viśvāmitreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 || ||

<6.45>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatraivāsti dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ supuṇyaṃ puṣkaratrayam||
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptamānartādhipabhūbhujā || 1 ||
yastatra kārtike māsi kṛttikāsthe niśākare ||
madhyāhne kurute snānaṃ sa gacchati parāṃ gatim || 2 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kathaṃ tatra samāyātaṃ supuṇyaṃ puṣkaratrayam ||
kasminsthāne ca vijñeyaṃ kaiścihnairvada sūtaja || || 3 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi yaiścihnaiḥ puṣkaratrayam ||
prāgdṛṣṭaṃ muninā tatra viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā || 4 ||
purā nivasatastasya viśvāmitrasya sanmuneḥ ||
saṃprāptā kārtikī puṇyā kṛttikāyogasaṃyutā || 5 ||
sarvatīrthamayaṃ kṣetraṃ tadvijñāya taponidhiḥ ||
tataśca cintayāmāsa svacitte gādhinandanaḥ || 6 ||
adyeyaṃ kārtikī puṇyā kṛttikāyogasaṃyutā ||
yasyāṃ snāne naraiḥ śreyaḥ prāpyate puṣkarodake ||
ādyaṃ tu puṣkaraṃ dūre na gantuṃ śakyate'dhunā || 7 ||
tasmādatra sthitaṃ yacca tasminsnānaṃ karomyaham ||
sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 8 ||
tataścānveṣayāmāsa puṣkarāṇi samaṃtataḥ ||
bahutvāttatra tīrthānāṃ niścayaṃ nānvapadyata ||9||
dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā jalasthānaṃ snānaṃ cakre tataḥ param||
sa tadā śramamāpanno bhramamāṇa itastataḥ||6.45.10||
vṛkṣamūlaṃ samāśritya niviṣṭaśca kṣitau tataḥ||
tuṣṭāvātha śucirbhūtvā śraddhayā ca tripuṣkaram ||11||
madhyamādyojanaṃ svargaḥ kaniṣṭhādardha yojanam ||
jyeṣṭhakuṇḍātpunaḥ khyāto hastaprāyaḥ śubhātmabhiḥ || 12 ||
pāvayaṃti hi tīrthāni snānadānādasaṃśayam ||
puṣkarālokanādeva naraḥ pāpātpramu cyate || 13 ||
puṣkarāraṇyamāśritya śākamūlaphalairapi ||
ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 14 ||
puṣkare duṣkaraṃ snānaṃ puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ||
puṣkare duṣkaro vāsaḥ sarvaṃ puṣkaraduṣkaram || 15 ||
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge puṣkare snāti yo naraḥ ||
sa kṣaṇānmucyate pāpādājanmamaraṇodbhavāt || 16 ||
jyeṣṭhe prātaśca madhyāhne madhyame snāti yo naraḥ ||
kaniṣṭhe'stamite bhānau sakṛtsvargamavāpnuyāt || 17 ||
tāvattiṣṭhati deheṣu pātakaṃ sarvadehinām ||
yāvanna pauṣkaraistoyaiḥ snānaṃ vai kurvate narāḥ || 18 ||
divākarakaraiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ tamo yadvatpraṇaśyati ||
puṣkarodakasaṃsparśācchīghraṃ gacchati pātakam || 19 ||
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtvāpi puruṣo bhuvi ||
kārtikyāṃ puṣkare snātvā nirdoṣatvaṃ prapadyate || 6.45.20 ||
kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ vratairhomaiḥ kiṃ yajñairvahuvistaraiḥ ||
kārtikyāṃ puṣkare snānaiḥ sarveṣāṃ labhyate phalam || 21 ||
yadyeṣā bhāratī satyā mayā samyamudīritā ||
tanme syāddarśanaṃ śīghraṃ sadyaḥ puṣkarasaṃbhavam || 22 ||
evaṃ tasya bruvāṇasya viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ||
aśarīrā'bhavadvāṇī gaganāddvijasattamāḥ || 23 ||
viśvāmitra muniśreṣṭha sadā me gagane sthitiḥ ||
muktvaikāṃ kārtikīṃ caiva kṛttikāyogasaṃyutām || 24 ||
tadatra divase vāso mama bhūmitale dhruvam ||
asminneva vane puṇye tattvaṃ snānaṃ samācara || 25 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ śrūyate ca samāśrayaḥ ||
tatkathaṃ vedmi tīrtheśa tvāmatraiva vyavasthitam || 26 ||
tadotthitā punarvāṇī tārā gaganagocarā ||
viśvāmitraṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ harṣayaṃtī dvijottamāḥ || 27 ||
nātidūre vanādasmādatra saṃti jalāśayāḥ ||
teṣāmekatame padmaṃ vidyate'dhomukhaṃ sthitam || 28 ||
ūrdhvavaktraṃ dvitīye ca tiryagvaktraṃ tṛtīyake ||
tatrordhvāsyaiḥ sarojaiśca vijñeyaṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkaram || 29 ||
pārśvavaktrairdvijaśreṣṭha madhyamaṃ parikīrtitam ||
adhovaktraistathā jñeyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ puṣkaraṃ kṣitau || 6.45.30 ||
etaiścihnairmuniśreṣṭha jñātvā snānaṃ samācara ||
tacchrutvā sa munistūrṇaṃ samutthāya yayau tataḥ || 31 ||
tādṛśaiḥ kamalaistatra saṃsthitāste jalāśayāḥ ||
tāndṛṣṭvā śraddhayopetaḥ kṛtvā snānaṃ yathākramam || 32 ||
tataśca vidhinā samyakcakārapitṛtarpaṇam || 33 ||
tataḥ śākaiśca mūlaiśca nīvāraiḥ phalasaṃyutaiḥ ||
cakāra vidhinā śrāddhaṃ tatraiva dvijasattamāḥ || 34 ||
tatra tasyaiva tīrastho vīkṣāṃcakre samāhitaḥ ||
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge cihnadarśanalālasaḥ || 35||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
kīdṛśaṃ jāyate cihnaṃ kārtikyāṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare ||
saṃprāpte kṛttikāyoge sarvaṃ tatra vadāśu naḥ || 36 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge yadā gacchati caṃdramāḥ ||
tadā niṣkrāmati śreṣṭhaṃ kamalaṃ jalamadhyataḥ || 37 ||
tanmadhyeṃ'guṣṭhamātrastu puruṣo dṛśyate janaiḥ ||
susnātaiḥ śraddhayopetaistatastīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 38 ||
etasmātkāraṇātsnātvā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ||
taccihnaṃ vīkṣayāmāsa mahadyatnaṃ samāśritaḥ || || 39 ||
tasyaivaṃ vīkṣamāṇasya viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ||
ānartādhipatistatra prāpto rājā bṛhadbalaḥ || 6.45.40 ||
atyaṃtaṃ mṛgayāśrāṃto hatvā mṛgagaṇānbahūn ||
ṛkṣāṃścaiva varāhāṃśca sāraṃgānatha saṃbarān || 41 ||
siṃhānvyāghrānvṛkāṃścaiva hiṃsānāraṇyacāriṇaḥ ||
tathānyānapi madhyāhne tena mārgeṇa saṃgataḥ || 42 ||
athāpaśyaddrumopāṃte viśvāmitraṃ munīśvaram ||
upaviṣṭaṃ kṛtasnānaṃ vīkṣamāṇaṃ jalāśayam || 43 ||
tatastaṃ praṇipatyoccairavatīrya turaṃgamāt ||
śramārttaḥ salile tasminpraviveśa nṛpottamaḥ || 44 ||
etasminnaṃtare toyātkamalaṃ tadvinirgatam ||
sahasrapatrasaṃjuṣṭaṃ dvādaśārkasamaprabham || || 45 ||
taddṛṣṭvā sa mahīpālaḥ padmamatyadbhutaṃ mahat ||
jagrāha kautukāviṣṭaḥ svayaṃ savyena pāṇinā || 46 ||
spṛṣṭamātre tatastasminkamale dvijasattamāḥ ||
utthitaḥ sumahāñchabdo viśvaṃ yena prapūritam || 47 ||
taṃ śabdaṃ sa mahīpālaḥ śrutvā mūrchāmupāviśat ||
patitaśca jale tasminpadmaṃ cādarśanaṃ gatam || 48 ||
tataḥ kṛcchreṇa mahatā karṣitaḥ salilādbahiḥ ||
sevakairduḥkhaśokārttairhāheti pratijalpakaiḥ || 49 ||
tatastīraṃ samāsādya kṛcchrātprāpyātha cetanām ||
yāvadvīkṣayati svāṃgaṃ tāvatkuṣṭhaṃ samāgatam || 6.45.50 ||
tato viṣādamāpanno dṛṣṭvā tādṛṅnijaṃ vapuḥ ||
śīrṇaghrāṇāṃghrihastaṃ ca ghargharasvarasaṃyutam || 51 ||
atha gatvā muneḥ pārśve viśvāmitrasya bhūmipaḥ ||
uvāca vacanaṃ dīnaṃ bāṣpagadgadayā girā || || 52 ||
bhagavanpaśya me jātaṃ yādṛśaṃ vapureva hi ||
akasmādeva magnasya salile'tra vigarhitam || 53 ||
tatkiṃ pānīyadoṣo vā kiṃ vā bhūmermunī śvara ||
yenedṛksahasā yātaṃ vikṛtiṃ me śarīrakam || 54 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
sāvitraṃ padmamevaitadyatspṛṣṭaṃ bhūpate tvayā ||
ucchiṣṭena ravirmadhye svayaṃ yasya vyavasthitaḥ || 55 ||
yadā syātkṛttikāyogaḥ kārtike māsi pārthiva ||
śaśāṃkasya tadā caitajjāyate pauṣkare jale || 56 ||
tadidaṃ puṣkaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhavānyatra śramāturaḥ ||
praviṣṭaḥ kārtikī cādya kṛttikāyogasaṃyutā || 57 ||
etadvīkṣya naro hyatra snānaṃ kuryājjalāśaye ||
śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ sa gacchati parāṃ gatim ||58||
ucchiṣṭena tvayā rājanharaṇāya hi kevalam ||
etatsaroruhaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ tenedṛksaṃsthitaṃ phalam ||59|| ||
|| bṛhadbala uvāca || ||
kathaṃ me syānmuniśreṣṭha kuṣṭhavyādhiparikṣayaḥ ||
tapasā niyamenāpi vratenāpi kṛtena vai || 6.45.60 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
ārādhaya sahasrāṃśumasminkṣetre mahīpate ||
tataḥ prāpsyasi saṃsiddhiṃ kuṣṭhanāśasamudbhavām || 61 ||
tacchrutvā sa munervākyaṃ bhūmipālo bṛhadbalaḥ ||
tatkṣaṇātsthāpayāmāsa sūryasya pratimāṃ tadā || 62 ||
arcayāmāsa vidhivatpuṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ||
śraddhayā parayā yukto ravivāre viśeṣataḥ|| || 63 ||
upavāsaparo bhūtvā raktacandanasaṃyutaiḥ ||
pūjayanraktapuṣpaiśca śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || 64 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte sa babhūva mahīpatiḥ ||
kuṣṭha vyādhi vinirmukto dvādaśārkasamaprabhaḥ || 65 ||
tataḥ svaṃ rājyamāsādya bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ ||
dehāṃte dinanāthasya saṃprāpto maṃdiraṃ tathā || 66 ||
|| || sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ tatra dvijaśreṣṭhā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā ||
prakaṭaṃ sarvalokasya vihitaṃ puṣkaratrayam || 67 ||
yastatra kārtike māse kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāsu ca ||
prakaroti naraḥ snānaṃ brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati || 68 ||
tathā yo bhāskaraṃ paśyedbṛhadvalapratiṣṭhitam ||
vatsaraṃ ravivāreṇa yāvatkṛtvā kṣaṇaṃ naraḥ ||
sa mucyate naro rogairyadi syādrogasaṃyutaḥ || 69 ||
nīrogo vā naraḥ sadyo labhate manasepsitam ||
niṣkāmo mokṣamāpnoti prasādāttīkṣṇadīdhiteḥ || 6.45.70 ||
kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge vṛṣotsargaṃ karoti yaḥ ||
puṣkareṣu supuṇyeṣu so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 71 ||
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyekopi gayāṃ vrajet ||
yajeta vā'śvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet || 72 ||
ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni sarvadānāni caikataḥ ||
ekatastu vṛṣotsargaḥ kārtikyāṃ puṣkareṣu ca || 73 ||
yaścaitacchuṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedvā śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
saṃprāpya sarvakāmānvai brahmaloke mahīyate || 74 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye tripuṣkaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcacatvāriṃśo' dhyāyaḥ || 45 || || cha ||

<6.46>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
anyāni tatra tīrthāni yāni saṃti mahāmate ||
tāni kīrtaya sarvāṇi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatra sārasvataṃ tīrthamanyadasti suśobhanam ||
yatra snāto'timūko'pi bhavedvākyavicakṣaṇaḥ || 2 ||
labhate cepsitānkāmānmānuṣāndaivikānapi ||
brahmalokādiparyatāṃstathālokāndvijottamāḥ || 3 ||
purāsītpārthivo nānā vikhyāto balavardhanaḥ ||
samudravalayāmurvīṃ bubhuje yo bhujārjitām|| 4 ||
tasya putraḥ samutpannaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ ||
tasya nāma pitā cakre saṃprāpte dvādaśe'hani ||
ambuvīciriti spaṣṭaṃ samāhūya dvijottamān || 5 ||
tataḥ sa vavṛdhe bālo lālitastena bhūbhujā ||
mūkabhāvaṃ samāpanno na śakroti prajalpitum || 6 ||
tato'sya saptame varṣe saṃprāpte balavardhanaḥ ||
paṃcatvaṃ samanuprāptaḥ saṃgrāme śatrubhirhataḥ || 7 ||
tato mūko'pi bālopi maṃtribhistasya bhūpateḥ ||
sa sutaḥ sthāpito rājye abhāve'nyasutasya ca || 8 ||
evaṃ tasya mahīpasya rājyasthasya jaḍātmanaḥ ||
bālatve vartamānasya rājyaṃ viplavamadhyagāt || 9 ||
tato jalacaranyāyaḥ saṃpravṛtto mahītale ||
pīḍyaṃte sarvalokāstu durbalā balavattaraiḥ || 6.46.10 ||
tataste maṃtriṇaḥ procurvasiṣṭhaṃ svapurohitam ||
vaco'rthaṃ nṛpaterasya kurūpāyaṃ mahāmune || 11 ||
paśya kṛtsnaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe śūnyatāṃ samupasthitam ||
jaḍatvānnṛpaterasya tasmātkuru yathocitam || || 12 ||
tatastu suciraṃ dhyātvā dīnānprovāca maṃtriṇaḥ ||
sarvānārtisamopetāñchṛṇvatastasya bhūpateḥ || 13 ||
asti sārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tatrāyaṃ snātu bhūpatiḥ || 14 ||
atha tadvacanātsadyaḥ sa gatvā tatra satvaram ||
snānāttīrthe'tha saṃjātastatkṣaṇātsa kala svanaḥ || 15 ||
tatprabhāvaṃ sarasvatyāḥ sa vijñāya mahīpatiḥ ||
śraddhayā parayā yukto dhyāyamānaḥ sarasvatīm || 16 ||
tatastūrṇaṃ samādāya mṛttikāṃ sa nadītaṭāt ||
cakāra bhāratīṃ devīṃ svayameva caturbhujām || 17 ||
dadhatīṃ dakṣiṇe haste kamalaṃ sumanoharam ||
akṣamālāṃ tathānyasmiñjitatāraka varcasam || 18 ||
kamaṇḍaluṃ tathānyasmindivyavāriprapūritam ||
pustakaṃ ca tathā vāme sarvavidyāsamudbhavam || 19 ||
tato medhye śilāpṛṣṭhe tāṃ niveśya prayatnataḥ ||
pūjayāmāsa sadbhaktyā dhūpamālpānulepanaiḥ || 6.46.20 ||
cakāra ca stutiṃ paścācchraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
tadagre prayato bhūtvā svareṇa mahatā nṛpaḥ || 21 ||
sadasaddevi yatkiñcidbandhamokṣātmakaṃ padam ||
tatsarvaṃ guptayā vyāptaṃ tvayā kāṣṭhaṃ yathāgninā || 22 ||
sarvasya siddhirūpeṇa tvaṃ janasya hṛdi sthitā ||
vācārūpeṇa jihvāyāṃ jyotīrūpeṇa cakṣuṣi || 23 ||
bhaktigrāhyāsi deveśi tvamekā bhuvanatraye ||
śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇe ||24||
tvaṃ kīrtistvaṃ dhṛtirmedhā tvaṃ bhaktistvaṃ prabhā smṛtā ||
tvaṃ nidrā tvaṃ kṣudhā kīrtiḥ sarvabhūtanivāsinī || 25 ||
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirvapuḥ prītiḥ svadhā svāhā vibhāvarī ||
ratiḥ prītiḥ kṣitirgaṃgā satyaṃ dharmo manasvinī || 26 ||
lajjā śāṃtiḥ smṛtirdakṣā kṣamā gaurī ca rohiṇī ||
sinīvālī kuhū rākā devamātā ditistathā || 27 ||
brahmāṇī vinatā lakṣmīḥ kadrūrdākṣāyaṇī śivā ||
gāyatrī cātha sāvitrī kṛṣirvṛṣṭiḥ śrutiḥ kalā || 28 ||
balānāḍī tuṣṭikāṣṭhā rasanā ca sarasvatī ||
yatkiñcittriṣu lokeṣu bahutvādyanna kīrtitam || 29 ||
iṃgitaṃ neṃgitaṃ tacca tadrūpaṃ te sureśvari||
gandharvāḥ kinnarā devāḥ siddhavidyādharoragāḥ || 6.46.30 ||
yakṣaguhyakabhūtāśca daityā ye ca vināyakāḥ ||
tvatprasādena te sarve saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ || 31 ||
tathānye'pi bahutvādye na mayā parikīrtitāḥ ||
ārādhitāstu kṛcchreṇa pūjitāśca suvistaraiḥ ||
haraṃtu devatāḥ pāpamanye tvaṃ kīrtitā'pi ca || 32 ||
evaṃ stutā sā deveśī bhūbhujā tena bhāratī ||
yayau pratyakṣatāṃ tūrṇaṃ prāha cedaṃ suharṣitā || 33 ||
|| sarasvatyuvāca || ||
stotreṇānena bhūpāla bhaktyā susthirayā sadā ||
parituṣṭāsmi tenāśu varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam|| 34 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
adyaprabhṛti madvākyāttvayā stheyamasaṃśayam ||
atrārcāyāṃ trilokesmi nyāvatkīrtirmama sthirā || 35 ||
yastvāmārādhayetsamyagatrasthāṃ mannimittataḥ ||
bhaktyānurūpamevāśu tasmai deyaṃ tvayā hi tat || 36 ||
|| sarasvatyuvāca||
yo māmatra sthitāṃ nityaṃ snātvā'tra salile śubhe||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pūjayiṣyati mānavaḥ || 37 ||
tasyāhaṃ vāṃchitānkāmānsaṃpradāsyāmi pārthiva ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ tatra sthitā devī svayameva sarasvatī || 38||
tataḥprabhṛti lokānāṃ hitāya parameśvarī ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ || 39 ||
yastāṃ pūjayate martyaḥ śvetapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ||
sa syādvāggmī sumedhāvī sadā janmanijanmani ||6.46.40||
sarasvatyāḥ prasādena jāyamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ||
anvaye'pi na tasyaiva kaścinmūrkhaḥ prajāyate || 41 ||
yo dharmaśravaṇaṃ tasyāḥ purataḥ kurute naraḥ||
sa nūnaṃ vasati svarge tatprabhāvādyugatrayam||42||
vidyādānaṃ naro yaśca tasyā hyāyatane sadā ||
karoti śraddhayā yuktaḥ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||43||
yo yacchati dvijendrāya dharmaśāstrasamudbhavam||
pustakaṃ vājimedhasya sa samagraṃ phalaṃ labhet || 44 ||
yo vedādhyayanaṃ tasyāḥ karoti purataḥ sthitaḥ ||
so'gniṣṭomasya yajñasya kṛtsnaṃ phalamavāpnuyāt || 458 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sarasvatī tīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 || || cha ||

<6.47>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
mahākālasya māhātmyaṃ vistareṇa mahāmate ||
asmākaṃ sūtaja brūhi sarvaṃ vetti yato bhavān || 1 ||
||sūta uvāca || ||
āsītpūrvaṃ mahīpāla ikṣvākukulanandanaḥ ||
rudrasena iti khyātaḥ sarvaśatruniṣūdanaḥ || 2 ||
samudra iva gāṃbhīrye saumyatve śaśisaṃnibhaḥ ||
vīrye yathā sahasrākṣo rūpe kandarpasannibhaḥ || 3 ||
tasya kāṃtīti vikhyātā purī sarvaguṇānvitā ||
rājadhānyabhavacchreṣṭhā proccaprākāratoraṇā || 4 ||
tathaivāsītpriyā tasya bhāryā paramasaṃmatā ||
khyātā padmavatīnāma rūpaudārya guṇānvitā || 5 ||
sa tayā sahito rājā vaiśākhyā divase sadā ||
samabhyeti nijasthānātsainyenālpena saṃvṛtaḥ || 6 ||
camatkārapure kṣetre pīṭhe tatra dvijottamāḥ ||
mahākālasya devasya purato rātrijāgaram ||
karoti śraddhayā yuktaḥ sabhāryaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ || 7 ||
upavāsaparo bhūtvā dhyāyamāno maheśvaram ||
gītavādyena hṛdyena nṛtyena dvijasattamāḥ ||
dharmākhyānena viprāṇāṃ vedādhyayanavistaraiḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvā dhautāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ||
dadau dānāni viprebhyastapasvibhyo viśeṣataḥ || 9 ||
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyaśca tathānyebhyaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||
varṣevarṣe sadaivaṃ sa samabhyetya mahīpatiḥ ||
vaiśākhyāṃ jāgaraṃ tasya devasya purato'karot || 6.47.10 ||
yathāyathā sa bhūpālaḥ kurute rātrijāgaram ||
mahākālāgratastasya tathā vṛddhiḥ prajāyate || 11 ||
śatravo vilayaṃ yāṃti lakṣmīrvṛddhiṃ pragacchati ||
ekadā sa samāyātastatra yāvanmahīpatiḥ || 12 ||
tatraiva divase tāvanmahākālasya cāgrataḥ ||
apaśyadbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhānnānādigbhyaḥ samāgatān || 13 ||
vedādhyayanasaṃpannānvrataniṣṭhāparāyaṇān ||
eke tatra kathāścakruḥ supuṇyā brāhmaṇottamāḥ || 14 ||
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ tathā pare ||
tīrthānāṃ ca tathā cānye brahmarṣīṇāṃ tathā pare ||
yajñānāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ ca dvīpānāṃ ca manoharāḥ || 15 ||
atha tānpṛthivīpālaḥ sa praṇamya yathākramam ||
upaviṣṭaḥ sabhāmadhye taiḥ sarvaiścābhinaṃditaḥ || 16 ||
kasmiṃścidatha saṃprāpte kathāṃte te munīśvarāḥ ||
papracchurbhūmipālaṃ tu kautūhalasamanvitāḥ || 17 ||
vaiśākhīdivase rājaṃstvaṃ sadābhyetya dūrataḥ ||
varṣevarṣe'sya devasya purato rātrijāgaram || 18 ||
prakaroṣi prayatnena tyaktvānyāḥ sakalāḥ kriyāḥ ||
snānadānādikā yāśca nirdiṣṭāḥ śāstraciṃtakaiḥ || 19 ||
na te yadi rahasyaṃ syāttadā'śeṣaṃ prakīrtaya ||
nūnaṃ tvaṃ vetsi tatsarvaṃ yatphalaṃ rātrijāgare || 6.47.20 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ caiva yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
yuṣmābhiḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi tathāpyakhilameva hi || 210
ahamāsaṃ vaṇigjātyā purā vai vaidiśe pure ||
nirdhano baṃdhubhirmuktaḥ paribhūtaḥ padepade || 22 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ||
vaidiśe nākarodvṛṣṭiṃ sapta varṣāṇi paṃca ca || 23 ||
tato vṛṣṭinirodhena sarve lokāḥ kṣudhārdditāḥ ||
annābhāvānmṛtāḥ kecitkeciddeśāṃtare gatāḥ || 24 ||
tato'haṃ svāṃ samādāya patnīṃ kṣutkṣāmagātrikām ||
aśrupūrṇamukhīṃ dīnāṃ praskhalantīṃ padepade ||25||
saurāṣṭraṃ manasi dhyātvā prasthitastadanantaram ||
subhikṣaṃ lokataḥ śrutvā jīvanāya dvijottamāḥ ||26||
krameṇa gacchamāno'tha bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ ||
ānartaviṣayaṃ prāptaścamatkārapurāṃtike || 27 ||
tatra ramyaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ padminīkhaṇḍamaṃḍitam ||
saraḥ svacchodakāpūrṇaṃ jalapakṣibhirāvṛtam || 28 ||
tato'haṃ tatsamāsādya snātaḥ śītena vāriṇā ||
kṣudhārtaśca tṛṣārtaśca śramārtaśca viśeṣataḥ || 29 ||
athāhaṃ bhāryayā prokto gṛhāṇeśa jalāśayāt ||
jalajāni krayārthāya yena syādadya bhojanam || 6.47.30 ||
etatsaṃdṛśyate dūrātpuraṃdarapuropamam ||
puraśreṣṭhaṃ samāsādya vikrayaṃ kartumarhasi || 31 ||
tato mayā gṛhītāni padmāni dvijasattamāḥ ||
vikrayārthaṃ prabhūtāni vācchamānena bhojanam ||32||
camatkārapuraṃ prāpya tato'haṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
bhrāṃtastrikeṣu sarveṣu catvareṣu gṛheṣu ca || 33 ||
na kaścitpratigṛhṇāti tāni padmāni mānavaḥ ||
mama bhāgyavaśālloko jātaḥ krayaparāṅmukhaḥ ||34||
atha kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhasya śrāṃtasya mama bhāskaraḥ ||
astācalamanuprāptaḥ saṃdhyākālastato'bhavat || 35 ||
tato vairāgyamāpannaḥ supto'haṃ bhagnamaṃdire ||
tāni padmāni bhūpṛṣṭhe nidhāya saha bhāryayā| 36 ||
athārdharātre saṃprāpte śruto gītadhvanirmayā ||
tataśca ciṃtitaṃ citte jāgaro'yamasaṃśayam ||37||
tasmādgacchāmi cetkaścitpadmānyetāni me naraḥ ||
mūlyena pratigṛhṇāti bhojanaṃ jāyate tataḥ || 38 ||
evaṃ viniścayaṃ kṛtvā padmānyādāya satvaram||
sabhāryaḥ prasthitastatra yatra gītasya niḥsvanaḥ || 39 ||
tataścāyatane tasminprāpto'haṃ munipuṃgavāḥ ||
apaśyaṃ devadeveśaṃ mahākālaṃ prapūjitam ||
agrasthitairdvijaśreṣṭhairjapagītaparāyaṇaiḥ || 6.47.40 ||
eke nṛtyaṃ prakurvaṃti gītamanye japaṃ pare ||
anye homaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā dharmākhyānamathāpare || 41 ||
tataḥ kaścinmayā pṛṣṭaḥ kriyate jāgaro'tra kim ||
ka ete jāgarāsaktā lokāḥ kīrtaya me drutam || 42 ||
tenoktameṣa devasya mahākālasya jāgaraḥ ||
kriyate brāhmaṇairbhaktyā upavāsaparāyaṇaiḥ || 43 ||
adya puṇyatithirnāma vaiśākhī puṇyadā parā ||
yasyāmasya puro bhaktyā naraḥ kuryātprajāgaram ||
mahākālasya devasya saukhyaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 44 ||
saṃti padmāni me yaccha mūlyamādāya bhadraka ||
bhojanārthamahaṃ dadmi kaladhautapalatrayam || 45 ||
tato'vadhāritaṃ citte mayā brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
pūjayāmi mahākālaṃ padmairetaiḥ sureśvaram || 46 ||
na mayā sukṛtaṃ kiṃcidanyadehāṃtare kṛtam ||
niyataṃ tena saṃbhūta itthaṃbhūto'smi durgataḥ || 47 ||
paraṃ kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭheyaṃ bhāryā me priyavādinī ||
annābhāvānna saṃdehaḥ prātaryāsyati saṃkṣayam || 48 ||
evaṃ ciṃtayamānasya mama sā dayitā tataḥ ||
provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ vinayāvanatā sthitā ||49||
mā nātha kuru padmānāṃ vikrayaṃ dhanalobhataḥ ||
kuruṣva ca hitaṃ vākyaṃ yatte vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam || 6.47.50 ||
upavāso balājjātaḥ sasyābhāvādasaṃśayam ||
asmākaṃ jāgaraṃ cāpi bhaviṣyati bubhukṣayā || 51 ||
tatrobhābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ snānaṃ divā sarasi śobhane ||
gharmārttābhyāṃ śramārttābhyāṃ kṛtadevārcanaṃ tathā ||52||
tasmāddevaṃ mahākālaṃ pūjayāmo'dhunā vayam ||
padmairetaiḥ paraṃ śreya āvayoryena jāyate || 53 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
ubhābhyāmatha hṛṣṭābhyāṃ pūjito'yaṃ maheśvaraḥ ||
taiḥ padmaiḥ sattvamāsthāya kṛtvā pūjāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 54 ||
kṣutpīḍayā samāyātā naiva nidrā kathaṃcana ||
svalpāpi maṃdire cātra sthitayorharasannidhau ||55||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye prodgate ravimaṃḍale ||
mṛto'haṃ kṣudhayāviṣṭaḥ sthāne'traiva dvijottamāḥ || 56 ||
atha sā dayitā mahyaṃ tadādāya kalevaram||
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭā praviṣṭā havyavāhanam || 57 ||
tatprabhāvādahaṃ jātaḥ kāṃtīnātho mahīpatiḥ ||
daśārṇādhipateḥ kanyā sāpi jātismarā satī || 58 ||
tataḥ svayaṃvaraṃ prāptā māṃ vijñāya nijaṃ patim ||
mayāpi saiva vijñāya pūrvapatnī samāhṛtā || 59 ||
etasmātkāraṇādasya mahākālasya jāgaram ||
varṣevarṣe ca vaiśākhyāṃ karomi dvijasattamāḥ || 6.47.60 ||
anayā priyayā sārdhaṃ puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ||
pūjayitvā mahākālaṃ satyametanmayoditam || 61 ||
kṛto viprā mayā tveṣa sa tadā rātrijāgaraḥ ||
yathāpyetatphalaṃ jātaṃ devasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 62 ||
adhunā śraddhayā yukto yathoktavidhinā tataḥ ||
yatkaromi na jānāmi kiṃ me saṃyacchate phalam || 63 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā satyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
yena satyena tenaiṣa mahākālaḥ prasīdatu || 64 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etacchrutvā dvijaśreṣṭhā vismayotphullalocanāḥ ||
pracakrurjapatestasya sādhuvādānanekaśaḥ || 65 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
satyamuktaṃ mahīpāla tvayaitadakhilaṃ vacaḥ ||
mahākālaprasādena na kiṃciddurlabhaṃ bhuvi || 66 ||
tasmādviśeṣataḥ sarve varṣevarṣe vayaṃ nṛpa ||
kariṣyāmo'sya devasya śraddhayā rātrijāgaram || 67 ||
tataḥ sa pārthivaste ca sarva eva dvijātayaḥ ||
pracakrurjāgaraṃ tasya mahākālasya saṃnidhau ||68||
viśeṣāddharṣasaṃyuktā vividhairgītavādanaiḥ ||
dharmākhyānaiśca nṛtyaiśca vedoccāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
tadārabhya nṛpāḥ sarve pracakrurvismayānvitāḥ || 69 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale samutthāya sa bhūpatiḥ ||
pūjayitvā mahākālaṃ tāṃśca sarvāndvijottamān ||
anujñāpya yayau hṛṣṭaḥ sasainyaḥ svapuraṃ prati || 6.47.70 ||
tataḥ kālena saṃprāpya dehāntaṃ sa mahīpatiḥ ||
saṃprāptaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 71 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mahākālasamudbhavam ||
māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇa śreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam || 72 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mahākāle śvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 || ||

<6.48>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatraivāsya samuddeśe hariścaṃdrasya bhūpateḥ ||
āśramo 'sti suvikhyāto nānādrumasamāvṛtaḥ || 1 ||
yatra tena tapastaptaṃ saṃsthāpyomāmaheśvarau ||
yacchatā vividhaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo'bhivāṃchitam || 2 ||
āsīdrājā hariścaṃdrastriśaṃkutanayaḥ purā ||
ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmānsūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || 3 ||
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ dhruvam ||
tasmiñchāsati dharmeṇa na ca caurakṛtaṃ bhayam || 4 ||
kālavarṣī sadā meghaḥ sasyāni pracurāṇi ca ||
rasavaṃti ca toyāni sarvartuphalitā drumāḥ || 5 ||2
daṃḍastatrābhavadvāstau gṛharodho'kṣadevane ||
eko doṣākaraścaṃdraḥ priyadoṣāśca kauśikāḥ || 6 ||
snehakṣayaśca dīpeṣu vivāhe ca karagrahaḥ ||
vṛttabhaṃgastathā gadye dānotthitirgajānane || 7 ||
tasyaivaṃ guṇayuktasya sārvabhaumasya bhūpateḥ ||
eka eva mahānāsīddoṣaḥ putravivarjitaḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ putrakṛte gatvā cakāra sumahattapaḥ ||
camatkārapure kṣetre liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ ||9||
paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme varṣāsvākāśasaṃsthitaḥ ||
jalāśrayaśca hemaṃte sa dhyāyati maheśvaram || 6.48.10 ||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tasya tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ||
pratyakṣo'bhūtsamaṃ gauryā gaṇasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || 11 ||
uvāca varado'smīti prārthayasva yathepsitam ||
ahaṃ te saṃpradāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham||12||
tatastaṃ praṇipatyoccaiḥ stutvā sūktaiḥ śrutairapi ||
provāca vinayopetaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ || 13 ||
tvatprasādātsuraśreṣṭha yatkiṃciddharaṇītale ||
tadasti me gṛhe sarvaṃ vāṃchitaṃ svena cetasā || 14 ||
surūpāṇi kalatrāṇi rājyaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam ||
śarīraṃ roganirmuktaṃ saṃkhyāhīnaṃ tathā dhanam||15||
ekaṃ me sumahadduḥkhaṃ yadapatyaṃ na vidyate ||
tasmāddehi sutaṃ deva prasanno yadi śaṃkara ||16|| ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
acireṇa nṛpaśreṣṭha putrastava bhaviṣyati ||
matprasādānna saṃdehastasmādgaccha drutaṃ gṛham||17||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etasminnaṃtare gaurī kopasaṃraktalocanā ||
bhartsayitvā mahādevaṃ tataḥ provāca taṃ nṛpam ||18||
yasmāttvayā mahāmūrkha na praṇāmaḥ kṛto mama ||
harādanaṃtaraṃ tasmācchāpaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ tava || 19 ||
tava saṃlapsyate putro yathoktaḥ śūlapāṇinā ||
paraṃ tanmṛtyujaṃ duḥkhaṃ tvaṃ śiśutvepi lapsyase || 6.48.20 ||
evamuktvā bhagavatī sārdhaṃ devena śaṃbhunā ||
adarśanaṃ yayau paścāttathānyairapi pārśvagaiḥ|| 21 ||
so'pi rājā varaṃ labdhvā śāpaṃ ca tadanaṃtaram ||
na jagāma gṛhaṃ bhūyaścakāra sumahattapaḥ || 22 ||
ekāsanaṃ samārūḍhau kṛtvā gaurī maheśvarau ||
tataścārādhayāmāsa samaṃ puṣpānulepanaiḥ || 23 ||
viśeṣeṇa dadau dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo mahīpatiḥ ||
bhūmiśāyī praśāṃtātmā ṣaṣṭhakālakṛtāśanaḥ || 24 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
pārvatyā sahito bhūyastasya saṃdarśanaṃ gataḥ || 25 ||
tataḥ sa nṛpatistābhyāṃ yugapadvidhipūrvakam||
kṛtvā natiṃ tato vākyaṃ vinayādidamabravīt || 26 ||
purā devi mayānaṃdapūre vyākula cetasā ||
na natā tvaṃ na me kopaṃ tasmāttvaṃ kartumarhasi || 27 ||
dehārdhadhāriṇī devi sadā tvaṃ śūladhāriṇaḥ ||
tadaikasminnate kasmānna natā tvaṃ vadasva me || 28 ||
yastaṃ namati deveśaṃ tena tvaṃ sarvadā natā ||
natāyāṃ tvayi deveśo nataḥ syāditi me matiḥ 529 ||
tathāpi ca pṛthaktvena mayā tvaṃ tu natā saha ||
ekāsanaṃ samārūḍhā tatsamaṃ devi pūjitā || 6.48.30 ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yaḥ puroktaḥ purāriṇā ||
sostu vai saphalaḥ sadyo varaḥ putrakṛte mama || 31 ||
yayā vaṃśadharaḥ putro dīrghāyurdṛḍhavikramaḥ ||
tvatprasādādbhaveddevi tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi || 32 ||
|| śrīdevyuvāca || ||
nānyathā me vaco rājañjāyate'tra kathaṃcana ||
tasmādbālo'pi te putraḥ paṃcatvaṃ samupaiṣyati || 33 ||
darśayitvā tu te duḥkhamalpamṛtyusamudbhavam ||
bhūyaḥ saṃprāpsyati prāṇānacirānme prasādataḥ || 34 ||
bhaviṣyati ca dīrghāyustato vaṃśadharo jayī ||
sārvabhaumapradhānaśca dānī yajvā ca dharmavit || || 35 ||
tasmādrājangṛhaṃ gatvā kuru rājyamabhīpsitam ||
saṃprāpsyasi sutaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yādṛśaṃ kīrtitaṃ mayā || 36||
anyo'pi mānavo yo māṃ rūpeṇā nenasaṃsthitām ||
pūjayiṣyati cātraiva samaṃ devena śaṃbhunā || 37 ||
tasyāhaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi putrānhṛdayavāṃchitān ||
tathānyadapi yatkiṃcidacirānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 38 ||
śrīmahādeva uvāca || ||
bhūya eva nṛpaśreṣṭha mattaḥ prārthaya vāṃchitam ||
na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syātsatyametadbravīmi te || 39 ||
|| hariścaṃdra uvāca || ||
kṛtakṛtyosmi deveśa sarvamasti gṛhe mama ||
putraṃ tyaktvā tvayā so'pi datto vaṃśadharo jayī || 6.48.40 ||
tathāpi na tavādeśo vyarthaḥ kāryaḥ kathaṃcana ||
etasmātkāraṇāddeva yācayiṣyāmi vāṃchitam || 41 ||
rājasūyakṛte'smākaṃ sadā buddhiḥ pravartate ||
niṣedhayaṃti māṃ sarve mantriṇaḥ suhṛdastadā || 42 ||
sarvaistairjāyate yajñaḥ pārthivaiḥ karadīkṛtaiḥ ||
yuddhaṃ vinā karaṃ te'pi na yacchanti yato vibho || 43 ||
tato yuddhārthinaṃ māṃ te vārayaṃti hitaiṣiṇaḥ ||
kṛtotsāhaṃ makhaprāptau nītimārgasamāśritāḥ || 44 ||
tasmāttava prasādena rājasūyo bhavenmakhaḥ ||
avighnaḥ siddhimāyātu mama nānyadvṛṇomyaham ||45||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya jagāmādarśana haraḥ ||
so'pi labdhavaro bhūpaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ gataḥ || 46 ||
evaṃ tena narendreṇa pūrvaṃ tatra vinirmitau ||
umāmaheśvarau paścānnirmitāvitarairapi || 47 ||
yastābhyāṃ kurute pūjāṃ saṃprāpte paṃcamī dine ||
phalaiḥ sarveṣu gātreṣu yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ ||
sutaṃ prāpnoti so'bhīṣṭaṃ svavaṃśoddharaṇakṣamam || 48 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya umāmaheśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 48 || || || || 

<6.49>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatraivāsti mahāpuṇyo hradatīre vyavasthitaḥ ||
kalaśeśvara ityākhyaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 1 ||
dṛṣṭvā pramucyate pāpānmanuṣyaḥ kalaśeśvaram|| 2 ||
purāsītkalaśonāma yaduvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ||
yajvā dānapatirdakṣaḥ sarvalokahite rataḥ || 3 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya durvāsā muni sattamaḥ ||
cāturmāsyavrataṃ kṛtvā tadgṛhaṃ samupasthitaḥ || 4 ||
athotthāya nṛpastūrṇaṃ sammukhaḥ prayayau mudā ||
svāgataṃ svāgataṃ testu bruvāṇa iti sādaram || 5 ||
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ bhaktyā prakṣālya caraṇau svayam ||
dattvārghamiti hovāca harṣabāṣpākulekṣaṇaḥ || 6 ||
idaṃ rājyamamī putrā imā nārya idaṃ dhanam||
brūhi sarvaṃ mune tvaṃ ca tava kāryaṃ dadāmyaham || 7 ||
|| durvāsā uvāca || ||
yuktametanmahārāja vaktuṃ te kāryamīdṛśam ||
gṛhāgatāya viprāya vratine'smadvidhāya ca || 8 ||
na me kiñciddhanaiḥ kāryaṃ na rājyena nṛpottama ||
cāturmāsyavrato'to'haṃ pāraṇaṃ kartṛmutsahe || 9 ||
tasmādyatkiñcidannaṃ te siddhamasti gṛhe nṛpa ||
taddehi bhojanārthaṃ me bubhukṣātīva vardhate || 6.49.10 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālo yathāsiddhaṃ susaṃskṛm ||
annaṃ bhojyakṛte tasmai pradadau svayameva hi || 11 ||
vyañjanāni vicitrāṇi pakvānnāni bahūni ca ||
peyaṃ coṣyaṃ ca khādyaṃ ca lehyamannamanekadhā ||
tathā māṃsaṃ vicitraṃ ca lavaṇādyaiḥ susaṃskṛtam || 12 ||
athāsau bubhuje vipraḥ kṣutkṣāmastvarayānvitaḥ ||
avindanna rasāsvādaṃ bṛhadgrāsairmudānvitaḥ || 13 ||
atha tṛptena māṃsasya jñātastena raso dvijāḥ ||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā taṃ śaśāpa munīśvaraḥ || 14 ||
yasmānmāṃsaṃ tvayā dattvā vratabhaṃgaḥ kṛto mama ||
tasmāttvamāmiṣāhāro raudro vyāghro bhaviṣyasi || 15 ||
tataḥ sa bhūpatirbhītaḥ praṇamya ca munīśvaram ||
provāca dīnavadano vepamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ || 16 ||
tava kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhasya mayā bhaktiḥ kṛtā mune ||
yathāsiddhena bhojyena tatkasmācchaptumudyataḥ || 17 ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me bhaktasya vinatasya ca ||
śāpasyānugraheṇaiva śīghraṃ brāhmaṇasattama || 18 ||
|| durvāsā uvāca || ||
muktvā śrāddhaṃ tathā yajñaṃ na māṃsaṃ bhakṣayeddvijaḥ ||
viśeṣeṇa vratasyāṃte cāturmāsyodbhavasya ca || 19 ||
upavāsaparo bhūtvā māṃsamaśnāti yo dvijaḥ ||
vṛthāmāṃsādvṛthā tasya tadvrataṃ jāyate dhruvam || 6.49.20 ||
tasmādvrataṃ praṇaṣṭaṃ me cāturmāsyasamudbhavam ||
tena śapto'si rājeṃdra mayā kopena sāṃpratam || 21 ||
||rājovāca || ||
tathāpi kuru me vipra śāpasyāṃtaṃ yathepsitam ||
bhaktiyuktasya dīnasya nirdoṣasya viśeṣataḥ || 22||
|| durvāsā uvāca || ||
yadā te naṃdinī dhenurliṃgaṃ bāṇārcitaṃ purā ||
darśayiṣyati te muktistadā tūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati || 23 ||
evamuktvā sa viprendro jagāma nijamāśramam ||
babhūva so'pi bhūpālo vyāghro raudratamākṛtiḥ || 24 ||
naṣṭasmṛtistatastūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā jaṃtūnpuraḥsthitān ||
jaghānoccāṭitonyaiśca praviveśa mahāvanam || 25 ||
atha te maṃtriṇastasya śāpasyātaṃ mahīpateḥ ||
vāṃchatastasya tadrājyaṃ cakrureva surakṣitam || 26 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kalaśeśvarākhyāne kalaśanṛpaterdurvāsasaḥ śāpena vyāghratvaprāptivarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 || || ||

<6.50>

evaṃ tasya narendrasya vyāghrarūpasya kānane ||
jagāma sumahānkālo nighnato vividhāndvija || 1 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya tasmindeśe dvijottamāḥ ||
ā yātaṃ gokulaṃ ramyaṃ gopagopīsamākulam || 2 ||
tatrāsti nandinīnāma dhenuḥ pīnapayodharā ||
vistīrṇajaghanābhogā haṃsavarṇā ghaṭasravā || 3 ||
atha sā nijayūthasya sadāgre tṛṇavāṃchayā ||
bhramamāṇā nikuñjāṃte liṃgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ || 4 ||
apaśyattejasā yuktaṃ svayameva vyavasthitam ||
dvādaśārkapratīkāśaṃ cittāhlādakaraṃ param || 5 ||
tatastasyopari sthitvā susrāva sumahatpayaḥ ||
śraddhayā parayā yuktā tasya snānakṛte dvijāḥ || 6 ||
evaṃ tāṃ snapanaṃ tasya sadā liṃgasya kurvatīm ||
na jānāti janaḥ kaścidvane vṛkṣasamākule || 7 ||
anyasmindivase tatra sthāne vyāghraḥ samāgataḥ ||
tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro mahākāyaḥ sarvajantubhayāvahaḥ || 8 ||
atha sā tatra āyātā patitā dṛṣṭigocare ||
nandinī dvīpinastasya daivayogāddvijottamāḥ || 9 ||
tataḥ sā gokule baddhaṃ smṛtvā svaṃ laghuvatsakam ||
atṛṇādaṃ payovṛttiṃ karuṇaṃ paryadevayat || 6.50.10 ||
adyaikāhaṃ ca saṃprāptā kānane janavarjite ||
putraṃ bālaṃ parityajya gopairgoṣṭhe niyaṃtritam || 11 ||
yena satyena bhaktyādya snapanāyāhamāgatā ||
śivasya tena satyena bhūyānme sutasaṃgamaḥ || 12 ||
evaṃ sā karuṇaṃ yāvannandinī vilapatyalam||
tāvadvyāghraḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā provāca paruṣākṣaram || 13 ||
|| vyāghra uvāca || ||
pralāpānkiṃ mudhā dheno karoṣi vaśagā mama ||
tasmādiṣṭatamaṃ devaṃ smara svargakṛte śubhe || 14 ||
|| dhenuruvāca || ||
nāhamātmakṛte vyāghra vilapāmi suduḥ khitā ||
śivārcanakṛte mṛtyurmama jātaḥ śubhāvahaḥ || 15 ||
vatso me gokule baddhaḥ smaramāṇo mamāgamam ||
santiṣṭhate payovṛttiḥ kathaṃ syātsa mayā vinā || 16 ||
etasmātkāraṇādvyāghra vilapāmi suduḥkhitā ||
na cātmajīvanārthāya satyenātmānamālabhe || 17 ||
tasmānmuṃca mahāvyāghra māṃ sadyaḥ sutavatsalām ||
sakhījanasya taṃ dattvā samāgacchāmi teṃtikam || 18 ||
|| vyāghra uvāca || ||
kathaṃ mṛtyumukhaṃ prāpya niṣkramya ca kathañcana || bhūyastatraiva niryāsi tasmāttvāṃ bhakṣayāmyaham || 19 ||
|| nandinyuvāca || ||
śapathairāgamiṣyāmi yaiḥ punarvyāghra teṃ'tikam ||
tānākarṇaya me vaktrāttato yuktaṃ samācara || 6.50.20 ||
yatpāpaṃ brahmahatyāyāṃ mātāpitrośca vaṃcane ||
tena pāpena lipyehaṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi || 21 ||
vivastraṃ snānasaktānāṃ divāmaithunagāminām ||
yatpāpaṃ tena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi || 22 ||
rajasvalānusaktānāṃ yatpāpaṃ nagnaśāyinām ||
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi || 23 ||
viśvāsaghātakānāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ ca yadbhavet ||
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi || || 24 ||
gokanyābrāhmaṇānāṃ ca dūṣakānāṃ ca yadbhavet ||
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi || 25 ||
vṛthāpākaprakartṛṇāṃ vṛthāmāṃsāśināṃ ca yat ||
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi || 26 ||
vratabhaṃgaprakartṛṇāmanṛtau gāmināṃ ca yat ||
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi || || 27 ||
paiśunyasūcakānāṃ ca yatpāpaṃ śastrakarmaṇām||
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgacchāmi punaryadi || 28 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāharasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kalaśeśvaramāhātmye govyāghrasaṃvādavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 50 ||cha||

<6.51>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha tācchapathāñchrutvā sa vyāghro vismayānvitaḥ ||
satyaṃ matvā punaḥ prāha nandinīṃ putravatsalām || 1 ||
yadyevaṃ tadgṛhaṃ gaccha vīkṣayasva nijātmajam||
sakhīnāmarpayitvātha bhūya āgamanaṃ kuru || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
iti vyāghravacaḥ śrutvā suśīlā nandinī tadā ||
gatālayaṃ samuddiśya yatra bālaḥ sutaḥ sthitaḥ|| 3 ||
athākālāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā mātaraṃ trastacetasam||
raṃbhamāṇāṃ samālokya vatsaḥ provāca vismayāt ||4||
kasmāt prāptāsyakāle tu kasmādudbhrāṃtamānasā ||
vāṣpaklinnamukhī kasmādvada mātardrutaṃmama || 5 ||
|| naṃdinyuvāca || ||
yadi pṛcchasi māṃ putra stanapānaṃ samācara ||
yena tṛptasya te sarvaṃ vṛttāṃtaṃ tadvadāmyaham || 6 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
so'pi tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pītvā kṣīraṃ yathocitam ||
āghrātaśca tayā mūrdhni tataḥ provāca satvaram || 7 ||
sarvaṃ kīrtaya vṛttāṃtamadyāraṇyasamudbhavam ||
yena me jāyate svāsthyaṃ śrutvā mātastavāsyataḥ || 8 ||
|| naṃdinyuvāca || ||
ahaṃ gatā mahāraṇye hyadya putra yathecchayā ||
vyāghreṇāsāditā tatra bhramamāṇā itastataḥ || 9 ||
sa mayā prārthitaḥ putra bhakṣamāṇo nakhāyudhaḥ ||
śapathairāgamiṣyāmi gokule vīkṣya cātmajam||6.51.10||
sāhaṃ tena vinirmuktā śapathairbahubhiḥ kṛtaiḥ ||
bhūyastatraiva yāsyāmi dṛṣṭaḥ saṃbhāṣito bhavān || 11 ||
|| vatsa uvāca || ||
ahaṃ tatraiva yāsyāmi yatra tvaṃ hi pragacchasi ||
ślāghyaṃ hi maraṇaṃ samyaṅmāturagre mamādhunā || 12 ||
ekākināpi martavyaṃ tvayā hīnena vai mayā ||
vināpi kṣīrapānena svalpena samayena tu || 13 ||
yadi mātastvayā sārdhaṃ vyāghro māṃ sūdayiṣyati ||
yā gatirmātṛbhaktānāṃ sā me nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati || 14 ||
athavā ye tvayā tasya vihitāḥ śapathāḥ śubhe ||
te saṃtu mama tiṣṭha tvaṃ tasmādatraiva gokule || || 15 ||
nāsti mātṛsamo bandhurbālānāṃ kṣīrajīvinām ||
nāsti mātṛsamo nātho nāsti mātṛsamā gatiḥ || 16 ||
nāsti mātṛsamaḥ pūjyo nāsti mātṛsamaḥ sakhā ||
nāsti mātṛsamo deva iha loke paratra ca || 17 ||
evaṃ matvā sadā mātuḥ kartavyā bhaktiruttamaiḥ ||
tamenaṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ prajāpativinirmitam ||
anutiṣṭhaṃti ye putrāste yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 18 ||
tasmādahaṃ gamiṣyāmi tvaṃ ca tiṣṭhātra gokule ||
ātmaprāṇaistava prāṇānrakṣayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 19 ||
|| naṃdinyuvāca || ||
mamaiva vihito mṛtyurna te putrādya vāsare ||
tatkathaṃ mama jīvaṃ tvaṃ rakṣasyasubhirātmanaḥ || || 6.51.20 ||
apaścimamidaṃ putra mātṛsaṃdiṣṭamuttamam ||
tvayā kāryaṃ prayatnena madvākyamanutiṣṭhatā || 21 ||
bhramamāṇo vane putra mā pramādaṃ kariṣyasi ||
lobhātsaṃjāyate nāśa ihaloke paratra ca || 22 ||
samudramaṭavīṃ yuddhaṃ viśaṃte lobhamohitāḥ ||
iha tannāsti lobhena yatra kurvaṃti mānavāḥ || 23 ||
lobhātpramādādviśraṃbhātpuruṣo vadhyate tribhiḥ ||
tasmāllobho na kartavyo na pramādo na viśvaset || 24 ||
ātmā putra tvayā rakṣyaḥ sarvadaiva praya tnataḥ ||
sarvebhyaḥ śvāpadebhyaśca bhramatā gahane vane || 25 ||
viṣamasthaṃ tṛṇānnādyaṃ kathaṃcitputraka tvayā ||
naikākinā pragaṃtavyaṃ yūthaṃ tyaktvā nijaṃ kvacit || 26 ||
evaṃ saṃbhāṣya taṃ vatsamavalihya muhurmuhuḥ ||
śokena mahatāviṣṭā bāṣpavyākulalocanā || 27 ||
tataḥ sakhījanaṃ sarvaṃ gatā draṣṭuṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
nandinīṃ putraśokena pīḍitāṃgī suvihvalā || 28 ||
tataḥ provāca tāḥ sarvā gatvā'raṇyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
caraṃtīḥ svecchayā hṛṣṭā vāṃchitāni tṛṇāni tāḥ ||29 ||
bahule caṃpake dāme vasudhāre ghaṭasrave ||
haṃsanādi priyānaṃde śubhakṣīre mahodaye || 6.51.30 ||
tathānyā dhenavo yāśca saṃsthitā gokulāṃtike ||
śṛṇvaṃtu vacanaṃ mahyaṃ kurvaṃtu ca tataḥ param ||
adyāhaṃ nijayūthasya bhramaṃtī nātidūrataḥ || 31 ||
tataśca gahanaṃ prāptā vanaṃ mānuṣavarjitam ||
vyāghreṇāsāditā tatra bhramaṃtī tṛṇavāṃchayā || 32 ||
yuṣmākaṃ darśanārthāya sutasaṃbhāṣaṇāya ca ||
saṃprāptā śapathaiḥ kṛcchrāttaṃ viśvāsya nakhāyudham || 33 ||
dṛṣṭaḥ saṃbhāṣitaḥ putraḥ śāsitaśca mayā hi saḥ ||
adhunā bhavatīnāṃ ca pradattaḥ putrako yathā || 34 ||
ajñānājjñānato vāpi bhavatīnāṃ mayā kṛtam ||
yatkiṃcidduṣkṛtaṃ bhadrāstatkṣaṃtavyaṃ prasādataḥ ||35||
anātho hyabalo dīnaḥ kṣīrapo mama bālakaḥ ||
mātṛśokābhisaṃtaptaḥ pālyaḥ sarvābhireva saḥ || 36 ||
bhramamāṇo'same sthāne vrajamāno'nyagokule ||
akāryeṣu ca saṃsakto nivāryaḥ sarvadā''darāt || 37 ||
ahaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi sa vyāghro yatra saṃsthitaḥ ||
apaścimapraṇāmo'yaṃ sarvāsāṃ vihito mayā || 38 ||
|| dhenava ūcuḥ || ||
na gaṃtavyaṃ tvayā tatra kathaṃcidapi naṃdini ||
āpaddharmaṃ na vetsi tvaṃ nūnaṃ yena pragacchasi || 39 ||
na narmayuktaṃ vacanaṃ hinasti na strīṣu jātirna vivāhakāle ||
prāṇātyaye sarvadhanāpahāre paṃcānṛtānyāhurapātakāni || 6.51.40 ||
tasmāttatra na gaṃtavyaṃ doṣo nāstyatra te śubhe ||
pālayasva nijaṃ putraṃ vrajāsmābhirnijaṃ gṛham || || 41 ||
|| naṃdinyuvāca || ||
pareṣāṃ prāṇayātrārthaṃ tatkartuṃ yujyate śubhāḥ ||
ātmaprāṇahitārthāya na sādhūnāṃ praśasyate || 42 ||
satye pratiṣṭhito loko dharmaḥ satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
udadhiḥ satyavākyena maryādāṃ na vilaṃghayet || 43 ||
viṣṇave pṛthivīṃ dattvā baliḥ pātālamāśritaḥ ||
satyavākyaṃ samāśritya na niṣkrāmati daityapaḥ || 44 ||
yaḥ svaṃ vākyaṃ pratijñāya na karoti yathoditam ||
kiṃ tena na kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ caureṇākṛta buddhinā || 45 ||
|| sakhya ūcuḥ || ||
tvaṃ naṃdini namaskāryā sarverapi surāsuraiḥ ||
yā tvaṃ satyapratiṣṭhārthaṃ prāṇāṃstyajasi dustyajān || 46 ||
kiṃ tvāṃ kalyāṇi vakṣyāmaḥ svayaṃ dharmārthavādinīm ||
savareṃpi guṇairyuktā nityaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitām || 47 ||
tasmādgaccha mahābhāge na śocyaḥ putrakastava ||
bhavatyā yadvayaṃ proktāstatkariṣyāma eva hi || 48 ||
etatpunarvayaṃ vidmaḥ sadā satyavatāṃ nṛṇām ||
na niṣphalaḥ kriyāraṃbhaḥ kathaṃcidapi jāyate || 49 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ saṃbhāṣya taṃ sarvaṃ naṃdinī svasakhījanam ||
prasthitā vyāghramuddiśya putraśokena pīḍitā || 6.51.50 ||
śokāgnināpi saṃtaptā nirāśā putradarśane ||
viyuktā cakravākīva lateva patitā taroḥ || 51 ||
aṃdheva dṛṣṭinirmuktā praskhalaṃtī padepade ||
vanādhidevatāḥ sarvāḥ prā'rthayacca sutārthataḥ || 52 ||
prasuptaṃ bhramamāṇaṃ vā mama putraṃ subālakam ||
vanādhidevatāḥ sarvā rakṣaṃtu vacanānmama || 53 ||
evaṃ pralapya manasā saṃprāptā tatra yatra saḥ ||
āste visphūrjitāsyaśca tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro bhayāvahaḥ || 54 ||
vyāghraḥ kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhaśca tasyā mārgāvalokakaḥ ||
saṃraṃbhāṭopasaṃyuktaḥ sṛkkiṇī parilehayan || 55 ||
|| naṃdinyuvāca || ||
āgatāhaṃ mahāvyāghra satye ca śapathe sthitā ||
kuru tṛptiṃ yathākāmaṃ mama māṃsena sāṃpratam || 56 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā so'pi duṣṭātmā vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||
satyāśayā punaḥ prāptā saṃtyajya prāṇajaṃ bhayam || 57 ||
|| vyāghra uvāca || ||
svāgataṃ tava kalyāṇi sudheno satyavādini ||
na hi satyavatāṃ kiṃcidaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit || 58 ||
tvayoktaṃ śapathairbhadre āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ ||
tena me kautukaṃ jātaṃ kimeṣā prakariṣyati || 59 ||
so'haṃ bhadre durācāro nṛśaṃso jīvaghātakaḥ ||
yāsyāmi narakaṃ ghoraṃ karmaṇānena sarvadā || 6.51.60 ||
tasmāttvaṃ me mahābhāge pāpāsyātidurātmanaḥ ||
upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 61 ||
yena me syātparaṃ śreya iha loke paratra ca ||
na te'styaviditaṃ kiṃcitsatyācārānmatirmama || 62 ||
tasmāttvaṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ saṃkṣepānmama kīrtaya ||
satsaṃgamaphalaṃ yena mama saṃjāyate'khilam|| 63 ||
|| naṃdinyuvāca || ||
tapaḥ kṛte praśaṃsaṃti tretāyāṃ dhyānameva ca ||
dvāpare yajñayogaṃ ca dānamekaṃ kalau yuge ||
sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ nāsti dānamataḥ param || 64 ||
carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāmabhayaṃ yaḥ prayacchati ||
sa sarvabhayanirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmā dhigacchati || 65 ||
|| vyāghra uvāca || ||
anyeṣāṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ taddānaṃ yujyate śubhe ||
ahiṃsayā bhavedyeṣāṃ prāṇayātrānnapūrvakam || 66 ||
na hiṃsayā vinā'smākaṃ yataḥ syātprāṇadhāraṇam ||
tasmādbrūhi mahābhāge kiñcinmama sukhāvaham ||
upadeśaṃ sudharmāya hiṃsakasyāpi dehinām || || 67 ||
|| nandinyuvāca || ||
atrāsti sumahalliṃgaṃ purā bāṇapratiṣṭhitam ||
gahane yatprabhāvena tvayā muktāsmyahaṃ dhruvam || 68 ||
tasya tvaṃ prātarutthāya kuru nityaṃ pradakṣiṇām ||
praṇāmaṃ ca tataḥ siddhiṃ vāṃchitāṃ samavāpsyasi || 69 ||
nānyasya karmaṇaḥ śaktirvidyate te nakhāyudha ||
pūjādikasya hīnatvāddhastābhyāmiti me matiḥ || 6.51.70 ||
evamuktvātha sā dhenurvyāghrasyātha vanāṃtike ||
talliṃgaṃ darśayāmāsa puraḥ sthitvā dvijottamāḥ || 71 ||
so'pi saṃdarśanāttasya tatkṣaṇānmuktimāptavān ||
vyāghratvātpārthivo bhūyaḥ sa babhūva yathā purā || 72 ||
śāpaṃ durvāsasā dattaṃ rājyaṃ svaṃ sahitaiḥ sutaiḥ ||
sasmāra sa nṛpaśreṣṭhastataḥ provāca naṃdinīm || 73 ||
nṛpaḥ kalaśanāmāhaṃ haihayānvayasaṃbhavaḥ ||
śapto durvāsasā pūrvaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare || 74 ||
tataḥ prasāditenoktastenāhaṃ naṃdinī yadā ||
darśayiṣyati talliṃgaṃ tadā muktirbhaviṣyati || 75 ||
sā nūnaṃ nandinī tvaṃ hi jñātā śāpāntato mayā ||
tattvaṃ brūhi pradeśo'yaṃ katamo varadhenuke || 76 ||

teṣāṃ tvaṃ pārthivaśreṣṭha saṃspṛṣṭo brahmahatyayā || 76 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
tadarthaṃ dehi me vipra prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye ||
yena nirmuktapāpo'haṃ rājyaṃ prāpnomi cātmanaḥ || 77 ||
|| vasiṣṭha uvāca || ||
atrārthe tīrthayātrāṃ tvaṃ kuru pārthiva sattama ||
nirmamo nirahaṃkārastataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi || 78 ||
tataḥ sa pārthivaśreṣṭhaḥ saṃyatātmā jiteṃdriyaḥ ||
prayāgādiṣu tīrtheṣu snānaṃ cakre samā hitaḥ || 79 ||
na naśyati sa durgaṃdho na ca tejaḥ pravardhate ||
na kāyo laghutāṃ yāti nālasyena vimucyate || 6.53.80 ||
tataḥ saṃbhramamāṇaśca kadāci ddvijasattamāḥ ||
camatkārapure kṣetre snānārthaṃ samupāgataḥ || 81 ||
suśrāṃtaḥ kṣutpipāsārto niśīthe tamasāvṛte ||
gartāyāṃ patito'kasmātpūrṇāyāṃ payasā nṛpaḥ || 82 ||
kṛcchrāttato viniṣkrāṃtastīrthāttasmānmahīpatiḥ ||
yāvatpaśyati cātmānaṃ dvādaśārkasamaprabham || 83 ||
durgaṃdhena parityaktaṃ sodyamaṃ laghutāṃ gatam ||
dṛṣṭvā ca ciṃtayāmāsa nūnaṃ mukto'smi pātakāt || 84 ||
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ||
harṣayantī mahīpālaṃ vimuktaṃ brahmahatyayā ||85||
vimukto'si mahārāja sāṃprataṃ pūrvapātakaiḥ ||
tīrthasyāsya prabhāvena tasmādgaccha nijaṃ gṛham|| 86 ||
atra saṃnihito nityaṃ bhrūṇarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa caturdaśyāṃ mahīpate || 87 ||
yadā prapatitaṃ liṃgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||
dvijaśāpena gartaiṣā tadānena vinirmitā || 88 ||
lajjitena svavāsārthaṃ mahadduḥkhayutena ca ||
satīviyogayuktena bhrūṇatvaṃ pragatena ca || 89 ||
sarvapāpaharā tena garteyaṃ pṛthi vīpate ||
bhrūṇagarteti vikhyātā tasya nāmā jagattraye || 6.53.90 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvātha sā vāṇī virarāmāṃ'tarikṣagā ||
so'pi pārthivaśārdūlaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ svapuraṃ yayau || 91 ||
tatastaṃ pāpanirmuktaṃ tejasā bhāskaropamam ||
dṛṣṭvā putrāstathā martyāḥ praṇemustuṣṭisaṃyutāḥ || 92 ||
so'pi brāhmaṇaśārdūlo vasiṣṭhastaṃ mahīpatim||
samabhyetya tataḥ prāha harṣagadgadayā girā || 93 ||
diṣṭyā muktosi rājeṃdra pāpādbrahmavadhodbhavāt ||
diṣṭyā tvaṃ tejasā yuktaḥ punaḥ prāpto nijaṃ puram || 94 ||
tasmātkīrtaya bhūpāla kasmiṃstīrthe samāgataḥ ||
tvaṃ muktaḥ pātakādghorādbrahmahatyāsamudbhavāt || 95 ||
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa bhrūṇagartāsamudbhavam ||
vṛttāṃtaṃ tasya viprarṣeranubhūtaṃ yathā tathā || 96 ||
tataste maṃtriṇo vṛddhāḥ sa ca rājā munīśvaraḥ ||
putraṃ pratardanaṃnāma rājye saṃsthāpya tatkṣaṇāt || 97 ||
bhrūṇagartāṃ samāsādya tāmeva dvijasattamāḥ ||
tapaścerurmahādevaṃ dhyāyamānā divā niśam || 98||
gatāśca paramāṃ siddhiṃ kālenālpena durlabhām ||
bhrūṇarūpadharaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā maheśvaram || 99 ||
tataḥprabhṛti sā gartā prakhyātā dharaṇītale ||
bhrūṇagarteti vipreṃdrāḥ sarvapātakanāśinī || 6.53.100 ||
tatra kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ||
sa pitṝṃstārayennūnaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśā parān|| 101 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra śrāddhaṃ samācaret ||
snānaṃ ca brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā dānaṃ vāpi svaśaktitaḥ || 102 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bhrūṇagartāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 || || dha || ||

<6.54>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
carmamuṃḍā tathā devī tasminsthāne vyavasthitā ||
nalena sthāpitā pūrvaṃ svayameva mahātmanā || 1 ||
abhyarcayati tāṃ bhaktyā yo mahānavamī dine ||
sa kāmānvāṃchitām̐llabdhvā padaṃ prāpnoti śāśvatam || 2 ||
vīrasenasutaḥ pūrvaṃ nalonāma mahīpatiḥ ||
āsītsarvaguṇopetaḥ sarva śatrukṣayāvahaḥ || 3 ||
bhāryā tasyābhavatsādhvī prāṇebhyopi garīyasī ||
damayaṃtīti vikhyātā vidarbhādhipateḥ sutā || 4 ||
athāsau kalināviṣṭo dyūtaṃ cakre mahīpatiḥ ||
puṣkareṇa samaṃ viprā dāyādena divāniśam || 5 ||
tataḥ sa vyasanāsakto vāryamāṇo'pi sajjanaiḥ ||
hārayāmāsa saptāṃgaṃ rājyaṃ muktvā ca tāṃ priyām || 6 ||
atha tāṃ sa samādāya praviṣṭo gahanaṃ vanam ||
nirjalaṃ lajjayāviṣṭo duḥkhavyākuliteṃdriyaḥ || 7 ||
tataḥ sa ciṃtayāmāsa yadyeṣā bhīmamaṃdire ||
yāti tanmucyate kaṣṭādvanavāsasamudbhavāt || 8 ||
na mayā tatra gaṃtavyaṃ kathaṃcidapi māninā ||
tasmādenāṃ parityajya rātrau gacchāmi dūrataḥ || 9 ||
yena tyaktā mayā sādhvī kuṇḍinaṃ yāti tatpuram ||
sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā sukhasuptāṃ vihāya tām ||
prajagāma vanaṃ ghoraṃ vanyaśvāpadasaṃkulam|| 6.54.10 ||
pratyūṣe cāpi sotthāya yāvatpaśyati bhābhinī ||
tāvatpaśyatiśūnyaṃ svaṃ pārśvaṃ yatra nalaḥ sthitaḥ || 11 ||
tato vilapya duḥkhārtā karuṇaṃ tatra kānane ||
jagāma mārgamāśrittha piturharmyaṃ śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 12 ||
nalo'pi ca vane tasminbhramamāṇo mahīpatiḥ ||
ekākī vṛkṣakuṃjāni sevayāmāsa sarvadā || 13 ||
tatastadvanamutsṛjya jagāmānyanmahāvanam ||
nānāvṛkṣagaṇairyuktaṃ bahuśvāpadasaṃkulam || 14 ||
evaṃ sa pṛthivīpālo bhramamāṇovanādvanam ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetramāsasāda tataḥ param || 15 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptaṃ tanmahānavamīdinam ||
viśeṣādyatra bhūpālāḥ pūjayanti sureśvarīm || 16 ||
tataḥ sa mṛnmayīṃ kṛtvā carmamuḍadharāṃ nṛpaḥ ||
vibhavābhāvataḥ paścātphalamūlairatarpayat || 17 ||
tatastasyāḥ stutiṃ kṛtvā puraḥ sthitvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||
śraddhayā parayā yukto niṣadhādhipatiḥ svayam || 18 ||
jaya sarvagate devi carmamuṇḍadhare vare ||
jaya daityakulocchedadakṣe dakṣātmaje śubhe || 19 ||
kālarātri jayācintye navamyaṣṭamivallabhe ||
trinetre tryaṃbakābhīṣṭe jaya devi surārcite|| || 6.54.20 ||
bhīmarūpe surūpe ca mahāvidye mahābale ||
mahodaye mahākāye jayadevi mahāvrate || 21 ||
nityarūpe jagaddhātri surāmāṃsavasāpriye ||
vikarāli mahākāli jaya pretajanānuge || 22 ||
śavayānarate ramye bhujaṃgābharaṇānvite ||
pāśahaste mahāhaste rudhiraughakṛtāspade || 23 ||
phetkārā ravaśobhiṣṭhe gītavādyavirājite ||
jayānādye jaya dhyeye bhargadehārdhasaṃśraye || 24 ||
tvaṃ ratistvaṃ dhṛtistuṣṭistvaṃ gaurī tvaṃ sureśvarī ||
tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ ca sāvitrī gāyatrī tvamasaṃśayam || 25 ||
yatkiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu strīrūpaṃ devi dṛśyate ||
tatsarvaṃ tvanmayaṃ nātra vikalpo'sti mama kvacit || 26 ||
yena satyena tena tvamatrāvāsaṃ drutaṃ kuru ||
sānnidhyaṃ bhaktitastuṣṭā surāsuranamaskṛte || 27 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ stutā ca sā devī nalena pṛthivībhujā ||
provāca darśanaṃ gatvā taṃ nṛpaṃ bhaktavatsalā || 28 ||
|| śrīdevyuvāca || ||
parituṣṭā'smi te vatsa stotreṇānena sāṃpratam ||
tasmādgṛhāṇa mattastvaṃ varaṃ manasi saṃsthitam || 29 ||
|| nala uvāca || ||
damayantīti me bhāryā prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ||
sā mayā nirjane muktā
vane vyālagaṇānvite || 6.54.30 ||
akhaṇḍaśīlāṃ nirdoṣāṃ yathāhaṃ tvatprasādataḥ ||
labhe bhūyo'pi tāṃ devi tathātra kuru satvaram || 31 ||
stotreṇānena yo devi stutiṃ kuryātpurastava ||
tatraiva divase tasmai tvayā deyaṃ manogatam || 32 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sā tatheti pratijñāya jagāmādarśanaṃ tataḥ ||
so'pi pārthivaśārdūlo lebhe sarvaṃ tayoditam || 33 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nalanirmitacarmamuṇḍāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 || ||

<6.55>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasyā eva samīpasthaṃ devudevaṃ naleśvaram ||
dṛṣṭvā vimucyute pāpātsthāpitaṃ nalabhūbhujā || 1 ||
yastaṃ paśyennaro bhaktyā māghe ṣaṣṭhyāṃ site dvijāḥ ||
sarva rogavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam || 2 ||
kaṇḍūḥ pāmātha dadrūṇi maṃḍalāni vicarcikā ||
darśanāttasya naśyanti jantūnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 3||
asti tasyāgrataḥ kuṇḍaṃ svacchodakasupūritam||
matsyakūrmasamākīrṇaṃ padminīkhaṃḍamaṃḍitam || 4 ||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ pratyūṣe somavāsare ||
api kuṣṭhāmayamastaḥ sa bhūyaḥ syātpunarnavaḥ || 5 ||
yadā saṃsthāpitaḥ śaṃbhurnalena pṛthivībhujā ||
tadā tuṣṭena sa prokto brūhi kiṃ te karomyaham || 6 || ||
|| nala uvāca || ||
atra stheyaṃ tvayā deva sadā sannihitena ca ||
sarvalokahitārthāya roganāśāya śaṃkara || 7 ||
|| śaṃkara uvāca || ||
ahaṃ tvadvacanādrājansaṃprāpte somavāsare ||
pratyūṣe ca nivatsyāmi prāsāde nātra saṃśayaḥ || 8 ||
māghāṣṭamyāmahorātraṃ sakalaṃ ca mahīpate 0|
prāṇināṃ roganāśāya śuklapakṣeviśeṣataḥ || 9 ||
yo māmatra sthitaṃ tatra divase vīkṣayiṣyati ||
snātvā suvimale kuṃḍe samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
tasya nāśaṃ prayāsyaṃti vyādhayo gātrasaṃbhavāḥ || 6.55.10 ||
yo'sya kuṃḍasya saṃbhūtāṃ mṛttikāmapi mānavaḥ ||
saṃdhāsyati nije dehe somavāre niśākṣaye ||
so'pi rogairvinirmuktaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati puṣṭimān || 11 ||
niṣkāmastu punaryo māṃ tasminkāle nṛpottama ||
pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktyā puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto mama lokaṃ sa yāsyati || 12 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstrailokyadīpako haraḥ ||
antardhānaṃ gato viprā yathā dīpo'tra tatkṣaṇāt || 13 ||
nalo'pi tuṣṭimāpannastamārādhya ciraṃ nṛpaḥ ||
tadāhūyākhilānviprāṃścamatkārapurodbhavān ||14||
eṣa saṃsthāpitaḥ śaṃbhurmayā yuṣmatpuroṃtike ||
yena dṛṣṭena rogāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ || 15 ||
adhunāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi svarājyāya kṛte dvijāḥ ||
niṣadhāṃ ca purīmeṣa sarvaiḥ pūjyaḥ samāhitaiḥ || 16 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
evaṃ pārthivaśārdūla kariṣyāmaḥ samāhitāḥ ||
tava devakṛte yatnaṃ yātrādyāsu kriyāsu ca || 17 ||
tathā pūjāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ||
asmākaṃ putrapautrā ye bhaviṣyaṃti tathā pare ||
vaṃśajāste kariṣyaṃti pūjāmasya subhaktitaḥ || 18 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktaḥ sa bhūpālastairvipraistuṣṭisaṃyutaḥ ||
pratasthe tānpraṇamyoccaiḥ sarvaistaiścābhinaṃditaḥ || || 19 ||
evaṃ sa bhagavāñchaṃbhustasminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ ||
hitāya sarvalokānāṃ sarvarogakṣayāvahaḥ || 6.55.20 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena vīkṣaṇīyaḥ sadā hi saḥ ||
viśeṣātsomavāreṇa śāśvataṃ śreya icchatā || 21 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye naleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||

<6.56>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasyāpi nātidūrasthaṃ sāṃbādityaṃ sureśvaram ||
dṛṣṭvā kāmānavāpnoti sarvānmartyo hṛdi sthitān|| 1 ||
yastu māghasya śuklāyāṃ saptamyāṃ ravivāsare ||
bhaktyā saṃpaśyate martyo narakānna sa paśyati || 2 ||
āsītpūrvaṃ dvijo nāma gālavaḥ sa mahāmuniḥ ||
svādhyāyanirato nityaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || 3 ||
śucivrataparaḥ śāṃto devadvijaparāyaṇaḥ ||
kṛtajñaśca suśīlaśca yajñakarmavicakṣaṇaḥ || 4 ||
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya saṃprāptaṃ paścimaṃ vayaḥ ||
aputrasya dvijaśreṣṭhāstato duḥkhaṃ vyajāyata || 5 ||
tataḥ sarvaṃ parityajya gṛhakṛtyaṃ sa bhaktimān ||
sūryamārādhayāmāsa kṣetre'traiva samāhitaḥ || 6 ||
vaṭavṛkṣaṃ samāśritya śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ||
sthāpayitvā raverarcāṃ yathoktāṃ paṃcarātrike || 7 ||
varṣāsvākāśaśāyī ca hemaṃte jalasaṃśrayaḥ ||
paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ paṃcadaśe varṣe saṃprāpte bhagavānraviḥ ||
vaṭavṛkṣaṃ samāśritya samīpasthamuvāca tam || 9 ||
|| śrīsūrya uvāca || ||
varadosmyadya bhadraṃ te varaṃ prārthaya gālava ||
atidurlabhamapyāśu tava dāsyāmyasaṃśayam ||6.56.10||
|| gālava uvāca || ||
aputro'haṃ suraśreṣṭha paścime vayasi sthitaḥ ||
tasmāddehi sutaṃ mahyaṃ vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ param || 11 ||
|| śrīsūrya uvāca || ||
vaṃśavṛddhikaro vipra putrastava bhaviṣyati ||
tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca śāstrajño veda pāragaḥ||12||
yeyaṃ tvayā kṛtā me'rcā sāṃbasūryasya saṃnidhau ||
sāṃbasūryābhidhāno'yaṃ bhaviṣyati dharātale||13||
anyo'pi śradrayopeto ya enaṃ pūjayiṣyati ||
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa yāvaddvādaśa bhāskarāḥ ||14||
saptamyaśca dvijaśreṣṭha nirāhārastu bhaktitaḥ yā ||
sa prāpsyati na saṃdehaḥ putraṃ vaṃśavivardhanam || 15 ||
evamuktvā ca saptāśvo virarāma divākaraḥ ||
gālavo'pi prahṛṣṭātmā jagāma nijamaṃdiram || 16 ||
nātidīrgheṇa kālena tatastasyābhava tatsutaḥ||
yathoktastena devena sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ || 17 ||
tataścakre pitā nāma vaṭeśvara iti svayam ||
vaṭasthena yato dattaḥ saṃtuṣṭenāṃśumālinā || 18 ||
vaṭeśvarasutāndṛṣṭvā pautrāṃśca dvijasattamāḥ ||
gālavaḥ sūryamāpannaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ tapaḥ || 19 ||
vaṭeśvaro'pi saṃjñāya pitrā saṃsthāpitaṃ ravim ||
tadarthaṃ kārayāmāsa prāsādaṃ sumanoharam || 6.56.20 ||
tataḥprabhṛti loke ca sa vaṭādityasaṃjñitaḥ ||
putraprado hyaputrāṇāṃ vikhyāto bhuvanatraye || 21 ||
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ||
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā saptarmārdvādaśa kramāt ||
sa prāpnoti sutaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svavaṃśasya vivardhanam || 22 ||
niṣkāmo vā naro yastu taṃ pūjayati mānavaḥ ||
sa mokṣamāpnuyānnūnaṃ durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi || 23 ||
atha gāthā purā gītā nāradena surarṣiṇā ||
dṛṣṭvā putrapradaṃ devaṃ vaṭādityaṃ sureśvaram || 24 ||
api varṣaśatā nārī vaṃdhyā vā durbhagāpi vā ||
sāṃbasūryaprasādena sadyo garbhavatī bhavet || 25 ||
kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ vratairdhyānaiḥ kiṃ japaiḥ sopavāsakaiḥ ||
putrārthaṃ vidyamāne'tha sāṃbasūrye sureśvare || 26 ||
varṣamekaṃ naro bhaktyā yaḥ paśyetsūryavāsare ||
kṛtakṣaṇo'tra putraṃ sa labhate cottamaṃ sukham|| 27 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena taṃ devaṃ yatnato dvijāḥ ||
paśyedātmahitārthāya svavaṃśaparivṛddhaye || 28 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sāṃbādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 56|| || cha ||

<6.57>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasminkṣetre tathādityaḥ sthāpito dvijasattamāḥ ||
bhīṣmeṇa brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ saṃmatena tathātmanā || 1 ||
śaṃtanordayitaḥ putro gāṃgeya iti viśrutaḥ ||
āsītpurā varo nṛṇāmūrdhvaretāḥ suviśrutaḥ || 2 ||
tasyāsīttumulaṃ yuddhaṃ bhārgaveṇa samaṃ mahat ||
trayoviṃśaddinānyeva devāsuraraṇopamam||
aṃbākṛte śitaiḥ śastrairastraiśca tadanaṃtaram|| 3 ||
tato brahmādayo devāḥ svayameva vyavasthitāḥ ||
tābhyāṃ nivāraṇārthāya śāṃtyarthaṃ sarvadehinān ||
gatāśca te samutthāpya punareva triviṣṭapam || 4 ||
aṃbāpi prāpya paramaṃ gāṃgeyotthaṃ parābhavam ||
praviṣṭā koparaktākṣī susamiddhe hutāśane||5||
bhartsayitvā nadīputraṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanā||
tataḥprovāca madhyasthā vahneḥ kurupitāmaham||6||
yasmādbhīṣma tvayā tyaktā kāmārtāhaṃ sudurmate||
tasmāttava vadhāyāśu bhaviṣyāmi punaḥ kṣitau||7||

pramāṇaṃ yadi dharmo'tra smṛtiśāstrasamudbhavaḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ sa ghṛṇayā''viṣṭo bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ ||

|| śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca || ||

|| bhīṣma uvāca || ||

|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || ||

|| || sūta uvāca || ||
sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ ||

|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||

|| bhīṣma uvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

kanyakā divase prāpte sarvaśāstravigarhite || 4 ||
tata ānīya viprānsa jyotirjñānavicakṣaṇān ||
papraccha kīdṛśī kanyā mameyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 5 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
yā kanyā prāpnuyājjanma citrāsaṃsthe divākare ||
caṃdre vāpi caturdaśyāṃ sā bhavedviṣakanyakā || 6 ||
yastasyāḥ pratigṛhṇāti pāṇiṃ pārthivasattama ||
ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare mṛtyuṃ sa prāpnoti naro dhruvam || 7 ||
yasminsā jāyate harmye ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare ca tat ||
karoti vibhavairhīnaṃ dhanadasyāpyasaṃśayam || 8 ||
seyaṃ tava sutā rājanyathoktā viṣa kanyakā ||
paitṛkaṃ śvāśurīyaṃ ca haniṣyati gṛhadvayam || 9 ||
tasmādimāṃ parityajya sukhī bhava narādhipa ||
śraddadhāsi vaco'smākaṃ hita muktaṃ yadi prabho || 6.61.10 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
tyakṣyāmi yadi nāmaitāṃ dhārayiṣyāmi vā gṛhe ||
anyadehodbhavaṃ karma phaliṣyati tathāpi me || 11 ||
śubhaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ na tu śakyaṃ prarakṣitum ||
tasmātkarma puraskṛtya naiva tyakṣyāmi kanyakām || 12 ||
yenayena śarīreṇa yadyatkarma karoti yaḥ ||
tenatenaiva bhūyaḥ sa prāpnoti sakalaṃ phalam || 13 ||
yasyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ kriyate'tra śubhāśubham ||
tasyāṃ tasyāṃ dhruvaṃ tasya phalaṃ tadbhujyate naraiḥ || 14 ||
na naśyati purākarma kṛtaṃ sarveṃdriyairiha ||
akṛtaṃ jāyate naiva tasmānnāsti bhayaṃ mama || 15 ||
āyuḥ karma ca vittaṃ ca vidyā nidhanameva ca ||
pañcaitāni hi sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ || 16 ||
yathā vṛkṣeṣu vallīṣu kusumāni phalāni ca ||
svakālaṃ nātivartaṃte tadvatkarma purākṛtam || 17 ||
yenaiva yadyathā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ||
sa eva tattathā bhuṃkte nityaṃ vihitamātmanaḥ || 18 ||
yathā dhenusahasreṣu vatso vindati mātaram ||
tathaivaṃ koṭimadhyasthaṃ kartāraṃ karma vindati || 19 ||
anyadehakṛtaṃ karma na kaścitpuruṣo bhuvi ||
balena prajñayā vāpi samarthaḥ kartumanyathā || 6.61.20 ||
anyathā śāstragarbhiṇyā dhiyā dhīro mahīyate ||
svāmivatprākkṛtaṃ karma vidadhāti tadanyathā || 21 ||
svakṛtānyupatiṣṭhaṃti sukhaduḥkhāni dehinām ||
hetubhūto hi yasteṣāṃ so'haṃkāreṇa badhyate || 22 ||
suśīghramabhidhāvantaṃ nijaṃ karmānudhāvati ||
śete saha śayānena tiṣṭhantamanutiṣṭhati || 23 ||
yathā chāyātapau nityaṃ susaṃbaddhau parasparam ||
tathā karma ca kartā ca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 29 ||
yena yatropabhoktavyaṃ sukhaṃ vā duḥkhameva vā ||
naraḥ sa baddho rajjveva balāttatraiva nīyate || 25 ||
pramāṇaṃ karmabhūtānāṃ sukhaduḥkhopapādane ||
sāvadhānatayā yacca jāgratāṃ svapatāmapi || 26 ||
tailakṣaye yathā dīpo nirvāṇamadhigacchati ||
karmakṣaye tathā jaṃturnirvāṇamadhigacchati || 27 ||
na mantrā na tapo dānaṃ na tīrthaṃ na ca saṃyamaḥ ||
samarthā rakṣituṃ jaṃtuṃ pīḍitaṃ pūrvakarmabhiḥ || 28 ||
saṃgatyā jaṭhare nyasto retobinduracetanaḥ ||
ṛtukāle manuṣyeṇa vṛddhiṃ gacchati karmataḥ || 29 ||
annapānāni jīryaṃti yatra bhakṣyaṃ ca bhakṣitam ||
tasminnevodare garbhaḥ kathaṃ nāma na jīryati || 6.61.30 ||
tasmātkarmakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ dehināmatra jāyate ||
śubhaṃ vā yadi vā pāpamiti me niścayaḥ sadā || 31 ||
arakṣitaṃ tiṣṭhati daivarakṣitaṃ surakṣitaṃ daivahataṃ vinaśyati ||
jīvatyanātho'pi vane visarjitaḥ kṛtaprayatno'pi gṛhe na jīvati || 32 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye viṣakanyakotpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||

<6.62>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā pārthivo dvijasattamāḥ ||
nātyajattāṃ tathokto'pi daivajñairviṣakanyakām ||
dīyamānāmapi prītyā na ca gṛhṇāti bhūbhujā || 1 ||

śarmiṣṭheti suvikhyātā tataḥ sā hyabhavadbhuvi || 2 ||
etasminnaṃtare tasya śatravaḥ pṛthivīpateḥ ||
sarvataḥ pīḍayāmāsa rāṣṭraṃ krodhasamanvitāḥ| ||3||

yuddhāya niryayau sthānānmṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartane ||4||

asyā doṣeṇa pāpāyā mṛtaśca sa mahīpatiḥ||
tathā rāṣṭrasya vidhvaṃse bhaviṣyati puraḥ kṣayaḥ || 6.62.10 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

pratasthe'raṇyamāsādya maraṇe kṛtaniścayā ||15||

tapasvibhiḥ samākīrṇaṃ cittāhlādakaraṃ param || 16 ||

kṣetrasyāsya prabhāvena tasmādatraiva me sthitiḥ || 18 ||
sūta uvāca || ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
