|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha someśvarākhyaṃ ca tatra liṃgaṃ suśobhanam ||
asti khyātaṃ triloke'tra svayaṃ somena nirmitam || 1 ||
somavāreṇa yastatra vatsaraṃ yāvadarcayet ||
kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sa rogeṇa dāruṇenāpi mucyate ||2||
yakṣmaṇāpi na saṃdehaḥ kiṃ punaḥ kuṣṭhapūrvakaiḥ ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena rogārttastaṃ prapūjayet ||3||
tadārādhya purā somaḥ kṣayavyādhisamanvitaḥ ||
babhūva nīrugdeho'sau yathā pāṃḍyo narādhipaḥ || 4 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
oṣadhīnāmadhīśasya kathaṃ somasya sūtaja ||
kṣayavyādhiḥ purā jātā upaśāṃtiṃ kathaṃ gataḥ ||5||
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate||
tathā tasya mahīpasya pāṃḍyasyāpi kathāṃ śubhām || 6 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
dakṣasya kanyakāḥ pūrvaṃ saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā ||
upayeme niśānātho devāgnigurusaṃnidhau || 7 ||
nakṣatrasaṃjñitā loke kīrtyaṃte yā dvijottamaiḥ ||
daivajñairaśvinīpūrvā rūpaudāryaguṇānvitāḥ ||8||
atha tāsāṃ samastānāṃ madhye tasya niśāpateḥ ||
rohiṇī vallabhā jajñe prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || 9 ||
tataḥ samaṃ parityajya sarvāstā dakṣakanyakāḥ ||
rohiṇyā saha saṃyuktaḥ saṃbabhūva divāniśam || 6.63.10 ||
tatastāḥ kāma saṃtaptā daurbhāgyena samanvitāḥ ||
procurduḥkhānvitā dakṣaṃ gatvā bāṣpaplutānanāḥ || 11 ||
vayaṃ yasmai tvayā dattāḥ patnyarthaṃ tāta pāpine||
ṛtumātramapi prītyā so'smākaṃ na prayacchati || 12 ||
tasmātprāṇānvihāsyāmaḥ saṃpraviśya hutāśanam ||
avilaṃbānmahābhāga satyaṃ brūmastavāgrataḥ || 13 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣo duḥkhasamanvitaḥ ||
sarvāstāḥ svayamādāya jagāma śaśisaṃnidhau || 14 ||
tataḥ provāca so'nvakṣaṃ tāsāṃ dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
bhartsayanparuṣairvākyairniśānāthaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 15 ||
kimidaṃ yujyate kartuṃ tvayā rātripate'dhama ||
karma mūḍha satāṃ bāhya dharmaśāstravigarhitam|| 16 ||
ṛtukāle'pi saṃprāpte sutā mama samudbhavāḥ ||
yanna saṃbhāṣasi prītyā dharmaśāstraṃ na vetsi kim || 17 ||
ṛtu snātāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ saṃnidhau nopagacchati ||
ghorāyāṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 18 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā salajjo rātrināyakaḥ ||
provācādhomukho dakṣaṃ prakariṣye vacastava || 19 ||
tato hṛṣṭamanā dakṣaḥ sutāḥ sarvā himadyute ||
nivedyāmaṃtrya taṃ paścājjagāma nijamaṃdiram || 6.63.20 ||
candro'pi pūrvavatsarvāstāḥ parityajya dakṣajāḥ ||
rohiṇyā saha saṃsargaṃ pracakārānurāgataḥ || 21 ||
atha tā duḥkhitā bhūyo jagmuryatra pitā sthitaḥ ||
procuśca bāṣpapūrṇākṣāstatkālasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ || 22 ||
etattāta mahadduḥkhamasmākaṃ vartate hṛdi ||
yaddaurbhāgyaṃ prasaṃjātaṃ sarvastrījanagarhitam || || 23 ||
yatpunastvaṃ kṛtastena kāmukena durātmanā ||
vyarthaśramo'pramāṇīva kṛte'smākaṃ gataḥ svayam || 24 ||
tadduḥkhaṃ na vayaṃ śaktā hṛdi dhartuṃ kathaṃcana ||
ramate sa hi rohiṇyā caṃdramāḥ sahito'niśam || 25 ||
viśeṣāttava vākyena niṣiddho rātrināyakaḥ ||
anujñāṃ dehi tasmāttvamasmākaṃ tatra sāṃpratam ||
daurbhāgyaduḥkhasaṃtaptāstyajāmo yena jīvitam || 26 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣaḥ kopasamanvitaḥ ||
śaśāpa śarvarīnāthaṃ gatvā tatsaṃnidhau tataḥ || 27 ||
yasmātpāpa na me vākyaṃ tvayā dharmasamanvitam ||
kṛtaṃ tasmātkṣayavyādhistvāṃ grasiṣyati dāruṇaḥ || 28 ||
evamuktvā yayau dakṣaścandro'pi dvijasattamāḥ ||
tatkṣaṇādyakṣmaṇāśliṣṭaḥ kṣayaṃ yāti dine dine || 29 ||
tato'sau kṛśatāṃ prāptaḥ saṃparityajya rohiṇīm ||
aśaktaḥ sevituṃ kāmaṃ vabhrāma jagatītale || 6.63.30 ||
kṣayavyādhipraṇāśāya pṛccha mānaścikitsakān||
auṣadhāni vicitrāṇi prakurvāṇo jitendriyaḥ || 31 ||
tathāpi mucyate naiva yakṣmaṇā sa niśāpatiḥ ||
dakṣaśāpena raudreṇa kṣayaṃ yāti dinedine || 32 ||
tato vairāgyamāpannastīrthayātrāparāyaṇaḥ ||
babhūva śraddhayāyuktastyaktvā bheṣajamuttamam || 33 ||
athāsau bhramamāṇastu tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ||
saṃprāpto brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam|| 34 ||
tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā prabhāsaṃ vīkṣya rātripaḥ ||
yāvatsaṃprasthitonyatra tāvadagre vyavasthitam || 35 ||
apaśyadromakaṃnāma sa muni saṃśitavratam ||
tapovīryasamopetaṃ sarvasattvānukampakam || 36 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa praṇamyoccai stataḥ provāca sādaram ||
kṣayavyādhiyutaścandro nirvedāddvijasattamāḥ || 37 ||
parikṣīṇo'smi vipreṃdra kṣayavyādhiprabhāvataḥ ||
tasmātkuru pratīkāra mahaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 38 ||
mayā cikitsakāḥ pṛṣṭāstairuktaṃ bheṣajaṃ kṛtam ||
anekadhā mahābhāga parikṣīṇo dinedine || 39 ||
yadi naivopadeśaṃ me kañcittvaṃ saṃpradāsyasi ||
vyādhināśāya tattena tyakṣyāmyadya kalevaram || 6.63.40 ||
|| romaka uvāca || ||
anyasyāpi niśānātha na śāpaḥ kartumanyathā ||
śakyate kiṃ punastasya dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ || 41 ||
tasmādatropadeśaṃ te prayacchāmi susaṃmatam ||
yena te syādasaṃdigdhaṃ kṣayavyādhi parikṣayaḥ || 42 ||
nādeyaṃ kiṃcidastīha devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||
saṃprahṛṣṭasya tadvākyāttasmādārādhayasva tam || 43 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu satyaṃ vāsaḥ sadā kṣitau ||
teṣu saṃsthāpya talliṃgaṃ tasya nāśāya rātripa || 44 ||
ārādhaya tato nityaṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
saṃprāpsyasi na saṃdehaḥ kṣayavyādhiparikṣayam || 45 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃprahṛṣṭo niśāpatiḥ ||
tasminprabhāsake kṣetre divyaliṃgāni śūlinaḥ ||
saṃsthāpya pūjayāmāsa svanāmāṃkāni bhaktitaḥ || 46 ||
tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasya saṃdarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
provāca varado'smīti prārthayasva yathepsitam || 47 || ||
|| candra uvāca || ||
paraṃ kṣīṇo'smi deveśa yakṣmaṇāhaṃ padāṃtikam ||
prāptastasmātparitrāhi nānyatsaṃprārthayāmyaham || 48 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
dakṣamāhūya tatraiva tataḥ provāca sādaram || 49 ||
eṣa caṃdrastvayā śapto jāmātā na kṛtaṃ śubham ||
tasmādanugrahaṃ cāsya mama vākyātsamācara || 6.63.50 ||
|| dakṣa uvāca || ||
mayā dharmyamapi prokto vākyameṣa kubuddhimān ||
nākaronme puraḥ procya kariṣyāmītya satyavāk || 51 ||
tena śaptastu kopena sutārthe vṛṣabhadhvaja ||
hāsyenāpi mayā proktaṃ nānyathā saṃprajāyate || 52 ||
|| devadeva uvāca || ||
adyaprabhṛti sarvāstāḥ sutā eṣa niśākaraḥ ||
samāḥ saṃvīkṣate nityaṃ mama vākyādasaṃśayam || 53 ||
tasmātpakṣaṃ kṣayaṃ yātu pakṣaṃ vṛddhiṃ pragacchatu ||
yena te syādvacaḥ satyaṃ matprasādasamanvitam || 54 ||
tato dakṣastathetyuktvā jagāma nijamandiram ||
devo'pi śaṃkaro bhūyaḥ provāca śaśalāṃchanam || 55 ||
bhūyo'pi prārthayābhīṣṭaṃ mattastvaṃ śaśalāṃchana ||
yena sarvaṃ prayacchāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 56 || ||
|| candra uvāca || ||
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama ||
tatsthāpiteṣu liṃgeṣu mayā sarveṣu sarvadā||
saṃnidhānaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ lokānāṃ hita kāmyayā || 57 ||
|| deva uvāca || ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu liṃgeṣu sthāpiteṣu tvayā vibho ||
somavāreṇa sāṃnidhyaṃ kariṣye vacanāttava || 58 ||
evamuktvā sa deveśastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
candro'pi harṣasaṃyuktaḥ samaṃ paśyati tāstataḥ || 59 ||
sutā dakṣasya vipreṃdrā śaṃkarasya vacaḥ smaran||
tato harṣa samāyuktā vabhūvustadanaṃtaram || 6.63.60 ||
evaṃ someśvarāstatra babhūvurdvijasattamāḥ ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu tathānyeṣu tataḥ param || 61 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye somanāthotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 63 || || cha ||

<6.64>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
camatkārī purā devī tatraivāsti dvijottamāḥ ||
camatkāranareṃdreṇa sthāpitā śraddhayā purā || 1 ||
yayā sa mahiṣaḥ pūrvaṃ nihato dānavo raṇe ||
kaumāravratadhāriṇyā māyāśatasahasradhṛk || 2 ||
yadā tannirmitaṃ tatra puraṃ tena mahātmanā ||
tasya saṃrakṣaṇārthāya tadā sā sthāpitā dvijāḥ || 3 ||
purasya tasya rakṣārthaṃ tathā tatpuravāsinām ||
sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ bhaktyā bhāvitacetasām || 4 ||
yastāmabhyarcayetsamyaṅmahānavamivāsare ||
kṛtsnaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tasya na bhayaṃ jāyate kvacit || 5 ||
bhūtapretapiśācebhyaḥ śatrutaśca viśeṣataḥ ||
rogebhyastaskarebhyaśca duṣṭebhyo'nyebhya eva ca || 6 ||
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyañchuklāṣṭamyāṃ naraḥ śuciḥ ||
tāṃ pūjayati sadbhaktyā sa tamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 7 ||
niṣkāmaḥ sukhamāpnoti mokṣaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||
tasyā devyāḥ prasādena satyametanmayoditam || 8 ||
tāmārādhya gatāḥ pūrvaṃ siddhiṃ bhūrirmahībhujaḥ ||
brāhmaṇāśca tathānye'pi yoginaḥ parameśvarīm || 9 ||
yastasyāḥ śraddhayopetaḥ prakaroti pradakṣiṇām ||
nityaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvattiryagyonau na sa vrajet||6.64.10||
tasyā āyatane pūrvamāścaryamabhavanmahat ||
yattadvaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 11 ||
āsīccitrarathonāma pūrvaṃ pārthivasattamaḥ ||
daśārṇādhipatiḥ khyātaḥ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ || 12 ||
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ sadā bhaktyā sa tasyāḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ yāvatpracakāra pradakṣiṇām || 13 ||
tataḥ praṇamya tāṃ devīṃ saṃprayāti punargṛham ||
sainyena caturaṃgeṇa samaṃtātparivāritaḥ || 14 ||
evaṃ tasya nareṃdrasya pradakṣiṇaratasya ca ||
jagāma sumahānkālo devyā bhaktiratasya ca || 15 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya sa rājā tatra saṃgataḥ ||
apaśyadbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāndevīgṛhasamāśritān || 16 ||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā tāṃ devīṃ sa mahīpatiḥ || 16 ||
agrasthāṃstāndvijānsarvānnamaścakre samāhitaḥ || 17 ||
tatastaiḥ sahitaistatra sahāsīnaḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ ||
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ viprarṣīṇāṃ cakāra ha || 18 ||
tataḥ kasminkathāṃte sa pṛṣṭastairdvijasattamaiḥ ||
kautūhalasamopetairvinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ || || 19 ||
rājanpṛcchāmahe sarve tvāṃ vayaṃ kautukānvitāḥ ||
tasmātkīrtaya cedguhyaṃ na tattava vyavasthitam || 6.64.20 ||
māsimāsi sadāṣṭamyāṃ tvaṃ śuklāyāṃ sudūrataḥ ||
āgatya devatāyāśca prakaroṣi pradakṣiṇām || 21 ||
yatnenānyāḥ parityajya sarvāḥ pūjādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||
nūnaṃ vetsi phalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yatpradakṣiṇasaṃbhavam|| 22 ||
|| rājovāca || || satyametaddvijaśreṣṭhā yadbhavadbhirudāhṛtam ||
rahasyamapi vaktavyaṃ yuṣmākaṃ sāṃprataṃ mayā || 23 ||
ahamāsa śukaḥ pūrvamasminnāyatane śubhe ||
devyāḥ paścimadigbhāge kulāyakṛtasaṃśrayaḥ || 24 ||
tatra nirgacchato nityaṃ kurvataścapraveśanam ||
pradakṣiṇābhavaddevyā nityameva dvijottamāḥ || 25 ||
tataḥ kālena me mṛtyuḥ saṃjāto'traiva maṃdire ||
tatprabhāveṇa saṃjāto rājā jātismaro'tra hi || || 26 ||
etasmātkāraṇāddūrātsamabhyetya pradakṣiṇām ||
karomyasyā dvijaśreṣṭhā devatāyāḥ samāhitaḥ || 27 ||
purā bhaktivihīnena kulāye vasatā mayā ||
kṛtā pradakṣiṇā devyāstena jāto'smi bhūpatiḥ || 28 ||
adhunā śraddhayā yukto yatkaromi pradakṣiṇām ||
kiṃ me bhaviṣyati śreyastanna vedmi dvijottamāḥ || 29 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā tasya te viprā vismayotphullalocanāḥ ||
sādhuvādaṃ tathā cakrustasya bhūpasya harṣitāḥ || || 6.64.30 ||
tataḥ sa pārthivaḥ sarvānpraṇamya dvijasattamān ||
anujñāpya yayau tūrṇaṃ svagṛhāya sasainikaḥ || 31 ||
adhunā śraddhayā yukto yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto labhate vāṃchitaṃ phalam || 32 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti te viprāḥ sarve bhaktipuraḥsarāḥ ||
tasyāḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ cakrustathānye muktihetave || 33 ||
prāptāśca paramāṃ siddhiṃ vāṃchitāṃ tatprabhāvataḥ ||
iha loke pare caiva durlabhāṃ tridaśairapi || 34 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tāṃ devīmiha saṃśrayet ||
sarvakāmapradāṃ nṛṇāṃ tasminkṣetre vyavasthitām || 35 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye camatkārīdurgāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 || || dha ||

<6.65>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyadapi tatrāsti taḍāgaṃ devanirmitam ||
yatrānarto nṛpaḥ siddhaḥ suhayo nāma nāmataḥ || 1 ||
tenaiva bhūbhujā tatra liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ śubham ||
ānarteśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca sarva siddhipradaṃ nṛṇām || 2 ||
tatrāṃgārakaṣaṣṭhyāṃ yastaḍāge snānamācaret ||
sa prāpnoti naraḥ siddhiṃ yathā''nartādhipena ca || 3 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kathaṃ siddhistu saṃprāptā ānartena mahātmanā ||
sarvaṃ kathaya tatsūta sarvaṃ vetsi na saṃśayaḥ || 4 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
ānartaḥ suhayo nāma purāsītpṛthivīpatiḥ ||
sarvāribhirhato yuddhe palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ ||
ucchiṣṭo mlecchasaṃspṛṣṭa ekākī bahubhirvṛtaḥ || 5 ||
atha tasya kapālaṃ ca kāpālika vratānvitaḥ ||
jagṛhe nijakarmārthaṃ jñātvā taṃ vīrasaṃbhavam || 6 ||
ānarteśvarasāṃnidhye vasamāno vane sthitaḥ ||
sa rātrau tena toyena sarvadevamayena ca || || 7 ||
taḍāgotthena saṃpūrṇaṃ rātrau kṛtvā pramuṃcati ||
āsītpūrvaṃ vaṇiṅnāmnā siddhasena iti smṛtaḥ ||
dhanī bhṛtyasamopetaḥ sadā puṇyaparāyaṇaḥ || 8 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya paṇyabuddhyā dvijottamāḥ ||
prasthitaścottarāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ sa sārthena samanvitaḥ || 9 ||
atha prāptaḥ kramātsarvaiḥ sa gacchanmarumaṃḍalam ||
vṛkṣodakaparityaktaṃ sarvasattvavivarjitam|| 6.65.10 ||
tatra rātriṃ samāsādya śrāṃtāḥ pāṃthāḥ samantataḥ||
suptāḥ sthānāni saṃsṛtya gatā nidrāvaśaṃ tathā || 11 ||
tataḥ pratyūṣamāsādya samutthāya ca satvaram ||
prasthitā uttarāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ muktvaikaṃ śūdrasevakam || 12 ||
sa vai mārgapariśrāṃto gatvā nidrāvaśaṃ bhṛśam ||
na jajāgāra jāte'pi prayāṇe bahuśabdite || 13 ||
na ca taiḥ sa smṛtaḥ sārthairyaiḥ samaṃ prasthito gṛhāt ||
na ca kenāpi saṃdṛṣṭaḥ sa tu rodhasi saṃsthitaḥ || 14 ||
evaṃ gate tataḥ sārthe prodgate sūryamaṃḍale ||
tīvratāpaparispṛṣṭo jajāgāra tataḥ param ||15||
yāvatpaśyati no kiñcittasminsthāne sa sārthakam||
na ca teṣāṃ marau tasmim̐llakṣyate padapaddhatiḥ||16||
tato duḥkhaparītātmā dhāvamāna itastataḥ||
patito medinīpṛṣṭhe madhyāhne kṣuttṛṣārditaḥ ||17||
evaṃ tasya tṛṣārtasya patitasya dharātale ||
dhṛtaprāṇasya kṛcchreṇa saṃyāto'stācalaṃ raviḥ || 18 ||
tataḥ kiṃcitsasaṃjño'bhūnmaṃdībhūte divākare ||
cintayāmāsa cittena kvāhaṃ gacchāmi sāṃpratam || 19 ||
na lakṣyate kvacinmārgo dṛśyate na ca mānuṣam ||
nātra toyaṃ na ca cchāyā nūnaṃ me mṛtyu rāgataḥ || 6.65.20 ||
evaṃ cintāprapannasya tasya śūdrasya nirjane ||
marau tasminsamāyātā śarvarī tadanantaram || 21 ||
atha kṣaṇena śuśrāva sa gītaṃ madhuradhvani ||
paṭhatāṃ nandivṛddhānāṃ tathā śabdaṃ manoharam || 22 ||
athāpaśyatkṣaṇenaiva pretasaṃghaiḥ sabhāvṛtam ||
pretamekaṃ ca sarveṣāmādhipatye vyava sthitam || 23 ||
tataste pārśvagāḥ pretā eke nṛtyaṃ pracakrire ||
tatpuro gītamanye tu stutiṃ caiva tathā pare || 24 ||

athāśaucāṃtamāsādya rāmaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ ||
tīkṣṇaṃ paraśumādāya māhiṣmatyunmukhaṃ yayau || 19 ||
sarvaistaiḥ śabaraiḥ sārdhaṃ pulindairmedakaistathā ||
baddhagodhāṃgulitrāṇairvarabāṇadhanurdharaiḥ || 6.67.20 ||
tathā'rjuno'pi taṃ śrutvā samāyātaṃ bhṛgūttamam ||
sainyena mahatā yuktaṃ pratijñādhāriṇaṃ tathā || 21 ||
tatastu sammukho dṛṣṭo yuddhārthaṃ sa viniryayau ||
sārdhaṃ nānāvidhairyodhaiḥ sarvairdevāsuropamaiḥ || 22 ||
athābhavanmahāyuddhaṃ pulindānāṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
haihayādhipateryodhaiḥ sārdhaṃ devāsuropamaiḥ || 23 ||
tataste haihayāḥ sarve śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ ||
vadhyante śabaraiḥ saṃkhye garjamānairmuhurmuhuḥ || 24 ||
brahmahatyāsamutthena pātakena tataśca te ||
jātā nistejasaḥ sarve prapataṃti dharātale || 25 ||
na kaścitpauruṣaṃ tatra saṃpradarśayituṃ kṣamaḥ ||
palāyanaparā sarve vadhyante niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 26 ||
atha bhagnaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā haihayādhipatiḥ krudhā ||
svacāpaṃ vāñchayāmāsa sajyaṃ kartuṃ tvarānvitaḥ ||
śaknoti nāropayituṃ suyatnamapi cāśritaḥ || 27 ||
tataścākarṣayāmāsa khaṅgaṃ kośātsunirmalam ||
ākraṣṭuṃ na ca śakroti vailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 28 ||
gadayā nirjito raudro rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ ||
yayā sāpyapataddhastāttatkṣaṇātpṛthivītale || 29 ||
narmadāyāḥ pravāho yaiḥ sahasrākhyaiḥ karaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
vidhṛtastena te sarve babhūvuḥ kampavihvalāḥ || 6.67.30 ||
na śastraṃ śekuruddhartuṃ daivayogātkathaṃcana ||
divyāstrāṇāṃ tathā sarve mantrā vismṛtimāgatāḥ || 31 ||
etasminnaṃtare rāmaḥ saṃprāptaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ||
tīkṣṇaṃ paraśumudyamya tatastaṃ prāha niṣṭhuram || 32 ||
haihayādhipate pāpa yaiḥ karairjanako mama ||
tvayā vinihatastānme śīghraṃ darśaya sāṃpratam || 33 ||
brahmatejohataḥ so'pi proktastena suniṣṭhuram ||
novāca cottaraṃ kiṃcidālekhye likhito yathā ||34||
tato bhujavanaṃ tasya rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ||
muhurmuhurvinirbhartsya pracakarta śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 35 ||
tataśchittvā śirastasya kuṭhāreṇa bhṛgūdvahaḥ ||
jagrāha rudhiraṃ yatnātprahārebhyaḥ svayaṃ dvijāḥ || 36 ||
pūrayitvā mahākumbhāñchabarebhyo dadau tataḥ ||
mlecchebhyo lubdhakebhyaśca tataḥ provāca sādaram ||37||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre gartā me bhrātṛbhiḥ kṛtā ||
pitṛsaṃtarpaṇārthāya salilena pariplutā || 38 ||
prakṣipadhvaṃ drutaṃ gatvā tasyāṃ raktamidaṃ mahat ||
pāpasyāsya sapatnasya mamādeśādasaṃśayam || 39 ||
yena tātaṃ nijaṃ bhaktyā tarpayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
ṛṇasya muktirbhavati yena me paitṛkasyaca || 6.67.40 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sahasrārjunavadhavarṇanaṃnāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo' dhyāyaḥ || 67 || || dha ||

<6.68>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha te śabarā yatnādraktaṃ taddhaihayodbhavam ||
tatra ninyuḥ sthitā yatra gartā sā pitṛsaṃbhavā || 1 ||
bhārgavo'pi ca taṃ hatvā raktamādāya kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
tataḥ saṃpreṣayāmāsa yatra gartā'tha paitṛkī || 2 ||
na sa bālaṃ na vṛddhaṃ ca parityajati bhārgavaḥ ||
yauvanasthaṃ viśeṣeṇa garbhasthaṃ vātha kṣatriyam || 3 ||
svayaṃ jaghāna bhūpānsa teṣāṃ pārśve tathā parān ||
vidhvaṃsāyayati kruddhaḥ sainikaiśca samantataḥ || 4 ||
tathaivāsṛkpragṛhṇāti gṛhṇāpayati cādarāt ||
teṣāṃ pārśvaistatastūrṇaṃ preṣayāmāsa tatra ca || 5 ||
evaṃ niḥkṣatriyāṃ kṛtvā kṛtsnāṃ pṛthvīṃ bhṛgadvahaḥ ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre jagāma tadanantaram || 6 ||
tatastai rudhiraiḥ snātvā samādāya tilānbahūn ||
apasavyaṃ samādhāya pracakre pitṛtarpaṇam || 7 ||
pratyakṣaṃ sarvaviprāṇāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ tapasvinām ||
pratijñāṃ pūrayitvā'tha viśokaḥ sa babhūva ha || 8 ||
tato niḥkṣatriye loke kṛtvā hayamakhaṃ ca saḥ ||
prāyacchatsakalāmurvīṃ brāhmaṇebhyaśca dakṣiṇām || 9 ||
atha labdhavarā viprāstamūcurbhṛgusattamam ||
nāsmadbhūmau tvayā stheyameko rājā yataḥ smṛtaḥ || 6.68.10 ||
so'pi bāḍhamiti procya harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ ||
mahīparyaṃtamāsādya provācātha nadīpatim ||11||
āropya sumahaccāpamāgneyāstraṃ prayujya ca ||
triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīṃ kṛtvā kopena mahatānvitaḥ ||12||
|| rāma uvāca || ||
mayā niḥkṣatriyā bhūmiḥ kṛtā śailavanānvitā ||
brāhmaṇebhyastato dattā vājimedhe mahāmakhe ||13||
tasmāttvaṃ dehi me sthānaṃ kṛtvā'pasaraṇaṃ svayam||
na hi dattvā grahī ṣyāmi viprebhyo medinīṃ punaḥ || 14 ||
na karoṣyathavā vākyaṃ mamādya tvaṃ nadīpate ||
sthalarūpaṃ kariṣyāmi vahnyastrapariśoṣitam || 15 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā samudro bhayasaṃkulaḥ ||
apasāraṃ tataścakre yāvattasyābhivāṃchitam || 16 ||
tataścakāra tatraiva vasatiṃ sa bhṛgūdvahaḥ ||
tapaścaryāsamāyuktaḥ piturvadhamanusmaran||17||
tataḥ sarvānpulindāṃśca śavarānmedasaṃyutān ||
bhūmyante dhārayāmāsa parvateṣu sa bhārgavaḥ ||18||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye paraśurāmakṛtamahīdānapūrvakasamudrāpasāraṇavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāmā ṣṭāṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 68 || || cha ||

<6.69>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tato niḥkṣatriye loke kṣattriṇyo vaṃśakāraṇāt ||
kṣetrajānbrāhmaṇebhyaśca suṣuvustanayā nvarān||1||
te vṛddhiṃ ca samāsādya kṣetrajāḥ kṣatriyopamāḥ ||
jagṛhurmedinīṃ vīryātsaṃnirasya dvijottamān||2||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve paribhūtipadaṃ gatāḥ||
procurbhārgavamabhyetya duḥkhena mahatānvitāḥ|| 3 ||
rāmarāma mahābāho yā tvayā vasudhā ca naḥ ||
vājimedhe makhe dattā kṣatriyaiḥ sā hatā balāt||
tasmānno dehi tāṃ bhūyo hatvā tānkṣatriyādhamān ||
kuru śreyo'bhivṛddhiṃ tāṃ yadyasti tava pauruṣam || 5 ||
tato rāmaḥ krudhāviṣṭo bhūyastaiḥ śavaraiḥ saha ||
pulindairmedakaiścaiva kṣatriyāṃtāya niryayau || 6 ||
tatraiva kṣatriyānhatvā raktamādāya tadbahu ||
tāṃ gartāṃ pūrayāmāsa cakāra pitṛtarpaṇam || 7 ||
pradadau brāhmaṇebhyaśca vājimedhe dharāṃ punaḥ ||
taiśca nirvāsitastatra jagāmodadhisaṃnidhau || 8 ||
evaṃ tena kṛtā pṛthvī sarvakṣattravivarjitā ||
triḥsaptavāraṃ vipreṃdrā dvijebhyaśca niveditā || 9 ||
tarpitāḥ pitaraścaiva rudhireṇa mahātmanā ||
pratijñā pālitā tasmādvikopaśca babhūva saḥ || 6.69.10 ||
ekaviṃśatime prāpte tataśca pitṛtarpaṇe ||
aśarīrā'bhavadvāṇī khasthā pitṛsamudbhavā || 11 ||
rāmarāma mahābhāga tyajaitatkarma garhitam ||
vayaṃ te tuṣṭimāpannāḥ svavākyaparipāla nāt || 12 ||
yattvayā vihitaṃ karma naitadanyaḥ kariṣyati ||
na kṛtaṃ kenacitpūrvaṃ pitṛvairasamudbhavam || 13 ||
tasmāttuṣṭā vayaṃ vatsa dāsyāmaścitta vāṃchitam|
prārthayasva drutaṃ tasmāddurlabhaṃ tridaśairapi||14||
rāma uvāca|
pitaro yadi tuṣṭā me yacchaṃti yadi vāṃchitam|
tasmāttīrthamidaṃ puṇyaṃ mannāmnā lokaviśrutam|
raktadoṣavinirmuktaṃ sevitaṃ varatāpasaiḥ||15||
pitara ūcuḥ|
pitṛtarpaṇajā gartā tvayā yeyaṃ vinirmitā|
rāmahrada iti khyātiṃ prayāsyati jagattraye || 16 ||
yatra bhaktiyutā lokāstarpayiṣyaṃti vai pitṝn ||
te'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya prayāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim||17||
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade naraḥ||
kariṣyati ca yaḥ śrāddhaṃ bhaktyā śastrahatasya ca||18||
api pretatvamāpannaṃ narake vā samāśritam||
uddhariṣyati sa pretamapi pāpasamanvitam||19||
sūta uvāca||
evamuktvā tu rāmaṃ te viremustadanaṃtaram||
rāmo'pi ca tapastepe tatraiva krodhavarjitaḥ||6.69.20||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra śastrahatasya ca||
tasmindine prakartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaiḥ||21||
upasarga mṛtānāṃ ca sarpāgniviṣabandhanaiḥ||
tatra muktipradaṃ śrāddhaṃ dine tasminnudāhṛtam||22||
yaḥ pitṝṃstarpayettatra pretapakṣe jalairapi||
sa teṣāmanṛṇo bhūtvā pitṛloke mahīyate||23||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ rāmahradasamudbhavam||
māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam||24||
śrāddhakāle naro bhaktyā yaścaitatpaṭhati svayam||
sa gayāśrāddhajaṃ kṛtsnaṃ phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam||25||
parvakāle 'thavā prāpte paṭhedbrāhmaṇasaṃnidhau||
pitṛmedhasya yajñasya sa phalaṃ labhate 'khilam||26||
śṛṇuyādvāpi yo bhaktyā kīrtyamānamidaṃ naraḥ||
sautrāmaṇau kṛte kṛtsnaṃ phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam||27||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye rāmahradotpattivṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāmaikonasaptatitamo' dhyāyaḥ || 69 || || dha ||

<6.70>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyāpi ca tatrāsti śaktiḥ pāpapraṇāśinī ||
kārtikeyena nirmuktā hatvā vai tārakaṃ raṇe || 1 ||
tathāsti sumahatkuṇḍaṃ svacchodakasamāvṛtam ||
tenaiva nirmitaṃ tatra yaḥ snātvā tāṃ prapūjayet ||
sa pāpānmucyate sadya ājanmamaraṇāṃti kāt || 2 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kasminkāle vinirmuktā sā śaktistena no vada ||
kimarthaṃ svāminā tatra kiṃprabhāvā vada svayam || || 3 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
purāsīttārakonāma dānavo'tibalānvitaḥ ||
hiraṇyākṣasya dāyādastrailokyasya bhayāvahaḥ || 4 ||
sa jñātvā janakaṃ dhvastaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ||
tapastepe tatastīvraṃ gokarṇaṃ prāpya parvatam || 5 ||
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṃtaṃ śīrṇaparṇā śanaḥ sthitaḥ||
dhyāyamāno mahādevaṃ kāyena manasā girā||6||
varupūjopahāraiśca naivedyairvividhaistataḥ||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte sa daityo duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ || 7 ||
jñātvā rudramasaṃtuṣṭaṃ tato raudraṃ tapo'karot ||
viniṣkṛttyātmamāṃsāni juhotisma hutāśane || 8 ||
tatastuṣṭo mahādevo vṛṣārūḍha umāpatiḥ ||
sarvaireva gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ tasya saṃdarśanaṃ yayau || 9 ||
tatra provāca saṃhṛṣṭastāranādena nādayan ||
diśaḥ sarvā mahādevo harṣa gadgadayā girā || 6.70.10 ||
bhobhostāraka tuṣṭo'smi sāhasaṃ medṛśaṃ kuru ||
prārthayasva mano'bhīṣṭaṃ yena te pradadāmyaham || 11 ||
|| tāraka uvāca ||
ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ tvatprasādādahaṃ vibho ||
yathā bhavāmi saṃgrāme tvāṃ vihāya tathā kuru || 12 ||
|| bhagavānuvāca || ||
matprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ sarvametadbhaviṣyati ||
tvayā yatprārthitaṃ daitya tvameko balavāniha || 13 ||
evamuktvā mahādevaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ gataḥ ||
tārakaścāpi saṃhṛṣṭastathaivanija mandiram || 14 ||
tato dānavasainyena mahatā parivāritaḥ ||
gataḥ śakrapurīṃ yoddhuṃ vikhyātāmamarāvatīm || 15 ||
athābhavanmahāyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha ||
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṃte mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam || 16 ||
tatrābhavatkṣayo nityaṃ devānāṃ raṇamūrdhani ||
vijayo dānavānāṃ ca prasādācchūlapā ṇinaḥ || 17 ||
tataścakrurupāyāṃste vijayāya divaukasaḥ ||
varmāṇi suvicitrāṇi yantrāṇi parikhāstathā || 18 ||
anyānyapi śarīrasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
tathaiva yodhamukhyānāṃ viśeṣāddvijasattamāḥ || 19 ||
sasṛjuste surādhīśā dānavebhyo divāniśam || 6.70.20 ||
mudgarā bhiṃḍipālāśca śataghnyo'tha vareṣavaḥ ||
prāsāḥ kuntāśca bhallāśca tasminkāle vinirmitāḥ ||
viśeṣāhavasaṃbandhavyūhānāṃ prakriyāśca yāḥ || 21 ||
tathānyāni vicitrāṇi kūṭayuddhānyanekaśaḥ ||
bhīṣikāḥ kuhakāścaiva śakrajālāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || 22 ||
na ca te vijayaṃ prāpustathāpi dvijasattamāḥ ||
dānavebhyo mahāyuddhe prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ||23||
atha prāha sahasrākṣo bhayatrasto bṛhaspatim ||
dinedine vayaṃ daityairvijayāmo dvijottama || 24 ||
yathāyathā raṇārthāya sadupāyānkaromyaham ||
tathātathā parābhūtirjāyate me mahāhave || 25 ||
tadupāyaṃ surācārya svabuddhyā tvaṃ pracintaya ||
yena me syājjayo yuddhe tava kīrtiraninditā || 26 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tato bṛhaspatiḥ prāha ciraṃ dhyātvā śacīpatim ||
prahṛṣṭavadano jñātvā jayopāyaṃ mahāhave || || 27 ||
mayā śakra parijñātaḥ sa upāyo mahāhave ||
jīyante śatravo yena līlayaivāpi bhūriśaḥ || 28 ||
yadābhīṣṭaṃ varaṃ tena prārthitastripurāṃtakaḥ ||
tadaivaṃ vacanaṃ prāha praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ || 29 ||
ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ tvatprasādādahaṃ vibho ||
yathā bhavāmi saṃgrāme tvāṃ vihāya tathā kuru || 6.70.30 ||
na taṃ svayaṃ mahādevaḥ svaśiṣyaṃ sūdayiṣyati ||
viṣavṛkṣamapi sthāpya kaśchinatti punaḥ svayam || 31 ||
yo vai pitā sa putraḥ syācchrutivākyamidaṃ smṛtam ||
tasmājjanayatu kṣipraṃ harastannāśakṛtsutam || 32 ||
yena senādhipatye taṃ viniyojya mahāhavam ||
kurmo daityaiḥ samaṃ śastraiḥ prāpnuyāma tato jayam ||33||
eṣa eva upāyo'tra mayā te parikīrtitaḥ ||
vijayāya sahasrākṣa nānyo'sti bhuvanatraye || 34 ||
tato devagaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sametaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ||
tamarthaṃ proktavāñchaṃbhuṃ vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ || 35 ||
sutasya jananārthāya kuru yatnaṃ vṛṣadhvaja||
yena senādhipatye taṃ yojayāmi divaukasām ||36||
prāpnomyahaṃ ca saṃgrāme vijayaṃ tvatprasādataḥ ||
nihatya dānavānsarvāṃstārakeṇa samanvitān || 37 ||
nānyathā vijayo me syātsaṃgrāme dānavaiḥ saha||
iti māṃ prāha devejyo jñātvā samyaṅmahāmatiḥ || 38 ||
athovāca vihasyoccaiḥ śaṃkarastridaśeśvaram ||
kariṣyāmi vacaḥ kṣipraṃ tava śakra na saṃśayaḥ || 39 ||
putramutpādayiṣyāmi sarvadaityavināśakam ||
yaṃ tvaṃ senāpatiṃ kṛtvā jayaṃ prāpsyasi sarvadā || 6.70.40 ||
evamuktvā mahādevo gatvā kailāsa parvatam ||
gauryā samaṃ tataścakre kāmadharmaṃ yathocitam || 41 ||
hāvairbhāvaiḥ samopetaṃ hāsyairanyaistadātmikaiḥ ||
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṃtaṃ divyaṃ caiva nimeṣavat || || 42 ||
atha devagaṇāḥ sarve bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ ||
cakrurmaṃtraṃ tadarthaṃ hi tārakeṇa prapīḍitāḥ || 43 ||
sahasraṃ vatsarāṇāṃ tu ratāsaktasya śūlinaḥ ||
atikrāṃtaṃ na devānāṃ tena kṛtyaṃ vinirmitam || 44 ||
tasmādgacchāmahe tatra yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ||
saṃtiṣṭhate samaṃ gauryā kailāse vijane sthitaḥ ||45||
tatastatraiva saṃjagmuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ||
udvahantaḥ parāmārtiṃ tārakārisamudbhavām || 46 ||
atha kailāsamāsādya yāvadyāṃti bhavāṃtikam||
niṣiddhā naṃdinā tāvanna gaṃtavyamataḥ param || 47 ||
rahasye bhagavānsārdhaṃ pārvatyā samavasthitaḥ ||
asmākamapi no gamyaṃ tasmāttāvanna gamyatām || 48 ||
tatastairvibudhaiḥ sarvaiḥ preṣitastatra cānilaḥ||
kiṃ karoti mahādevaḥ śīghraṃ vijñāyatāmiti || 49 ||
atha vāyurgatastatra yatrāste bhagavāñchivaḥ ||
gauryā saha ratāsakta ānandaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 6.70.50 ||
atha pracalite śukre sthānādaprāptayonike ||
devena vīkṣito vāyurnātidūre vyavasthitaḥ || 51 ||
tato vrīḍā samopetastatkṣaṇādeva cotthitaḥ ||
bhāvāsaktāṃ priyāṃ tyaktvā mā mottiṣṭhetivādinīm || 52 ||
abravīdatha taṃ vāyuṃ vinayāvanataṃ sthitam ||
kimarthaṃ tvamihāyātaḥ kaccitkṣemaṃ divaukasām || 53 ||
|| vāyuruvāca || ||
ete śakrādayo devā naṃdinā vinivāritāḥ ||
tārakeṇa hatotsāhāstiṣṭhaṃti girirodhasi || 54 ||
tasmādetānsamābhāṣya samāśvāsya ca sādaram ||
preṣayasva drutaṃ tatra yatra te dānavāḥ sthitāḥ || 55 ||
atha tānāhvayāmāma tatkṣaṇāttripurāṃtakaḥ ||
saṃprāha caviṣaṇṇāsyaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭānsthitān || 56 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
yuṣmatkṛte samāraṃbhaḥ putrārthaṃ yo mayā kṛtaḥ ||
svasthānāccalite śukre kṛto moghodya vāyunā || 57 ||
etadvīryaṃ mayā dhairyātstaṃbhitaṃ liṃgamadhyagam ||
amoghaṃ tiṣṭhate sarvaṃ kva dadhāmi nivedyatām|| 58 ||
yena saṃjāyate putro dānavāṃtakaraḥ paraḥ ||
senānāthaśca yuṣmākaṃ durddharaḥ samare paraiḥ || 59 ||
etatkalpāgnisaṃkāśaṃ dhartuṃ śaknoti nāparaḥ ||
vinā vaiśvānaraṃ tasmāddadhātveṣa sanātanam|| 6.70.60 ||
yena tatra pramuñcāmi sutāya vijayāya ca ||
etadvīryaṃ mahātīvraṃ dvādaśārkasamaprabham || || 61 ||
atha prāhuḥ surāḥ sarve vahniṃ saṃślāghya sādarāḥ ||
tvaṃ dhārayāgne vaktrāṃte vīryametadbhavodbhavam || 62 ||
tataḥ prasārayāmāsa svavaktraṃ pāvako drutam||
kurvañchakrasamādeśamavikalpena cetasā ||63||
śaṃkaro'pyakṣipattatra kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ ||
gaurīṃ bhagavatīṃ dhyāyannānandaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ||64||
pāvako'pi bhṛśaṃ tena kalpāgnisadṛśena ca ||
dahyamāno'kṣipadbhūmau śarastaṃbe suvistare||65||
etasminnaṃtare prāptā bhramamāṇā itastataḥ||
bhāryāstatra munīnāṃ tāḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ ṣaṭkṛttikāḥ śubhāḥ||66||
tāsāṃ nideśayāmāsa svayameva śatakratuḥ ||
etadbījaṃ trinetrasya paripālyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 67 ||
atra saṃpatsyate putro dvādaśārkasamaprabhaḥ ||
bhavatīnāmapi prāyaḥ putratvaṃ saṃprayāsyati || 68 ||
iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kārtikeyotpattivṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 6.70 || || cha ||

<6.71>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tāstatheti pratijñāya cakrustacchakraśāsanam ||
sūtikāgṛhadharme yattaccakrustasya sarvaśaḥ || 1 ||
athānyadivase bālo dvādaśārkasamadyutiḥ ||
saṃjajñe tena vīryeṇa dvibhujaika mukhaḥ śubhaḥ || 2 ||
yathāsau jātamātrastu praruroda suduḥkhitaḥ ||
tacchrutvā ruditaṃ sarvāḥ kṛttikāstamupāgatāḥ || 3 ||
mahāseno'pi saṃvīkṣya mātṝstāḥ samupāgatāḥ||
sotkaṇṭhaḥ ṣaṇmukho jāto dvādaśākṣabhujastathā || 4 ||
ekaikasyāḥ pṛthaktena prapapau prayataḥ stanam ||
dvābhyāmāliṃgayāmāsa bhujābhyāṃ snehapūrvakam|| 5 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ||
sarve devāḥ sahendreṇa gandharvāpsarasastathā || 6 ||
mahotsavo'tha saṃjajñe tasminsthāne nirargalaḥ ||
gītavādyapraṇādena yenaviśvaṃ prapūritam || 7 ||
raṃbhādyā nanṛtustasya vilāsinyo divaukasām ||
jaguśca mukhyagandharvā ścitrāṃgadamukhāśca ye || 8 ||
tatastu devatāḥ sarvāstasya nāma pracakrire ||
skandanādretaso bhūmau skanda ityeva sādaram || 9 ||
atha tasya kumā rasya tadā tatrābhiṣecanam ||
senāpatyaṃ kṛtaṃ sākṣāddevānāṃ śaṃbhunā svayam || 6.71.10 ||
tasya śaktiḥ svayaṃ dattā vidhinā'dbhutadarśanā ||
amoghā vijayārthāya daityapakṣakṣayāya ca || 11 ||
mayūro vāhanārthāya tryaṃbakeṇa suśīghrataḥ ||
divyāstrāṇi mahendreṇa viṣṇunātha mahātmanā || 12 ||
tato'bhīṣṭāni śastrāṇi devaiḥ sarvaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||
tasya dattāni saṃtuṣṭaistathā mātṛgaṇairapi || 13 ||
tatastamagrataḥ kṛtvā senānāthaṃ sureśvarāḥ ||
jagmuḥ sasainikāstatra tārako yatra saṃsthitaḥ || 14 ||
tārako'pi samālokya devānsvayamupāgatān ||
yuddhārthaṃ harṣasaṃyuktaḥ sammukhaḥ satvaraṃ yayau || 15 ||
tato'bhūtsumahadyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha ||
kopasaṃraktanetrāṇāṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam || 16 ||
atha skandena saṃvīkṣya dūrasthaṃ tārakaṃ raṇe ||
samāhūya tato muktā sā śaktistasya mṛtyave || 17 ||
athāsau hṛdayaṃ bhittvā tasya daityasya dāruṇā ||
camatkārapuropāṃte patitā rudhirokṣitā || 18 ||
tārakastu gato nāśaṃ muktaḥ prāṇaiśca tatkṣaṇāt ||
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve saṃhṛṣṭāstaṃ mahābalam || 19 ||
stotrairbahuvidhaiḥ stutvā procustasminhate sati ||
gatāśca tridivaṃ tūrṇaṃ saha śakreṇa nirbhayāḥ || 6.71.20 ||
skando'pi tāṃ samādāya śaktiṃ tatra purottame ||
sthāpayāmāsa yenaiva raktaśṛṃgo'bhavaddṛḍhaḥ || || 21 ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
raktaśṛṃgaḥ kathaṃ tena niścalo'pi dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ ||
kasya vākyena no brūhi vistareṇa mahāmate || 22 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
yadā vai bhūmikampastu saṃprajātaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||
raktaśṛṅgaḥ pracalitaḥ svasthānādativegataḥ || 23 ||
tasya daityasya pātena yathānye parva tottamāḥ ||
atha harmyāṇi sarvāṇi camatkārapure tadā || 24 ||
śīrṇāni calite tasminparvate vyathitā dvijāḥ ||
prāyaśo nidhanaṃ prāptāstathā'nye mūrchayārditāḥ || 25 ||
hataśeṣāstato viprā gatvā skandaṃ krudhānvitāḥ ||
procuśca kimidaṃ pāpa tvayā kṛtamabuddhinā || 26 ||
nāśaṃ nītā vayaṃ sarve saputrapaśubādhavāḥ ||
tasmācchāpaṃ pradāsyāmo vayaṃ duḥkhena duḥkhitāḥ || 27 ||
|| skanda uvāca || ||
hitāya sarvalokānāṃ mayaitatsamanuṣṭhitam ||
yaddhato dānavo raudro nānyathā dvijasattamāḥ || 28 ||
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ tasmānmānyā me brāhmaṇāḥ sadā ||
mṛtānapi dvijānsarvānahaṃ tānamṛtāśrayāt|| 29 ||
punarjīvitasaṃyuktānkariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||
tathā suniścalaṃ śailaṃ kariṣyāmi svaśaktitaḥ || 6.71.30 ||
evamuktvā samādāya tāṃ śaktiṃ rudhirokṣitām ||
cakre sthāpanamasyāstu raktaśṛṅgasya mūrdhani || 31 ||
tataḥ provāca saṃhṛṣṭo devatānāṃ catuṣṭayam ||
āṃbavṛddhāṃ tathaivāmrāṃ māhitthāṃ ca camatkarīm || 32 ||
yuṣmābhirniścalaḥ kāryo bhūyo'yaṃ nagasattamaḥ ||
pralaye'pi yathā sthānādraktaśṛṅgaścalennahi || 33 ||
sadaiva khyātimāyātu mannāmnā puramuttamam||32||
yuṣmākaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarve pūjāṃ dāsyaṃti sarvadā||34||
bāḍhamityeva tāḥ procya caturdikṣu tataśca tam||
śūlāgraiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ cakruḥ skandavākyena harṣitāḥ||
tataścāmṛtamādāya mṛtānapi dvijottamān||
skando jīvāpayāmāsa dvijabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ||36||
tataste brāhmaṇāstatra saṃhṛṣṭā varamuttamam ||
dadustasya sa ca prāha mannāmaitatpurottamam ||
sadaiva khyātimāyātu etanme hṛdi vāṃchitam || 37 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
etatskandapuraṃnāma tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati ||
camatkārapuraṃ tadvatsāṃprataṃ surasattama || 38 ||
pūjāṃ tava kariṣyāmaḥ kṛtvā prāsādamutta mam ||
tathaiva devatāḥ sarvāścatasro'pi tvayā dhṛtāḥ || 39 ||
sarvāḥ saṃpūjayiṣyāmaḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu sādaram||
etāṃ caṃ tāvakīṃ śaktiṃ sadā suravarottama ||
viśeṣātpūjayiṣyāmaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śraddhāsamanvitāḥ || 6.71.40 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sa brāhmaṇaiḥ prokto mahāseno mahābalaḥ ||
sthitastatraiva tadvā kyājjñātvā tatkṣetramuttamam || 41 ||
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā caitraṣaṣṭhyāṃ subhāvataḥ ||
śuklāyāṃ tasya saṃtuṣṭiṃ kurute barhivāhanaḥ || 42 ||
tasyāṃ śaktau naro yaśca kuryātpṛṣṭhinigharṣaṇam||
pūjayitvā tu puṣpādyaiḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
sa na syādrogasaṃyukto yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ || 43 ||
evaṃ tatra dhṛtā śaktistena skandena dhīmatā ||
raktaśṛṃgasya rakṣārthaṃ tatpurasya viśeṣataḥ || 44 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye skandasthāpitaśaktimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 71 || || dha ||

<6.72>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatraiva sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa bhūbhujā ||
duryodhanena cālokya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 1 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kasminkāle narendreṇa dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa bhūbhujā ||
tatra saṃsthāpitaṃ ligaṃ vada tvaṃ raumaharṣaṇe || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
āsīdbhānumatīnāma balabhadrasutā purā ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā rūpau dāryaguṇānvitā || 3 ||
tāṃ dadāvatha patnyarthe dhārtarāṣṭrāya dhīmate ||
duryodhanāya saṃmantrya viṣṇunā saha yādavaḥ || 4 ||
atha nāgapurātsarve bhīṣma droṇādayaśca ye ||
kauravāḥ prasthitāstūrṇaṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prati ||5||
tathā pāṃḍusutāḥ paṃca parivārasamanvitāḥ||
saubhrātraṃ manyamānāste duryodhanasamanvi tāḥ ||
jagmurdvāravatīṃ hṛṣṭāḥ sainyena mahatānvitāḥ ||6||
atha krameṇa gacchaṃtaste sarve kurupāṇḍavāḥ ||
ānartaviṣayaṃ prāptā dhanadhānyasamākulam ||7||
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ yatra tatkṣetramuttamam||
hāṭakeśvaradevasya vikhyātaṃ bhuvanatraye || 8 ||
atha prāha viśuddhātmā vṛddhaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ ||
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ mahīpālaṃ saputraṃ prahasanniva || 9 ||
|| bhīṣma uvāca || ||
etadvatsa purā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā kṣetramanuttamam||
hāṭakeśvaradevasya sarvapātakanāśanam || 6.72.10 ||
atrāhaṃ caiva ni rmuktaḥ strīhatyodbhavapātakāt ||
tasmādatraiva rājeṃdra tiṣṭhāmaḥ paṃcavāsarān ||11||
yena sarvāṇi paśyāmastīrthānyāyatanāni ca||
yānyatra saṃti puṇyāni munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ||12||
atha tadvacanādrājā dhṛtarāṣṭroṃ'bikāsutaḥ ||
śatasaṃkhyaiḥ sutaiḥ sārdhaṃ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ ||13||
jagāma satvaraṃ tatra yatra tatkṣetramuttamam ||
tapasvigaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ yuktaṃ caivāśramaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 14 ||
brahmaghoṣeṇa mahatā nāditaṃ sarvatodiśam ||
vahnipūjotthadhūmreṇa kaluṣīkṛtapāda pam ||
krīḍāmṛgaiśca saṃkīrṇaṃ dhāvadbhirbahubhistathā || 15 ||
tato nivārya sainyaṃ svamupadravabhayānnṛpaḥ ||
pañcabhiḥ pāṃḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ śatasaṃkhyaistathā sutaiḥ || || 16 ||
bhīṣmeṇa somadattena bāhlīkena samanvitaḥ||
droṇācāryeṇa vīreṇa tatputreṇa kṛpeṇa ca ||17||
saubalena ca karṇena tathānyairapi pārthivaiḥ||
parivāraparityaktaistasminkṣetre cacāra saḥ || 18 ||
te'pi sarve mahātmānaḥ kṣatriyāstatra saṃsthitāḥ ||
cakrurdharmakriyāḥ sarvāḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 19 ||
snānaṃ cakrurvidhānena tīrtheṣu dvijasattamāḥ ||
bhrāṃtvābhrāṃtvā supuṇyeṣu śrutvāśrutvā dvijanmanām || 6.72.20 ||
dānāni ca viśiṣṭāni daduriṣṭāni cāpare ||
dīnebhyaḥ kṛpaṇebhyaśca tapasvibhyo viśeṣataḥ || 21 ||
cakruḥ śrāddhakriyāścānye pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ ||
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cānye tilamiśra jalena ca || 22 ||
anye homakriyā bhūpā japamanye nirargalam ||
svādhyāyamapare śāntāḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitāḥ || 23 ||
devatāyatanānyanye māhātmyasahitāni ca ||
śrutvā pūrvanṛpāṇāṃ ca pūjayaṃti viśeṣataḥ || 24 ||
balidānaiḥ suvastraiśca gandhapuṣpopalepanaiḥ ||
mārjanaidhvajadānaiśca tathā prekṣaṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 25 ||
maṃḍanaiḥ puṣpamālābhiḥ samaṃtāddvijasattamāḥ ||
hastyaśvarathadānaiśca gorbhirvastraiśca kāṃcanaiḥ ||
kṛtārthā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve kṛtāstai statra bhaktitaḥ || 26 ||
evaṃ snātvā tathā'bhyarcya devānviprānnṛpottamāḥ ||
dhṛtarāṣṭrasamāyuktā jagmuḥ svaśibiraṃ tataḥ || 27 ||
śaṃsanto vismayā viṣṭāstīrthānyāyatanāni ca ||
tasminkṣetre dvijāṃścaiva tāpasānsaṃśitavratān || 28 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dhṛtarāṣṭrādikṛtahāṭakeśvarakṣetradarśanavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 72 || || cha ||

<6.73>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ te kauravāḥ sarve pāṃḍoḥ putrāśca śālinaḥ ||
tasmātsthānāttato jagmuryatra dvāravatī purī || 1 ||
tatra gatvā vivāhaṃ tu cakruḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ||
duryodhanasya bhūpasya bhānumatyā samaṃ tadā || 2 ||
nānāvāditraghoṣeṇa vedadhvaniyutena ca ||
gītairmanoharaiḥ pāṭhairbandināṃ ca sahasraśaḥ || 3 ||
evaṃ mahotsavo jajñe tatra yāvaddināṣṭakam ||
yādavānāṃ kurūṇāṃ ca militānāṃ parasparam || 4 ||
kṛtārthāstatra saṃjātāḥ sūtamāgadha bandinaḥ ||
cāraṇā brāhmaṇeṃdrāśca tathānye'pi ca tārkikāḥ || 5 ||
tatastu navame prāpte divase kurupāṃḍavāḥ ||
bhīṣmādyāḥ puṃḍarīkākṣamidamūcuḥ sasauhṛ dam || 6 ||
na vayaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣa tava rāmasya cāśrayam ||
kathaṃcittyaktumicchāmaḥ snehapāśaniyaṃtritāḥ || 7 ||
tathāpi ca pragantavyaṃ svapuraṃ prati mādha va ||
balabhadrasamāyuktastasmānnaḥ kuru mokṣaṇam || 8 ||
|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||
na tāvadvatsaro jāto na māsaḥ pakṣa eva ca ||
sthitānāmatra yuṣmākaṃ tatkimautsukyamāgatam || 9 ||
tasmādatraiva tiṣṭhāmaḥ sahitāḥ kurupāṃḍavāḥ ||
yūyaṃ vayaṃ vinodena mṛgayākṣodbhavena ca || 6.73.10 ||
śastraśikṣākriyābhiśca damanena ca dantinām ||
tathābhivāṃchitairanyaiḥ sneho'sti yadi vo mayi || 11 ||
|| bhīṣma uvāca || ||
upapannamidaṃ viṣṇo yattvayā vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ ||
paraṃ śṛṇuṣva me vākyaṃ yadarthaṃ hyutsukā vayam || 12 ||
ānartaviṣaye'smābhirāgacchadbhistavāṃtikam ||
dṛṣṭamatyadbhutaṃ kṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarajaṃ mahat ||
tatra liṃgāni dṛṣṭāni bhūpatīnāṃ mahātmanām || 13 ||
sūryacandrānvayotthānāmanyeṣāṃ ca mahātmanām || 14 ||
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
sākārāṇi sutejāṃsi nānāprāsādabhoji ca || 15 ||
tataśca kurumukhyānāṃ pāṃḍavānāṃ ca mādhava ||
liṃgasaṃsthāpanārthāya tatra jātā matirdṛḍhā || 16 ||
te vayaṃ tatra gatvāśu yathāśaktyā yathecchayā ||
liṃgāni sthāpayiṣyāmaḥ svānisvāni pṛthakpṛthak || 17 ||
etasmātkāraṇāttūrṇaṃ calitā vayamacyuta ||
na vayaṃ tava saṃgasya tṛpyāmo'bdaśatairapi || 18 ||
tasmādājñāpayasvādya kṛtvā cittaṃ dṛḍhaṃ vibho ||
bhūyo'pyatrāgamiṣyāmastava darśanalālasāḥ || 19 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
ahaṃ jānāmi tatkṣetraṃ supuṇyaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
tāpasaiḥ kīrtitaṃ nityaṃ mamānyaistīrthayātrikaiḥ || 6.73.20 ||
tasmāttatra sameṣyāmo yuṣmābhiḥ sahitā vayam ||
liṃga saṃsthāpanārthāya kṣetradarśanavāṃchayā || 21 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchutvā kauravāḥ sarve paraṃ harṣamupāgatāḥ ||
tathā pāṃḍusutāścaiva ye cānye tatra pārthivāḥ || 22 |
te tu saṃprasthitāḥ sarve militāḥ kurupāṃḍavāḥ ||
gajavājivimardena kampayanto vasundharām || 23 ||
atha tatkṣetramāsādya dūre kṛtvā niveśanam ||
kauravā yādavā mukhyāścamatkārapuraṃ gatāḥ || 24 ||
tatra sarvānsamāhūya brāhmaṇānvinayānvitāḥ ||
procurdattvā vicitrāṇi bhūṣaṇācchādanāni ca || 25 ||
vayaṃ sarve'tra vāṃchāmo ligasaṃsthāpanakriyām ||
kartuṃ prāsādamukhyānāṃ pṛthaktvena svaśaktitaḥ || 26 ||
tasmātkṛtvā prasādaṃ no dayāṃ ca dvijasattamāḥ ||
ājñāpayata śīghraṃ hi yena karma pravartate || 27 ||
bhaviṣyatha tathā yūyaṃ hotāraḥ sarvakarmasu ||
na cānyo brāhmaṇo bāhyo yadyapi syādbṛhaspatiḥ || 28 ||
yato'smābhiḥ śrutā vārtā kīrtyamānā purātanī ||
viṣṇunā tasya rājarṣeḥ pretaśrāddhasamudbhavā || 29 ||
yathā tena kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ pituḥ pretasya yatnataḥ ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ puro'nyeṣāṃ yathoktānāmapi dvijāḥ || 6.73.30 ||
yathoktavidhinā tīrthe nāgānāṃ paṃcamīdine ||
śrāvaṇe māsi no muktaḥ pitā tasya tathāpi saḥ || 31 ||
pretatvātsarpadoṣeṇa saṃjātā dvijasattamāḥ ||
devaśarmapuro yāvattatkṛtaṃ śrāddhamādarāt ||
tāvatpitā vinirmuktaḥ pretatvāddāruṇāddvijāḥ || 32 ||
yadatra kriyate kiṃcitkarma dharmyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
tadbāhyaṃ ca bhavedvyarthametadvidmaḥ sphuṭaṃ vayam || || 33 ||
prārthayāmo viśeṣeṇa tena dainyaṃ samāgatāḥ ||
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ tasmādājñāṃ yacchata mā ciram || 34 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brāhmaṇāste parasparam ||
mantraṃ cakrustadarthaṃ hi kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet || 35 ||
eke procurna dāsyāmaḥ prāsādārthaṃ vasundharām ||
eteṣāmapi caikasya tasmādgacchaṃtu satvaram || 36 ||
paṃcakrośapramāṇena kṣetrametadvyavasthitam ||
pūrveṣāmapi devānāṃ prāsādaistatsamāvṛtam || 37 ||
anye procurdhanomattā yūyaṃ ca sukhamāśritāḥ ||
dāridyārtiṃ na jānītha brūtha tena bhṛśaṃ vacaḥ || 38 ||
tasmādvayaṃ pradāsyāma eteṣāṃ hi vasu ndharām ||
arthasiddhirbhavedyena bhūṣā sthānasya jāyate || 39 ||
tathānye madhyamāḥ procuryatra sākṣājjanārdanaḥ ||
svayaṃ prārthayate bhūmiṃ tatkasmānna pradīyate || 6.73.40 ||
tasmādyatra samāyātāḥ kurupāṃḍavayādavāḥ ||
prādhānyena prakurvaṃtu prāsādāṃstena cāpare || 41 ||
yācate yatra gāṃgeyaḥ svayameva tathā paraḥ ||
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputraśca pāṃḍavāśca mahābalāḥ ||
liṃgasaṃsthāpanārthāya niṣedhastatra nārhati || 42 ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratipannaṃ dvijottamaiḥ ||
nirdhanaiḥ sadhanaiścāpi saspṛhairniḥspṛhairapi || 43 ||
tataḥ sametya te sarve brāhmaṇāḥ kurusattamān ||
yādavānpāṃḍavānprocuḥ kṛtvā vai mantraniścayam || 44 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
etatsvalpataraṃ kṣetraṃ sarveṣāmapi bhūbhujām ||
prāsādaiḥ sarvato vyāptaṃ tatkiṃ brūmo'dhunā vayam || 45 ||
tadbhavaṃtaḥ prakurvaṃtu prādhānyena yadṛcchayā ||
kṣetre'traivābhimukhyena prāsādānsumanoharān ||
yathājyeṣṭhaṃ yathāśreṣṭhaṃ pṛthaktvena vyavasthitāḥ || 46 ||
atha harṣasamāyuktā dhṛtarāṣṭramukhāḥ kramāt ||
prādhānyena yathāśreṣṭhaṃ cakruḥ prāsādapaddhatim || 47 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dhṛtarāṣṭrādikṛtaprāsādasthāpanodyamavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 73 || 

<6.74>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa bhūpena śataputrānvitena ca ||
liṃgānāṃ sthāpitaṃ tatra śatamekottaraṃ dvijāḥ || 1 ||
tathā ca pāṃḍavaiḥ sarvaiḥ sthāpitaṃ liṃgapaṃcakam ||
draupadyā cā'tha kuntyā'tha gāṃdhāryā'tha yadṛcchayā || 2 ||
bhānumatyā ca gaurīṇāṃ sthāpitaṃ ca catuṣṭayam ||
vidureṇātha śalyena kaliṃ gena yuyutsunā || 3 ||
bāhlīkena saputreṇa karṇenātha sasūnunā ||
tathā śakuninā tatra droṇena ca kṛpeṇa ca || 4 ||
aśvatthāmnā pṛthaktvena liṅgamekaikamuttamam ||
sthāpitaṃ parayā bhaktyā varaprāsādamāśritam || 5 ||
tathā saṃsthāpitaṃ tatra viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ||
liṃgaṃ prāsādamādhāya prottuṃgaśikharānvitam || 6 ||
sātvatenāpi sāṃbena balabhadreṇa dhīmatā ||
pradyumenāniruddhena tathānyairmukhyayādavaiḥ || 7 ||
cārudeṣṇādibhiḥ putrai rukmiṇyā daśabhiḥ sutaiḥ ||
liṃgānāṃ daśakaṃ mukhyaṃ sthāpitaṃ śraddhayānvitaiḥ || 8 ||
evaṃ saṃsthāpya liṅgāni te sarve kurupāṃḍavāḥ ||
yādavāśca susaṃhṛṣṭā kṛtakṛtyāstadā| 'bhavan || 9 ||
tatra sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ||
dhanāḍhyānbrāhmaṇānkṛtvā camatkārapurodbhavān || 6.74.10 ||
dattvā tebhyo varānnāgānha yāñjātyānanekaśaḥ||
sadgrāmāṇi vicitrāṇi kṣetrāṇi ca sudhenavaḥ || 11 ||
mahokṣāṃśca suvastrāṇi bhūsthānānyāśrayāṃstathā ||
dāsīdāsāṃstathā bhṛtyāndānāni vividhāni ca || 12 ||
tata āmantrya tānsarvānpraṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ||
svasthānaṃ prati saṃhṛṣṭāḥ prajagmuḥ sarva eva te || 13 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ sthāpitaṃ tena bhūbhujā ||
tathā taddhṛtarāṣṭreṇa liṃgaṃ pātakanāśanam || 14 ||
tathānyairapi bhūpālaiḥ prādhānyena vyavasthitaiḥ ||
pāṇḍavairyādavaiścaiva pṛthaktvena vyavasthitaiḥ ||15||
yastāni puruṣaḥ samyakpūjayedbhaktibhāvitaḥ ||
sa labheccākhilānkāmānvāṃchitānsvena cetasā || 16 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhenāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kauravapāṇḍavayādavakṛtaliṃga pratiṣṭhāvṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||

<6.75>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
purā kalpe bhagavatā etatkṣetramanuttamam ||
rudreṇa brahmaṇe dattaṃ tuṣṭena dvijasattamāḥ || 1 ||
yadā tu sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ||
devaiḥ prītena rudreṇa pradattaṃ brahmaṇe punaḥ || 2 ||
etatkṣetraṃ tadā dattaṃ śaṃbhunā ṣaṇmukhasya ha ||
rakṣaṇārthaṃ hi viprāṇāṃ kalikālādidoṣataḥ ||3||
brahmaṇā prārthitenedaṃ svayamādimamuttamam ||
pitrādiṣṭastu gāṃgeyastatra vāsamathākarot || 4 ||
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge yaḥ kuryātsvāmidarśanam ||
saptajanma bhavedvipro dhanāḍhyo vedapāragaḥ ||5||
mahāsenasya devasya prāsādaṃ sumanoharam||
uccaiḥ sthitaṃ sarvaloke pātukāmamivāṃbaram || 6 ||
tacchrutvā vibudhāḥ sarve kautukādetya satvaram ||
vīkṣāṃcakrustato gatvā dṛṣṭvā medhyatamaṃ puram || 7 ||
prāsādasyottare deśe prācye deśe tathā dvijāḥ ||
yajñakriyāsamāraṃbhāṃścakurviprairyathoditān ||8||
iṣṭvā ca vibudhāḥ sarve dattvā tebhyaśca dakṣiṇām ||
jagmustriviṣṭapaṃ hṛṣṭā labdhvā tatsthānajaṃ phalam || 9 ||
tatastu devayajanaṃnāma tasya babhūva ha ||
yadanyatra śataṃ kṛtvā kratūnāṃ phalamāpnuyāt ||
tadatraikena labhate kratunā dakṣiṇāvatā || 6.75.10 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yajña bhūmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 75 || || a ||

<6.76>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyadapi tatrāsti bhāskaratritayaṃ śubham ||
yaistuṣṭaistriṣu lokeṣu mānavo muktimāpnuyāt || 1 ||
muṇḍīraṃ prathamaṃ tatra kālapriyaṃ tathāparam ||
mūlasthānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca sarvavyādhivināśanam || 2 ||
tatra saṃkramate sūryo muṃḍīre rajanīkṣaye ||
kālapriye ca madhyāhne mūlasthāne kṣapāgame || 3 ||
tasminkāle naro bhaktyā paśyedapyekamevaca ||
kṛtakṣaṇo naro mokṣaṃ satyaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ || 4 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
muṃḍīraḥ pūrvadigbhāge dharitryāḥ śrūyate kila ||
madhye kālapriyo devo mūlasthānaṃ tadantare || 5 ||
tatkathaṃ te trayastatra saṃjātāḥ sūta bhāskarāḥ ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sarvaṃ no brūhi vistarāt || 6 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
asti sāgaraparyaṃte viṭaṃkapuramuttamam ||
samudravīcisaṃsaktaproccaprākāramaṇḍanam || 7 ||
tatrābhūdbrāhmaṇaḥ kaścitkuṣṭhavyādhisamanvitaḥ ||
pūrvakarmavipākena yauvanesamupasthite || 8 ||
tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī kulīnā śīlamaṃḍanā ||
tathābhūtamapi prāyaḥ sā paśyati yathā smaram || 9 ||
auṣadhāni vicitrāṇi mahārghyāṇyapi cādade ||
tadarthamupalepāṃśca pathyāni vividhāni ca || 6.76.10 ||
tathā bhiṣagvarānnityamānināya ca sādaram ||
tadarthe na guṇastasya tathāpi syāccharīrajaḥ || 11 ||
yathāyathā sa gṛhṇāti bheṣajāni dvijottamāḥ ||
kuṣṭhena sarvagātreṣu vyāpyate ca tathātathā || 12 ||
athaivaṃ vartamānasya tasya vipravarasya ca ||
gṛhe'tithiḥ samāyātaḥ kaścitpāṃthaḥ śramānvitaḥ || 13 ||
atha vipraṃ gṛhaṃ prāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya satī priyā ||
ajñātamapisadbhaktyā sūpacārairatoṣayat || 14 ||
atha taṃ snātamācāṃtaṃ kṛtāhāraṃ dvijottamam ||
viśrāntaṃ śayane vipraḥ provāca sa gṛhādhipaḥ || 15 ||
tejo'nvitaṃ yathā bhānuṃ rūpaudāryaguṇānvitam ||
yauvane vartamānaṃ ca mūrtaṃ kāmamivāparam || 16 ||
|| kuṣṭhyuvāca || ||
kuta āgamyate vipra kva yāsyasi vadā'dhunā ||
evaṃ lāvaṇyayukto'pi kimekākī yathārtibhāk || 17 ||
|| pathika uvāca || ||
asti kāntīpurīnāma puraṃdarapurī yathā ||
susthitaiḥ sevitā nityaṃ janairdharmavratānvitaiḥ || 18 ||
tasyāmahaṃ kṛtāvāso gṛhasthāśramamāvahan ||
grastaḥ kuṣṭhena raudreṇa yathā tvaṃ dvijasattama || 19 ||
tataḥ śrutaṃ mayā tāvatpurāṇe skāndasaṃjñite ||
bhāskaratritayaṃ bhūmau sarvavyādhivināśanam || 6.76.20 ||
tato nirvedamāpanno bheṣajaiḥ kleśitaściram ||
kṣāraiścāmlaiḥ kaṣāyaiśca kaṭukairatha tiktakaiḥ || 21 ||
tato viniścayaṃ citte kṛtvā gṛhya dhanaṃ mahat ||
muṇḍīrasvāminaṃ gatvā sthitastasyaiva sannidhau || 22 ||
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya nityaṃ paśyāmi taṃ vibhum ||
pūjayāmi svaśaktyā ca praṇamāmi tataḥ param|| 23 ||
sūryavāre viśeṣeṇa nirāhāro yatendriyaḥ ||
karomi jāgaraṃ rātrau gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ || 24 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte taṃ praṇamya dinādhipam ||
kālapriyaṃ tataḥ paścācchraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || 25 ||
tenaiva vidhinā vipra tasyāpi divaseśituḥ ||
pūjāṃ karomi madhyāhne śraddhā pūtena cetasā || 26 ||
tato'pi vatsarasyāṃte taṃ praṇamyātha śaktitaḥ ||
mūlasthānaṃ gato devamaparasyāṃ diśi sthitam || 27 ||
tenaiva vidhinā pūjā tasyāpi vihitā mayā ||
saṃdhyākāle dvijaśreṣṭha yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ sthitaḥ || 28 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte svapne māṃ bhāskaro'bravīt ||
sametya prahasanvipraḥ saṃprahṛṣṭena cetasā || 29 ||
parituṣṭo'smi te vipra karmaṇā'nena bhaktitaḥ ||
mamārādhanajenaiva tasmātkuṣṭhaṃ prayātu te || 6.76.30 ||
gaccha śīghraṃ dvijaśreṣṭha śrāṃto'si nijamaṃdiram ||
paśya baṃdhujanaṃ sarvaṃ sotkaṇṭhaṃ tatkṛte sthitam || 31 ||
tvayā hṛtaṃ purā rukmaṃ brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ ||
tena karmavipākena kuṣṭhavyādhirupasthitaḥ || 32||
sa mayā nāśitastubhyaṃ prahṛṣṭenādhunā dvija ||
etajjñātvā na kartavyaṃ suvarṇaharaṇaṃ punaḥ || 33 ||
dṛśyante ye narā loke kuṣṭhavyādhisamākulāḥ ||
suvarṇaharaṇaṃ sarvaistaiḥ kṛtaṃ pāpakarmabhiḥ || 34 ||
tasmāddeyaṃ yathāśaktyā na steyaṃ kanakaṃ budhaiḥ ||
icchadbhiḥ paramaṃ saukhyaṃ svaśarīrasya śāśvatam || 35 ||
evamuktvā sahasrāṃśustataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
ahaṃ ca vismayāviṣṭaḥ protthitaḥ śayanāddrutam || || 36 ||
yāvatpaśyāmi dehaṃ svaṃ kuṣṭhavyādhiparicyutam ||
dvādaśārkaprabhaṃ divyaṃ yathā tvaṃ paśyase dvija || 37 ||
tasmāttvamapi vipreṃdra bhaktyā tadbhāskaratrayam ||
anena vidhinā paśya yena kuṣṭhaṃ praśāmyati ||38||
kimauṣadhaiḥ kimāhāṃraiḥ kaṭukairapi yojitaiḥ ||
sarvavyādhipraṇāśeśe sthite'sminbhāskaratraye || 39 ||
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ tāṃ purīṃ prati ||
gṛhe'dya tava viśrāṃto yathā vipra nije gṛhe || 6.76.40 ||
evamuktaḥ sa pāṃthena tena vipraḥ sa kuṣṭhabhāk ||
vīkṣāṃcakre tato vaktraṃ svapatnyā duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ || 41 ||
sā'bravīdyuktamuktaṃ te pāṃthenānena vallabha ||
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gaccha yatra tadbhāskaratrayam || 42 ||
ahaṃ tvayā samaṃ tatra śuśrūṣāniratā satī ||
gamiṣyāmi na saṃdehastasmādgaccha drutaṃ vibho || 43 ||
evamuktastayā so'tha vittamādāya bhūriśaḥ ||
prasthitaḥ kāṃtayā sārdhaṃ muṇḍīrasvāminaṃ prati || 44 ||
pratijñayā gamiṣyāmi draṣṭuṃ taddevatātrayam||
muṃḍīraṃ kālanāthaṃ ca mūla sthānaṃ ca bhāskaram || 45 ||
tataḥ kṛcchreṇa mahatā kuṣṭhavyādhisamākulaḥ ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre saṃprāptaḥ sa dvijottamāḥ || 46 ||
taddṛṣṭvā sumahatkṣetraṃ tāpasaughaniṣevitam ||
nirviṇṇaḥ kuṣṭharogeṇa pathi śrāṃto'bravītpriyām || 47 ||
ahaṃ nirvedamāpanno rogeṇātha bubhukṣayā ||
muṇḍīrasvāminaṃ yāvanna śakromi prasarpitum ||48||
tasmādatraiva dehaṃ svaṃ vihāsyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||
tvaṃ gaccha svagṛhaṃ kāṃte sārthamāsādya śobhanam ||49||
|| patnyuvāca || ||
abhukte tvayi no bhuktaṃ kadācitkāṃta vai mayā ||
ekāṃte'pi mahābhāga na suptaṃ jāgrati tvayi || 6.76.50 ||
tasmādetanmahākṣetraṃ saṃprāpya tvāṃ vyavasthitam||
paralokāya saṃtyajya kathaṃ gacchāmyahaṃ gṛham || 51 ||
darśayiṣye mukhaṃ teṣāṃ tvayā hīnā ahaṃ katham ||
bāṃdhavānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca anyeṣāṃ sudṛdā mapi ||52||
tasmāttvayā samaṃ nātha pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam ||
snehapāśavinirbaddhā satyenātmānamālabhe||53||
yāvatastava saṃjātā upavāsā mahāmate||
tāvaṃtaśca tathāsmākaṃ kathaṃ gacchāmi tadgṛham||54||
evaṃ tasyā viditvā sa niścayaṃ brāhmaṇastadā ||
citiṃ kṛtvā tu dāhārthaṃ tayā sārdhe tato'viśat || ||55||
bhāskaraṃ manasi dhyātvā yāvadagniṃ samādade ||
tāvatpaśyati cāgrasthaṃ sudīptaṃ puruṣatrayam||56||
taddṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭaḥ ka ete puruṣāstrayaḥ||
na kadācinmayā dṛṣṭā īdṛktejaḥsamanvitāḥ || 57 ||
|| puruṣā ūcuḥ || ||
mā tvaṃ mṛtyupathaṃ gaccha kṛtvā vairāgyamākulaḥ ||
vyāvṛtya svagṛhaṃ gaccha sva bhāryāsahito dvija || 58 ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
pratijñāya mayā pūrva gṛhaṃ muktaṃ nijaṃ yataḥ ||
muṇḍīrasvāminaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā'nyaṃ kālavallabham || || 59 ||
mūlasthānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tataḥ sasyaprabhakṣaṇam ||
so'haṃ tānavilokyātha kathaṃ gacchāmi mandiram ||
bhakṣayāmi tathā sasyaṃ tena tyakṣyāmi jīvitam|| 6.76.60 ||
|| puruṣā ūcuḥ || ||
vayaṃ te bhāskarā brahmaṃstrayo'traiva samāgatāḥ ||
tvadbhaktyākṛṣṭamanaso brūhi kiṃ karavāmahe || 61 || ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
yadi yūyaṃ samāyātāḥ svayameva mamāṃtikam ||
trayo'pi bhāskarā nāśameṣa kuṣṭhaḥ pragacchatu || 62 ||
tathā'traiva sadā stheyaṃ kṣetre yuṣmābhireva hi ||
sāṃnidhyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu gantavyaṃ ca yathā purā || 63 ||
|| bhāskarā ūcuḥ || ||
evaṃ vipra kariṣyāmaḥ sthāsyāmo 'tra sadā vayam ||
tvaṃ cāpi roganirmuktaḥ sukhaṃ prāpsyasyanuttamam || 64 ||
prāsādatritayaṃ tasmādasmadarthaṃ nirūpaya ||
yena trikālamāsādya gacchāmaḥ saṃnidhiṃ dvija || 65 ||
evamuktvā tu te sarve gatāścāddarśanaṃ tataḥ ||
so'pi paśyati kāyaṃ svaṃ yāvadrogavivarjitam || 66 ||
dvādaśārka pratīkāśaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam ||
tataḥ provāca tāṃ bhāryāṃ vinayāvanatāṃ sthitām || 67 ||
paśya tvaṃ subhrūrme gātraṃ yādṛgrūpaṃ punaḥ sthitam ||
prasādāddevadevasya bhāskarasyāṃśumālinaḥ || 68 ||
so'hamatra sthito nityaṃ pūjayiṣyāmi bhāskaram ||
na yāsyāmi punaḥ sadma satyametanmayoditam||69||
evamuktvā sa viprendrastasminkṣetre suśobhane||
prāsādatritayaṃ ramyaṃ nirmame bhaktisaṃyutaḥ||6.76.70||
muṇḍīrasvāminaścaikamanyatkālapriyasya ca||
mūlasthānasya cānyattu satpatākāvibhūṣitam||71||
trayāṇāmapi teṣāṃ tu sādhvarcāḥ śāstrasūcitāḥ||
sthāpayāmāsa sūryāṇāṃ hastārke sūryavāsare || 72 ||
tatastāḥ puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ samabhyarcya ciraṃ dvijaḥ ||
trisaṃdhyaṃ kramaśaḥ prāpto dehāṃte bhāskarālayam || 73 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ te tatra saṃjātāstrayo'pi dvijasattamāḥ ||
bhāskarā bhaktalokasya sarvavyādhivināśakāḥ || 74 ||
yastānpaśyati kāle sve yathokte sūraryavāsare ||
sa vāṃchitām̐llabhetkāmāndurlabhānapi mānavaiḥ ||75||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye muṃḍīrakālapriyamūlasthānapratiṣṭhāvarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 76 || || cha ||

<6.77>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ tatra tau parameśvarau ||
umāmaheśvarau sūta hariścandreṇa bhūbhujā || 1 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

tatastaddarśanārthāya sa upāyaṃ vyalo kayat ||

reto'vaskandanāttasya kopādetaduvāca ha || 6.77.40 ||
kimetadvihitaṃ pāpa tvayā karma vigarhitam ||
naivārhā mama kāntāyā vaktravīkṣā'nurāgataḥ || 41 ||
tvaṃ vetsi śaṃkareṇaitatkarmajālaṃ na viṃditam||

yatkiñcittriṣu lokeṣu jaṃgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathā ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca|| ||

|| pitāmaha uvāca || ||

<6.78>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
brahmaṇā katame sthāne tatra sūta kṛtaṃ tapaḥ ||
vālakhilyaiśca taiḥ sarvairmunibhiḥ śaṃsitavrataiḥ || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasyā vāyavyadigbhāge haravedyā dvijottamāḥ ||

tatrāścaryamabhūdyadvai pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇa sattamāḥ ||
āśrame caturāsyasya tadvo vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam || 3 ||
tatra duścāriṇī kācidrātrau brāhmaṇavaṃśajā ||
devadattaṃ samāsādya vallabhaṃ ramate sadā || || 4 ||

kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ samāsādya vijane hṛṣṭamānasā || 5 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya dṛṣṭā sā kenaci ddvijāḥ ||

abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ nindamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || || 17 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃkruddhasya dvijanmanaḥ ||
saptārcirbhayasaṃtrastaḥ kṛtāṃjaliruvāca tam || 6.78.20 ||
|| agniruvāca || ||
naiṣa doṣo mama brahmanyanna dagdhā tava priyā ||
kṛtāgasā'pi me vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣvātra sphuṭeritam || 21 ||

|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||

na tasyāḥ sa jarāgrastaścitte vasati pārthivaḥ ||
tasmiṃstīrthe samāgatya vāṃchitaṃ ramate naraḥ || 43 ||
pārthivo'pi parijñāya tasyāstacca viceṣṭitam ||
kopāviṣṭastato gatvā tasminkṣetre suśobhane || 44 ||
tatkuṇḍaṃ pūrayāmāsa tataḥ pāṃśūtkarairdrutam ||
babhaṃja taṃ ca prāsādaṃ tataḥ provāca dāruṇam || 45 ||
yaścaitatpūritaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pāṃśunā nikhaniṣyati ||
prāsādaṃ ca punaścainaṃ kariṣyati punarnavam || 46 ||
paradārakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tasya saṃpatsyate'khilam ||
yadatra prakariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ kāmamohitāḥ ||47||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sa pārthivaḥ procya tāmādāya tataḥ priyām ||
jagāma svagṛhaṃ paścātprahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ||48||
atha tāṃ viratāṃ jñātvā so'nyacittāṃ priyāṃ nṛpaḥ ||
yatnena rakṣayāmāsa viśvāsaṃ naiva gacchati || 49 ||
anyasmindivase śastraṃ sūkṣmaṃ veṇyāṃ nidhāya sā||
jagāma śayanaṃ tasya vadhārthaṃ varavarṇinī||6.78.50||
tatastena samaṃ hāsyaṃ kṛtvā kṣatriyabhāvajam||
surataṃ rucirairbhāvairhāvairbhūribhireva ca ||51||
tato nidrāvaśaṃ prāptaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ sā nṛpapriyā ||
svaveṇyāḥ śastramādāya nijaghāna sunirdayā||52||
evaṃ tasya phalaṃ jātaṃ sadyastīrthasya bhaṃgajam ||
ānartādhipate raudraṃ sarvalokavigarhitam || 53 ||
adyāpi tatra deveśo rudraśīrṣaḥ sa tiṣṭhati ||
liṃgabhedabhayāttena na sa bhagno dvijottamāḥ ||54||
yastasya purataḥ sthitvā japedrudraśiraḥ śuciḥ ||
māghaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ pūjayitvā sragādibhiḥ ||55||
vāṃchitaṃ labhate cāśu tasyeśasya prabhāvataḥ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ yāvadyo japetpurataḥ sthitaḥ || 56 ||
rudraśīrṣaṃ na saṃdehaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
ekavāraṃ naro yo vā tatpuraḥ paṭhati dvijaḥ || 57 ||
nityaṃ dinakṛtātpāpānmucyate dvijasattamāḥ ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ rudraśīrṣasamudbhavam || 58 ||
māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ sadyo nāśanakārakam||
maṃgalaṃ paramaṃ hyetadāyuṣyaṃ kīrtivardhanam||
rudraśīrṣasya māhātmyaṃ tasmācchrotavyamādarāt || 59 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye rudraśīrṣa (jāgeśvara)māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 78 || || dha ||

<6.79>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge vālakhilyaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam ||
liṃgamasti suvikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 ||
yamārādhya ca taiḥ pūrvaṃ śakāmarṣasamanvitaiḥ ||
garuḍo janitaḥ pakṣī khyāto viṣṇuratho'tra yaḥ || 2 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kathaṃ teṣāṃ samutpannaḥ śakrasyopari sūtaja ||
prakopo vālakhilyānāṃ saṃjajñe garuḍaḥ katham || 3 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
purā prajāpatirdakṣastasminkṣetre suśobhane ||
cakāra vidhivadyajñaṃ saṃpūrṇavaradakṣiṇam || 4 ||
tataḥ śakrādayo devāḥ sahāyārthaṃ nimaṃtritāḥ ||
dakṣeṇa munayaścaiva tathā rājarṣayo'malāḥ || 5 ||
tathā vedavido viprā yajñakarmavicakṣaṇāḥ ||
gṛhasthāśramiṇo ye ca ye cāraṇyanivāsinaḥ|| 6 ||
atha te vālakhilyākhyā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ||
ekāṃ samidhamādāya sāhāyyārthaṃ prajāpateḥ ||
prasthitā yajñavāṭaṃ taṃ bhārārtāḥ kleśasaṃyutāḥ || 7 ||
atha teṣāṃ samastānāṃ mārge goṣpadamāgatam ||
jalapūrṇaṃ samāyātamakālajaladāgame || 8 ||
tatastarītu kāmāste kliśyamānā itastataḥ ||
samidbhāraśramopetā devarājena vīkṣitāḥ || 9 ||
gacchatā tena mārgeṇa makhe dakṣaprajāpateḥ ||
tataściraṃ samālokya smitaṃ kṛtvā sa kautukāt ||
jagāmātha samullaṃghya aiśvaryamadagarvitaḥ||6.79.10||
tataste kopasaṃyuktāḥ śakrāddṛṣṭvā parābhavam ||
nivṛtya svāśramaṃ gatvā cakrurmaṃtraṃ saniścayam || 11||
śākraṃ padaṃ samāsādya yasmādetena pāpmanā ||
atikrāṃtā vayaṃ sarve tasmātpātyaḥ sa satpadāt || 12 ||
anyaḥ śakraḥ prakartavyo maṃtravīryasamudbhavaḥ ||
ātharvaṇairmahāsūktairābhicārikasaṃbhavaiḥ || 13 ||
yena vyāpādyate tena śakro'yaṃ madagarvitaḥ ||
makhamāhātmyasaṃpannaḥ svalpabuddhiparā kramaḥ || 14 ||
tataste śucayo bhūtvā skaṃdasūktena pāvakam ||
juhuvuśca divārātrau kṣurikoktena sodyamāḥ || 158 ||
garbhopaniṣadenaiva nīlarudrairdvijottamāḥ ||
rudraśīrṣeṇa kāmyena viṣṇusūktayutena caṃ || 16 ||
nidhāya kalaśaṃ madhye maṃḍalasyodakāvṛtam ||
homāṃte tatra saṃsparśaṃ cakrustasya jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 17 ||
etasminnaṃtare śakraḥ prapaśyati sudāruṇān ||
utpātānātmanāśāya jāyamānānsamaṃtataḥ || 18 ||
vāmo bāhuśca netraṃ ca muhuḥ sphurati cāsya vai ||
na ca paśyati nāsāgraṃ jihvāgraṃ ca tathā hanum || 19 ||
śirohīnāṃ tathā chāyāṃ gagane bhāskaradvayam ||
aruṃdhatīṃ dhruvaṃ caiva na ca viṣṇupadāni saḥ || 6.79.20 ||
na ca maṃdaṃ na cākāśe saṃsthitāṃ svardhunīṃ hariḥ ||
svapanpaśyati kṛṣṇāṃgīṃ nityaṃ nārīṃ dhṛtāyudhām || 21 ||
muktakeśīṃ vivastrāṃ ca kṛṣṇadaṃtāṃ bhayānakām ||
tāndṛṣṭvā sa mahotpātāndevarājo bṛhaspatim || 22 ||
papraccha bhayasaṃtrastaḥ kimetaditi me guro ||
jāyaṃte sumahotpātā durnimittāni vai pṛthak || 23 ||
kiṃ me bhaviṣyati prājña vināśaḥ sāṃprataṃ vada ||
kiṃ vā trailokya rājyasya kiṃ vā vittādikasya ca || 24 ||
|| bṛhaspatiruvāca || ||
ye tvayā madamattena vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ ||
ullaṃghitāḥ sthitā mārge goṣpadaṃ tarttumicchavaḥ || 25 ||
tairevātharvaṇairmaṃtraistvakṛte'sti śacīpate ||
kṛto homaḥ susaṃpūrṇaḥ kalaśaścābhimaṃtritaḥ || 26 ||
yuṣmākaṃ suvināśāya sarvadevādhināyakaḥ ||
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho maṃtrairātharvaṇairhariḥ || 27 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sahasrākṣo bhayānvitaḥ ||
dakṣaṃ gatvā ca dīnāsyaḥ provāca tadanaṃtaram || 28 ||
asmannāśāya munibhirvālakhilyaiḥ prajāpate ||
prodyamo vihitaḥ samyakchakrasyānyasya vai kṛte || 29 ||
tānvāraya svayaṃ gatvā yāvanno jāyate paraḥ ||
śakro'smaddhvaṃsanārthāya nāsti teṣāmasādhyatā || 6.79.30 ||
atha dakṣo drutaṃ gatvā śakrādyairamarairvṛtaḥ ||
prahasaṃstānuvācedaṃ vinayena samanvitaḥ || 31 ||
kimetatkriyate viprāḥ karma raudratamaṃ mahat ||
trailokyaṃ vyākulaṃ yena sarvametadvyavasthitam || 32 ||
atha te dakṣamālokya samāyātaṃ svamāśrayam ||
saṃmukhāścābhyayustūrṇaṃ pragṛhītārghyapāṇayaḥ || 33 ||
arghyaṃ dattvā yathānyāyaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvātha bhaktitaḥ ||
procuśca praṇatā bhūtvā svāgataṃ te prajāpate || 34 ||
ādeśo dīyatāṃ śīghraṃ yadarthamiha cāgataḥ ||
api prāṇapradānena kariṣyāmaḥ priyaṃ tava || 35 || ||
|| dakṣa uvāca || ||
etadraudratamaṃ karma sarvadevabhayāvaham ||
tyājyaṃ yuṣmābhiravyagrairetadarthamihāgataḥ || 36 ||
|| munaya ūcuḥ || ||
vayaṃ śakreṇa te yajñe samāyātāḥ subhaktitaḥ ||
ullaṃghitā madodrekātkṛtvā hāsyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 37 ||
śakrocchedāya cāsmābhiḥ śako'nyo vīryamaṃtrataḥ ||
prārabdhaḥ kartumatyugrairhomāṃtaśca vyavasthitaḥ || 38 ||
tatkathaṃ maṃtravīryaṃ tatkriyate moghamityaho ||
vedoktaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tasmādatra vada prabho || 39 ||
tvameva yadi śaktaḥ syādanyathā kartumeva hi ||
kuruṣva vā svayaṃ nātha nāsmākaṃ śaktirīdṛśī || 6.79.40 ||
|| dakṣa uvāca || ||
satyametanmahābhāgā yadyuṣmābhiḥ prakīrtitam ||
nānyathā śakyate kartuṃ vedamantrodbhavaṃ balam || 41 ||
tadya eṣa kṛto homo yuṣmābhirvedamaṃtrataḥ ||
devarājārthamavyagraiḥ kalaśaścābhimaṃtritaḥ || 42 ||
so'yaṃ madvacanādrājā bhaviṣyati patatriṇām ||
tejovīryasamopetaḥ śakrādapi suvīryavān || 43 ||
etasya devarājasya kṣaṃtavyaṃ mama vākyataḥ ||
tatkṛtaṃ mūḍhabhāvena yadanena viceṣṭitam || 44 ||
evamuktvātha teṣāṃ taṃ sahasrākṣaṃ bhayāturam ||
darśayāmāsa dakṣastu vinayāvanataṃ sthitam || 45 ||
te'pi dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaṃ vepamānaṃ kṛtāṃjalim ||
procurmā'tikramaṃ śakra brāhmaṇānāṃ kariṣyasi || 46 ||
bhūyo yadi diveśānāmādhipatyaṃ pravāṃchasi ||
api mando'pi mūrkho'pi kriyāhīno'pi vā dvijaḥ ||
nāvajñeyo budhaiḥ kvāpi lokadvaya mabhīpsubhiḥ || 47 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
ajñānādyadi vā jñānādyanmayā kukṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
tatkṣaṃtavyaṃ dvijaiḥ sarvairviśeṣāddakṣa vākyataḥ || 48 ||
pragṛhyatāṃ varo'smākaṃ yaḥ sadā vartate hṛdi ||
pradāsyāmi na saṃdeho nādeyaṃ vidyate mama || 49 ||
|| munaya ūcuḥ || ||
asminkuṇḍe naro homaṃ yaḥ kuryācchraddhayā'nvitaḥ ||
etalliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya tasyā'stu hṛdi vāṃchitam || 6.79.50 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
etalliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya yo'tra homaṃ kariṣyati ||
kuṃḍe'tra vāṃchitaṃ sadyaḥ saphalaṃ sa hi lapsyate || 51 ||
niṣkāmo vā'tha saṃpūjya liṃgametacchubhāvaham ||
prayāsyati parāṃ siddhiṃ tridaśairapi durlabhām || 52 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā sahasrākṣo vālakhilyānmunīśvarān ||
airāvataṃ samāruhya dakṣayajñe tato gataḥ || 53 ||
dakṣo'pi vidhivadyajñaṃ cakāra dvijasattamāḥ ||
saṃhṛṣṭairvālakhilyaistairupaviṣṭaiḥ samīpataḥ || 54 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāha vālakhilyāśramamāhātmyakathanaṃnāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 79 || || dha || ||

<6.80>

atha suparṇākhyamāhātmyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ tejovīryasamanvitaḥ ||
garuḍastena saṃjajñe munīnāṃ homakarmaṇā || 1 ||
sa kathaṃ tatra saṃbhūta etanno vistarādvada ||
vinatāyāḥ samudbhūta ityeṣā śrūyate śrutiḥ || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
yo'sāvātharvaṇairmaṃtraiḥ kalaśaścābhimantritaḥ ||
tairmaṃtrairvālakhilyaiśca mahā'marṣasamanvitaiḥ || 3 ||
nivāritaiśca dakṣeṇa sūcite vihagādhipe ||
kaśyapastaṃ samādāya kalaśaṃ prayayau gṛham || 4 ||
tataḥ provāca saṃhṛṣṭo vinatāṃ dayitāṃ nijām ||
etatpiba jalaṃ bhadre mantrapūtaṃ mahattaram || 5 ||
yena te jāyate putraḥ sahasrākṣādhiko balī ||
tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca ajeyaḥ sarva dānavaiḥ || 6 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tatkṣaṇādeva saṃpapau ||
tattoyaṃ sā varārohā sadyo garbhaṃ tato dadhe || 7 ||
evaṃ tajjalapānena tejovīryasama nvitaḥ ||
kaśyapādgaruḍo jajñe sarvasarpabhayāvahaḥ || 8 ||
yenāmṛtaṃ hṛtaṃ vīryātparibhūya puraṃdaram ||
mātṛbhaktiparītena sarpāṇāṃ saṃniveditam || 9 ||
yo jajñe dayito viṣṇorvāhanatvamupāgataḥ ||
dhvajāgre tu rathasyāpi yaḥ sadaiva vyavasthitaḥ || 6.80.10 ||
yena pūrvaṃ tapastaptvā kṣetre'traiva mahātmanā ||
trinetrastuṣṭimānīto gatapakṣeṇa dhīmatā || 11 ||
pakṣāptiryena saṃjātā yasya bhūyo'pi tādṛśī ||
devadevaprasādena viśiṣṭā cā'tha nirmitā || 12 || ||
|| munaya ūcuḥ || ||
kathaṃ tasya gatau pakṣau garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ ||
punarlabdhau kathaṃ tena kathaṃ tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ||
etanno vistarādbrūhi sūtaputra yathātatham || 13 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
purāsīdbrāhmaṇo mitraṃ bhṛguvaṃśakulodvahaḥ ||
garuḍasya dvijaśreṣṭhā bālabhāvādapi prabho || 14 ||
tasya kanyā purā jātā mādhavī nāma saṃmatā ||
rūpaudāryasamopetā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 193 ||
na devī na ca gandharvī nāsurī na ca pannagī ||
tādṛgrūpā mahābhāgā yādṛśī sā sumadhyamā || 16 ||
atha tasyā varārthāya garuḍaṃ vihagādhipam ||
sa provāca paraṃ mitraṃ vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ || || 17 ||
etasyā mama kanyāyā varaṃ tvaṃ vihagādhipa ||
sadṛśaṃ vīkṣayasvādya yena tasmai dadāmyaham || 18 ||
|| garuḍa uvāca || ||
mama pṛṣṭhaṃ samāruhya samastaṃ kṣitimaṃḍalam ||
tvaṃ bhramasva dvijaśreṣṭha gṛhītvemāṃ ca kanyakām || 19 ||
tatastasyāḥ kumāryā vai anurūpaṃ guṇānvitam ||
svayaṃ cāhara bhartārameṣā maitrī mamodbhavā || 6.80.20 ||
|| sūta uvāca ||
evamukto'tha vipraḥ sa tatkṣaṇātkanyayā saha ||
ārūḍho gāruḍaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ varārthāya dvijottamāḥ || 21 ||
yaṃyaṃ paśyati vipraḥ sa kumāraṃ taruṇākṛtim ||
sa sa no tasya cittāṃte vartatesma kathaṃcana || 22 ||
kasyacidrūpamatyugraṃ na kulaṃ ca sunirmalam ||
kulaṃ rūpaṃ ca yasya syāttasya no guṇasaṃcayaḥ || 23 ||
yasya vā guṇasandohastasya no rūpamuttamam ||
pakṣapātaṃ ca vittaṃ ca tathānyadvaralakṣaṇam || 24 ||
evaṃ varṣasahasrāṃte bhramatastasyabhūtalam ||
viprasya pakṣināthasya varārthāya drijottamāḥ || 25 ||
kadācidatha tau śrāntau bhramamāṇāvitastataḥ ||
kṣetre'traiva samāyātau vāsudevadidṛkṣayā || 26 ||
śvetadvīpaṃ samālokya tathānyāṃ badarīṃ śubhām ||
kṣīrodaṃ ca savaikuṇṭhaṃ tathānyaṃ tasya saṃśrayam || 27 ||
atha tābhyāṃ munirdṛṣṭo nārado brahmasaṃbhavaḥ ||
sāṃtvapūrvaṃ tadā pṛṣṭo viṣṇuṃ brahma sanātanam || || 28 ||
kva devaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣaḥ sāṃprataṃ vartate mune ||
viṣṇusthānāni sarvāṇi vīkṣitāni samaṃtataḥ ||
āvābhyāṃ saṃprahṛṣṭābhyāṃ na saṃdṛṣṭaḥ sa keśavaḥ || 29 ||
|| nārada uvāca || ||
jalaśāyisvarūpeṇa yāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sa saṃtiṣṭhati sarvadā || 6.80.30 ||
tasmāttaddarśanārthāya gamyatāṃ tatra mā ciram ||
yena sandarśanaṃ yāti dvābhyāmapi sa cakradhṛk || 31 ||
ahamapyeva tatraiva prasthitastasya darśanāt ||
prasthitaśca tvayā yuko devakāryeṇa kenacit || 32 ||
atha tau pakṣiviprendrau sa ca brahmasuto muniḥ ||
prāptāḥ sarve sthito yatra jalaśāyī janārdanaḥ || 33 ||
atha dṛṣṭvā mahattejo vaiṣṇavaṃ dūrato'pi tam ||
brāhmaṇaṃ garuḍaḥ prāha nāradaśca munīśvaraḥ || 34 ||
atraiva tvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha tiṣṭha dūre'pi tejasaḥ ||
vaiṣṇavasya sutāyuktaḥ kalpāṃtāgnisamam va (?)|| 35 ||
no cetsaṃpatsyase bhasma pataṃga iva pāvakam ||
samāsādya niśāyoge mūḍhaṃ bhāvaṃ samāśritaḥ || 36 ||
āvābhyāṃ tatprasādena soḍhametatsuduḥsaham ||
na karoti śarīrārti tathānyadapi kutsitam || 37 ||
evaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tatra muktvā dūre sutānvitam ||
gatau tau tatra saṃsuptastoye yatra janārdanaḥ || 38 ||
divyastutiparau mūrdhni dhṛtahastāṃjalīpuṭau ||
pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgāvānandāśruplutānanau || 39 ||
triḥparikamya taṃ devamaṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇatau harim||
dṛṣṭavantau ca pādāṃte saṃniviṣṭāṃ samudrajām || 6.80.40 ||
pādasaṃvāhanāsaktāṃ viṣṇu vaktrāhitekṣaṇām||
athāparāṃ vayovṛddhāṃ śvetavastrāvaguṃṭhitām || 41 ||
sanniviṣṭāṃ tadabhyāśe samyagdhyānaparāyaṇām ||
dvādaśārkaprabhāyuktāṃ kṛśāṃgīṃ pulakānvitām|| 42 ||
atha tau viṣṇunā harṣādubhāvapi praharṣitau ||
saṃbhāṣitau ca saṃpṛṣṭau yadarthaṃ ca samāgatau || 43 ||
|| śrīnārada uvāca || ||
ahaṃ hi surakāryeṇa saṃprāpyo'tra tavāṃtikam ||
garuḍo vai brāhmaṇāya yanmāṃ pṛcchasi keśava || 44 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
kaccitkṣemaṃ muniśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām ||
kaccinneṃdrasya saṃjātaṃ bhayaṃ dānavasaṃbhavam || 45 ||
yajñabhāgaṃ labhaṃte sma kacciddevāḥ savāsavāḥ ||
kaccinna dānavaḥ kaścidutkaṭo'bhūddharātale || 46 ||
|| śrīnārada uvāca || ||
sāṃprataṃ dharaṇī prāptā caturvaktrasya saṃnidhau ||
rorūyamāṇā bhārārtā dānavaiḥ pīḍitā bhṛśam ||
provāca padmajaṃ tatra duḥkhena mahatā'nvitā || 47 ||
|| dharaṇyuvāca || ||
kālanemirhato yo'sau viṣṇunāprabhaviṣṇunā ||
ugrasenasutaḥ kaṃsaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ sa mahāsuraḥ || 48 ||
ariṣṭo dhenukaḥ keśī pralambonāma cāparaḥ ||
tathānyā tu mahāraudrā pūtanā nāma rākṣasī || 49 ||
itaścetaśca dhāvadbhirdānavairebhireva ca||
vṛthā me jāyate pīḍā tathānyairapi dāruṇaiḥ || 6.80.50 ||
ūrdhvabāhustathā jāto martyaloke jano'dhunā ||
bahutvānna pramāti sma kathaṃciddhi mamopari || 51 ||
bhārāvataraṇaṃ deva na kariṣyasi cāśu cet ||
rasātalaṃ prayāsyāmi tadā'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 52 ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā ||
saṃmaṃtrya vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ preṣito'haṃ tavāṃtikam || 53 ||
proktavyo bhagavānvākyaṃ tvayā devo janārdanaḥ ||
yathā'vatīrya bhūpṛṣṭhe bhāramasyāḥ praṇāśayet || 54 ||
tasmādbhūbhitale deva kṛtvā janma svayaṃ vibho ||
bhāraṃ nāśaya medinyā etadartha mihāgataḥ || 55 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
evaṃ mune kariṣyāmi saṃmaṃtrya brahmaṇā saha ||
bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhūmeḥ sākaṃ devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ || 56 ||
evamuktvā'tha taṃ viṣṇurnāradaṃ munipuṃgavam ||
tataśca garuḍaṃ prāha tvaṃ kimarthamihāgataḥ || 57 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇākhyamāhātmye viṣṇudarśanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 || cha ||

<6.81>

|| || śrīgaruḍa uvāca || ||
mamāsti dayitaṃ mitraṃ brāhmaṇo bhṛguvaṃśajaḥ ||

|| bhagavānuvāca || ||
atrānaya dvijaśreṣṭha tāṃ kanyāṃ kamalekṣaṇām||

|| garuḍa uvāca || ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

tasmādaśvamukhī nūnaṃ vikṛtā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 13 ||

|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
sahasraṃ yācyate kanyā karotyekaḥ karagraham ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
na santāpastvayā kāryaḥ kṛtyesmindvijasattama ||
mamāṃtike prayātānāṃ nāśubhaṃ jāyate kvacit || 19 ||

gṛhītvemāṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha prayaccha svepsitāya ca || 6.81.20 ||
śayane vāmadigbhāgaḥ kalatrāṇāmudāhṛtaḥ ||
dakṣiṇe bandhulokānāṃ tatkālocitaśāyinām||21||

evaṃ sa bhagavānvipraṃ taṃ santoṣya tadā girā ||

kimarthaṃ keyamākhyāhi kutaḥ prāptā janārdana || 27 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
eṣā khyātā khagaśreṣṭha loke'sminvṛddhakanyakā ||

tapovīryasamopetā sarvadevābhivaṃditā ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vihasya vihagādhipaḥ ||
provāca vāsudevaṃ ca tāṃ vilokya ciraṃ dvijāḥ || 6.81.30 ||
|| garuḍa uvāca || ||
naitaccitraṃ tapo yacca kriyate sumahattaram ||

tathā ca kriyate yuddhaṃ saṃgrāme yuddhaśālibhiḥ || 31 ||
nāścaryaṃ citrametacca brahmacaryaṃ tadadbhutam ||
viśeṣādyauvanāvasthāṃ saṃprāpya puruṣottama || 32 ||
viśeṣeṇa ca nārībhiratra na śraddadhāmyaham ||
avaśyaṃ yauvanasthena tiryagyonigatena ca || 33 ||
vikāraḥ khalu kartavyo nādhi kārāya yauvanam ||
yadi na prāpnuvaṃtyetāḥ puruṣaṃ yoṣitaḥ kvacit || 34 ||
anyonyaṃ maithunaṃ cakruḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ ||
kuṣṭhinaṃ vyādhitaṃ vāpi sthaviraṃ vyaṃgameva ca ||

na paratra bhayādetā maryādāṃ vidadhuḥ striyaḥ ||
muktvā bhūpabhayaṃ caikamathavā gurujaṃ bhayam || 37 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śāṃḍilī brahmacāriṇī ||
maunavratadharā'pyevaṃ hṛdi kopaṃ dadhāra sā || 38 ||

aśaktaśca tathā gantuṃ padamātramapi kvacit || || 6.81.40 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇapakṣapātavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 81 || || cha || || 

<6.82>

sūta uvāca || ||
taddṛṣṭvā puṃḍarīkākṣo garuḍasya viceṣṭitam ||
vismitaściṃtayāmāsa kimidaṃ sāṃprataṃ sthitam || 1 ||
api vajraprahāreṇa yasya romāpi na cyutam ||
tau pakṣau sahasā cāsya kathaṃ nipatitau bhuvi || 2 ||
nūnametena yā strīṇāṃ kṛtā niṃdā mahātmanā||
dūṣitaṃ brahmacaryaṃ yacchāṃḍilīṃ samavekṣya ca||3||
anayā pātitau pakṣau tapaḥśaktiprabhāvataḥ||
nānyasya vidyate śaktirīdṛśī bhuvanatraye || 4 ||
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa śāṃḍilīṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

|| śāṃḍilyuvāca || ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

|| śāṃḍilyuvāca || ||
manasāpi mayā dhyātaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadivā'śubham ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

cāṃdrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā sāṃtapanāni ca ||
prājāpatyāni cakre'tha pārākāṇi tadagrataḥ || 18 ||
snātvā triṣavaṇaṃ paścādbhasmasnāna parāyaṇaḥ ||
japanrudraśiro rudrānnīlarudrāṃstathāparān || 19 ||

balipūjopahārāṃśca vidhānena prayacchati || 6.82.20 ||
evaṃ tasya vratasthasya japapūjāparasya ca ||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte gatastuṣṭiṃ maheśvaraḥ ||
abravīdvarado'smīti vṛṇuṣveṣṭaṃ dvijottama || || 21 ||
|| garuḍa uvāca || ||

|| bhagavānuvāca || ||
adyaprabhṛti me cātra liṃge vāso bhaviṣyati ||

devopi vacanāttasya tasmim̐lliṃge sadā haraḥ ||
nivāsamakarotsamyakprāpte saṃdhyātraye sadā ||2 ||
tasya cāyatane puṇye yogātprāṇānparityajet ||
prāyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā na sa bhūyo'pi jāyate 29 ||

vāṃchadbhiḥ śivasāṃnidhyaṃ satyametanmayoditam || 35 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇeśvarākhyamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 82 || || cha ||

<6.83>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatrāścaryamabhūtpūrvaṃ yattadbrāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi purāṇe yadudāhṛtam || 1 ||

sadaiva pāpasaṃyukto durmedhāḥ kāmapīḍitaḥ || 2 ||
śāsanāni pradattāni brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ||
anyaiḥ pārthivaśārdūlaistena tāni hṛtānyalam || 3 ||
vidhvaṃsitāḥ striyo naikā vidhavāśca viśeṣataḥ 4

devatārādhanaṃ pūjāṃ kartuṃ naiva dadāti saḥ ||

iha lokeṣvasaṃdigdhaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham || 7 ||

naṣṭo mahāhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā śatrusaṃghānupasthitān ||
kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ parityajya prāṇarakṣārthameva hi || 9 ||
acaurāḥ pragṛhītāśca caurāḥ saṃrakṣitāḥ sadā ||
sādhavaḥ kleśitā nityaṃ teṣāṃ saṃharatā dhanam || 6.83.10 ||
na kṛtaṃ ca vrataṃ tena śraddhāpūtena cetasā ||

evaṃ tasya narendrasya pāpāsaktasya nityaśaḥ ||
kuṣṭhavyādhirabhūdugro vaṃśocchedaśca saddvijāḥ || 12 ||

yāvatprāptaḥ parityaktastāva tprāṇairupoṣitaḥ || 17 ||
tato divyavapurbhūtvāvimānavaramāśritaḥ ||
jagāmaśivalokaṃ sa durlabhaṃ dhārmikairapi || 18 ||
sevyamānopsarobhiśca stūyamānaśca kinnaraiḥ ||

ko'yaṃ deva samāyātaḥ sukṛtī tava mandire ||
anena kiṃ kṛtaṃ karma yatprāpto'tra vibhūtidhṛk || 6.83.20 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
eṣa pāpasamācāraḥ sadā''sītpṛthivīpatiḥ ||
veṇusaṃjño dharāpṛṣṭhe kuṣṭhavyādhisamākulaḥ || 21 ||

bhramamāṇaḥ samāyātaḥ suparṇākhyasya mandire || 22 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā pārvatī vākyaṃ proktaṃ devena śambhunā ||
