etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ||
suparṇākhyasya māhātmyaṃ yanmayā svapituḥ śrutam || 6.83.30 ||
iti śrīskande mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇākhyamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 83 ||

<6.84>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ devadevena viṣṇunā ||
mādhavīṃ bhaginīṃ prāpya janmāṃtaramupasthitām || 1 ||
aśvavaktrāṃ kariṣyāmi tapasā suśubhānanām ||
sā kathaṃ vihitā tena tapastaptaṃ tathā katham ||
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
nāradasya samākarṇya taṃ sandeśaṃ surodbhavam ||
gatvā viṣṇuḥ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ pracakre maṃtraniścayam || 3 ||
bhārāvataraṇārthāya dānavānāṃ vadhāya ca ||
vasudevagṛhe śrīmāndvāparāṃte tato hariḥ || 4 ||
devakyā jaṭhare devaḥ saṃjāto daityadarpahā ||
tathānyā rohiṇīnāma bhāryā tasya ca yā'bhavat || 5 ||
tasyāṃ jajñe halīnāma balabhadraḥ pratāpavān ||
tṛtīyā suprabhānāma vasudevapriyā ca yā || 6 ||
tasyāṃ sā mādhavī jajñe aśvavaktrasvarūpadhṛk ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtākārāṃ sutāṃ jātāṃ ca suprabhā ||
vāsudevasamāyuktā viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gatā || 7 ||
atha te yādavāḥ sarve kṛtaśāntikapauṣṭikāḥ ||
svastisvastīti saṃtrastāḥ procurbhūyātkule'tra naḥ ||8||
evaṃ sā yauvanopetā tathā duḥkhasamanvitā ||
na kaścidvarayāmāsa vājivaktrāṃ vilokya tām || 9 ||
tataśca bhagavānviṣṇurjñātvā tāṃ bhaginīṃ tathā ||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva tathā duḥkhasamanvitau || 6.84.10 ||
tāmādāya gatastūrṇaṃ baladevasamanvitaḥ ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tapastaptuṃ tataḥ param || 11 ||
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa samyagyajñaparāyaṇaḥ ||
vrataiśca vividhairdānairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ || 12 ||
tatastuṣṭiṃ gato brahmā varṣāṃte tasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ||
uvāca varado'smīti prārthayasvābhivāṃchitam || 13 ||
|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||
eṣā me bhaginī deva jātā'śvavadanā kila ||
tava prasādātsadvaktrā bhūyādetanmamepsitam || 14 ||
|| śrībrahmovāca || ||
eṣā śubhānanā sādhvī matprasādādbhaviṣyati ||
subhadrā nāma vikhyātā vīrasūḥ pativallabhā || 15 ||
etadrūpāṃ pumānyo'tra pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ ||
etāṃ viṣṇo tvayā sārdhaṃ tathānena ca sīriṇā || 16 ||
dvādaśyāṃ māghamāsasya gaṃdhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ||
so'pyavāpsyati yaccitte vartate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 17 ||
yā nārī patinā tyaktā vaṃdhyā vā bhaktisaṃyutā ||
tṛtīyādivase caitāṃ pūjayiṣyati keśava || 18 ||
bhaviṣyati suputrāḍhyā subhagā sā sukhānvitā ||
aiśvaryasahitā nityaṃ sarvaiḥ samuditā guṇaiḥ || 19 ||
evamuktvā caturvaktro virarāma tataḥ param ||
vāsudevo'pi hṛṣṭātmā yayau dvāravatīṃ purīm || 6.84.20 ||
tāmādāya viśālākṣīṃ caṃdrabiṃbasamānanām ||
baladevasamāyukto hyanujñāpya pitāma ham|| 21 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sā mādhavī viprāḥ subhagārūpamāsthitā ||
avatīrṇā dharāpṛṣṭhe lakṣmīśāpaprapīḍitā || 22 ||
upayeme sutaḥ pāṃḍoryāṃ pārthaścāruhāsinīm ||
jajñe tasyāḥ suto vīro'bhimanyuriti viśrutaḥ || 23 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mādhabījanmasambhavam ||
suparṇākhyasya devasya kathāsaṃgāddvijottamāḥ || 24 ||
yaścaitatpaṭhate martyo bhaktyā yuktaḥ śṛṇoti vā ||
mucyate sa naraḥ pāpāttaddinaikasamudbhavāt || 25||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇākhyatīrthamāhātmye mādhavyā aśvamukhyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇatapaścaryayā padmādattaśāpavimuktipūrvaka subhadrātvaprāptivarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 84 || || cha ||

<6.85>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
mādhavyāḥ padmayā datto yaḥ śāpastasya yatphalam ||
pariṇāmodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śrutamasmābhiradya tat || 1 ||
tena yatkamalā śaptā brāhmaṇena mahātmanā ||
sā kathaṃ gaja vaktrā'tha punarjātā śubhānanā || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
śāpena tasya viprasya tatkṣaṇādeva sā dvijāḥ ||
gajavaktrā samutpannā mahāvismayakāriṇī || 3 ||
sā proktā hariṇā tiṣṭha kiñcitkālāṃtare śubhe ||
anenaiva tu rūpeṇa yāvatsyāddvāparakṣayaḥ || 4 ||
tato'haṃ medinīpṛṣṭhe hyavatīrya samudraje ||
tapaḥ śaktyā kariṣyāmi bhūyastvāṃ tu śubhānanām || 5 ||
avajñāyātha sā tasya tadvākyaṃ śārṅgadhanvinaḥ ||
śubhāsyatvakṛte tepe tapastīvraṃ suharṣitā|| || 6||
etatkṣetraṃ samāsādya trikālaṃ snānamācarat||
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa divārātrimataṃdritā|| 7||
tāmuvāca tato brahmā varṣāṃte tuṣṭimāgataḥ ||
varaṃ prārthaya tuṣṭo'haṃ tava keśavavallabhe || 8 ||
|| lakṣmīruvāca || ||
gajāsyāhaṃ kṛtā deva śāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam ||
brāhmaṇena sukruddhena kasmiścitkāraṇāṃtare ||9||
tasmāttadrūpiṇīṃ bhūyo māṃ kuruṣva pitāmaha ||
yadi me tuṣṭimāpanno nānyatkiṃcidvṛṇomyaham || 6.85.10 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ vaktraṃ matprasādādasaṃśayam ||
tava bhadre viśeṣeṇa tasmāttvaṃ svagṛhaṃ vraja || 11 ||
mahattvaṃ te mayā dattamadyaprabhṛti śobhane ||
mahālakṣmīti te nāma tasmādatra bhaviṣyati || 12 ||
gajavaktrāṃ naro yastvāṃ pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ ||
sa gajādhipatirbhūpo bhaviṣyati ca bhūtale || 13 ||
dvitīyādivase yastvāṃ mahālakṣmīriti bruvan ||
śrīsūktena subhaktyā'tha devi saṃpūjayiṣyati || 14 ||
saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva na bhaviṣyati so'dhanaḥ||
evamuktvā caturvaktro virarāma tataḥ param|| 15 ||
sā'pi hṛṣṭā gatā devī yatra tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ || 16 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mahālakṣmīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 85 ||cha||

<6.86>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
athānyāpi ca tatrāsti saptaviṃśatikā tathā ||
nakṣatraiḥ sthāpitā devī vāṃchitasya pradāyinī || 1 ||
dakṣasya tanayā pūrvaṃ saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā ||
udvāhitā hi somena pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ || 2 ||
tāsāṃ madhye 'bhavaccaikā rohiṇī tasya vallabhā ||
prāṇebhyo'pi sadāsaktastayā sārdhaṃ sa tiṣṭhati || 3 ||
tato daurbhāgyasaṃtaptāḥ sarvā stā dakṣakanyakāḥ ||
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā kṣetre'smiṃstapasi sthitāḥ || 4 ||
saṃsthāpya devatāṃ durgāṃ śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ||
balipūjopahāraistāṃ pūjayaṃtyaḥ sureśvarīm || 5 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāṃ sā tuṣṭimabhyagāt ||
abravīcca pratuṣṭo'haṃ varaṃ dāsyāmi putrikāḥ || 6 ||
tasmāttatprārthyatāṃ citte yadyuṣmākaṃ vyavasthitam ||
sarvaṃ dāsyāmyasaṃdigdhaṃ yadyuṣmākaṃ hṛdi sthitam || 7 ||
tataḥ procuśca tāḥ sarvāḥ prasādāttava vāṃchitam ||
asmākaṃ vidyate devi yāvattrailokyasaṃsthitam || 8 ||
ekaṃ patyuḥ sukhaṃ muktvā yatsaubhāgyasamudbhavam ||
tasmāttaddehi cāsmākaṃ yadi tuṣṭāsi caṃḍike || 9 ||
vayaṃ daurbhāgyadoṣeṇa sarvāḥ kleśaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ||
na śaknumaḥ priyānprāṇāndehe dhartuṃ kathaṃcana || 6.86.10 ||
|| śrīdevyuvāca || ||
adyaprabhṛti yuṣmākaṃ saubhāgyaṃ patisaṃbhavam||
matprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ bhaviṣyati sukhodayam|| 11 ||
anyāpi yā patityaktā strī māmatra sthitāṃ sadā ||
pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktayā caturdaśyāmupoṣitā || 12 ||
sā bhaviṣyati saubhāgyayuktā putravatī satī ||
yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ tāvadekabhaktaparāyaṇā || 13 ||
akṣāralavaṇāśā yā nārī māṃ pūjayiṣyati ||
na tasyāḥ patijaṃ duḥkhaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ vā bhaviṣyati || 14 ||
āśvinasya site pakṣe saṃprāpte navamīdine ||
upavāsaparā yā māṃ niśīthe pūjayiṣyati ||
tasyāḥ saubhāgyamatyugraṃ sarvadā vai bhaviṣyati || 15 ||
evamuktvā tu sā devī virarāma dvijottamāḥ ||
tāśca sarvāḥ susaṃhṛṣṭā jagmurdakṣasya maṃdiram|| 16 ||
etasminnaṃtare dakṣa āhūtaḥ śūlapāṇinā ||
proktaḥ kasmāttvayā candro yakṣmaṇā saṃniyojitaḥ ||
tadayuktaṃ kṛtaṃ dakṣa jāmātā'yaṃ yatastava || 17 ||
|| dakṣa uvāca || ||
anena tanayā mahyamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyayā ||
ūḍhā akhaṇḍacāritrāstāstyaktā doṣavarjitāḥ ||
muktvaikāṃ rohiṇīṃ deva niṣiddhena mayā'sakṛt || 18 ||
tato mayā'tikopena niyukto rājayakṣmaṇā ||
asatyajalpako mandaḥ kāmadevavaśaṃ gataḥ || 19 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
adyaprabhṛti sarvāsāṃ samaṃ sa pracariṣyati ||
madvākyānnātra saṃdehaḥ satyametanmayoditam|| 6.86.20 ||
tvayāpi yadvacaḥ proktamasatyaṃ syānna tatkvacit ||
tasmādeṣa kṣayaṃ pakṣaṃ vṛddhiṃ pakṣaṃ prayāsyati || 21 ||
dakṣo'pi bāḍhamityeva tatproktvā ca yayau gṛham ||
caṃdrastu dakṣakanyāstāḥ samaṃ paśyati sarvadā || 22 ||
gacchamānaḥ kṣayaṃ pakṣaṃ vṛddhiṃ pakṣaṃ ca saddvijāḥ ||
sāpi devī tataḥ proktā saptaviṃśatikā kṣitau ||
sarvasaubhāgyadā strīṇāṃ tasminkṣetre vyavasthitā || 23 ||
yaścaitatpuratastasyāḥ saṃprāpte cāṣṭamīdine ||
śucirbhūtvā paṭhedbhaktyā sa saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt || 24 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye saptaviṃśatikāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 86 || || cha ||

<6.87>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathā tatrāsti viprendrāḥ somasyāyatanaṃ śubham||
yasyāpi darśanādeva mucyate pātakairnaraḥ || 1 ||
somavāre tu saṃprāpte somasya grahaṇe naraḥ ||
yastaṃ paśyati pāpo'pi narakaṃ na sa paśyati || 2 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ dṛśyaṃte'tra samāśrayāḥ ||
atra caṃdrasya caivaikaḥ kathaṃ jātaḥ samāśrayaḥ || 3 ||
etannaḥ sūtaputrāticitraṃ manasi vartate ||
tasmādvada mahābhāga sarvaṃ tvaṃ vetsyaśeṣataḥ || 4 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
enajjagaddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvaṃ somamayaṃ smṛtam ||
tasmātpratiṣṭhite tasmiṃstrailokyaṃ syātpratiṣṭhitam || 5 ||
etāścauṣadhayaḥ sarvāḥ sasyādyāśceha bhūtale ||
sarvāḥ somamayāstāśca yābhirjīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 6 ||
tasmādbrahmādayo devāḥ somaṃ prāpya kramādvijāḥ ||
tṛptiṃ yāṃti parāṃ hṛṣṭā yatastasmādvaro'tra saḥ || 7 |
agniṣṭomādayo yajñāstathā some pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
tasya pānādyatastṛptiṃ tatra yāṃti dvijottamāḥ || 8 ||
etasmātkāraṇātsomaḥ sarveṣāmadhikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca sa hi pūjyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 9 ||
yathānyeṣāṃ surendrāṇāṃ harmyāṇi dharaṇītale ||
kriyante rātrināthasya tadvatkurvaṃti mānavāḥ || 6.87.10 ||
yairyernarairniśeśasya prāsādo vihitaḥ kṣitau ||
tete muktipadaṃ prāptāḥ kṛtvā'tha śubhasaṃcayam || 11 ||
yanmaheśvaraharmyāṇāṃ sahasreṇa bhavecchubham ||
tadeke naiva caṃdrasya prāpnuvaṃti śubhaṃ narāḥ || 12 ||
atha candrotthaharmyasya māhātmyaṃ taddvijottamāḥ ||
jñātvā brahmādayo devā bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ ||
tadvighnārthamidaṃ procurmerumūrdhānamāśritāḥ || 13 ||
saumyarkṣe somavāreṇa saumye māsi ca saṃsthite ||
tithau ca somadevatye prāpte somagrahe tathā ||
sakāraiḥ paṃcabhiryukte kāle somasya maṃdiram || 14 ||
ya ekāhena saṃpādya prāsādaṃ sthāpayiṣyati ||
caṃdraṃ sa sarvadevotthaharmyasyāpnoti satphalam || 15 ||
sahasraguṇitaṃ samyakchraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
anyathā yastu caṃdrasya prāsādaṃ prakariṣyati || 16 ||
vaṃśocchedaṃ samāsādya narakaṃ sa prayāsyati ||
etasmātkāraṇādbhītā na kurvaṃti narā bhuvi || 17 ||
prāsādaṃ rātrināthasya supuṇyamapi saddvijāḥ ||
ya eṣa rātrināthasya kṣetre'traiva vyavasthitaḥ || 18 ||
prāsādastvaṃbarīṣeṇa bhūbhujā sa vinirmitaḥ ||
kathaṃcitsamayaṃ prāpya yathoktaṃ śāstraciṃtakaiḥ || 19 ||
tasyaivottaradigbhāge dvitīyo'nyaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
candramā dhaṃdhumāreṇa tadvatso'pi pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 6.87.20 ||
tataśca tau mahīpālau tatprabhāvādubhau dvijāḥ ||
gatau ca paramāṃ siddhiṃ janmamṛtyuvivarjitām || || 21 ||
prāsādo'nyastṛtīyastu kṣetre prābhāsike tathā ||
ikṣvākuṇā nareṃdreṇa śraddhāyuktena nirmitaḥ || 22 ||
prāsādatrayametaddhi muktvātra dharaṇītale ||
aparo nāsti candrasya satyametanmayoditam ||
eko'sti narmadātīre puṇye revorisaṃgame || 23 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ candramāhātmyamuttamam ||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi sarvapātakanāśanam || 24 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhenāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhatmye somaprāsādamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 87 || || va ||

<6.88>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yāstvayā devatāḥ proktāścatasraḥ sūtanaṃdana ||
camatkārī mahitthā ca mahālakṣmīstathā'parā || 1 ||
aṃbāvṛddhā caturthī ca tāsāṃ tisraḥ prakīrtitāḥ||
vistareṇa caturthī ca aṃbāvṛddhā na kīrtitā || 2 ||
etasyāḥ sarvamācakṣva prabhāvaṃ sūtasaṃbhava ||
kenaiṣā nirmitā yātrā sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 3 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
eṣā tapomayī śaktirambāvṛddhā sureśvarī ||
yathātra saṃsthitā pūrvaṃ tatsarvaṃ śrūyatāṃ mama || 4 ||
camatkāramahīpena purametadyadā kṛtam||
tadā tadrakṣaṇārthāya nirmitā bhāvitātmanā ||
catasro devatā hyetāḥ saṃmatena dvijanmanām || 5 ||
atha tasya mahīpasya aṃbānāmābhavatsutā ||
tathānyā vṛddhasaṃjñā ca rūpaudāryaguṇānvite || 6 ||
ubhe te kāśirājena pariṇīte dvijottamāḥ ||
gṛhyoktena vidhānena devaviprāgnisaṃnidhau || 7 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya kāśirājasya bhūpateḥ ||
taiḥ kālayavanaiḥ sārdhamabhavatsaṃgaro mahān || 8 ||
atha tairnihataḥ saṃkhye sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ ||
haralabdhavarai raudraiḥ kāśirājaḥ pratāpavān || 9 ||
athāṃbā caiva vṛddhā ca vaidhavyaṃ prāpya duḥkhadam ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ gatvā te vāṃchitapradam || 6.88.10 ||
devyā ārādhane yatnaṃ kṛtavatyau tataḥ param ||
nāśārthaṃ patiśatrūṇāṃ dhṛtavatyau śubhavratam || 11 ||
yāvadvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ na ca tuṣṭā sureśvarī ||
tato vairāgyamāsādya vāṃchaṃtyau svatanukṣayam || 12 ||
maṃtrairātharvaṇairviprāḥ kṣurikāsūktasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
chittvācchittvā svamāṃsāni maṃtrapūtāni bhaktitaḥ || 13 ||
kṛtavatyau tato homaṃ susamiddhe hutāśane ||
agnikuṇḍāttatastasmāścaturhastā śubhānanā || 14 ||
śvetavastrā viniṣkrāṃtā nārī bālārkasavribhā ||
tathānyā ca sunetrāsyā taptahāṭakasannibhā | 15 ||
tasmātkuṇḍādviniṣkrāṃtā dhṛtakhaḍgā bhayāvahā ||
sā'parāpi tathārūpā śaktiḥ paramadāruṇā || 16 ||
procatuste varaṃ hṛtsthaṃ prārthyatāmiti durlabham || || 17 ||
|| te ūcatuḥ || ||
asmākaṃ dayito bharttā kāśirājaḥ pratāpavān ||
nihataḥ saṃgare kruddhairyavanaiḥ kālapūrvakaiḥ || 18 ||
yuṣmadīya prasādena yathā teṣāṃ parikṣayaḥ ||
sañjāyate mahādevyau tathā kāryamasaṃśayam || 19 ||
sthātavyaṃ ca tathātraiva ubhābhyāmapi sādaram ||
svapurasya prarakṣārthametatkṛtyaṃ mataṃ hi nau || 6.88.20 ||
tayostadvacanaṃ śrutvā ubhe te devate tataḥ||
saṃprocya bāḍhamityevaṃ tasminkuṇḍe vyavasthite || 21 ||
etasminnaṃtare tasmātkuṇḍācchatasahasraśaḥ ||
niṣkrāṃtāḥ saṃkhyayā hīnā mātaro naikarūpikāḥ || 22 ||
ekā gajamukhī tatra tathānyā turagānanā ||
sārameya mukhāścānyāḥ pakṣicchāgamukhāḥ parāḥ || 23 ||
tiryañca vapuṣaścānyā vaktrairmānuṣasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
triśīrṣāḥ pañcaśīrṣāśca daśaśīrṣāstathā parāḥ || 24 ||
guhya sthānasthitairvaktrairekāścānyā hṛdisthitaiḥ ||
pārśvasaṃsthaiḥ sthitāścānyā anyāḥ pṛṣṭhigatairmukhaiḥ || 25 ||
ekahastā dvihastāśca pañcahastāstathāparāḥ ||
anyā viṃśatihastāśca vihastāśca tathāparāḥ || 26 ||
bahupādā vipādāśca ekapādāstathāparāḥ ||
tathānyāścārdhapādāśca adhovaktrā vibhīṣaṇāḥ || || 27 ||
ekanetrā dvinetrāśca trinetrāśca tathāparāḥ ||
kāścidgajasamārūḍhā hayārūḍhāstathāparāḥ || 28 ||
vṛṣavānarasiṃhājavyāghrasarpāsthitāḥ parāḥ ||
godhāśvarāsabhārūḍhāstathā ca vihagāśritāḥ || 29 ||
kūrmakukkuṭasarpādisamārūḍhāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||
prakurvaṃtyo rudantyaśca gāyantyaśca tathā parāḥ ||
nṛtyaṃtyaśca hasaṃtyaśca krīḍāsaktāḥ parasparam || 6.88.30 ||
ūrdhvakeśā vikeśāśca gātrakeśāśca bhūriśaḥ ||
laṃbakeśā vikeśāśca vājikeśāstathaiva ca ||31||
hrasvadantyo vidaṃtyaśca dīrghadantyo vibhīṣaṇāḥ ||
gajadaṃtyastathaivānyā lohadaṃtyobhayāvahāḥ || 32 ||
laṃbakarṇyo vikarṇyaśca śūrpakarṇyastathā parāḥ ||
śaṃkukarṇyaḥ kukarṇyaśca bahukarṇyaḥ sukarṇikāḥ || 33 ||
ekavastrā vivastrāśca bahuvastrāstathā parāḥ ||
carmaprāvaraṇāścaiva kathāprāvaraṇānvitāḥ || 34 ||
khaṅgahastāḥ śarāhastāḥ kuṃtahastāśca bhīṣaṇāḥ ||
pāśahastāstathaivānyāḥ prāsacāpakarāḥ parāḥ ||
śūlamudgarahastāśca bhuśuṃḍikarabhūṣitāḥ || 35 ||
atha tābhyāṃ tathā''karṇya tāḥ sarvā harṣasaṃyutāḥ ||
prasthitāstatra tā yatra te kālayavanāḥ sthitāḥ ||36||
tataste tatsamālokya balaṃ devīsamudravam ||
raudra rūpadharaṃ tīvraṃ vikṛtaṃ vikṛtairmukhaiḥ ||37||
viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve bhayabhītā samaṃtataḥ ||
dhāvato bhakṣitāstābhirdevatābhiḥ sunirdayam || 38 ||
bālavṛddhasamopetaṃ teṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ durātmanām ||
strībhiśca sahitaṃ tābhirdevatābhiḥ prabhakṣitam ||39||
evaṃ nirvāsya tadrāṣṭraṃ sarvāstā harṣasaṃyutāḥ ||
bhūya eva nijaṃ sthānaṃ saṃprāptā dvijasattamāḥ || 6.88.40 ||
tataḥ procuḥ praṇamyoccaistābhyāṃ vinayapūrvakam ||

udvāsitastathā sarvo deśasteṣāṃ sa vai mahān ||
sāṃprataṃ dīyatāṃ kaścidāhārastṛptihetave ||
nivāsāya tataḥ sthānaṃ kiṃciccāvedyatāṃ hi naḥ || 42 ||
|| devyāvūcatuḥ|| ||
martyaloke'tra yā nāryo garbhavatyaḥ svapaṃti ca ||

tāsāṃ garbhastu yuṣmākaṃ saṃpradattaḥ prabhujyatām || 44 ||
ucchiṣṭā yāḥ prasarpaṃti ramante ca svapaṃti ca ||
tāsāṃ garbhaḥ samastānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ bhoja nāya vai || 45 ||
sūtikābhavane yasminnucchiṣṭaṃ copajāyate ||
sa bālakastu yuṣmākaṃ bhojanāya prakalpitaḥ || 46 ||
na ṣaṣṭhījāgaro yasya bālakasya bhaviṣyati ||
sa bhaviṣyati bhojyāya yuṣmākaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 47 ||
nāśaṃ yāsyati vā yatra pāvakaḥ sūtikāgṛhe ||
sa bhaviṣyati bhojyāya yuṣmākaṃ bālarūpadhṛk || 48 ||
māṃgalyaiḥ saṃparityaktaṃ yadbhavetsūtikāgṛham ||
tasminyastiṣṭhate bālaḥ sa yuṣmākaṃ prakalpitaḥ ||49||
saṃdhyāyāṃ bālakā ye vā svapaṃtyākāśadeśagāḥ||
te sarve bhojanārthāya yuṣmākaṃ saṃniveditāḥ || 6.88.50 ||
yasya janmadine prāpte varṣāṃte kriyate na ca ||
māṃgalyaṃ tasya yadgātraṃ tadyuṣmākaṃ prakalpitam || 51 ||
tailābhyaṃgaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā yaśca snānaṃ karoti na ||
sa datto bhojanārthāya yuṣmākaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 52 ||
ucchiṣṭo yaḥ pumāṃstiṣṭhedyo vā catvaramadhyagaḥ||
bhakṣaṇīyaḥ sa sarvābhirnirvikalpena cetasā ||53 ||
rajasvalāṃ vrajedyo vā puruṣaḥ kāmamohitaḥ||
nagnaḥ śete tathā snāti bhakṣaṇīyaḥ sa satvaram || 54 ||
dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau yaśca snāti vimūḍhadhīḥ ||
śete ca śayane so'pi bhakṣaṇīyaśca satvaram ||55||
udaṅmukhaśca yo rātrau divā vā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||
mūtrotsargaṃ purīṣa vā prakuryādbhakṣya eva saḥ || 56 ||
yaḥ kuryādrajanīvaktre dadhisaktuprabhakṣaṇam ||
aṃtyajābhigamaṃ cātha bhakṣaṇīyo drutaṃ hi saḥ || 57 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ tābhyāṃ tadā proktā devatāstāḥ samaṃtataḥ ||
parivārya tadā tasthuḥ saṃprahṛṣṭena cetasā || 58 ||
etasminnaṃtare rājā camatkāraḥ pratāpavān ||
prāsādaṃ nirmame tābhyāṃ kailāsaśikharopamam || 59 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti te khyāte kṣetre tatra mahodaye ||
aṃbāvṛddhābhidhāne ca purarakṣāpare sadā || 6.88.60 ||
yaḥ pumānprātarutthāya tābhyāṃ paśyati cānanam ||
tasya saṃvatsaraṃyāvanna ca cchidraṃ prajāyate || 61 ||
vṛddhyādau vātha cāṃte vā tābhyāṃ pūjāṃ karoti yaḥ ||
na tasya jāyate cchidraṃ kathaṃcidapi bhūtale || 62 ||
yātrākāle pumānyaśca tābhyāṃ pūjāṃ samācaret ||
sa vāṃchitaphalaṃ prāpya śīghraṃ svagṛhamāpnuyāt || 63 ||
sadāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ yastābhyāṃ balimāharet ||
sa kāmānāpnuyādiṣṭāniha pretya ca sadgatim || 64 ||
yo mahānavamīsaṃjñe divase śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
tābhyāṃ samācaretpūjāṃ sa sadā syādakaṇṭakī || || 65 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmyeṃ'bāvṛddhāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 88 || || dha ||

<6.89>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ tatra sthite nityaṃ tasminmātṛgaṇe dvijāḥ ||
bālakānāṃ kṣayo jajñe brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛhegṛhe || 1 ||

|| devatā ūcuḥ || ||

|| ambovāca || ||

procurmaheśvaraṃ gatvā vinayāvanatāḥ sthitāḥ ||
stutvā pṛthagvidhaiḥ sūktairvedoktaiḥ śatarudriyaiḥ || 21 ||
devā ūcuḥ || ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre pāduke tatra saṃsthite ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

|| kumāryuvāca || ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
yasyāyasyāḥ prasannā tvaṃ kanyakāyā vadiṣyasi ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| gaja uvāca || ||
vaṃśastaṃbe'tra saṃkīrṇe saṃpraviṣṭo hutāśanaḥ ||
sāṃprataṃ tena nirdagdhaḥ kṛcchrādatrāhamāgataḥ || 27 ||
atha tairveṣṭitastasminvaṃśastaṃbe hutāśanaḥ ||
devairdattvā gajeṃdrasya śāpaṃ paścādvinirgataḥ || || 28 ||
yasmāttvayāhamādiṣṭo devānāṃ vāraṇādhama ||
tasmāttava mukhe jihvā viparītā bhaviṣyati || 29 ||
evaṃ śaptvā gajaṃ śīghraṃ naṣṭo vaiśvānaraḥ punaḥ ||
devāścāpi tathā pṛṣṭhe saṃlagnāstaddidṛkṣayā || 6.90.30 ||
atha dṛṣṭaḥ śukastaiśca bhramamāṇairmahāvane ||
bhobhoḥ śuka tvayā vahniryadi dṛṣṭo nivedyatām || 31 ||
śuka uvāca || ||
yo'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate dūrācchamīgarbhe ca pippalaḥ ||
etasmiṃstiṣṭhate vahniraśvatthe surasattamāḥ || 32 ||
atrastho yaḥ kulāyo ma āsīcchiśusamanvitaḥ ||
saṃdagdhastatpratāpena ahaṃkṛcchrādvinirgataḥ ||33||
tacchrutvā taiḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ śamīgarbhaḥ sa tatkṣaṇāt ||
veṣṭitaḥ pāvako'pyāśu śukaṃ śaptvā vinirgataḥ || 34 ||
ahaṃ yasmāttvayā pāpa devānāṃ saṃniveditaḥ ||
tasmācchuka na te vāṇī vispaṣṭā saṃbhaviṣyati || 35 ||
evamuktvā jātavedā devādarśanavāṃchayā ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ || 36 ||
jalāśayaṃ sugambhīraṃ pūrvottaradiksaṃsthitam ||
dṛṣṭvā tatra praviṣṭastu nibhṛtaṃ ca samāśritaḥ || 37 ||
etasminnaṃtare tatra matsyakacchapadardurāḥ ||
vahnipratāpanirdagdhā dṛśyaṃte śataśo mṛtāḥ || 38 ||
atha caiko'rdhanirdagdha āyuḥśeṣeṇa darduraḥ ||
tasmājjalādviniṣkrāṃto dṛṣṭo devaiśca dūrataḥ || 39 ||
pṛṣṭaśca brūhi cedbheka tvayā dṛṣṭo hutāśanaḥ ||
tadarthamiha saṃprāptāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 6.90.40 ||
|| bheka uvāca || ||
asmiñjalāśaye vahniḥ sāṃprataṃ paryavasthitaḥ ||
tasyaite jalamadhyasthā mṛtā bhūrijalodbhavāḥ || 41 ||
asmākaṃ nidhanaṃ prāptaṃ kuṭumbaṃ surasattamāḥ ||
ahaṃ kṛcchreṇa niṣkrāṃta etasmājjalasaṃśrayāt || 42 ||
tacchrutvā te surāḥ sarve sarvatastaṃ jalāśayam ||
veṣṭayitvā sthitāstatra vahnirbhekaṃ śaśāpa ha || 43 ||
yasmādbheka tvayā mūḍha devebhyo'haṃ niveditaḥ ||
tasmāttvaṃ bhavitā nūnaṃ vijihvo'tra dharātale || 44 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ sthānāttato vahnirvinirgataḥ ||
tāvatsa brahmaṇā proktaḥ svayameva mahātmanā || 45 ||
bhobho vahne kimarthaṃ tvaṃ devāndṛṣṭvā pragacchasi ||
tvamādyaścaiva sarveṣāmeteṣāṃ saṃsthito mukham || 46 ||
tvayyāhutirhutā samyagādityamupatiṣṭhate ||
ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ || 47 ||
tasmāddhātā vidhātā ca tvameva jagataḥ sthitaḥ ||
saṃtuṣṭe dhāryate viśvaṃ tvayi ruṣṭe vinaṃkṣyati || 48 ||
agniṣṭomādikā yajñāstvayi sarve pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
atha sarvāṇi bhūtāni jīvaṃti tava saṃśrayāt || 49 ||
tvamagne sarvabhūtānāmantaścarasi sarvadā ||
tenaivānnaṃ ca pānaṃ ca jaṭharasthaṃ pacatyalama || 6.90.50 ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām ||
kopasya kāraṇaṃ brūhi yatastyaktvā pragacchasi || 51 || ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
provāca praṇayātkopaṃ kṛtvā natvā ca padmajam || 52 ||
|| agniruvāca || ||
ahaṃ kopaṃ samādhāya śakrasyopari padmaja ||
praṇaṣṭo jagadutsṛjya yasmāttatkāraṇaṃ śṛṇu || 53 ||
anāvṛṣṭyā mahendrasya saṃjātaścauṣadhīkṣayaḥ ||
tato'smyahaṃ śvamāṃsena viśvāmitreṇa yojitaḥ || 54 ||
etasmātkāraṇānnaṣṭo na kāmānna ca saṃbhramāt ||
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇādbhītaḥ satyametanmayoditam ||55||
tacchrutvā sa caturvaktraḥ śakramāha tataḥ param ||
yuktameva śikhī prāha kimarthaṃ na ca varṣasi || 56 ||
|| śakra uvāca || ||
jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramullaṃghya śaṃtanuḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
pitṛpaitāmahe rājye sa niviṣṭaḥ pitāmaha || 57 ||
etasmātkāraṇādvṛṣṭiḥ saṃniruddhā mayā prabho ||
tadbrūhi kiṃ karomyadya tvaṃ pramāṇaṃ pitāmaha || 58 ||
|| pitāmaha uvāca || ||
tasyākramasya saṃprāptaṃ pāpaṃ tena mahībhujā ||
upabhuktamavṛṣṭyādya tasmādvṛṣṭiṃ kuru drutam || 59 ||
madvākyādyāti no nāśaṃ yāvadetajjagattrayam ||
akālenāpi devendra sasyābhāvādbubhukṣayā || 6.90.60 ||
etasminnaṃtare śakra ādideśa tvarānvitaḥ ||
puṣkarāvartakānmeghānvṛṣṭyarthaṃ dharaṇītale || 61 ||
te'pi śakrasamādeśātsamastadharaṇītalam ||
tatkṣaṇātpūrayāmāsurgarjanto vidyudanvitāḥ || 62 ||
athābravītpunarbrahmā devaiḥ sārdhaṃ hutāśanam ||
agnihotreṣu viprāṇāṃ pratyakṣo bhava pāvaka ||
sāṃprataṃ tvaṃ varaṃ mattaḥ prārthayasvābhivāṃchitam || 63 ||
|| agniruvāca || ||
ayaṃ jalāśayaḥ puṇyo mannāmnā pṛthivītale ||
khyātiṃ yātu caturvaktra vahnitīrthamiti smṛtam ||64||
atra yaḥ prātarutthāya snātvā śraddhā samanvitaḥ ||
agnisūktaṃ japitvā ca tvāṃ prapaśyati sādaram ||
tasya tuṣṭistvayā kāryā drutaṃ madvākyataḥ prabho || 65 ||
|| śrībrahmovāca || ||
atra yaḥ prātarutthāya snātvā vai vedaviddvijaḥ ||
agnisūktaṃ japitvā ca vīkṣayiṣyati māṃ tataḥ || 66 ||
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya sakalaṃ lapsyate phalam ||
anekajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ nāśameṣyati pāvaka || 67 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā sa bhagavānvirarāma pitāmahaḥ ||
pāvako'pi ca viprāṇāmagnihotreṣu saṃsthitaḥ || 68 ||
evaṃ tatra samudbhūtaṃ vahnitīrthaṃ mahādbhutam ||
tatra snāto naraḥ prātaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 69 ||
|| agniruvāca || || mamātṛptasya lokeśa tāvaddvādaśavatsarān ||
kṣutpīḍāsaṃvṛte martye na prāptaṃ kutraciddhaviḥ || 6.90.70 ||
bhaviṣyaṃti tathā yajñā kālena mahatā vibho ||
saṃjātaiḥ paśubhirbhūyaḥ sasyādairaparairbhuvi || 71 ||
|| śrībrahmovāca || ||
atra ye brāhmaṇāḥ kecinnivasaṃti hutāśana ||
vasorddhārāpradānena te tvāṃ naktaṃdinaṃ sadā || 72 ||
tarpayiṣyaṃti sadbhaktyā tataḥ puṣṭimavāpsyasi ||
te'pi kāmyairmano'bhīṣṭairbhaviṣyaṃti samanvitāḥ || 73 ||
saṃkrāṃti samaye yeṣāṃ vasordhārāpradāyinām ||
bhaviṣyati kṣutaṃ vahne hūyamāne tavānala || 74 ||
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ ca yatkiṃcijjñānato'jñānataḥ kṛtam ||
tadyāsyati kṣayaṃ sarvamājanmamaraṇāṃtikam|| 75 ||
tvayi tuṣṭiṃ gate paścādbhaviṣyati mahīpatiḥ ||
śibirnāma suvikhyāta uśīnarasamudravaḥ || 76 ||
sa kṛtvā śraddhayā yuktaḥ satraṃ dvādaśavārṣikam||
vasorddhārāpradānena varṣaṃ tvāṃ tarpayiṣyati ||
kalaśasya ca vaktreṇāvicchinnena divāniśam || 77 ||
tatastuṣṭiṃ parāṃ prāpya parāṃ puṣṭimavāpsyasi ||
pūjyamāno dharāpṛṣṭhe sarvairvedavidāṃ varaiḥ || 78 ||
adyaprabhṛti yatkiṃcitkarma cātra bhaviṣyati ||
śāṃtikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vāpi vasorddhārāsamanvitam ||
saṃbhaviṣyati tatsarvaṃ tava tṛptikaraṃ param|| 79 ||
api yadvaiśvadevīyaṃ karma kiṃciddvijanmanām ||
vasorddhārāvihīnaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 6.90.80 ||
yasmādbhavati saṃpūrṇaṃ karma yajñādikaṃ hi tat ||
śāṃtikaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ ca pūrṇāhutirihocyate || 81 ||
yaḥ samyakchraddhayā yukto vasorddhārāṃ pradāsyati ||
sa kāmaṃ manasā dhyātaṃ samavāpsyati kṛtsnaśaḥ || 82 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vasorddhārāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 90 || || cha ||

<6.91>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā sa bhagavānvirarāma pitāmahaḥ ||
saṃtoṣya pāvakaṃ kruddhaṃ svayameva dvijottamāḥ || 1 ||
tataḥ sarvaiḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ śakraviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ ||
jagāma brahmalokaṃ ca devāste ca nijaṃ padam || 2 ||
pāvako'pi dvijeṃdrāṇāmagnihotreṣu saṃsthitaḥ ||
havirjagrāha vidhivadvasorddhārodbhavaṃ tathā || 3 ||
evaṃ tatra samudbhūtamagnitīrthamanuttamam ||
yatra snāto naraḥ prātarmucyate dinajādaghāt || 4 ||
atha saṃprasthitāndṛṣṭvā tāndevānsvāśramaṃ prati ||
gajeṃdraśukamaṇḍūkāste procurduḥkhasaṃyutāḥ ||5||
yuṣmatkṛte vayaṃ śaptāḥ pāvakena sureśvarāḥ ||
tasmājjihvākṛte'smākamupāyaściṃtyatāmapi ||6||
|| devā ūcuḥ || ||
viparītāpi te jihvā yathānyeṣāṃ gajottama ||
kāryakṣamā na saṃdeho bhaviṣyati viśeṣataḥ || 7 ||
tathā yūyaṃ narendrāṇāṃ maṃdireṣu vyavasthitāḥ ||
bahu mānasamāyuktā mṛṣṭānnaṃ bhakṣayiṣyatha || 8 ||
yathā ca śuka te jihvā kṛtā maṃdā havirbhujā ||
tathāpi bhūmipālānāṃ śaṃsanīyā bhaviṣyati || 9 ||
śrīmatāṃ ca tathānyeṣāmasmadīyaprasādataḥ ||
tvaṃ ca maṃḍūka yattena vijihvo vahninā kṛtaḥ ||
tadbhaviṣyati te śabdo vijihvasyāpi dīrghagaḥ || 6.91.10 ||
evamuktvā'tha te devāḥ svasthānaṃ prasthitāstataḥ ||
teṣāmanugrahaṃ kṛtvā kṛpayā parayā yutā || 11 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgararakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'gnitīrthotpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 91 || || cha ||

<6.92>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
agnitīrthasya māhātmyametadvaḥ parikīrtitam ||
brahmakuṃḍasamutpattiradhunā śrūyatāṃ dvijāḥ || 1 ||
yadā saṃsthāpito brahmā mārkaṃḍena mahātmanā ||
tadā vinirmitaṃ tatra kuṇḍaṃ śucijalānvitam || 2 ||
proktaṃ ca kārtike māsi kṛttikāsthe niśākare ||
samyagbhīṣmavrataṃ kṛtvā snātvātra salile śubhe || 3 ||
pūjayiṣyati yo devaṃ padmayoniṃ tataḥ param ||
sa śūdro'pi tanuṃ tyaktvā brahmayonau prayāsyati || 4 ||
brāhmaṇo'pi yadi snānaṃ tatra kuṇḍe kariṣyati ||
kṛtvā bhīṣmavrataṃ samyagbrahmalokaṃ prayāsyati || 5 ||
evaṃ pravadatastasya mārkaṃḍeyasya sanmuneḥ ||
śrutaṃ tatsakalaṃ vākyaṃ paśupālena kenacit || 6 ||
tataḥ śraddhāprayuktena tena tadbhīṣmapaṃcakam ||
yathāvadvihitaṃ samyakkārtike māsi saṃsthite || 7 ||
tataśca kṛttikāyoge pūrṇimāyāṃ yathāvidhi ||
saṃpūjya padmajaṃ paścātpūjitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 8 ||
tataḥ kālavipākena sa paṃcatvamupāgataḥ ||
brāhmaṇasya gṛhe jātaḥ pure'traiva dvijottamāḥ ||
jātismaraḥ prabhāyuktaḥ pitṛmātṛpratuṣṭidaḥ || 9 ||
evaṃ pragacchatastasya vṛddhiṃ tatra purottame ||
pitṛmātṛsamudbhūto yādṛksneho vyavasthitaḥ || 6.92.10 ||
anyadehodbhave vāpi tasya śūdreparisthitaḥ ||
sa tasya dhanasaṃpannaḥ sadaiva kurute dvijaḥ || 11 ||
upakārapradānaṃ ca yatkiṃcittasya saṃmatam ||
anyasmindivase śūdraḥ sa pitā pūrvajanmanaḥ ||
tasya pañcatvamāpannaḥ saṃprāpte cāyuṣaḥ kṣaye || 12 ||
atha tasya mahāśokaṃ sa kṛtvā tadanaṃtaram ||
cakāra pretakāryāṇi niḥśeṣāṇi prabhaktitaḥ || 13 ||
atha tasya samālokya tādṛśaṃ tadviceṣṭitam ||
pṛṣṭaḥ sa kautukāviṣṭaiḥ pitṛmātṛsutādibhiḥ || 14 ||
kasmāttvamasya nīcasya paśupālasya sarvadā ||
atisnehasamāyukto niḥspṛhasyāpi śaṃsa naḥ || 15 ||
tasyāpi pretakāryāṇi mṛtasyāpi karoṣi kim ||
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva na cedguhyaṃ vyavasthitam || 16 ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kiṃcillajjāsamanvitaḥ ||
tānabravīcchṛṇudhvaṃ ca kathayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 17 ||
ahamasyānyadehatve putra āsaṃ susaṃmataḥ ||
paśupālanakarmajñaḥ prāṇebhyo vallabhaḥ sadā || 18 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya mārkaṃḍasya mahāmuneḥ ||
śrutaṃ pravadato vākyaṃ brahmakuṇḍasamudbhavam || 19 ||
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge bhīṣmapañcakakṛnnaraḥ ||
samyakchraddhāsamutpanno yo'tra snānaṃ kariṣyati || 6.92.20 ||
dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā janārdanam ||
sa bhaviṣyati śūdro'pi brāhmaṇaścānyajanmani || 21 ||
tanmayā vihitaṃ samyaksnātvā tatra śubhāvahe ||
sukuṇḍe kārtike māsi tena jāto'smi saddvijaḥ || 22 ||
candrodayasya viprarṣeranvaye bhuvi viśrute ||
saṃsmaranpūrvikāṃ jāti tena sneho mama sthitaḥ ||
tasyopari mahānnityaṃ śūdrasyāpi nirargalaḥ || 23 ||
ato'haṃ kṛttikāyoge kārtikyāṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ||
jñātvā karomi bhīṣmasya paṃcakaṃ vratamuttamam || 24 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā te cānye ca dvijottamāḥ ||
bhīṣmasya pañcakaṃ cakruḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitāḥ| 25 ||
tataḥprabhṛti tatkuṇḍaṃ vikhyātaṃ dharaṇītale ||
sthitamuttaradigbhāge brahmakuṇḍamiti smṛtam || 26 ||
yaḥ snānaṃ sarvadā tatra brāhmaṇaḥ prakaroti vai ||
sa saṃbhavati vipreṃdro jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 27 ||
itiśrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvinavatitamodhyāyaḥ ||92|| ||

<6.93>

sūta uvāca || ||
athānyadapi tatrāsti gomukhākhyaṃ suśobhanam||
yadgovaktrātpurā labdhaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 ||
purāsīdatra gopālaḥ kaścitkuṣṭhasamāvṛtaḥ ||
camatkārapuraṃ vipra atīva kṣāmatāṃ gataḥ || 2 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya tena mārgeṇa gokulam ||
madhyāhnasamaye prāptaṃ caṃdre citrāsamanvitaḥ || 3 ||
ekādaśyāṃ tṛṣārttaṃ ca bhāskare vṛṣasaṃsthite ||
ekayāpi tato dhenvā tṛṇastambamatīva hi ||
nīlamālokitaṃ tatra dūrādetya praharṣitā || 4 ||
dantairdrutaṃ samutpāṭya yāvadākarṣati dvijāḥ ||
tāvattajjaḍamārgeṇa toyadhārā vinirgatā || 5 ||
athāsvādya tṛṇaṃ tasmāttṛṣārtā ca śanaiḥśanaiḥ ||
papau toyaṃ suviśrabdhā susvādu kṣīrasaṃnibham || 6 ||
tasyā vegena tattoyaṃ pibantyāstatrabhūtale ||
gartā jātā suvistīrṇā salilena samāvṛtā || 7 ||
tato'nyāḥ śataśo gāvaḥ papustoyaṃ munirmalam ||
tṛṣārttāstaddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ pīyūṣarasasaṃnibham || 8 ||
yathāyathā gatā gāvastatra toyaṃ pibaṃti tāḥ ||
sā gartā vaktrasaṃsparśādvṛddhiṃ yāti tathā tathā || 9 ||
tataśca gokule kṛtsne jāte tṛṣṇāvivarjite ||
gopālo'pi tṛṣārtastu tasmiṃstoye viveśa ca || 6.93.10 ||
aṃgaṃ prakṣālya pītvāpo yāvanniṣkrāmati drutam ||
tāvatpaśyati gātraṃ svaṃ dvādaśārkasamaprabham || 11 ||
tato vismayamāpanno gatvā svīyaṃ niketanam ||
vṛtāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa lokānāṃ purato'khilam || 12 ||
tṛṇastambaṃ yathā dhenvā tatrotpāṭya praśaktitaḥ ||
yathā vinirgataṃ toyaṃ yathā tenāvagāhitam || 13 ||
taddṛṣṭvā mānavāḥ sarve gatvā divyaṃ jalaṃ ca tat ||
vyādhigrastā viśeṣeṇa snānaṃ cakruḥ samāhitāḥ ||14||
bhavaṃti ca vinirmuktā rogaiḥ pāpaiśca tatkṣaṇāt||
apāpāśca punaryāṃti tatkṣaṇāttridivālayam || 15 ||
tataḥprabhṛti tatkhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ gomukhasaṃjñitam ||
gomukhādbhūtale jātaṃ yataścaivaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 16 ||
atha bhītaḥ sahasrākṣastaddṛṣṭvā svargadāyakam ||
akleśena manuṣyāṇāṃ pūrayāmāsa pāṃsubhiḥ || 17 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kiṃ tatkāraṇamādiṣṭaṃ yena tattādṛśaṃ jalam ||
tasmātsthānādviniṣkrāṃtaṃ sūtaputra vadasva naḥ || 18 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atra pūrvaṃ tapastaptamambarīṣeṇa bhūbhujā ||
putra śokābhibhūtena toṣito garuḍadhvajaḥ || 19 ||
tasya putraḥ suvikhyātaḥ suvarcā iti viśrutaḥ ||
eko babhūva vṛddhatve kathaṃciddvijasattamāḥ || 6.93.20 ||
pūrvakarmavipākena sa bālo'pi ca tatsutaḥ ||
kuṣṭhavyādhisamākrāṃtaḥ pitṛmātṛsuduḥkhadaḥ || 21 ||
atha tatkāmikaṃ kṣetraṃ sa gatvā pṛthivīpatiḥ ||

|| rājovāca || ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

yāvatkālaṃ suraśreṣṭha śūnye jāte sva āśraye ||
tasmātkuru drutaṃ kaṃcidupāyaṃ tadvināśane || 64 ||
evamukte yamenātha taṃ visṛjya gṛhaṃ prati ||
vyāghrarūpaṃ samāsthāya svayaṃ tatsaṃnidhau yayau || 65 ||
yatra saṃstho mahīpaḥ sa prajāpālanatatparaḥ ||
meghagambhīranirghoṣaṃ garjamāno muhurmuhuḥ || 66 ||
ajāstāstaṃ ca saṃvīkṣya vyāghraṃ raudravapurddharam ||
ajāpālaṃ samuddiśya saṃtrastāḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 67 ||
tasya yatnaparasyāpi rakṣamāṇasya bhūpateḥ||
ajāstā vyāghrarūpeṇa śaṃkareṇa prabhakṣitāḥ || 68 ||
ajānāṃ kadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ sa pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
svahastādyaṣṭimutsṛjya jagrāha niśitāyudham || || 69 ||
yattasya tuṣṭayā dattaṃ caṃḍaṃ caṃḍārciṣā samam ||
tacchastraṃ ca tathānyāni devīdattāni śaṃkaraḥ ||
śanaiḥśanaiḥ prajagrāha svavaktreṇa maheśvaraḥ || || 6.95.70 ||
astrābhāvāttatastūrṇaṃ dhriyamāṇe'pi kāṃtayā ||
dvaṃdvayuddhena taṃ vyāghraṃ yodhayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ || 71 ||
tatastasyāṃgasaṃsparśānmuktvā vyāghratanuṃ ca tām ||
dadhāra bhasmasaṃdigdhāṃ tanuṃ candravibhūṣitām || 72 ||
ruṃḍamālāvarāṃ divyāṃ sakhaṭvāṃgāṃ sapannagām ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa mahīpālaḥ sabhāryaḥ praṇatastataḥ || 73 ||
provācātha stutiṃ kṛtvā vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ ||
ānaṃdāśrupariklinno harṣagadgadayā girā || 74 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
ajñānādyanmayā deva prahārāstava nirmitāḥ ||
tiraskārastathā dattastatsarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ vibho || 75 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

parituṣṭena te karma dṛṣṭvā caivātimānuṣam || 76 ||

tathānyo bhūpatiḥ kaścinna kartā na kariṣyati || 77 ||
tasmādgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ pātāle pārthivottama ||
anenaiva śarīreṇa dharmapatnyānayā saha || 78 ||

viruddhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ yataḥ karma tvadudbhavam || 79 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
evaṃ deva kariṣyāmi gatvā'yodhyāṃ mahāpurīm ||
putraṃ rājye pratiṣṭhāpya maṃtriṇāṃ saṃnivedya ca || 6.95.80 ||
tathāhaṃ deva devyā ca proktaḥ saṃtuṣṭayā purā ||

tadātra māmake kuṇḍe prakṣeptavyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || 82 ||
tāni cārpaya me bhūyo yenānṛṇyaṃ vrajāmyaham ||
tasyā devyāḥ surādhīśa tvatprasādena sāṃpratam || 83 ||
evamuktastatastena bhagavāṃstripurāṃtakaḥ ||
ājñāpya tāni sarvāṇi dadau tatra drutaṃ gataḥ || 84 ||
abravīcca sutastatra svayaṃ rājā bhaviṣyati ||
vīryaudāryasamopeto vaṃśasyoddharaṇakṣamaḥ || 85 ||
tvaṃ cāgaccha mayā sārdhamadyaiva mama maṃdire ||
praviśyātra jale puṇye devīkuṇḍasamudbhave || 86 ||
adya māghacaturdaśyāṃ śuklāyāmaparo'pi yaḥ ||
devīmimāṃ ca saṃpūjya jale'sminbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 87 ||
kariṣyati praveśena prāṇatyāgaṃ nṛpottama ||
sa ca yāsyati yatrāste pātāle hāṭakeśvaraḥ || 88 ||
snānaṃ vā pārthivaśreṣṭha yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ tasya vyādhīnāṃ na bhaviṣyati || || 89 ||
evamuktvā tamādāya nṛpaṃ bhāryāsamanvitam ||
ajābhistābhirastraiśca taiścāpi parameśvaraḥ ||
praviveśa jale tasmindevīkuṇḍasamudbhave || 6.95.90 ||

tenaiva naradehena sa kalatrasamanvitaḥ || 91
adyāpi tiṣṭhate tatra jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ ||
pūjayānaśca taṃ devaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram || 92 ||
evaṃ tatra samudbhūtā sā devī parameśvarī ||
sthāpitā tena bhūpena śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 93 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'jāpāleśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 95 || ||9 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

<6.98>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tato daśaratho rājā maṃtribhistairvisarjitaḥ ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ saṃprāpto harṣasaṃyutaḥ || 1 ||
tatrāgatya tato devīṃ pitrā saṃsthāpitā purā ||
pūjayitvā'tha sadbhaktyā snātvā kuṇḍe śubhodake || 2 ||
tato'nyāni ca mukhyāni dṛṣṭvā cāyatanāni saḥ ||
snātvā tīrtheṣvanekeṣu dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ || 3 ||
prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ||
tatra saṃsthāpayāmāsa pratimāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ śubhām || 4 ||
tasyāgre kārayāmāsa vāpīṃ svacchodakānvitām ||
sopānapaṃktibhiryuktāṃ sādhubhiḥ saṃpraśaṃsitām|| 5 ||
udakena tatastasyā devārādhanatatparaḥ ||
prakārairbahubhistīvraṃ cakāra sumahattapaḥ || 6 ||
tato varṣaśate'tīte tasya tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ ||
vilokya ca tapastīvraṃ vihitaṃ tena bhūbhujā || 7 ||
provāca darśanaṃ gatvā pakṣirājaṃ samāśritaḥ ||
meghagambhīrayāvācā bahudevagaṇairvṛtaḥ || 8 ||
|| śrīviṣṇuruvāca || ||
parituṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ varaya suvrata ||
api te durlabhaṃ kāmamahaṃ dāsyāmi kṛtsnaśaḥ || 9 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
putrārtho'yaṃ samāraṃbho mayā deva kṛto'khilaḥ ||
tapaso dehi me putrāṃstasmādvaṃśavivṛddhidān || 6.98.10 ||
anyatsarvaṃ surādhīśa dhruvamasti gṛhe sthitam ||
prasādāttava yatkiṃcidvaibhavaṃ vidyate mama || 11 ||
|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||
ahaṃ tava gṛhe rājansvayameva na saṃśayaḥ ||
avatāraṃ kariṣyāmi kṛtvā rūpacatuṣṭayam|| 12 ||
devakāryāya tasmāttvaṃ gṛhaṃ gatvā mahīpate ||
kuru rājyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat || 13 ||
tatheyaṃ yā tvayā vāpī nirmitā vimalodakā ||
rājavāpīti vikhyātā loke seyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 14 ||
asyāṃ snātvā naro bhaktyā ya enāṃ pūjayiṣyati ||
śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine || 15 ||
tataḥ kariṣyati śrāddhaṃ yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa ||
aputraḥ prāpsyate putrānvaṃśavṛddhikarānsa hi || 16 ||
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
prahṛṣṭavadano bhūtvā so'pi rājā yayau gṛham || 17 ||
tataḥ stokena kālena tasya putracatuṣṭayam ||
saṃjātaṃ loke vikhyātaṃ kalatratritayasya ca || 18 ||
kauśalyānāma vikhyātā tasya bhāryā suśobhanā ||
jyeṣṭhā tasyāṃ suto jajñe rāmākhyaḥ prathamaḥ sutaḥ || 19 ||
tathānyā kaikayī nāma tasya bhāryā kaniṣṭhikā ||
bharato nāma vikhyātastasyāḥ putro'bhavattvasau || 6.98.20 ||
sumitrākhyā tathā cānyā patnī yā madhyamā sthitā ||
śatrughnalakṣmaṇau putrau tasyāṃ jātau mahābalau || 21 ||
tathānyā kanyakā caikā babhūva varavarṇinī ||
dadau yāṃ putrahīnasya lomapādasya bhūpateḥ ||22||
ānṛṇyaṃ bhūpatiḥ prāpya evaṃ daśarathastadā||
pitṝṇāṃ prayayau svargaṃ kṛtakṛtyastathā dvijāḥ || 23 ||
atha rājā'bhavadrāmaḥ sārvabhaumastataḥ param||
rāvaṇo yena durdharṣo nihato devakaṃṭakaḥ || 24 ||
yena rāmeśvaraścātra nirmito lakṣmaṇeśvaraḥ ||
sītādevī tathā mūrtā yena cātra pratiṣṭhitā ||25||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye rājasvāmirājavāpīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 98 ||

<6.99>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ tatra rāmeṇa nirmitaḥ ||
rāmeśvarastathā sītā tena tatra vinirmitā || 1 ||
tathā ca lakṣmaṇārthāya nirmitastena saṃśrayaḥ ||
etanmahadviruddhaṃ te pratibhāti vaco'khilam || 2 ||
tvayā sūta purā proktaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ ||
sītayā sahitaḥ prāptaḥ kṣetre'tra prasthito vane || 3 ||
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā gayāśīrṣe lakṣmaṇena viruddhya ca ||
punaḥ saṃprasthito'raṇyaṃ krodhāviṣṭaśca taṃ prati | 4 ||
yattvayoktaṃ tadā tena nirmito'tra maheśvaraḥ ||
etacca sarvamācakṣva saṃdehaṃ sūtanandana || 5 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atra me nāsti saṃdeho yuṣmākaṃ ca punaḥ sthitaḥ ||
tato vakṣyāmyaśeṣeṇa śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
etatkṣetraṃ punaścādyaṃ na kṣayaṃ yāti kutracit || 6 ||
anyasmindivase prāpte sa tadā raghunaṃdanaḥ ||
yadā virodhamāpannaḥ sārdhaṃ saumitriṇā saha || 7 ||
etatpunardinaṃ cānyadyatra tena pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
rāmeśvaraḥ svayaṃ bhaktyā duḥkhitena mahātmanā || 8 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
anyasmindivase tatra kasminkāle raghūttamaḥ ||
saṃprāptastasya kiṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃjātaṃ tatprakīrtaya || 9 || |
|| sūta uvāca || ||
kṛtvā sītāparityāgaṃ rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ||
lokāpavādasaṃtrastastato rājyaṃ cakāra saḥ || 6.99.10 ||
kṛtvā svarṇamayīṃ sītāṃ patnīṃ yajñaprasiddhaye ||
na sa cakre mahābhāgo bhāryāmanyāṃ kathaṃcana || 11 ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca ||
brahmacaryeṇa cakre sa rājyaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam || 12 ||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte prāpte caikādaśe dvijāḥ ||
devadūtaḥ samāyāto rāmasya sadanaṃ prati ||13||
tenoktaṃ devarājena preṣito'haṃ tavāṃtikam ||
tasmātkuru samālokaṃ vijane tvaṃ mayā saha || 14 ||
evamuktastadā tena dūtena raghunaṃdanaḥ ||
paraṃ rahaḥ samāsādya mantraṃ cakre tataḥ param || 15 ||
tasyaivamupaviṣṭasya maṃtrasthāne mahātmanaḥ ||
bahutvādiṣṭalokasya na rahasyaṃ prajāyate || 16 ||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā dūtaḥ provāca sādaram ||
vihasya janasaṃsargaṃ dṛṣṭvaikāṃte'pi saṃsthite || 17 ||
yathā daṃṣṭrācyutaḥ sarpo nāgo vā madavarjitaḥ ||
ājñāhīnastathā rājā mānavaiḥ paribhūyate || 18 ||
seyaṃ tava raghuśreṣṭha nājñāsti prativedmyaham ||
śakrālāpamapi tvaṃ ca naikāṃte śrotumarhasi || 19 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ ||
triśākhāṃ bhṛkuṭīṃ kṛtvā tataḥ sa prāha lakṣmaṇam|| 6.99.20 ||
mamātra saṃniviṣṭasya sahānena prajalpataḥ ||
yadi kaścinnaro mohādāgamiṣyati lakṣmaṇa ||
svahastena na saṃdehaḥ sūdayiṣyāmi taṃ drutam || 21 ||
na hanmi yadi taṃ prāptamatra me dṛṣṭigocaram||
tanmā bhūnme gatiḥ śreṣṭhā dharmiṇāṃ yā prapadyate || || 22 ||
evaṃ jñātvā prayatnena tvayā bhāvyamasaṃśayam ||
rājadvāri yathā kaścinna mayā vadhyate'dhunā || 23 ||
tamomityeva saṃprocya lakṣmaṇaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||
rājadvāraṃ samāsādya cakāra vijanaṃ tataḥ|| 24 ||
devadūto'pi rāmeṇa samaṃ cakre tataḥ param||
maṃtraṃ śakrasamādiṣṭaṃ tathānyaiḥ svargavāsibhiḥ || 25 ||
|| devadūta uvāca || ||
tvaṃ rāvaṇavināśārthamavatīrṇo dharātale ||
sa ca vyāpādito duṣṭaḥ pāpastrailokyakaṃṭakaḥ || 26 ||
kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mahābhāga deva kṛtyaṃ tvayā'dhunā ||
tasmātsaṃtu sanāthāste devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ||27||
yadi te rocate citte noparodhena sāṃpratam ||
prasādaṃ kuru devānāṃ tasmādāgaccha satvaram ||
svargalokaṃ parityajya martyalokaṃ suniṃditam ||28||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etasminnaṃtare prāpto durvāsā munisattamaḥ ||
provācātha kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ kvāsau kvāsau raghūttamaḥ || 29 ||
|| lakṣmaṇa uvāca || ||
vyagraḥ sa pārthivaśreṣṭho devakāryeṇa kenacit ||
tasmādatraiva vipreṃdra muhūrtaṃ paripālaya ||6.99.30||
yāvatsāṃtvayate rāmo dūtaṃ śakrasamudbhavam ||
mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā vinayāvanatasya hi || 31 ||
|| durvāsā uvāca || ||
yadi yāsyati no dṛṣṭiṃ mama drāksa raghūttamaḥ ||
śāpaṃ dattvā kulaṃ sarvaṃ taddhakṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 32 ||
mamāpi darśanādanyanna kiṃcidvidyate guru ||
kṛtyaṃ lakṣmaṇa yāvattvamanyanmūढ़ prakatthase || 33 ||
tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇaścitte ciṃtayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ ||
varaṃ me mṛtyurekasya mā bhūyātkulasaṃkṣayaḥ || 34 ||
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato rāmamupādravat ||
uvāca daṃḍavadbhūmau praṇipatya kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 35 ||
durvāsā muniśārdūlo deva te dvāri tiṣṭhati ||
darśanārthī kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām || 36 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tato dūtamuvāca tam ||
gatvemaṃ brūhi deveśaṃ mama vākyādasaṃśayam ||
ahaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃta āgamiṣyāmi teṃ'tike || 37 ||
evamuktvā visṛjyātha taṃ dūtaṃ prāha lakṣmaṇam ||
praveśaya drutaṃ vatsa taṃ tvaṃ durvāsasaṃ munim || 38 ||
tataścārghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ ca gṛhītvā sammukho yayau ||
rāmadevaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā sacivaiḥ parivāritaḥ || 39 ||
dattvārghyaṃ vidhivattasya praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ||
provāca rāmadevo'tha harṣagadgadayā girā || 6.99.40 ||
svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca te ||
etadrājyamamī putrā vibhavaśca tava prabho || 41 ||
kṛtvā mama prasādaṃ ca gṛhāṇa munisattama ||
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yattvaṃ me gṛhamāgataḥ ||
pūjyo lokatrayasyāpi niḥśeṣatapasāṃnidhiḥ || 42 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
cāturmāsyavrataṃ kṛtvā nirāhāro raghūttama ||
adya te bhavanaṃ prāpya āhārārthaṃ bubhukṣitaḥ || 43 ||
tasmāttvaṃ yaccha me śīghraṃ bhojanaṃ raghunaṃdana ||
nānyena kāraṇaṃ kiṃcitsaṃnyastasya dhanādinā || 44 ||
tatastaṃ bhojayāmāsa śraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
svayamevāgrataḥ sthitvā mṛṣṭānnairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 45 ||
lehyaiścoṣyaistathā carvyaiḥ khādyaireva pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
yāvadicchā munestasya tathānnairvividhairapi || 46 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye rāmeśvarasthāpanaprastāve śrīrāmaṃprati durvāsaḥ samāgamanavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ || 99 || || cha ||

<6.100>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ bhuktvā sa viprarṣirvāṃchayā rāmamaṃdire ||
dattāśīrnirgataḥ paścādāmaṃtrya raghunaṃdanam || 1 ||
atha yāte munau tasmindurvāsasi tadaṃtikāt ||
lakṣmaṇaḥ khaṅgamādāya rāmadevamuvāca ha || 2 ||
etatkhaṅgaṃ gṛhītvāśu māṃ prabho vinipātaya ||
yena te syādṛtaṃ vākyaṃ pratijñātaṃ ca yatpurā || 3 ||
tato rāmaścirātsmṛtvā tāṃ pratijñāṃ svayaṃ kṛtām ||
vadhārthaṃ saṃpraviṣṭasya samīpe puruṣasya ca || 4 ||
tato'ticiṃtayāmāsa vyākulenāṃtarātmanā ||
bāṣpavyākulanetraśca niḥṣvasanpannago yathā || 5 ||
taṃ dīnavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā niḥṣvasaṃtaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||
bhūyaḥ provāca saumitrirvinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ || 6 ||
eṣa eva paro dharmo bhūpatīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
yathātmīyaṃ vacastathyaṃ kriyate nirvikalpitam || 7 ||
tasmāttvayā prabho proktaṃ svayameva mamāgrataḥ ||
tasyaiva devadūtasya tāranādena kopataḥ || 9 ||
yo'trāgacchati saumitre mama dūtasya saṃnidhau ||
taṃ ceddhanmi svahastena nāhaṃ tasmātsupāpakṛt || 9 ||
tadahaṃ cāgatastāta bhayāddurvāsaso muneḥ ||
niṣiddho'pi tvayātīva tasmācchīghraṃ tu ghātaya || 6.100.10 ||
tataḥ saṃmaṃtrya suciraṃ maṃtribhiḥ sahito nṛpaḥ ||
brāhmaṇairdharmaśāstrajñaistathānyairvedapāragaiḥ || 11 ||
provāca lakṣmaṇaṃ paścādvinayāvanataṃ sthitam ||
vāṣpaklinnamukho rāmo gadgadaṃ niḥśvasanmuhuḥ || 12 ||
vraja lakṣmaṇa muktastvaṃ mayā deśātaraṃ drutam ||
tyāgo vātha vadho vātha sādhūnāmubhayaṃ samam || 13 ||
na mayā darśanaṃ bhūyastava kāryaṃ kathaṃcana ||
na sthātavyaṃ ca deśe'pi yadi me vāṃchasi priyam || 14 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praṇipatya tataḥ param ||
niryayau nagarāttasmāttatkṣaṇādeva lakṣmaṇaḥ || 15 ||
akṛtvāpi samālāpaṃ kenacinnijamaṃdire ||
mātrā vā bhāryayā vātha sutena suhṛdāthavā || 16 ||
tato'sau sarayūṃ gatvā'vagāhyātha ca tajjalam ||
śucirbhūtvā niviṣṭotha tattīre vijane śubhe || 17 ||
padmāsanaṃ vidhāyātha nyasyātmānaṃ tathātmani ||
brahmadvāreṇa taṃ paścāttejorūpaṃ vyasarjayat || 18 ||
atha tadrāghavo dṛṣṭvā mahattejo viyadgatam ||
vismayena samāyukto'cintayatkimidaṃ tataḥ || 19 ||
atha martye parityakte tejasā tena tatkṣaṇāt ||
vaiṣṇavena turīyeṇa bhāgena dvijasattamāḥ || 6.100.20 ||
papāta bhūtale kāyaṃ kāṣṭhaloṣṭopamaṃ drutam||
lakṣmaṇasya gataśrīkaṃ sarayvāḥ puline śubhe || 21 ||
tatastu rāghavaḥ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaṃ gatajīvitam ||
patitaṃ saritastīre vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ || 22 ||
svayaṃ gatvā tamuddeśaṃ sāmātyaḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ ||
lakṣmaṇaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā karuṇaṃ paryadevayat || 23 ||
hā vatsa māṃ parityajya kiṃ tvaṃ saṃprasthito divam ||
prāṇeṣṭaṃ bhrātaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sadā tava mate sthitam || 24 ||
tasminnapi mahāraṇye gacchamānaḥ purādaham ||
api saṃdhāryamāṇena anuyātastvayā tadā || 25 ||
saṃprāpte'pi kabaṃdhākhye rākṣase balavattare ||
tvayā rātrimukhe ghore sabhāryo'haṃ prarakṣitaḥ || 26 ||
yenendrajiddhato yuddhe tādṛgrūpo niśācaraḥ ||
sa eṣa patitaḥ śete gatāsurdharaṇītale || 97 ||
yena śūrpaṇakhā dhvastā rākṣasī sā ca dāruṇā ||
līlayāpi mamādeśātsoyamevaṃvidhaḥ sthitaḥ || 28 ||
yadbāhubalamāśritya mayā dhvastā niśācarāḥ ||
so'yaṃ nipatitaḥ śete mama bhrātā hyanāthavat  || 29 ||
hā vatsa kva gato māṃ tvaṃ vimucya bhrātaraṃ nijam ||
jyeṣṭhaṃ prāṇasamaṃ kiṃ te sneho'dya vigataḥ kvacit || 6.100.30 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ bahuvidhānkṛtvā pralāpānraghunandanaḥ ||
mātṛbhiḥ sahito dīnaḥ śokena mahatānvitaḥ || 31 ||
tataste maṃtriṇastasya procustaṃ vīkṣya duḥkhitam ||
vilapaṃtaṃ raghuśreṣṭhaṃ strījanena samanvitam || 32 ||
|| maṃtriṇa ūcuḥ || ||
mā śokaṃ kuru rājendra yathānyaḥ prākṛtaḥ sthitaḥ ||
kuruṣva ca yathedaṃ syātsāṃprataṃ caurdhvadaihikam|| 33 ||
naṣṭaṃ mṛtamatītaṃ ca ye śocanti kubuddhayaḥ ||
dhīrāṇāṃ tu purā rājannaṣṭaṃ naṣṭaṃ mṛtaṃ mṛtam || 34 ||
evaṃ te mantriṇaḥ procya tatastasya kalevaram ||
lakṣmaṇasya vilapyauccaiścandanośīrakuṃkumaiḥ || 35 ||
karpūrāgurumiśraiśca tathānyaiḥ susugandhibhiḥ ||
pariveṣṭya śubhairvastraiḥ puṣpaiḥ saṃbhūṣya śobhanaiḥ || 36 ||
candanāgurukāṣṭhaiśca citiṃ kṛtvā suvistarām ||
nyadadhustasya tadgātraṃ tatra dakṣiṇadiṅmukham || 37 ||
etasminnaṃtare jātaṃ tatrāścaryaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
tanme nigadataḥ sarvaṃ śṛṇvaṃtu sakalaṃ dvijāḥ || 38 ||
yāvatteṃ'taḥ samāropya citāṃ tasya kalevaram ||
prayacchaṃti havirvāhaṃ tāvannaṣṭaṃ kalevaram || 39 ||
etasminnaṃtare vāṇī nirgatā gaganāṃgaṇāt ||
nādayaṃtī diśaḥ sarvāḥ puṣpavarṣādanaṃtaram || 6.100.40 ||
rāmarāma mahābāho mā tvaṃ śokaparo bhava ||
na cāsya yujyate vahnirdātuṃ caiva kathaṃcana || 41 ||
brahmajñānaprayuktasya saṃnyastasya viśeṣataḥ ||
agnidānaṃ na yuktaṃ syātsarveṣāmapi yoginām || 42 ||
tavāyaṃ bāṃdhavo rāma brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ gataḥ|
brahmadvāreṇa cātmānaṃ niṣkramya sumahāyaśāḥ || 43 ||
atha te maṃtriṇaḥ procustacchrutvā''kāśagaṃ vacaḥ ||
aśocyo yaṃ mahārāja saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ ||
lakṣmaṇo gamyatāṃ śīghraṃ tasmātsvabhavane vibho || 44 ||
cintyantāṃ rājakāryāṇi tathā yaccaurdhvadaihikam ||
kuru snehocitaṃ tasya pṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇasattamān || 45 ||
|| rāma uvāca ||
nāhaṃ gṛhaṃ gamiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇena vinā'dhunā ||
prāṇānatra vihāsyāmi yathā tena mahātmanā || 46 ||
eṣa putro mayā dattaḥ kuśākhyo mama saṃmataḥ ||
yuṣmabhyaṃ kriyatāṃ rājye madīye yadi rocate || 47 ||
evamuktvā tato rāmo gantukāmo divālayam ||
cintayāmāsa bhūyo'pi smṛtvā mitraṃ vibhīṣaṇam || 48 ||
mayā tasya tadā dattaṃ laṃkāyāṃ rājyamakṣayam ||
bahubhaktipratuṣṭena yāvaccandrārkatārakāḥ || 49 ||
atikrūratarā jātī rākṣasānāṃ yataḥ smṛtā ||
viśeṣādvarapuṣṭānāṃ jāyate'tra dharātale || 6.100.50 ||
taccedrākṣasabhāvena sa mahātmā vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
kariṣyati suraiḥ sārdhaṃ virodhaṃ rāvaṇo yathā || 51 ||
taṃ devāḥ sūdayiṣyaṃti upāyaiḥ sāmapūrvakaiḥ ||
trailokyakaṇṭako yadvattasya bhrātā daśānanaḥ || 52 ||
tato me syānmṛṣā vāṇī tasmādgatvā tadaṃtikam ||
śikṣāṃ dadāmi tasyāhaṃ yathā devānna dūṣayet || 53 ||
tathā me paramaṃ mitraṃ dvitīyaṃ vānaraḥ sthitaḥ ||
sugrīvākhyo mahābhāgo jāṃbavāṃśca tathā'paraḥ || 54 ||
sabhṛtyo vāyuputraśca vāliputrasamanvitaḥ ||
kumudākhyaśca tāraśca tathānye'pi ca vānarāḥ ||55||
tasmāttānapi saṃbhāṣya sarvānsaṃmaṃtrya sādaram ||
tato gacchāmi devānāṃ kṛtakṛtyo gṛhaṃ prati || 56 ||
evaṃ saṃcintya suciraṃ samāhūya ca puṣpakam ||
tatrāruhya yayau tūrṇaṃ kiṣkindhākhyāṃ purīṃ prati ||57||
atha te vānarā dṛṣṭvā proddyotaṃ puṣpakodbhavam ||
vijñāya rāghavaṃ prāptaṃ satvaraṃ sammukhā yayuḥ || 58 ||
tataḥ praṇamya te dūrājjānubhyāmavaniṃ gatāḥ ||
jayeti śabdamādāya muhurmuhuritastataḥ ||59||
tatastenaiva saṃyuktāḥ kiṣkindhāṃ tāṃ mahāpurīm ||
viviśuḥ satpatākābhiḥ samaṃtātsamalaṃkṛtām || 6.100.60 ||
athottīrya vimānāgryātsugrīvabhavane śubhe ||
praviveśa drutaṃ rāmaḥ sarvataḥ suvibhūṣite || 61 ||
tatra rāmaṃ niviṣṭaṃ te viśrāṃtaṃ vīkṣya vānarāḥ||
arghyādibhiśca saṃpūjya papracchustadanantaram ||62||
|| vānarā ūcuḥ || ||
tejasā tvaṃ vinirmukto dṛśyase raghunandana||
kṛśo'syatīva codvignaḥ kaccitkṣemaṃ gṛhe tava ||63||
kāye vā'nugato nityaṃ tathā te lakṣmaṇo'nujaḥ||
na dṛśyate samīpasthaḥ kimadya tava rāghava ||64||
tathā prāṇasamā'bhīṣṭā sītā tava prabho ||
dṛśyate kiṃ na pārśvasthā etannaḥ kautukaṃ param ||65||
|| sūta uvāca|| ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ niḥśvasya rāghavaḥ ||
vāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇo bhūtvā sarvaṃ teṣāṃ nyavedayat ||66||
atha sītā parityaktā tathā bhrātā sa lakṣmaṇaḥ||
yadarthaṃ tatra saṃprāptaḥ svayameva dvijottamāḥ ||67||
tacchrutvā vānarāḥ sarve sugrīvapramukhāstataḥ ||
ruruduste suduḥkhārtāḥ samāliṃgya tataḥ param||68||
evaṃ ciraṃ pralapyoccaistataḥ procū raghūttamam||
ādeśo dīyatāṃ rājanyo'smābhiriha sidhyati ||69||
dhanyā vayaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe yeṣāṃ tvaṃ raghusattama ||
īdṛksnehasamāyuktaḥ samāgacchasi maṃdire || 6.100.70 ||
|| rāma uvāca || ||
uṣitvā rajanīmekāṃ sugrīva tava maṃdire ||
prātarlaṃkāṃ gamiṣyāmi yatrāste sa vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 71 ||
pradhānāmātyayuktena tvayāpi kapisattama ||
āgaṃtavyaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ vibhīṣaṇagṛhaṃ prati || 72 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrīrāmeśvarasthāpana prastāve lakṣmaṇanirvāṇottaraṃ śrīrāmasya sugrīvanagarīṃprati gamanavarṇanaṃnāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 100 ||

<6.101>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ tāṃ rajanīṃ tatra sa uṣitvā raghūttamaḥ ||
upāsyamānaḥ sarvaistaiḥ sadbhaktyā vānarottamaiḥ || 1 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṇḍale ||
kṛtvā prābhātikaṃ karma samāhūyātha puṣpakam || 2 ||
sugrīveṇa suṣeṇena tāreṇa kumudena ca ||
aṃgadenātha kuṇḍena vāyuputreṇa dhīmatā || 3 ||
gavākṣeṇa naleneva tathā jāṃbavatāpi ca ||
daśabhirvānaraiḥ sārdhaṃ samārūḍhaḥ sa puṣpake || 4 ||
tataḥ saṃprasthitaḥ kāle laṃkāmuddiśya rāghavaḥ ||
manojavena tenaiva vimānena suvarcasā || 5 ||
saṃprāptastatkṣaṇādeva laṃkākhyāṃ ca mahāpurīm ||
vīkṣayaṃstānpradeśāṃśca yatra yuddhaṃ purā'bhavat || 6 ||
tato vibhīṣaṇo dṛṣṭvā proddyotaṃ puṣpakodbhavam ||
rāmaṃ vijñāya saṃprāptaṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ sammukho yayau ||
maṃtribhiḥ sakalaiḥ sārdhaṃ tathā bhṛtyaiḥ sutairapi || 7 ||
atha dṛṣṭvā sudūrāttaṃ rāmadevaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau jayaśabdamudīrayan || 8 ||
tathāgataṃ pariṣvajya sādaraṃ sa vibhīṣaṇam ||
tenaiva sahitaḥ paścāllaṃkāṃ tāṃ praviveśa ha || 9 ||
vibhīṣaṇagṛhaṃ prāpya tatra siṃhāsane śubhe ||
niviṣṭo vānaraistaiśca samantātparivāritaḥ || 6.101.10 ||
tato nivedayāmāsa tasmai sarvaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
rājyaṃ putrakalatrādi yaccānyadapi kiṃcana || 11 ||
tataḥ provāca vinayātkṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||
ādeśo dīyatāṃ deva brūhi kṛtyaṃ karomi kim || 12 ||
akasmādeva saṃprāptaḥ kimarthaṃ vada me prabho ||
kiṃ nāyātaḥ sa saumitristvayā sārdha ca jānakī ||13||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
nivedya rāghavastasmai sarvaṃ gadgadayā girā ||
vāṣpapūrapraticchannavaktro bhūyo viniḥśvasan || 14 ||
tataḥ provāca satyārthaṃ vibhīṣaṇakṛte hitam ||
taṃ cāpi śokasaṃtaptaṃ saṃbodhya raghunaṃdanaḥ || 15 ||
ahaṃ rājyaṃ parityajya sāṃprataṃ rākṣasottama ||
yāsyāmi tridivaṃ tūrṇaṃ lakṣmaṇo yatra saṃsthitaḥ || || 16 ||
na tena rahito martye muhūrtamapi cotsahe ||
sthātuṃ rākṣasaśārdūla bāṃdhavena mahātmanā || 17 ||
ahaṃ śikṣāpaṇārthāya tava prāpto vibhīṣaṇa ||
tasmādavyagracittena saṃśṛṇuṣva kuruṣva ca || 18 ||
eṣā rājyodbhavā lakṣmīrmadaṃ saṃjanayennṛṇām ||
madyavatsvalpabuddhīnāṃ tasmātkāryo na sa tvayā || 19 ||
śakrādyā amarāḥ sarve tvayā pūjyāḥ sadaiva hi ||
mānyāśca yena te rājyaṃ jāyate śāśvataṃ sadā || 6.101.20 ||
mama satyaṃ bhavedvākya metasmādahamāgataḥ ||
prāptarājyapratiṣṭho'pi tava bhrātā mahābalaḥ || 21 ||
vināśaṃ sahasā prāptastasmānmānyāḥ surāḥ sadā ||
yadi kaścitsamāyāti mānuṣo'tra kathaṃcana ||
matkāya eva draṣṭavyaḥ sarvaireva niśācaraiḥ || 22 ||
tathā niśācarāḥ sarve tvayā vāryā vibhīṣaṇa ||
mama setuṃ samullaṃghya na gaṃtavyaṃ dharātale || 23 ||
|| vibhīṣaṇa uvāca || ||
evaṃ vibho kariṣyāmi tavādeśamasaṃśayam ||
paraṃ tvayā parityakte martye me jīvitaṃ vrajet || 24 ||
tasmānmāmapi tatraiva tvaṃ vibho netumarhasi ||
ātmanā saha yatrāste prāggato lakṣmaṇastava || 25 ||
|| śrīrāma uvāca || ||
mayā te'kṣayamādiṣṭaṃ rājyaṃ rākṣasasattama ||
tasmānnārhasi māṃ kartuṃ mithyācāraṃ kathaṃcana || 26 ||
ahamasminsvake setau śaṃkaratritayaṃ śubham ||
sthāpayiṣyāmi kīrtyarthaṃ tatpūjyaṃ bhavatā sadā ||
bhaktimānpratisaṃdhāya yāvaccaṃdrārkatārakam || 27 ||
evamuktvā raghuśreṣṭho rākṣasendraṃ vibhīṣaṇam ||
daśarātraṃ tatra tasthau laṃkāyāṃ vānaraiḥ saha || 28 ||
kurvanyuddhakathāścitrā yāḥ kṛtāḥ pūrvameva hi ||
paśyanyuddhasya sarvāṇi sthānāni vividhāni ca || 29 ||
śaṃsamānaḥ pravīrāṃstānrākṣasānbalavattarān ||
kumbhakarṇendrajitpūrvānsaṃkhye cābhimukhāgatān || 6.101.30 ||
tataścaikādaśe prāpte divase raghunaṃdanaḥ ||
puṣpakaṃ tatsamāruhya prasthitaḥ svapurīṃ prati || 31 ||
vānaraistaiḥ samopeto vibhīṣaṇapuraḥsaraḥ ||
tataḥ saṃsthāpayāmāsa setuprāṃte maheśvaram || 32
madhye caiva tathādau ca śraddhāpūtena cetasā ||
rāmeśvaratrayaṃ rāma evaṃ tatra vidhāya saḥ || 33 ||
setubaṃdhaṃ tathāsādya prasthitaḥ svagṛhaṃ prati ||
tāvadvibhīṣaṇenoktaḥ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ || 34 ||
|| vibhīṣaṇa uvāca || ||
anena setumārgeṇa rāmeśvaradidṛkṣayā ||
mānavā āgamiṣyaṃti kautukācchraddhayāvitāḥ || 35 ||
rākṣasānāṃ mahārāja jātiḥ krūratamā matā ||
dṛṣṭvā mānuṣamāyāṃtaṃ māṃsasyecchā prajāyate || 36 ||
yadā kaścijjanaṃ kaścidrākṣaso bhakṣayiṣyati |
ājñābhaṃgo dhruvaṃ bhāvī mama bhaktiratasya ca || 37 ||
bhaviṣyaṃti kalau kāle daridrā nṛpamānavāḥ ||
te'tra svarṇasya lobhena devatādarśanāya ca || 38 ||
nityaṃ caivāgamiṣyanti tyaktvā rakṣaḥkṛtaṃ bhayam |
teṣāṃ yadi vadhaṃ kaścidrākṣasātprāpayiṣyati || 39 ||
bhaviṣyati ca me doṣaḥ prabhudrohodbhavaḥ prabho ||
tasmātkaṃcidupāyaṃ tvaṃ cintayasva yathā mama |
ājñābhaṃgakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ jāyate na guro kvacit || 6.101.40 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tataḥ sa raghusattamaḥ ||
bāḍhamityeva coktvātha cāpaṃ sajjīcakāra saḥ || 41 ||
tatastaṃ kīrtirūpaṃ ca madhyadeśe raghūttamaḥ||
acchinanniśitairbāṇairdaśayojanavistṛtam|| 42 ||
tena saṃsthāpito yatra śikhare śaṃkaraḥ svayam ||
śikharaṃ tatsaliṃgaṃ ca patitaṃ vāridherjale || 43 ||
evaṃ mārgamagamyaṃ taṃ kṛtvā setusamudbhavam ||
vānarai rākṣasaiḥ sārdhaṃ tataḥ saṃprasthito gṛham || 44 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇaekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye setumadhye śrīrāmakṛtarāmeśvarapratiṣṭhāvarṇanaṃnāmaiko ttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 101 ||

<6.102>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
saṃprasthitasya rāmasya svakīyaṃ sadanaṃ prati ||
yadāścaryamabhūnmārge śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 1 ||
nabhomārgeṇa gacchattadvimānaṃ puṣpakaṃ dvijāḥ ||
akasmādeva sañjātaṃ niścalaṃ citrakṛnnṛṇām || 2 ||
atha tanniścalaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṣpakaṃ gaganāṃgaṇe ||
rāmo vāyusutasyedaṃ vacanaṃ prāha vismayāt || 3
tvaṃ gatvā mārute śīghraṃ bhūmiṃ jānīhi kāraṇam ||
kimetatpuṣpakaṃ vyomni niścalatvamupāgatam || 4 ||
kadāciddhāryate nāsya gatiḥ kutrāpi kenacit ||
brahmadṛṣṭiprasūtasya puṣpakasya mahātmanaḥ || 5 ||
bāḍhamityeva sa procya hanūmāndharaṇītalam ||
gatvā śīghraṃ punaḥ prāha praṇipatya raghūttamam || 6 ||
atrāsyādhaḥ śubhaṃ kṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvara saṃjñitam ||
yatra sākṣājjagatkartā svayaṃ brahmā vyavasthitaḥ || 7 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā devavaidyau tathāśvinau ||
tatra tiṣṭhanti te sarve tathānye siddhakinnarāḥ || 8 ||
etasmātkāraṇānnaitadatikrāmati puṣpakam ||
tatkṣetraṃ niścalībhūtaṃ satyametanmayoditam || 9 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kautūhalasamavitaḥ ||
puṣpakaṃ prerayāmāsa tatkṣetraṃ prati rāghavaḥ ||6.102.10 ||
sarvaistairvānaraiḥ sārdhaṃ rākṣasaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
avatīrya tato hṛṣṭastasminkṣetre samantataḥ || 11 ||
tīrthamālokayāmāsa puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ||
tato vilokayāmāsa pitāmahavinirmitām ||
cāmuṇḍāṃ tatra ca snātvā kuṇḍe kāmapradāyini || 12 ||
tato vilokayāmāsa pitrā tasya vinirmitam||
rāmaḥ svamiva deveśaṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ caturbhujam|| || 13 ||
rājavāpyāṃ śucirbhūtvā snātvā tarpya nijānpitṝn ||
tataśca cintayāmāsa kṣetre tra bahupuṇyade || 14 ||
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmyeva yadvattātena keśavaḥ ||
tathā me dayito bhrātā lakṣmaṇo divamāśritaḥ || 15 ||
yastasya nāmanirdiṣṭaṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmyaham ||
taṃ cāpi mūrtimaṃtaṃ ca sītayā sahitaṃ śubham ||
kṣetre medhyatame cātra tathātmānaṃ dṛṣanmayam || 16 ||
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā prāsādānāṃ ca paṃcakam ||
sthāpayāmāsa sadbhaktyā rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || 17 ||
tataste vānarāḥ sarve rākṣasāśca viśeṣataḥ ||
liṃgāni sthāpayāmāsuḥ svānisvāni pṛthakpṛthak || 18 ||
tatraiva suciraṃ kālaṃ sthitāste śraddhayā'nvitāḥ ||
tato jagmurayodhyāyāṃ vimānavaramāśritāḥ || 19 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yathā rāmeśvaro mahān ||
lakṣmaṇeśvarasaṃyuktastasmiṃstīrthe suśobhane || 6.102.20 ||
yastau prātaḥ samutthāya sadā paśyati mānavaḥ ||
sa kṛtsnaṃ phalamāpnoti śrute rāmāyaṇe'tra yat || 21 ||
athāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ yo rāmacaritaṃ paṭhet ||
tadagre vājimedhasya sa kṛtsnaṃ labhate phalam || 22 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrīrāmacandreṇa hāṭakeśvarakṣetre lakṣmaṇādiprāsādapañcakanirmāṇapratiṣṭhāpanavarṇanaṃnāma dvyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 102 || 

<6.103>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ||
āścaryaṃ sūtaputraitadyattvayā parikīrtitam ||
yatsthāpitāni liṃgāni rākṣasairapi vānaraiḥ || 1 ||
tasmādvistarato brūhi yatrayatra yathāyathā ||
taiḥ sthāpitāni liṃgāni yeṣu sthāneṣu sūtaja || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||'
sugrīvaḥ saṃbhramitvātha kṣetraṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ ||
bālamaṃḍanakaṃ prāpya tatra snātvā samāhitaḥ || 3 |
mukhaliṃgaṃ tatastatra sthāpayāmāsa śūlinaḥ ||
tathānyairvānaraiḥ sarvaimukhaliṃgāni śūlinaḥ ||
svasaṃjñārthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sthāpitāni yathecchayā || 4 ||
yasteṣāṃ mukhaliṃgānāṃ karoti ghṛtakaṃbalam||
makarasthena sūryeṇa śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || 5 ||
tataḥ paścimadigbhāge tasya kṣetrasya rākṣasaiḥ ||
saṃsthāpitāni liṅgāni caturvaktrāṇi ca dvijāḥ || 6 ||
rāmeṇa pūrvadigbhāge prāsādānāṃ ca paṃcakam ||
sthāpitaṃ bhaktiyuktena sarvapātakanāśanam || 7 ||
tathādakṣiṇadigbhāge kūpikā tena nirmitā||
ānarttīyataḍāgasya samīpe pāpanāśanī || 8 ||
yastasyāṃ kurute śrāddhaṃ saṃprāpte dakṣiṇāyane ||
so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya pitṛloke mahīyate || 9 ||
yastatra dīpakaṃ dadyātkārtike māsi ca dvijāḥ ||
na sa paśyati raudrāṃstānnarakānekaviṃśatim ||
na cāṃdho jāyate kvāpi yatrayatra prajāyate || 6.103.10 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
ānarttīyataḍāgaṃ tatkena tatra vinirmitam ||
kiṃprabhāvaṃ ca kārtsnyena sūtaputra prakīrtaya || 11 ||
|| sūta uvāca ||
ānarttīyataḍāgasya mahimā dvijasattamāḥ ||
ekavaktreṇa no śakyo vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi || 12 ||
āśvinasya site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
snātvā devānpitṝṃścaiva tarpayedvidhipūrvakam || 13 ||
tato dīpotsavadine śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ ||
dāmodaraṃ yamaṃ pūjya dīpaṃ dadyātsvabhaktitaḥ || || 14 ||
saṃpūjyo dharmarājastu gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ||
māṣāstilāśca dātavyā goviṃdaḥ prīyatāmiti || 15 ||
tilamāṣapradānena dvijānāṃ tarpaṇena ca ||
yamena sahito devaḥ prīyate puruṣottamaḥ || 16 ||
ya evaṃ kurute viprāstīrtha ānarta saṃjñite ||
so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpyabrahmaloke mahīyate || 17 ||
yasmindine samāyāto rāmastatra praharṣitaḥ ||
tasmindvijottamaiḥ sarvaiḥ proktaḥ so'bhyetya sādaram || 18 ||
atrāgastyo muniśreṣṭhastiṣṭhate raghunaṃdana ||
taṃ gatvā paśya viprendra mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavam || 19 ||
atha teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ||
vānarai rākṣasaiḥ sārdhaṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ satvaraṃ yayau || 6.103.20 ||
aṣṭāṃgapraṇipātena taṃ praṇamya raghūttamaḥ ||
pariṣvakto dṛḍhaṃ tena sānandena mahātmanā || 21 ||
nātidūre tatastasya vinayena samanvitaḥ ||
upaviṣṭo dharāpṛṣṭhe kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ || 22 ||
tataḥ pṛṣṭastu muninā kathayāmāsa vistarāt ||
vṛttāṃtaṃ sarvamātmīyaṃ svargasya gamanaṃ prati || 23 ||
yathā sītā parityaktā yathā saumitriṇā kṛtaḥ ||
parityāgaḥ svakīyasya saṃtyaktena mahātmanā || || 24 ||
tathā sugrīvamāsādya tathaiva ca vibhīṣaṇam ||
saṃbhāṣya cāgamastvatra tataḥ puṣpakasaṃsthitiḥ ||25 ||
tato'gastyaḥ kathāścitrāścakre tasya purastadā ||
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ dṛṣṭāṃtairbahubhirmuniḥ || 26 ||
tataḥ kathāvasāne ca calacittaṃ raghūttamam ||
vilokya pradadau tasmai ratnābharaṇamuttamam || 27 ||
yanna deveṣu yakṣeṣu siddhavidyādhareṣu ca ||
nāgeṣu rākṣasendreṣu mānuṣeṣu ca kā kathā || 28 ||
yasyendrāyudhasaṃghāśca niṣkrāmaṃti sahasraśaḥ ||
rātrau tamisrapakṣe'pi lakṣyate'rkopamatviṣaḥ || 29 ||
tadrāmastu gṛhītvā'tha vismayotphullalocanaḥ ||
papraccha kautukāviṣṭaḥ kutastvetanmune tava || || 6.103.30 ||
atyadbhutakaraṃ ratnairnirmitaṃ timirāpaham ||
kaṇṭhābharaṇamākhyāhi nedamasti jagattraye || 31 ||
|| agastiruvāca || ||
yatpaśyasi raghuśreṣṭha taḍāgamidamuttamam ||
mamāśramasamīpasthaṃ taddevadevanirmitam || 32 ||
tasya tīre mayā dṛṣṭaṃ yadāścaryamanuttamam ||
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva raghu nandana || 33 ||
kadācidrāghavaśreṣṭha niśīthe'haṃ samutthitaḥ ||

yāvattāvadvimānaṃ tadapsarogaṇarājitam ||

mṛtakasya tato daṃtairbhakṣayāmāsa satvaram || 38 ||
yathāyathā mahāmāṃsaṃ sa bhakṣayati rāghava ||
tathātathā punaḥ kāyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tatprajāyate || 39 ||

niṣkamya salilādyāvadvimānamadhirohati || 6.103.40 ||
tāvanmayā drutaṃ gatvā sa pṛṣṭaḥ kautukānnṛpaḥ ||
sevyamāno'pi gandharvaiḥ samaṃtādbuddhitatparaiḥ || 41 ||
bhobho vaimānikaśreṣṭha muhūrtaṃ pratipālaya ||
agastirnāma vipro'haṃ mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ || 42 |
tacchrutvā sammukho bhūtvā praṇāmamakarottataḥ ||
taiśca vaimānikaiḥ sārdhaṃ sarvaistaiḥ kinnarādibhiḥ || 43 ||
so'yaṃ rājā mayā pṛṣṭaḥ kṛtānatiḥ puraḥ sthitaḥ ||
kastvamīdṛgvapuḥ śrīmānvimānavaramāśritaḥ ||
sevyamāno'psarobhiśca gandharvaiḥ kinnaraistathā || || 44 ||
atrā''gatya taḍāgāṃte mahāmāṃsaprabhakṣaṇam ||
kṛtavānasi vaikalyaṃ kasmātte dṛṣṭisaṃbhavam || 45 ||
|| vaimānika uvāca || ||
sādhu sādhu muniśreṣṭha yattvaṃ prāpto mamāntikam ||
avaśyaṃ sānukūlo me vidhiryattvaṃ samāgataḥ || 46 ||
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthabhūtā hi sādhavaḥ ||
kālena phalate tīrthaṃ sadyaḥ sādhusamāgamaḥ || 47 ||
tasmātsarvaṃ tavākhyānaṃ kathayāmi mahāmune |
yena me garhitaṃ bhojyaṃ vibhavaśca tathedṛśaḥ || 48 ||
ahamāsaṃ purā rājā śvetonāma mahāmune ||
ānartādhipatiḥ pāpaḥ sarvalokanipīḍakaḥ || 49 ||
na kiṃcitprāṅmayā dattaṃ na hutaṃ jātavedasi ||
na ca rakṣā kṛtā loke na trātāḥ śaraṇāgatāḥ || 6.103.50 ||
dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā mayā ratnaṃ yatkiṃciddharaṇītale || |
tadvai balāddhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sarveṣāmiha dehinām || 51 ||

hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ svaputreṇa māṃ nirvāsya vigarhitam || || 52 ||
tato'haṃ jarayā grasto vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ||
samāyāto'tra vipreṃdra bhramamāṇa itastataḥ || 53 ||

mṛtaśca saṃniviṣṭohaṃ kṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ|| 54||
prāviśyā'tra jale puṇye paṃcatvaṃ samupāgataḥ ||
tataśca tatkṣaṇādeva vimānaṃ samupasthitam || | || 55 ||

divyamālyāvaradharaṃdivyagandhānulepanam ||

tādṛgrūpo vicakṣuśca dhārito brahmaṇaḥ puraḥ || 58 ||

|| kiṃkarā ūcuḥ || ||
eṣa devaścaturvaktraḥ sabheyaṃ tasya sambhavā ||
sarvairdevagaṇairjuṣṭā praṇāmaḥ kriyatāmiti || 6.103.60 ||
tato'haṃ praṇipatyoccaistaṃ devaṃ devasaṃyutam ||
upaviṣṭaḥ sabhāmadhye vrīḍayā'vanataḥ sthitaḥ || 61 ||

devadvijanarendrāṇāṃ dharmākhyānāni kuṃbhaja || 62 ||

jāne kiṃ bhakṣayāmyāśu dṛṣadaḥ kāṣṭhameva vā || 63 ||

tathā paśyāmi no kiṃcittādṛgbhojyaṃ prayaccha me ||65||

|| pitāmaha uvāca || ||

yastvaṃ pātakayukto'pi saṃprāpto mama maṃdiram||

śvetadvīpapatistatra kalikālabhayāturaḥ || 6.103.70 ||

annādānātparā pīḍā jāyate kṣutsamu dbhavā ||71||

|| brahmovāca || ||
tasmāttatraiva gaccha tvaṃ preṣi to'si kimatra vai ||
narake tava vāso na śvetadvīpasamudbhavam ||74||

yenaikaṃ culukaṃ kṛtvā nipītaḥ payasāṃnidhiḥ || 6.103.80 ||
tasmānmune dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari mahattarām ||
akṛtyā drakṣa māmasmātsarvalokavigarhitāt || 81 ||
tathā dṛṣṭipradānaṃ me kuruṣva munisattama ||
nirviṇṇo'smyaṃdhabhāvena nānyā tvatto'sti me gatiḥ || || 82 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṛpayā mama mānasam||

tathā'dyaprabhṛti prājña ratnadīpānsunirmalān ||

|| rājovāca || ||
mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā tvameva munisattama ||

yadāsīdakṣayaṃ nityaṃ tasmiṃstoye vyavasthitam || 91 ||

anujñāṃ dehi me tasmādyena gacchāmi sāṃpratam ||

tato mayā vinirmuktaḥ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ||

evaṃ me bhūṣaṇamidaṃ jātaṃ hastagataṃ purā ||
tava yogyamidaṃ jñātvā tubhyaṃ tena niveditam || 99 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti rājeṃdra samāgatyātra mānavāḥ ||
ratnadīpānpradāyoccaiḥ snātvā'tra salile śubhe ||
kārtike māsi niryāṃti dehāṃte tridivālayam || 6.103.100 ||
ye punaḥ prāṇasaṃtyāgaṃ prakurvaṃti samāhitāḥ ||
pāpātmāno'pi te yāṃti brahmalokaṃ raghūttama || 101 ||
tato dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaḥ prabhāvaṃ tajjalodbhavam ||

tadadya divasaḥ prāpto dīpotsavasamudbhavaḥ ||
supuṇyo'tra mamādeśāttvaṃ kuruṣva sukūpikām || 103 ||

yena saṃjāyate siddhirbrahmalokasamudbhavā ||
anenaiva śarīreṇa satyametanmayoditam ||5||

tasmindeśe vinidadhuḥ kūpikāṃ vimalodakām ||6||

samastaṃ kārtikaṃ yāvadayodhyāṃ prasthitāstataḥ | 107 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
adyāpi dīpadānaṃ yaḥ kurute tatra sādaram ||
saṃprāpte kārtike māsi snātvā tatra jale śubhe ||

iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhi tāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye ānartakatīrthakūpikāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 103 || || cha || || ||
