|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
rākṣasaistatra liṃgāni yāni bhaktyā samanvitaiḥ ||
sthāpitāni ca māhātmyaṃ teṣāṃ sūta prakīrtaya || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
teṣāṃ pūjākṛte raudrā rākṣasā balavattarāḥ ||
laṃkāpuryāḥ samāyāṃti sadaiva śataśaḥ purā || 2 ||
āgacchanto vrajantaste mārge kṣetre ca tatra ca ||
bhakṣayanti janaughāṃśca bālavṛddhāñjanānapi || 3 ||
tataste mānavāḥ sarve pradravaṃtaḥ samaṃtataḥ ||
itaścetaśca dhāvanti prāṇarakṣaṇatatparāḥ || 4 ||
tathānye bahavo gatvā hyayodhyākhyāṃ mahāpurīm ||
rāmaputraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ kuśaṃ procuḥ suduḥkhitāḥ || 5 ||
tava pitrā samaṃ prāptāḥ pūrvaṃ ye rākṣasā nṛpa ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre vibhīṣaṇapuraḥsarāḥ || 6 ||
saṃsthāpitāni liṃgāni caturvaktrāṇi tatra vai ||
rākṣaseṃdraiḥ svamantraistaistasya kṣetrasya paścime || 7 ||
tenaiva cānuṣaṃgeṇa samāgacchaṃti nityaśaḥ ||
tasminkṣetre prakurvaṃti tathā lokasya bhakṣaṇam || 8 ||
yadi vā tāni liṃgāni kaścitsaṃpūjayennaraḥ ||
sadyo vināśamāyāti so'pyanartho mahānabhūt || 9 ||
tasmādyadi na rakṣā naḥ kariṣyasi mahīpate ||
tacchanairyāsyate lokaḥ sarvo'yaṃ saṃkṣayaṃ dhruvam || 6.104.10 ||
tacca kṣetraṃ viśeṣeṇa yatrāgacchaṃti te sadā ||
rākṣasāḥ krūrakarmāṇo mahāmāṃsasya lolupāḥ || 11 ||
tacchrutvā sa nṛpastūrṇaṃ svāmātyānāṃ nyavedayat ||
rājyabhāraṃ tatastatra balena sahito yayau || 12 ||
atha prāptaṃ kuśaṃ dṛṣṭvā hataśeṣā dvijottamāḥ ||
procustaṃ bhartsayitvā tu vacanaiḥ paruṣākṣaraiḥ || 13 ||
kimevaṃ kriyate rājyaṃ yathā tvaṃ kṣatriyādhamaḥ ||
karoṣi yatra vidhvaṃsaṃ rākṣasai rnīyate janaḥ | 14 ||
nūnaṃ jāto na rāmeṇa bhavānrāvaṇasaṃbhavaḥ ||
yenopekṣasi sarvānno rākṣasaiḥ paripīḍitān || 15 ||
satyametatpurā proktaṃ nītiśāstravicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
yasya varṇasya yo rājā sa varṇaḥ sukhamedhate || 16 ||
tasmāttvaṃ rākṣasodbhūto rākṣasairdvijasattamān ||
upekṣase tataḥ sarvānbhakṣyamāṇāṃstathāparān || 17 ||
ārtānāṃ yatra lokānāṃ doṣaiḥ pārthivasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
pataṃtyaśrūṇi bhūpṛṣṭhe tatra rājā sa doṣabhāk || 18 ||
|| kuśa uvāca || ||
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ viprā na mayā jñātamīdṛśam ||
rākṣasebhyaḥ samutpanno brāhmaṇānāṃ parābhavaḥ || 19 ||
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ kaścidvināśaṃ nīyate kvacit ||
brāhmaṇo vā'thavā'nyo'pi tadbhavenmama pātakam || 6.104.20 ||
evamuktvā tatastūrṇaṃ preṣayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ||
vibhīṣaṇāya saṃkruddho dūtaṃ bhayavivarjitam || 21 ||
gaccha dūta drutaṃ gatvā tvayā vācyo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
rāmocitastvayā sneho mayā saha kṛto mahān || 22 ||
yadrākṣasagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ mama bhūmiṃ samaṃtataḥ ||
tvaṃ kleśayasi durbuddhe māṃ viśvāsya subhāṣitaiḥ || 23 ||
mama pitrā kṛteyaṃ te pratiṣṭhā rākṣasādhama ||
tena no hanmi te bhrātā yathā tātena śātitaḥ || 24 ||
viṣavṛkṣo'pi yo vṛddhiṃ svayameva praṇīyate ||
kathaṃ saṃchidyate so'tra svayameva manīṣibhiḥ || 25 ||
tasmādadya dinādūrdhvaṃ yadi kaścinniśācaraḥ ||
samudrasyottaraṃ pāraṃ kathaṃcidāgamiṣyati || 26 ||
tadahaṃ satvaraṃ prāpya laṃkāṃ tava purīmimām ||
sasainyo dhvaṃsayiṣyāmi tathā sarvānniśācarān || 27 ||
tvāṃ ca baddhvā dṛḍhaiḥ pāśairnigaḍaiśca susaṃyatam ||
kārāsaṃsthaṃ kariṣyāmi sadya eva na saṃśayaḥ || 28 ||
evamuktastato dūto gatvā setuṃ drutaṃ tataḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā rāmeśvaraṃ devaṃ yāvadagre vyava sthitaḥ || 29 ||
tāvatpṛṣṭo janaiḥ kaiścitkastvaṃ vatsa ihāgataḥ ||
kena kāryeṇa no brūhi nātra gacchaṃti mānavāḥ || 6.104.30 ||
|| dūta uvāca || ||
ahaṃ kuśena bhūpena vibhīṣaṇagṛhaṃ prati ||
preṣitaḥ kāryamuddiśya tatra yāsyāmyahaṃ katham || 31 ||
|| janā ūcuḥ || ||
nātaḥ paraṃ naraḥ kaścidgantuṃ śaktaḥ kathaṃcana ||
bhagnaḥ seturyato madhye rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā || 32 ||
tasmādatraiva te kāryaṃ siddhiṃ dūta prayāsyati ||
vibhīṣaṇakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ darśanāttasya rakṣasaḥ || 33 ||
sarvadā rākṣasendro'sau śubhaṃ rāmeśvaratrayam ||
trikālaṃ pūjayatyeva niyamaṃ samupāśritaḥ || 34 ||
laṃkādvāre sthito yo vai setukhaṇḍe maheśvaraḥ ||
prabhāte kurute tasya svayaṃ pūjāṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 35 ||
jalamadhyagataṃ yacca setukhaṃḍaṃ dvitīyakam ||
tatra rāmeśvaro yaśca madhyāhne taṃ prapūjayet || 36 ||
enaṃ deva niśīthe ca sarvadāgatya bhaktitaḥ ||
saṃpūjayenna sandehaḥ satyametatprakīrtitam || 37 ||
tasmāttiṣṭha tvamavyagraḥ sthāne'traiva samāhitaḥ ||
yāvadāgamanaṃ tasya rākṣasasya mahātmanaḥ || 38 ||
tenaiva sahitaḥ paścātsvecchayā tasya mandiram ||
prayāsyasi gṛhaṃ vāpi svakīyaṃ tadvisarjitaḥ || 39 ||
atha teṣāṃ tadākarṇya sa dūto harṣasaṃyutaḥ ||
bāḍhamityeva coktvātha tatra caiva vyavasthitaḥ || 6.104.40 ||
atha prāpte niśārdhe sa rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ ||
vibhīṣaṇaḥ samāyātastasminnāyatane śubhe || 41 ||
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ stūyamānaḥ samantataḥ ||
rākṣasairbaṃdirūpaistairgīyamānastathā paraiḥ ||42||
uttīrya ca vimānāgryātkṛtvā'tha triḥ pradakṣiṇām ||
rāmeśvaraṃ praṇamyoccaiḥ stotrametaccakāra saḥ ||43||
namaste devadeveśa bhaktānāmabhayaprada ||
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ te sarvatokṣiśiromukham || 44||
tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvaṃ caṃdrastvaṃ prabhākaraḥ ||
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ caturvaktraḥ śakrastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||45||
yathā tilagataṃ tailaṃ gūḍhaṃ tiṣṭhati sarvadā||
tathā tvaṃ sarva lokeṣu gūḍhastiṣṭhasi śaṃkara || 495 ||
yathā kāṣṭhagato vahniḥ saṃsthito'pi na lakṣyate||
mūḍhaiḥ sarvatrasaṃsthopi tathā tvaṃ naiva lakṣyase||47||
yathā dadhigataṃ sarpirnigūḍhatvena saṃsthitam||
carācareṣu bhūteṣu tathā tvaṃ deva saṃsthitaḥ ||48||
yathā jalaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhātkhanannāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
tathā tvāṃ pūjayannityaṃ mokṣamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 49 ||
tāvacca durlabhaḥ svargastāvacchūrāśca śatravaḥ ||
yāvadeva na santoṣaṃ tvaṃ karoṣi śarīriṇām || 6.104.50 ||
tāvallakṣmīścalā nṝṇāṃ tāvadrogāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ||
na yāvaddevadeva tvaṃ santoṣaṃ saṃprayāsyasi || 51 ||
tāvatputrodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathā priyasamu dbhavam||
yāvattvaṃ deva nāyāsi santoṣaṃ dehināmiha | 52 ||
evaṃ stutvā tato liṃgaṃ snāpayitvā yathāvidhi ||
gandhānulepanaidivyairmardayāmāsa vai tataḥ || 53 ||
pārijātakapuṣpaiśca tathā santānasambhavaiḥ ||
kalpapādapasaṃbhūtaistathā mandārajairapi ||54||
pūjāṃ cakre suvistīrṇā śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ||
divyairābharaṇairbhūṣya divyavastraistataḥ param || 55 ||
sa ca gītaṃ svayaṃ cakre tālamādāya pāṇinā ||
mūrchātālakṛtaṃ ramyaṃ saptasvaravirājitam || 56 ||
tānayuktyā samopetaṃ grāmai rāgaiḥ svalaṃkṛtam ||
evaṃ kṛtvā sa śuśrūṣā tasya devasya bhaktitaḥ || 57 ||
yāvatsaṃprasthito bhūyo laṃkāṃ prati vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
tāvaddūto'grataḥ sthitvā kuśavākyamuvāca ha || 58 ||
viśeṣatastu tenoktaṃ yattasya purataḥ purā ||
atikopābhibhūtena praraktanayanena ca || 59 ||
tacchrutvātha praṇamyoccairdūtaṃ prāha vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ ||6.104. 60 ||
yadyevaṃ vihitaṃ rājye rāmaputrasya rākṣasaiḥ ||
tannūnaṃ tanmayā sarvaṃ vihitaṃ dūtasattama || 61 ||
tasmānmahāprasādo me kṛtastena mahātmanā ||
kuśena preṣito yastvaṃ mama mūrkhasya saṃnidhau || 62 ||
evamuktvā sa tānsarvāñchodhayāmāsa rākṣasān ||
ye gatvā bhūtale martyāndhvaṃsayaṃti sadaiva hi || 63 ||
tatastatraiva cānīya tasya dūtasya saṃnidhau ||
pratyekaṃ tānuvācedaṃ kopādaśrūṇi cotsṛjan|| 64 ||
yaiḥ kṛto janavidhvaṃso rākṣasaiḥ sudurātmabhiḥ ||
rājye kuśasya saṃprāptaiḥ prabhormama mahātmanaḥ || || 65 ||
te sarve vyaṃtarā raudrāḥ prabhavaṃtu suduḥkhitāḥ ||
laṃkādvāragatā nityaṃ kṣutpipāsānipīḍitāḥ || 66 ||
sarvabhogaparityaktāḥ śītātapasahi ṣṇavaḥ ||
śleṣmamūtrakṛtāhārā nindyāḥ sarvajanasya ca || 67 ||
evaṃ dattvātha teṣāṃ sa śāpaṃ rākṣasasattamaḥ ||
tataḥ prāha ca taṃ dūtaṃ punareva kṛtāṃ jaliḥ || 68 ||
adyaprabhṛti no kaścidrākṣasaḥ saṃprayāsyati ||
tasmādvācyo raghuśreṣṭho madvākyātsa kuśastvayā ||
kṣamyatāmaparādho me yadajñānā dayaṃkṛtaḥ || 69 ||
rākṣasairduṣṭajātīyairmahāmāṃsasyalolupaiḥ ||
kṛtaśca nigrahasteṣāṃ pratyakṣaṃ tava dūta yaḥ || 6.104.70 ||
yadanyadapi kṛtyaṃ syāddaivaṃ vā mānuṣaṃ ca vā ||
mama bhṛtyasya tatsarvaṃ kathanīyamaśaṃkitam || 71 ||
|| dūta uvāca || ||
yāni tatra ca liṃgāni rākṣasairnirmitāni ca ||
tāni gatvā svayaṃ śīghraṃ tvamutpāṭaya rākṣasa || 72 ||
etadeva paraṃ kṛtyaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham ||
sthāpitāni ca yānyeva maṃtrai rākṣasasaṃbhavaiḥ || 73 ||
saṃpūjitāni rakṣobhiścaturvaktrāṇi rākṣasa||
ajānanmānavaḥ kaścidyadi pūjāṃ samācaret ||74||
tatkṣaṇānnāśamāyāti etaddṛṣṭaṃ mayā svayam||
etasmātkāraṇādvacmi tvāmahaṃ rākṣasādhipa ||
taiḥ sthitairbhūtale liṃgaiḥ sthitāḥ sarve niśācarāḥ ||75||
|| vibhīṣaṇa uvāca || ||
mayā pūrvaṃ pratijñātaṃ rāmasya purataḥ kila ||
rāmeśvaramatikramya na gatavyaṃ dharātale || 76 ||
anyacca kāraṇaṃ dūta proktamatra manīṣibhiḥ ||
duḥsthitaṃ susthitaṃ vāpi śivaliṃgaṃ na cālayet || 77 ||
tatkathaṃ tatra gatvā'tha liṃgabhedaṃ karomyaham ||
svayaṃ māheśvaro bhūtvā pratijñāya ca vai svayam || 78 ||
tasmātprasādanīyaste madvākyātsa narādhipaḥ ||
yadyuktaṃ mayā proktaṃ tattvaṃ kuru vinigraham|| 79 ||
evamuktvātha taṃ dūtaṃ ratnaiḥ sāgarasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
prabhūtairbhūṣayitvā'tha visasarja nṛpaṃ prati || 6.104.80 ||
atha te rākṣasāstena śaptāḥ procuḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ||
kuru śāpasya mokṣaṃ naḥ sarveṣāṃ rākṣaseśvara || 81 ||
|| vibhīṣaṇa uvāca || ||
nāhaṃ karomi bhūyo'pi yuṣmākaṃ rākṣasādhamāḥ| ||
anugrahaṃ praśaptānāṃ vaṃcakānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 82 ||
tasmātso'pi raghuśreṣṭhaḥ prasādaṃ vaḥ kariṣyati ||
mama vākyāda saṃdigdhaṃ kālaḥ kaścitpratīkṣyatām || 83 ||
evamuktvā'tha rakṣendraḥ preṣayāmāsa satvaram ||
dūtaṃ kuśamahīpasya mānuṣaṃ devapūjakam || 84 ||
gatvā brūhi kuśaṃ bhūpaṃ satvaraṃ vacanānmama ||
eteṣāṃ matpraśaptānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ durātmanām ||
anugrahaṃ kuru vibho dīnānāṃ bhojanāya vai || 85 ||
evamuktastatastena ito dūtena saṃyutaḥ ||
kuśastena viniryātaḥ satvaraṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 86 ||
tato gatvā drutaṃ dūtaḥ kuśaṃ provāca sādaram ||
praṇipatya yathā nyāyaṃ vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ || 87 ||
vibhīṣaṇo mayā dṛṣṭo deve rāmeśvare vibho ||
pūjārthaṃ tatra cāyāto rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ || 88 ||
prokto mayā bhavadvākyamaśeṣaṃ raghunandana ||
śrutaṃ tenāpi tatsarvaṃ vinayāvanatena ca || 89 ||
ajānataḥ prabho tasya rākṣasaiḥ sudurātmabhiḥ ||
prajaivaṃ pīḍitā bhūmau mahāmāṃsasya lolupaiḥ || 6.104.90 ||
tacchrutvā manmukhāttena sarveṣāṃ nigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
yaiḥ kṛtaṃ kadanaṃ bhūmau tava pārthiva sattama ||
kṛtāste vyantarā sarve pāpāhāravihāriṇaḥ || 91 ||
bhaviṣyatha tathā yūyaṃ kṣutpipāsānipīḍitāḥ ||
taiḥ sarvaiḥ prārthitaḥ so'pi bhūyobhūyaḥ praṇamya tam || 92 ||
śaptāḥ sarve vayaṃ tāvatprasādaṃ kuru tadvibho ||
te tenātha tataḥ proktā nāhaṃ vo rākṣasādhamāḥ || 93 ||
anugrahaṃ kariṣyāmi na dāsyāmi ca bhojanam ||
kuśādeśānmayā sarve yūyaṃ pāpasamanvitāḥ || 94 ||
nigṛhītāḥ sa yuṣmākaṃ prasādaṃ prakariṣyati ||
tadarthaṃ preṣito dūtastvatsakāśaṃ mahīpate || 95 ||
rakṣasā tena yadyuktamakhilaṃ tattvamācara ||
kiṃ vā te bahunoktena nāsti bhaktastathā vidhaḥ ||
bhaktiśaktisamopeto yathā te sa vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 96 ||
adyaprabhṛti no bhūmau vicariṣyaṃti rākṣasāḥ ||
tasya vākyādasaṃdehaṃ tvaṃ rājansukha bhāgbhava || 97 ||
liṃgānāṃ ca kṛte rājanvijñaptaṃ tena rakṣasā ||
na mayā cātra rājeṃdra āgantavyaṃ kathaṃcana ||
rāmadevasya vākyena jaṃbudvīpe na me gatiḥ || 98 ||
atra sthitasya yatkṛtyaṃ daivaṃ vā mānuṣaṃ ca vā |
tavādeśaṃ kariṣyāmi yadyapi syātsuduṣkaram | 99 ||
tasmāttena mahārāja rāmeśvaraprapūjakaḥ ||
manuṣyaḥ preṣito dūto yastaṃ paśya mahīpate || 6.104.100 ||
atha tasya samādeśāḍḍhaukanīyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
sahitaḥ sa samāyāto dūto rakṣeṃdranoditaḥ || 101 ||
dhātrīphalapramāṇānāṃ tena prasthāstrayodaśa ||
mauktikānāṃ samānītāḥ kṛte tasya mahīpateḥ || 102 ||
vaiḍūryāṇāṃ marakatānāṃ maṇīnāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ ||
jātyānāṃ ṣoḍaśa droṇāḥ samānītāḥ sunirmalāḥ || 103 ||
agniśaucāni vastrāṇi tathā devamayāni ca ||
asaṃkhyātāni vai hema jātyaṃ saṃkhyāvivarjitam || 104 ||
tatsarvaṃ darśayitvātha kuśāya sumahātmane ||
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ paścātpraṇāmamakaroddvijāḥ | || 105 ||
eṣa pārthivaśārdūla rākṣasendro vibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
praṇāmaṃ kurute bhaktyā manmukhenedamabravīt || 106 ||
prasādātte pituḥ kṣemaṃ mama rājye mahī pate ||
eṣa tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ nityaṃ pūjayaṃste piturharam || || 107 ||
mama rājannavijñātairyadi taiḥ sudurātmabhiḥ ||
mahītale kṛtaṃ kiṃcidviruddhaṃ kṣamyatāṃ mama || 108 ||
ete ye rākṣasāḥ śaptāstavārthāya mayā prabho ||
eteṣāṃ pretarūpāṇāṃ tvamāhāraṃ prakīrtaya || 109 ||
|| kuśa uvāca || ||
mamādeśātsamāgatya te'tra liṃgāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
pūrayaṃtu prayatnena pāṃsubhiḥ sarvatodiśam || 6.104.110 ||
tatastu bhojanaṃ teṣāṃ yadbhaviṣyati bhūtale ||
tadvakṣyāmi sthiro bhūtvā śṛṇu devaprapūjaka || 111 ||
tulāgate sadāditye tairāgatya dharātale ||
vihartavyaṃ prayatnena yāvadvṛścikadarśanam || 112 ||
tatra yairna kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ pretapakṣe narādhamaiḥ ||
kanyāsthe vā ravau yāvanna tulāṃtagatirbhavet || 113 ||
jvararūpaistadaṃgasthairbhakṣyamannaṃ pṛthagvidham ||
mamādeśādasaṃdigdhaṃ māsamekaṃ niśācaraiḥ || 114 ||
vidhihīnaṃ ca yairdattaṃ bhuktaṃ ca vidhivarjitam ||
śrāddhaṃ vā mānuṣaiḥ sevyā jvararūpaiśca te sadā || 115 ||
evaṃ vācyāstvayā sarve pretāste madvaco'khilam ||
tasmādāgatya kurvaṃtu kārtike māsi madvacaḥ || 116 ||
tathā dūta tvayā vācyo mama vākyādvibhīṣaṇaḥ ||
pramādādyanmayā proktaṃ paruṣaṃ vacanaṃ tava || 117 ||
jānāmyahaṃ mahābhāga na te'sti vikṛtiḥ kvacit ||
parikliṣṭaṃ janaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayaitadvyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 118 ||
rākṣasendre sthite bhūmau tvayi jānāmyahaṃ sadā ||
tiṣṭhate janako mahyaṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || 119 ||
evamuktvā tato dūtaṃ pūjayā māsa rāghavaḥ ||
vastrairbahuvidhai ratnairnadyutthaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 6.104.120 ||
vibhīṣaṇakṛte paścātpreṣayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ||
ḍhaukanīyānyanekāni yāni saṃti ca tatra vai || 121 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sa sukhasaṃyuktānkṛtvā sarvāndvijottamān |
etatsarvaṃ dadau paścāttebhyo muktādikaṃ nṛpaḥ || 122 ||
ḍhaukanīyaṃ tathā''yātaṃ tallaṃkāyāḥ pṛthagvidham ||
śāsanāni tathānyāni gajāśvasahitāni ca || 123 ||
pattanāni vicitrāṇi grāmāṇi nagarāṇi ca ||
yaccānyadvāṃchitaṃ yena taddattaṃ tena tasya vai || 124 ||
tataḥ kuśeśvaraṃ devaṃ vidhāya ca laveśvaram ||
svāṃ tanuṃ ca mahābhāgau bhrātarau tau raghūttamau || 125 ||
nivedya brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ kṛtvā vṛttiṃ yathocitām ||
ayodhyāṃ nagarīṃ tūrṇaṃ kṛtakṛtyau vinirgatau || 126 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kuśeśvaralaveśvarapratiṣṭhāvarṇanaṃnāma caturuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 104 || || cha ||

<6.105>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha prāpte dinādhīśe tulāyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
pretā liṃgodbhavāṃ bhūmiṃ pūrayāmāsureva hi || 1 ||
yatkiṃcittatra saṃsthaṃ tu ādyatīrthaṃ surālayam ||
tatsarvaṃ vyantaraistaiśca pāṃsubhiḥ paripūritam || 2 ||
tataḥ kṣemaṃ samutpannaṃ kṣetre tatra dvijottamāḥ ||
anyeṣāmapi lokānāṃ liṃgaistairluptimāgataiḥ || 3 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya bṛhadaśvo mahīpatiḥ ||
śālvadeśātsamāyātaḥ kasmiścidyugaparyaye || 4 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā vipulāṃ bhūmiṃ prāsādaiḥ parivarjitām ||
prāsādārthaṃ matiṃ cakre tatra kṣetre dvijottamāḥ || 5 ||
śilpinaśca samāhūyānekāṃstatra sahasraśaḥ ||
śodhayāmāsa tāṃ bhūmimadhastādbahuvistṛtām || 6 ||
bhūmau nikhanyamānāyāṃ tato liṃgāni bhūriśaḥ ||
caturvaktrāṇi tānyeva yāṃti dṛṣṭeśca gocaram || 7 ||
tataḥ sa pārthivastaiśca liṃgairdṛṣṭvā vṛtāṃ bhuvam ||
tatkṣaṇānmṛtyumāpannaḥ śilpibhiśca samanvitaḥ || 8 ||
tataḥprabhṛti no tatra kaścinmartyo mahītale ||
prāsādaṃ kurute bhītyā taḍāgaṃ kūpameva ca || 9 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye rākṣasaliṃgacchedanaṃnāma pañcottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 105 || || ||

<6.106>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
bhūpṛṣṭhe pāṃsubhistasminpretaistaiḥ paripūrite ||
yāni tīrthāni luptāni liṅgāni ca vadasva naḥ || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
asaṃkhyātāni tīrthāni tathā liṃgāni ca dvijāḥ ||
lopaṃ gatāni vakṣyāmi prādhānyena prabodhata || 2 ||
tatra lopaṃ gataṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamiti smṛtam ||
yatra cakraṃ purā nyastaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || || 3 ||
mātṛtīrthaṃ tathaivānyatsarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām ||
yatra tā mātaro divyāḥ kārtikeyapratiṣṭhitāḥ || 4 ||
mucukundasya rājarṣestathānyalliṃga muttamam ||
tatra lopaṃ gataṃ viprāḥ sagarasya tu bhūpateḥ || 5 ||
ikṣvākorvasuṣeṇasya kakutsthasya mahātmanaḥ ||
ailasya candradevasya kāśirājasya sanmateḥ || 6 ||
agniveśasya raibhyasya cyavanasya bhṛgostathā ||
āśramo yājñavalkyasya tatra lopaṃ samāyayau || 7 ||
hārītasya maharṣeśca haryaśvasya mahātmanaḥ ||
kutsasya ca vasiṣṭhasya nāradasya tritasya ca || 8 ||
tathaiva ṛṣipatnīnāṃ tatra liṃgāni bhūriśaḥ||
kātyāyanyāśca śāṃḍilyā maitreyyāśca tathā purā || 9 ||
anyāsāṃ munipatnīnāṃ yāsāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate ||
tatrāścaryamabhūdanyatpūryamāṇe mahītale || 6.106.10 ||
pāṃsubhī rākṣasairyaistaiḥ pretairbrāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
tadvo'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrotavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ || 10 ||
dṛṣṭvā pāṃsumayīṃ vṛṣṭiṃ muktāṃ pretaiḥ samaṃtataḥ ||
mātṛvargeṇa tenātha pramuktaḥ pracuro'nilaḥ || 11 ||
tena pāṃsukṛtā vṛṣṭiḥ samaṃtānmathitā bahiḥ |
tasyā bhūmeḥ patatyeva na kiṃcittatra pūryate || 13 ||
tataste vyaṃtarāḥ khinnā nirāśāstasya pūraṇe ||
bhūtāstasya puro gatvā cukruśuḥ kuśabhūpateḥ || 14 ||
asmābhirvihitā tatra pāṃsuvṛṣṭirmahīpate ||
nīyate śatadhā'nyatra mātṛmuktena vāyunā || 19 ||
sa tvaṃ tāsāṃ vighātārthamupāyaṃ bhūpa ciṃtaya ||
yena tāṃ pāṃsubhirbhūmiṃ pūrayāmaḥ samaṃtataḥ || 16 ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tataḥ kuśamahīpatiḥ ||
rudramārādhayāmāsa tatkṣetraṃ prāpya saddvijāḥ || 17 ||
tatastasya gatastuṣṭiṃ varṣāṃte bhagavānharaḥ ||
provāca prārthayābhīṣṭaṃ yatte manasi vāṃchitam || 18 ||
|| kuśa uvāca || ||
yathā saṃpūryate cāśu pāṃsubhirbhūmimaṃḍalam||
etatpretapramuktaiśca prasādātte tathā kuru || 19 ||
mayā pretagaṇādeva nirdiṣṭāstasya pūraṇe ||
mātṛsaṃrakṣyamāṇaṃ tacchakyaṃ caitanna pūritum || 6.106.20 ||
tatra rākṣasajairmaṃtraiḥ saṃti liṃgāni ca prabho ||
pratiṣṭhitāni tatsparśāddarśanātsyājjanakṣayaḥ || 21 ||
acalatvāttathā deva liṃgānāṃ śāstrasadbhayāt ||
anyadutpāṭanādyaṃ ca naiva kurmaḥ kathaṃcana || 22 ||
tasmālliṃgakṛto nāśo brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvinām ||
yathā na syātsuraśreṣṭha tathā nītirvidhīyatām || 23 ||
tataśca bhagavānrudrastāḥ samāhūya mātaraḥ ||
provāca tyajyatāṃ sthānaṃ bhavatyo yatra saṃsthitāḥ || 24 ||
tatra pāṃsubhiravyagrāḥ kariṣyaṃti divāniśam ||
pretāḥ kuśasamādeśādvṛṣṭiṃ lokahitāya ca || 25 ||
|| mātara ūcuḥ || ||
tyakṣyāmaśca tavādeśāttatsthānaṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja ||
paraṃ darśaya cāsmākaṃ kiṃcidanyattathāvidham || 26 ||
kṣetre'traiva nivatsyāmo yena skandakṛte vayam ||
tena saṃsthāpitāścātra proktāḥ stheyaṃ sadā tataḥ || 27 ||
tataḥ provāca bhagavāṃstasmātsthānānmahattaram ||
sthānaṃ dāsyāmi sarvāsāṃ pṛthaktvena śubhāvaham || 28 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭistu kṣetrāṇāṃ madīyānāṃ samaṃtataḥ ||
saṃsthitāsti mahābhāgā yeṣu matsaṃsthitiḥ sadā || 29 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭivibhāgena bhūtvā sarvāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||
teṣu tiṣṭhatha madvākyātpūjāmagryāmavāpsyatha || 6.106.30 ||
tasya devasya tacchrutvā vākyaṃ tā mātarastadā ||
prahṛṣṭāstatparityajya sthānaṃ skandavinirmitam || 31 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭivibhāgena bhūtvā rūpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu kṣetreṣu tasya tāḥ saṃsthitāḥ sadā || 32 ||
tatastābhirvinirmuktaṃ tatsarvaṃ bhūmimaṇḍalam ||
pāṃsubhiḥ pūritaṃ pretairdivārātramataṃdritaiḥ || 33 ||
evaṃ tasya varaṃ dattvā bhagavānvṛṣavāhanaḥ ||
jagāmādarśanaṃ paścātsārdhaṃ savargaiṇairdvijāḥ ||34||
kuto'pi brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvestāpasaiśca praśaṃsitaḥ ||
labdhāśī prayayau tasmādayodhyānagarīṃ prati || 35 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye luptatīrthamāhātmyakathanaṃnāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 106 || 

<6.107>

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiriyaṃ proktā yā tvayā sūtanandana ||
kṣetrāṇāṃ devadevasya kathaṃ sā tatra saṃsthitā ||
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca|| ||
praśnabhāro mahāneṣa yo bhavadbhiḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
tathāpi kīrtayiṣyāmi namaskṛtvā pinākinam || 2 ||
camatkārapure'vāsītpūrvaṃ brāhmaṇasattamaḥ ||
vatsasyānvayasaṃbhūtaścitraśarmā mahāyaśāḥ || 3 ||
tasya buddhiriyaṃ jātā pātāle hāṭakeśvaram ||
atrānīya tato bhaktyā pūjayāmi divāniśam || 4 ||
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā tapaścake tataḥ param ||
niyato niyatāhāraḥ parāṃ niṣṭhāṃ samāśritaḥ || 5 ||
tasyāpi bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ kālena mahatā tataḥ ||
saṃtuṣṭo brāhmaṇa śreṣṭhāstataḥ provāca sādaram || 6 ||
varaṃ prārthaya viprendra yatte manasi vartate ||
api trailokyarājyaṃ te tuṣṭo dāsyāmyasaṃśayam || 7 ||
tasmātprārthaya te nityaṃ yatra citte vyavasthitam ||
durlabhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 8 ||
|| citraśarmovāca || ||
yadi tuṣṭosi me deva varaṃ cenme prayacchasi ||
tadatrāgaccha pātālālliṃgarūpī sureśvara || 9 ||
yatpātāle sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmaṇā saṃpratiṣṭhitam ||
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu tadihāyātu satva ram || 6.107.10 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
acalaṃ sarvaliṃgaṃ syātsarvatrāpi dvijottama ||
ki punaḥ prathamaṃ yacca brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ svayam || 11 ||
tasmātthāpaya liṃgaṃ taddhāṭakena dvijottama ||
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu loke khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati || 12 ||
somavāre catudaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
yastadbhaktisamāyuktaḥ pūjayiṣyati mānavaḥ || 13 ||
ādyaliṃgodbhavaṃ śreyaḥ pūjayā lapsyate dvija ||
evamuktvā'tha bhagavāṃstataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||14||
citraśarmā'pi kṛtvātha prāsādaṃ sumanoharam ||
tatra hemamayaṃ liṃgaṃ sthāpayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 15||
śāstroktena vidhānena pūjāṃ cakre ca nityaśaḥ ||
tatastrailokya vikhyātaṃ talliṃgaṃ tatra vai dvijāḥ || 16 ||
dūrādabhyetya lokāśca pūjayaṃti tataḥ param ||
atha tatra dvijā ye'nye saṃsthitā guṇavattarāḥ || 17 ||
teṣāṃ spardhā tato jātā dṛṣṭvā tasya viceṣṭitam ||
ekasthānaprasūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ guṇaśālinām || 18 ||
ayaṃ guṇavihīno'pi prakhyāto bhuvanatraye ||
harārādhanamāsādya yasmāttasmādvayaṃ haram ||
tadarthe toṣayiṣyāmaḥ sāmyaṃ yena prajāyate || 19 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiḥ smṛtā loke kṣetrāṇāṃ śūlapāṇinaḥ ||
yatra sānnidhyamabhyeti trikālaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 6.107.20 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiśca gotrāṇāmasmākaṃ cātra saṃsthitā ||
etena mūḍhamanasā sārdhaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇā || 22 ||
tasmādanena cārādhya bhagavantaṃ trilocanam ||
tacca liṃgaṃ samānītamatra pātālasaṃsthitam || 22 ||
tathā sarvaiśca sarvāṇi kṣetraliṃgāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
ānetavyāni cārādhya tapaḥśaktyā maheśvaram || 23 ||
eteṣāṃ sarvagotrāṇāmāneṣyati ca śaṃkaraḥ ||
yadgotraṃ kṣetrasaṃyuktaṃ yaccānyadvā bhaviṣyati || 24 ||
tataste śarmasaṃyuktāḥ sarva eva dvijottamāḥ ||
cakrustapaḥkriyāṃ sarve duṣkarāṃ sarvajantubhiḥ || || 25 ||
japairhomopavāsaiśca niyamaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
balipūjopahāraiśca snānadānādibhistathā || 26 ||
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya devasya nāmnā khyātaṃ dvijeśvaram ||
manoharatare procce prāsāde parvatopame || 27 ||
tyaktvā gṛhakriyāḥ sarvāstathā yajñasamudbhavāḥ ||
anyāśca lokayātrotthāstoṣayaṃti maheśvaram || || 28 ||
evamārādhyamāno'pi santoṣaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||
nābhyagacchatparāṃ tuṣṭiṃ kathaṃcidapi sa dvijāḥ || 29 ||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte samārādhya maheśvaram ||
na ca kiñcitphalaṃ prāptā yāvatkruddhāstato'khilāḥ ||6.107.30||
asya mūrkhatamasyā'pi tvaṃ śūliṃścitraśarmaṇaḥ ||
sustokenā'pi kālena santoṣaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||31||
vayaṃ vārdhakyamāpannā bālyātprabhṛti śaṃkaram ||
pūjayanto'pi no dṛṣṭastathā'pi parameśvara|| 32 ||
tasmātsarve prakartavyaṃ havyavāhapraveśanam ||
asmābhirniścayo hyeṣa tavāgre sāṃprataṃ kṛtaḥ|| 33 ||
tataścāhṛtya kāṣṭhāni sarve te dvijasattamāḥ ||
īśvaraṃ manasi dhyātvā citāścakruḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ||34||
tathā sarvaṃ kriyākalpaṃ snānadānādikaṃ ca yat ||
kṛtvā te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve susamiddhahutāśanam ||35||
yāvatkṛtvā sutaiḥ sārdhaṃ praviśaṃti samāhitāḥ ||
tāvatsa bhagavāṃstuṣṭasteṣāṃ saṃdarśanaṃ yayau || 36 ||
abravīcca vihasyoccairmeghagambhīrayā girā ||
sarvāṃstānbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhānmṛtānsaṃjīvayanniva || 37 ||
bho bho brāhmaṇaśārdūlā mā maivaṃ sāhasaṃ mahat ||
yūyaṃ kuruta madvākyātsaṃtuṣṭasya viśeṣataḥ || 38 ||
tasmādvadata yaccitte yuṣmākaṃ caiva saṃsthitam ||
yena dattvā pragacchāmi svameva bhuvanaṃ punaḥ || 39 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
asminkṣetre suraśreṣṭha purasyāsya ca saṃnidhau ||
kṣetrāṇāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭiryā dhanyā saṃkīrtyate janaiḥ || 6.107.40 ||
sadābhyaitu samaṃ liṃgaistairādyaiḥ surasattama ||
yenāmarṣapraśāṃtirnaḥ sarveṣāmiha jāyate || 41 ||
eṣa saṃspardhate'smābhiḥ sarvairguṇavivarjitaḥ||
tvalliṃgasya prabhāvena tasmādetatsamācara ||42||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etasminnaṃtare vipro jñātvā taṃ varadaṃ haram ||
uvāca spardhayā yuktaścitraśarmā maheśvaram||43||
|| citraśarmovāca || ||
etaiḥ prāṇaparityāgamārabhya tadanataram ||
tuṣṭiṃ nīto'si devaśa kṛtvā ca sumahattapaḥ||44||
mayā sparddhamānaiśca kevalaṃ guṇagarvitaiḥ ||
tasmādeṣo na dātavyatvaṃ tvayā kiṃcitsureśvara||46||
yadi tvaṃ māmatikramya saṃpradāsyasi vāṃchitam ||
etaiḥ putrakalatraiśca sārdhaṃ pratyakṣatastava ||
pāvakaṃ sādhayiṣyāmi tasmādyuktaṃ samācara ||46||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavāñchaśiśekharaḥ ||
cintayāmāsa cittena kimatra sukṛtaṃ bhavet || 47 ||
ete brāhmaṇaśārdūlā vināśaṃ yāṃti matkṛte ||
eṣo'pi sarvasaṃsiddho gaṇatulyo dvijottamaḥ ||48||
tasmāddvābhyāṃ mayā kāryaṃ kṣetre saukhyaṃ yathā bhavet ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā cātra nivāsinām ||49||
mamāpi sarvadā citte kṛtyametaddhi vartate ||
eka sthāne karomyeva sarvakṣetrāṇi yāni me || 6.107.50 ||
bhaviṣyati tathā kālo raudraḥ kalisamudbhavaḥ ||
tatra kṣetrāṇi tīrthāni nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti bhūtale || 51 ||
sattīrthaistadbhayātsarvaiḥ kṣetrametatsamāśritam ||
ānayiṣyāmyahamapi svāni kṣetrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ ||52||
tatastaṃ citraśarmāṇaṃ prāha cedaṃ maheśvaraḥ ||
śṛṇu madvacanaṃ kṛtsnaṃ kuruṣva tadanaṃtaram || 53 ||
atra kṣetrāṇi sarvāṇi madīyāni dvijottama ||
samāgacchaṃtu viprāśca prabhavaṃtu praharṣitāḥ || 54 ||
tavāpi yogyatāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kariṣyāmi mahāmate ||
yadi me vartase vākye muktvā sparddhāṃ dvijodbhavām || 55 ||
turīyamapi te gotraṃ vedoktena krameṇa ca ||
ādyatāṃ cāpi te sarve kīrtayiṣyaṃti te dvijāḥ || 56 ||
tathānyadapi sanmānaṃ tava yacchāmi ca dvija ||
ācandrārkamasaṃdigdhaṃ putrapautrādikaṃ ca yat || 57 ||
tvadanvaye bhaviṣyaṃti putrapautrāstathā pare ||
kṛtye śrāddhe tarpaṇe vā kriyamāṇe vidhānataḥ || 58 ||
ādyasya vatsasaṃjñasya nāma uccārya gotrajam ||
tato nāmāni cāpyevaṃ kīrtayiṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || 59 ||
tataḥ saṃtarpayiṣyaṃti pitṝnatha pitāmahān ||
tathānyānapi baṃdhūṃśca suhṛtsaṃbaṃdhibāṃdhavān || || 6.107.60 ||
tvadanvaye vinā nāmnā tvadīyena vimohitāḥ ||
ye pitṝṃstarpayiṣyaṃti teṣāṃ vyarthaṃ bhaviṣyati || 61 ||
śrāddhaṃ vā yadi vā dānaṃ tarpaṇaṃ vā tvadudbhavam ||
tasmādahaṃkṛtiṃ muktvā māmārādhaya kevalam ||62||
yena siddho'pi saṃsiddhiṃ parāmāpnoṣi śāśvatīm ||
evaṃ saṃbodhya taṃ vipraṃ kṛtvādyamapi paścimam||63||
tatastānbrāhmaṇānāha prāsādaḥ kriyatāmiti ||
gotraṃgotraṃ puraskṛtya sthāpyaṃ liṃgamanuttamam ||
yena saṃkramaṇaṃ teṣu mama saṃjāyatedvijāḥ || 64 ||
atha te brāhmaṇāstatra bhūmibhāgānmanoharān ||
dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā pracakruśca prāsādānharṣasaṃyutāḥ || 65 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭimitāndivyānkailāsaśikharopamān ||
teṣu saṃsthāpayāmāsu liṅgāni vividhāni ca ||
kṣetrekṣatre ca yannāma tattatsaṃjñāṃ pracakrire || 66 ||
atha teṣāṃ punardṛṣṭiṃ gatvā devastrilocanaḥ ||
provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ kasmiṃścitkālaparyaye ||
ārādhitastapaḥśaktyā liṃgasaṃsthāpanādanu || 67 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
parituṣṭo'smi vipreṃdrā yuṣmākamahamadya vai ||
etanmama kṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhavadbhirakhilaṃ tataḥ || 68 ||
asmadīyāni liṃgāni kṣetrāṇi ca kalerbhayāt ||
tato mānyāśca me yūyaṃ nānyairetadbhaviṣyati || 69 ||
tasmāccittasthitaṃ śīghraṃ prārthayaṃtu dvijottamāḥ ||
saṃprayacchāmi yenāśu yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 6.107.70 || ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
yadi deva prasannastvamasmākaṃ ca sureśvara ||
paścimaścitraśarmā ca yathādyo bhavatā kṛtaḥ || 71 ||
asmadīyaṃ sadā nāma kīrtanīyamasaṃśayam ||
śrāddhakṛtyeṣu sarveṣu yathā tena samā vayam ||
bhavāmastvatprasādena sāṃprataṃ citraśarmaṇā || 72 ||
||śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
yuṣmākamapi ye kecidvaśaṃ yāsyaṃti mānavāḥ ||
yuvānaḥ śāstrasaṃyuktā vedavidyāviśāradāḥ ||73||
ānayiṣyatha tānyūyamāmuṣyāyaṇasaṃjñitān ||
nityaṃ sthitāśca te kṣetre śrāddhasyākṣayyakārakāḥ || 74 ||
evamuktvātha deveśastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
te'pi viprāḥ susaṃtuṣṭāstatra sthāne vyavasthitāḥ || 75 ||
evaṃ tatra samastāni kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni ca ||
kalibhītāni vipreṃdrā nivasaṃti sadaiva hi || 76 ||
evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ prāpya siddhiṃ ceśvarapūjanāt ||
khyātāḥ sarvatra bhuvane śrāddhasyākṣayyakārakāḥ || 77 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye brāhmaṇacitraśarmaliṃgasthāpanavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma saptottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 107 || || ||

<6.108>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇāni yāni kṣetrāṇi sūtaja ||
tvayoktāni ca tānyeva nāmato naḥ prakīrtaya || 1 ||
tathānyāni ca tīrthāni yāni saṃti dharātale ||
tāni kīrtaya kārtsnyena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
yāni proktāni tīrthāni bhavadbhirdvijasattamāḥ ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭipramāṇāni tathā kṣetrāṇi bhūtale ||3||
tāni sarvāṇi bhītāni praviṣṭāni rasātalam ||
tīrthāni muniśārdūlāḥ pāpe hyatra kalau yuge ||4||
etadeva purā pṛṣṭaḥ pārvatyā parameśvaraḥ ||
yadbhavadbhirahaṃ pṛṣṭastīrthayātrākṛte dvijāḥ || 5 ||
kailāsaśikharāsīnaḥ purā devo maheśvaraḥ ||
sarvairgaṇagaṇaiḥ sārdhamupaviṣṭo varāsane || 6 ||
praṇāma karaṇārthāya hyāgateṣvamareṣu ca ||
gateṣu teṣu vipreṃdrā sarveṣu tridivālayam ||
ardhāsanagatā devī vākyametaduvāca ha || 7 ||
|| devyuvāca || ||
devadeva mahādeva gaṃgākṣālitaśekhara ||
vada me tīrthamāhātmyaṃ yadyahaṃ vallabhā tava | 8 ||
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca tīrthānāmiha bhūtale ||
saṃkhyayā nāmato deva mahyaṃ kīrtaya sāṃpratam | 9 ||
yāni tīrthānyanekāni kṣetrāṇi caiva me prabho ||
tāni kīrtaya deveśa sugamyaṃ caiva dehinām ||
kīrtanācca samagrāṇāṃ tīrthānāṃ labhyate phalam || 6.108.10 ||
|| īśvara uvāca || ||
tīrthaśabdo varārohe dharmakṛtyeṣu vartate ||
dharmasthāneṣu sarveṣu tattvaṃ śṛṇu samāhitā || 11 ||
mātā tīrthaṃ pitā tīrthaṃ tīrtha sādhusamāgamaḥ ||
dharmānuciṃtanaṃ caiva tathaiva niyamo yamaḥ || 12 ||
puṇyāḥ kathā varārohe devarṣīṇāṃ kṛtāstathā ||
āśrayāḥ sanmunīṃdrāṇāṃ devānāṃ ca tathā priye || 13 ||
bhūmibhāgāḥ pavitrāḥ syuḥ kīrtyate tīrthamityuta ||
teṣāṃ saṃdarśanādeva smaraṇāccāvagāhanāt ||
mucyaṃte jantavaḥ pāpairapi janmaśatodbhavaiḥ || 14 ||
tathā pātakino ye ca ye ca viśvāsaghātakāḥ ||
te'pi sarve tathā muktāsteṣāṃ caivāvagāhanāt|| 15 ||
evaṃ pāpāni saṃyāṃti nāśaṃ sarvāṃgasundari ||
api brahmavadhātpāpaṃ yadbhavediha dehinām ||
taccāpi tīrthasaṃsargātpralayaṃ yātyasaṃśayam || 16 ||
mamāpi karasaṃlagnaṃ kapālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ purā ||
patitaṃ tīrthasaṃsargātteṣāṃ caivāvagāhanāt || 17 ||
evaṃ sarveṣu tīrtheṣu tathā hyāyataneṣu ca ||
snātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā nānyagāminā || 18 ||
yatra snātairnaraiḥ samyaksarveṣāṃ labhyate phalam ||
mamāśrayaṃ viśālākṣi sarvapātakanāśanam||
kāmadaṃ ca tathā nṝṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 19 ||
etadguhyatamaṃ devi mama nityavyavasthitam ||
na kasyā'pi mayākhyātaṃ deveṃdrasyāpi pṛcchataḥ || 6.108.20 ||
vāllabhyāttava me bhadre kathitaṃ vai varānane ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiḥ pragamyāni bhaktyā tīrthāni mānavaiḥ || 21 ||
mamāśrayāṇi tānyeva sarvapāpaharāṇi ca ||
kāmadāni varārohe matprabhāvādasaṃśayam || 22 ||
yaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ samādhāya tatra tīrthe pumānyadi ||
kṛtvā snānaṃ tato devamarcayecca maheśvaram || 23 ||
sukṛtaṃ manasi dhyātvā yairnaraiḥ pūjito hariḥ ||
āstāṃ teṣāṃ varārohe darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ tathā ||
smaraṇādapi mucyaṃte narāḥ pāpaiḥ purākṛtaiḥ || 24 ||
ete śakrādayo devāsteṣu tīrtheṣu sundari ||
māṃ pūjya tridivaṃ prāptāstathānye nāradādayaḥ || 25 ||
tānyahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi vistareṇa pṛthakpṛthak ||
nāmataḥ śṛṇu deveśi samāhitamanāḥ sthitā || 26 ||
vārāṇasī prayāgaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ cāparaṃ tathā ||
gayāśiraḥ supuṇyaṃ ca pavitraṃ kurujāṃgalam || 27 ||
prabhāsaṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva viśveśvaramathāparama ||
aṭṭahāsaṃ mahendraṃ ca tathaivojjayanī ca yā || 28 ||
marukoṭiḥ śaṃkukarṇaṃ gokarṇaṃ kṣetramuttamam ||
rudrakoṭiḥ sthaleśaṃ ca harṣitaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam || 29 ||
kedāraṃ ca tathā kṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ madhyamakeśvaram ||
sahasrākṣaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ tathānyatkārtikeśvaram || 6.108.30 ||
tathaiva vastramārgaṃ ca tathā kanakhalaṃ smṛtam ||
bhadrakarṇaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ daṇḍakākhyaṃ tathaiva ca || 31 ||
tridaṇḍākhyaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ tathaiva kṛmijāṃgalam ||
ekāmraṃ ca tathā kṣetraṃ kṣetraṃ chāgalakaṃ tathā || 32 ||
kāliṃjaraṃ ca deveśi tathānyanmaṇḍaleśvaram ||
kāśmīraṃ marukeśaṃ ca hariścaṃdraṃ suśobhanam|| 33 ||
puraścaṃdraṃ ca vāmeśaṃ kukuṭeśvarameva ca ||
bhasmagātramathokāraṃ trisaṃdhyā virajā tathā || 34 ||
arkeśvaraṃ ca nepālaṃ duṣkarṇaṃ karavīrakam ||
jāgeśvaraṃ tathā devi śrīśailaṃ parvatottamam || 35 ||
ayodhyā caiva pātālaṃ tathā kārohaṇaṃ mahat ||
devikā ca nadī puṇyā bhairavaṃ pūrvasāgaraḥ || 36 ||
saptagodāvarītīrthaṃ tathaiva samudāhṛtam ||
nirmaleśaṃ tathānyacca karṇikāraṃ suśobhanam || 37 ||
kailāsaṃ jāhnavītīraṃ jalaliṃgaṃ ca vāḍavam||
badarītīrthavaryaṃ ca koṭitīrthaṃ tathaiva ca || 38 ||
viṃdhyācalo hemakūṭaṃ gandhamādanameva ca ||
liṃgeśvaraṃ tathā kṣetraṃ laṃkādvāraṃ tathaiva ca || 39 ||
naleśvaraṃ tu madhyeśaṃ kedāraṃ rudrajālakam ||
suvarṇākhyaṃ ca vāmoru tathānyatṣaṣṭikāpatham || 6.108.40 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśavarakṣetramāhātmye 'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 108 ||

<6.109>

|| īśvara uvāca || ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi varānane ||
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ sāraṃ tīrthasamuccayam || 1 ||
eteṣvahaṃ varārohe sarveṣveva vyavasthitaḥ ||
nāmnā cānyeṣu tīrtheṣu tridaśānāṃ hitārthataḥ || 2 ||
yo māmeteṣu tīrtheṣu snātvā paśyati mānavaḥ ||
kīrtayetkīrtanānnāmnā sa nūnaṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt || 3 ||
|| śrīdevyuvāca || ||
yeṣu tīrtheṣu yannāma kīrtanīyaṃ tava prabho ||
tatkārtsyena mama brūhi yaccahaṃ tava vallabhā || 4 ||
|| īśvara uvāca || ||
vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevaṃ prayāge ca maheśvaram ||
naimiṣe devadevaṃ ca gayāyāṃ prapitāmaham || 5 ||
kurukṣetre viduḥ sthāṇuṃ prabhāse śaśiśekharam ||
puṣkare tu hyajāgandhiṃ viśvaṃ viśveśvare tathā || 6 ||
aṭṭahāse mahānādaṃ mahendre ca mahāvratam ||
ujjayinyāṃ mahākālaṃ marukoṭe mahotkaṭam ||7||
śaṃkukarṇe mahātejaṃ gokarṇe ca mahābalam ||
rudrakoṭyāṃ mahāyogaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ sthaleśvare ||8||
harṣite ca tathā harṣaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vṛṣabhadhvaje ||
kedāre caiva īśānaṃ śarvaṃ madhyamakeśvare || 9 ||
suparṇākṣaṃ sahasrākṣe susūkṣmaṃ kārtikeśvare ||
bhavaṃ vastrāpathe devi hyugraṃ kanakhale tathā || 6.109.10 ||
bhadrakarṇe śivaṃ caiva daṇḍake daṇḍinaṃ tathā ||
ūrdhvaretaṃ tridaṇḍāyāṃ caṇḍīśaṃ kṛmijāṃgale || 11 ||
kṛttivāsaṃ tathaikāmre chāgaleye kapardinam ||
kāliñjare nīlakaṇṭhaṃ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ maṇḍaleśvare || 12 ||
vijayaṃ caiva kāśmīre jayantaṃ marukeśvare ||
hariścandre haraṃ caiva puraścandre ca śaṃkaram|| 13 ||
jaṭiṃ vāmeśvare vindyātsaumyaṃ vai kukkuṭeśvare ||
bhūteśvaraṃ bhasmagātre oṃkāre'marakaṇṭakam || 14 ||
tryaṃbakaṃ ca trisaṃdhyāyāṃ virajāyāṃ trilocanam ||
dīptamarkeśvare jñeyaṃ nepāle paśupālakam || 15 ||
yamaliṃgaṃ ca duṣkarṇe kapālī karavīrake ||
jāgeśvare triśūlī ca śrīśaile tripurāṃtakam || 16 ||
rohaṇaṃ tu ayodhyāyāṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram ||
kārohaṇe nakulīśaṃ devikāyāmumāpatim|| 17 ||
bhairave bhairavākāramamaraṃ pūrvasāgare ||
saptagodāvare bhīmaṃ svayaṃbhūrnirmaleśvare || 18 ||
karṇikāre gaṇādhyakṣaṃ kailāse tu gaṇādhipam ||
gaṃgādvāre himasthānaṃ jala liṃge jalapriyam || 19 ||
analaṃ vāḍave'gnau ca bhīmaṃ badarikāśrame ||
śreṣṭhe koṭīśvaraṃ caiva vārāhaṃ vindhyaparvate || 6.109.20 ||
hemakūṭe virūpākṣaṃ bhūrbhuvaṃ gandhamādane ||
liṃgeśvare ca varadaṃ laṃkāyāṃ ca narāṃtakam || 21 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiriyaṃ devi tavākhyātā viśeṣataḥ ||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ vāpi sarvapātakanāśinī || 22 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kīrtanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
kālatraye'pi śucibhirviśeṣācchivadīkṣitaiḥ || 23 ||
likhitāpi varārohe yasyaiṣā tiṣṭhate gṛhe ||
na tatra jāyate doṣo bhūtapretasamudbhavaḥ || 24 ||
na vyādherna ca sarpāṇāṃ na caurāṇāṃ varānane ||
nānyeṣāṃ bhūbhujādīnāṃ kadācidapi kutracit || 25 ||
iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthamāhātmya kathanaṃnāma navottaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 109 || || cha ||

<6.110>

|| śrīdevyuvāca || ||
naiteṣvapi suraśreṣṭha sarveṣu bhuvi mānavāḥ ||
api dīrghāyuṣo bhūtvā snātuṃ śaktāḥ kathaṃcana || 1 ||
eteṣāmapi sārāṇi mama tīrthāni kīrtaya ||
yeṣu snāto naraḥ samyaksarveṣāṃ labhate phalam || 2 || ||
|| īśvara uvāca || ||
eteṣāṃ madhyato devi tīrthāṣṭakamanuttamam ||
asti snātairnaraistatra sarveṣāṃ labhyate phalam || 3 ||
naimiṣaṃ caiva kedāraṃ puṣkaraṃ kṛmijāṃgalam ||
vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ hāṭakeśvaram || 4 ||
aṣṭāsveteṣu yaḥ snātaḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu satyametanmayoditam || 5 ||
|| śrīdevyuvāca || ||
kalikāle mahādeva bhaviṣyati kathaṃcana ||
snānaṃ tasmānmama brūhi yatsāraṃ tīrthameva hi || 6 ||
aṣṭānāmapi caiteṣāṃ devadeva trilocana ||
yadyahaṃ vallabhā bhaktā tathā cittānuvartinī || 7 ||
|| īśvara uvāca || ||
aṣṭānāmapi deveśi kṣetrāṇāmasti cottamam ||
eteṣāmapi tatkṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam || 8 ||
yatra sarvāṇi kṣetrāṇi saṃsthitāni mamājñayā ||
tathānyāni ca tīrthāni kalikāle'pi saṃsthite || 9 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatkṣetraṃ sevyameva hi ||
mānuṣairmokṣamicchadbhiḥ satyametanma yoditam || 6.110.10 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātamaṣṭaṣaṣṭisamudbhavam ||
samuccayaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā nāmadevasamanvitam || 11 ||
yathā devena cākhyātaṃ pārvatyā guhyamuttamam ||
prasannena mayā kṛtsnaṃ yuṣmākaṃ samudāhṛtam ||12||
yaścaitatpaṭhate bhaktyā hyaṣṭaṣaṣṭisamudbhavam ||
snānajaṃ labhate puṇyaṃ śṛṇvānaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ || 13 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya 'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 110 ||

<6.111>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
śivakṣetrāṇi yairvipraiḥ samānītāni tatra ca ||
teṣāṃ sarvāṇi gotrāṇi vada sūtaja vistarāt || 1 ||
kasya gotrodbhavairvipraiḥ kiṃ kṣetraṃ samupārjitam ||
śaṃkarasya prasādena tasminkāla upasthite ||2||
kiyatyapi ca gotrāṇi camatkārapurottame ||
sthāpitāni subhaktena tenānartena sūtaja || 3||
tvayā proktaṃ purā dattaṃ puraṃ kṛtvā dvijanmanām ||
na ca teṣāṃ kṛtā saṃkhyā tasmāttāṃ parikīrtaya || 4 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
upadeśaḥ purā datto dvisaptatimunīśvaraiḥ ||
ānartādhipatiḥ pūrvaṃ kuṣṭharoga prapīḍitaḥ ||
śaṃkhatīrthaṃ samāgatya snānaṃ cakre tvarānvitaḥ || 5 ||
tena nāśaṃ gataḥ kuṣṭho bhūpatestasya tatkṣaṇāt ||
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyānnirvi ṇṇasya tanuṃ prati || 6 ||
tataḥ sa nīrujo bhūtvā toṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ ||
tānuvāca muniśreṣṭhān praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ || 7 ||
suvarṇaṃ vā gajāśvaṃ vā rājyaṃ sakalameva vā ||
bhavadbhyaḥ saṃpradāsyāmi tasmābrūta dvijottamāḥ || 8 ||
yadyasya rocate yāvanmātramanyadapi dvijāḥ ||
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ dīnasya praṇatasya ca || 9 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
niṣparigrahadharmāṇo vānaprasthā vayaṃ dvijāḥ ||
sadyaḥprakṣālakāḥ kiṃ no rājyena vibhavena ca || 6.111.10 || ||
|| rājovāca | ||
upakāraṃ samāsādya yaḥ karoti na pāpakṛt ||
upakāraṃ punastasya sa kṛtaghna udāhṛtaḥ || 11 ||
brahmaghnaṃ ca surāpe ca caure bhagnava te śaṭhe ||
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ || 12 ||
tasmātkṛtvā prasādaṃ me kiṃcidbrūt dvijottamāḥ||
yenānṛṇyaṃ pragacchāmi yadyapi syātsujīvitam ||13||
|| munaya ūcuḥ || ||
satyametanmahābhāga kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ||
paraṃ tatra bhaveddoṣo yatra dātā tu saspṛhaḥ||14||
niḥspṛho yatra rājendra hyupakāraparo bhavet||
na tatra jāyate doṣaḥ svalpo'pi ca kathaṃcana ||15||
tasmāttvaṃ gaccha rājyaṃ svaṃ svadharmeṇa prapālaya ||
iha loke pare caiva yena saukhyaṃ prajāyate || 16 ||
evaṃ sa bhūmipo viprairniṣiddhaḥ sa sahasradhā ||
kṛcchreṇa tānpraṇamyoccairjagāma svagṛhaṃ tataḥ ||17||
tatra gatvā prahṛṣṭā tmākṛtvā ramyaṃ maheśvaram ||
gītanṛtyasavādyaiśca rātrijāgaraṇādibhiḥ ||
cakāra pūrvavadrājyaṃ samaṃtāddhatakaṃṭakam || 18 ||
ciṃtayāno divānaktaṃ brāhmaṇā nprati tatsadā ||
kathaṃ teṣāṃ dvijeṃdrāṇāmupakāro bhaviṣyati ||
madīyo mama yairdattaṃ gātrametatpunarnavam || 19 ||
te'pi sarve muniśreṣṭhāḥ khecaratva samanvitāḥ ||
tapaḥśaktyā yāṃti nānātīrtheṣu bhaktitaḥ || 6.111.20 ||
teṣu snānaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva pitṛtarpaṇam ||
prāṇayātrāṃ punaścakrustatrāgatya sva āśrame || 21 ||
anye tatraiva kurvaṃti nityakṛtyāni ye dvijāḥ ||
tathānye dūramāsādya tīrthaṃ dṛṣṭvā manoharam || 22 ||
uṣitvā rajanīṃ tatra dvirātraṃ vā punargṛham||
samāgacchaṃti cānye tu trirātreṇa samāyayuḥ || 23 ||
vārāṇasyāṃ prayāge vā puṣkare vātha naimiṣe ||
prabhāse vā'tha kedāre hyanyasminnahi vāṃchyate || 24 ||
kadācidatha te sarve kārtikyāṃ puṣkaratraye ||
gatā viniścayaṃ kṛtvā snānārthaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 25 ||
paṃcarātraṃ vasiṣyāmo vayaṃ tatra samāhitāḥ ||
tasmādvahniṣu dāreṣu rakṣā kāryā svaśaktitaḥ || 26 ||
evaṃ te samayaṃ kṛtvā gatā yāvaddvijottamāḥ||
tāvaddha patinā jñātā na kaścittatra tiṣṭhati | 27 ||
teṣāṃ madhye munīṃdrāṇāṃ sutīrthāśramavāsinām ||
damayaṃtīti vikhyātā caṃdrabiṃbasamānanā || 28 ||
tāmuvāca rahasyevaṃ vaja tvaṃ cāruhāsini|
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mamādeśo'dhunā dhruvam || 29 ||
tatra tiṣṭhaṃti yāḥ patnyo munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ||
bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi tāsāṃ yaccha yathecchayā || 6.111.30 ||
na tāsāṃ patayo'smākaṃ prakurvaṃti pratigraham ||
kathaṃcidapi suśroṇi lobhyamānāpi bhūriśaḥ || 31 ||
strīṇāṃ bhūṣaṇajā cintā sadā caivādhikā bhavet ||
laulyaṃ ca kautukaṃ caiva sadā bhūṣaṇajaṃ bhavet || 32 ||
api mṛnmayakaṃ kiṃcitkāṣṭhasūtra mayaṃ ca vā ||
jatukācamayaṃ vāpi nārī dhatte vibhūṣaṇam || 33 ||
eṣa eva bhavetteṣāmupakārasyasaṃbhavaḥ ||
upāyaḥ padmapatrākṣi na cānyo'sti kathaṃcana || 34 ||
sā tatheti pratijñāya vicitrābharaṇāni ca ||
gṛhītvā harṣasaṃyukā tatastatkṣetramāyayau ||35||
maṇimuktāmayānyeva kuṇḍalāni śubhāni ca ||
tathā candrojjvalāhārānnūpurāṇi bṛhaṃti ca || 36 ||
indranīlamahānīlavaiḍūryakhacitāni ca |
padmarāgaistathā vajrairmāṇikyaiśca manoramaiḥ||37||
keśaiḥ kaṃkaṇairdivyaiḥ śakracāpanibhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
hemasūtraiśca jātyaiśca mekhalābhistathaiva ca || 38 ||
atha sā bodhane viṣṇoḥ saṃprāpte divase śubhe |
upavāsaparā snātā ekasminsalilāśaye || 39 ||
tīradeśe niveśyaiva mahābhūṣaṇaparvatam ||
yasya prabhābhirugrābhirvyāptaṃ gaganamaṃḍalam || 6.111.40 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptāstāpasyaḥ kautukānvitāḥ ||
kīdṛśā rājapatnī sā kiṃrūpā kiṃvibhūṣaṇā || 41 ||
atha tāstāṃ samālokya divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām||
surūpāṃgīṃ samādhisthāṃ citte cintāṃ pracakrire || 42 ||
dhanyeyaṃ bhūpaterbhāryā yaivaṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ||
damayaṃtī surūpāḍhyā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 43 ||
samādhyaṃtaṃ samāsādya tāpasīrvīkṣya sā'pi ca ||
damayaṃtī namaścakre tāḥ sarvā vidhipūrvakam || 44 ||
tāḥ kṛtāṃjalinā prāha valguvākyaṃ manoharam ||
mayāyaṃ bhūṣaṇastoma uddiśya garuḍadhvajam||
kalpito'dya dine snātvā samupoṣya dine hareḥ || 45 ||
tasmādgṛhṇaṃtu tāpasyo mayā dattāni vāṃchayā ||
bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama || 46 ||
tataścaikā'bravīttāsāmeṣā muktāvalī mama ||
imāṃ dehi na me vāṃchā vidyate'nyā nṛpapriye||47||
tatastayā vihasyoccaiḥ prakṣālya caraṇau svayam||
dattā muktāvalī tasyā vastrairdivyaiḥ samanvitā ||
yasyāḥ ṣaṇmāṣatulyāni mauktikānyamalāni ca || 48 ||
śaratkāle yathā vyomni nakṣatrāṇi dvijottamāḥ||
tathānyā sparddhayā yuktā yayāce'malavarcasam||
hāraṃ nirmūlyatāyuktaṃ cittāhlādakaraṃ param || || 49 ||
atha sā taṃ kare kṛtvā tasyā hāraṃ prayacchati ||
tāvadanyā prajagrāha hāraṃ śṛṃgāralālasā || 6.111.50 ||
tataḥ śeṣāśca tāpasyo bhūṣaṇārthaṃ samu tsukāḥ ||
sasparddhā jagṛhustāni bhūṣaṇāni svayaṃ dvijāḥ || 51 ||
anyāścānyākare kṛtvā bhūṣaṇaṃ sumanoharam ||
balādākṛṣya jagrāha dharṣayitvā tataḥ param|| 52 ||
yathāyathā pragṛhṇaṃti tāpasyo bhūṣaṇārcitāḥ ||
tathātathāsyāḥ saṃjajñe damayaṃtyā mudā hṛdi || 53 ||
anyāni ca pracikṣepa śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||
na tṛptirjāyate tāsāṃ tathāpi dvijasattamāḥ ||54||
bhūṣaṇābhāvamāsādya tataḥ sā pārthivapriyā ||
hṛṣṭā provāca tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃtoṣaḥ kriyatāmi ti||55||
punaścaivānayiṣyāmi prabhāte nātra saṃśayaḥ||
anyāni ca vicitrāṇi yasyā rocaṃti yāni ca||56||
tatastāḥ sakalāḥ procurgacchatvaṃ pārthivapriye||
āgaṃtavyaṃ ca bhūyo'pi pragṛhyābharaṇānica || 57 ||
evamuktā tatastābhiḥ praṇipatya nṛpapriyā ||
prahṛṣṭā prayayau tūrṇaṃ svapuraṃ prati saddvijāḥ || 58 ||
tāpasyopi gṛhaṃ gatvā vastrāṇi vividhāni ca ||
bhūṣaṇāni ca gātreṣu sasparddhā nidadhustadā || 59 ||
tāpasīnāṃ catuṣkaṃ ca parityajya yatavratam ||
śeṣābhiḥ pragṛhītāni maṇḍanāni yathecchayā || 6.111.60 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṇḍale ||
bhūyopi rājapatnī sā bhūṣaṇānyaṃbarāṇi ca || || 61 ||
tathaiva pradadau tāsāṃ jagṛhuśca tathaiva tāḥ ||
evaṃ tasyāḥ prayacchaṃtyā ahanyahani bhaktitaḥ || 62 ||
paṃcarātramatikrāṃta tṛptāstāstāpasa priyāḥ ||
na rājñī tṛptimāyāti prayacchaṃtī prabhaktitaḥ || 63 ||
tataḥ śuśrāva tāpasyaścatasro'tra suniḥspṛhāḥ ||
valkalājinadhāriṇyo na tasyāḥ pārśvamāgatāḥ ||
na cānyā bhūṣitā dṛṣṭvā cakrurīrṣyāṃ kathaṃcana || 64 ||
atha sā tvaritaṃ gatvā tāsāṃ pārśvamaniṃditā ||
bhūṣaṇāni mahārhāṇi gṛhītvā paṃcamīdine || 65 ||
tataḥ provāca tāḥ sarvāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti ||
imāni bhūṣaṇārthāya bhūṣaṇāni pragṛhyatām || 66 ||
|| tāpasya ūcuḥ || 2||
nāsmākaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ kāryaṃ bhūṣitā valkalairvayam ||
tasmādgaccha nijaṃ harmyamarthibhyaḥ saṃpradīyatām || 67 ||
vadantīnāṃ tayā sārdhamevaṃ tāsāṃ dvijottamāḥ|
catvāraḥ patayaḥ prāptā ekaikasyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak68||
śunaḥśepo'tha śākreyo bauddho dāntaścaturthakaḥ|
viyanmārgaṃ hi catvāraḥ svāśramamāyayuḥ || 69 ||
śeṣāḥ sarve gatibhraṃśaṃ prāpya bhūmārgamāśritāḥ ||
atha te svāśramaṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtākārabhūṣaṇam ||
kimidaṃkimidaṃ procuryattāpasyo viḍaṃbitāḥ || 6.111.70 ||
kenaivaṃ pāpmanā'smākamāśramo'yaṃ viḍaṃbitaḥ ||
pradattvā tāpasīnāṃ ca bhūṣaṇānyaṃbarāṇi ca || 71 || ||
|| tatpatnya ūcuḥ || ||
camatkārasyabhūpasya yaiṣā bhāryā vyavasthitā ||
anayā saṃpradattāni sarvāsāṃ bhūṣaṇāni vai || 72 ||
asmākamapi saṃprāptā gṛhe vai nṛpavallabhā ||
dātuṃ vibhūṣaṇānyeva niṣiddhā'smābhiradya sā || 73 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tataste kopa mūrcchitāḥ |
ūcustāṃ nṛpaterbhāryāṃ śāpaṃ dātuṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 74 ||
dvisaptatirvayaṃ pāpe snānārthaṃ puṣkare gatāḥ ||
kārtikyāṃ vyomamārgeṇa manomāru taraṃhasā || 75 ||
catvārasta ime prāptā yeṣāṃ dāraiḥ pratigrahaḥ ||
na kṛtastasya bhūpasya kubhāryāyāḥ kathaṃcana || 76 ||
tasmādviḍaṃbito yasmādā śramo'yaṃ tapasvinām ||
śilārūpā ca bhavatī tasmādbhavatu kutsitā || 707 ||
atha sā tatkṣaṇādeva śilārūpā babhūva ha ||
niśceṣṭā tatkṣaṇādeva munivākyādanaṃtaram || 78 ||
tataḥ sa parivāro'syāstadduḥkhena samākulaḥ ||
vāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇo dīnaḥ prasthitaḥ svapuraṃ prati || 79 ||
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ damayaṃtyāḥ samudbhavam ||
vṛttāṃtaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāstasyāḥ śāpasamudbhavam || 6.111.80 ||
śrutvā sa pārthivastūrṇaṃ vṛttāṃtaṃ śāpajaṃ tadā ||
prasādanāya viprāṇāṃ duḥkhitaḥ sa vanaṃ yayau || 81 ||
tataste munayastūrṇaṃ catvāro'pi mahīpatim ||
jñātvā prasādanārthāya bhāryārthaṃ samupasthitam || 82 ||
agrihotrāṇi dārāṃśca samādāya tataḥ param ||
kurukṣetraṃ samājagmuḥ khamārgeṇa drutaṃ tadā || 83 ||
pārthivo'pi samanveṣya yatnāttānsarvato munīn|
nirviṇṇaḥ śramārtaśca bhāryāvyasanaduḥkhitaḥ ||94||
tato jagāma taṃ deśaṃ yatra bhāryā śilāmayī ||
sā sthitā tāpasīvṛndaiḥ sarvato'pi samanvitā ||85||
atha tāṃ tādṛśīṃ dṛṣṭvā sevakaiḥ sakalairvṛtaḥ ||
hāheti sa muhuḥ procya mūrcchitaḥ prāpatatkṣitau ||96||
tataḥ kṛcchrātsamāsādya saṃjñāṃ toyasamukṣitaḥ||
pralāpamakarotpaścātsmṛtvāsmṛtvā priyānguṇān ||87||
hā priye mṛgaśāvākṣi mama prāṇavināśini ||
māṃ muktvā'dya priyaṃ kāṃtaṃ kva gatāsi śubhānane ||88||
nābhukte mayi bhuktāsi nidrāṃ nā'nidrite gatā ||
na saubhāgyasya garveṇa mamājñā laṃghitā kvacit|| 89 ||
na smarāmi tvayā proktaṃ kadācidvi kṛtaṃ vacaḥ ||
rahasyapi viśālākṣi kimu bhojanasaṃsadi || 6.111.90 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ pralapatastasya bhūpateḥ karuṇaṃ bahu ||
āyātā maṃtriṇa stasya śrutvā bhūpaṃ tathāvidham || 91 ||
tataḥ saṃbodhya taṃ kṛcchāddṛṣṭāntairvahuvistaraiḥ ||
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ mahadvyasanasaṃbhavaiḥ || 92 ||
ninyustaṃ bhūpatiṃ dīnaṃ vāṣpavyākulalocanam ||
niśvasaṃtaṃ yathānāgaṃ tejasā parivarjitam || 93 ||
so'pi kṛtvā''layaṃ tasyāḥ samaṃtātsumanoharam||
karpūrāgarudhūpādyairvastrakuṃkumacandanaiḥ ||
yojayāmāsa tāṃ bhāryāṃ śilārūpāmapi sthitām || 94 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye damayantyupākhyāne damayantyā vipraśāpena śilātvaprāptāvānartādhipatikṛtaśokakathanaṃnāmaikādaśottara śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 111 || || cha ||

<6.112>

sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ katipayāhasya gate tasminmahīpatau ||
svagṛhaṃ prati duḥkhārte parivārasamanvite || 1 ||
padbhyāmeva samāyātā hyaṣṭaṣaṣṭirdvijottamāḥ ||
pariśrāṃtāḥ kṛśāṃgāśca dhūlidhūsaritānanāḥ || 2 ||
yāvatpaśyati dārāḥ svā divyābharaṇa bhūṣitāḥ ||
divyavastraiḥ susaṃvītā rājapatnya ivāparāḥ || 3 ||
tataśca vismayāviṣṭāḥ papracchuste kṣudhānvitāḥ ||
kimidaṃ kimidaṃ pāpā viruddhaṃ vihitaṃ vapuḥ || 4 ||
kathaṃ prāptāni vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni varāṇi ca ||
nūnamasmadgaterbhraṃśaḥ khe jāto nā'nyathā bhavet || 5 ||
vikāramenaṃ saṃtyaktvā yuṣmadīyaṃ sugarhitāḥ||
atha tāḥ sarvavṛttāṃtamūcustāpasayoṣitaḥ||6||
yathā rājñī samāyātā damayantī nṛpapriyā||
bhūṣaṇāni ca dattāni tayā caiva yathā dvijāḥ || 7||
yathā śāpaśca sañjāto brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām||
atha te munayaḥ kruddhāstacchrutvā garhitaṃ vacaḥ ||
rājapratigraho niṃdyastāpasānāṃ viśeṣataḥ||8||
tato bhūpasya rāṣṭrasya nāśārthaṃ jagṛhurjalam||
krodhena mahatāviṣṭā vepamānā nirargalam||9||
anena pāpmanā'smākaṃ kubhūpena praṇāśitā||
khe gatirlobhayitvā tu patnyo'smākamakṛtrimāḥ ||
saralāstadgaṇāḥ sarve yenedṛgvyasanaṃ sthitam ||6.112.10||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ te munayo yāvacchāpaṃ tasya mahīpateḥ||
prayacchaṃti ca tāstāvadūcurbhāryā ruṣānvitāḥ || 11 ||
na deyo bhūpatestasya śāpo brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
asmadīyaṃ vacastāvacchrotavyamaviśaṃkitaiḥ ||12||
vayaṃ sarvā narendrasya bhāryayā samalaṃkṛtāḥ ||
suvastrairbhūṣaṇairdivyaiḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 13 ||
vayaṃ daridradoṣeṇa sadā yuṣmadgṛhe sthitāḥ ||
karśitā na ca saṃprāptaṃ sukhaṃ martyasamu dbhavam ||14||
eteṣāṃ paraloko'tra vidyate ye taporatāḥ ||
na ca martyaphalaṃ kiṃcidapi svalpataraṃ bhavet ||15||
anyeṣāṃ viṣayasthānāmiha lokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
bhogaprasaktacittānāṃ nīcānāṃ sudurātmanām || 16 ||
gṛhasthāśramiṇāṃ caiva svadharmaratacetasām ||
iha lokaḥ paraścaiva jāyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ||17||
tā vayaṃ nātra sandeho gṛhasthāśramamuttamam ||
saṃsevya sādhayiṣyāmo lokadvayamanuttamam ||18||
tasmādgṛhāṇi ramyāṇi pravadaṃti samāhitāḥ ||
bhūpālādbhūmimādāya vṛttiṃ caivābhivāṃchitām || 19 ||
tataścaivātha vīkṣadhvaṃ putrapautrasamudbhavam ||
saukhyaṃ cāpi kumārīṇāṃ bāṃdhavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 6.112.20 ||
na kariṣyatha cedvākyametadasmadudīritam ||
sarvāḥ prāṇaparityāgaṃ kariṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ || 21 ||
yūyaṃ strīvadhapāpena yuktāḥ santastataḥ param |
narakaṃ rauravaṃ durgaṃ gamiṣyatha suniścitam ||22||
evaṃ te munayaḥ śrutvā tāsāṃ vākyāni tāni vai ||
bhūpṛṣṭhe tatyajustoyaṃ śāpārthaṃ yatkarairdhṛtam ||23||
tatastattoyanirdagdhaṃ tadvibhāgaṃ kṣitestadā ||
ūṣaratvamanuprāptamadyāpi dvijasattamāḥ || 24 ||
āstāmannādikaṃ tatra yadutpaṃ na prarohati ||
na janma cāpnuyādbhūyaḥ pakṣī vā kīṭa eva vā || 25 ||
tṛṇaṃ vātha mṛgastatra kiṃ punarbhaktimānnaraḥ ||
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ śraddhayā phālgune naraḥ || 26 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ ravairvāre sa pitṝnuddharennijān ||
api svakarmaṇā prāptānnarake dāruṇākṛtau || 27 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye damayantyupākhyāna ūṣarotpattimāhātmyakathanaṃnāma dvādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 112 ||

<6.113>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve gatakopā dadhurmatim ||
yajñakarmasu gārhasthye putrapautrasamudbhave || 1 ||
etasminnaṃtare rājā sa tānprāptāndvijottamān||
śrutvā bhakti samāyuktaḥ praṇāmārthamupāgataḥ || 2 ||
śrutvā kopagatāṃ vārtāmupaśāmakṛtāṃ tathā ||
gārhasthyāpratipannānāṃ vākyairbhāryāsamudbhavaiḥ || 3 ||
tataḥ praṇamya tānsarvānsāṣṭāṃgaṃ sa mahīpatiḥ ||
tataḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ provāca vinataḥ sthitaḥ || 4 ||
yuṣmadīyaprasādena saṃprāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam ||
mayā rogavināśena tasmādbrūta karomi kim || 5 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||

mattavāraṇajuṣṭāni dīrghikāsahitāni ca ||

tathā kṛtvā'tha ratnaughaiḥ pūrayitvā tathā paraiḥ|

provāca tāranādena śrūyatāṃ jalpato mama || 14 ||
etatpuraṃ mayā dattamebhirgrāmaiḥ samanvitam ||
etebhyo brāhmaṇeṃdrebhyaḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 15 ||
tasmādrakṣā prakartavyā yathā na syātkṣatiḥ kvacit ||
kaṣṭaṃ vā brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ tathā caiva parābhavam|| 16 ||
asmadvaṃśasamudbhūto yastvetāṃstoṣayiṣyati ||
anyo vā bhūpatirvṛddhimagryāṃ nūnaṃ sa yāsyati || 17 ||
yaścāparādhasaṃyuktānetānkhedaṃ nayiṣyati ||
yojayiṣyati vā kleśairvividhairvā parābhavaiḥ ||
sa śatrubhiḥ parābhūto veṣṭito vividhairgadaiḥ || 18 ||
iha loke viyogādīnprāpya kleśānsudāruṇān||
rauravādiṣu raudreṣu narakeṣu prayāsyati| 19 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ sarvaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtyaṃ mahīpatiḥ ||
svayamevākaronnityaṃ divārātramataṃdritaḥ || 6.113.20 ||
atha tā brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ bhāryāḥ sarvāḥ dvijottamāḥ ||
damayaṃtyāḥ samāsādya prāsādaṃ snehavatsalāḥ || 21 ||
kuṃkumāgarukarpūraiḥ puṣpairgaṃdhaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
tadarccā pūjayāmāsuḥ sa ca rājā dinedine || 22||

|| sūta uvāca ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

śrāvayasva mahābhāga tāraśabdena sarvaśaḥ ||73||
taṃ śrutvā ye na yāsyaṃti pātālaṃ pannagādhamāḥ ||
yuṣmadvākyādbhaviṣyaṃti nirviṣāste na saṃśayaḥ || 74 || ||
|| trijāta uvāca || ||
brūhi taṃ me mahāmaṃtraṃ sarvatīkṣṇavināśanam ||
yena gatvā nijaṃ sthānaṃ sarpānutsādayāmyaham ||75||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
garaṃ viṣamiti proktaṃ na tatrāsti ca sāṃpratam ||
matprasādāttvayā hyetaduccāryaṃ brāhmaṇottama || 76
na garaṃ na garaṃ caitacchrutvā ye pannagādhamāḥ||
tatra sthāsyaṃti te vadhyā bhaviṣyaṃti yathāsukham || 77 ||
adyaprabhṛti tatsthānaṃ nagarākhyaṃ dharātale ||
bhaviṣyati suvikhyātaṃ tava kīrtivivardhanam || 78 ||
tathānyopi ca yo vipro nāgaraḥ śuddhavaṃśajaḥ ||
nagarākhyena maṃtreṇa abhimaṃtrya tridhā jalam || 79 ||
prāṇinaṃ kāla saṃdaṣṭamapi mṛtyuvaśaṃgatam ||
prakariṣyati jīvāḍhyaṃ prakṣipya vadane svayam ||6.114.80||
anyatrāpi sthito martyo maṃtrametaṃ trirakṣaram ||
yaḥ smariṣyati saṃsupto na hiṃsyaḥ syādaherhi saḥ ||81||
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ vāpi kṛtrimaṃ vā garaṃ hi tat ||
tadanena ca maṃtreṇa saṃspṛṣṭaṃ tvamṛtāyitam ||82||
ajīrṇaprabhavā rogā ye cānye jaṭharodbhavāḥ||
maṃtrasyāsya prabhāvena sarve yāṃti drutaṃ kṣayam ||83||
evamuktvā'tha taṃ vipraṃ bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
jagāmādarśanaṃ paścādyathā dīpo vitailakaḥ ||84||
trijāto'pi samaṃ viprairhataśeṣaistu tairdrutam ||
jagāma saṃprahṛṣṭātmā camatkārapuraṃ prati || 85 ||
evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve trijātena samanvitāḥ ||
na garaṃ na garaṃ proccairuccaraṃtaḥ samāyayuḥ || 86 ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ yattadvyāptaṃ samaṃtataḥ ||
raudrairāśīviṣaiḥ krūraiḥ śeṣasyādeśamāśriteḥ ||87||
atha te pannagāḥ śrutvā siddhamaṃtra śivodbhavam ||
nirviṣāstejasā hīnāḥ samantātte pradudravuḥ ||88||
valmīkānkecidāsādya citraraṃdhrāṃtarodbhavān ||
anye cāpi prajagmuśca pātālaṃ daṃdaśūkakāḥ || 89 ||
ye kecidbhayasaṃtrastā vārddhakyena nipīḍitāḥ ||
vālatvena tathā cānye śaknuvaṃti na sarpitum || 6.114.90 ||
te sarve brāhmaṇendraistaiḥ kṛtasya pratikārakaiḥ ||
nihatāḥ pannagāstatra daṃḍakāṣṭhaiḥ sahasraśaḥ || 91 ||
evamutsādya tānsarvānbrāhmaṇāste gatavyathāḥ |
taṃ trijātaṃ puraskṛtya sthānakṛtyāni cakrire || 92 ||
evaṃ tannagaraṃ jātamasmātkālādanaṃtaram ||
devadevasya bhargasya prasādena dvijottamāḥ || 93 ||
etadyaḥ paṭhate nityamākhyānaṃ nagarodbhavam ||
na tasya sarpajaṃ kvāpi kathaṃcijjāyate bhayam | 94 ||
iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nagarasaṃjñotpattivarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 114 ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

tataḥ paraṃ yugaṃ pāpaṃ yato bhīru bhaviṣyati ||
tadūrdhvaṃ martyadharmāṇo mlecchāḥ sthāsyaṃti sarvataḥ || 45 ||
tataḥ svarganivāsārthaṃ bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ ||
saṃhartā svakulaṃ sarvaṃ svayameva na saṃśayaḥ || 46 ||
bhaviṣyaṃti punardaṃṣṭrāstava vaktre manoramāḥ ||
tasmāttvaṃ gaccha pātālaṃ svabharttā yatra tiṣṭhati || 47 ||
anyaccāpi yadiṣṭaṃ te kiṃciccitte vyavasthitam ||
tatkīrtayasva kalyāṇi mahāṃstoṣo mama sthitaḥ || 48 |
|| revatyuvāca || ||
sthāne stheyaṃ sadā'traiva mama nāmnā sureśvari ||
yena me jāyate kīrtistrailokye sacarācare ||49||
tathā'haṃ nāgalokācca caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca ||
sadā tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi viśeṣānnavamīdine ||6.116.50||
āśvinasya site pakṣe sarvairnāgaiḥ samanvitā ||
prapūjāṃ te vidhāsyāmi śraddhayā parayā yutā ||51||
tasminnahani ye'nye'pi pūjāṃ dāsyaṃti te narāḥ ||
mā paśyaṃtu prasādātte narāste vallabhakṣayam | 52 |
|| devyuvāca || ||
evaṃ bhadre kariṣyāmi vāso me'tra bhaviṣyati||
tvannāmnā pūjakānāṃ ca śreyo dāsyāmi te sadā ||
mahānavamije cāhni viśeṣeṇa śucismite || 53 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktā tayā sā'tha revatī śeṣavallabhā ||
jagāma svagṛhaṃ paścāddharṣeṇa mahatānvitā 54 ||
tataḥprabhṛti sā devī tasminkṣetre vyavasthitā ||
tannāmnā kāmadā nṛṇāṃ sarvavyasananāśinī || 55 ||
aṃbā sā kīrtyate durgā revatī soragapriyā ||
tataḥ saṃkīrtyate loke bhūtale cāṃbarevatī || 56 ||
yastāṃ śraddhāsamopetaḥ śucirbhūtvā prapūjayet ||
navamyāmāśvine māsi śuklapakṣe samāhitaḥ ||
na sa saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadvyasanaṃ svakulo dbhavam|| 57||
dṛṣṭvāgre chidrakaṃ vyālayuktaṃ doṣairvimucyate ||
grahabhūtapiśācotthaistathānyairapi cāpadaiḥ || 58 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhahasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmyeṃ'bārevatītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 116 || || cha ||

<6.117>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
bhaṭṭikākhyā purā proktā yā tvayā sūtanandana ||
kasmāttasyāḥ śarīrāntāddaṃṣṭrā nāgasamudbhavāḥ || 1 ||
viśīrṇāḥ kiṃ prabhāvaśca tapasaḥ sūtanandana ||
kiṃ vā maṃtraprabhāvaśca etannaḥ kautukaṃ param || 2 ||
yanmānuṣaśarīre'pi viśīrṇāstā viṣolbaṇāḥ ||
nāgānāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa tasmātsarvaṃ prakīrtaya || 3 ||
| sūta uvāca || ||
sā purā brāhmaṇī bālye vartamānā piturgṛhe ||
vaidhavyena samāyuktā jātā karmavipākataḥ || 4 ||
tato bālye'pi śuśrāva śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca ||
devayātrāṃ pracakre'tha tīrthe snāti samāhitā || 5 ||
tatra kedāradevaṃ ca gatvā nityaṃ samāhitā ||
prātarutthāya gītaṃ ca bhaktyā cakre tadagrataḥ || 6 ||
tatastadgītalaulyena pātālātsamupetya ca ||
takṣako vāsukiścaiva dvija rūpadharāvubhau || 7 ||
sā'pi tatra mahadgītaṃ tānaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtam||
mūrcchanābhiḥ samopetaṃ saptasvaravirājitam || 8 ||
yatibhiśca tathā grāmairvarṇagrāmaiḥ pṛtha gvidhaiḥ||
tataṃ ca vitataṃ caiva ghanaṃ suṣirameva ca || 9 ||
tālakālakriyāmānavardhamānādikaṃ ca yat ||
avidagdhāpi sā teṣāṃ gītāṃgānāṃ dvijāṃganā ||
kevalaṃ kaṃṭhasaṃśuddhyā tābhyāṃ toṣaṃ samādadhe ||6.117.10||
tatastadgītalobhena sarve tatpuravāsinaḥ ||
prātarutthāya kedāraṃ samāgacchaṃti kautukāt ||11||
kasya cittvatha kālasya nāgau tau svapuraṃ prati ||
ninyurbalātsamudyamya sarvalokasya paśyataḥ|| 12 ||
nāgarūpaṃ samādhāya raudraṃ janavibhīṣaṇam ||
bhogāgryeṇa ca saṃveṣṭya pātālatalamabhyayuḥ || 13 ||
atha tāṃ svagṛhaṃ nītvā procatuḥ kāmapīḍitau ||
bhavāvābhyāṃ viśālākṣi bhāryā dharmaparāyaṇā ||
etadarthaṃ samānītā tvaṃ pātāle mahītalāt || 14 ||
|| bhaṭṭikovāca || ||
yattvaṃ takṣaka māṃ śāṃtāmanapekṣāṃ ratotsave ||
ānaiṣīrapahṛtyāśu brāhmaṇānvaya saṃbhavām || 15 ||
mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya purā māṃ tvaṃ samāśritaḥ ||
kāmopahṛtacittātmā tasmānmartyo bhaviṣyasi || 16 ||
yadi māṃ tvaṃ durācāra dharṣayiṣyasi vīryataḥ ||
śatadhā tava mūrdhā'yaṃ sadya eva bhaviṣyati || 17 ||
taṃ śrutvā sumahāśāpaṃ tasyāḥ sa bhayavihvalaḥ ||
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ || 18 ||
mayā tvaṃ kāmasaktena samānītā sumohataḥ ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me śāpasyāṃto yathā bhavet || 19 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ prasāditā tena takṣakeṇa dvijātmajā ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ nāgaṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanā || 6.117.20 ||
yadi māṃ martyaloke tvaṃ bhūyo na yasi takṣaka ||
tatra śāpasya paryaṃtaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 21 ||
etasminnaṃtare jñātvā mānuṣīṃ svagṛhāgatām ||
takṣakeṇa samānītāṃ kāmopahatace tasā || 22 ||
tatastasya kalatrāṇi maherṣyāsaṃśritāni ca ||
tasyā nāśārthamājagmuḥ koparaktekṣaṇāni ca || 23
atha tāsāṃ parijñāya takṣakaḥ sa viceṣṭitam ||
vāñchañchāpasya paryaṃtaṃ tatpārśvādbhayasaṃyutaḥ ||24||
vajrāṃ nāmāsmaradvidyāṃ tasyā gātraṃ tatastayā ||
yojayāmāsa rakṣārthaṃ prāptā cātha bhujaṃgamī || 25 ||
adaśattāṃ tataḥ kruddhā brāhmaṇasya sutāṃ satīm||
sapatnīṃ manyamānoccaiḥ śīrṇadaṃṣṭrā vyajāyata || 26 ||
atha tāmapi sā kruddhā śaśāpa dvijasaṃbhavā ||
dṛṣṭvā sāpatnyajairbhāvairvartamānāṃ saherṣyayā || 27 ||
yasmāttvaṃ doṣahīnāṃ māṃ sadoṣāmiva manyase ||
tasmādbhava drutaṃ pāpe mānuṣī duḥkhabhāginī || 28 ||
atha tāṃ saṃgṛhītvā sa takṣako nāgasattamaḥ ||
kedārāyatane tasminnardharātre mumoca ha || 29 ||
tataḥ provāca tāṃ devīṃ kṛtāṃ jalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||
śāpāṃtaṃ kuru me sādhvi svagṛhaṃ yena yāmyaham || 6.117.30 ||
|| bhaṭṭikovāca || ||
saurāṣṭraviṣaye rājā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi pannaga ||
bhūmau raivatako nāma bhogānāṃ bhājanaṃ sadā || 31 ||
tataścaiva tanuṃ tyaktvā kṣetreṣvāśramamadhyataḥ ||
saṃprāpsyasi nijaṃ sthānaṃ tatkṣetrasya prabhāvataḥ || || 32 ||
|| takṣaka uvāca || ||
eṣā mama priyā kāṃtā tvayā śāpena yojitā ||
yā sā bhavatu me bhāryā mānuṣatve'pi vartite || 33 ||
eta tkuru prasādaṃ me dīnasya pariyācataḥ ||
mā'syā bhavatu cānyena puruṣeṇa samāgamaḥ || 34 ||
|| bhaṭṭikovāca || ||
ānartādhipatereṣā bhavitrī duhitā śubhā||
tataḥ pāṇigrahaṃ prāpya bhāryā tava bhaviṣyati||35||
kṣemaṃkarīti vikhyātā rūpayauvanaśālinī ||
tvayā sārdhaṃ bahūnbhogānbhuktvā'tha pṛthivītale||
paraloke punastvāṃ vai cānuyāsyati śobhanā || 36||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ ca sa tayā proktaḥ kṣamyatāmiti sādaram ||
praṇipatya jagāmā'tha nijaṃ sthānaṃ praharṣitaḥ ||37||
sā'pi prāpte niśāśeṣe kedārasya puraḥ sthitā ||
punaścakre ca tadgītaṃ śrutisaukhyakaraṃ param||38||
atha tasya samāyātāḥ kedārasya didṛkṣavaḥ||
punaḥ kedārabhaktyāḍhyā brāhmaṇāḥ śataśaḥ param ||39||
te tāṃ dṛṣṭvā samāyātāṃ bhaṭṭiṃkāṃ tāṃ dvijodbhavām ||
vismayena samāyuktāḥ papracchustadanaṃtaram||6.117.40||
ko'sau brāhmaṇarūpeṇa nāgaḥ prāptaḥ suśobhane ||
tena tvaṃ kutra nītāsi kimarthaṃ ca vadasva naḥ||41||
kasmātpunaḥ pramuktā'si sarvaṃ vada yathātatham||
atra naḥ kautukaṃ jātaṃ sumahattava kāraṇāt||42||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ sā kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ takṣakasaṃbhavam ||
vṛttāṃtaṃ nāgasaṃbhūtaṃ śāpānugrahajaṃ tathā || 43 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptaṃ sarvaṃ tasyāḥ kuṭumbakam ||
rorūyamāṇaṃ duḥkhārtaṃ śrutvā tāṃ tatra cāgatām || 44 ||
atha sā jananī tasyā vāṣpa paryākulekṣaṇā ||
sasvaje tāṃ tathā cānyāḥ sakhyaḥ snigdhena cetasā || 45 ||
tato ninyurgṛhaṃ svaṃ ca śṛṇvaṃtaśca muhurmuhuḥ ||
nāgalokodbhavāṃ vārtāṃ visya yāviṣṭacetasaḥ || 46 ||
atha tatra pure paurāḥ sarve procuḥ parasparam ||
ayuktaṃ kṛtametena brāhmaṇena durātmanā || 47 ||
yadānītā sutaruṇī paraharmyoṣitā tayā? ||
anyeṣāmapi viprāṇāṃ saṃti nāryo hyanekaśaḥ || 48 ||
taruṇyo rūpavatyaśca vaidhavyena samanvitāḥ ||
tāsāmapi ca sarvāsāmeṣa nyāyo bhaviṣyati ||
yonisaṃkarajo nūnaṃ tasmānnirvāsyatāmiti || 49 ||
ekībhūya tataḥ sarve brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
sāmapūrvamidaṃ vākyaṃ procuḥ śāstra samudbhavam || 6.117.50 ||
eṣā tava sutā vipra taruṇī rūpasaṃyutā ||
sānurāgeṇa nāgeṇa pātāle ca samāhṛtā || 51 ||
tadvakṣyati pramuktāhaṃ nirdoṣā tena rāgiṇā ||
na śraddhāṃ yāti loko'yaṃ śuddhaiṣā samudāhṛtā 52 ||
tasmācchuddhiṃ dvijedrāṇāṃ prayacchatu dvijottama ||
yenānyeṣāmapi prājña vinaśyaṃti na yoṣitaḥ || 53 ||
bāḍhamityeva sa proktvā tatastāṃ vijane sutām ||
papraccha yadi te doṣaḥ kaścidasti prakīrtaya|| 54 ||
no cetprayaccha saṃśuddhiṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ pratuṣṭaye || 55 ||
|| bhaṭṭikovāca || ||
yuktamuktaṃ tvayā tāta tathānyairapi ca dvijaiḥ ||
yuktā syādyoṣitaḥ śuddhirdvārātikramaṇādapi|| || || 56 ||
kiṃ punaḥ paradeśaṃ ca gatāyā rāgiṇā saha ||
tasmādahaṃ na saṃdehaḥ prātaḥ snātā hutāśanam || 57 ||
praviśya sarvaviprāṇāṃ śuddhiṃ dāsyāmya saṃśayam ||
ahamatra ca pānaṃ ca yaccānyadapi kiṃcana ||
prāśayiṣyāmi saṃprāpya śuddhiṃ caiva hutāśanāt || 58 ||
evamuktastayā so'tha harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ ||
prātarutthāya dārūṇi purabāhye nyayojayat || 59 ||
bhaṭṭikā'pi tataḥ snātvā śuklāṃbaradharā śuciḥ ||
sarvaiḥ parijanaiḥ sārdhaṃ tathā nija kuṭuṃbakaiḥ || 6.117.60 ||
prasannavadanā hṛṣṭā viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇā ||
jagāma tatra yatrāste sumahāndāruparvataḥ || 61 ||
tato vahniṃ samādhāya svayaṃ tatra dvijottamāḥ||
pradakṣiṇātrayaṃ kṛtvā prāha caiva kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 62 |
yadi me'sti kvaciddoṣaḥ kāmajo'lpo'pi gātrake ||
kṛto vā'pi balāttena takṣakeṇa durātmanā || 63 ||
anyenāpi ca kenāpi bhaviṣyatyathavā paraḥ ||
tasmātpradahatu kṣipraṃ samiddho'yaṃ hutāśanaḥ || 64
evamuktvā'tha sā sādhvī praviṣṭā nijaharmyavat ||
susamiddho huto vahnirjāto jalamayaḥ kṣaṇāt || 65 ||
sā ca paśyati cātmānaṃ jalamadhyagatāṃ śubhā |80
papātā'tha mahāvṛṣṭiḥ kusumānāṃ nabhastalāt || 66 ||
devadūto vimānastha idaṃ vākyamuvāca ha ||
śuddhāsi tvaṃ mahābhāge cāritrairnijagātrajaiḥ || 67 ||
na tvayā sadṛśī cānyā kācinnārī bhaviṣyati ||
tisraḥ koṭyordhakoṭī ca yāni lomāni mānuṣe ||
prabhavaṃti mahābhāge sarvagātreṣu sarvadā || 68 |
teṣāṃ madhye na te sādhvi pāpamekamapi kvacit |
tasmācchīghraṃ grahaṃ gaccha nijaṃ bāṃdhavasaṃyutā || 69 ||
kuru kṛtyāni puṇyāni samārādhaya keśavam ||
etaccaiva citeḥ sthānaṃ tvadīyaṃ jalapūritam || 6.117.70 ||
tava nāmnā suvikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ loke bhaviṣyati ||
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti śayane bodhane hareḥ || 71 ||
te yāsyaṃti parāṃ siddhiṃ duṣprāpyā yā'marairapi ||
uktvaivaṃ viratā vāṇī devadūtasamudbhavā || 72 ||
bhaṭṭikā tu tato hṛṣṭā praṇamya janakaṃ nijam ||
nāhaṃ gṛhaṃ gamiṣyāmi kiṃ kariṣyāmyahaṃ gṛhe || 73 ||
atraivārādhayiṣyāmi nijatīrthe sadā'cyu tam ||
tathā tapaḥ kariṣyāmi bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanā || 74 ||
tasmāttāta gṛhaṃ gaccha sthitā'haṃ cāgra saṃśraye || 75 ||
tataḥ sa janakastasyāste vā'pi puravāsinaḥ ||
saṃprahṛṣṭā gṛhaṃ jagmuḥ śaṃsatastāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 76 ||
tayā traivikramī tatra pratimā prāgvinirmitā ||
paścānmāheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kṛtvā prāsādamuttamam || 77 ||
tataḥ paraṃ tapaścakre bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanā ||
śasyamānā janaiḥ sarvaiścamatkārapurodbhavaiḥ || 78 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ||
yathā tasyā dṛḍhaṃ kāyamabhedyaṃ saṃsthitaṃ sadā || 79 ||
sarpāṇāṃ ca tathā'nyeṣāṃ śastrādīnāmapi dvijāḥ ||
yaścaitatpaṭhate nityaṃ bhaṭṭikākhyānamuttamam ||
nāpavādo bhavettasya kukṛto dvijasattamāḥ || 6.117.80 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bhaṭṭikātīrthotpattimāhātmyakathanaṃnāma saptadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 117 || || cha ||

<6.118>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yattvayā sūtaja proktaṃ takṣakaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ||
saurāṣṭraviṣaye rājā raivatākhyo mahābalaḥ || 1 ||
tathā tasya priyā bhāryo nāmnā kṣemaṃkarīti yā ||
ānartādhipaterharmye saṃbhaviṣyati bhāminī || 2 ||
tābhyāṃ sarvaṃ samācakṣva vṛttāṃtaṃ sūtanaṃdana ||
atra naḥ kautukaṃ jātaṃ vicitraṃ jalpatastava || 3 ||
kedāraśca śruto'smābhiḥ sūtaputra himācale ||
sa kathaṃ tatra saṃjātaḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 4|| ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvaṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
yathā mayā śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ nijatātamukhāddvijāḥ || 5 ||
pūrvaṃ tacchāpadoṣeṇa takṣako dharaṇītale ||
saurāṣṭrādhipaterharmye raivatākhyo babhūva ha || 6 ||
ānarttādhipateścāpi saṃjātā tanayā gṛhe ||
tasyāścāpi suvikhyātaṃ nāma jātaṃ dharātale || 7 ||
kṣemaṃkarīti viprendrāḥ karmaṇā prakaṭīkṛtam ||
ānartādhipatiḥ pūrvamāsīdrājā prabhaṃjanaḥ || 8 ||
tasya vairaṃ samutpannaṃ bahubhiḥ saha bhūmipaiḥ ||
tato nirvāsyate deśo nīyate paśavo balāt ||
śatrubhirjāyate yuddhaṃ divā naktaṃ dvijottamāḥ||9||
tataḥ katipayāhasya tasya bhāryā priyaṃvadā ||
ṛtusnātā dadhārātha garbhaṃ puṇyaṃ nijodare||6.118.10||
yataḥ prabhṛti tasyāḥ sa garbho'bhūdudarāśrayaḥ||
tataḥ prabhṛti rāṣṭrasya kṣemaṃ jātaṃ tathā pure||11||
eke saṃkhye jitā stena śatravo'pi sudurjayāḥ ||
nihatāśca tathaivānye mitrabhāvaṃ samāśritāḥ || 12||
tato jajñe śubhā kanyā tasyāḥ padmāyatekṣaṇā||
aṃdhakāre'pi yadrātryāṃ dyotitaṃ sūtikāgṛham||13||
athā'sau pārthivaścakre sutavatsumahotsavam||
tasyāstoṣasamāyukto gītavādyādinisvanaiḥ ||14||
dine trayodaśe prāpte nāma tasyā yathocitam||
vihitaṃ bhūbhujā tena viprāṇāṃ purato dvijāḥ ||15||
yasmātkṣemaṃ samutpannaṃ garbhavāse'pi saṃsthayā ||
anayā kṣemaṃkarīnāma tasmādeṣābhave ddvijāḥ ||16||
evaṃ suvihitā khyātā vṛddhiṃ yāti dinedine ||
śuklapakṣe kalā cendoryathaiva gaganāṃgaṇe||17||
tatastāṃ yauvanopetāṃ raivatāya mahīpatiḥ ||
dadau saurāṣṭranāthāya kāle vaivāhike śubhe || 18 ||
atha tābhyāṃ sutā jātā revatīnāma viśrutā ||
bhaṭṭikāśāpadoṣeṇa śeṣapatnī yaśasvinī ||19||
yā tūḍhā rāmarūpeṇa nāgarājena dhīmatā ||
putrapautravatī jātā saubhāgyamadagarvitā || 6.118.20 ||
na ca tābhyāṃ suto jātaḥ kathaṃcidapi vaṃśajaḥ ||
vayasoṃ'te'pi vipreṃdrāstato duḥkhaṃ vyajāyata || 21 ||
atha tau maṃtrivargasya rājyaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ ||
arpayitvā tu putrārthaṃ tapo'rthamiha cāgatau || || 22 ||
tataḥ svamāśramaṃ gatvā sthitau tatra samāhitau ||
devīṃ kātyāyanīṃ sthāpya tadārādhanatatparau || 23 ||
yayā vinihato raudro mahiṣākhyo mahāsuraḥ ||
kaumāravratadhāriṇyā tasminvindhye mahācale || 24 ||
tatastābhyāṃ dadau tuṣṭā sā putraṃ vaṃśavardhanam ||
nāmnā kṣemajitaṃ khyātaṃ parapakṣakṣayā vaham || 25 ||
tataḥ svaṃ rājyamāsādya bhūyo'pi sa mahīpatiḥ ||.
svaputraṃ vardhayāmāsa harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ || 26 ||
yadā sa yauvanopetaḥ sañjātaḥ kṣemajitsutaḥ ||
taṃ ca rājye niyojyā'tha svasthānaṃ sa punaryayau || 27 ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ tadetaddvijasattamāḥ ||
bhāryayā sahitastyaktvā śeṣamanyaṃ paricchadam || 28 ||
tatra saṃsthāpayāmāsa liṃgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ ||
prāsādaṃ ca manohāri tataścakre samāhitaḥ|| 29
raivateśvaramityuktaṃ sarvapātaka nāśanam ||
darśanādeva sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 6.118.30 ||
yā pūrvaṃ sthāpitā durgā tasminkṣetre mahībhujā ||
tasyāḥ kṣemaṃkarī cakre prāsādaṃ śraddha yānvitā || 31 ||
sāpi kṣemaṃkarīnāma tataḥ prabhṛti kīrtyate ||
kātyāyanyapi yā proktā mahiṣāsuramardinī || 32 ||
yastāṃ caitrasite pakṣe saṃpa śyedaṣṭamīdine ||
tasyābhīṣṭā bhavetsiddhiḥ sarvadaiva dvijottamāḥ || 33 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ raivateśvaravarṇanam ||
kṣemaṃkaryāḥ prabhāvaṃ ca sarvapātakanāśanam || 34 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kṣemaṃkarīraivateśvarotpattitīrtha māhātmyavarṇananāmāṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 118 || ||

<6.119>

|| ||ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yatvayā sūtaja proktaṃ devī kātyāyanī ca sā ||
mahiṣāṃtakarī jātā kathaṃ sā me prakīrtaya||1||
kīdṛgdānavavaryaḥ sa māhiṣaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ ||
kasmātsa sūdito devyā tanme vistarato vada ||2||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi devyā māhātmyamuttamam ||
śrutamātre'pi martyānāṃ yena śatrukṣayo bhavet || 3 ||
hiraṇyākṣasutaḥ pūrvaṃ mahiṣonāma dānavaḥ ||
āsīnmahiṣarūpeṇa yena bhuktaṃ jagattrayam||4||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
māhiṣeṇa svarūpeṇa kiṃjātaḥ sūtanaṃdana ||
athavā śāpadoṣeṇa sañjātaḥ kenacidvada ||5||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
saṃjāto hi surūpāḍhyaḥ śatapatranibhānanaḥ ||
dīrghabāhuḥ pṛthugrīvaḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ||
nāmnā citrasamaḥ proktastejovīryasamanvitaḥ | 6 ||

karoti saṃparityajya sarvamaśvādivāhanam|| 7 ||
kadācinmahiṣārūḍhaḥ sa pratasthe danoḥ sutaḥ ||
jāhnavītīramāsādya vinighnañjalapakṣiṇaḥ || 9 ||
athāsītsusamādhistho durvāsā munisattamaḥ ||
gaṃgātīre vidhāyoccaiḥ padmā sanamanuttamam || 9 ||
vihaṃgāsaktacittena śūnyena sa munīśvaraḥ ||
dṛṣṭo na mahiṣakṣuṇṇaḥ khurairvegavaśāddvijaḥ || 6.119.10 ||
tataḥ kṣatajadigdhāṃgaḥ sa dṛṣṭvā dānavaṃ puraḥ ||
atha dṛṣṭvā praṇāmena rahitaṃ kopamāviśat||11||
tataḥ provāca taṃ kruddhastoyamādāya pāṇinā ||
yasmātpāpa mama kṣuṇṇaṃ gātraṃ mahiṣajaiḥ khuraiḥ || 12 ||
samādheśca kṛto bhaṃgastasmāttvaṃ mahiṣo bhava ||
yāvajjīvasi durbuddhe samyagjñānasamanvitaḥ || 13 ||
athā'sau mahiṣo jātaḥ kṛṣṇagātradharo mahān ||
atidīrghaviṣāṇaśca aṃjanādririvāparaḥ || 14 ||
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa taṃ muniṃ vinayānvitaḥ ||
śāpātaṃ kuru me vipra bālyabhāvādajānataḥ || 15 ||
atha taṃ sa muniḥ prāha na me syādvacanaṃ vṛthā ||
tasmādyāvatsthitāḥ prāṇāstāvaditthaṃ bhaviṣyati || 16 ||
mahiṣasya svarūpeṇa ninditasya sudurmate ||
evaṃ sa taṃ parityajya gaṃgātīraṃ munīśvaraḥ ||
jagāmā'nyatra so'pyāśu gatvā śukramuvāca ha || 17 ||
ahaṃ durvāsasā śaptaḥ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare ||
mahiṣatvaṃ samānītastasmāttvaṃ me gatirbhava || 18 ||
yathā syātpūrvajaṃ dehaṃ tiryaktvaṃ naśyate yathā ||
prasādāttava vipreṃdra tathā nītirvidhīyatām || 19 ||
|| śukra uvāca || ||
tasya śāpo'nyathā kartuṃ naiva śakyaḥ kathaṃcana ||
kenāpi saṃparityajya devamekaṃ maheśvaram || 6.119.20 ||
tasmādārādhayā''śu tvaṃ gatvā liṃgamanuttamam ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sarvasiddhipradāyake || 21 ||
tatra sañjāyate siddhiḥ śīghraṃ dānavasattama ||
api pāpayuge prāpte kiṃ punaḥ prathame yuge| 22 ||
evamuktaḥ sa śukreṇa dānavaḥ satvaraṃ yayau ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ tapastepe tataḥ param || 23 ||
sthāpayitvā mahalligaṃ bhaktyā devasya śūlinaḥ ||
prāsādaṃ ca tataścakre kailāsaśikharopamam || 24 ||
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya tapaḥsthasya mahātmanaḥ ||
jagāma sumahānkālaḥ kṛcchre tapasi vartataḥ || 25 ||
tatastuṣṭo mahādevo gatvā taddṛṣṭigocaram ||
provāca parituṣṭo'smi varaṃ varaya dānava || 26 ||
|| mahiṣa uvāca || ||
ahaṃ durvāsasā śapto mahiṣatve niyojitaḥ ||
tiryaktvaṃ nāśamāyātu tasmānme tvatprasādataḥ || 27 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
nānyathā śakyate kartuṃ tasya vākyaṃ kathaṃcana ||
tasmāttava kariṣyāmi sukhopāyaṃ śṛṇuṣva tam || 28 ||
ye kecinmānavā bhogā daivikā ye tathā''surāḥ ||
te sarve tava gātre'tra samprayāsyaṃti saṃśrayam || 29 ||
bhogārthamiṣyate kāyaṃ yato martyaṃ surāsuraiḥ ||
samavāpsyasi tānsarvāṃstasmāttava kalevaram || 6.119.37 ||
|| mahiṣa uvāca || ||
yadyevaṃ devadeveśa bhogaprāptirbhavenmama ||
tasmādavadhyamevāstu gātrametanmama prabho || 31 ||
daśānāṃ devayonīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
tiryañcānāṃ ca nāgānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ surasattama || 32 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
nāvadhyo'sti dharāpṛṣṭhe kaściddehī ca dānava ||
tasmādekaṃ parityaktvā śeṣānprārthaya daityapa || 33 ||
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā provāca vṛṣabhadhvajam ||
striyamekāṃ parityaktvā nānyebhyastu vadho mama || 34 ||
tathātra māmake tīrthe yaḥ kaścicchraddhayā naraḥ ||
karoti snānamavyagrastvāṃ paśyati tataḥ param || 35 ||
tasya syāttvatprasādena saṃsiddhiḥ sārvakāmikī ||
sarvopadravanāśaśca tejovṛddhiśca śaṃkara || 36 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
mārgaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ tīrthe snātvā'tra tāvake ||
vilokayiṣyati prītyā mama liṃgaṃ tataḥ param || 37 ||
bhūtapretapiśācādi saṃbhavāstasya tatkṣaṇāt |
doṣā nāśaṃ prayāsyaṃti tathā rogā jvarādayaḥ || 38 ||
evamuktvā'tha deveśastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
mahiṣo'pi nijaṃ sthānaṃ prajagāma tataḥ param || 39 ||
sa gatvā dānavānsarvānsamāhūya tataḥ param ||
provācāmarṣasaṃyuktaḥ sabhāmadhye vyavasthitaḥ || 6.119.40 ||
pitā mama pitṛvyaśca ye cānye mama pūrvajāḥ ||
dānavā nihatā devairvāsudevapurogamaiḥ || 41 ||
tasmāttānnāśayiṣyāmi devānapi mahāhave ||
ahaṃ trailokyarājyaṃ hi grahīṣyāmi tataḥ param || 42 ||
atha te dānavāḥ procuryuktametadanuttamam ||
asmadīyamidaṃ rājyaṃ yacchakraḥ kurute divi || 43 ||
tasmādadyaiva gatvā''śu hatvendraṃ raṇamūrdhani ||
divyānbhogānprabhuñjānāḥ sthāsyāmaḥ sukhino divi || 44 ||
evaṃ te dānavāḥ sarve kṛtvā maṃtraviniścayam ||
meruśṛṃgaṃ tato jagmuḥ sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ||45||
atha śakrādayo devā dṛṣṭvā taddānavodbhavam||
akasmādeva saṃprāptaṃ balaṃ śastrāstrasaṃyutam||
yuddhārthaṃ svapuradvāri niryayustadanaṃtaram||46||
ādityā vasavo rudrā nāsatyau ca bhiṣagvarau|
viśvedevāstathā sādhyāḥ siddhā vidyādharāśca ye||47||
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ devānāṃ saha dānavaiḥ|
mithaḥ prabhartsyamānānāṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam||48||
evaṃ samabhavadyuddhaṃ yāvadvarṣatrayaṃ divi|
raktanadyotivipulāstatrātīva prasusruvuḥ|49||
anyasmindivase śakraṃ dṛṣṭaivārāvaṇasaṃsthitam|
taṃ śuklenātapatreṇa dhriyamāṇena mūrdhani|
devaiḥ parivṛtaṃ divyaśastrapāṇibhireva ca||6.119.50||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā mahiṣo dānavādhipaḥ|
mahāvegaṃ samāsādya tasyaivābhimukho yayau||51||

vivyādha hṛdaye so'tha cakre rāvaṃ sudāruṇam||52||
tataḥ parāṅmukho bhūtvā palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ|
abhidudrāva vegena purī yatrāmarāvatī||53||
aṃkuśotthaprahāraiśca kṣatakuṃbho'pi bhūriśaḥ|

athābravītsahasrākṣo mahiṣaṃ vīkṣya garvitam|

mā daitya pravijānīhi yannaṣṭastridaśādhipaḥ|

tasmāttiṣṭha muhūrtaṃ tvaṃ yāvadāsthāya sadratham|

sahasraidarśabhiryuktaṃ vājināṃ vātaraṃhasām||58||
te 'tha mātalinā aśvāḥ pratodena samāhatāḥ|
utpataṃta ivākāśe satvaṃ saṃpradudruvuḥ||59||
atha cāpaṃ samāropya satvaraṃ pākaśāsanaḥ|
śarairāśīviṣākāraiśchādayāmāsa dānavam||6.119.60||

tatastānsuhayāṃstasya śṛṃgābhyāṃ vegamāśritaḥ|
dārayāmāsa saṃkruddha āvidhyāvidhya cāsakṛt||62||
tataste vājinastrastāḥ saṃjagmuḥ kṣatavakṣasaḥ|
raktaplāvitasarvāṃgā mārgamairāvaṇasya ca||63||

sarve pradudruvurbhītāstasya mārgamupāśritāḥ||64||
tatastu dānavāḥ sarve bhagnāndṛṣṭvā raṇe surān|
śastravṛṣṭiṃ pramuṃcaṃto garjamānā yathā ghanāḥ||65||
etasminnaṃtare prāptā rajanī tamasāvṛtā|
na kiṃcittatra saṃyāti kasyaciddṛṣṭigocare||66||
tatastu dānavāḥ sarve yuddhānnirvṛtya sarvataḥ|
meruśṛṃgaṃ samāśritya ramyaṃ vāsaṃ pracakramuḥ||67||
vijayena samāyuktāstuṣṭiṃ ca paramāṃ gatāḥ|
kathāścakruśca yuddhotthā yuddhaṃ tasya yathā bhavat||68||
devāścāpi hatotsāhāḥ prahāraiḥ kṣatavikṣatāḥ|
maṃtraṃ cakrurmitho bhūtvā bṛhaspatipuraḥsarāḥ||69||
sāṃprataṃ dānavaiḥ sainyamasmākaṃ vimukhaṃ kṛtam ||
vidhvastaṃ sunirutsāhamakṣamaṃ yuddhakarmaṇi || 6.119.70 ||
tasmāttyaktvā pravekṣyāmaḥ purīṃ caivāmarāvatīm ||
brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ yatra na syāddānavajaṃ bhayam||71||
evaṃ te niścayaṃ kṛtvā brahmalokaṃ tato gatāḥ ||
śūnyāṃ śakrapurīṃ kṛtvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ||72||
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya dānavāste praharṣitāḥ ||
śūnyāṃ śakrapurīṃ dṛṣṭvā viviśustadanaṃtaram || 73 ||
atha śākre pade daityaṃ mahiṣaṃ saṃnidhāya ca ||
praṇemustuṣṭisaṃyuktāścakruścaiva mahotsavam || 74 ||
jagṛhuryajñabhāgāṃśca sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām ||
devasthāneṣu sarveṣu devatā'bhimatāśca ye || 76 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye devasenāparājayavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 119 || || cha ||

<6.120>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ śakrādayo devā jitāste tu raṇājire ||
mahiṣeṇa tato rājyaṃ trailokye'pi cakāra saḥ || 1 ||
yatkiñcittriṣu lokeṣu sārabhūtaṃ prapaśyati ||
gajavājirathāśvādi sarvaṃ gṛhṇāti so'suraḥ || 2 ||

vadhārthaṃ militāścakruḥ kathā duḥkhasama nvitāḥ || 3 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāpto nārado munisattamaḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ māhiṣaṃ sarvaṃ vyavahāraṃ mahotkaṭam || 4 ||
tataśca kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ teṣāṃ savista ram ||
tasya saṃceṣṭitaṃ bhūri lokatrayaprapīḍanam || 5 ||
atha teṣāṃ mahākopo bhūya evābhyavardhata ||
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā tādṛglokakathodbhavam || || 6 ||
teṣāṃ kopodbhavo gharmo vaktradvāreṇa niryayau ||
yena diṅmaṃḍalaṃ sarvaṃ tatkṣaṇātkaluṣīkṛtam || 7 ||

|| nārada uvāca || ||
