yasmājjātātra sā kanyā tasmātkātyāyanī smṛtā || 13 ||
tatastasyā dadau vajramāyudhaṃ tridaśādhipaḥ ||
śaktiṃ skandaḥ sutīkṣṇāgrāṃ cāpaṃ devo janārdanaḥ || 14 ||
triśūlaṃ ca mahādevaḥ pāśaṃ ca varuṇaḥ svayam ||
ādityaśca sitānbāṇāṃścaṃdramāścarma cottamam || 15 ||
nistriṃśaṃ nirṛtistuṣṭa ulmukaṃ ca hutāśanaḥ ||
vāyuśca cchurikāṃ tīkṣṇāṃ dhanadaḥ parighaṃ tathā || 16 ||
daṇḍaṃ pretādhipo raudraṃ vadhāya suravidviṣām ||
dvādaśaivaṃ samālokya sā''yudhāni dvijottamāḥ || 17 ||
kātyāyanī tataścakre bhujadvādaśakaṃ tadā ||
jagrāha ca drutaṃ tāni surāstrāṇi divaukasām || 18 ||
tataḥ provāca tānsarvānsaṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhā ||
yadarthaṃ vibudhaśreṣṭhāḥ sṛṣṭā tadbrūta mā ciram|| 19 ||
sarvaṃ kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
|| devā ūcuḥ || ||
mahiṣo dānavo raudraḥ samutpanno'tra sāṃpratam || 6.120.20 ||
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
muktvaikāṃ yoṣitaṃ tena tvamasmābhirvinirmitā || 21 ||
tasmāttvaṃ sāṃprataṃ gaccha viṃdhyākhyaṃ parvatottamam ||
tapastatra kuruṣvogra tejo yenābhivardhate || 22 ||
tatastu tejaḥsaṃyuktāṃ tvāṃ jñātvā vayameva hi ||
agre dhṛtvā kariṣyāmo yuddhaṃ tena durātmanā || 23 ||
tatastvacchastranirdagdhaḥ paṃcatvaṃ sa prayāsyati ||
vayaṃ ca tridaśaiśvaryaṃ labhiṣyāmo hatadviṣaḥ || 24 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kātyāyanyutpattivarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| ||120|| || cha ||

<6.121>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
devānāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā tataḥ sā parameśvarī ||
provāca vāhanaṃ kiṃciddevā yacchatu me drutam ||1||
tataḥ siṃhaṃ dadau gaurī yānārthaṃ vikṛtānanam ||
tamāruhya pratasthe sā tato viṃdhyaṃ nagaṃ prati || 2 ||
tasyaikaṃ śṛṃgamāsthāya ramyaṃ śreṣṭhadrumānvitam ||
phalapuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ latāmaṃḍapamaṃḍitam || 3 ||
tatastapo'karotsādhvī tīvravrataparāyaṇā ||
saṃyamyendriyavargaṃ svaṃ dhyāyamānā maheśvaram || 4 ||
yathāyathā tapovṛddhistasyāḥ sañjāyate dvijāḥ ||
tathā rūpaṃ ca kāṃtiśca śarīre prativardhate|| 5 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptāstatra daityeśakiṃkarāḥ ||
te tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vratopetāmatyadbhutavapurdha rām ||
gatvā procuḥ svanāthasya mahiṣasya durātmanaḥ || 6 ||
|| cārā ūcuḥ || ||
bhramamāṇairdharāpṛṣṭhe dṛṣṭā'pūrvā kumārikā ||
vindhyācale'dya cāsmābhirbhujairdvādaśabhiryutā ||
nānāśastradharairdīptaiścarmacchāditagātrakā ||7||
na devī na ca gandharvī nāsurī nāgakanyakā ||
tādṛgrūpā purā'smābhiḥ kāciddṛṣṭā nitambinī| || 8 ||
na vidmo yannimittaṃ sā tapaścakre yaśasvinī ||
svargakāmā'rthakāmā vā patikāmātha vā vibho|| 9 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mahiṣo dānavādhipaḥ ||
kāmadeva vaśaṃ prāptaḥ śravaṇādapi tatkṣaṇāt || 6.121.10 ||
tatastānagrataḥ kṛtvā sainyena mahatā nvitaḥ ||
jagāma kautukāviṣṭo yatrāste sā tu kanyakā || 11 ||
yathā mṛtyukṛte mandaḥ śṛgālaḥ siṃhavallabhām ||
vane suptāṃ suviśvastāṃ sarvathāpya kutobhayām||12||
tasyāḥ saṃdarśanādeva tataḥ kāmaśarairhataḥ||
sa dānavapradhānaśca tatkṣaṇādeva saddvijāḥ||13||
atha prāha priyaṃ vākyamekākī tatpuraḥsthitaḥ||
dhṛtvā dūrataresainyaṃ tasyā rūpeṇa mohitaḥ||14||
viruddhaṃ yauvanasyaitadvrataṃ te cāruhāsini|
tasmādetatparityaktvā trailokyasvāminī bhava || 15 ||
ahaṃ hi mahiṣo nāma dānavendro yadi śrutaḥ ||
mayā yena sahasrākṣo dvandvayuddhe vinirjitaḥ || 16 ||
trelokyaṃ sakalaṃ mahyaṃ sāṃprataṃ ca vaśe sthitam ||
tasmāttvaṃ bhava suśroṇi bhāryā mama suvallabhā ||17||
sahasraṃ mama bhāryāṇāmanyadasti suśobhanam||
tatsarvaṃ te'dya bhṛtyatvaṃ sāṃprataṃ praka riṣyati ||18||
ahaṃ cāpi tavātyaṃtaṃ dāsabhāvaṃ samāśritaḥ||
vartayiṣyāmi suśroṇi pradattvā'śeṣasaṃpadaḥ ||19||
||sūta uvāca ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tataḥ sā parameśvarī ||
provāca bhartsamānā taṃ kopasaṃraktalocanā||6.121.20||
dhigdhikpāpasamācāra kumāravratadhāriṇīm ||
kāmopahatacittātmā kiṃ māmitthaṃ prabhā ṣase ||21||
ahaṃ tava vadhārthāya nirmitā vibudhottamaiḥ ||
tasmāttvāṃ nāśayiṣyāmi smareṣṭaṃ yaddhṛdi sthitam||22||
|| mahiṣa uvāca || ||
yadyevaṃ tadvarārohe yuktā syācca kumārikā ||
prārthanīyā bhavedatra sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ yataḥ ||23||
svargārthaṃ kriyate dharmastapaśca varavarṇini ||
yena bhogāḥ prabhuñjaṃti ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ || 24 ||
tasmāddehi mamātmānaṃ gāṃdharveṇa suśobhane ||
vivāhena yato'nyeṣāṃ sa pradhānaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||25||
evaṃ pravadatastasya sā devī krodhamūrchitā ||
tadvaktrāṃtaṃ samuddiśya śaraṃ cikṣepa sa kṣaṇāt ||26||
viveśa vadanaṃ tasya valmīkaṃ pannago yathā ||
atha tairmārgagaṇairviddhaḥ sa vaktrāṃtānnadaṃstataḥ ||27||
susrāva rudhiraṃ bhūri gairikaṃ parvato yathā ||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā nivṛttyātha śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||28||
svasainyaṃ tvarito bheje kāmena ca vaśī kṛtaḥ||
provāca sainikānsarvānduṣṭā strīyaṃ pragṛhyatām ||
yathā na tyajati prāṇānprahārairjarjarīkṛtā||29||
eṣā mama na sandehaḥ priyā bhāryā bhaviṣyati||
yadi no śastrapātena paṃcatvamupayāsyati || 6.121.30 ||
evamuktāstadā tena dānavā yuddhadurmadāḥ ||
dudruvuḥ sammukhāstasyā muñcanto niśitāñcharān ||31||
etasminnaṃtare devī sā dṛṣṭvā tānupasthitān ||
yuddhāya kṛtasaṃkalpāṃstarjataśca muhurmuhuḥ| 32 ||
tatastu līlayā devī muktā tīkṣṇānmahāśarān ||
tānsarvāṃstāḍayāmāsa sarvamarmasu tatkṣaṇāt || 33 ||
atha tīkṣṇaiḥ śarairdaityā nihatā dānavāstathā ||
eke paṃcatvamāpannā gatāścānya itastataḥ||34||
tataḥ sainyaṃ samālokya tadbhagnaṃ ca tayā raṇe ||
kopāviṣṭastato daityaḥ svayaṃ tāṃ samupādravat || 35 ||
yacchañchṛṃgaprahārāṃśca tasyāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ||
garjitaṃ vidadhaccograṃ śāradābhrasamaṃ muhuḥ || 36 ||
etasminnaṃtare devī sāṭṭahāsakṛtasvanā ||
trailokyavivaraṃ sarvaṃ yacchabdena prapūritam | 37 ||
evaṃ tasyā hasaṃtyāśca vaktrāntādatha niryayuḥ||
puliṃdāḥ śabarā mlechāstathānye'raṇyavāsinaḥ||38||
śakāśca yavanāścaiva śataśaśtu vapurdharā?||
varma sthagitagātrāśca yamadūtā ivāpare||39||
te procurdevi no brūhi yena sṛṣṭā vayaṃ kṣitau||
kāryeṇa kriyate kṛtsnaṃ yena śīghraṃ varānane||6.121.40 ||
|| devyuvāca || ||
etānasya suduṣṭasya sainikānbalagarvitān ||
sūdayadhvaṃ drutaṃ vākyādasmadīyādyathecchayā || 41 ||
atha te tadvacaḥ śrutvā valgaṃto'sidhanurddharāḥ ||
daiteyabalamuddiśya dudruvurvegamāśritāḥ || 42 ||
tatasteṣāṃ mahadyuddhaṃ mitho jajñe sudāruṇam |
nātmīyaṃ na paraṃ tatra kenacijjñā yate kvacit || 43 ||
atha te dānavāḥ sarve yodhairdevīsamudbhavaiḥ ||
bhagnā vyāpāditāścānye prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ || 44 ||
tato bhagnaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahiṣaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ||
tāmuvāca krudhā devīṃ vacanaiḥ paruṣākṣaraiḥ || 45 ||
āḥ pāpe strīti matvādya na hatāsi mayā yudhi ||
tasmātpaśya prahāraṃ me tattvaṃ budhyasi nānyathā || 46 ||
evamuktvā viśeṣeṇa prahārānsa vicikṣipe ||
viṣāṇābhyāṃ mahāvego bhartsayāno muhurmuhuḥ || 47 ||
tato'bhyāśagataṃ dṛṣṭvā sā devī dānavaṃ ca tam ||
ārurohātha vegena pṛṣṭhideśena kopataḥ || 48 ||
tataścukrośa daityo'sau vyomamārgaṃ samāśritaḥ ||
pṛṣṭhyāstalena nirbhinno rudhiraughapariplutaḥ || 49 ||
etasminnaṃtare siṃhaḥ sa tasyā jyotisaṃbhavaḥ ||
jagrāha paścime bhāge daṃṣṭrāgrairniśitaiḥ krudhā || 6.121.50 ||
tato niścalatāṃ prāptaḥ pādākrāṃtaśca dānavaḥ||
akarodbhairavānnādānna śaktaścalituṃ padam || 51 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ||
vyomasthāstāṃ tadā procurdevīṃ harṣasamanvitāḥ || 52 ||
etasya śirasaśchedaṃ śīghraṃ kuru sureśvari ||
khaṅgenānena tīkṣṇena yāvanno yāti cānyataḥ || 53 ||
sā śrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ devī kopasamanvitā ||
khaḍgaṃ vyāpārayāmāsa kaṃṭhe tasyātipīvare || 54 ||
sa tena khaḍgaghātena kaṃṭhaḥ pīno'pi niṣṭhuraḥ||
dvidhā jajñe'tha daityasya dadhattuṣṭiṃ divaukasām || 55 ||
dvādaśārkapratīkāśo vaktrāṃtaścarmakhaḍgadhṛk ||
bhartsayaṃstāṃ mahādevīṃ khaḍgodyatakarāṃ tadā ||
khaḍgaṃ vyāpārayangātre tasyā bālārkasannibham || 56 ||
tataḥ keśeṣu cādhāya yāvattasyāpi cikṣipe |
prahāraṃ gātranāśāya tāvadūce sa dānavaḥ || 57 ||
|| dānava uvāca || ||
jaya devi jayāciṃtye jaya sarvasureśvari ||
jaya sarvagate devi jaya sarvajanapriye || 58 ||
jaya kāmaprade nityaṃ jaya trailokyasundari ||
jaya trailokya rakṣārthamudyate hyakutobhaye || 59 ||
jaya devi kṛtānaṃde jaya daityavināśini ||
jaya kleśacchide kāṃte jayābhaktavimohade || 6.121.60 ||
tvaṃ sṛṣṭistvaṃ varā devī tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ sarasvatī |
tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā ||61||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me prāṇānrakṣa dayāṃ kuru||
praṇatasya sudīnasya hīnasya ca viśeṣataḥ||62||
ahaṃ durvāsasā śapto hiraṇyākṣasuto balī||
mahiṣatvaṃ samānītastvayā devī vimokṣitaḥ||63||
tasmāddarpaḥ pramukto'dya mayā dānavasaṃbhavaḥ||
kiṃkaratvaṃ prayāsyāmi sāṃprataṃ te sureśvari||64||
jaya sarvagate devi sarvaduṣṭavināśini||65||
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṛpaṇaṃ sā sureśvarī ||
kṛpāviṣṭā'bravīdvākyaṃ tato vyomasthitānsurān||66||
kiṃ karomi dayā jātā mamainaṃ prati he surāḥ ||
tasmānnāhaṃ haniṣyāmi dānavaṃ dīnajalpakam || 67 ||
vimukhaṃ khaḍgaśastraṃ ca tavāsmīti pravādinam ||
api me pitṛhaṃtāraṃ na hanyāṃ ripumāhave || 68 ||
|| devā ūcuḥ || |
na cedasi ca deveśi tvamenaṃ dānavādhamam ||
nāśayiṣyati tatkṛtsnaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 69 ||
eṣa vyarthaḥśramaḥ sarvastathāsmākaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
tava saṃbhūtisaṃbhūtastava kleśastathā'khilaḥ || 6.121.70 ||
|| devyuvāca || ||
nāhamenaṃ haniṣyāmi tyajiṣyāmi tathā'marāḥ ||
enaṃ kacagrahaṃ kṛtvā dhārayiṣyāmi sarvadā || 71 ||
|| devā ūcuḥ || ||
sādhusādhu mahābhāge yuktamuktaṃ tvayā vacaḥ ||
etaddhi yujyate kartuṃ kāle'smiṃstridaśeśvari || 72 ||
sāṃprataṃ martyaloke tvaṃ rūpametatsamāśritā ||
śastrodyatakarā raudrā mahiṣopari saṃsthitā || 73 ||
avāpsyasi parāṃ pūjāṃ durlabhā mamarairapi ||
yastvāmetena rūpeṇa saṃsthitāṃ pūjayiṣyati || 74 ||
tvamasya saṃgato bhāvi vikhyātā viṃdhyavāsinī ||
kiṃ te vā bahunoktena śṛṇu saṃkṣepato vacaḥ || 75 ||
asmadīyaṃ paraṃ tathyaṃ sarvalokahitāvaham ||
pārthivānāṃ tvadāyattaṃ balaṃ devi bhaviṣyati || 76 ||
yuddhakāle samutpanne bhaktānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
prasthānaṃ vā praveśaṃ ca yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ || 77 ||
tvāṃ smṛtvā praṇipatyātha pūjayitvā viśeṣataḥ ||
tasya saṃpatsyate siddhiḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā ||
iha kāpuruṣasyāpi kiṃ punaḥ subhaṭasya ca || 78 ||
āśvinasya site pakṣe navamyāṃ cāṣṭamīdine ||
pūjayiṣyati yo marttyastvāṃ sadbhaktisamanvitaḥ || 79 ||
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvatsamagraṃ surasundari ||
na bhaviṣyati vai rogo na bhayaṃ na parābhavaḥ ||
nāpamṛtyurna caurādi samudbhūta upadravaḥ || 6.121.80 ||
| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvātha te devāstāṃ devīṃ harṣasaṃyutāḥ ||
anujñātāstayā jagmuḥ svāṃ purīmamarāvatīm || || 91 ||
tatra gatvā cirātprāpya svaṃ rājyaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ ||
pālayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭastrailokyaṃ hatakaṭakam || 82 ||
lokāśca sukhasaṃpannāḥ sarve jātā stataḥ param||
yajñabhāgabhujo devā bhūyo jātā jagattraye || 83 ||
tataḥ paraṃ ca sā devī trailokye khyātimāgatā ||
sarvakṣetreṣu tīrtheṣu sthāneṣu ca viśeṣataḥ || 84 ||
etasminnaṃtare jātaḥ surathonāma bhūpatiḥ ||
ānartastena sadbhaktyā kṣetre'traiva vinirmitā || 85 ||
yastāṃ paśyati sadbhaktyā caitrāṣṭamyāṃ site'hani ||
sa pumānvatsaraṃ yāvatkṛtārthaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ || 86 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mahiṣāsuraparājaya kātyāyanīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ekaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 121 || || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭosmi dvijottamāḥ ||
yathā sa nihato devyā mahiṣākhyo danūttamaḥ || 1 ||
sāṃprataṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm ||
kedārasaṃbhavāṃ puṇyāṃ tāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ || 2 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || |
kedāraḥ śrūyate sūta gaṃgādvāre himācale ||
sa kathaṃ ceha saṃprāptaḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 3 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etatsatyaṃ girau tasminsvayaṃbhūḥ saṃsthitaḥ prabhuḥ ||
paraṃ tatra vaseddevo yāvanmāsāṣṭakaṃ dvijāḥ || 4 |
yāvadgharmaśca varṣā ca tāvattatra vasetprabhuḥ ||
śītakāle punaścātra kṣetre saṃtiṣṭhate sadā || || 5 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kiṃ tatkāryaṃ vasedyena kṣetre māsacatuṣṭayam ||
himācale yathaivāṣṭau sūtaputra vadasva naḥ || 6 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuvasyādau manordaityo mahābalaḥ ||
hiraṇyākṣo mahātejāstapovīryasamanvitaḥ || 7 ||
tairvyāptaṃ jagadetaddhi nirasya tridaśādhipam ||
yajña bhāgāścadevānāṃ hṛtā vīryaprabhāvataḥ || 8 ||
atha śakraḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ gaṃgādvāraṃ samāśritaḥ ||
tapastepe suduḥkhārto rājyaśrīparivarjitaḥ || 9 ||
tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya tapastīvraṃ mahātmanaḥ ||
māhiṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya niścakrāma dharātalāt || 6.122.10 ||
svayameva mahādevastataḥ śakramuvāca ha ||
kedārayāmi me śīghraṃ brūhi sarvaṃ surottama ||
daityānāmatha sarveṣāṃ rūpeṇānena vāsava || 11 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
hiraṇyākṣo mahādaityaḥ subāhurvakra kandharaḥ ||
triśṛṃgo lohitākṣaśca paṃcaitāndāraya prabho ||
hatairetairhataṃ sarvaṃ dānavānāmasaṃśayam || 12 ||
kimanyaiḥ kṛpaṇairdhvastairyaiḥ kiṃcinnātra sidhyati ||
tasya tadvacanaśrutvā bhagavāṃstūrṇamabhyagāt ||
yatra dānavamukhyo'sau hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaḥ || 13 ||
atha taṃ dūrato dṛṣṭvā mahiṣaṃ parvatopamam ||
āyātaṃ raudrarūpeṇa dānavāḥ sarvataśca te || 14 ||
tato jaghnuśca pāṣāṇairlaguḍaiśca tathāpare ||
kṣveḍitāsphoṭitāṃścakrustathānye balagarvitāḥ || || 15 ||
athavamanya tāndevaḥ prahāraṃ līlayā dadau ||
yatrāste dānavendro'sau caturbhiḥ sacivaiḥ saha || 16 ||
tataḥ śastraṃ samudyamya yāvaddhāvati sammukhaḥ ||
tāvacchṛṃgaprahāreṇa sonayadyamasādanam || 17 ||
hatvā taṃ sacivānpaścātsubāhupramukhāṃśca tān ||
jaghāna hanyamāno'pi samantāddānavaiḥ paraiḥ || 18 ||
na tasya lagate kvāpi śastraṃ gātre kathaṃcana ||
yatnato'pi visṛṣṭaṃ ca labdhalakṣaiḥ prahāribhiḥ || 19 ||
evaṃ paṃca pradhānāstānhatvā daityānmaheśvaraḥ ||
bhūyo jagāma taṃ deśaṃ yatra śakro vyavasthitaḥ ||
abravīcca prahaṣṭātmā tataḥ śakraṃ taponvitam || 6.122.20 ||
mayā te nihatāḥ paṃca dānavā ye tvayeritāḥ ||

matto'nyadapi deveśa varaṃ prārthaya vāṃchitam ||
kailāsaśikharaṃ yena gacchāmi tvarayā'nvitaḥ || 22 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
anenaiva hi rūpeṇa tiṣṭha tvaṃ cātra śaṃkara ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
etadrūpaṃ mayā śakra kṛtaṃ tasya vadhāya vai ||

śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ bhagavāṃstripurātakaḥ || 27 ||

|| indra uvāca || ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

|| śakra uvāca || ||

varaṃ vā yacchasi prītastatkuruṣva vaco mama || 46 ||
parvato'yaṃ bhavedgamyo māsānaṣṭau sureśvara||
yāvanmīnasthito bhānuḥ pragacchati śrutaṃ mayā || 47 ||
tataḥ paramagamyaśca himapūreṇa saṃvṛtaḥ ||
yadā syāccaturo māsānyāvatkumbhagato raviḥ || 48 ||
saṃjāyate'pyagamyaśca mamāpi tripurāṃtaka ||
kiṃ punaḥ svalpasattvānāṃ narādīnāṃ sureśvara || 49 ||
tasmātsvarge'tha pātāle martye vā tridaśeśvara ||
kuruṣvānenarūpeṇa sthitiṃ māsacatuṣṭayam ||
yena na syātpratijñāyā hānirmama sureśvara || 6.122.50 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tato devaściraṃ dhyātvā provāca balasūdanam ||
paraṃ saṃtoṣamāpanno meghanirghoṣaniḥsvanam || || 51 ||
ānartaviṣaye kṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam||
asmadīyaṃ sahasrākṣa vidyate dharaṇītale || 52 ||
tatrāhaṃ vṛścikasthe'rke sadā sthāsyāmi vāsava||
yāvatkumbhasya paryaṃtaṃ tava vākyādasaṃśayam|| 53 ||
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gatvā kṛtvā prāsādamuttamam ||
mama rūpaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kurupūjā yathocitām ||
yena tatra nijaṃ tejo dhārayāmi tavārthataḥ || 54 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etacchrutvā sahasrākṣo devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||
gatvā tatra tataścakre yaddeveneritaṃ vacaḥ || 55 ||
prāsādaṃ nirmayitvātha rūpaṃ saṃsthāpya śūlinaḥ ||
kuṇḍaṃ cakre ca tadrūpaṃ svacchodakasamāvṛtam||56||
tataścārādhayāmāsa puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ||
snātvā kuṇḍe'pibattoyaṃ triḥkṛtvā ca yathāpurā || 57 ||
evaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra śakreṇārādhitaḥ purā ||
samāyāto'tra vipreṃdrāḥ suramyāttu himācalāt || 58 ||
yastamārādhayetsamyaksadā māsacatuṣṭayam ||
himapātodbhave martyaḥ sa śivāya prapadyate || 59 ||
śeṣakāle'pi yaḥ pūjāṃ karotyeva subhaktitaḥ ||
sa pāpaṃ kṣālayetprājña ājanmamaraṇāṃtikam || 6.122.60 ||
tatra gītaṃ praśaṃsaṃti nṛtyaṃ caiva pṛthagvidham ||
devasya purataḥ prājñāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ || 61 ||
atra ślokaḥ purā gīto nāradena surarṣiṇā ||
tadvo'haṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ || 62 ||
kedāre salilaṃ pītvā gayāpiḍaṃ pradāya ca ||
brahmajñānamathāsādya punarjanma na vidyate || 63 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ kedārasya ca saṃbhavam ||
ākhyānaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam || 64 ||
yaścaitatchṛṇuyātsamyakpaṭhedvā tasya cāgrataḥ ||
śrāvayedvāpi vā viprāḥ sarvapātakanānam ||
kedārasya sa pāpaughairmucyate tatkṣaṇānnaraḥ || 65 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kedārotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmadvāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 122 || || cha ||

<6.123>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyadapi tatrāsti śuklatīrthamanuttamam||
darbhaiḥ saṃsūcitaṃ śvetairyadadyāpi dvijottamāḥ || 1 ||
camatkārapure pūrvamāsītkaścitsuśalyavit ||
rajakaḥ śuddhakonāma putrapautrasamanvitaḥ || || 2||
sa sarvarajakānāṃ ca prādhānyena vyavasthitaḥ ||
pradhānabrāhmaṇānāṃ ca karotyaṃbaraśodhanam || 3 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya nīlīkuṇḍyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
prākṣipadbrāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ vāso vijñātavāṃścirāt || 4 ||
athāsau mandacittaśca svāmāhūyakuṭumbinīm ||
putrāṃśca vacanaṃ prāha rahasye bhayavihvalaḥ || 5 ||
nirmūlyāni suvastrāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ||
nīlīmadhye vimohena prakṣiptāni bahūni ca || 6 ||
vadhabandhādikaṃ karma te kariṣyaṃtyasaṃśayam ||
tasmādanyatra gacchāmo gṛhītvā rajanīmimām || 7 ||
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā sāramādāya maṃdirāt ||
prasthito bhāryayā sārddhaṃ kāṃdiśīko dvijottamāḥ || 8 ||
tāvattasya sutā gatvā svāṃ sakhīṃ dāśasaṃbhavām ||
uvāca kṣamyatāṃ bhadre yanmayā kukṛtaṃ kṛtam|| 9 ||
ajñānājjñānato vāpi prakrīḍaṃtyā tvayā saha ||
praṇayādbālyabhāvācca krodhādvātha maherṣyayā || 6.123.10 ||
atha sā sahasā śrutvā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā ||
uvāca kimidaṃ bhadre yanmāmitthaṃ prabhāṣase || 11 ||
|| sakhyuvāca || ||
mama tātena nīlāyāṃ prakṣiptānyaṃbarāṇi ca ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ mahārhāṇi vibhrameṇa sulocane || 12 ||
tatprabhāte parijñāya daṃḍaṃ dhāsyaṃti dāruṇam ||
evaṃ citte samāsthāya tātaḥ saṃprasthito'dhunā || 13 ||
ahaṃ tavātikaṃ prāptā darśanārthamanindite ||
anujñātā prayāsyāmi tvayā tasmātpramucyatām || 14 ||
atha sā tadvacaḥ śrutvā prasannavadanā'bravīt ||
yadyevaṃ mā sarojākṣi kutracitsaṃprayāsyasi || 15 ||
nivāraya drutaṃ gatvā tātaṃ no gamyatāmiti ||
asti pūrvottare bhāge sthānādasmājjalāśayaḥ || 16 ||
tatraikadā vinikṣiptaṃ mama tātena jālakam ||
atīvakṛṣṇakeśotthaṃ tāvacchuklatvamāgatam||17||
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭaḥ svayaṃ sasnau kutūhalāt |
yāvacchuklatvamāpannastādṛkkṛṣṇavapurdharaḥ || 19 ||
suśvetamūrdhajaḥ sadyaḥ strīṇāṃ vairāgyakārakaḥ ||
tataḥprabhṛti no jñātvā kaścittatra pragacchati || 19 ||
tasmāttatraiva vastrāṇi prakṣālayatu satvaram ||
tātaḥ sa tava yāsyaṃti viśuddhiṃ paramāṃ śubhe || 6.123.20 ||
atha sā satvaraṃ gatvā nijatātasya tadvacaḥ ||
satvaraṃ kathayāmāsa prahṛṣṭavadanā satī || 21
mama sakhyā samādiṣṭaṃ nātidūre jalāśayaḥ ||
tatra śvetatvamāyāti sarvaṃ kṣiptaṃ sitetaram ||22||
tasmātprakṣālaya prātastatra gatvā jalāśaye ||
vastrāṇyamūni śuklatvaṃ saṃprayāsyaṃtyasaṃśayam|| 23||
|| rajaka uvāca ||
naitatsaṃpatsyate putri yannīlasya parikṣayaḥ ||
vastralagnasya jāyeta yataḥ proktaṃ purātanaiḥ ||24||
vajralepasya mūrkhasya nārīṇāṃ karkaṭasya ca ||
eko grahastu mīnānāṃ nīlīmadyapayostathā ||25||
|| kanyovāca || ||
tatra hyāgamyatāṃ tāvadvastraṇayādāya yatnataḥ ||
toyācchuddhiṃ prayāsyaṃti tadā''gaṃtavyameva hi || ||26||
bhūyo'pi maṃdire vā'tha tasmātsthānāddigaṃtaram ||
gaṃtavyaṃ sakalaireva mamaitaddhṛdi saṃsthitam||27||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sādhusādhviti te'sakṛt ||
procya bāṃdhavabhṛtyāśca rātrāveva prajagmire ||28||
dāśakanyāṃ puraḥ kṛtvā saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ||
vibhavena samāyuktā nijena dvijasattamāḥ ||29||
tataḥ sā darśayāmāsa dāśakanyā jalāśayam ||
bahuvīrudhasaṃchannaṃ duṣpraveśaṃ ca dehinām || 6.123.30 ||
tataḥ sa rajakastatra vastrāṇyādāya sarvaśaḥ ||
praviṣṭaḥ salile tasminkṣālayāmāsa vai dvijāḥ || 31 ||
atha tāni suvastrāṇi mecakābhāni tatkṣaṇāt ||
jātāni sphaṭikābhāni tatkṣaṇādeva kṛtsnaśaḥ || || 32 ||
tatastuṣṭisamāyuktaḥ sādhusādhviti cā'bravīt ||
samāliṃgya sutāṃ prāha dāśakanyāṃ ca sādaram || 33 ||
suvastrāṇi dvijeṃdrāṇāmarpayāmo yathākramam || 34 ||
tataḥ sa svagṛhaṃ gatvā tāni vastrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
yathākrameṇa saṃhṛṣṭaḥ pradadau dvijasattamāḥ || 35 ||
atha te brāhmaṇā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ śuddhiṃ vastrasaṃbhavām ||
taṃ ca śvetīkṛtaṃ cedṛgrajakaṃ vismayānvitāḥ || 36 ||
papracchuḥ kimidaṃ citraṃ vastramūrdhajasaṃbhavam ||
anaupamyaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ vadasva yadi manyase || 37 ||
|| rajaka uvāca || ||
etāni viprā vastrāṇi mayā kṣiptāni mohataḥ ||
nīlīmadhye suvastrāṇi vinaṣṭāni ca kṛtsnaśaḥ || || 38 ||
tato bhayaṃ mahadbhūtaṃ kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ ||
calito rajanīvaktre digaṃte brāhmaṇottamāḥ || 39 ||
athaiṣā tanayā'smākaṃ gatā nijasakhīṃ prati ||
dāśātmajāṃ suduḥkhārtā punardarśanalālasā || 6.123.40 ||
tayā sarvamabhiprāyaṃ jñātvā me duḥkhahetukam ||
tataḥ saṃdarśayāmāsa sthitāgre svajalāśayam || 41 ||
tasminprakṣiptamātrāṇi vastrāṇīmāni tatkṣaṇāt ||
īdṛgvarṇāni jātāni vismayasya hi kāraṇam || 42 ||
tathā me mūrdhajāḥ kṛṣṇāstatra snātasya tatkṣaṇāt ||
paraṃ śuklatvamāpannā etatproktaṃ mayā sphuṭam || 43 ||
evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ śrutvā kautūhalasamanvitāḥ ||
tatra jagmuḥ parīkṣārthaṃ vikṣipya tadanaṃtaram || 44 ||
kṛṣṇadravyāṇi bhūrīṇi keśādīni sahasraśaḥ ||
sarvaṃ tacchuklatāṃ yāti tyaktvā varṇaṃ malīmasam || 45 ||
tato vṛddhatayā ye ca viśeṣācchvetamūrdhajāḥ ||
te sasnuḥ śraddhayā yuktāstaruṇāścāpi dharmiṇaḥ || 46 ||
tataḥ śuklatvamāpannāstejovīryasamanvitāḥ ||
bhavaṃti tatprabhāvena prayāṃti ca parāṃ gatim | 47 ||
atha tadvāsavo dṛṣṭvā śuklatīrthaṃ pramuktidam ||
pūrayāmāsa rajasā mānuṣotthabhayena ca || 48 ||
adyāpi tatra yatkiṃcijjāyate'tha tṛṇādikam ||
tatsarvaṃ śuklatāmeti tattoyasya prabhāvataḥ || 49 ||
tatrotthairyaḥ kuśaiḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute śraddhayānvitaḥ |3
śvaitaistaistārayetsarvānpitṝnnarakagānapi | 6.123.50 ||
tattīrthotthāṃ mṛdaṃ gātre yojayitvā narottamaḥ ||
snānaṃ karoti tīrthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ labhate phalam || 51 ||
yastairdarbhairnaro bhaktyā tilaiścāraṇyasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
karoti tarpaṇaṃ viprāḥ sa prīṇāti pitāmahān || 52 ||
athāśvamedhātsaṃprāpyaṃ gayāśrāddhena yatphalam ||
nīlasaṃjñagavotsarge tathātrāpi dvijottamāḥ || 53 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || |
śuklatīrthaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ tatra tvaṃ sūtanaṃdana ||
vistareṇa samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 54 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
śvetadvīpaḥ samānīto viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ||
tatkṣetre kalibhītena yathā śauklyaṃ na saṃtyajet || 55 ||
kalikālena saṃspṛṣṭaḥ śvetadvīpo'pi śyāmatām ||
na prayāti dvijaśreṣṭhāstatastatra niveśitaḥ || 56 ||
itiśrīskāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śuklatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatyuttara śatatamodhyāyaḥ || 123 || || cha ||

<6.124>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
athānyadapi tatrāsti mukhāraṃ tīrthamuttamam ||
yatra te munayaḥ śreṣṭhā viprāścaureṇa saṃgatāḥ||1||
yatra siddhiṃ samāpannaḥ sa caurastatprabhāvataḥ|
vālmīkiriti vikhyāto rāmāyaṇanibaṃdhakṛt||2||
camatkārapure pūrvaṃ māṃḍavyānvaya saṃbhavaḥ ||
lohajaṃgho dvijo hyāsītpitṛmātṛparāyaṇaḥ ||3||
tasyaikā cābhavatpatnī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī||
pativratā patiprāṇā patipriyahite ratā ||4||
atha tasya sthitasyātra brahmavṛttyābhivartataḥ ||
jagāma sumahānkālaḥ pitṛmātṛratasya ca ||5||
ekadā bhagavāñchakro na vavarṣa dharātale ||
ānartaviṣaye kṛtsne yāvadvādaśavatsarāḥ || 6 ||
tataḥ sa kaṣṭamāpanno lohajaṃgho dvijottamāḥ ||
na prāpnoti kvacidbhikṣāṃ na ca kiṃcitpratigraham || 7 ||
tatastau pitarau dvau tu dṛṣṭvā kṣutparipīḍitau ||
bhāryāṃ ca ciṃtayāmāsa duḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ || 8 ||
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ syāddarśanaṃ mama ||
etābhyāmapi vṛddhābhyāṃ patnyāścaiva viśeṣataḥ || 9 ||
tataḥ sa duḥkhasaṃyuktaḥ phalārthaṃ prayayau vane ||
na ca kiṃcidavāpnoti sarve śuṣkā mahīruhāḥ || 6.124.10 ||
athāpaśyatsa vṛddhāṃ strīṃ stokasasyasamanvitām ||
gacchamānāṃ tathā tena śrameṇa mahatānvitām ||11||
tatastatsasyamādāya vastrāṇi ca sa nirdayaḥ||
jagāma svagṛhaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ ca nyavedayat||12||
sa evaṃ labdhalakṣo'pi dasyukarmaṇi nityaśaḥ|
kṛtvā cauryaṃ pupoṣātha nijameva kuṭumbakam||13|
subhikṣe cāpi saṃprāpte nānyatkarma karoti saḥ|
brāhmīṃ vṛttiṃ parityaktvā cauryakarma samācarat||14||
kasyacittvatha kālasya tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ|
tatra saptarṣayaḥ prāptā marīcipramukhā dvijāḥ||15||
tatastānvijane dṛṣṭvā drohakopasamanvitaḥ|
yaṣṭimudyamya vegena tiṣṭhadhvamiti cābravīt||16||
triśikhāṃ bhṛkuṭīṃ kṛtvā satvaraṃ samupādravat|
bhartsamānaḥ sa paruṣairvākyaistāṃstāḍayanniva||17||
tataste munayo dṛṣṭvā yamadūtopamaṃ ca tam|
yajñopavītasaṃyuktaṃ procuste kṛpayānvitāḥ||18||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
aho tvaṃ brāhmaṇo'sīti tatkasmādatigarhitam|
karoṣi karma caitaddhi mlecchakṛtyaṃ tu bāliśa||19||
vayaṃ ca munayaḥ śāṃtāstyaktā'śeṣaparigrahāḥ|
nāsmākamapi pārśvasthaṃ kiṃcidgṛhṇāti yadbhavanān|6.124.20||
lohajaṃgha uvāca|
etāni śubhracīrāṇi valkalānyajināni ca|
upānahasametāni śīghraṃ yacchaṃtu me dvijāḥ||21||
no ceddhatvāprahāreṇa yaṣṭyā vajropamena ca ||
prāpayiṣyasyasaṃdigdhaṃ dharmarājaniveśanam || 22 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ||
sarvaṃ dāsyāmahe tubhyaṃ vayaṃ tāvanmalimluca ||
kiṃvadantīṃ vadāsmākaṃ yāṃ pṛcchāmaḥ kutūhalāt || 23 ||
kimarthaṃ kuruṣe cauryaṃ tvaṃ vipro'si sunirghṛṇaḥ ||
kiṃ jito vyasanai raudraiḥ kiṃ vā vyādhadvijo bhavān ||24||
|| lohajaṃgha uvāca || ||
vyasanārthaṃ na me kṛtyametaccauryasamudbhavam ||
kuṭumbārthaṃ vijānītha dharmametanna saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
pitarau mama vārddhakye vartamānau vyavasthitau ||
tathā pativratā patnī gṛhadharmavicakṣaṇā || 26 ||
upārjjayāmi yatkiñcidahametena karmaṇā ||
tatsarvaṃ tatkṛte nūnaṃ satyenātmānamālabhe ||27||
tasmānmuṃcatha prāksarvaṃ vibhavaṃ kiṃ vṛthoktibhiḥ ||
kṛtābhiḥ sphurate hasto mamāyaṃ hantumeva hi ||28|| ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadyevaṃ caura tadgatvā tvaṃ pṛcchasva kuṭumbakam ||
mamapāpāṃśabhāgī tvaṃ kiṃ bhaviṣyasi kiṃ na vā||29||
yadi te saṃvibhāgena pāpasyāṃśo'pi gacchati ||
tatkuruṣvāthavā pāpa durvahaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 6.124.30 ||
sakalaṃ raurave raudre patitasya sudurmate ||
vayaṃ tvā brāhmaṇaṃ matvā brūma etadasaṃśayam ||31||
kṛpāviṣṭāḥ sahāsmābhiḥ sañjāte'pi sudarśane ||

bhoktāro vipramucyaṃte kartā doṣeṇa lipyate || 33 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sa teṣāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā cauraḥ kiṃcidbhayānvitaḥ ||
satyametanna saṃdeho yadetairvyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 34 ||
tasmātpṛcchāmi tadgatvā nijameva kuṭumbakam ||
yadi syātsaṃvibhāgo me pāpāṃśasya karomi vai || 39 ||
etatkarma na gṛhṇaṃti yadi vā saṃtyajāmyaham ||
mahadbhayaṃ samutpannaṃ mama cetasi sāṃpratam ||36||
yadi yūyaṃ na cānyatra prayāsyatha munīśvarāḥ ||
palāyanaparā bhūtvā tadgatvā nijamaṃdiram ||37||
pṛcchāmi poṣyavargaṃ ca yuṣmadvākyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
yadi tatpātakāṃśaṃ me grahīṣyati kuṭumbakam ||
tadyuṣmākaṃ grahīṣyāmi yatkiṃcitpārśvasaṃsthitam || 38 ||
athavā pratiṣedhaṃ me pāpasyāsya kariṣyati ||
tattyajiṣyāmyasaṃdigdhaṃ sarvānvaḥ saparicchadān || 39 ||
tataste śapathānkṛtvā tasya pratyayakāraṇāt ||
tasyopari dayāṃ kṛtvā mumucustaṃ gṛhaṃ prati || 6.124.40 ||
so'pi gatvā'tha papraccha pragatvā pitaraṃ nijam ||
śṛṇu tāta vaco'smākaṃ tataḥ pratyuttaraṃ kuru || 41 ||
yatkṛtvāhamakṛtyāni cauryādīni sahasraśaḥ ||
puṣṭiṃ karomi te nityas tadbhāgaste'sti vā na vā || 42 ||
pāpasya mama prabrūhi pṛcchato'tra yathātatham ||
atra me saṃśayo jātastasmācchīghraṃ prakīrtaya || 43 ||
|| pitovāca ||
bālye putra mayā nītastvaṃ puṣṭiṃ vyākulātmanā ||
śubhā'śubhāni kṛtyāni kṛtvā snigdhena cetasā || 44 ||
etadarthaṃ punaryena vārdhakye samupasthite ||
gāṃ pālayasi bhūyo'pi kṛtvā karma śubhā'śubham || 45 ||
na tasya vidyate bhāgastava svalpo'pi putraka ||
śubhasya vā'tha pāpasya sāṃprataṃ ca tathā mama || 46 ||
ātmanaiva kṛtaṃ karma svayamevopabhujyate ||
śubhaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ bhoktāronyajanāḥ smṛtāḥ || 47 ||
sādhutvenātha cauryeṇa kṛṣyā vā vāṇijena vā ||
tvamupānayase bhojyaṃ na me cintā prajāyate || 48 ||
tasmānnaitaddhṛdi sthāpyaṃ karmaniṃdyaṃ kariṣyasi ||
yattasyāṃśaṃ prabhoktā tvaṃ vayaṃ sarve prabhuṃjakāḥ|| 49 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sa etadvacanaṃ śrutvā vyākulenānttarātmanā ||
papraccha mātaraṃ gatvā tamevārthaṃ prayatnataḥ ||6.124.50||
tatastayāpi taccoktaṃ yatpitrā tasya jalpitam ||
asāmānyaṃ śubhe pāpe kṛtye tasya dvijottamāḥ ||51||
tataḥ papraccha tāṃ bhāryāṃ gatvā duḥkhasamanvitaḥ ||
sā'pyuvāca tatastādṛkpāpaṃ gurujanodbhavam || 52 ||
tataḥ sa śokasaṃtaptaḥ paścāttāpena saṃyutaḥ ||
garhayanneva cātmānaṃ yayau te yatra tāpasāḥ ||53||
tataḥ praṇamya tānsarvānkṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ|
gamyatāṃ gamyatāṃ viprāḥ kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāṃ mama || 54 ||
yanmayā maurkhyamāsthāya yuṣmannirbhartsanā kṛtā ||
supāpmanā vimūḍhena tasmātkāryā kṣamādya me || 55 ||
yuṣmadīyaṃ vacaḥ kṛtsnaṃ madgurubhyāṃ prajalpitam ||
bhāryayā ca dvijaśreṣṭhāstena me duḥkhamāgatam||56||
tasmātkurvaṃtu me sarve prasādaṃ munisattamāḥ ||
upadeśapradānena yena pāpaṃ kṣapāmyaham ||57||
mayā karma kṛtaṃ niṃdyaṃ sadaiva dvijasattamāḥ||
striyo'pi ca dvijeṃdrāśca tāpasāśca viśeṣataḥ ||58||
ye ye dīnatarā lokā na samarthāḥ prayodhitum ||
te mayā muṣitāḥ sarve na samarthāḥ kadācana ||59||
kuṭumbārthaṃ vimūḍhena sādhusaṃgavivarjinā ||
yathaiva paṭhatā śāstraṃ tanme'dya patitaṃ hṛdi ||6.124.60||
yadi na syādbhavadbhirme darśanaṃ cādya sattamāḥ ||
tadanyānyapi pāpāni kartāhaṃ syāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 61 ||
teṣāṃ madhyagataścāsītpulaho nāma sanmuniḥ ||
hāsyaśīlaḥ sa taṃ prāha viplavārthaṃ dvijottamam || || 62 ||
ahaṃ te kīrtayiṣyāmi mantramekaṃ suśobhanam ||
yaṃ dhyāyañjapyamānastvaṃ siddhiṃ yāsyasi śāśvatīm || 63 ||
jāṭaghoṭetimantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ ||
tamenaṃ japa vipra tvaṃ divārātramataṃdritaḥ || 64 ||
tato yāsyasi saṃsiddhiṃ durlabhāṃ tridaśairapi || 65 ||
evamuktvātha te viprāstīrthayātrāṃ tato yayuḥ ||
so'pi tatraiva caurastu sthito japaparāyaṇaḥ || 66 ||
ananyamanasā tena prārabdhaḥ sa tadā japaḥ ||
yathā'bhavatsamādhistho yenāvasthāṃ parāṃ gataḥ || 67 ||
tasyaivaṃ smaramāṇasya taṃ mantraṃ brāhmaṇasya ca ||
niścalatvaṃ gataḥ kāyaḥ kārye ca niścalaḥ sthitaḥ || 68 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā valmīkena samāvṛtaḥ ||
samaṃtādbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā dhyānasthasya mahātmanaḥ || 69 ||
tau mātāpitarau tasya sā ca bhāryā manasvinī ||
yātā mṛtyuvaśaṃ sarve tamanveṣya prayatnataḥ || 6.124.70 ||
na vijñātaśca tatrasthaḥ saṃnyastaḥ sa mahāvrataḥ ||
saṃsārabhāvanirmuktastasmānmunisamāgamāt | 71 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya tena mārgeṇa te punaḥ ||
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena munayaḥ samupasthitāḥ || 72 ||
procuścaitaddvijāḥ sthānaṃ yatra caureṇa saṃgamaḥ ||
āsīdvastena raudreṇa brāhmaṇacchadmadhāriṇā || 73 ||
tato valmīkamadhyasthaṃ śuśruvurnisvanaṃ ca te ||
jāṭaghoṭetimaṃtrasya tasyaiva ca mahātmanaḥ || 74 ||
atha bhūmyāṃ prahārāste sasvanuḥ sarvatodiśam ||
te valmīkaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā taṃ cauraṃ tasya madhyagam || 75 ||
japamānaṃ tu taṃ mantraṃ pulahena niveditaḥ ||
hāsyarūpeṇa yastasya siddhiṃ ca dvijasattamāḥ || 76 ||
yadvā satyamidaṃ proktamācāryaiḥ śāstradṛṣṭibhiḥ ||
stokaṃ siddhikṛte tasya yasmātsiddhirupasthitā || 77 ||
mantre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bheṣaje gurau ||
yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī || || 78 ||
atha taṃ vīkṣya saṃsiddhaṃ kumantreṇāpi taskaram ||
te viprā vismayāviṣṭāḥ kṛpāviṣṭā viśeṣataḥ || 79 ||
samādhyarhaistato dravyaistailaistadbheṣajairapi || 6.124.80 ||
mamardustasya tadgātraṃ samādhisthaṃ ciraṃ dvijāḥ ||
tataḥ sa cetanāṃ labdhā ālokya ca muhurmuhuḥ ||
provāca vismayāviṣṭastānmunīnprakṛtāniti || 81 ||
|| lohajaṃgha uvāca || ||
kimarthaṃ na gatā yūyaṃ mayā muktā dvijottamāḥ ||
nāhaṃ kiṃcidgrahīṣyāmi yuṣmadīyaṃ kathaṃcana ||
kuṭuṃbārthaṃ yatastasmādvrajadhvaṃ svecchayā'dhunā || 82 ||
|| munaya ūcuḥ|| ||
cirakālādvayaṃ prāptāḥ punarbhrāṃtvā'tra kānane ||
samādhisthena na jñātaḥ kālo'tītastvayā bahu || 83 ||
tau mātāpitarau vṛddhau tvayā muktau kṣayaṃ gatau |
tvaṃ ca saṃsiddhimāpannaḥ parāmasmatprasādataḥ || ||84||
valmīkāṃtaḥ sthito yasmātsaṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ ||
valmīkirnāma vikhyātastasmālloke bhaviṣyasi|| 85 ||
atrasthena yato muṣṭāstvayā lokāḥ purā dvija ||
mukhārākhyaṃ tatastīrthametatkhyātiṃ gamiṣyati||86||
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti śrāvaṇyāṃ śraddhayā dvijāḥ||
kṣālayiṣyaṃti te pāpaṃ caurya karmasamudbhavam ||87||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvātha te viprāstamāmaṃtrya muniṃ tataḥ ||
praṇatāstena saṃjagmurvāṃchitāśāṃ tataḥ param || 88 ||
tapaḥsthaḥ so'pi tatraiva vālmīkiriti yaḥ smṛtaḥ | 89 ||
munīnāṃ pravaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ saṃjātaśca tataḥ param ||
adyāpi tiṣṭhate mūrtaḥ sa tatrastho munīśvaraḥ || 6.124.90 ||
yastaṃ prapūjayedbhaktyā sa kavirjāyate bhuvam||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 91 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mukhāratīrthotpattivarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 124 ||

<6.125>

| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ karṇotpalātīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ cāsti śobhanam ||
yatra snāto naraḥ samyaṅna viyogamavāpnuyāt || 1 ||
kathaṃcidapi ceṣṭena dhanenālijanena ca ||
parākrameṇa dharmeṇa kalatreṇa viśeṣataḥ || 2 ||
satyasaṃdha iti khyātaḥ purāsītpṛthivīpatiḥ ||
ikṣvākukulasaṃbhūtaḥ sarvarūpaguṇairyutaḥ || 3 ||
tasya karṇotpalānāma jātā kanyā suśobhanā ||
bahuputrasya caikā sā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 4 ||
atha tasyāḥ pitā nāma cakre dvādaśame dine ||
saṃmaṃtrya brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhṛtyāmātyairmuhurmuhuḥ || 5 ||
yasmātkarṇotpalā ceyaṃ jātā mama kumārikā ||
tasmātkarṇotpalānāma jātā kanyā suśobhanā || 6 ||
bahu putrasya caikā sā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā ||
tasmātkarṇotpalānāma jāyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 7 ||
kṛtanāmā'tha sā bālā vṛddhiṃ yāti dinedine ||
āhlādakāriṇī nityaṃ kalā cāṃdramasī yathā || 8 ||
atha sā kramaśaḥ prāptā yauvanaṃ baṃdhulālitā ||
hastāddhastaṃ pragacchaṃtī sarveṣāṃ dvijasattamāḥ|| || 9 ||
atha tāṃ yauvanopetāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa pṛthivīpatiḥ |
ciṃtayāmāsa cittena kasyemāṃ pradadāmyaham || 6.125.10 ||
na tasyāḥ sadṛśaḥ kaścidvaro'tra dharaṇītale ||
na svarge na ca pātāle kiṃ kṛtyaṃ me'dhunā bhavet | 11 ||
sa evaṃ bahudhā dhyātvā tadarthaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
niścayaṃ prākaroccitte praṣṭavyo'tra pitāmahaḥ || 12 ||
mayādya viṣaye cāsminsa devaḥ prerayiṣyati ||
tasmai putrīṃ pradāsyāmi nānyasmai vai kathaṃcana || 13 ||
sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā tāmādāya tataḥ param ||
brahmalokaṃ jagāmātha praṣṭuṃ tasyāḥ kṛte varam || 14 ||
atha yāvatsa saṃprāpto brahmalokaṃ nareśvaraḥ ||
tāvatsaṃdhyā samutpannā brāhmī brāhmaṇasattamāḥ || 15 ||
etasminnaṃtare brahmā sāyaṃtanakriyotsukaḥ ||
upaviṣṭaḥ samādhisthastatkālaṃ samapadyata || 16 ||
satyasaṃdho'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā samādhisthaṃ pitāmaham ||
samādhyaṃtaṃ pratīkṣansa upaviṣṭaḥ samīpataḥ || 17 ||
tato vilokya cātmānamātmani prapitāmahaḥ ||
padme pravartite samyagaṣṭapatre hṛdi sthite || 18 ||
karṇikāmadhyagaṃ dīptaṃ bahuvarṇamatisthiram ||
ānaṃdāśrupariklinnavadanaḥ pulakāṃkitaḥ || 19 ||
tata ācamya prakṣālya caraṇau sarvatodiśam ||
apaśyatpraṇataḥ sarvairbrahmalokanivāsibhiḥ ||6.125.20 ||
etasminnaṃtare rājā tāmādāya śubhānanām ||
namaskṛtya tayā sārdhaṃ tataḥ provāca sādaram || 21 ||
ahaṃ deva samāyāto martyalokāttavāṃtikam ||
satyasaṃdho mahīpāla ānarta bhuvi viśrutaḥ || 22 ||
iyaṃ karṇotpalānāma mama kanyā suśobhanā ||
asyā bhuvi mayā labdho na samo'tra patiḥ kvacit || 23 ||
sadṛśastena cāyātastava pārśve surottama ||
tasmānme brūhi bharttāramasyā yena dadāmyaham || 24 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tataḥ provāca padmajaḥ ||
vihasya sarvadevānāṃ samāje dvijasattamāḥ | 25 ||
yadi pṛcchasi me bhūpa kanyādharmapatiṃ prati ||
tannaiṣā kasyaciddeyā sāṃprataṃ śṛṇu kāraṇam || 26 ||
ātmaśreṇiprasūtāya vayojyeṣṭhāya bhūpate ||
kanyā deyā ca dharmāya yaśase kulavṛddhaye || 27 ||
seyaṃ tava sutā martye jyeṣṭhabhāvaṃ samāśritā ||
sarveṣāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ yattattvaṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu || 28 ||
mamāṃtikaṃ prapannasya tava jātaṃ yugatrayam||
atītā bhūtale martyā ye dṛṣṭāḥ prāktvayā nṛpa || 29 ||
anyā sṛṣṭiḥ samutpannā sāṃprataṃ dharaṇītale ||
na tvaṃ jānāsi māhātmyānmama lokasamudbhavāt|| 6.125.30 ||
na devā mānuṣīṃ bhāryāṃ kurvanti ca kathaṃcana ||
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ saṃsthānaṃ yā vigarhitā || 31 ||
tasmādatraiva tiṣṭha tvaṃ sutayā sahito nṛpa ||
hastyaśvādi ca yatkiṃcittatsarvaṃ te kṣayaṃ gatam || 32 ||
putrāḥ pautrāstathā bhṛtyā ye cānye bāṃdhavāstava ||
te sarve nidhanaṃ prāptā ye cānye bhavatekṣitāḥ || 33 ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya sthitaḥ pārthivasattamaḥ ||
yāvattāvatsuduḥkhārtā rudatīsā'bravītsutā || 34 ||
nāhaṃ tāta vasiṣyāmi sthānesminbrahmasaṃbhave ||
sakhījanaparityaktā baṃdhuvargavinākṛtā || 35 ||
tasmādyāsyāmi tatraiva yatra sā jananī mama ||
tāśca sakhyaḥ kṛtānaṃdā yābhiḥ saṃkrīḍitaṃ mayā || 36 ||
bhartrā vinākṛtā nāhaṃ nayiṣye kālasaṃsthitim ||
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gaccha yatra me jananī sthitā || 37 ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā snehārdreṇa sa cetasā ||
tāmādāya tataḥ prāptaḥ svaṃ deśaṃ pārthivottamaḥ || 38 ||
yāvatpaśyati tāvatsa sthalasthāne jalāśayān ||
jalasthāneṣu saṃjātāḥ sthalasaṃghāḥ sudurgamāḥ || 39 ||
anye lokāstathā dharmāsteṣāṃ madhye vyavasthitāḥ ||
pṛcchannapi na jānāti saṃbaṃdhaṃ kenacitsaha || 6.125.40 ||
tathā martyānilaspṛṣṭandyatattkaṇātsa mahīpatiḥ ||
sā ca kanyā jarāgrastā saṃjātā śvetamūrddhajā || 41 ||
valibhiḥ pūrṇitāṃgī ca śīrṇadaṃtā kucacyutā ||
amanojñā virūpāṃgī cipiṭākṣī dvijottamāḥ || 42 ||
sopi rājā tathābhūto vepamānaḥ padepade ||
papraccha bhūpatiḥ kotra deśaḥ koyaṃ puraṃ ca kim || 43 ||
atha procurjanāstasya deśa ānarta ityayam ||
ayaṃ bhūpotra vikhyātaḥ sudharmajño bṛhadbalaḥ || 44 ||
etatprāptipuraṃnāma eṣā sābhramatī nadī ||
gartātīrthamidaṃ puṇyametasyāḥ parikīrtitam || 49 ||
yatraite munayaḥ śāṃtā dāṃtāścāṣṭaguṇe ratāḥ ||
taparatā mahābhāgāḥ snānajapyayaparāyaṇāḥ || || 46 ||
tataḥ sa tu samākarṇya ruroda kṛtaniḥsvanaḥ ||
svasutāṃ tāṃ samāliṃgya duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ || 47 ||
tau ca vṛddhatamau dṛṣṭvā rudatau kṛpayānvitāḥ ||
sarve lokāḥ samājagmuḥ papracchuśca suduḥkhitāḥ || 48 ||
kiṃ tvaṃ vṛddha suduḥkhārtaḥ prarodiṣi nirargalam ||
anayā vṛddhayā sārdhaṃ tasmānnaḥ kāraṇaṃ vada || 49 ||
kiṃ te naṣṭaḥ priyaḥ kaścitkiṃ vā jāto dhanakṣayaḥ ||
parābhūtosi vā kiṃ tvaṃ kenāpi vada mā ciram || 6.125.50 ||
dharmajño duṣṭahaṃtā ca sādhūnāṃ pālane rataḥ ||
rājā bṛhadbalosmākaṃ yena te kurute sukham || 51 || ||
satyasaṃdha uvāca || ||
ānarttādhipatiścāhaṃ satyasaṃdha iti smṛtaḥ ||
mama karṇotpalānāma suteyaṃ dayitā sadā ||
sohamasyāḥ pradānārthaṃ brahmalokamito gataḥ ||
praṣṭuṃ pitāmahaṃ devaṃ sthitastatra muhūrtavat || 93 ||
tato bhūyaḥ samāyāto yāvatpaśyāmi bhūtalam ||
tāvadvilomatāṃ prāptaṃ sarvaṃ no vedmi kiñcana || 54 ||
tacchrutvā te janā gatvā vismayotphullalocanāḥ ||
bṛhadbalāya tatsarvamācakhyustuṣṭisaṃyutāḥ || 55 ||
so'pi tatsarvamākarṇya tataḥ śīghrataraṃ gataḥ ||
padbhyāmeva sthito yatra satyasandho mahīpatiḥ || 56 ||
tatastaṃ praṇipatyoccaiḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||
svāgataṃ te mahīpāla bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca te || 57 ||
idaṃ rājyaṃ nijaṃ bhūyo mayā bhṛtyena sādaram ||
kuruṣva svecchayā dehi dānāni vividhāni ca || 58 ||
tatastaṃ ca samāliṃgya śirasyādhāya cāsakṛt ||
uvācāśrupariklinnavadano gadgadākṣaram || 59 ||
vatsa cīrṇaṃ mayā rājyaṃ dānaṃ dattaṃ pṛthagvidham ||
vājimedhamukhairyajñairiṣṭaṃ saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥ ||6.125.60||
tasmāttapaścariṣyāmi sutayā cānayā saha ||
yathaiṣā labhate bhūyastāruṇyaṃ prāktanaṃ śubham ||61||
|| bṛhadbala uvāca || ||
pāraṃparyeṇa rājeṃdra mayaitatsakalaṃ śrutam ||
satyasaṃdho mahīpālaḥ kanyāmādāya nirgataḥ || 62 ||
kutracinna samāyātaḥ sa bhūyo'pi purottame ||
tatastatsacivai rājyaṃ pratipālya ciraṃ nṛpa ||
abhiṣiktastataḥ putraḥ suhayonāma viśrutaḥ || 63 ||
tasyāhaṃ kramaśo jātaḥ saptasaptatimo vibho||
puruṣastava vaṃśasya samudbhūto mahāpatiḥ || 64 ||
tasmādatraiva kalyāṇe sthāne'sminmedhyatāṃ gate ||
gartātīrthe kuru vibho tapastvamanayā saha || 65 ||
yena te caraṇau nityaṃ praṇipatya trisaṃdhijam||
śreyaḥ prāpnomyasaṃdigdhaṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti || 66 ||
|| satyasaṃdha uvāca || ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mayāsītsthāpitaṃ purā ||
liṃgaṃ vṛṣabhanāthasya tāvadasti suputraka || 67 ||
tattasyārādhanaṃ nityaṃ kariṣyāmi divāniśam ||
tasmātprāpaya māṃ tatra anayā sutayā saha || 68 ||
evaṃ tayoḥ pravadatoranyonyaṃ bhūmipālayoḥ ||
garttātīrthātsamāyātā brāhmaṇāḥ kautukānvitāḥ ||
śrutvā bhūmipatiṃ prāptaṃ ciraṃtanaguruṃ śubham|| 69 ||
tataḥ sa pārthivasteṣāṃ dattvārghaṃ prāṃjaliḥ sthitaḥ ||
provāca svargavṛttāṃtamāsyatāmiti sādaram || 6.125.70 ||
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve yathājyeṣṭhaṃ yathāsukham||
upaviṣṭā nareṃdrasya caturdikṣu suvismitāḥ ||
papracchustaṃ ca bhūpālaṃ vārtāṃ brahmagṛhodbhavām || 71 ||
yathā sa tatra niryāta āgataśca yathā purā ||
ālāpāḥ padmayoneśca yathā jātāstvanekaśaḥ || 72 ||
tataḥ kathāṃtamāsādya satyasaṃdho mahīpatiḥ ||
kiṃcidāsādya taṃ prāha samīpasthaṃ bṛhadbalam || 73 ||
mayā iṣṭaṃ makhaiścitrairanekairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ||
dānāni ca vicitrāṇi yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate || 74 ||
ekadāhaṃ gataḥ putra camatkārapurottame ||
dṛṣṭaṃ mayā puraṃ tacca samaṃtādbrāhmaṇaivṛtam || 75||
japasvādhyāyasaṃpannairagnihotraparāyaṇaiḥ ||
gṛhasthadharmasaṃpannairlokadvayaphalānvitaiḥ || 76 ||
tataśca ciṃtitaṃ citte sa vanyo mama pūrvajaḥ ||
yenaiṣopārjitā kīrtiḥ śāśvatī kṣayavarjitā || 77 ||
tasmādahamapi sthāpya puramīdṛksamucchritam ||
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyāmi tatkīrtiparivṛddhaye || 78 ||
evaṃ citayamānasya mama nityaṃ mahīpate ||
avāṃtareṇa saṃjātaṃ brahmalokaprayāṇakam || 79 ||
etadekaṃ hi me citte paścāttāpakaraṃ sthitam||
nānyatkiṃcinmahīpāla kṛtakṛtyasya sarvataḥ || 6.125.80 ||
tasmātprārthaya vipreṃdrānkāṃścideṣāṃ mahātmanām ||
yena yacchāmi susthānaṃ kṛtvā tebhyastavājñayā || 81 ||
tataḥ sa prārthayāmāsa tadarthaṃ brāhmaṇottamān ||
mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā kriyatāṃ bhoḥ parigrahaḥ || 82 ||
asya bhūpasya sadbhaktyā yacchataḥ puramuttamam ||
ahaṃ vaḥ pālayiṣyāmi sarve madvaṃśajāśca te || || 83 ||
tataḥ kāṃścitsukṛcchreṇa samānīya bṛhadbalaḥ ||
rājñe nivedayāmāsa etebhyo dīyatāmiti || 84 ||
tataḥ prakṣālya sarveṣāṃ pādānsa pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
satyasaṃdho dadau tebhyaḥ purārthaṃ bhūmimuttamām || 85 ||
bṛhadbalasya cādeśaṃ dadau saṃprasthitaḥ svayam ||
tvayaitadyogyatāṃ neyaṃ puraṃ parapuraṃjaya || 86 ||
gatvā ca sa tayā sārdhaṃ tatkṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvaram ||
talliṃgaṃ prāpya saṃhṛṣṭaściraṃ tepe tapastataḥ || 87 ||
sāpi karṇotpalā prāpya kiṃcitpuṇyaṃ jalāśayam ||
tapastepe pratiṣṭhāpya gaurīṃ śraddhāsamanvitā || 88 ||
etasminnaṃtare rājā kāladharmamupāgataḥ ||
ānartādhipatiryuddhe hataḥ putraiḥ samanvitaḥ || 89 ||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve gartātīrthasamudbhavāḥ ||
satyasaṃdhaṃ samabhyetya procurduḥkhasamanvitāḥ || 6.125.90 ||
parigrahaḥ kṛto'smābhiḥ kevalaṃ pṛthivīpate ||
na ca kiṃcitphalaṃ jātaṃ vṛttijaṃ naḥ purodbhavam || 91 ||
tasmātkuru sthitiṃ tvaṃ ca svadharmaparivṛddhaye ||?|
yena tadvartanopāyo hyasmākaṃ nṛpasattama || 92 ||
rājā bṛhadbalo yuddhe kāladharmamupāgataḥ ||
yastvayā darśito'smākaṃ vṛttyarthaṃ nṛpasattama || 93 ||
|| satyasandha uvāca || ||
saṃnyasto'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā vṛttiṃ kartuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ ||
yadi me syātpumānkaścidanvaye'pi na saṃśayaḥ || 94 ||
tasmādvrajatha harmyaṃ svaṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama ||
abhāgyairbhavadīyaiśca hato rājā bṛhadbalaḥ || 95 ||
evamuktāśca te viprā matvā tathyaṃ ca tadvacaḥ ||
svasthānaṃ tvaritā jagmuḥ so'pi cakre tapaściram || 96 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye satyasandhanṛpativṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 125 ||

<6.126>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ tasya tapasthasya putryā saha dvijottamāḥ ||
ājagmurbrāhmaṇāḥ sarve camatkārapurodbhavāḥ || 1 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
sandeheṣu ca sarveṣu vivādeṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
abhāvātpārthivendrasya saṃjātaśca parābhavaḥ || 2 ||
tataśca dvijavaryaiḥ sa saṃnyastaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
pṛṣṭaśca prārthitaścaiva nijarājyasya rakṣaṇe ||
anyasmindivase prāha kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ || 3 ||
|| rājovāca || |
anarho'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ saṃdehaṃ hartumeva vaḥ ||
rakṣāṃ kartuṃ viśeṣeṇa tyaktaśastro'smi cādhunā || 4 ||.
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
sarve vayaṃ mahārāja bhūpasyāpyadhikā yataḥ ||
ahaṃkāreṇa darpeṇa nijaṃ sthānaṃ samāśritāḥ || 5 ||
na kasyacinmahārāja kadāpi ca kathaṃcana ||
vartanāyāśca sandehaḥ sthānakṛtye'pi saṃsthitaḥ || 6 ||
asaṃkhyātā kṛtā vṛttiḥ purā'smākaṃ mahātmanā ||
tataḥ sā vṛddhimānītā tatparaiḥ pārthivottamaiḥ || 7 ||
tvayā caiva viśeṣeṇa yāvadrājā bṛhadbalaḥ ||
ānartaviṣaye rājā yo yaḥ syātsa prayacchati || 8 ||
sarvāṃ vṛttiṃ gṛhasthānāṃ yathāyogyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
tavāgre kiṃ vayaṃ brūmastvaṃ vetsi sakalaṃ yataḥ || 9 ||
yathā vṛttiḥ purā dattā yathā saṃrakṣitā tvayā ||
tasmāccintaya rājendra sthānaṃ vartanasaṃbhavam ||
upāyaṃ yena maryādā vṛttistasmātsukhena tu || 6.126.10 ||
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā gartātīrthasamudbhavān ||
ākāryopamanyuvaṃśasya saṃbhavānvedapāragān || 11 ||
praṇipātaṃ prakṛtvātha tataḥ provāca sādaram ||
madīyasthāna saṃsthānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 12 ||
sarvakṛtyāni kāryāṇi bhṛtyavadvinayānvitaiḥ ||
nityaṃ rakṣā vidhātavyā yuṣmadīyaṃ vacokhilam || 13 ||
ete saṃpālayiṣyanti maryādākāramuttamam ||
sandeheṣu ca sarveṣu vivādeṣu viśeṣataḥ || 14 ||
rājakāryeṣu cānyeṣu ete dāsyanti nirṇayam ||
yuṣmadīyaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham || 15 ||
ete pālyāḥ prasādena puṣṭiṃ neyāśca śaktitaḥ||
īrṣyāṃ sarvāṃ parityajya madīyasthānavṛddhaye || 16 ||
bāḍhamityeva taiḥ proktaḥ sa rājā brāhmaṇottamān ||
camatkāpurodbhūtānbhūyaḥ provāca sādaram || 17 ||
yuṣmākaṃ vartanārthāya sarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā ||
ete viprā mayā dattā gartātīrthasamudbhavāḥ || 18 ||
eteṣāṃ vacanātsarvaṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ prajāyatām ||
pratiṣṭhā jāyate nūnaṃ cātuścaraṇasūcitā || 19 ||
nānyathā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ||
proktaṃ lakṣamitairanyairyuṣmadīyapurodbhavaiḥ || 6.126.20 ||
|| sūta uvāca ||
tataste brāhmaṇā hṛṣṭāstānādāya dvijottamān ||
teṣāṃ matena cakruśca sarvakṛtyāni sarvadā || 21 ||
tatastatra pure jātā maryādā dharmavarddhinī ||
sarvakṛtyeṣu sarveṣāṃ tathā vṛddhiḥ purasya ca || 22 ||
te'pi teṣāṃ prasādena garttātīrthabhavā dvijāḥ ||
parāṃ vibhūtimāsthāya modante sukhasaṃyutāḥ || 23 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya sa rājā tatpurottamam ||
samabhyetya dvijānsarvāṃstataḥ provāca sādaram ||24||
yuṣmadīyaprasādena kṣetre'tra sumahattapaḥ ||
kṛtaṃ svargaṃ prayāsyāmi sāṃprataṃ tu dvijottamāḥ || 25 ||
nāsmākamanvaye kaścitsāṃprataṃ vartate nṛpaḥ ||
tasyāhaṃ liṃgametadvai darśayāmi dvijottamāḥ ||26||
pūjārthaṃ cāpi vṛttyarthaṃ bhogārthaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
tasmādyuṣmābhirevāsya pūjā kāryā prayatnataḥ ||
rathayātrā viśeṣeṇa dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari || 27 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
sapta viṃśatiliṃgāni yatheṣṭāni mahītale ||
camatkārasutānāṃ ca pūjyaṃte sarvadaiva tu || 28 ||
aṣṭāviṃśatimaṃ tadvadetalliṃgaṃ tavodbhavam ||
sarvadā pūjayiṣyāmo niścinto bhava pārthiva || 29 ||
asya yātrāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ kārtike māsi sarvadā ||
balipūjopahārāṃśca gītavādyāni śaktitaḥ || 6.126.30 ||
evamuktaḥ sa tairhṛṣṭo gatvātmīyaṃ tadāśramam ||
snāpayitvātha talliṃgaṃ pūjāṃ cakre prabhaktitaḥ || 31 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ samarpitaṃ liṃgaṃ tena taddharasaṃbhavam ||
sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ vaṃśocchede sthite dvijāḥ || 32 ||
sakalaṃ kārtikaṃ martyo yastacchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
snāpayetpūjayeccāpi sa nūnaṃ muktimāpnuyāt || 33 ||
somasya divase prāpte varṣaṃ yāvatkṛtakṣaṇaḥ ||
tasya pūjāṃ karotyevaṃ snāpayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
so'pi muktiṃ vrajenmartya etattātānmayā śrutam || 34 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye satyasaṃdheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 126 || || cha ||

<6.127>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yā sā karṇotpalānāma tvayāsmākaṃ prakīrtitā ||
kiñcijjalāśrayaṃ prāpya tapastapati saṃsthitā ||
tasyāḥ sarvaṃ samācakṣva yathā tapasi sā sthitā || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
gaurīpādakṛtasthānā śraddhayā parayā yutā ||
tāvattuṣṭiṃ gatā devī girijā śaṃkarapriyā || 2 ||
tataḥ provāca te putri tuṣṭāhaṃ vāṃchitaṃ vada ||
yena yacchāmyasaṃdigdhaṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 3 ||
|| karṇotpalovāca || ||
mama patyuḥ kṛte devi mama tātaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ||
rājyādbhraṣṭaḥ sukhāccāpi kuṭuṃbena vivarjitaḥ || 4 |
tataścaiva tapastepe vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||
ahaṃ vārddhakyamāpannā kaumārye'pi ca saṃsthitā || 5 ||
tasmādbhavatu me bharttā kaścidrūpotkaṭaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
sarveṣāṃ devamartyānāṃ tvatprasādātsureśvari ||6||
tathā syātparamaṃ rūpaṃ tāruṇyaṃ tvatprasādataḥ ||
yathāsya jāyate saukhyaṃ tāpasasyāpi me pituḥ || 7 ||
|| devyuvāca || ||
māghamāsatṛtīyāyāṃ śanaiścaradine śubhe ||
nakṣatre vasudaivatye rūpaṃ dhyātvātha yauvanam || 8 ||
tvayā snānaṃ prakartavyaṃ supuṇye'tra jalāśaye ||
tato divya vapurbhūtvā yauvanena samanvitā|
bhaviṣyasi na saṃdehaḥ satyametanmayoditam || 9 ||
anyāpi yā mahābhāge nārī snānaṃ kariṣyati||
tasminnahani sāpyevaṃ rūpayuktā bhaviṣyati || 6.127.10. ||
||sūta uvāca|| ||
evamuktvātha sā devī gatā cādarśanaṃ tataḥ ||
sāpi cānveṣayāmāsa tṛtīyāṃ śaninā saha || 11 ||
vasudevātmakenaiva nakṣatreṇa prayatnataḥ ||
dhyāyamānā ca tāṃ devīṃ sarvakāmapradāyinīm || 12 ||
tataḥ katipayāhasya jātā sā yogasaṃyutā ||
tṛtīyā yā yathoktā ca tayā devyā purā dvijāḥ || 13 ||
tataḥ sā rūpasaubhāgyaṃ yauvanaṃ vāṃchitaṃ patim ||
dhyāyamānā jale tasminnarddharātre viveśa ca || 14 ||
tato divyavapurbhūtvā yauvanena samanvitā ||
niṣkrāṃtā salilāttasmājjanavismayakāriṇī || 15 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāpto gaurīvākyaprabodhitaḥ ||
tadarthaṃ bhagavānkāmaḥ patnyarthaṃ prītisaṃyutaḥ ||
abravīcca mahābhāge kāmohaṃ svayamāgataḥ || 16 ||
pārvatyādeśitā bhāryā tasmānme bhava mā ciram || || 17 ||
yasmātprītyā samāyātastavāṃtikamahaṃ śubhe ||
tasmātprītiriti khyātā mama bhāryā bhaviṣyasi || 18 ||
|| karṇotpalovāca || ||
yadyevaṃ smara mattātaṃ taṃ gatvā prārthaya svayam ||
svacchaṃdā syādyataḥ kanyā na kathaṃcitpravartitā || 19 ||
ya eṣa dṛśyate ramyaḥ prāsādo nāti dūrataḥ ||
asyāṃte tiṣṭhate'smākaṃ tātastapasi saṃsthitaḥ || 6.127.20 ||
atrāhaṃ pūrvato gatvā tasya tiṣṭhāmi cāṃtike ||
bhavānāgatya paścācca prārthayiṣyati māṃ tataḥ || 21 ||
bāḍhamityeva kāmokte gatā sā tatsamīpataḥ ||
praṇipatya tataḥ prāha diṣṭyā tāta mayā punaḥ || 22 ||
saṃprāptaṃ yauvanaṃ kāṃtaṃ samārādhya harapriyām ||
tasmātkuru vivāhaṃ me hṛtsthaṃ sukhamavāpnuhi || 23 ||
madarthe preṣito bharttā tayā devyā'tisundaraḥ ||
puṣpa cāpaḥ svayaṃ prāptaḥ so'pi tāta tavāṃtikam || 24 ||
atha tāṃ sa samālokya svāṃ sutāṃ yauvanānvitām ||
harṣeṇa mahatā yuktāṃ kāṃtayuktāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
abravīdadya me putri saṃjātaṃ tapasaḥ phalam || 25 ||
jīvitasya ca kalyāṇi yatvaṃ prāptā navaṃ vayaḥ ||
bhartāraṃ ca tathābhīṣṭaṃ devyā dattaṃ manobhavam || 26 ||
etasminnaṃtare kāmastasyāṃtikamupādravat ||
abravīddehi me bhūpa svāṃ kanyāṃ cāruhāsinīm || 27 ||
asyā arthe'hamādiṣṭaḥ svayaṃ gauryā nṛpottama ||
kāmadeva iti khyātastrailokyaṃ yena mohitam || 28 ||
tatastāmarpayāmāsa tāṃ kanyāṃ sa mahīpatiḥ ||
kṛtvāgniṃ sākṣiṇaṃ vākyādbrāhmaṇānāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 29 ||
sā cāsya cābhavatprītisthānaṃ yasmātsulocanā ||
rateranaṃtarā tasmātprītināmā'bhavacchubhā || 6.127.30 ||
evaṃ tayā tapastaptaṃ tasmāttatra jalāśaye ||
tannāmnā khyātimāyātaṃ samaste'tra mahītale || 31 ||
sakalaṃ māghamāsaṃ ca yā strī snānaṃ samācaret ||
pumānvā prātarutthāya sa prayāgaphalaṃ labhet || 32 ||
rūpavāñjāyate dakṣaḥ sadā janmani janmani ||
na viyogamavāpnoti kadātridbāṃdhavaiḥ saha || 33 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye karṇotpalātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 127 || ||

<6.128>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
satyasandhopi hṛṣṭātmā satāṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhānvitām||
abhīṣṭapatinā yuktāṃ kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha || 1 ||
tatastasyaiva liṃgasya dakṣiṇāṃ mūrtimāśritaḥ ||
dṛḍhaṃ padmāsanaṃ kṛtvā samyagdhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 ||
ātmānamātmanaivātha brahmadvāreṇa saṃsthitaḥ ||
tato niḥsārayāmāsa pulakena samanvitaḥ || 3 ||
atha te brāhmaṇāstasya camatkārapurodbhavāḥ ||
devatā darśanārthāya prāptā dṛṣṭvā kalevaram || 4 ||
apriyaṃ tejasā hīnaṃ mṛtamaspṛśyatāṃ gatam ||
liṃgasya nātidūrasthaṃ dāhyārthaṃ yatnamāsthitāḥ || 5 ||
yāvadgurvīṃ citāṃ kṛtvā tamanveṣṭuṃ samudyatāḥ ||
tāvannaṣṭaṃ śavaṃ tacca jñāyate naiva kutracit || 6 ||
tataśca vismayāviṣṭāstaṃ praśaṃsāsamanvitaiḥ ||
vacanairbahuśo bhūyo vikathya ca muhurmuhuḥ || 7 ||
tatastasyotthaliṃgasya sarvaṃ pūjādikaṃ ca yat ||
sarve nirūpayāmāsuḥ saptaviṃśatimadhyataḥ || 8 ||
liṃgānāṃ tadbhavennityaṃ satyasaṃdhasya bhūpateḥ ||
kāmadaṃ bhaktajaṃtūnāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 9 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
camatkāranareṃdrasya vaṃśe kṣīṇe mahāmate ||
ānarttādhipatiḥ ko'nyastatra rājā babhūva ha || 6.128.10 ||
sūta uvāca || ||
bṛhadbale hate bhūpe saṃgrāme dvijasattamāḥ |
putrabaṃdhusamāyuktāḥ sarva lokāḥ samāyayuḥ || 11 ||
yatrasthaḥ sa mahīpālaḥ satyasaṃdhastaponvitaḥ ||
śokodvignāstataḥ prāhustaṃ bhūpaṃ rahasi sthitam || 12 ||
kṣīṇo'yaṃ tāvako vaṃśo na kaścidvidyate yataḥ ||
dāyādo'pi kathaṃ pṛthvī saṃpratīyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 13 ||
arājake nṛpaśreṣṭha mātsyo nyāyaḥ pravartate ||
rāṣṭre caiva pure caiva grāme caiva viśeṣataḥ || 14 ||
paradāraratā ye ca ye ca taskaravṛttayaḥ |
sarve rājabhayādrājanmaryādāṃ pālayaṃti vai || 15 ||
tasmāttvaṃ tapa utsṛjya rājyaṃ pūrvakramāgatam ||
kuru rājyaṃ tathā dārānputrārthaṃ prāpya mā ciram || 16 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
saṃnyasto'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā na rājyaṃ kartumutsahe ||
na sutānāṃ na dārāṇāṃ saṃgrahaṃ ca kathaṃcana || 17 ||
tatputrārthaṃ pravakṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ svāminaḥ kṛte ||
upāyaṃ yena rājā syādānartto lokapālakaḥ || 18 |
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa yadā kṣatraṃ nipātitam ||
garbhasthamapi kārtsnyena kopopahatacetasā || 19 ||
tataḥ kṣatriyabhāryāḥ prāgṛtusnānātsamāyayuḥ ||
brāhmaṇānputrajanmārthaṃ na kāmārthaṃ kathaṃcana || 6.128.20 ||
tataḥ putrāḥ samutpannāstejovīryasamanvitāḥ ||
kṣetrajā bhūmipālānāṃ saṃjātāśca mahīkṣitaḥ ||21||
tasmādbṛhadbalasyaitā bhāryāstiṣṭhaṃti yā janāḥ ||
brāhmaṇāṃstā upāgamya ṛtusnātā yathocitān || 22 ||
labhiṣyaṃti ca putrāṃstāstebhyaḥ kṣatriyapuṃgavān ||
ye bhūmiṃ pālayiṣyaṃti pālayiṣyaṃti ca prajāḥ || 23 ||
tathā'trāsti śubhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ putrajanmadam ||
yatra snātā ṛtau nārī sadyo garbhavatī bhavet ||
amogharetāḥ kāṃtā ca snānādatra prajāyate || 24 ||
ye pūrvaṃ kṣatriyā jātā brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriṇīṣu ca ||
te sarve tatprabhāvena saṃjātā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
yayāyayā dvijo yaśca kṣatriṇyā'bhūdvṛtaḥ purā ||
tayā saha samāgatya snātaṃ mantrapuraskṛtam || 26 ||
sakṛnmaidhunasaṃsargāttatastīrthaprabhāvataḥ ||
sarvāsāṃ yatsutā jātā duhitā na kathaṃcana || 27 ||
ye kecitputradā maṃtrāścātuścaraṇāsaṃbhavāḥ |
te sarve'tra vasiṣṭhena prayuktāḥ kṣattramicchatā || 28 |
daṃpatyoḥ snānamātreṇa jāte'tra syātsuputrakaḥ||
tasmātsuputradaṃnāma kuṇḍametannigadyate || 29 ||
tasmādbhāryāḥ samastāstā bṛhadbalasamudbhavāḥ ||
atra snānaṃ prakurvaṃtu yathoktavidhinā janāḥ || 6.128.30 ||
naiva kiṃcidasatyaṃ syānna ca niṃdākaraṃ tathā ||
śrūyate ca yataḥ ślokaḥ pūrvācāryairudāhṛtaḥ || 31 ||
adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥ kṣattramaśmano lohamucchritam||
teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati || 32 ||
tacchrutvā janāḥ sarve sacivānāṃ vacokhilam ||
tadācakhyurdrutaṃ gatvā satyasaṃdhasya bhūpateḥ || 33 ||
tatastāḥ sarvaśo dārā brāhmaṇānatisundarān ||
ṛtusnātāḥ samājagmurnṛpapatnyaḥ suharṣitāḥ || 34 ||
yatra tatputradaṃ tīrthaṃ vasiṣṭhena vinirmitam ||
tatra snātvā sakṛtsaṃgaṃ samāsādya dvijodbhavam || 35 ||
sarvāstāḥ putravatyaśca saṃjātā dvijasattamāḥ ||
āsīttasya nareṃdrasya śataṃ paṃcabhiranvitam || 36 ||
tāsāṃ samabhavadviprāḥ śataṃ paṃcādhikaṃ tathā || 37 ||
pratyekaṃ varaputrāṇāṃ vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ param ||
ānaṃdajananaṃ samyaksarveṣāṃ rāṣṭravāsinām || 38 ||
tatra śreṣṭho'bhavatputro ya ānartapatirbhuvi ||
aṭonāma suvikhyātaḥ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ || 39 ||
aṭeśvaraiti khyāto yena devo'tra nirmitaḥ ||
subhaktyā yena dṛṣṭena vaṃśocchittirna jāyate || 6.128.40 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kasmāttasya kṛtaṃ nāma etaccā'ṭa iti smṛtam ||
anvayena parityaktaṃ tasmātkīrtaya sūtaja ||41||
sacivairbrāhmaṇairvāpi tasyaitannāma nirmitam ||
mātrā vā tatsamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 42 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
na mātrā tatkṛtaṃ nāma na vipraiḥ sacivairnṛpa ||
tatkṛtaṃ devadūtena vyomasthena dvijottamāḥ || 43 ||
yathā tathā pravakṣyāmi śrotavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ ||
yayā sa bhūpatirjāto daśārṇādhipateḥ sutā || 49 ||
sā rūpayauvanopetā rūpāḍhyaṃ prāpya saddvijam ||
prasthitā snātukāmātha putratīrthe mṛgekṣaṇā || 45 ||
sahitā tena vipreṇa kaṃdarpapratimena ca ||
atha tābhyāṃ mahānrāmo mithaḥ saṃdarśanātsthitaḥ || 46 ||
tādṛṅmātraṃ sukṛcchreṇa prāptaṃ tīrthaṃ sutapradam ||
tataḥ snātvā jale tasminniṣkrāṃtau tau sukāmukau ||47||
vrajamānau ca mārge'pi kāmadharmamupāgatau ||
atyautsukyātsusaṃhṛṣṭau lajjāṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ || 48 ||
niṃdamānasya lokasya vicchedavacanaistadā ||
vīryotsarge'tha saṃjāte yāvaduttiṣṭhate dvijaḥ || 49 ||
tāvadākāśagā vāṇī sahasā devanirmitā ||
aṭatārājamārgeṇa vipreṇānena vai yataḥ || 6.128.50 ||
utpāditastu putro'yamautsukyādbrāhmaṇena tu ||
aṭākhyo bhūpatistasmālloke khyāto bhaviṣyati || 51 ||
dīrghāyurbahuputraśca śatruṃpakṣakṣayāvahaḥ ||
etasmātkāraṇādviprā aṭākhyaḥ sa babhūva ha || 52 ||
svavaṃśoddharacaṃdro'tra vāṃchitārthaprado'rthinām ||
tenaitatkṣetramāsādya sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam ||
svanāmnā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvadeṣṭapradaṃ nṛṇām || 53 ||
yastanmāghacaturdaśyāṃ pūjayecchraddhayānvitaḥ ||
na tasya jāyate kiṃcidduḥkhaṃ saṃtānasaṃbhavam || 54 ||
api varṣaśatānārī snātvā kuṇḍe sutaprade ||
aṭeśvaraṃ tataḥ paśyecchivabhaktiparāyaṇā || 55 ||
sadyaḥ putramavāpnoti vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ param || 
tatprasādānna saṃdehaḥ kārtikeya vaco yathā || 56 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'ṭeśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 128 ||

<6.129>

|| sūta uvāca ||
tathānyo'pi ca tatrāsti yājñavalkyasamudravaḥ ||
āśramo loka vikhyāto mūrkhāṇāmapi siddhidaḥ || 1 ||
yatra taptvā tapastīvraṃ yājñavalkyena dhīmatā ||
saṃprāptā nikhilā vedā guruṇā'pahṛtāśca ye || 2 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
ko'sau gururabhūttasya yājñavalkyasya dhīmataḥ ||
pāṭhayitvā punaryena hṛtā vedā mahātmanā || 3 ||
kimarthaṃ ca samācakṣva sūtaputrātra vistarāt||
kautukaṃ paramaṃ jātaṃ sarveṣāṃ no dvijanmanām || 4 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
āsīdbrāhmaṇaśārdūlaḥ śākalya iti viśrutaḥ||
bhārgavānvayasaṃbhūto veda vedāṃgapāragaḥ || 5 ||
bṛhatkalpe purā viprā vardhamāne purottame ||
bahuśiṣyasamāyukto vedādhyayanatatparaḥ || 6 ||
sa sadā prātarutthāya vidyādānaṃ prayacchati |
śiṣyebhyaścānurūpebhyaḥ prasādādvijasattamāḥ || 7 ||
cakāra sa tadā viprāḥ paurohityaṃ mahīpateḥ ||
sūryavaṃśaprasūtasya supriyasya mahātmanaḥ || || 8 ||
sa tasya dharmakṛtyāni sarvāṇyeva dinedine ||
kṛtvā svagṛhamabhyeti pūjitastena bhūbhujā || 9 ||
ekaṃ śiṣyaṃ samāropya śāṃtyarthaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ ||
kathayitvā pramāṇaṃ ca vidhānaṃ homasaṃbhavam || 6.129.10 ||
śiṣyo'pi sakalaṃ kṛtvā tatkarma susamāhitaḥ ||
āśīrvādaṃ pradattvā ca bhūpatergṛhameti ca || 11 ||
evaṃ prakurvatastasya śākalyasya mahātmanaḥ ||
paurohityaṃ gataḥ kālaḥ kiyanmātro dvijottamāḥ || 12 |
tadā vaivāhike kāle śapto yaḥ śaṃbhunā svayam ||
suniṃdyāṃ vikṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya vedyāṃ gatasya ca || 13 ||
atha taṃ yojayāmāsa śāṃtyarthaṃ nṛpamaṃdire ||
yājñavalkyaṃ sa śākalyaḥ pratipadyāgataṃ tadā || 14 ||
so'pi tāruṇyagarveṇa veśyākarajavikṣataḥ ||
sarvāṃgeṣu sunirlajjaḥ prakaṭāṃgo jagāma vai || 15 ||
tataśca śāṃtikaṃ kṛtvā japāṃte bhūpatiṃ ca tam ||
śāṃtodakapradānāya hasyamāno janairyayau || 16 ||
pārthivo'pi ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛgrūpaṃ viṭaṃ dvijam ||
nāśīrjagrāha tenoktāṃ vākyametaduvāca ha || 17 |
ucchiṣṭo'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭha śayyārūḍho vyavasthitaḥ |
atra śālodbhave staṃbhe tasmādetajjalaṃ kṣipa || 18 ||
so'pi sāvajñamājñāya taṃ bhūpaṃ kupitānanaḥ ||
taṃ ca staṃbhaṃ samuddiśya dhyātvā tadbrahma śāśvatam || 19 ||
dyāṃ tvamālikhya ityeva proktvā maṃtraṃ ca yājuṣam|| (yāṃ tvamālikhyapāṭhabhedaḥ)
prākṣipacchāṃtikaṃ toyaṃ tasya mūrdhani satvaram|| 6.129.20 ||
tataḥ sa patite toye staṃbhaḥ pallavaśobhitaḥ ||
tatkṣaṇādeva saṃjajñe phala puṣpairvirājitaḥ || 21 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pārthivaḥ so'tha vismayotphullalocanaḥ ||
paścāttāpaṃ vidhāyātha vākyametaduvāca ha || 22 ||
abhiṣekaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha mamāpi tvaṃ prayaccha bhoḥ ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa śucitvaṃ me vyavasthitam || 23 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
mamābhiṣekadānasya tvamanarho'si pārthiva ||
tasmādyāsyāmyahaṃ sadyo yatrasthaḥ sa gururmama || 24 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
tava dāsyāmi vastrāṇi vāhanāni vasūni ca ||
tasmādyacchābhiṣekaṃ me mantreṇā'nena sāṃpratam || 25 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
na homāṃtaṃ vinā mantraḥ sphurate pārthivottama ||
abhiṣekavidhau prokto yaḥ pūrvaṃ padmayoninā ||
tasmānnāhaṃ kariṣyāmi tava yadvai hṛdi sthitam|| 26 ||
ityuktvā vacanaṃ bhūpaṃ yājñavalkyaḥ sa vai dvijaḥ ||
jagāma svagṛhaṃ tūrṇaṃ nispṛhatvaṃ samāśritaḥ || 27
apare'hni samāyātaṃ śākalyamatha bhūpatiḥ ||
provāca prāṃjalirbhūtvā vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ || 28 ||
yastvayā preṣitaḥ kalya śiṣyo brāhmaṇasattamaḥ ||
śāṃtyarthaṃ preṣaṇīyaśca bhūyo'pyevaṃ gṛhe mama || 29 ||
bāḍhamityeva sa proktvā tato gatvā nijālayam ||
yājñavalkyaṃ samāhūya tataḥ provāca sādaram || 6.129.30 ||
adyāpi tvaṃ nareṃdrasya śāṃtyarthaṃ bhavane vraja ||
viśeṣātpārthiveṃdreṇa samāhūto'si putraka || 31 || ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
nāhaṃ tāta gamiṣyāmi śāṃtyarthaṃ tasya maṃdire ||
avalepena yuktasya śuddhyā virahitasya ca || 32 ||
mayā tasyābhiṣekārthaṃ salilaṃ codyataṃ ca yat ||
salilaṃ tena tatkāṣṭhe samādiṣṭaṃ kubuddhinā || 33 ||
tato mayāpi tatraiva tatkṣaṇātsalilaṃ ca yat ||
tasminkāṣṭhe parikṣiptaṃ nītaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt || 34 ||
|| śākalya uvāca || ||
ata eva viśeṣeṇa samāhūto'si putraka ||
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gaccha nāvajñeyā mahībhujaḥ || 35 ||
apamānādbhavenmānaṃ pārthivānāmasaṃśayam ||
yaḥ karoti punastatra mānaṃ na sa bhavetpriyaḥ || 36 ||
kopaprasāda vastūni vicinvaṃtīha ye sadā ||
ārohaṃti śanairbhṛtyā dhunvaṃtamapi pārthivam || 37 ||
samau mānāpamānau ca cittajñaḥ kālavittathā ||
sarvaṃsahaḥ kṣamī vijñaḥ sa bhavedrājavallabhaḥ || 38 ||
apamānamanādṛtya tasmādgaccha nṛpālayam ||
mamājñāpi na laṃghyā ta eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 39 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
ājñābhaṃgo dhruvaṃ bhāvī paripāṭīvyatikramāt ||
karoṣi yadi śiṣyāṇāṃ ye tvayā tatra yojitāḥ || 6.129.40 ||
tasmādyadi balānmāṃ tvaṃ yojayiṣyasi taṃ prati ||
tvāṃ tyaktvā'nyatra yāsyāmi yataḥ proktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ || 41 ||
gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ ||
utpathe vartamānasya parityāgo vidhīyate || 42 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śākalyaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ bhūyo bhartsamāno muhurmuhuḥ || 43 ||
ekamapyakṣaraṃ yatra guruḥ śiṣye nivedayet ||
pṛthivyāṃ nāsti taddravyaṃ yaddattvā hyanṛṇī bhavet || 44 ||
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ dattvā madadhyayanamālayam ||
tyaktvā vidyāṃ mayā dattāṃ no cecchapsyāmyahaṃ tava || 45 ||
evamuktvābhimaṃtryātha nādabiṃdusamudbhavaiḥ ||
maṃtrairātharvaṇaistoyaṃ pānārthaṃ cārpayattataḥ || 46 ||
so'pibattatkṣaṇāttoyaṃ tatpītvā vyākuleṃdriyaḥ ||
udgiradvāṃtidharmeṇa tattvavidyāvimiśritam || 47 ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ bhūyaḥ śākalyaṃ kupitānanaḥ ||
ekamapyakṣaraṃ nāsti tāvakīyaṃ mamodare || 48 ||
tasmācchiṣyo'smi te nāhaṃ na ca me tvaṃ guruḥ sthitaḥ ||
sāṃprataṃ svecchayā'nyatra prayāsyāmi karoṣi kim || 49 ||
evamuktvā'tha nirgatya tasmātsthānācciraṃtanāt ||
papraccha mānavānbhūyaḥ siddhikṣetrāṇi cāsakṛt || 6.129.50 ||
tatastasya samādiṣṭaṃ kṣetrametanmanīṣibhiḥ ||
siddhidaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ na vṛthā syātkathaṃcana || 51 ||
āstāṃ tāvattapastaptvā vrataṃ niyamameva vā ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre siddhiḥ saṃvasato'pi ca || 52 ||
yenayena ca bhāvena tatra kṣetre vasejjanaḥ ||
tasyānurūpiṇī siddhiḥ śubhā syādyadi vā'śubhā || 53 ||
tacchrutvā ca drutaṃ prāpya kṣetrametaddvijottamāḥ ||
bhānumārādhayāmāsa sthāpayitvā tataḥ param || 54 ||
niyato niyatāhāro brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ||
gāyatraṃ nyāsamāsādya nirvikalpena cetasā || 55 ||
tataśca bhagavāṃstuṣṭo varṣāṃte tamuvāca saḥ ||
darśane tasya saṃsthitvā tejaḥ saṃyamya dāruṇam || 56 ||
yājñavalkya varaṃ brūhi yatte manasi rocate ||
sarvameva pradāsyāmi nādeyaṃ vidyate tvayi || 57 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
yadi tuṣṭaḥ suraśreṣṭha vedādhyayanasaṃbhave ||
gururbhava mamādyaiva mamaitadvāṃchitaṃ hṛdi | 58 ||
|| bhāskara uvāca || ||
ahaṃ tava kṛpāviṣṭastejaḥ saṃhṛtya tatparam ||
tataścātra samāyātastena no dahyase dvija || 59 ||
tasmādatraiva kuṃḍe ca maṃtrānsārasvatāñchubhān ||
vedoktānkṣepayiṣyāmi svayameva dvijottama || || 6.129.60 ||
tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā yatkiṃcidvedasaṃbhavam ||
paṭhiṣyasi sakṛttatte kaṃṭhasthaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 61 ||
tattvārthaṃ prakaṭaṃ kṛtsnaṃ viditaṃ te bhaviṣyati ||
matprasādānna saṃdehaḥ satyametanmayoditam || 62 ||
adyādi mānavaḥ prātaḥ snātvā tvatra hrade ca yaḥ ||
sāvitreṇa ca sūktena māṃ dṛṣṭvā prapaṭhiṣyati ||
tasmai tatsyādasaṃdigdhaṃ yattavoktaṃ mayā dvija || 63 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
evaṃ bhavatu deveśa yattvayoktaṃ vaco'khilam ||
paraṃ mama vaco'nyacca tacchṛṇuṣva bravīmi te || 64 ||
nāhaṃ manuṣyadharmāṇamupādhyāyaṃ kathaṃcana ||
kariṣyāmi jagannātha kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari || 65 ||
tatastasyā dadau sūryo laghimā nāma śobhanām||
vidyāṃ hi tatprabhāvāya sutuṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || 66 ||
tatastaṃ prāha karṇāṃte mamāśvānāṃ praviśya vai ||
abhyāsaṃ kuru vidyānāṃ vedādhyayanamācara || 67 ||

evamuktaḥ sa tenātha vājikarṇaṃ samāśritaḥ ||
laghurbhūtvā'paṭhadvedānbhāskarasya mukhāttataḥ || 69 ||

kṛtvopaniṣadaṃ cāru vedārthaiḥ sakalairyutam || 6.129.70 ||

tyaktvā kalevaraṃ tatra brahmadvāri vinirmite ||

iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yājñavalkyāśramamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 129 || || cha ||

<6.130>

||ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yājñavalkyasutaḥ sūta yastvayā parikīrtitaḥ ||
katamā tasya mātābhūtsarvaṃ no brūhi vistarāt || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya bhāryādvayaṃ śreṣṭhamāsītsarvaguṇānvitam||
ekā guṇavatī tasya maitreyīti prakīrtitā || 2 ||
jyeṣṭhā cānyātha kalyāṇī khyātā kātyāyanīti ca ||
yasyāḥ kātyāyanaḥ putro vedārthānāṃ prajalpakaḥ || 3 ||
tābhyāṃ kuṇḍadvayaṃ tatra saṃtiṣṭhati suśobhanam ||
yatra snātā narā yāṃti lokāṃstāṃśca mahodayān ||4 ||
kātyāyanyāśca tīrthasya śāṃḍilyāstīrthamuttamam||
pativratātvayuktāyāstathānyattatra saṃsthitam || 5 ||
yatra kātyāyanī prāptā śāṃḍilyā pratibodhitā ||
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ prāptā sapatnīduḥkhaduḥkhitā || 6 ||
tatra yā kurute snānaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ samāhitā ||
nārī mārgasite pakṣe sā saubhāgyavatī bhavet ||
atha daurbhāgyasaṃpannā kāṇā vṛddhā'tha vāmanā ||
abhīṣṭā jāyate sā ca tatprabhāvāddvijottamāḥ || 8 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kīdṛksapatnijaṃ duḥkhaṃ kātyāyanyā upasthitam ||
upadeśaḥ kathaṃ labdhaḥ śāṃḍilyāḥ sūta kīdṛśaḥ || 9 ||
kātyāyanyā samācakṣva kautukaṃ no vyavasthitam ||
sāmānyo bhavitā naiṣa upadeśastayeritaḥ || 6.130.10 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
maitreyyā saha saṃsaktaṃ yājñavalkyaṃ vilokya sā ||
kātyāyanī suduḥkhārtā saṃjātā cerṣyayā tataḥ || 11 ||
sā na snāti na bhuṃkte ca na hāsyaṃ kurute kvacit ||
kevalaṃ bāṣpapūrṇākṣī niḥśvāsāḍhyā babhūva ha || 12 ||
tataḥ kadācidevātha phalārthaṃ nirgatā bahiḥ ||
apaśyacchāṃḍilīnāma patipārśve vyavasthitām|| 13 ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭāṃ sādhvī vinayāvanatā sthitām ||
so'pi tasyā mukhāsaktaḥ sānurāgaḥ prasannadṛk || 14 ||
guṇadoṣodbhavāṃ vārtāmāpṛcchyākathayattathā ||
sā ca tau daṃpatī dṛṣṭvā saṃhṛṣṭāvitaretaram || 15 ||
citte sve ciṃtayāmāsa sudhanyeyaṃ tapasvinī ||
yasyāḥ patirmukhāsakto guṇadoṣaprajalpakaḥ ||
sānurāgaśca susnigdho nānyāṃ nārīṃ bibhartti ca || 16 ||
evaṃ saṃcitya sā sādhvī bhūyobhūyo dvijottamāḥ ||
jagāma svāśramaṃ paścānniṃdyamānā svakaṃ vapuḥ || 17 ||
tataḥ kadācidekāṃte sthitāṃ tāṃ śāṃḍilīṃ dvijāḥ ||
bahirgate bhartari ca tasyāḥ kāryeṇa kenacit || 18 ||
kātyāyanī samāgamya tataḥ papraccha sādaram ||
vada kalyāṇi me kaṃcidupadeśaṃ mahodayam || 19 ||
mukhaprekṣaḥ sadā bharttā yena strīṇāṃ prajāyate ||
nāpamānaṃ karotyeva duruktavacanaiḥ kvacit || || 6.130.20 ||
nānyāṃ saṃgacchate nārīṃ cittenāpi kathaṃcana ||
ahaṃ bhartuḥ kṛtairduḥkhairatīva paripīḍitā ||
sapatnījairviśeṣeṇa tasmānme tvaṃ prakīrtaya || || 21 ||
yathā te vaśago bharttā saṃjātaḥ kāmadaḥ sadā ||
manasāpi na saṃdadhyānnārīmeṣa kathaṃcana || 22 ||
|| śāṃḍilyuvāca || ||
śṛṇu sādhvi pravakṣyāmi tavāhaṃ guhyamuttamam ||
yathā mamābhavadvaśyo mukhaprekṣastathā patiḥ || 23 ||
mama tātaḥ kurukṣetre śāṃḍilyo munisattamaḥ ||
vānaprasthāśrame'tiṣṭhatpūrve vayasi saṃsthitaḥ || 24 ||
tatraikāhaṃ samutpannā kanyā tasya mahātmanaḥ ||
vṛddhiṃ gatā krameṇātha tasminneva tapovane || 25 ||
karomi tatra śuśrūṣāṃ homakāle yathocitām ||
nīvārādīni dhānyāni nityaṃ caivānayāmyaham || 26 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya nārado munisattamaḥ ||
āśrame mama tātasya suśrāṃtaḥ samupāgataḥ || 27 ||
tātādeśāttatastatra mayā sa viśramaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
pādaśaucādibhiḥ kṛtyaiḥ snānādyaiśca tathāparaiḥ || 28 ||
tato bhuktāvasāne'tha niviṣṭaḥ mukhasaṃsthita||

ekeyaṃ kanyakāsmākaṃ jāte vayasi saṃsthite ||
saṃjātā muniśārdūla prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || 6.130.30 ||
tadasyāḥ kīrtaya kṣipraṃ sukhopāyaṃ sukhodayam ||
vrataṃ vā niyamaṃ vā tvaṃ homaṃ vā mantrameva vā || 31 ||

priyaṃvado mukhaprekṣaḥ paranārīparāṅmukhaḥ || 32 ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa munistadanaṃtaram ||
ciraṃ dhyātvā vacaḥ prāha prasannavadanastataḥ || 33 ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre pañcapiṃḍā vyavasthitā ||
gaurī gauryā svayaṃ tatra sthāpitā parameśvarī || 34 ||
tāmeṣā vatsaraṃ yāvacchraddhayā parayā yutā ||
sadā pūjayatu prītyā tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 35 ||
tato varṣāṃtamāsādya saṃprāpsyati yathocitam ||
bharttāraṃ nātra saṃdeho yādṛgrūpaṃ yathocitam || 36
tatra pūrvaṃ gatā gaurī parityajya maheśvaram ||
gaṃgerṣyayā mahābhāge jñātvā kṣetraṃ susiddhidam || 37 ||
tataḥ sā ciṃtayāmāsa kāṃ devīṃ pūjayāmyaham ||
saubhāgyārthaṃ yato'nyā māṃ pūjayaṃti surastriyaḥ || 38 ||
tasmādahaṃ prabhaktyāḍhyā svayamātmānameva ca ||
ātmanaiva kṛtotsāhā pūjayiṣyāmi siddhaye || || 39 ||
tataḥ prāṇāgnihotrotthairmaṃtrairātharvaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
mṛtpiṃḍānpaṃca saṃyojya hyekasthāne samāhitā || 6.130.40 ||
pṛthvīmapaśca tejaśca vāyumākāśameva ca |
teṣu saṃyojayāmāsa mṛtpiṃḍeṣu nidhāya sā || 41 ||
mahadbhūtāni caitāni pañca devī yatavratā ||
tataḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ || 42 ||
atha tāṃ tatra vijñāya tapaḥsthāṃ girajāṃ bhavaḥ ||
tanmaṃtrākṛṣṭacittaśca satvaraṃ samupāgataḥ || 43 ||
provāca ca prahṛṣṭātmā kasmāttvamiha cāgatā ||
māṃ muktvā doṣanirmuktaṃ mukhaprekṣaṃ sadā ratam || 44 ||
tasmādāgaccha kailāsaṃ vṛṣārūḍhā mayā saha ||
athavā kāraṇaṃ brūhi yadi doṣo'sti me kvacit || || 45 ||
|| devyuvāca || ||
tvaṃ mūrdhnā jāhnavīṃ dhatse mūrtāṃ padajalātmikām ||
tasmānnāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi maṃdiraṃ te kathaṃcana || 46 ||
yāvanna tyajasi vyaktaṃ mama sāpatnyatāṃ gatām ||
tathā nityaṃ praṇāmaṃ tvaṃ karoṣi vṛṣabhadhvaja || 47 ||

anyathāhaṃ na yāsyāmi tava harmye kathaṃcana ||
etacchrutvā yadiṣṭaṃ te kuruṣva vṛṣabhadhvaja || 49 ||
|| deva uvāca | ||
nāhaṃ saukhyena tāṃ gaṃgāṃ dhārayāmi sureśvari || 6.130.50 ||
bhagīrathena bhūpena prārthito jñāti kāraṇāt ||
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tapastaptvā sudāruṇam || 51 ||
yena no yāti pātālaṃ gaṃgā svargaparicyutā ||
tasmāttvaṃ deva madvākyātsvamūrdhnā vaha jāhnavīm ||52||
mayā tasya pratijñātaṃ dhārayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam ||
ākāśājjāhnavīvegaṃ pataṃtaṃ dharaṇītale || 53 ||
no cedvrajeta pātālaṃ yadatra viṣayesthi?m||
tato'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ||54||
eṣā gaṃgā varārohe mama mūrdhno vinirgatā ||
himavaṃtaṃ nagaṃ bhittvā dvidhā jātā tataḥ param||55||
tataḥ siṃdhvabhidhānā sā paścimaṃ sāgaraṃ gatā||
śatāni nava saṃgṛhya nadīnāṃ parameśvari ||56||
tathā gaṃgābhidhānā ca saiva prāksāgaraṃ gatā ||
tāvatīśca samādāya nadīḥ parvatanandini ||57||
evamaṣṭādaśaitāni nadīnāṃ parvatātmaje ||
śatāni sāgare yāṃti tena nityaṃ sa tiṣṭhati ||58||
satataṃ śoṣyamāṇo'pi vāḍavena divāniśam ||
samudrasalilaṃ meghāḥ samādāya tataḥ param ||59||
martyaloke pravarṣaṃti tataḥ sasyaṃ prajāyate||
sasyena jīvate lokaḥ prabhavanti makhāstathā ||
makhāṃśena surāḥ sarve tṛptiṃ yāṃti tataḥ param|| 6.130.60 ||
etasmātkāraṇānmūrdhni devi gaṃgāṃ dadhāmyaham ||
na snehātkāmato naiva jagadyena pravartate || 61 ||
athavā santyajāmyenāṃ yadi mūrdhnaḥ kathaṃcana ||
taddūraṃ vegato bhittvā pṛthvīṃ yāti rasātalam || 62 ||
tataḥ śoṣaṃ vrajedāśu samudraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ ||
aurveṇa pīyamāno'tra tato vṛṣṭirna jāyate ||
vṛṣṭyabhāvājjagannāśaḥ satyametanmayoditam || 63 ||
evaṃ gaṃgākṛte proktaṃ mayā tava sureśvari ||
śṛṇu sandhyākṛte'nyacca yena tāṃ praṇamāmyaham|| 64 ||
iti śrīskāndemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśva rakṣetramāhātmye paṃcapiṇḍāgauryutpattivarṇanaṃnāma triṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 130 || || cha ||

<6.131>

|| deva uvāca || ||
eṣā rātriḥ samādiṣṭā dānavānāṃ sureśvari ||
piśācānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 1 ||
yatkiṃcitkriyate karma tatra snānādikaṃ śubham||
tatsarvaṃ jāyate teṣāṃ purā dattaṃ svayaṃbhuvā || 2 ||
maryādā taiḥ samaṃ yena devānāṃ ca yadā kṛtā ||
arhāṇāṃ yajñabhāgasya kāśyapānāmathāgrajām|| 3 ||
tadarthaṃ daśasāhasrā dānavā yuddha durmadāḥ ||
kuṃtaprāsakarā bhānuṃ ruṃdhantyudgatakārmukāḥ ||4||
tamuddiśya sahasrāṃśuṃ yajjalaṃ parikṣipyate|

mayā ca taṃ vimuñcaṃti mūrcchitā nipatanti ca || 9 ||

|| devyuvāca || ||

dhyānaṃ dhṛtvā susūkṣmeṇa jñānenātha svayaṃ tataḥ || 17 ||
tameva mantraṃ mantreṇa nyāsena ca viśeṣataḥ ||
samyagārādhayāmāsa saṃpūjyātmānamātmanā || 18 ||
yathā devyātmabhūtāni pṛthakkṛtvā ca paṃca ca ||

tasmānnāsti paraḥ kaścitpūjyapūjyaḥ sa eva ca ||

evaṃ yāvatsa īśānaḥ samārādhayati prabhuḥ ||

tataḥ provāca taṃ devaṃ praṇipatyakṛtāṃjaliḥ ||

tasmādāgaccha gacchāvo yatra tvaṃ vāñchasi prabho ||
kṣamyatāṃ deva me sarvaṃ na kṛtaṃ yadvacastava || 24 ||

idamūce vihasyoccairmeghagambhīrayā girā || 25 ||
yaiṣā tvayā''tmabhūtotthā nirmitā paramā tanuḥ ||

tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ śubhe ||

tathaitāṃ māmakīṃ mūrtimīśānākhyāṃ ca ye narāḥ ||
teṣāṃ duṣṭāpi yā kāntā saumyā caiva bhaviṣyati || 28 ||

|| nārada uvāca | ||

|| śāṃḍilyuvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
śrutvā kātyāyanī sarvaṃ śāṃḍilyā yatprakīrtitam ||

mārgaśīrṣe'tha saṃprāpte tṛtīyādivase site ||

tailakṣāraparityaktairgandhaiḥ kuṃkumapūrvakaiḥ || 43 ||

tasmādāgaccha gacchāva svameva bhavanaṃ śubhe || 45 ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | ||

āha bhūtaṃ tadā viṣṇurvacasā hlādayanniva || 6.132.20 ||
