tadbhūtaṃ niścalaṃ jātaṃ harṣeṇa mahatānvitam || 25 ||
tato devāḥ samutthāya tattyaktvā śastrapāṇayaḥ ||
jaghnuśca niśitaiḥ śastraiḥ palāyanasamutsukān ||
lajjāhīnāngatāmarṣāndīnavākyaprajalpakān || 26 ||
tataḥ svasthaḥ sa bhūtvā tu harirdaityairnipātitaiḥ ||
provāca padmajaṃ nāma bhūtasyāsya kuruṣva bhoḥ || 27 ||
|| brahmovāca ||. ||
anena tava vākyasya proktaṃ vākyaṃ hare yataḥ ||
vāstvetaditi yasmācca tasmādvāstu bhaviṣyati || 28 ||
evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśa āhūya viśvakarmaṇe ||
vidhānaṃ kathayāmāsa pūjārthaṃ vistarānvitam || 29 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāha yājñavalkyasutaḥ sudhīḥ ||
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya prathamaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 6.132.30 ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mamāśramapadaṃ kuha ||
anenaiva vidhānena proktena tu mahāmate || 31 ||
tatohaṃ sakalaṃ buddhvā vṛddhiṃ neṣyāmi bhūtale ||
bālāvabodhanārthāya tasmādāgaccha satvaram || 32 ||
tataḥ saṃpreṣayāmāsa taṃ brahmāpi tadaṃtikam ||
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya svasutasya hite sthitaḥ || 33 ||
viśvakarmāpi tatraitya vāstupūjāṃ yathoditām ||
cakāra brahmaṇā proktāṃ yādṛśīṃ sakalāṃ tataḥ || 34||
kātyāyano'pi tāṃ sarvāṃ dṛṣṭvā cakre sahasraśaḥ ||
tadā viśvahitārthāya śālākarmādi pūrvikām || | 35 ||
evaṃ vāstupadaṃ jātaṃ tasminkṣetre dvijottamāḥ ||
asminkṣetre naraḥ pāpātspṛṣṭo mucyeta karmaṇā || 36 ||
tathā na prāpnuyāddoṣaṃ gṛhajātaṃ kathaṃcana ||
śilpotthaṃ kupadotthaṃ ca kuvāstujamathāpi ca || 37 ||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ rohiṇīṣu ca ||
tatpadaṃ nihitaṃ tatra vāstostena mahātmanā || 38 ||
tasminnapi ca yaḥ pūjāṃ tenaiva vidhinā naraḥ ||
tasya yaḥ kurute samyaksa bhūpatvamavāpnuyāt || 39 ||
gṛhaṃ doṣānvitaṃ prāpya śilpādibhirupadrutam ||
tasyopasaṃgamaṃ prāpya samṛddhiṃ yāti taddine || 6.132.40 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vāstupadotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 132 ||

<6.133>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathā'nyāpi ca tatrāsti devatā dvijasattamāḥ ||
ajāgṛheti vikhyātā sarvarogakṣayāvahā || 1 ||
ajāpālo yadā rājā sarvalokahite rataḥ ||
ajārūpāḥ prayāṃti sma vyādhayaḥ sakalā dvijāḥ ||
tadā rātrau samānīya tasminsthāne dadhāti saḥ || 2 ||
tatastadāśrayātsthānamajāgṛhamiti smṛtam ||
sarvairjanairdharā pṛṣṭhedarśanādvyādhināśanam || 3 ||
tatraiśvaryamabhūtpūrvaṃ yattadbrāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi śrotavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ || 4 ||
tatrāgato dvijaḥ kaścitkṣetre tāpasarūpadhṛk ||
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena rātrau prāptaḥ śramānvitaḥ || 5 ||
ajāvṛṃdamathālokya niviṣṭaṃ susukhānvitam ||
romaṃtha karmasaṃyuktaṃ viśvastamakutobhayam|| 6 ||
sa jñātvā mānuṣeṇātra bhavitavyamasaṃśayam ||
na śūnyāḥ paśavo rātrau sthāsyaṃti vijane vane || 7 ||
tataḥ phūtkṛtya phūkṛtya divaṃ yāvanna saṃdadhe ||
kaścidvācaṃ prasuptaśca tāvattatraiva ciṃtayan || 8 ||
avaśyaṃ mānuṣeṇātra paśūnāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ||
āgaṃtavyaṃ kuto'pyāśu tasmāttiṣṭhāmi nirbhayaḥ || 9 ||
evaṃ tasya prasuptasya gatā sā rajanī tataḥ ||
tatastvaritavattasya suśrāṃtasya dvijottamāḥ || 6.133.10 ||
atha yāvatprabhāte sa prapaśyati nijāṃ tanum ||
tāvatkuṣṭhādibhī rogaiḥ samaṃtātparivāritām || 11 ||
aśaktaścalituṃ sthānādapi caikaṃ padaṃ kvacit ||
tejo hīno'pi raudreṇa cintayāmāsa vai tataḥ || 12 ||
kimidaṃ kāraṇaṃ yena mamaiṣā saṃsthitā tanuḥ ||
akasmādeva rogo'yaṃ calituṃ naiva ca kṣamaḥ ||13||
evaṃ cintayamānasya tasya viprasya tatkṣaṇāt||
dvādaśārkapratīkāśaḥ puruṣaḥ samupāgataḥ || 14 ||
taṃ yūthaṃ kālayāmāsa tataḥ saṃjñābhirāhvayan ||
pṛthaktvena samādāya yaṣṭiṃ savyena pāṇinā || 15 ||
athāpaśyatsa taṃ vipraṃ vyādhibhiḥ sarvato vṛtam||
aśaktaṃ calituṃ kvāpi tataḥ provāca sādaram||16||
kastvamevaṃvidhaḥ prāptaḥ sthāne cātra dvijottama ||
nāsti rājye mama vyādhiḥ kasyacitkutracitsphuṭam || 17||
ajonāma narendro'haṃ yadi te śrotramāgataḥ||
vyādhīṃśca cchāgarūpeṇa rakṣāmi janakāraṇāt ||18||
tasmādbrūhi śarīrastho yaste vyādhirvyavasthitaḥ ||
yenā'haṃ nigrahaṃ tasya karomi dvijasattama ||19||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
tīrthayātrāparo'haṃ ca bhramāmi kṣitimaṃḍale||
krameṇā'tra samāyātaḥ kṣetre'sminhāṭakeśvare || 6.133.20 ||
niśāvaktre nṛpaśreṣṭha vāsaḥ saṃciṃtito mayā ||
dṛṣṭvā'mūṃśca paśūnbhūpa mānuṣaṃ bhāvyameva hi || 21 ||
tataścātra prasupto'haṃ paśūnāmaṃtike nṛpa ||22||
atha yāvatprabhāte'haṃ prapaśyāmi nijāṃ tanum||
tāvatkuṣṭhādirogaiśca samaṃtātparivāritām || 23 ||
nānyatkiṃcinnṛpaśreṣṭha kāraṇaṃ vedmi tattvataḥ ||
kimetena nṛpaśreṣṭha bhūyobhūyaḥ prajalpatā ||
bahutvātkuru tasmānme yathā syānnīrujā tanuḥ|| 24 ||
tataste vyādhayaḥ proktā ajāpālena bhūbhujā ||
kenājñā khaṃḍitā me'dya ko vadhyaḥ sāṃprataṃ mama || 25 ||
|| vyādhaya ūcuḥ || ||
mā kopaṃ kuru bhūpāla kṛtye'smiṃstvaṃ kathaṃcana ||
yasmādeṣa dvijo viṣṭaḥ sāṃprataṃ vyādhibhistribhiḥ ||26||
rājayakṣmā ca kuṣṭhaṃ ca pāmā ca dvijasattama ||
ete saṃsargajā doṣāstrayo'dyāpi prakīrtitāḥ || 27 ||
eteṣāṃ prathamau yau dvau nivṛttirahitau smṛtau ||
auṣadhaiścaiva maṃtraiśca śeṣā nāśaṃ vrajaṃti ca ||28||
ābhyāṃ ca brahmaśāposti yena nāsti nivartanam ||
tasmādatra nṛpaśreṣṭha kuru yatte kṣamaṃ bhavet ||29||
etena brāhmaṇenaite spṛṣṭā rājaṃstrayopi ca||
tasmāttāvattanuṃ cāsyāviśatāṃ tāvasaṃśayam||6.133.30||
aparaṃ śṛṇu bhūpāla vacanaṃ no mukhāccyutam||
hitāya sarvajaṃtūnāṃ tava śreyovivṛddhaye||31||
yatra sthānaṃ ciraṃ tatra medinyāṃ vihitaṃ nṛpa|
purīṣaṃ ca samāviddhā tenaiṣā medinī drutam||32||
kālāṃtarepi ye martyā bhūmyāmasyāṃ samāgatāḥ|
bhūmeḥ sparśaṃ kariṣyaṃti te bhaviṣyaṃti cedṛśāḥ||33||
vayaṃ śeṣā mahārāja vyādhayo ye vyavasthitāḥ|
tvayā muktvā bhaviṣyāmo mantrauṣadhavaśānugāḥ ||34||
naitau punastu durgrāhyau brahmaśāpa samudbhavau ||35||
tacchrutvā pārthivaḥ so'pi tasminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ ||
taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ punaḥ prāha na bhetavyaṃ tvayā dvija || 36 ||
ahaṃ tvāṃ rakṣayiṣyāmi vyādherasmātsudāruṇāt ||
atra tasmātpratīkṣasva kañcitkālaṃ mamājñayā || 37 ||
evamuktvā tataścakre tadarthaṃ sumahattapaḥ ||
ārādhayanprabhaktyā ca samyaktāṃ kṣetradevatām ||38||
muṃḍenātharvaśīrṣeṇa divārātramataṃdritaḥ||
kṣetrapālotthasūktena vāstusūktena ca dvijāḥ||39||
siddhārthai raktapuṣpaiśca guggulena sudhūpitaiḥ||
homaṃ kurvannṛpaḥ paścānnīlarudrānviśeṣataḥ||6.133.40||
atha naktāvasānena tasya homasya cotthitā||
bhittvā dharātalaṃ devī mantrākṛṣṭā vinirgatā||41||
devatā tasya kṣetrasya tataḥ provāca taṃ nṛpam||42||
ekāhaṃ tava bhūpāla homasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
vinirgatā dharāpṛṣṭhātkṣetrasyāsyādhipā smṛtā || 43 ||
tasmādvada mahābhāga yatte kṛtyaṃ karomyaham ||
parāṃ tuṣṭimanuprāptā tasmādbrūhi yadīpsitam || 44 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
atra sthāne sadā stheyaṃ tvayā devi viśeṣataḥ ||
vyādhisaṃsargajo doṣo bhūmerasyā yathā vrajet || || 45 ||
adyaprabhṛti deveśi tathā nītirvidhīyatām ||
no cedasyāḥ prasaṃgena prabhaviṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || 46 ||
vyādhigrastā yathā vipro yo'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate puraḥ ||
mayātra vyādhayaḥ kālaṃ ciraṃ saṃsthāpitā yataḥ ||
bhaviṣyati ca me doṣo no ceddevi na saṃśayaḥ || 47 ||
tathāyaṃ brāhmaṇo rogāttvatprasādātsureśvari ||
mukto bhavatu medinyāmatra stheyaṃ sadā tvayā ||48||
|| kṣetradevatovāca || ||
etatsthānaṃ mayā sarvaṃ vyādhidoṣavivarjitam ||
vihitaṃ sarvadaivātra sthāsye'hamiha sarvadā ||49||
sāṃprataṃ yo'tra me sthāne vyādhigrastaḥ sameṣyati ||
pūjayiṣyati māṃ bhaktyā nīrogaḥ sa bhaviṣyati || 6.133.50 ||
tasmādadya dvijeṃdro'yaṃ māṃ pūjayatu sādaram ||
bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ|| 51 ||
atra kṣetre parā'nyāsti vikhyātā caṃdrakūpikā| ||
tasyāṃ snātu yathānyāyaṃ nityameva mahīpate || 52 ||
dakṣaśāpapraśaptena yā caṃdreṇa purā kṛtā ||
svasnānārthaṃ kṣayavyādhipragrastena mahātmanā | 53 ||
tathā khaṇḍaśilānāma devatā cātra tiṣṭhati ||
saubhāgyakūpikāsnānaṃ kṛtvā tāṃ ca prapaśyatu ||54||
yā kṛtā kāmadevena kuṣṭhagrastena vai purā |
snapanārthaṃ ca kuṣṭhasya vināśāya ca sādaram || 55||
tathā cāpsarasāṃ kuṇḍamatrāsti nṛpasattama ||
tatra snātvā raverahni tataḥ pāmā praśāmyati || 96 ||
|| sūta uvāca ||
tataḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ prāpya supuṇyāṃ candrakūpikām ||
snānaṃ kṛtvā ca tāṃ devīṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ||
yāvanmāsaṃ tato muktaḥ satvaraṃ rājayakṣmaṇā || 57
tataḥ saubhāgyakūpīṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmavinirmitām ||
tathā snānaṃ vidhāyātha paśyankhaṃḍaśilāṃ ca tām || 58 ||
tadvanmāsena nirmuktaḥ kuṣṭhena dvijasattamāḥ ||
tasyā devyāḥ prabhāvena kūpikāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | 59 ||
tataścāpsarasāṃ kuṃḍe snātvaikaṃ ravivāsaram ||
pāmayā saṃparityakto buddhyeva viṣayātmakaḥ || 6.133.60 ||
tataḥ sa brāhmaṇo jāto dvādaśārkasamaprabhaḥ ||
toṣeṇa mahatā yukto dattāśīstasya bhūpateḥ || 61 ||
prayayau vāṃchitaṃ deśamanujñātaśca bhūbhujā ||
devatāyāṃ praṇāmaṃ ca tābhyāṃ kṛtvā punaḥpunaḥ || 62 ||
sopi rājā sadoṣāṃstānajārūpānvilokya ca ||
svasyaiva brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ tathā saṃpraharṣitaḥ || 63 ||
svayaṃ ca prayayau tatra yatrastho hāṭakeśvaraḥ ||
tenaiva ca śarīreṇa nijakāṃtāsamanvitaḥ ||64 ||
ajāgṛhe sthitā yasmātsā devī kṣetradevatā ||
ajāgṛhā tataḥ khyātā sarvatraiva dvijottamāḥ || 65 ||
adyāpi yakṣmaṇā grasto yastāṃ pūjayate naraḥ ||
tainaiva vidhinā samyaksa nīrogo drutaṃ bhavet|| 66 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'jāgṛhotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 133 ||

<6.134>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadā dakṣeṇa kruddhena purā śapto himadyutiḥ ||
tatsarvaṃ bhavatā proktaṃ somanāthakathānakam|| 1 ||
sāṃprataṃ vada kāmasya yathā kuṣṭho'bhavatpurā ||
yena doṣeṇa śāpaśca kena tasya niyojitaḥ || 2 |
śilākhaṃḍā ca yā devī tathā saubhāgyakūpikā ||
yathā tatra samutpannā tathā'smākaṃ prakīrtaya || 3 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
purāsīdbrāhmaṇo nāma hārīta iti viśrutaḥ ||
sa tapastatra saṃtepe vānaprasthāśrame vasan || 4 ||
tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī rūpaudāryasamanvitā ||
trailokyasundarī sākṣāllakṣmīriva madhudviṣaḥ || 5 ||
khyātā pūṇakalānāma sarvaiḥ samuditāguṇaiḥ ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā padmajo'pyāśu kāmasya vaśago'bhavat || 6 ||
kadācidapi sa prāptastasminkṣetre manobhavaḥ ||
saha ratyā tathā prītyā kāmeśvaradidṛkṣayā || 7 ||
etasminnaṃtare sāpi snānārthaṃ tatra cāgatā ||
kṛtvā vastraparityāgaṃ viveśa jalāśayam || 8 ||
atha tāṃ kāmadevopi samālokya śubhānanām||
ātmīyairapi nirviddho hṛdaye puṣpasāyakaiḥ || 9 ||
tato ratiṃ parityaktvā prītiṃ ca śarapīḍitaḥ||
vijanaṃ kaṃcidāsādya prasuptaḥ sa taroradhaḥ || 6.134.10 ||
gātraiḥ pulakitaiḥ sarvairniḥśvāsānniḥśvasanmuhuḥ ||
agnivarṇānsudīrghāṃśca bāṣpa pūrṇavilocanaḥ || 11 ||
tiṣṭhansa darśane tasyā ekadṛṣṭyā vyalokayat||
yogīva susamādhistho dhyāyaṃstadbrahma saṃsthitam || 12 ||
sāpi kāmaṃ samālokya sānurāgaṃ puraḥ sthitam ||
jṛṃbhābhaṃgakṛtāsyaṃ ca vepamānaśarīrakam || 13 ||
sāpi tadbāṇanirbhinnā sābhilāṣā babhūva ha ||
kāmaṃ prati viśeṣeṇa tasya rūpeṇa mohitā || 14 ||
atha tasmājjalātkṛcchrādviniṣkramya śucismitā ||
tīropāṃtaṃ samāsādya sthitā taddṛṣṭigocare || 15 ||
tataḥ kāmaḥ samutthāya śanaistadaṃtikaṃ yayau ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā tataḥ provāca sādaram || 16 ||
kā tvamatra viśālākṣi prāptā snātuṃ jalāśaye ||
mama nāśāya cārvaṃgi tasmācchṛṇu vaco mama || 17 ||
ahaṃ puṣpaśaro loke prasiddhaścāruhāsini ||
viḍaṃbanāṃ mayā nītā devā api nijaiḥ śaraiḥ || 18 ||
madbāṇenāhato rudraḥ svaśarīre nitaṃbinīm ||
arddhena dhārayāmāsa tyaktvā lajjāṃ sudūrataḥ || 19 ||
brahmā maccharanirbhinnaḥ svasutāṃ cakame tataḥ ||
janayāmāsa tānviprānvālakhilyāṃstathāvidhān || 20 ||
ahilyāṃ cakame śakro gautamasya priyāṃ satīm ||
madbāṇaiḥ pīḍito'tīva svargādetya dharātalam || 21 ||
evaṃ devā api kṣuṇṇā maccharairye mahattarāḥ ||
kiṃ punarmānavāḥ subhrūḥ kṛmiprāyāḥ sucaṃcalāḥ || 22 ||
ākīṭāṃtaṃ jagatsarvamābrahmāṃtaṃ tathaiva ca ||
viḍaṃbanāṃ parāṃ prāptaṃ maccharaiścāruhāsini || 23 ||
ahaṃ punastvayā bhīru nīto'vasthāmimāṃ śubhe || 24 ||
tasmāddehi mahābhāge mamādya ratadakṣiṇām ||
yāvanna yāṃti saṃtyajya mama prāṇāḥ kalevarāt || || 25 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sāpi tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pativrataparāyaṇā ||
hanyamānā viśeṣeṇa tadbāṇairhṛdaye bhṛśam || 26 ||
anabhijñā ca sā sādhvī kāmadharmasya kevalam ||
tāpasaiḥ saha saṃvṛddhā nānyaṃ jānāti kiṃcana || 27 ||
vaktuṃ tadviṣaye yacca procyate kāmapīḍitaiḥ ||
adhomukhā'likhadbhūmimaṃguṣṭhena sthitā ciram || 28 ||
etasminnantare bhānuḥ prāptaścāstaṃ giriṃ prati ||
vihārasamaye prāpta āhitāgnirniveśane || 29 ||
hārīto'pi ciraṃ vīkṣya tanmārgaṃ cākṛtāśanaḥ ||
tataḥ sa ciṃtayāmāsa kasmātsā cātra nāgatā || 30 ||
snātvā tīrthavare tasmindṛṣṭvā tāṃ candrakūpikām||
kāmeśvaraṃ ca deveśaṃ kāmadaṃ sukhadaṃ nṛṇām || 31 ||
tataḥ śiṣyasamāyukto vīkṣamāṇa itastataḥ ||
taṃ deśaṃ samanuprāpto yatra tau dvāvapi sthitau || 32 ||
ālapanbahudhā kāmo hanyamāno nijaiḥ śaraiḥ ||
sāpi caiva viśeṣeṇa vrīḍayā'dhomukhī sthitā || 33 ||
sa gulmāṃtaritaḥ sarvaṃ tacchrutvā kāmajalpitam ||
tasyāśca tadgataṃ bhāvaṃ tataḥ kopāduvāca saḥ || 34 ||
yasmātpāpa tvayā patnī mamaivaṃ śarapīḍitā ||
anabhijñā tathā sādhvī patidharmaparāyaṇā ||
kuṣṭhavyādhisamāyuktastasmādvipriyadarśanaḥ || 35 ||
tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi pāpātmanmukto dāraiḥ svakairapi ||
sā'pi caiva viśeṣeṇa vrīḍayā'dhomukhī sthitā || 36 ||
eṣāpi ca śilāprāyā bhaviṣyati vicetanā ||
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā yā sarāgā'bhūnnijadharmabahiṣkṛtā || 37 ||
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa taṃ kāmaḥ praṇipatya ca ||
na jñāteyaṃ mayā vipra tava bhāryeti sundarī || 38 ||
tena proktā viruddhāni vākyāni vividhāni ca ||
etasyā nāsti doṣo'tra madbāṇaiḥ pīḍitā bhṛśam || 39
sānurāgā paraṃ jātā noktaṃ kiṃcidvaco mune ||
tasmānnārhasi śāpaṃ tvaṃ dātumasyāḥ kathaṃcana || 40 ||
mamāstyeṣo 'parādho'tra tasmānme nigrahaṃ kuru ||
bhūyo'pi brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha asyāḥ śāpasamudbhavam || 41 ||
api rudrādayo devā madbāṇebhyo dvijottama ||
soḍhuṃ śaktā na te yasmāttatkathaṃ syādiyaṃ śilā || 42 ||
tathātra trividhaṃ pāpaṃ pravadaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva karmajaṃ ca tṛtīyakam||
tadasmākaṃ dvidhā jātamekaṃ cāsyā munīśvara | 43 ||
bhāryāyāste surūpāyāstasmātsaṃpūrṇanigraham ||
kariṣyasi na te bhītiḥ kācidasti paratrajā || || 44 ||
manastāpādvrajetpāpaṃ mānasaṃ vācikaṃ ca yat ||
tasya prasādanenaiva yasyopari vijalpitam || 45 ||
prāyaścittairyathoktaiśca karmajaṃ pātakaṃ vrajet |
dharmaśāstraiḥ pariproktaṃ yataḥ sarvairmahāmune || 46 ||
|| hārīta uvāca || ||
anyatra viṣaye tasyāḥ pātakaṃ kāmadevate ||
etasya tava dharmasya prādhānyaṃ manasaḥ smṛtam || 47 ||
tasmādevaṃvidhā ceyaṃ sadā sthāsyati cādhama ||
kiṃ punaḥ kuru yatkṛtyaṃ nāhaṃ vakṣyāmi kiṃcana || 48 ||
prathamaṃ manasā sarvaṃ ciṃtyate tadanaṃtaram ||
tataḥ prajalpate vācā kriyate karmaṇā tataḥ || 49 ||
pramāṇaṃ hi manastasmātsarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā ||
etasmātkāraṇātpūrṇo mayā'syā nigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ || 50 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā muniśreṣṭho hārītaḥ svāśramaṃ yayau ||
sāpi pūrṇakalā jātā śilārūpā ca tatkṣaṇāt || 51 ||
kāmadevo'pi kuṣṭhena grasto raudreṇa ca dvijāḥ ||
śīrṇanāsāṃghripāṇiśca netrāṇāmapriyo'bhavat|| 52 ||
atha kāme nirutsāhe saṃjāte dvijasattamāḥ ||
vyādhigraste jagatyasminsṛṣṭirodho vyajāyata ||53||
kevalaṃ kṣīyate loko naiva vṛddhiṃ pragacchati ||
svedajā ye'pi jīvāḥ syustepi yātāḥ parikṣayam || 54 ||
etasminnaṃtare devāḥ sarve ciṃtāsamākulāḥ ||
kimidaṃ kṣīyate loko jalasthaiḥ sthalajaiḥ saha ||55||
na dṛśyate kvacidbālaḥ ko'pi kaścitkathaṃcana ||
na ca garbhavatī nārī kaccitkṣemaṃ smarasya ca || ||56||
tatastaṃ vyādhinā grastaṃ jñātvātra kṣetrasaṃśrayam ||
ājagmustvaritāḥ sarve vyākulenāṃtarātmanā||57||
kāmeśvarapurasthaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā kusumāyudham||
atyaṃtavikṛtākāraṃ ciṃtayānaṃ maheśvaram || 58 ||
tataḥ procuḥ suduḥkhārtāḥ kimidaṃ kusumāyudha ||
nirutsāhaḥ samutpannaḥ kuṣṭhavyādhisamākulaḥ ||59||
tataścādhomukho jāto lajjayā parayā vṛtaḥ ||
provāca śāpajaṃ sarvaṃ hārītasya viceṣṭitam || 6.134.60 ||
tataste vibudhāḥ procuḥ pātakaṃ yadgirā kṛtam ||3
tattasyārādhanātsarvaṃ saṃkṣayaṃ yātyasaṃśayam || 61 ||
tasmādetāṃ śilārūpāṃ tvamārādhaya cittaja ||
yena kuṣṭhaḥ kṣayaṃ yāti tatastejo'bhivardhate || 62 ||
jagati syānmahāsṛṣṭirdevakṛtyaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet ||
na te'sti kāyajaṃ pāpaṃ yato muktvā pravācikam || 63 ||
atra kuṇḍe tvadīye'nyo yaḥ snātvā śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
enāṃ pāpavinirmuktāṃ śilāṃ vai mānavaḥ spṛśet || 64 ||
kuṣṭhavyādhisamopetaḥ kāyotthenāpi karmaṇā ||
so'pi vyādhivinirmukto bhaviṣyati gatajvaraḥ || 65 ||
etatsaubhāgyakūpaṃ ca loke khyātaṃ jalāśayam ||
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ sarvarogakṣayāvaham || 66 ||
dadrūṇi durvibhūtāni tathānyāśca vicarcikāḥ ||
atra snātasya yāsyaṃti dṛṣṭvaitāṃ sadya eva hi || 67 ||
evamuktvātha te devāḥ prajagmustridaśālayam ||
kāmadevo'pi tatrasthastasyāḥ pūjāmatha vyadhāt || 68 ||
tataśca samatikrāṃte māsamātre dvijottamāḥ ||
tādṛgrūpaḥ sa saṃjāto yādṛgāsītpurā smaraḥ || 69 ||
tataścāyatanaṃ tasyāḥ kṛtvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
jagāma vāṃchitaṃ deśaṃ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ yatnamāsthitaḥ || 6.134.70 ||
sāpi namramukhī tādṛktena śaptā tathaiva ca ||
saṃjātā khaṇḍakākārā tena khaṇḍaśilā smṛtā || 71 ||
yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā trayodaśyāṃ tathaiva ca ||
nāpavādo bhavettasya paradārasamudbhavaḥ || 72 ||
kāminyāśca viśeṣeṇa prāhaitacchaṃkarātmajaḥ ||
kārtikeyo dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ satyametanmayoditam || 73 ||
tathā kāmeśvaraṃ devaṃ kāmadevapratiṣṭhitam ||
trayodaśyāṃ samārādhya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 74 ||
ratiprītisamāyuktaḥ sthitastatra smarastathā ||
mūrto brāhmaṇaśārdūlāḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prāsādamāśritaḥ | 75 |
virūpo durbhago yo vā trayodaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
yastaṃ kuṃkumajaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayati mānavaḥ || 76 ||
sa saubhāgyasamāyukto rūpavāṃśca prajāyate ||
yā nārī patinā tyaktā sapatnījanasaṃvṛtā || 77 ||
taṃ devaṃ sukalatrāḍhyaṃ tathaiva paripūjayet ||
trayodaśyāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kesaraiḥ kuṃkumodbhavaiḥ || 78 ||
sā saubhāgyavatī viprā jāyate ca prajāvatī ||
dhanadhānyasamṛddhā ca duḥkhaśokavivarjitā ||
doṣaiḥ sarvairvinirmuktā śaṃsitā dharaṇītale || 79 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye khaṃḍaśilāsaubhāgyakūpikotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśaduttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 134 ||

<6.135>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyāpi ca tatrāsti dīrghikākhyā suśobhanā ||
sarasī lokavikhyātā sarvapātakanāśanī || 1 ||
yasyāṃ snāto naraḥ samyagbhāskarasyodayaṃ prati ||
jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||2||
āsītpūrvaṃ dvijo vīraśarmanāmātiviśrutaḥ ||
vedavidyāvratasnāto vardhamāne purottame || 3 ||
tasya kanyā samutpannā kadācillakṣaṇāccyutā ||
atidīrghā pramāṇena janahāsyavivarddhinī || 4 ||
tataḥ sā yauvanaṃ prāptā tadrūpāpi kumārikā ||
na kaścidvarayāmāsa śāstravākyamanusmaran || 5 ||
atisaṃkṣiptakeśā yā atidīrghātivāmanā ||
udvāhayati yaḥ kanyāṃ puruṣaḥ kāmamohitaḥ || 6 ||
ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare mṛtyuṃ sa prāpnoti naro dhruvam ||
etasmātkāraṇātsarve tāṃ tyajaṃti kumārikām || 7 ||
puruṣā atidīrghatvayuktāṃ vīkṣya samaṃtataḥ ||
tato vairāgyamāpannā tapastepe'tidāruṇam|| 8 ||
cāṃdrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tayā cīrṇānyanekaśaḥ ||
pārākāṇi yathoktāni tathā sāṃtapanāni ca || 9 ||
vrataṃ yadvidyate kiṃcinniyamaḥ saṃyamastathā ||
anyaccāpi śubhaṃ kṛtyaṃ tatsarvaṃ ca tayā kṛtam || 6.135.10 ||
evaṃ tasyā vratasthāyā jarā samyagupasthitā ||
tathāpi tejaso vṛddhirvavṛdhe tapasā kṛtā || 11 ||
sā ca nityaṃ mahendrasya sabhāṃ yātyatikautukāt ||
devarṣīṇāṃ mataṃ śrotuṃ devatānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 12 ||
yadā sā svāsanaṃ tyaktvā prayāti svagṛhonmukhī ||
tadaivābhyukṣaṇaṃ cakrustatra śakrasya kiṃkarāḥ || 13 ||
tathānyadivase dṛṣṭaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ tayā hi tat ||
abhyukṣaṇaṃ svakīye ca āsane dvijasattamāḥ || || 14 ||
tataḥ kopaparītāṃgī dīrghikā sā kumārikā ||
triśākhāṃ bhṛkuṭīṃ kṛtvā tataḥ prāha puraṃdaram || 15 ||
kiṃ doṣaṃ vīkṣya me śakra prokṣitaṃ cāsanaṃ tvayā ||
paradvā rakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ kiṃ mayaitatkṛtaṃ kvacit || 16 ||
tasmānme pātakaṃ brūhi no cecchāpaṃ sudāruṇam ||
tvayi dāsyāmyasaṃdigdhaṃ satye nātmānamālabhe || 17 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
na te dīrghe'stidoṣotra kaścidekaṃ vinā śubhe ||
tenātha kriyate caitadāsanasyābhiṣecanam || || 18 ||
tvaṃ kumāryapi saṃprāptā ṛtukālaṃ vigarhitā ||
tena doṣaṃ tvamāpannā nānyadastīha kāraṇam || 19 ||
tasmādadyāpi tvāṃ kaścidudvāhayati tāpasaḥ ||
tvaṃ taṃ varaya bharttāraṃ yena gacchasi medhyatām || 6.135.20 ||
tataśca lajjayā yuktā sā tadā dīrghakanyakā ||
gatvā bhūmitale tūrṇaṃ vardhamāne purottame || 21 ||
tataḥ phūtkartumārabdhā catvareṣu trikeṣu ca ||
ucchritya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ bhramamāṇā itastataḥ || 22 ||
yadi kaściddvijo jātyā karoti mama sāṃpratam ||
pāṇigrāhaṃ tapo'rddhasya śreyo yacchāmi tasya ca ||23||
evaṃ tāṃ pravijalpantīṃ śrutvā lokā divāniśam ||
unmattāmiti manvānā hāsyaṃ cakruḥ parasparam || 24 ||
tataḥ katipayāhasya prakurvaṃtī ca dīrghikā ||
kuṣṭhavyādhigṛhītena brāhmaṇena pariśrutā || 25 ||
tataḥ provāca mandaṃ sa samāhūya suduḥkhitām || 26 ||
ahaṃ tvāmudvahāmyadya kṛtvā pāṇigrahaṃ tava ||
yadi madvacanaṃ sarvaṃ sarvadaivānutiṣṭhasi || 27 || ||
|| kumārikovāca || ||
kariṣyāmi na saṃdehastava vākyaṃ dvijādhipa ||
kuru pāṇigrahaṃ me'dya vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 28 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatastasyāḥ kumāryāḥ sa pāṇiṃ jagrāha dakṣiṇam ||
gṛhyoktena vidhānena devāgnigurusaṃnidhau || 29 ||
atha sā prāha bhūyo'pi vivāhakṛtamaṃgalā ||
ādeśaṃ dehi me nātha yaṃ karomi tavādhunā || 6.135.30 ||
|| patiruvāca || ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu snātumicchāmi sundari ||
sāhāyyena tvadīyena yadi śaknoṣi tatkuru || 31 ||
bāḍhamityeva sā procya tatastūrṇaṃ pativratā ||
tatpramāṇaṃ dṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā ramyaṃ vaṃśakuṭīrakam || 32 ||
mṛdu tūlasamāyuktaṃ tataḥ prāha nijaṃ patim ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭā bhūtvā prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 33 ||
etattava kṛte ramyaṃ kṛtaṃ vaṃśakuṭīrakam ||
mama nāthāruhāśu tvaṃ yena kṛtvātha mūrdhani ||
nayāmi sarvatīrtheṣu kṣetreṣu suśubheṣu ca || 34 ||
tataḥ kuṣṭhī prahṛṣṭātmā śanairutthāya bhūtalāt ||
tayā coddhṛtadehaḥ sansupto vaṃśakuṭīrake || 35 ||
tatastaṃ mastake kṛtvā sarvatīrthe yathāsukham ||
sarvakṣetreṣu babhrāma snāpayantī nijaṃ patim || 36 ||
yathā yathā sa cakre'tha snānaṃ tīrtheṣu kuṣṭhabhāk ||
tathātathāsya gātreṣu tejo vṛddhiṃ pragacchati ||37||
tataḥ krameṇa sā sādhvī bhramamāṇā mahītale ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre saṃprāptā rajanī mukhe || 38 ||
klāntā vaiklavyamāpannā bhārākrāntā pativratā ||
nidrāndhā niśvasantī ca praskhalantī padepade || 39 ||
atha tatra pradeśe tu māṇḍavyo munipuṃgavaḥ ||
śūlāropitagātrastu saṃtiṣṭhati suduḥkhitaḥ || 6.135.40 ||
atha sā taṃ samāsādya śūlaṃ rātrau pativratā ||
nijagātreṇa bhārārttā gacchamānā mahāsatī || 41 ||
tayā saṃcālitaḥ so'tha māṃḍavyo munipuṃgavaḥ ||
parāṃ pīḍāṃ samāsādya tataḥ prāha suduḥkhitaḥ ||42||
kenedaṃ pāpmanā śalyaṃ mamāṃtaḥ paricālitam ||
yenāhaṃ duḥkhayukto'pi bhūyo duḥkhāspadīkṛtaḥ || 43 ||
|| dīrghikovāca || ||
na mayā tvaṃ mahābhāga nidropahatayā dṛśā ||
dṛṣṭastena parispṛṣṭo hyaspṛśyaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ || 44 ||
na tvayā sadṛśaścānyaḥ pāpātmāsti dharātale ||
śirasyudbhūtaśūlo'pi yo mṛtyuṃ nādhigacchati || || 45 ||
ahaṃ pativratā mūḍha vahāmi śirasā dhṛtam ||
tīrthayātrākṛte kāṃtaṃ vikalāṃgaṃ suvallabham || 46 ||
kasmāttasyāstiraskāraṃ mama yacchasi niṣṭhuram||
ajñātāṃ mūḍhabuddhiḥ sanviśeṣānmānuṣodbhavām || 47 ||
|| māṇḍavya uvāca || ||
ahaṃ yādṛktvayā proktastādṛgeva na saṃśayaḥ ||
pāpātmā mūḍhabuddhiśca aspṛśyaḥ sarvadehinām || 48 ||
yadi prātastavāyaṃ ca bharttā jīvati niṣṭhure ||
yena me janitā pīḍā prāṇāṃtakaraṇī dṛḍhā || 49 ||
tasmādeṣa tavābhīṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||
mayā śaptaḥ parityāgaṃ jīvitasya kariṣyati || 6.135.50 ||
|| dīrghikovāca || ||
yadyevaṃ maraṇaṃ patyuḥ prabhāte saṃbhaviṣyati ||
madīyasya tataḥ prātarnodgamiṣyati bhāskaraḥ || 51 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ sātha niṣasāda dharātale ||
bhūmau tadbhartṛsaṃyuktaṃ muktvā vaṃśakuṭīrakam || 52 ||
atha tāṃ prāha kuṣṭhī sa pipāsā saṃpravartate ||
tasmāttoyaṃ samānehi pānārthamatiśītalam || 53 ||
tathaiva sā samākarṇya bharturādeśamutsukā ||
itastataśca babhrāma jalārthaṃ na prapaśyati ||
na ca niryāti dūraṃ sā tyaktvāraṇye tathāvidham || 54 ||
bhartāraṃ śvāpadotthaṃ ca bhayaṃ hṛdi vitanvatī ||
upaviśya tato bhūmau spṛṣṭvā pādau patestadā ||
provāca dīrghikā vākyaṃ tāravākyena duḥkhitā || 55 ||
pativratā tvamācīrṇaṃ yadi samyaṅmayā sphuṭam ||
tena satyena bhūpṛṣṭhānnirgacchatu jalaṃ śubham || 56 ||
evamuktvā jaghānātha pādāghātena medinīm ||
kāntabhaktiṃ puraskṛtya tasya jīvitavāṃchayā || 57 ||
etasminnantare toyaṃ pādāghātādanantataram ||
niṣkrāṃtaṃ nirmalaṃ svādu māṇḍavyasya ca paśyataḥ || 58 ||
tatastaṃ snāpayāmāsa tasmiṃstoye śramāturam ||
apāyayattataḥ paścātsvayaṃ snātvā papau jalam || 59 ||
etasminnaṃtare sūryaḥ pativratakṛtādbhayāt ||
nābhyudeti samutpannastataḥ kālātyayo mahān || 6.135.60 ||
atha rātriṃ samālokya dīrghāṃ ye kāmukā janāḥ ||
te sarve tuṣṭimāpannāstathā ca kula striyaḥ || 61 ||
kauśikā rākṣasāścāpi corā jārāśca ye narāḥ ||
te sarve procuḥ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ samāliṃgya parasparam || 62||
adyāsmākaṃ vidhistuṣṭo bhagavānmanmathastathā ||
yena dīrghā kṛtā rātrirnāśaṃ nītaśca bhāskaraḥ || 63 ||
ye punarbrāhmaṇāḥ śāṃtā yajñakarmasamudyatāḥ ||
te sarve duḥkhamāpannāḥ sūryodayavinākṛtāḥ || 64 ||
na kaścidyajanaṃ cakre yājanaṃ na ca saddvijaḥ ||
na śrāddhaṃ na ca saṃkalpaṃ na svādhyāyaṃ kathaṃcana || || 65 ||
na snānaṃ na ca dānaṃ ca lokayātrāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
vyavahāraṃ na kṛtyaṃ ca kiṃciddharmasamudbhavam || 66 ||
etasminnantare devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ |
paraṃ dauḥsthyaṃ samāpannā yajñabhāgavivarjitāḥ || 67 ||
tato bhāskaramāsādya ūcurduḥkhasamanvitāḥ ||
kasmānnodgamanaṃ deva prakaroṣi divākara || || 68 ||
etattvayā vinā sarvaṃ jagadvyākulatāṃ gatam || 69 ||
tasmāllokahitārthāya tvamudgaccha yathāpurā ||
agniṣṭomādikā yajñā vartaṃte yena bhūtale || 6.135.70 ||
|| sūrya uvāca | ||
pativratāsamādeśāttyaktaścābhyudayo mayā ||
tasmādgatvā surāḥ sarve tāṃ vadaṃtu kṛte mama || 71 ||
yena tadvākyamāsādya pravarttāmi yathāsukham ||
anyathā māṃ śapetkruddhā nūnaṃ sā hi pativratā || 72 ||
evaṃ sā tapasā yuktā protkṛṣṭaṃ hi surottamāḥ ||
pativratātvamādhatte tathānyadaparaṃ mahat || 73 ||
kastasyā vacanaṃ śaktaḥ kartumevamato'nyathā ||
etasmātkāraṇādbhīto nodgacchāmi kathaṃcana|| 74 ||
na tatkratusahasreṇa yajaṃtaḥ prāpnuyuḥ phalam ||
pativratātvamāpannā yatstrī viṃdati kevalam || 79 ||
tataste vibudhāḥ sarve gatvā tatkṣetramuttamam ||
procustāṃ dīrghikāṃ vākyairmṛdubhiḥ purataḥ sthitāḥ || 76 ||
tvayā pativrate sūryo yanniṣiddho na tatkṛtam ||
śubhaṃ yato hatāḥ sarvā bhūtale śobhanāḥ kriyāḥ ||77||
tasmādudgacchatu prājñe tvadvākyāttīkṣṇadīdhitiḥ ||
yajñakriyā viśeṣeṇa yena vartaṃti bhūtale || 78 ||
|| pativratovāca ||
ayaṃ ca me patiḥ sadyaḥ prāṇebhyo'pi ca yaḥ priyaḥ ||
so'bhyeti nidhanaṃ devāḥ prodgate ravimaṃḍale || 79 ||
śaptaścānena duṣṭena māṃḍavyena supāpmanā ||
kāryaṃ vināpi nirdiṣṭastadbrūyāṃ bhāskaraṃ katham || 6.135.80 ||
udayārthaṃ na me yajñaiḥ kāryaṃ kiṃcinna cāparaiḥ ||
śrāddhadānādikaiḥ kṛtyaiḥ saṃjātairdaryitaṃ vinā || 81 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataste vibudhāḥ sarve samālokya parasparam ||
cirakālaṃ suduḥkhārtāstāmūcurvinayānvitāḥ || 82 ||
udgacchatu ravirbhadre tavāyaṃ dayitaḥ patiḥ ||
prayātu nidhanaṃ sadyo bhūyādeṣa munīśvaraḥ || 83 ||
punarjīvāpayiṣyāmo vayamenamapi drutam ||
mṛtyumārgamanuprāptaṃ tvatkṛte pativatsale || 84 ||
pañcaviṃśativarṣīyaṃ kāmadevamivāparam ||
tvaṃ drakṣyasi sudīptāṃgaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 85 ||
bhūtvā paṃcadaśābdīyā padmapatrāyatekṣaṇā ||
martyaloke sukhaṃ samyaktvecchayā sādhayiṣyasi || 86 ||
eṣo'pi muniśārdūlo vipāpmā sāṃprataṃ śubhe ||
śūlavedhena nirmuktaḥ sukhabhāgī bhavatklama|| || 87 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
bāḍhamityeva ca prokte tayā sa dvijasattamāḥ ||
udgato bhagavānsūryastatkṣaṇādeva vegataḥ || 88 ||
tataḥ sūryāṃśusaṃspṛṣṭaḥ sa mṛtaśca sukuṣṭhabhāk ||
vibudhānāṃ karaiḥ spṛṣṭaḥ punareva samutthitaḥ || 89 ||
paṃcaviṃśativarṣīyaḥ kāmadeva ivāparaḥ ||
saṃsmaranpūrvikāṃ jātiṃ sarvā harṣa samanvitaḥ || 6.135.90 ||
dīrghikāpi parispṛṣṭā svayaṃ devena śaṃbhunā |
saṃjātā yauvanopetā divyalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 91 ||
padmapatrekṣaṇā ramyā candrabimbasamānanā ||
madhye kṣāmā sugaurāṃgī pīnonnatapayodharā || 92 ||
tatastaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ śūlāgrādavatārya ca ||
procuśca vibudhaśreṣṭhāḥ sādaraṃ harṣasaṃyutāḥ ||93||
etatsatyaṃ kṛtaṃ vākyaṃ mune tava yathoditam||
mṛto'pi brāhmaṇaḥ kuṣṭhī saṃspṛṣṭo raviraśmibhiḥ||94||
punarutthāpito'smābhiḥ kṛtaśca taruṇaḥ punaḥ||
anayā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ tasmāttvaṃ svāśramaṃ vraja ||95||
nāsmākaṃ darśanaṃ vyarthaṃ kathaṃcidapi jāyate ||
tasmātprārthaya yaccitte tava nityaṃ samāśritam ||96||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye pativratāvaralābhonāma pañcatriṃśaduttaraśatata mo'dhyāyaḥ || 135 || || cha || ||

<6.136>

māṃḍavya uvāca || ||
grahīṣyāmi suraśreṣṭhā varaṃ yuṣmatsamudravam ||
paraṃ me nirṇayaṃ caikaṃ dharmarājaḥ pracakṣatu|| | 1 ||
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ loke kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ||
upatiṣṭhati nānyatra satyametatsurottamāḥ || 2 ||
mayāpyatra pare cāpi kiṃ kṛtaṃ pātakaṃ ca yat ||
īdṛśīṃ vedanāṃ prāpto na ca mṛtyuṃ kathacana || 3 ||
|| dharmarāja uvāca || ||
anyadehe tvayā vipra bālabhāvena vartatā ||
śūlāgreṇa sutīkṣṇena kāye viddho bakaḥ kṣitau || 4 ||
nānyatkṛtamapi svalpaṃ pātakaṃ kiṃcideva hi ||
etasmātkāraṇādeṣā vyathā saṃsevitā dvija || 5 || ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhṛśaṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ ||
tatastaṃ prāha māṃḍavyo dharmarājaṃ puraḥ sthitam || 6 ||
asya svalpāparādhasya yasmādbhūyānvinigrahaḥ ||
kṛtastvayā sudurbuddhe tasmācchāpaṃ gṛhāṇa me || 7 ||
tvaṃ prāpya mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ śūdrayonau vyavasthitaḥ ||
jātikṣayakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ prabhūtaṃ sevayiṣyasi || 8 ||
tathā kṛtā mayaiṣādya vyavasthā sarvadehinām ||
aṣṭamādvatsarādūrdhyaṃ karmaṇā garhitena ca ||
pragrahīṣyati vai jaṃtuḥ puruṣo yoṣideva vā || 9 ||
evamuktvā sa māṃḍavyo dharmarājaṃ tataḥ param ||
prasthito roṣanirmukto vāṃchitāśāṃ prati dvijāḥ || 6.136.10 ||
atha taṃ prasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā procuḥ sarve divaukasaḥ ||
dharmarājakṛte vyagrāḥ śrutvā śāpaṃ tathāvidham || 11 ||
|| devā ūcuḥ || ||
bhagavanpāpasaktasya dharmarājasya kevalam||
na tvamarhasi śāpena śūdraṃ kartuṃ kathaṃcana || 12 ||
prasādaṃ kuru tasmāttvamasya dharmapaterdvija ||
asmākaṃ vacanātsadyaḥ prārthayasva tathā varam || || 13 ||
|| māṃḍavya uvāca || ||
nānyathā jāyate vāṇī yā mayoktā surottamāḥ ||
avaśyaṃ dharmarājo'yaṃ śūdrayonau prayāsyati || 14 ||
paraṃ naivāsya saṃtānaṃ tasyāṃ yonau bhaviṣyati ||
saṃprāpsyati ca bhūyo'pi dharmarājatvamuttamam || 15 ||
ārādhayatu cāvyagraḥ kṣetre'traiva trilocanam ||
prasādāttasya devasya śīghraṃ mṛtyumavāpsyati || 16 ||
tathā deyo varo mahyaṃ bhavadbhiryadi svargapāḥ ||
tadeṣā śūlikā'smākaṃ sparśādbhūyātsudharmadā || || 17 ||
|| devā ūcuḥ || ||
enāṃ yaḥ prātarutthāya sparśayiṣyati śūlikām ||
pātakātsa vimukto vā iha loke bhaviṣyati || 18 ||
evamuktvā muniṃ taṃ te devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ||
tatastāṃ sādaraṃ prāhuḥ saha bhartrā pativratām || 19 ||
tvamapi prārthayābhīṣṭamasmatto varavarṇini ||
yatte citte sthitaṃ nityaṃ nādeyaṃ vidyate'tra naḥ || 6.136.20 ||
|| pativratovāca || ||
yeyaṃ mayākṛtā gartā sthāne'tra tridaśeśvarāḥ ||
mannāmnā khyātimāyātu dīrghiketi jagattraye || 21 ||
|| devā ūcuḥ || ||
adyaprabhṛti loke'tra gartteyaṃ tava śobhane ||
dīrghiketi suvikhyātā bhaviṣyati jagattraye || 22 ||
ye'syāṃ snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti prātarutthāya mānavāḥ ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktāste bhaviṣyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 23 ||
kanyārāśigate sūrye saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ||
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti śraddhayā sahitā narāḥ || 24 ||
aputrāste bhaviṣyaṃti saputrā vaṃśavardhanāḥ ||
evamuktvā'tha tāṃ devā jagmuḥ svargaṃ dvijottamāḥ|| || 25 ||
pativratāpi tenaiva saha kāṃtena sundarī ||
sevayāmāsa kalyāṇī smarasaukhyamanuttamam || 26 ||
parvateṣu suramyeṣu nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca ||
udyāneṣu vicitreṣu vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca || 27 ||
tato vayasi saṃprāpte paścime kālaparyayāt |
tadevātmīyasattīrthaṃ sevayāmāsa sādaram || 28 ||
tato dehaṃ parityaktvā svakāṃtaṃ vīkṣya taṃ mṛtam ||
tatra toye jagāmātha brahmalokaṃ pativratā | 29 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ dīrghikākhyānamuttamam ||
yasya saṃśravaṇādeva naraḥ pāpātpramucyate || 6.136.30 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye dīrghikotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 136 ||

<6.137>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kenāsau muniśārdūlo māṃḍavyaḥ sumahātapāḥ ||
śūlāyāṃ sthāpitaḥ kena kāraṇena ca no vada || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sa māṃḍavyo muniḥ pūrvaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ samācaran ||
asminkṣetre samāyātaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || 2 ||
viśvāmitrīyamāsādya sattīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat ||
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cakre bhāskaraṃ prati sa vratī || 3 ||
japanvibhrāḍiti śreṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ bhāskaravallabham ||
etasminnaṃtare cauro loptramādāya kasyacit || 4 ||
kopi tatra samāyātaḥ pṛṣṭhe lagnairjanairdvijāḥ ||
tataścauro'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā maunasthaṃ munisattamam || 5 ||
loptraṃ muktvā tadagre'tha praviveśa guhāṃtare ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptāste janā loptrahetave || 6 ||
dṛṣṭvā loptraṃ tadagrasthaṃ tamūcurmunipuṃgavam ||
mārgeṇānena cāyāto loptrahasto malimlucaḥ ||
brūhi śīghraṃ mahābhāga kena mārgeṇa nirgataḥ || 7 ||
sa ca jānannapi prājño guhāsaṃsthaṃ malimlucam ||
na kiṃcidapi covāca maunavrata parāyaṇaḥ || 8 ||
asakṛtprocyamāno'pi paraciṃtāsamanvitaḥ ||
yadā provāca no kiṃcitsa rakṣaṃścaurajīvitam || 9 ||
tatastairmaṃtritaṃ sarvaireṣa nūnaṃ malimlucaḥ ||
saṃprāptaḥ pṛṣṭhato'smābhirmunirūpo babhūva ha || 6.137.10 ||
avicārya tataḥ sarvairābhīraistairdurātmabhiḥ||
śūlīmāropitaḥ sadyo nītvā kiṃcidvanāṃtaram || 11 ||
evaṃ prāptā tadā śūlī muninā tena dāruṇā ||
pūrvakarmavipākena doṣahīnena dhīmatā ||12||
itiśrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye māṃḍavyaśūlīprāptivṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśaduttaraśatatamokyayāyaḥ || 137 || || dha ||

<6.138>

|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kiṃ kṛtaṃ dharmarājena tapodhyānādikaṃ ca yat||
māṃḍavyaśāpanāśāya tadasmākaṃ prakīrtaya || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
māṃḍavya śāpamāsādya dharmarājaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ||
tapastepe dvijaśreṣṭhāstasminkṣetre vyavasthitaḥ || 2 ||
prāsādaṃ devadevasya saṃvidhāya kapardinaḥ ||
avyagraṃ pūjayāmāsa puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ || 3 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭastasya maheśvaraḥ ||
provāca varado'smīti prārthayasva yadīpsitam || 4 ||
|| dharmarāja uvāca || ||
ahaṃ deva purā śapto māṃḍavyena mahātmanā ||
svadharme vartamāno'pi sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ || 5 ||
kupitena ca tenoktaṃ śūdrayonau bhaviṣyasi || 6 ||
tatrāpi ca mahadduḥkhaṃ jñātināśasamudravam ||
macchāpajanitaṃ sadyo jātijaṃ samavāpsyasi || 7 ||
tasmāttrāhi suraśreṣṭha tasyā yoneḥ sakāśataḥ ||
kathaṃ caitadvidho bhūtvā tasyāṃ janma karomyaham ||8||
tatrāpi ca mahaduḥkhaṃ jñātināśasamudbhavam ||
etadarthe suraśreṣṭha mayā cārādhito bhavān ||9|| ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
na tasya sanmunervākyaṃ śakyate kartumanyathā ||
tasmācchūdro'pi bhūtvā tvaṃ na saṃtānamavāpsyasi || 6.138.10 ||
jñātikṣayaṃ pradṛṣṭvāpi naiva duḥkhamavāpsyasi ||
yato niṣidhyamānāpi na kariṣyaṃti te vacaḥ || 11 ||
etasmātkāraṇāccitte na te duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
jñātijaṃ dharmarājaitatsatyameva mayoditam || 12 ||
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ prājña tvaṃ śūdro dharmavatsalaḥ ||
upadeśānbahūndattvā jñātibhyo hitakāmyayā ||
api śraddhā vihīneṣu pāpātmasu sadaiva hi || 13 ||
tato varṣaśate pūrṇe brahmadvāreṇa kevalam ||
ātmānaṃ samyagutsṛjya mokṣameva prayāsyasi || 14 ||
evamuktvā sa bhagavāngataścādarśanaṃ tataḥ ||
dharmarājo'pi taṃ śāpaṃ bheje māṃḍavyasaṃbhavam || 15 ||
tadā vidurarūpeṇa hyavatīrya dharātale ||
māṃḍavyasya vacaḥ satyaṃ sa cakāra mahāmatiḥ || 16 ||
jāto bhagavatā sākṣādvyāsenāmitatejasā ||
pārāśaryeṇa vipreṇa dāsīgarbhasamudbhavaḥ || 17 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ dharmarājasamudbhavam ||
ākhyānaṃ yadahaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ sarvapātakanāśanam || 18 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāharasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dharmarājeśvarotpattivarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśaduttaraśatatamoadhyāyaḥ || 138||

<6.139>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
dharmarājeśvarotthaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
yanmayā praśrutaṃ puṇyaṃ sakāśātsvapituḥ purā || 1 ||
tadahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ ||
trailokye'pi suvikhyātaṃ sarva pātakanāśanam || 2 ||
tatra kṣetre purā vipraḥ kaśyapānvayasaṃbhavaḥ ||
upādhyāya iti khyāto vedavidyāparāyaṇaḥ || 3 ||
paścime vayasi prāpte tasya putro babhūva ha ||
svādhyāyaniyamasthasya prabhūtavibhavasya ca ||4||
pañcavarṣakamātrastu yadā jajñe ca tatsutaḥ ||
tadā mṛtyuvaśaṃ prāptaḥ pitṛmātṛsuduḥkhakṛt ||5||
tataḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ kopaṃ cakre vaivasvatopari ||
dharmarājagṛhaṃ prāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā nijakumārakam || 6 ||
ādāya salilaṃ haste śucirbhūtvāsamāhitaḥ ||
pradadau dāruṇaṃ śāpaṃ dharmarājāya duḥkhitaḥ || 7 ||
aputro'dya kṛto yasmādahaṃ tena durātmanā ||
ataḥ so'pi ca duṣṭātmā yamo'putro bhaviṣyati || 8 ||
tathāsya bhūtale loko naiva pūjāṃ vidhāsyati ||
kīrtayiṣyati no nāma yathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām || 9 ||
yaḥ kaścitprātarutthāya nāma cāsya grahī ṣyati ||
maṃgalyakaraṇe cātha vighnaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati || 6.139.10 ||
taṃ śrutvā tasya viprasya yamaḥ śāpaṃ sudāruṇam ||
svadharme vartamānastu tato duḥkhā nvito'bhavat || 11 ||
etasminnaṃtare gatvā brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ prati ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā yamaḥ prāha pitāmaham || 12 ||
paśya deveśa śapto'haṃ nirdoṣopi dvijanmanā ||
svadharme vartamānastu yathānyaḥ prākṛto janaḥ || 13 ||
tasmādahaṃ tyajiṣyāmi niyogaṃ te pitāmaha ||
brahmaśāpabhayā dbhītaḥ satyametanmayoditam || 14 ||
purā māṃḍavyaśāpena śūdrayonyavatāritaḥ ||
sāṃprataṃ putrarahitaḥ kṛto'pūjyaśca sattama || 15 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dīnaṃ vaivasvatasya ca ||
tatkālocitamāhedaṃ svayameva śatakratuḥ || 16 ||
yuktamuktamanenaitaddharmarājena padmaja ||
niyoge vartamānena tāvakīye sureśvara || 17 ||
avaśyameva martye ca manuṣyāḥ samaye sthitāḥ||
bālye vā yauvane vātha vārdhakye vā pitāmaha ||
saṃhartavyā na saṃdeho nākāle ca kathaṃcana || 18 ||
etadeva kṛtaṃ nāma dharmarājākhyamuttamam ||
tvayā ca samamitrasya samaśastrormahātmanaḥ || 19 ||
tasmādadya samālokya kaścideva viciṃtyatām ||
upāyo yena nirdoṣo niyogaṃ kurute tava || 6.139.20 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
brahmaśāpaṃ na śakto'ha manyathākartumevaca ||
upāyaṃ ca kariṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ tridaśādhipa || 21 ||
tato dhyānaṃ pracakre sa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||
tadarthaṃ sarvadevānāṃ purataḥ susa māhitaḥ || 22 ||
tasyaivaṃ dhyānasaktasya prādurbhūtāḥ samaṃtataḥ ||
mūrtā rogāḥ suraudrāste vātagulmakaphātmakāḥ ||
aṣṭottaraśataprāyāḥ procustaṃ ca kṛtādarāḥ || 23 ||
|| rogā ūcuḥ || ||
kimarthaṃ devadeveśa tvayā sṛṣṭā vayaṃ vibho ||
ādeśo dīyatāṃ śīghraṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti || 24 || ||
|| vrahmovāca || ||
vrajadhvaṃ bhūtale śīghraṃ mamādeśādasaṃśayam ||
yamādeśānmanuṣyeṣu gantavyamavikalpitam || 25 ||
evamukttvā tu tānrogāṃstataḥ prāha pitāmahaḥ ||
dharmarājaṃ samīpasthaṃ bhṛśaṃ dīnamadhomukham || 26
ete te vyādhayaḥ sarve mayā yama niyojitāḥ ||
sāhāyyaṃ ca kariṣyaṃti sarvakṛ tyeṣu sarvadā ||27||
yaḥ kaścidadhunā martyo gatāyuḥ saṃprapadyate ||
vadhāya tasya yatnena tvayā preṣyāḥ sadaiva tu||28||
eteṣāṃ jāyate tena jananāśasamudbhavaḥ ||
apavādo dharāpṛṣṭhe na ca saṃjāyate tava ||29||
tasmādgatvā nijaṃ sthānaṃ svādhikāraparo bhava ||
mamādeśādasaṃdigdhaṃ naivaṃ doṣamavāpsyasi||6.139.30||
tatastānsakalānvyādhīngṛhītvā ravinaṃdanaḥ||
yamalokaṃ samāsādya tataḥ provāca sādaram || 31 ||
pṛṣṭvāpṛṣṭvā ca gaṃtavyaṃ citraguptaṃ dharātale ||
gaṃtavyaṃ jananāśāya samaye samupasthite || 32 ||
paramasti mayā tatra sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam |
hāṭakeśvarajekṣetre sarvapātakanāśanam ||33||
yastaṃ paśyati sadbhaktyā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ ||
sa yuṣmābhiḥ sadā tyājyo dūrato vacanānmama || 34 ||
evamuktvā sa tānvyādhīṃstato vaivasvataḥ svayam ||
tasya viprasya taṃ putraṃ gṛhītvā satvaraṃ yayau ||
tasyaiva maṃdire ramye kṛtvā rūpaṃ dvijanmanaḥ || 35 ||
athāsau brāhmaṇo dṛṣṭvā svaṃ putraṃ gṛhamāgatam ||
sahitaṃ viprarūpeṇa dharmarājena dhīmatā || 36 ||
tataḥ prahṛṣṭacittena satvaraṃ sammukho yayau ||
putraputreti jalpansa nijabhāryāsamanvitaḥ || 37 ||
pariṣvajya tato bhūyo vāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ ||
āghrāya ca tato mūrdhni vākyametaduvāca ha || 38 ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
kathaṃ putra samāyātastvaṃ tasmā dyamamaṃdirāt ||
na kaścitpunarāyāti yatra gatvā'pi vīryavān || 39 ||
kiṃ vā caitatsamutpannamindrajālaṃ mamāṃtikam ||
kiṃ vā svapnamidaṃ kiṃ vā mamāyaṃ dṛṣṭivibhramaḥ ||6.139.40||
kaścāyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ pārśve tava saṃtiṣṭhate suta ||
divyena tejasā yuktastaṃ namāmyahamātmaja || 41 ||
|| putra uvāca || ||
eṣa brāhmaṇarūpeṇa samāyāto yamaḥ svayam ||
māmādāya kṛpāviṣṭo jñātvā tvāṃ duḥkhasaṃyutam || 42 ||
tasmāttvaṃ kuru tātāsya śāpānugrahamadya vai||
gṛhaprāptasya susnehādyadyahaṃ tava vallabhaḥ || 43 ||
tatastasya praṇāmaṃ sa kṛtvā brāhmaṇasattamaḥ ||
vrīḍayā'dhomukho bhūtvā tataḥ provāca sādaram || 44 || ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam ||
yatputrasya mama prāptirgatasya yamasādanam | 45 ||
tvaṃ ca putrakṛte tāta santoṣaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||
tasmātputreṇa saṃyukto yathāyaṃ syāttathā kuru || 46 ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
na me syādanṛtaṃ vākyaṃ kadā cidapi putraka ||
api svaireṇa yatproktaṃ kiṃ punarduḥkhitena ca || 47 ||
tasmāttasya bhavetputro daivayonisamudbhavaḥ ||
na kathaṃcidapi prājña mama śāpavaśāddhruvam|| 48 ||
bhaviṣyati sutaścānyo mānuṣīyonisaṃbhavaḥ ||
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ yaścainaṃ tārayiṣyati || 49 ||
ko'rthaḥ putreṇa jātena yo na saṃtāraṇakṣamaḥ ||
pitṛpakṣaṃ śubhaṃ karma kṛtvā sarvottamaṃ bhuvi || 6.139.50 ||
tathā pūjākṛte yo'sya śāpo dattaśca vai purā ||
tatrāpi śṛṇu me vākyaṃ tasya putraka jalpataḥ ||51||
vedoktairvividhairmantrairyā pūjā cāsya saṃsthitā ||
na bhaviṣyati sā loke kathaṃcidapi putraka || 52 ||
asya mānuṣasaṃbhūtairmantraiḥ pūjā bhaviṣyati ||
viśiṣṭā sarvadevebhyaḥ satyametanmayoditam || 53 ||
|| putra uvāca || ||
ahamenaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya drijaśreṣṭha mahītale ||
samyagārādhayiṣyāmi kimanyairvibudhairmama || 54 ||
tasmātsaṃkīrtayiṣyāmi maṃtrānmānuṣasaṃbhavān ||
tathā pūjāvidhānaṃ ca tvatprasādena pūrvaja || 55 ||
tataḥ sugaṃ naḥ pantheti tasya maṃtraṃ vidhāya saḥ ||
samācaratprahṛṣṭātmā dharmarājasya śṛṇvataḥ || 56 ||
tacchrutvātha yamaḥ proccaiḥ suprasannena cetasā ||
taṃ brāhmaṇa muvācedaṃ harṣagadgadayāgirā || 97 ||
|| yama uvāca || ||
kathaṃcidapi vipredra na me syāddarśanaṃ vṛthā ||
anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ tasmātprārthaya vāṃchi tam || 58 ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
tavārcāṃ mama putro'yaṃ sthāpayiṣyati yāmiha ||
tāmanenaiva maṃtreṇa yaḥ kaścitpūjayeddvijaḥ || 59 ||
bhavetsaṃvatsaraṃ yāvatsaṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ||
mā tasya putraśoko hi iha loke kathañcana || 6.139.60 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya saṃprahṛṣṭamanā yamaḥ ||
yamalokaṃ jagāmātha svādhikāraparo'bhavat|| 61 ||
so'pi brāhmaṇadāyādaḥ kṛtvā prāsādamuttamam ||
yamamārādhayāmāsa madhye saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ ||
pitrā coktena mantreṇa tenaiva vidhipūrvakam|| 62 ||
tataśca kramaśaḥ prāpya putrapautrānanekaśaḥ ||
kāladharmamanuprāptaściraṃ sthitvā mahītale || 63 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ purāṇeyatpurā śrutam||
yaścaitatkīrtayedbhaktyā saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ||
nāpamṛtyurbhavettasya na ca śokaḥ sutodbhavaḥ || 64 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahapurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dharmarājeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttara śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 139 || || cha ||

<6.140>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ putro mānuṣavigrahaḥ ||
bhaviṣyati yamasyātra kaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ sa sūtaja || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasya putraḥ samutpannaḥ pāṃḍoḥ kṣetre mahītale ||
yudhiṣṭhira iti khyātaḥ sarvakṣatriyapuṃgavaḥ || 2 ||
rājasūyo makho yena iṣṭaḥ sampūrṇadakṣiṇaḥ ||
sarvānbhūmipatīnvīryātsaṃvidhāya karapradān || 3 ||
aśvamedhāḥ kṛtāḥ paṃca tathā sampūrṇadakṣiṇāḥ ||
bhrāmayitvā hayaṃ bhūmau paścātprāpa sa sadgatim || 4 ||
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyekopi gayāṃ vrajet ||
yajeta vā'śvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet || 5 ||
yadanena vṛtaṃ mattaḥ putritvaṃ sumahātmanā ||
hayamedhānmahāyajñānkartā syādasya vai sutaḥ || 6 ||
manyeta kṛtakṛtyatvaṃ yena putreṇa dharmapaḥ ||
anyaiḥ putraśataiḥ kiṃ vā vaṃśānuddhārakārakaiḥ || 7 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ dharmarājasutodbhavam ||
ākhyānaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā dharmavṛddhikaraṃ param || 8 || |
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dharmarājaputrākhyānavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśaduttara śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 140 ||

<6.141>

|| sūtauvāca || ||
tathānyo'pi hi tatrāsti devo miṣṭānnadāyakaḥ ||
yasya saṃdarśanādeva miṣṭānnaṃ labhate naraḥ || 1 ||
āsītpūrvaṃ nṛpo nāmnā vasusena iti smṛtaḥ ||
ānarttādhipatiḥ khyāto bṛhatkalpe dvijottamāḥ || 2 ||
atyaiśvaryasamāyukto gajavājirathānvitaḥ ||
jitāripakṣastejasvī dātā bhogī jiteṃdriyaḥ || 3 ||
sa saṃkrāṃtau vyatīpāte grahaṇe ravi somayoḥ ||
parvakāleṣu cānyeṣu vividheṣu subhaktitaḥ || 4 ||
prayacchati dvijātibhyo ratnāni vividhāni ca ||
iṃdranīlamahānīlavidrumasphaṭikādi ca || 5 ||
māṇikyamauktikānyeva vidrumāṇi viśeṣataḥ ||
hastyaśvarathayānāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca || 6 ||
na kasyacitpradadyātsa sasyaṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
atīva sulabhaṃ matvā tathā toyaṃ viśeṣataḥ|| 7 ||
tato rājyaṃ ciraṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā putrodbhavānsutān ||
kāladharmamanuprāptaḥ kasmiṃścitkālaparyaye || 8 ||
tataśca maṃtribhistasya satyasena iti smṛtaḥ ||
abhiṣiktaḥ suto rājye vīryodāryasamanvitaḥ || 9 ||
vasuseno'pi saṃprāpya svargaṃ dānaprabhāvataḥ ||
divyāṃbaradharo bhūtvā divyaratnairvibhūṣitaḥ || 6.141.10 ||
sevyamāno'psarobhiśca vimānavaramāśritaḥ ||
babhrāma sarvalokeṣu svecchayā kṣutsamāvṛtaḥ || 11 ||
pipāsākulacittaśca mukhena pariśuṣyatā ||
na kaṃciddadṛśe tatra bhuṃjānamaparaṃ divi || 12 |
na ca pānasamāsaktaṃ na sasyaṃ salilaṃ na ca || 13 ||
tato gatvā sahasrākṣamuvāca dvijasattamāḥ ||
kṣuttṛṣāvṛtadehastu lajjayā'dhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 14 ||
naivātra dṛśyate kaścitkṣuttṛṣāparipīḍitaḥ ||
māṃ muktvā vibudhaśreṣṭha tatkimetadvadasvame || 15 ||
eṣa me svargarūpeṇa narakaḥ samupasthitaḥ ||
kimetairbhūṣaṇairvastrairvimānādibhireva ca || 16 ||
kṣudhā saṃpīḍyamānasya svargametacchacīpate ||
agnitulyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ mama citte'pi vartate || 17 ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yathā kṣunna prabādhate ||
nocetkṣipa suraśreṣṭha raurave narake drutam ||18|| ||
|| iṃdrauvāca || ||
anarhosi mahīpāla narakasya tvameva hi ||
tvayā dānāni dattāni saṃkhyāhīnāni sarvadā||19||
paraṃ kiṃ tu kvacinnānnaṃ dattaṃ rājanna codakam||
na kiṃcidapi saṃciṃtya yataḥ sulabhameva hi ||6.141.20||
toyaṃ sānnaṃ sadā dadyādannaṃ caiva sadakṣiṇam||
ya icchecchāśvatīṃ tṛptimiha loke paratra ca || 21 ||
tasmāttvaṃ hi kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ svarge caiva mahīpate ||
bhūṣito bhūṣaṇaiḥ śreṣṭhairvimānavaramāśritaḥ || 22 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
asti kaścidupāyo'tra devau vā mānuṣo'pi vā ||
kṣutpipāse'titīvre me vināśaṃ yena gacchataḥ ||23||
|| indra uvāca || ||
yadi kaścitsutastubhyaṃ viprebhyaḥ satataṃ jalam||
dadāti ca sadā sasyaṃ tatte tṛptiḥ prajāyate || 24 ||
nānyathā pārthivaśreṣṭha ekasminnapi vāsare ||
adattasya tava prāptiḥ satyametanmayoditam ||25||
so'pi bhūmipateḥ putrastava yacchati nodakam||
na ca sasyaṃ dvijātibhyastvanmārgamanusaṃcaran||26||
etasminnaṃtare prāpto nārado munisattamaḥ||
brahmalokātsthitau yatra tau bhūmipasureśvarau || 27 ||
tataḥ śakraḥ samutthāya tasmai tuṣṭisamanvitaḥ ||
arghaṃ dattvā vidhānena sādaraṃ cedamabravīt || 28 ||
kutaḥ prāpto'si vipreṃdra prasthitaḥ kva ca sāṃpratam||
kena kāryeṇa cedguhyaṃ na te'sti vada sāṃpratam|| 29 ||
nārada uvāca || ||
brahmalokādahaṃ prāptaḥ prasthitastu dharātale ||
tīrthayātrākṛte śakra nānyadastīha kāraṇam || 6.141.30 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā sa nṛpo hṛṣṭastamuvāca munīśvaram ||
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ dīnasya munipuṃgava || 31 ||
tvayā bhūmitale vācyo mama putro mahīpatiḥ ||
ānarttādhipatiḥ khyātaḥ satyasena iti prabho || || 32 ||
tava tāto mayā dṛṣṭaḥ śakrasya sadanaṃ prati ||
kṣutpipāsāparītāṃgo dīnātmā devamadhyagaḥ || 33 ||
tasmātputro'si cenmahyaṃ tvaṃ satyaṃ parirakṣasi ||
tanmannāmnā prayacchoccaiḥ sasyāni salilāni ca || 34 ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya nārado munisattamaḥ ||
anujñāpya sahasrākṣaṃ prasthito bhūtalaṃ prati || 35 ||
tataḥ krameṇa tīrthāni bhramamāṇaḥ sa saddvijaḥ ||
ānarttaviṣayaṃ prāpya satyasenamupādravat || 36 ||
atha saṃpūjitastena samyagbhūpatinā muniḥ ||
pituḥ saṃdeśamācakhyau vijane tasya sādaram || 37 ||
tacchrutvā śokasaṃtaptaḥ satyaseno mahīpatiḥ ||
taṃ visṛjya muniśreṣṭhaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | 38 ||
tato janakamuddiśya miṣṭānnena subhaktitaḥ ||
sahasraṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ || 39 ||
prapādānaṃ tathā cakre grīṣmakāle viśeṣataḥ ||
tyaktvānyāḥ sakalā yāśca kriyā dharmasamudbhavāḥ || 6.141.40 |
evaṃ tasya mahīpasya vartamānasya ca dvijāḥ ||
anāvṛṣṭirabhūdraudrā sarvasasyakṣayāvahā || 41 ||
yāvaddvādaśavarṣāṇi na jalaṃ tridaśādhipaḥ ||
mumoca dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe sarve lokāḥ kṣudhārditāḥ || 42 ||
atrābhāvāttato bhūyo na sasyaṃ saṃprayacchati ||
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samuddiśya pitaraṃ svaṃ yathā purā || 43 ||
tataḥ sa kṣutparītāṃgaḥ pitā tasya mahīpateḥ ||
svapne provāca taṃ putramatīva malināṃbaraḥ || 44 ||
tvayā putreṇa putrāhaṃ kṣutpipāsāsamākulaḥ ||
svargastho'pi hi tiṣṭhāmi tasmādannaṃ prayaccha vai ||
mannāmnā toyasaṃyuktaṃ yadi tvaṃ matsamudbhavaḥ || 45 ||
tataḥ śokasamāyuktaḥ sa nṛpaḥ svapnadarśanāt ||
annābhāvātsamaṃ maṃtraṃ maṃtribhiḥ sa tadākarot || 46 ||
ahamārādhayiṣyāmi sasyārthe vṛṣabhadhvajam ||
rājye rakṣā vidhātavyā bhavadbhiḥ sādaraṃ sadā || 47 ||
tato'traiva samāgatya sthāpayitvā maheśvaram ||
samyagārādhayāmāsa vrataiśca niyamaistathā||48||
atha tasya gatastuṣṭiṃ varṣāṃte bhagavāñchivaḥ||
abravīdvarado'smīti prārthayasva yathepsitam||49||
rājovāca||
annārthaṃ devadeveśa mayāyaṃ vihito vidhiḥ||
tasmāttvaṃ yaccha me śīghramasaṃkhyaṃ vṛṣavāhana||6.141.50||
tathā saṃjāyatā vṛṣṭiḥ samaste dharaṇītale ||
yena sasyāni jāyaṃte salilāni ca sāṃpratam || 51 ||
jāyatāṃ mama tātasya svargasthasya mahātmanaḥ ||
prasādāttava saṃtṛptirakṣayā surasattama ||52||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
bhavitā na cirādvṛṣṭiḥ prabhūtā dharaṇītale ||
bhaviṣyaṃti tathānnāni yāni kāni mahītale || 53 ||
tasmāttvaṃ gaccha rājeṃdra svagṛhaṃ prati sāṃpratam||
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhametadeva bhaviṣyati ||54 ||
taccaitanmāmakaṃ liṃgaṃ yattvayā sthāpitaṃ nṛpa ||
prātarutthāya yaḥ kaścitsamyaktadvīkṣayiṣyati || 55 ||
miṣṭānnamamṛtasvādu sa hi nūnamavāpsyati||
mama vākyānnṛpaśreṣṭha sadā janmanijanmani || 56 ||
sa evaṃ bhagavānuktvā tataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
so'pi rājā nijaṃ sthānaṃ harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ ||
ājagāma cakārātha rājyaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam ||57||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
adyāpi kalikāle'tra saṃprāpte dāruṇe yuge ||
yastaṃ miṣṭānnadaṃ paśyetprātarutthāya bhaktitaḥ ||58||
sa miṣṭānnamavāpnoti yadi kāmayate dvijāḥ ||
niṣkāmo vā samabhyeti sthānaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ|| 59 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye miṣṭānnadeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||141||

<6.142>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyadapi tatrāsti puṇyaṃ gaṇapatitrayam ||
svargadaṃ martyadaṃ puṇyaṃ tathānyannarakāpaham||1||
haṃtṛ vai sarvavighnānāṃ pūjitaṃ suradānavaiḥ||
sarvakāmapradaṃ caiva vidyākīrtivivardhanam || 2 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
trividhāḥ puruṣāḥ sūta jāyaṃtetra mahītale ||
uttamā madhyamāścānye tathā cānye'dhamāḥ sthitāḥ || 3 ||
uttamāḥ prārthayaṃti sma mokṣameva hi kevalam ||
gatā yatra nivartaṃte na kathaṃciddharātale || 4 ||
madhyamāḥ svargamārgaṃ ca divyānbhogānmanoramān ||
apsarobhiḥ samaṃ krīḍāṃ yajñādyaiḥ karmabhiḥ kṛtām || || 5 ||
adhamā martyaloketra ramaṃte viṣayātmakāḥ ||
viṣakīṭakavattatra ratiṃ kṛtvā garīyasīm || 6 |
svargamokṣau parityajya tatkasmānmartya iṣyate ||
yenāsau prārthyate martyairmartyado gaṇanāyakaḥ || 7 ||
kena saṃsthāpitāste ca tasminkṣetre gajānanāḥ ||
kasminkāle ca draṣṭavyāḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 8 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
pūrvaṃ taptvā tapastīvraṃ martyaloke dvijottamāḥ ||
tato gacchaṃti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ svecchayā tridivaṃ prati ||
mokṣamārgaṃ tathaivānye dhyānāviṣkṛtamānasāḥ || 9 ||
tataḥ svarge samākīrṇe kadācinmanujottamaiḥ ||
deveṣu kṣipyamāṇeṣu samaṃtāttatprabhāvataḥ || 6.142.10 ||
gatvā svayaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha ||
provāca śaṃkaraṃ gauryā sārdhamekāsanasthitam || 11 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
tapaḥprabhāvasaṃsiddhairmānavaiḥ parameśvara ||
asmākaṃ vyāpyate sarvaṃ mahimānaṃ gṛhādikam|| 12 ||
tasmātkṛtvā prasādaṃ naḥ kaṃcicciṃtaya sāṃpratam ||
upāyaṃ yena tiṣṭhāmaḥ saukhyenātra śivālaye || 13 ||
atha śrutvā virūpākṣasteṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ dvijāḥ ||
pārvatyāḥ pārśvasaṃsthāyā mukhacandraṃ samaikṣayat || 14 ||
nijagātraṃ tato devī susaṃmardya muhurmuhuḥ ||
malamāhṛtya taṃ kṛtsnaṃ cakre nāgamukhaṃ tataḥ || 15 ||
caturhastaṃ mahākāyaṃ laṃbodarasamanvitam ||
sukautukakaraṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām || 16 ||
tataḥ sa vinayādāha devīṃ śikharavāsinīm ||
yadarthamaṃba sṛṣṭo'haṃ tatkāryaṃ vada mā ciram || 17 |
trailokye tvatprasādena nāsādhyaṃ vidyate mama || || 18 ||
|| śrīdevyuvāca || ||
martyaloke narā ye ca svargamokṣaparāḥ sadā ||
teṣāṃ vighnaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ śubhakṛtyeṣu caiva hi || 19 ||
saritāṃ patayastriṃśacchaṃkavaḥ saptasaptatiḥ ||
mahāsarojaṣaṣṭiśca nikharvāṇāṃ ca viṃśatiḥ || 6.142.20 ||
arbudāyutasaṃyuktāḥ koṭyo navatipañca ca ||
lakṣāśca paṃcapaṃcāśatsahasrāḥ paṃcaviṃśatiḥ||
śatāni navaṣaṣṭiśca gaṇāścānye'tra saṃsthitāḥ||21||
yeṣāṃ nadī smṛtaḥ pūrvo mahākālastathā paraḥ||
te sarve vaśagāstubhyaṃ prabhavaṃtu gaṇottamāḥ||22||
ādhipatyaṃ mayā dattaṃ tava vatsa kuruṣva tat ||
sarveṣāṃ gaṇavṛṃdānāmādhipatye vyavasthitaḥ ||23||
evamuktvātha sā devī samānīyauṣadhībhṛtān ||
hemakuṃbhānsutīrthāṃbhaḥ paripūrṇānmahodayān|| 24 ||
tasyābhiṣecanaṃ cakre svayameva sureśvarī ||
gītavādyavinodena nṛtyamaṃgalajaiḥ svanaiḥ || 25 ||
trayastriṃśatsmṛtāḥ koṭayo devānāṃ yāḥ sthitā divi ||
tāḥ sarvāstatra cāgatya tasya cakruśca maṃgalam || 26 ||
atha tasya dadau tuṣṭo bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||
kuṭhāraṃ niśitaṃ haste sadā vai śreṣṭhamāyudham || 27 ||
pātraṃ modakasaṃpūrṇamakṣayaṃ caiva pārvatī ||
bhojanārthe mahābhāgā mātṛsnehaparāyaṇā || 28 ||
mūṣakaṃ kārtikeyastu vāhanārthaṃ praharṣitaḥ ||
bhrātaraṃ manyamānastu bandhusnehena saṃyutaḥ || 29 ||
jñānaṃ divyaṃ dadau brahmā tasmai hṛṣṭena cetasā ||
atītānāgataṃ caiva vartamānaṃ ca yadbhavet||6.142.30||
prajñāṃ viṣṇuḥ sahasrākṣaḥ saubhāgyaṃ cottamaṃ mahat||
saubhāgyaṃ kāmadevastu kubero vibhavādikam||31||
pratāpaṃ bhagavānsūryaḥ kāṃtimagryāṃ niśākaraḥ||32||
tathānye vibudhāḥ sarve daduriṣṭāni bhūriśaḥ||
ātmīyāni pratuṣṭyarthaṃ devyā devasya ca prabhoḥ||33||
evaṃ labdhavaraḥ so'tha gaṇanātho dvijottamāḥ ||
devakṛtyaparo nityaṃ cakre vighnāni bhūtale || 34 ||
dharmārthaṃ yatamānānāṃ mokṣāya sukṛtāya ca ||
tato bhūmitale'bhyetya gaṇeśastatra yaḥ smṛtaḥ || 35 ||
vaimānikaiḥ samabhyetya sthāpitastatra sa dvijāḥ ||
yena svargārthino lokāḥ pūjāṃ tasya pracakrire ||
prathamaṃ sarvakṛtyeṣu vighnanāśāya tatparāḥ || 36 ||
etasminneva kāle ca camatkārapurodbhavaiḥ ||
brāhmaṇairbrahmavijñānatatparairmokṣahetubhiḥ ||
īśānaḥ sthāpitastatra mokṣado ya udāhṛtaḥ || 37 ||
svargaṃ vāñchadbhirevānyaiḥ svargadvārapradastathā ||
heraṃbaḥ sthāpitastatra satyanāmā yathoditaḥ || 38 ||
tathānyairmartyado nāma gaṇaiśastatra yaḥ sthitaḥ||
yena svargāccyutā yāṃti na kadā narakādikam||
tiryaktvaṃ vā kṛmitvaṃ vā sthāvaratvamathāpi vā || 39 ||
etasmātkāraṇāttatra kṣetre puṇye dvijottamāḥ ||
herambo martyado jātaḥ svargiṇāṃ martyadaḥ sadā || 6.142.40 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ puṇyaṃ heraṃbasaṃbhavam ||
ākhyānaṃ sarvavighnāni yannihanti śrutaṃ nṛṇām || 41 ||
etanmāghacaturthāṃ? yaḥ śuklāyāṃ pūjayennaraḥ ||
na tasya vatsaraṃ yāvadvighnaṃ sañjāyate kvacit || 42 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gaṇapatitrayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaraśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ || 142 || || cha ||

<6.143>

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| indra uvāca || ||

|| muniruvāca|| || 9||

raṃbhovāca||

|| muniruvāca || ||
na me gātrasvabhāvo na vyādhibhiśca sulocane ||

|| raṃbhovāca | ||
yadyevaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha māṃ bhajasva yathāsukham ||

hatā kāmaśaraistīkṣṇairna ca gaṃtuṃ samutsahe || || 43 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
sā gatvā tridivaṃ paścātsahasrākṣaṃ surairyutam ||

|| kanyovāca || ||

atha prāpte niśārdhe tu yoginyastāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ||
mahāmāṃsaṃ mahāmāṃsamityūcurbhakṣaṇāya vai ||68||
nṛtyamānāḥ purastasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||
saspardhā gaṇamukhyaistairnartamānaiḥ samaṃtataḥ ||69 ||
yastatra samaye tāsāṃ mahāmāṃsaṃ prayacchati ||
maṃtrapūtaṃ sa saṃsiddhiṃ samavāpnoti vāṃchitām || 6.144.70 ||
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā cānyannaivedyaṃ vā phalādikam ||
tasya siddhiḥ samādiṣṭā yathā svahṛdaye sthitā || 71 ||
etasminnaṃtare kanyā sā jābālisamudbhavā ||
sa ca citrāṃgadastatra gatvā provāca sādaram || 72||
asmadīyamidaṃ māṃsaṃ yoginyo harṣasaṃyutāḥ ||
bhakṣayantu yathāsaukhyaṃ svayameva prakalpitam || 73 ||
atha taṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā kuṣṭhavyādhisamāvṛtam ||
vivastrāṃ kanyakāṃ tāṃ ca sarvāstā vismayānvitāḥ || 74 ||
te ca sarve gaṇā raudrāḥ sa ca devastrilocanaḥ ||
papraccha kautukāviṣṭastatra citrāṃgadaṃ prabhuḥ || 75 ||
kastvaṃ dhairyasamāyukto mahatsattve vyavasthitaḥ ||
yaḥ prayacchasi jīvaṃ tvaṃ kīṭasyāpi suvallabham || 76 ||
keyaṃ ca vasanaiṃrhīnā tvayā sārdhaṃ gatavyathā ||
prayacchati nijaṃ dehaṃ yaddeyaṃ naiva kasyacit || 77 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa sarvamātmaviceṣṭitam ||
yathā kanyāsamaṃ saṃgaḥ kṛtaḥ śāpaśca sanmuneḥ || 78 ||
tataścitrāṃgadaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa gandharvaṃ divaukasām ||
tathārūpaṃ kṛpāviṣṭastataḥ provāca śaṃkaraḥ || 79 ||
mama saṃdarśanaṃ prāpya na mṛtyurjāyate kvacit ||
na vṛthā darśanaṃ caitattasmātprārthaya sādaram || 6.144.80 ||
|| citrāṃgada uvāca ||. ||
vyādhinā'haṃ sunirviṇṇastena devātra cāgataḥ ||
yena vyādhikṣayo bhāvī dehanāśena śaṃkara || 81 ||
tasmātkuru kṣayaṃ vyādheryadi yacchasi me varam ||
khecaratvaṃ punardehi yena svargaṃ vrajāmyaham || 82 ||
|| śrīśaṃkara uvāca || ||
tvaṃ sthāpayātra malliṃgaṃ pīṭhe gandharvasattama ||
tataścārādhaya prītyā yāvadvarṣamupasthitam || 83 ||
yathāyathā supūjāṃ tvaṃ malliṃgasya kariṣyasi ||
dinedine tathā vyādhestava nāśo bhaviṣyati || 84 ||
tatastu khe gatiṃ prāpya punaḥ svargaṃ prayāsyasi ||
matprasādānna sandehaḥ satyametanmayoditam || 85 ||
eṣāpi kanyakā yasmātpraviṣṭā pīṭhamadhyataḥ ||
tasmātphalavatīnāma yoginī sambhaviṣyati || 86 ||
anenaiva tu rūpeṇa nagnatvena vyavasthitā ||
mukhyāmavāpsyate pūjāṃ vāṃchitaṃ ca pradāsyati ||
pūjakānāṃ sthitaṃ citte śatasaṃkhyaguṇaṃ tadā || 87 ||
etāṃ saṃpūjayenmartyaḥ pīṭhametattataḥ param||
pūjayiṣyati tasyeṣṭā siddhirevaṃ bhaviṣyati || 88 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ sā'tha harṣeṇa mahatā'nvitā ||
yoginīvṛṃdamadhyasthā nṛtyaṃ cakre tataḥ param || 89
evaṃ babhūva sā tatra yoginī ca varāṃganā ||
tathā cakre paraṃ nṛtyaṃ yathā tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 6.144.90 ||
tataḥ provāca tāṃ hṛṣṭaḥ sarvayoginisaṃnidhau ||
anena tava nṛtyena gītena ca viśeṣataḥ || 91 ||
parituṣṭosmi te vatse tasmācchṛṇu vaco mama ||
niśīthe'dya dine prāpte yaste pūjāṃ kariṣyati || 92 ||
surā māṃsānnasatkārairmaṃtrairāgamasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
sa bhaviṣyati tatkālaṃ śāpānugrahaśaktimān || 93 ||
baṃdhanaṃ mohanaṃ cāpi śatroruccāṭanaṃ tathā ||
kariṣyati na sandeho vaśīkaraṇameva ca || 94 ||
trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamāsthāya diśāṃ pālānprapūjayet |
kṣetrapālaṃ ca sarvāstā devatā gamanodbhavāḥ || 95 ||
tathā catvarapūjāṃ ca prakṛtvā vidhipūrvakam ||
paścāttvāṃ pūjayitvā ca homaṃ yaśca kariṣyati || 96 ||
śatruvāmapadotthena spṛṣṭena rajasā'thavā ||
guggulena sahasrāṃtaṃ staṃbhanaṃ ca kariṣyati || 97 ||
yaśca śatruṃ hṛdi sthāpya śatrūdvartanasaṃbhavam ||
malaṃ dhātrīphalaiḥ sārdhaṃ mohanaṃ sa kariṣyati || 98 ||
yaḥ śatroḥ snānajaṃ toyaṃ gṛhītvā cātha kardamam ||
śivanirmālyasaṃyuktaṃ juhvayiṣyati pāvake || 99 ||
tavāgre sa naro nūnaṃ śatrumuccāṭayiṣyati ||
eṣopi tava saṃgena tava citrāṃgadaḥ priyaḥ ||
saṃprāpsyati ca satpūjāmanuṣaṃgāttvadudbhavāt || 6.144.100 ||
|| phalavatyuvāca || ||
yadi deva prasanno me tathānyamapi sadvaram||101||
hṛdisthaṃ dehi me saukhyaṃ yena saṃjāyate'khilam ||
pitā mamaiṣa jābālirnirmukto vasanaiḥ sadā || 102 ||
ahaṃ yathā tathātraiva saṃtiṣṭhatu divāniśam |
yena saṃtāpamāyāti paśyanmama virodhinīm || 103 ||
krīḍāṃ brāhmaṇavaṃśasya madyamāṃsasamudbhavām ||
madyagandhaṃ samāghrāti māṃsaṃ paśyati saṃskṛtam ||
māṃ svacchaṃdaratāṃ nityaṃ duḥkhaṃ yāti dinedine || 104 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
evaṃ bhaviṣyati proktaṃ saṃjātaṃ cādhunā śubhe ||
ahaṃ yāsyāmi kailāsaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭhātra yathoditā || 105 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sa bhagavānproktvā gataścādarśanaṃ haraḥ ||
yoginyaścaiva tāḥ sarvāḥ svesve sthāne vyavasthitāḥ || 106 ||
citrāṃgadopi tatraiva kṛtvā prāsādamuttamam ||
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa devadevasya śūlinaḥ || 107 ||
tataścārādhayāmāsa divārātramataṃdritaḥ || 108 ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte vyādhimuktaḥ surūpadhṛk ||
vimānavaramārūḍho jagāma tridaśālayam ||
so'pi jābālināmātha vivastra samapadyata || 109 ||
janahāsyakaro loke sthitastatraiva sarvadā ||
paśyamāno vikārāṃstānduḥkhitaḥ svasutodbhavān || 6.144.110 ||
tataśca garhayāmāsa strīṇāṃ janma mahāmuniḥ ||
tasminpīṭhe samāsādya duḥkhena mahatā'nvitaḥ || 111 ||
aho pāpātmanāṃ puṃsāṃ saṃbhaviṣyaṃti yoṣitaḥ ||
yāsāmīdṛksamācāro dvijavaṃśodbhavāsvapi || 112 ||
sakṛdeva mayā saṃgaḥ kṛto nāryā samanvitaḥ ||
ājanmamaraṇaṃ yāvatpāpaṃ prāptaṃ yathedṛśam || 113 ||
ye punastāsu saṃsaktāḥ sadaiva puruṣādhamāḥ ||
kā teṣāṃ jāyate loke gatirvedmi na ciṃtayan || 114 ||
evaṃ tasya bruvāṇasya yoginyastāḥ krudhānvitāḥ ||
tamūcurbrāhmaṇaṃ tatra ghṛṇayā parivāritam|| 115 ||
|| yoginya ūcuḥ ||
mā niṃdāṃ kuru mūḍhātmaṃstvaṃ strīṇāṃ yogamāśritaḥ ||
etaccarācaraṃ viśvaṃ strībhiḥ saṃdhāryate yataḥ || 116 ||
yābhiḥ saṃjanitaḥ śeṣaḥ kūrmaśca tadanaṃtaram ||
yābhyāṃ saṃdhāryate pṛthvī yasyāṃ viśvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 117 ||
dhanyeyaṃ te sutā mūḍha yā prāptā yogamuttamam ||
prāptā ca paramaṃ sthānaṃ stokairevātra vāsaraiḥ || 118||
tvaṃ punarmūrkhatāṃ prāptaśchāṃdasaṃ mārgamāsthitaḥ ||
avidyayā samāyuktaḥ saṃsāre'tra bhramiṣyasi || 119 ||
|| muniruvāca ||
striyo niṃdyatamāḥ sarvāḥ sarvāvasthāsu duḥkhadāḥ ||
ihaloke pare caiva tābhyaḥ saukhyaṃ na labhyate || 6.144.120 ||
yadarthaṃ nihataḥ śumbho niśumbhaśca mahāsuraḥ ||
rāvaṇo daṇḍabhūpaśca tathānye'pi sahasraśaḥ || 121 ||
prāpya tādṛgdvijaṃ kāṃtaṃ gautamaṃ strīsvabhāvataḥ ||
ahilyā śakramāsādya cakame śīlavarjitā || 122 || ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
yacca niṃdasi mūḍhātmansaṃti niṃdyāśca yoṣitaḥ ||
tadvadasva mayā sārdhaṃ yena tvāṃ bodhayāmyaham || 123 ||
na te'sti hṛdaye buddhirna lajjā na dayā mune ||
kimaṃtyajo'pi tatkarma kurute yattvayā kṛtam || 124 ||
ahaṃ tāvatprahāreṇa tvayā vyāpāditā'dhama ||
strīhatyodbhavapāpasya na cintā vidhṛtā hṛdi || 125 ||
viśeṣeṇa sutāyāśca kopāviṣṭena cetasā ||
gacchaṃti pātakānyatra prāyaścittaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || || 126 ||
strīvadhotthaṃ punaryāti yadi tattvaṃ prakīrtaya ||
etanme na ca duḥkhaṃ syādyaddhatāsmi dvijādhama || 127 ||
yacchaptā nagnasadbhāvaṃ nītā tatpātakaṃ ca te ||
kalpāṃte'pi sudurbuddhe na saṃyāsyati kutracit || 128 ||
tasmādbhuṃkṣva suduḥkhārtaḥ sthito'traiva mayā saha ||
na bhūyo niṃdasi prāyo na ca vyāpādayiṣyasi || 129 ||
aniṃdyā yoṣitaḥ sarvā naitā duṣyaṃti karhicit ||
māsimāsi rajo hyāsāṃ duṣkṛtānyapakarṣati || 6.144.130 ||
|| muni ruvāca || ||
striyaḥ pāpasamācārā naitāḥ śudhyaṃti karhicit ||
parakāṃte ratiryāsāmaṃtyajatvaṃ prayacchati || 131 ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
mā maivaṃ vada mūḍhātmannamedhyā iti yoṣitaḥ ||
atra ślokaḥ purā gīto manunā taṃ nibodha me || 132 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ pādato medhyā gāvo medhyāstu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||
ajāśvā mukhato medhyā striyo medhyāśca sarvataḥ || 133 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
brāhmaṇāḥ sarvato medhyā gāvo medhyāśca sarvataḥ ||
ajāśvā mukhato medhyā na medhyāśca striyaḥ kvacit || 134 ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
tasya ciṃtāmaṇirhaste tasya kalpadrumo gṛhe ||
kuberaḥ kiṃkarastasya yasya syātkāminī gṛhe || 135 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
tasyāpado'khilā duḥkhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tasyākhilaṃ gṛhe ||
narakaḥ sarvatastasya yasya syātkāminīgṛhe || 136 ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
yāni kānyatra saukhyāni bhogasthānāni yāni ca ||
dharmārthakāmajātāni tāni strībhyo bhavaṃti hi || 137 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
yāni kāni suduḥkhāni kleśāni yāni dehinām ||
yāni kaṣṭānyaniṣṭāni strībhyastāni bhavaṃti ca || 138 ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣānstrī caturo'pi catasṛbhiḥ ||
vahnipradakṣiṇābhistānvivāhe'pi pradarśayet || 139 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
saṃsārabhramaṇaṃ nārī prathame'pi samāgame ||
vahnipradakṣiṇānyāyavyājenaiva pradarśayet || 6.144.140 || ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
ke nāma na virajyaṃti jñānāḍhyā api mānavāḥ ||
karṇāṃtalagnanetrāṃtāṃ dṛṣṭvā pīna payodharām || 141 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
ke nāma na vinaśyaṃti mūḍhajñānā nitaṃbinīm ||
ramyabuddhyopasarpaṃti ye jvālāḥ śalabhā iva || 142 ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
nirmukhau ca kaṭhorau ca proddhatau ca manoramau ||
strīstanau sevate dhanyo madhumāṃse viśeṣataḥ ||143||
|| muniruvāca || ||
ābhoginau maṃḍalinau tatkṣaṇānmuktakaṃcukau||
varamāśīviṣau spṛṣṭau na tu patnyāḥ payodharau || 144 ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
na cāsāṃ racanāmātraṃ kevalaṃ ramyamaṃgibhiḥ |
pariṣvaṃgo'pi rāmāṇāṃ saukhyāya pulakāya ca || 145 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
na cāsāṃ racanāmātraṃ ramyaṃ syātpāpadaṃ dṛśaḥ ||
vapuḥ spṛṣṭaṃ vināśāya strīṇāṃ pretya narakāya ca || 146 ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
ko nāma na sukhī loke ko nāma sukṛtī na ca ||
spṛhaṇīyatamaḥ ko na strījano yasya rajyate || 147 || ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
ko na muktiṃ vrajettatra ko na śasyataro bhavet ||
ko na syātkṣemasaṃyuktaḥ strījane yo na rajyate || 148 ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
saṃsārāṃtaḥ prasuptasya kīṭasyāpi prarocate ||
strīśarīraṃ narasyātra kiṃ punarna vivekinaḥ || 149 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
amedhyajā tasya yathā tathā tadrocanaṃ kṛmeḥ ||
tathā saṃsārasūtasya strīśarīraṃ ca kāminaḥ || 6.144.150 ||
|| kanyovāca || ||
saukhyasthānaṃ nṛṇāṃ kiṃcidvedhasā 'nyadapaśyatā ||
śāśvataṃ ciṃtayitvātha strīratnamidamāhṛtam || 151 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
baṃdhanaṃ jagataḥ kiṃcidvedhasā'nyadapaśyatā ||
strīrūpeṇa tataḥ kopi pāśo'yaṃ strīmayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 152 |
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sa muniśārdūlastayātīva samāgame ||
niruttarīkṛto yāvattataḥ prāha nijāṃ sutām || 153 ||
|| muniruvāca || ||
tvayā saha na saṃvādo mayā kāryo'dhunā kvacit ||
yā tvaṃ bālāpi māmevaṃ niṣedhayasi sarvataḥ||154||
tasmāddhanyataraṃ manye ahamātmānamadya vai ||
yasya me tvaṃ sutā īdṛgīdṛkchāstravicakṣaṇā || 155 ||
tasmānna me mahābhāge kopaḥ svalpo'pi vidyate ||
tasmādyathecchayā krīḍāṃ kuru yoginimadhyagā || 156 ||
tataḥ sā lajjitā dṛṣṭvā pitaraṃ snehavatsalam |
praṇipatya punaḥprāha yoginīmadhyasaṃsthitā || 157 ||
ajñānādyadi vā jñānāttvaṃ niṣiddho mayā prabho ||
kṣaṃtavyaṃ sakalaṃ me'dya vālikāyā viśeṣataḥ || 158||
atra pīṭhe samāgatya prathamaṃ te dvijottamāḥ ||
pūjāṃ sarve kariṣyaṃti mānavā bhaktitatparāḥ ||
paścācca sarvapīṭhasya yāsyaṃti ca parāṃ gatim|| 159 ||
evaṃ sā tatra saṃjātā jābālimunisaṃbhavā ||
jābāliśca muniśreṣṭhastathā citrāṃgadeśvaraḥ || 6.144.160 ||
trayāṇāmapi yasteṣāṃ pūjāṃ martyaḥ samācaret||
divasedivase tatra sa siddhiṃ samavāpnuyāt || 161 ||
nāsādhyaṃ vidyate kiṃcittāvadatra dharātale ||
pūjyate bhūmipālādyairbhogāndivyāṃstathā labhet || 162 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena sa muniḥ sā ca kanyakā ||
pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa sa devo'tha maheśvaraḥ || 163 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātamākhyānaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva ihaloke paratra ca || 164
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye citrāṃgadeśvaraphalavatījābālyākhyānavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 144 || || cha ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yattvayā kathitaṃ sūta na mṛtā sā kumārikā ||
hatā raudraprahāraiśca kautukaṃ tanmahattaram || 1 ||
yato bhūyaḥ prasaṃjātā yoginī haratuṣṭidā ||
yattvārthaṃ sarvamācakṣva kāraṇaṃ ca tadadbhutam || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sā praviṣṭā samaṃ tena supuṇyamamareśvaram ||
māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ na mṛtyuryatra vidyate || 3 ||'
api caivāyuṣaḥ śeṣe kimutākālato dvijāḥ||
tena no nidhanaṃ prāptā hatāpi sudṛḍhaṃ tadā || 4||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ||
amareśvara ityukto yo devo hyamaratvadaḥ ||
kena saṃsthāpito hyatra kiṃprabhāvaśca kīrtaya || 5 ||
||sūta uvāca || ||
aditiśca ditiścaiva prajāpatisute śubhe||
kṛte purātirūpāḍhye kaśyapena mahātmanā||6||
adityāṃ vibudhā jātā diteścaiva tu daityapāḥ||
teṣāṃ sāpatnyabhāvena mahadvairamupasthitam||7||
atha daityaiḥ surā dhvastāḥ kṛtāścānye parāṅmukhāḥ ||
anye tu bhayasaṃtrastā diśo jagmuḥ kṣatāṃgakāḥ ||8||
tato duḥkhasamāyuktā devamātātra saṃsthitā ||
tapaścakre divānaktaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇā || 9 ||
evaṃ tasyāstapaḥsthāyā gate yugacatuṣṭaye ||
nirbhidya dharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ samutthitam || 6.145.10 ||
tatastasmai kṛtānandā stutvā stotraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
aṣṭāṃgapraṇipātena namaścakre samāhitā || 11 ||
etasminnaṃtare vāṇī saṃjātā gaganāṃgaṇe ||
śarīrarahitā divyā meghagambhīraniḥsvanā || 12 ||
varaṃ prārthaya kalyāṇi yaste hṛdi vyavasthitaḥ ||
prasanno'haṃ pradāsyāmi tavādya śaśiśekharaḥ || 13 ||
|| aditiruvāca || ||
mama putrāḥ suraśreṣṭha hanyante yudhi dānavaiḥ||
tatkuruṣva gatāyāsānavadhyānraṇamūrdhani || 14 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
etalliṃgaṃ madīyaṃ ye spṛṣṭvā yāsyaṃti saṃyuge ||
avadhyāste bhaviṣyanti yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ śubhe || 15 ||
anyo'pi mānavo yo'tra caturdaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
māghamāsasya kṛṣṇāyāṃ prakariṣyati jāgaram || ||16||
so'pi saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadbhaviṣyati nirāmayaḥ ||
api mṛtyudine prāpte yo'sminnāyatane śubhe || 17 ||
āgamiṣyati taṃ mṛtyurdūrātparihariṣyati ||
evamuktvātha sā vāṇī virarāma tataḥ param || 18 ||
aditiścāpi santuṣṭā hataśeṣānsutāṃstataḥ ||
samānīyātha talliṃgaṃ teṣāmeva nyadarśayat ||
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ māhātmyaṃ yadvaroditam || 19 ||
tataste vibudhāḥ sarve talliṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca ||
pratijagmustuṣṭiyuktāḥ śastrāṇyādāya tānprati|| 6.145.20 ||
yatra te dānavā hṛṣṭāḥ sthitāḥ śakrapade śubhe ||
svargabhogasamāyuktā nandanāṃtarvyavasthitāḥ || 21 ||
atha te dānavā dṛṣṭvā saṃprāptāṃstridivaukasaḥ ||
sahasā saṃgarārthāya nānāśastradharānbahūn || 22 ||
rathavaryānsamāruhya dhṛtaśastrāstravarmaṇaḥ ||
yuddhārthaṃ sammukhā jagmurgarjamānā ghanā iva || 23 ||
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha ||
roṣapreritacittānāṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam || 24 ||
tataste vibudhāḥ sarve haralabdhavarāstadā ||
jaghnurdaityānasaṃkhyātācchitaiḥ śastrairanekadhā || 25 ||
hataśeṣāśca ye teṣāṃ te tyaktvā tridaśālayam ||
palāyanakṛtotsāhāḥ praviṣṭā makarālayam || 26 ||
tataḥ śakraḥ samāpede svarājyaṃ dānavairhṛtam ||
yadāsītpūrvakāle tatsamagraṃ hatakaṇṭakam || 27 ||
tataste dānavāḥ śeṣā jñātvā talliṃgasaṃbhavam ||
māhātmyaṃ vṛṣanāthasya kṣetrasyāsyodbhavasya ca || 28 ||
śukreṇa kathitaṃ sarvaṃ māghakṛṣṇe niśāgame ||
caturdaśyāṃ śucirbhūtvā yastalliṃgaṃ prapūjayet ||
kālāghrāto'pi na prāṇaiḥ sa pumāṃstyajyate kvacit ||29||
tasmādyūyaṃ samāsādya talliṃgaṃ taddine niśi ||
pūjayadhvaṃ mahābhāgā yena syurmṛtyuvarjitāḥ || 6.145.30 ||
yāvatsaṃvatsarasyātaṃ satyametanmayoditam ||
yathā te devasaṃghāśca tatprabhāvādasaṃśayam || 31 ||
atha taṃ dānavendrāṇāṃ maṃtraṃ jñātvā sureśvaraḥ ||
nāradādbrāhmaṇaḥ putrādbhayatrastamanāstataḥ || 32 ||
maṃtraṃ cakre samaṃ devaistatra devasya rakṣaṇe ||
yathā syādudyamaḥ samyaktasminnahani sarvadā || 33 ||
koṭayastu trayastriṃśaddevānāṃ sāyudhāstataḥ ||
rakṣārthaṃ tasya liṃgasya tasminkṣetre vyavasthitāḥ ||
māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ susaṃnaddhāḥ prahāriṇaḥ || 34 ||
atha te dānavā dṛṣṭvā tāndevāṃstatra saṃsthitān ||
bhayasaṃtrastamanaso dudruvuḥ sarvato diśam || 35 ||
atha prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṇḍale ||
bhūya eva surāḥ sarve maṃtraṃ cakruḥ parasparam || 36 ||
yadyetatkṣetramutsṛjya gamiṣyāmaḥ surālayam ||
liṃgametatsamabhyetya pūjayiṣyaṃti dānavāḥ || 37 ||
tato'vadhyā bhaviṣyaṃti te'pi sarve yathā vayam ||
tasmādatraiva tiṣṭhāmastrayastriṃśatpranāyakāḥ || 38 ||
koṭīnāmeva sarveṣāṃ śeṣā gacchantu tatra ca ||
sahasrākṣeṇa saṃyuktāḥ svarge svapararakṣakāḥ || 39 ||
tato'ṣṭau vasavastatra dvādaśārkāstathaiva ca ||
ekādaśāpare rudrā nāsatyau dvau ca sundarau ||6.145.40||
ete talliṃgarakṣārthaṃ tasminkṣetre vyavasthitāḥ||
śeṣāḥ śakrasamāyuktāḥ prajagmustridaśālayam || 41 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ prabhāvaṃ liṃgaṃ tu devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||
bhavadbhiḥ paripṛṣṭaṃ yadadityā sthāpitaṃ purā || 42 ||
yasmānna vidyate mṛtyustena dṛṣṭena dehinām ||
amarākhyaṃ tato liṃgaṃ vikhyātaṃ bhuvanatraye || 43 ||
yasmindeśe'pi sā kanyā hatā tena dvijanmanā ||
jābālinā sukruddhena tasya devasya maṃdire || || 44 ||
āsīttatra dine kṛṣṇā māghamāsa caturdaśī ||
tena no nidhanaṃ prāptā suhatā'pi tapasvinī || 45 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ tasya liṃgasya sambhavam ||
māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam || 46 ||
yaścaitatpaṭhate bhaktyā tasya liṃgasya saṃnidhau ||
apamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya kathaṃcinnaiva jāyate || 47 ||
tasyāgre'sti śubhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pūritaṃ svacchavāriṇā |
adityā nirmitaṃ devyā snānārthaṃ cātmanaḥ kṛte || 48 ||
snānaṃ kṛtvā narastasminyastalliṃgaṃ prapaśyati ||
karoti jāgaraṃ rātrau tasminneva dinedine ||
so'dyāpi vatsaraṃ yāvannāpamṛtyumavāpnuyāt || 49 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'marakeśvarakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 145 || || cha ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
ādityānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vasurudrādikāśvinām ||
pratyekaśaḥ samācakṣva nāmāni tvaṃ mahāmate || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
vṛṣadhvajaśca śarvaśca mṛgavyādhastṛtīyakaḥ ||
ajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ pinākī ṣaṣṭha eva hi || 2 ||

dhuro dhruvaśca somaśca makhaścaivānilo'nalaḥ ||
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ || 4 ||
varuṇaśca tathā sūryo bhānuḥ khyātaśca tāpanaḥ ||
iṃdraścaivāryamā caiva dhātā caiva bhagastathā || 5 ||
gabhastirdharmarājaśca svarṇaretā divākaraḥ ||
mitraśca vāsudevaśca dvādaśaite ca bhāskarāḥ || 6 ||
nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca khyātāvetau tathāśvinau ||
devavaidyau mahābhāgau tvāṣṭrīgarbhasamudbhavau || 7 ||

kṣetre'traivāsthitā nityaṃ dānavānāṃ vadhāya ca ||8||
yastānsaṃpūjayedbhaktyā puruṣaḥ saṃyateṃdriyaḥ||
yathoktadivase prāpte nāpamṛtyuḥ prajāyate || 9 ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ rudrāḥ pūjyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
tasminkṣetre viśeṣeṇa vāṃchadbhiḥ paramaṃ padam ||6.146.10||
daśamyāṃ vasavaḥ pūjyāstathāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
svargaṃ samīhamānaiśca vilāsairvividhaistathā || 11 ||
saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca pūjanīyā divākarāḥ ||
ye vāṃchanti narāḥ sattvaṃ paripaṃthivivarjitam || 12 ||
devavaidyau tathā pūjyau dvādaśyāṃ vyādhisaṃkṣayam ||
ye vāṃchanti sadā martyā nīrujā sambhavaṃti te || 13 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'mareśvarakuṇḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 146 || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyo'pi ca tatrāsti devaḥ putraprado nṛṇām ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

kasmādgṛhaṃ parityaktvā śuko'pi vanamāśritaḥ || 3 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
āsīdvyāsasya vipreṃdrāḥ kalatrārthaṃ matiḥ kvacit |
niṣkāmasya praśāṃtasya sarvajñasya mahātmanaḥ || 5 ||

|| garbha uvāca || ||
rākṣaso'haṃ piśācohaṃ devo'haṃ mānuṣastathā ||6.147.20||

|| vyāsa uvāca || ||

|| garbha uvāca || ||

|| śuka uvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ taṃ niḥspṛhaṃ jñātvā gṛhaṃ prati nijātmajam ||
piṃgalā duḥkhasaṃyuktā vyāsametaduvāca ha || 1 ||
ahaṃ tapaścariṣyāmi putrārthaṃ dvijasattama ||
anujñāṃ dehi me yena toṣayāmi maheśvaram ||
putro yena bhavenmahyaṃ vaṃśavṛddhikaraḥ paraḥ || 2 ||
evaṃ sā niścayaṃ kṛtvā labdhvānujñāṃ munestataḥ ||
kṣetrametatsamāsādya tapastepe pativratā || 3 ||
saṃsthāpya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ tadagre nirmalodakam ||
kṛtvā vāpīṃ suvistīrṇāṃ snānātpātakanāśanīm || 4 ||
tatastasyā gatastuṣṭiṃ bhagavāṃstripurāṃtakaḥ ||
varado'smīti tāṃ prāha prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || 5 ||
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || ||
parituṣṭo'smi te bhadre varaṃ varaya suvrate ||
yaḥ sthito hṛdaye nityaṃ nādeyaṃ vidyate mama || 6 ||
|| vaṭikovāca || ||
sutaṃ dehi suraśreṣṭha mama vaṃśavivardhanam ||
cittāhlādakaraṃ nityaṃ suśīlaṃ vinayānvitam || 7 || ||
|| śrīmahādeva uvāca || ||
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehastava putraḥ suśobhane ||
yādṛktvayā mahābhāge prārthitastadviśeṣataḥ || 8 ||
anyāpi mānuṣī yā'tra vāpyāṃ snātvā samāhitā ||
pañcamyāṃ vatsaraṃ yāvacchuklapakṣe hyupasthite ||
pūjayiṣyati malliṃgaṃ yaccādya sthāpitaṃ tvayā || 9 ||
sātha lapsyati satputraṃ dattvā phalamanuttamam ||
yā ca daurbhāgyasaṃyuktā tṛtīyādivase'tra vai || 6.148.10 ||
snātvā'tra salile paścānmalliṃgaṃ pūjayiṣyati ||
sā saubhāgya samopetā varṣāṃte ca bhaviṣyati || 11 ||
yaḥ punaḥ puruṣaścātra snātvā māṃ pūjayiṣyati ||
sakāmo lapsyate kāmānvikāmo mokṣameva ca || 12 ||
evamuktvā mahādevastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
sā'pi lebhe sutaṃ vyāsātkapiṃjalamiti śrutam || 13 ||
yādṛktena purā prokto devadevena śūlinā ||
yenaiva sthāpitā cātra devī kelīvarī purā ||
sarvasiddhipradā loke tatra yā''rādhitā purā || 14 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vaṭikeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 148 || || cha ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
śukrastasya vacaḥ śrutvā citte kṛtvā dayāṃ tataḥ ||

varaṃ varaya tasmāttvaṃ na vṛthā darśanaṃ mama || 17 ||
|| andhaka uvāca || ||
anenaiva tu rūpeṇa ye tvāṃ dhyāyaṃti dehinaḥ ||
pūjayaṃti ca sadbhaktyā saṃsthāpya pratimāṃ tava ||

devyuvāca || ||
yo māmanena rūpeṇa sthāpayiṣyati mānavaḥ ||
tasya mokṣaṃ pradāsyāmi pāpasyāpi na saṃśayaḥ || 19 ||
yo'ṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ mama pūjāṃ kariṣyati ||
tasmai svargaṃ pradāsyāmi pāpasyāpi danūttama || 6.150.20 ||
kevalaṃ darśanaṃ yaśca dhyānaṃ vā me kariṣyati ||
tasya rājyaṃ pradāsyāmi bhogānmānuṣasaṃbhavān | 21 ||
evamuktvā'tha sā devī tataścādarśanaṃ gatā ||
taiśca mātṛgaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ paśyatastasya tatkṣaṇāt | 22 ||
śakro'pi dānavānsarvāṃstayā saṃsiddhayā tataḥ ||
mṛtānsaṃjīvayāmāsa daiteyānnavabhakṣitān || 23 ||
taiḥ sametya sa daityendraḥ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ||
tāṃ purīṃ prāpya śakrasya rājyaṃ cakre divāniśam || 24 ||
tāṃ devīṃ dhyāyamānastu pūjayāno divāniśam ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa mahābalaḥ || 25
atha tasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ taṃ jñātvā vyāsasamudbhavaḥ ||
sthāne'tra sthāpayāmāsa saṃsiddhiṃ pa parāṃ gataḥ || 26 ||
|| sūta uvāca | ||
evaṃ kelīśvara devī saṃjātā parameśvarī ||
tasmātsthāpyā ca pūjyā ca dhyeyā caiva viśeṣataḥ || 27 ||
evaṃ devyā naro yaśca paṭhate vā śṛṇoti vā ||
vācyamānaṃ sa mucyeta vyasanena garīyasā || 28 ||
bhraṣṭarājyo'thavā rājā yaḥ śṛṇotyaṣṭamīdine ||
sa rājyaṃ labhate bhūyo nikhilaṃ hatakaṃṭakam || 29 ||
yuddhakāle ca saṃprāpte yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnaraḥ ||
sa hatvā śatrusaṃghātaṃ vijayaṃ ca samāpnuyāt || 6.150.30 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kelīśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 150 ||

|| || sūta uvāca || ||
andhako'pi parāṃ vidyāṃ jñātvā śukrārjitāṃ tadā ||

|| || andhaka uvāca || ||

|| andhaka uvāca || ||
nirviṇṇo'smi suraśreṣṭha triśūlā'graṃ samāśritaḥ ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

<6.152>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
