bāḍhamityeva tairukto dāśārhaḥ pāṃḍunaṃdanaḥ||
teṣāṃ tadbhāramāveśya praśāṃtenāṃtarātmanā||
yayau tīrthāni cānyāni kṛtakṛtyastataḥ param||45||
evaṃ tatra sthito devaścakrapāṇivapurddharaḥ||
svayameva hṛṣīkeśo jaṃtūnāṃ pāpanāśanaḥ||46||
adyā'pi ca kalā viṣṇoḥ prāpte caikādaśītraye ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena tasmācchraddhāsamanvitaiḥ ||
sadaiva pūjanīyaśca vandanīyo viśeṣataḥ || 47 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye cakrapāṇimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 152 ||

<6.153>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyadapi tatrāsti rūpatīrthamanuttamam ||
yatra snāto naraḥ samyagvirūpo rūpavānbhavet || 1 ||
pūrvaṃ bhagavatā tena brahmaṇā loka kartṛṇā ||
sṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā ca vistīrṇāṃ yathoktaṃ ca caturvidhām||2||
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa rūpasaṃcayasaṃyutām |]
ekāmapsarasaṃ divyāṃ devamāyāṃ sṛjāmyaham || | ||3||
tataśca sarvadevānāṃ samādāya tilaṃtilam||
rūpaṃ ca nirmame paścādatyāścaryamayīṃ ca tām ||4||
yāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣobhamāpannaḥ svayameva pitāmahaḥ ||5||
tatastāṃ preṣayāmāsa kailāsaṃ prati padmajaḥ ||
gaccha devi mahādevaṃ praṇamasva śucismite || 6 ||
tataḥ sā satvaraṃ gatvā kailāsaṃ parvatottamam ||
apaśyacchaṃkaraṃ tatra nirviṣṭaṃ pārvatīsamam || 7 ||
śaṃkaro'pi ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||
sudṛṣṭāṃ nākarodbhītyā pārśvasthāṃ vīkṣya pārvatīm|| ||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ cakre sā praṇamya maheśvaram |
śraddhayā parayā yuktā kṛtāṃjalipuṭā sthitā ||9||
yāvaddakṣiṇapārśvasthā tāvadvaktraṃ sa dakṣiṇam||
pracakāra mahādeva stadupākṛṣṭalocanaḥ || 6.153.10 ||
paścimāyāṃ yadā sā'bhūtpradakṣiṇavaśācchubhā ||
paścimaṃ vadanaṃ tena tadarthaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tataḥ ||11||
evamuttarasaṃsthāyāṃ tasyāṃ devena śaṃbhunā ||
uttaraṃ vadanaṃ klṛptaṃ gaurībhītena cetasā ||
na grīvāṃ cālayāmāsa kathaṃcidapi sa dvijāḥ ||12||
etasminnaṃtare tatra nārado munipuṃgavaḥ||
abravītpārvatīṃ paścātpraṇipatya maheśvaram || 13 ||
|| nārada uvāca || ||
paśya pārvati te patyuśceṣṭitaṃ garhitaṃ yathā ||
dṛṣṭvā rūpavatīṃ nārīṃ kṛtaṃ| mukhacatuṣṭayam || 14 ||
ahametadvijānāmi na tvayā sadṛśī kvacit ||
asti nārī tathā'nyopi vijānāti sureśvari || 19 ||
hāsyasya padavī madya tvaṃ gamiṣyasi pārvati ||
sarvāsāṃ devapatnīnāṃ jñātvānyāsaktamīśvaram || 16 ||
etaddevi vijānāsi yādṛkcittaṃ śivodbhavam ||
asyā upari veśyāyā niṃditāyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 17 ||
samādāya nije harmya etāṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyati ||
paraṃ lajjāsamopeto na bravīti vacaḥ śubhe || 18 | ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā kāṃtaṃ caturmukham ||
krodhena mahatāviṣṭā vikṛtaṃ vīkṣya taṃ haram || 19 ||
tato nirodhayā māsa drutaṃ sā parvatātmajā ||
sarvanetrāṇi devasya mahiṣīdharmamāśritā || 6.153.20 ||
etasminnaṃtare śailā viśīryaṃti samaṃtataḥ ||
maryādāṃ saṃtyajati sma sarve ca makarālayāḥ || 21 ||
pralayasya samutthānaṃ saṃjātaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
tāvadbrahmadinaṃ prāptaṃ paramaṃ sṛṣṭilakṣaṇam || 22 ||
nimeṣeṇa punastasya pralayasya prajāpateḥ ||
brahmaṇaḥ sā niśā proktā sarvaṃ toyamayaṃ bhavet || 23 ||
atha tatra gaṇāḥ sarve bhṛginaṃdipuraḥsarāḥ ||
so'pi devamunirbhītastāmuvāca sureśvarīm || 24 ||
muṃcamuṃca surajyeṣṭhe devanetrāṇi saṃprati ||
nocennāśaḥ samastasya lokasyāsya bhaviṣyati || 25 ||
evaṃ proktā'pi sā devī yāvacca na mumoca tam ||
tāvaddevena lālāṭaṃ visṛṣṭaṃ locanaṃ param|| 26 ||
kṛpāviṣṭena lokānāṃ yena rakṣā prajāyate ||
na śakto vārituṃ devīṃ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasīm || 27 ||
aṃbikāṃ vibudhāḥ prāhustryaṃbakāṇi yato dvijāḥ ||
tasmātsaṃkīrtyate loke tryaṃbakaśca sureśvaraḥ || 28 ||
tataḥ saṃtyajya taṃ devaṃ devī parvataputrikā ||
provāca koparaktākṣī puraḥsthāṃ tāṃ tilottamām || 29 ||
yasmānme dayitaḥ pāpe tvayā rūpādviḍaṃbitaḥ ||
caturvaktraḥ kṛtastasmāttvaṃ virūpā bhava drutam || 6.153.30 ||
tataḥ sā sahasā bhūtvā tatkṣaṇādbhagnanāsikā ||
śīrṇakeśā bṛhaddaṃtā cipiṭākṣī mahodarā || 31 ||
atha vīkṣya nijaṃ dehaṃ tathābhūtaṃ varāpsarāḥ ||
provāca vepamānā sā kṛtāṃjalipuṭā sthitā || 32 ||
ahaṃ saṃpreṣitā devi praṇāmārthaṃ triśūlinaḥ ||
brahmaṇā tena cāyātā yuṣmākaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 33 ||
nirdoṣāyā virāgāyāstasmādyuktaṃ na te bhavet ||
śāpaṃ dātuṃ prasāda me tasmāttvaṃ kartumarhasi || 34 ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā dīnaṃ satyaṃ ca pārvatī ||
paścāttāpasamopetā tataḥ provāca supriyam || 35 ||
strīsvabhāvātsamāyātaḥ kopo'yaṃ tvāṃ prati drutam ||
tasmādāgaccha gacchāvo mayā sārdhaṃ dharātale || 36 ||
tatrāsti rūpadaṃ tīrthaṃ mayā cotpāditaṃ svayam ||
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ snānārthaṃ vimalodakam || 37 ||
yā nārī prātarutthāya tatra snānaṃ samācaret ||
sā syādrūpavatī nūnamadṛṣṭe ravimaṃḍale || 38 ||
sadā māghe tṛtīyāyāṃ tatra snānaṃ karomyaham ||
adya sā tatra yāsyāmi snānāya kṛtaniścayā || 39 || ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā samādāya sā devī tāṃ tilottamām ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre rūpatīrthaṃ jagāma ca || 6.153.40 ||
tatra snānaṃ svayaṃ cakre vidhipūrvaṃ sureśvarī ||
tasyā hyanantaraṃ sāpi bhaktiyuktā tilottamā || 41 ||
tataḥ kāṃtimatī jātā tatkṣaṇādeva bhāminī ||
pūrvamāsīyadthārūpā tathāsā'bhūdviśeṣataḥ || 42 ||
atha tuṣṭisamāyuktā tāṃ praṇamya sureśvarīm ||
provāca vismayāviṣṭā harṣagadgadayā girā|| 43 ||
prāptaṃ rūpaṃ mahādevi tvatprasādāccirantanam||
brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyāmi māmanujñātumarhasi || 44 ||
|| gauryuvāca || ||
varaṃ yacchāmi te putri yatkiṃciddhadi saṃsthitam||
tasmātprārthaya viśrabdhā na vṛthā mama darśanam || 45 ||
|| tilottamovāca || ||
ahamatra kariṣyāmi kṣetre tīrthaṃ nijaṃ śubhe ||
tvatprasādena taddevi yātu khyātiṃ dharātale || 46 ||
tvayā tatrāpi kartavyaṃ varṣāṃte snānameva hi ||
hitārthaṃ sarvanārīṇāṃ rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam || 47 || ||
|| gauryuvāca || ||
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ sadāhaṃ tvatkṛte śubhe ||
snānaṃ tatra kariṣyāmi madhyāhne samupasthite || 48 ||
hitārthaṃ sarvanārīṇāṃ tava vākyādasaṃśayam ||
yā tatra divase nārī tasmiṃstīrthe kariṣyati || 49 ||
snānaṃ sā saukhyasaṃyuktā bhaviṣyati sukhānvitā ||
spṛhaṇīyā ca nārīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ dharaṇītale || 6.153.50 ||
puruṣo'pi subhaktyā yastatra snānaṃ kariṣyati ||
saptajanmāni rūpāḍhyaḥ sasaubhāgyo bhaviṣyati || 51 ||
sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktā tadā devyā sāpsarā dvijasattamāḥ ||
cakre kuṇḍaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ vimalodaprapūritam|| 52 ||
upakaṃṭhe tatastasya sthāpayāmāsa pārvatīm ||
tato jagāma saṃhṛṣṭā brahmalokaṃ tilottamā || 53 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti saṃjātaṃ kuṇḍamapsarasā kṛtam ||
snānamātrairnarairyatra saubhāgyaṃ labhyate dvijāḥ || 54 ||
nārībhiśca viśeṣeṇa putraprāptiranuttamā ||
tathānyadapi yatkiṃcidvāṃchitaṃ hṛdaye sthitam || 55 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'psaraḥkuṇḍotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 153 || || cha ||

<6.154>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
yā nārī tatra satkuṇḍe snātvā tāṃ pārvatīṃ punaḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā snāti tatastīrthe tasminrūpamaye śubhe ||1||
punaśca pārvatīṃ paśyecchraddhayā parayā yutā ||
sadyaḥ sā mucyate kṛtsnairājanmamaraṇāṃtikaiḥ || 2 ||
tatraivāsti jayānāma pārvatyāḥ kiṃkarī dvijāḥ ||
tayā tatra kṛtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ gaurīkuṇḍasamīpataḥ || 3 ||
yā tatra kurute snānaṃ tṛtīyādivase'balā ||
sutasaubhāgyasaṃpannā sā bhavetpativallabhā || 4 ||
tathānyadapi tatrāsti vijayākuṇḍamuttamam ||
tatra snātā'pi vaṃdhyā strī jāyate putrasaṃyutā || 5 ||
na ca paśyati putrāṇāṃ kadācidvyasanaṃ dvijāḥ ||
na viyogaṃ na duḥkhaṃ ca svapnāṃte ca kadācana ||6||
kākavaṃdhyā'pi yā nārī tatra snānaṃ samācaret||
sā putrānvividhām̐llabdhvā svargaloke mahīyate ||7|| ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
eteṣāṃ sūta tīrthānāṃ tīrthamasti susiddhidam||
kvacitkiṃñcidbhavetsiddhiryatra snānāccharīrajā || 8||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
saptaviṃśatiliṃgāni yāni saṃti dvijottamāḥ ||
teṣāṃ madhye'bhavatsiddhirekasminnikhilā dvijāḥ ||9||
ekasya sattvayuktasya vīravratayutasya ca ||
āśvinasya caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ||6.154.10||
ardharātre vidhānena teṣāṃ pūjāṃ karoti yaḥ ||
prāguktaṃ japanaṃ bhaktyā sa kramātsādhakottamaḥ||11||
aṃganyāsaṃ vidhāyoccaiḥ kṣurikāsūktamuccarat ||
teṣāmagre punaḥ samyakpūjayitvā ca śaṃkaram || 12 ||
pṛthagekaikaśo bhaktyā pūjayeddikpatīṃśca vai || 13 ||
athā''gatya gaṇeśo vai vikarālo bhayānakaḥ ||
laṃbodaro vai nagnaśca kṛṣṇadantasamudbhavaḥ || 14 ||
khaḍgahasto'bravīdyuddhaṃ prakuruṣva mayā samam ||
muktvaitatkapaṭaṃ bhūmau yadi vīro'si sāttvikaḥ || 15 ||
tatastatkarṣaṇāccāpi yastenāśu pratāḍyate ||
sa tenaiva śarīreṇa nīyate tena tatpadam || 16 ||
yatra sthāne jarāmṛtyurna śokaśca kadācana ||
tathā citreśvarīpīṭhe siddhirekasya kīrtitā || 17 ||
māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ pīṭhaṃ tatra pūjayet ||
āgamoktavidhānena samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 19 ||
paścātkapālamādāya mahāmāṃsaprapūritam ||
ahamasya karomyadya mahāmāṃsasya vikrayam || 19 ||
siddhimūlye na gṛhṇātu kaściccedasti sāttvikaḥ ||
tataśca yācate yaśca pragṛhṇāti ca saddvijāḥ || 6.154.20 ||
sa tamādāya niryāti yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ liṃgaṃ citraśarmapratiṣṭhitam || 21 ||
tasya sthānasya madhyastho yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ||
śivarātrau niśīthe ca puṣpalakṣaṇabhaktitaḥ ||
susiddhimāpnuyāttūrṇaṃ sa śarīreṇa tatkṣaṇāt || 22 ||
siddhisthānāni sarvāṇi tasminkṣetre sthitāni vai||
vīravrataprayuktānāṃ mānavānāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 23 || ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
tāmaso yastvayā proktaḥ siddhimārgo mahāmate ||
anarho brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 24 ||
śuddhāntaḥ karaṇaiḥ sūta bhūtahiṃsāvivarjitaiḥ ||
yathā saṃprāpyate mokṣo brāhmaṇaiḥ sucirādapi || 25 ||
tattvaṃ brūhi mahābhāga mokṣopāyaṃ dvijanmanām || 26 || ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
rudrairdaśabhiḥ saṃyuktamānaṃdeśvarakaṃ tathā ||
snātvā tadagrataḥ kuṇḍe śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 27 ||
saṃsiddhimāpnuyānmartyo durlabhāṃ tridaśairapi ||
māghamāse naraḥ snātvā viśvāmitrahrade naraḥ || 28 ||
pratyūṣe tilapātraṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahma loke mahīyate || 29 ||
yadyapi syāddurācāraḥ sarvāśī sarvavikrayī ||
suparṇākhyasya devasya purataḥ śraddhayā'nvitaḥ || 6.154.30 ||
prāyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā hyupavāsaparo naraḥ ||
yastyajenmānavaḥ prāṇānna sa bhūyo'bhijāyate || 31 ||
evaṃ siddhitrayaṃ proktaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāvaham ||
sāttvikaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ śaṃsitaṃ tridaśairapi || 32 ||
anyāni tatra tīrthāni devatāyatanāni ca ||
tāni svargapradānyāhurmunayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || 33 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam ||
hāṭakeśvaradevasya sarvapātakanāśanam || 34 ||
yo'tra sarveṣu tīrtheṣu snātvā paśyati bhaktitaḥ ||
sarvāṇyāyatanānyeva sa pāpo'pi vimucyate || 35 ||
etatkhaṃḍaṃ purāṇasya prathamaṃ parikīrtitam ||
kārtikeyapraṇītasya sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham || 36 ||
yaścaitatkīrtayedbhaktyā śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ ||
iha bhuktvā suvipulānbhogānyāti triviṣṭapam || 37 ||
sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadānaiśca yatphalam ||
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti śṛṇvañchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 38 ||
śrutvā purāṇametaddhi janmakoṭisamudbhavāt ||
pātakādvipramucyeta kulānāmuddharecchatam || 39 ||
tato vyāsaḥ pūjanīyo vastradānādibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
gobhūhiraṇyanirvāpairdānaiśca vividhairapi ||6.154.40||
tena saṃpūjito vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ manuḥ ||
sākṣātsatyavatīputro yena vyāsaḥ supūjitaḥ||41||
ekamapyakṣaraṃ yastu guruḥ śiṣye nivedayet||
pṛthivyāṃ nāsti taddravyaṃ yaddattvā hyanṛṇī bhavet ||42||
etatpavitramāyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ sva styayanaṃ mahat||
yacchrutvā sarvaduḥkhebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ||43|
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye citreśvarīpīṭhakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥpaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||154||

<6.155>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathā'nye tatra tiṣṭhaṃti vasavo'ṣṭau dvijottamāḥ||
sthānamekaṃ samāśritya sarvadaiva prapūjitāḥ||1||
ekādaśa tathā rudrā ādityā dvādaśaiva tu ||
devavaidyau tathā cānyāvaśvinau tatra saṃsthitau ||2||
devatāstatra tiṣṭhaṃti koṭikoṭipranāyakāḥ||
ekaikā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ kalikālabhayākulāḥ||3||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yajñabhāgāptaye sadā ||
aṣṭamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu madhumāse vyavasthite || 4 ||
yastānvasūñchucirbhūtvā snātvā dhautāṃbaro naraḥ ||
tarpayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhānpaścātsaṃpūjayennaraḥ || 5 ||
vasavastvā kṛṇvanniti mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ ||
naivedyaṃ ca tato dadyādvasavaśchaṃdasāviti || 6 ||
tato dhūpaṃ sugandhaṃ ca yo yacchati samāhitaḥ ||
vasavastvāṃ jetu tathā mantrametamudīrayet || 7 ||
ārārtikaṃ tato bhūyo yaḥ karoti dvijottamāḥ ||
vasavastvāṃ jetu tathā śrūyatāṃ yatphalaṃ hi tat || 8 ||
kanyābhiḥ koṭibhiryacca pūjitābhirbhavetphalam||
vasūnāṃ caiva tatsarvamaṣṭabhistaiḥ prapūjitaiḥ || 9||
tathā ye dvādaśādityāstasminkṣetre vyavasthitāḥ ||
tānsthāpya pūjayitvā ca saptamyāmarkavāsare ||
samyakchraddhāsamopetaḥ puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥ || 6.155.10 ||
paścāttatpuratasteṣāṃ samastānyekaviṃśatiḥ ||
ādityavrata saṃjñāni tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||11||
koṭidvādaśakaṃ yastu sūryāṇāṃ pūjayennaraḥ ||
tatphalaṃ prāpnuyātkṛtsnaṃ pūjayannātra saṃśayaḥ || 12 ||
tathaikādaśarudrā ye tatra kṣetre dvijottamāḥ ||
ekasthāne sthitāsteṣāṃ pūjayā śrūyatāṃ phalam || 13 ||
yastānpūjayate bhaktyā sthāpayitvā sureśvarān||
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ japecca śatarudriyam || 14 ||
ekādaśapramāṇena koṭayastena pūjitāḥ ||
bhavaṃti nātra saṃdehaḥ satyametanmayoditam || 15 ||
yathā tāvaśvinau tatra devavaidyau vyavasthitau ||
āśvine māsi cāśvinyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tathā tithau || 16 ||
yastau saṃpūjayitvā tu hyaśvinīsūktamuccaret |
dvikoṭi guṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ samyaktena samāpyate | 17 |
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ vasusaṃbhavam ||
ādityānāṃ ca rudrāṇāmaśvinordvijasattamāḥ || 198 || ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathā'nyo'pi ca tatrāsti yājñavalkyapratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
puṣpāditya iti khyātaḥ sarvakāmaprado nṛṇām || 19 ||
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya taṃ pūjayati mānavaḥ ||
sa taṃ kṛtsnamavāpnoti yadyapi syātsudurlabham||6.155.20||
aputro labhate putrāndhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt ||
bahuvairo'rināśaṃ ca vidyārthī śāstravidbhavet|| 21 ||
saptamyāmarkavāreṇa yastaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ||
mucyeddinodbhavātpāpānmahato'pidvijottamāḥ || 22 ||
pūjayā hi praṇaśyeta pāpaṃ varṣasamudbhavam||
nāśaṃ yāti na saṃdehastamaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 23 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ caiva yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām ||
phalahastaḥ sa mucyeta hyājanmamaraṇādaghāt || 24 ||
pradakṣiṇāṃ prakuvāṇo yo yaṃ kāmamabhīpsati ||
sa tamāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ niṣkāmo mokṣamāpnuyāt || 25 ||
saṃkrāṃtau sūryavāreṇa yaḥ kuryātsnāpanakriyām||
abhīṣṭaṃ sidhyate tasya meṣe vā yadi vā tule || 26 ||
tasminsarvaprayatnena vāṃchadbhirīpsitaṃ phalam ||
sa devo vīkṣaṇīyaśca pūjanīyo viśeṣataḥ || 27 ||
yaddevaiḥ sakalairdṛṣṭaiścamatkārapurodbhavaiḥ ||
phalamāpnoti taddṛṣṭau tena tatphalamāpnuyāt || 28 ||
| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
yājñavalkyena devo'sau yadi tāvatpratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
puṣpādityaḥ kathaṃ prokta etanno vaktumarhasi || 29 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi cetihāsaṃ purātanam ||
puṣpādityo yathā jāto yājñavalkyapratiṣṭhitaḥ||6.155.30||
astyatra medinīpṛṣṭhe supuraṃ vaidiśaṃ mahat ||
nānāsaudha samākīrṇaṃ varaprākāraśobhitam|| 31 ||
udyānaśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ taḍāgairupaśobhitam ||
tatrāsītpārthivaśreṣṭhaścitravarmeti viśrutaḥ || 32 ||
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirna ca caurakṛtaṃ bhayam ||
tasmiñchāsati dharmajñe satataṃ dharmavatsale || 33 ||
tatpure kṣatriyo jātyā maṇibhadra iti smṛtaḥ ||
sa vai dhanena saṃyuktaḥ pitṛpaitāmahena ca || 34 ||
tatpuraṃ sakalaṃ caiva sa rājā maṃtribhiḥ saha ||
kusīdāhṛtavittena vartate kārya utthite || 35 ||
sa ca kāyena kubjaḥ syājjarāvyāptastathaiva ca ||
valīpalitagātraśca hyatyaṃtaṃ ca virūpadhṛk ||36||
tathā caiva kukīnāśaḥ prabhūte'pi dhane sati ||
na dadāti sa pāpātmā kasyacitkiñcideva hi ||
na bhakṣayati tṛṣṇārtaḥ svayameva kathaṃcana || 37 ||
evaṃvidho'pi so'tīvavirūpo'pi sudurmatiḥ ||
prārthayāmāsa vai kanyāṃ svajātyāṃ vīkṣya suṃdarīm|| 38 ||
biṃboṣṭhīṃ cārudehāṃ ca muṣṭigrāhyakṛśodarīm||
padmapatraviśālākṣīṃ gūḍhagulphāṃ sukeśikām || 39 ||
raktāṃ saptasu gātreṣu trigaṃbhīrāṃ tathā punaḥ ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇāṃ jātīyāṃ sumanoramām || 6.155.40 ||
kṣatriyāddvijaśārdūlā daridreṇa ca pīḍitāt ||
tena tatsakalaṃ vṛttaṃ bhāryāyai saṃniveditam || 41 ||
tacchrutvā sā ca duḥkhena mūrcchitā saṃbabhūva ha ||
saṃbodhitā tatastena vākyairdṛṣṭāṃtasaṃbhavaiḥ || 42 ||
|| kṣatriya uvāca || ||
na sā vidyā na tacchilpaṃ na tatkāryaṃ na sā kalā ||
arthārthibhirna tajjñānaṃ dhanināṃ yanna dīyate || 43 ||
iha loke ca dhanināṃ paro'pi svajanāyate ||
svajano'pi daridrāṇāṃ kāryārthe durjanāyate || 44 ||
arthebhyo hi vivṛddhebhyaḥ saṃbhṛtebhyastatastataḥ ||
pravartaṃte kriyāḥ sarvāḥ parvatebhyo yathāpagāḥ || 45 ||
pūjyate yadapūjyo'pi yadagamyo'pi gamyate ||
vaṃdyate yadavandyo'pi hyanubaṃdho dhanasya saḥ || 46 ||
aśanādiṃdriyā ṇīva syuḥ kāryāṇyakhilāniha ||
sarvasmātkāraṇādvittaṃ sarvasādhanamucyate || 47 ||
arthārthī jīvaloko'yaṃ śmaśānamapi sevate ||
janitāramapi tyaktvā niḥsvaḥ saṃyāti dūrataḥ || 48 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye puṣpādi tyamāhālaye maṇibhadravṛttāṃte maṇibhadrāya kanyāpradānārthaṃ kṣatriyakṛtanijabhāryāsaṃbodhanavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||155|| ||

<6.156>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sambodhitā tena sā bhāryā vijane gatā ||
kanyāpradānasya ruciḥ saṃjātā tadanantaram || 1 ||
tataḥ sa pādau prakṣālya maṇibhadrasya satvaram||
udakaṃ sākṣataṃ haste kanyādānakṛte dadau || 2 ||
so'pi hastakṛte toye taṃ kṣatriyamuvāca ha ||
adyaiva kuru me śīghraṃ vivāhaṃ kanyayā saha || 3 ||
yasmādicchāmi saṃsthātuṃ tena te gṛhamāgataḥ ||
|| kṣatriya uvāca || ||
nātra nakṣatramarhaṃ tu na kiṃcidbhagadaivatam || || 4 ||
vivāhasya na vārastu prasupte madhusūdane ||
asminkāle tu saṃprāpte yā kanyā pariṇīyate ||5||
sā ca saṃvatsarānmadhye dhruvaṃ vaidhavyamāpnuyāt||
evaṃ daivajñamukhyānāṃ śrutaṃ pravadatāṃ mayā || 6 ||
tasmācchubhe tu saṃprāpte nakṣatre bhagadaivate ||
tvaṃ vivāhaya me kanyāṃ protthite madhusūdane ||
yena kṣemaṃkarī te syāttathā putraprapautriṇī || 7 ||
|| maṇibhadra uvāca || ||
nakṣatraṃ vahnidaivatyaṃ prasupto madhusūdanaḥ || 8 ||
sāṃprataṃ vatsarāṃto'yaṃ vivāhe vihite sati ||
kāmāgnirutthitaḥ kāye sāṃprataṃ māṃ prabādhate || 9 ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me kanyāvivahitena tu ||
tava vittaṃ pradāsyāmi sukhī yena bhaviṣyasi || 6.156.10 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasmācca vittalobhena kṣatriyo dvijasattamāḥ ||
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇādeva sa dvijāḥ || 11 ||
dadau kanyāṃ suduḥkhārtāmaśrupūrṇekṣaṇāṃ sthitām ||
sannidhau vahniviprāṇāṃ tadā tena vivāhitā || 12 ||
nītvā nijagṛhaṃ paścātkāmadharme niyojitā ||
anicchaṃtīmapi satīṃ tāmatīva nirargalaḥ || 13 ||
so'pi niṣkāmatāṃ prāpya nirbhartsya ca muhurmuhuḥ ||
bhāṣikābhiranekābhistāpayitvā ca bhāminīm|| 14 ||
śāṃtiṃ nītā tatastena pratyūṣe samupasthite ||
bhṛtyavargaḥ samasto'pi tato niḥsārito gṛhāt || 15 ||
irṣyādharmaṃ samāsthāya paramaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
eka eva kṛtastena dvārapālo napuṃsakaḥ || 16 ||
proktaṃ na ca tvayā deyaḥ praveśo'tra gṛhe mama ||
bhṛtyasya bhikṣukasyaiva vṛddhasya vratinastathā ||17||
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ tu tataścakre janaiḥ samam ||
vyavahārakriyāḥ sarvā dravyalakṣaiḥ sahasraśaḥ|| 18 ||
śvaśurasyāpi no dattaṃ kiṃcittena durātmanā ||
bhāryāyāḥ śvetavastrāṇi muktvā'nyannaiva kiṃcana || 19 ||
yāmadvaye'pi saṃprāpte dinasya gṛhamāgataḥ ||
mitamannaṃ tata stasyā bhojanārthaṃ prayacchati || 6.156.20 ||
yāvanmātraṃ ca sā bhuṃkta ekaviprānvitaḥ svayam ||
bhuktvā caiva tato yāti vyavahārakṛte bahiḥ || 21 || 8|
āgacchati punarharmyaṃ saṃdhyākāla upasthite ||
sā'pi tiṣṭhati harmyasthā patnī tasya durātmanaḥ || 22 ||
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ prāptā duḥkhaśokasamanvitā || |
matsīva patitā toyādanyasmiṃstu sthalāṃtike || 23 ||
cakravākī vimukteva saṃprāpte divasakṣaye ||
haṃsī haṃsaviyukteva mṛgīva mṛgavarjitā || 24 || |
so'pi nityaṃ dadau bhojyaṃ viprasyaikasya ca dvijāḥ ||
procya taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 25 ||
adhovaktreṇa bhoktavyaṃ sadā vipra gṛhe mama || |
yadi paśyasi me bhāryāṃ saṃprāpsyasi viḍaṃbanām ||26||
evaṃ viḍaṃbitāstena hyūrdhvavaktrāvalokinaḥ ||
ye cānye bhayasaṃtrastā na yāṃti ca tadālayam || 27 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya puṣponāma dvijottamaḥ ||
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena saṃprāptastatpuraṃ prati ||28||
pūrve vayasi saṃsthaśca darśanīyatamākṛtiḥ ||
kṣutkṣāmaḥ supariśrāṃto madhyāhne samupasthite || 29 ||
paribhramati vai nṛṇāṃ sa gṛhāṇi samaṃtataḥ ||
maṇibhadraḥ samādiṣṭastasya kenāpi bhojyadaḥ ||6.156.30|| ||
tatastaṃ prārthayāmāsa gatvā bhojyaṃ ca sa dvijāḥ ||
tenāpi sa dvijaḥ proktastadāsau dvijasattamāḥ || 31 ||
adhovaktreṇa bhoktavyaṃ tvayā vīkṣyā na me priyā ||
no cedviḍaṃbanāṃ vipra saṃprāpsyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 32 ||
evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāga yatkṣemaṃ tatsamācara || 33 ||
|| puṣpa uvāca || ||
kṣutkṣāmasya na me kāryaṃ paradāravilokanaiḥ ||
vedādhyayanayuktasya tīrthayātrāratasya ca || 34 ||
|| maṇibhadra uvāca || ||
tadāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ sāṃprataṃ mama maṃdiram ||
viśeṣāttava dāsyāmi bhojanaṃ dakṣiṇānvitam || 35 ||
evaṃ tau saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā yayaturbrāhmaṇottamāḥ ||
haṭṭamārge gatau tatra yatra ṣaṃḍho vyava sthitaḥ || 36 ||
tatpārśve brāhmaṇaṃ dhṛtvā praviṣṭo gṛhamadhyataḥ ||
bhāryayā śrapayāmāsa dhānyaṃ mānamitaṃ tadā || 37 ||
tato devārcanaṃ kṛtvā vaiśvadevāṃta āgatam ||
puṣpamāhūya tatpādau prakṣālya ca niveśya ca || 38 ||
kṛtvārcanavidhiṃ tasya dattvānnaṃ ca susaṃskṛtam ||
upaviśya tataḥ paścādbhojanārthaṃ tato dvijāḥ|
puṣpo'pi vīkṣate tasyāḥ pādau paṃkajasaṃnibhau||39||
yathāyathā sa kautukyādvīkṣate yauvanāśritaḥ||
kautukyāttena ca tatastasyā vaktraṃ nirīkṣitam ||6.156.40||
tataścākārayāmāsa maṇibhadraḥ prakopataḥ||
taṃ ṣaṇḍhamuktavāñjāraṃ tvamenaṃ ca viḍaṃbaya||41||
tatastena dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sa puṣpo mūrdhni tāḍitaḥ || 42 ||
adho nipatitaṃ bhūmau rudhireṇa pariplutam ||
caraṇābhyāṃ samākṛṣya dūto mārgaṃ samāśritaḥ || 43 ||
yāvaccatuṣpathaṃ nīto yatra saṃcarate janaḥ ||
hāhākāro mahānāsīttasminpuravare tadā || 44 ||
sarveṣāmeva paurāṇāṃ tadavasthaṃ vilokya tam ||
tato'nyaiḥ śītatoyena sobhiṣikto dayānvitaiḥ || 45 ||
kṛtvā vāyupradānaṃ ca gamitaścetanāṃ prati ||
sa prāpya cetanāṃ kṛcchrāttattoyāttānathābravīt || 46 ||
na mayā vihitaṃ cauryaṃ paradārā na sevitāḥ ||
paśyadhvaṃ maṇibhadreṇa yathāhaṃ kleśito janāḥ || 47 ||
tīrthayātrāparo vipro brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ||
bhojanārthaṃ samāmantrya nīto'vasthāmimāṃ tataḥ || 48 ||
kiṃ nāsti vātra bhūpālo yenaitadasamaṃjasam ||
brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa nirdoṣasya mahājanāḥ || 49 ||
|| janā ūcuḥ || ||
bahavastena pāpena viprāḥ pūrvaṃ viḍaṃbitāḥ ||
rājaprasādayuktena cerṣyāṃ prāpya śarīriṇā || 6.156.50 ||
ko'pi rājaprasādānna kiṃcidbrūte'sya sammukham ||
tasmāduttiṣṭha gacchāmo dāsyāmaste'śanaṃ vayam || 51 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye puṣpādityamāhātmye maṇibhadrakṛtapuṣpabrāhmaṇaviḍaṃbanavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 156 || || kṣa || ||

<6.157>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ saṃbodhitastaistu lokaiḥ puṣpastadā dvijāḥ ||
tānabravīttataḥ kuddho na kariṣyāmi bhojanam || 1 ||
yāvanna cāsya pāpasya kariṣyāmi pratikriyām ||
tadvadadhvaṃ mahābhāgā devo vā devatā'thavā || 2 ||
tathānye siddhamantrā vā sadyaḥ pratyayakārakāḥ ||
ārādhitā yathā sadyo mānuṣāṇāṃ varapradāḥ || 3 ||
|| janā ūcuḥ || ||
eko devaḥ sthitaścātra sadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ ||
tathaikā devatā cātra śrūyate jagatī tale || 4 ||
|| puṣpa uvāca || ||
ko'sau devaḥ kiyaddūre kasminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ ||
tathā ca devatā brūta dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari || 5 || ||
|| janā ūcuḥ || ||
camatkārapure sūryo yājñavalkyapratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
asti vipra śruto'smābhiḥ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaḥ || 6 ||
sūryavāreṇa saptamyāṃ phalahastaḥ pradakṣiṇām ||
yaḥ karoti narastasya hyaṣṭottaraśataṃ dvija || 7 ||
tasya siddhipradaḥ samyaṅmanasā vāṃchitaṃ dadet ||
tathānyā śāradā nāma devī kāśmīrasaṃsthitā || 8 ||
upavāsakṛtereva sāpi siddhipradāyinī ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ janānāṃ sa dvijottamāḥ || 9 ||
samuddiśya camatkāraṃ tasmātsthānāttataḥ param ||
camatkārapuraṃ prāpya saptamyāṃ sūryavāsare || 6.157.10 ||
tatrāgatya tataḥ snātvā śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ ||
gataḥ saṃti ṣṭhate yatra yājñavalkyakṛto raviḥ || 11 ||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā aṣṭottaraśataṃ mitāḥ ||
nālikerāṇi cādāya śraddhayā parayāḥ yutaḥ || 12 ||
tataḥ kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhaḥ sa pariśrāṃtastadagrataḥ ||
upaviṣṭo japaṃ kurvansūryeṣṭaiḥ stavanaistadā || 13 ||
maṃḍalabrāhmaṇādyaiśca tāraṃ svaramupāśritaḥ ||
saptayuṃjara vādyaiśca agnireveti bhaktitaḥ || 14 ||
ādityavratasaṃjñādyaiḥ sāmabhirdṛḍhabhaktibhāk ||
kṣurikāmaṃtrapūrvaiśca tathaivātharvaṇodbhavaiḥ || 15 ||
yāvadanyorkavārastu naiva tuṣṭo divākaraḥ ||
paurṇamāsīdine prāpte vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 16 ||
tataḥ puṣpo vidhāyātha snānaṃ dhautāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ||
bhūnāmnā sādhya bhūmiṃ ca sthaṃḍilārthaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 17 ||
sthaṃḍilaṃ hastamātraṃ ca sthaṃḍile pratyakalpayat ||
agnimīletimaṃtreṇa tato'gniṃ sa nidhāya ca || 18 ||
tṛṇaiḥ paristṛṇāmītikṛtvopastaraṇaṃ tataḥ ||
ābrahmanniti mantreṇa dattvā brahmāsanaṃ tataḥ || 19 ||
sutrāmāṇamiti procya samidhaḥsthāpanaṃ ca yat ||
prokṣaṇīpātramāsādya prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtavāṃstataḥ || 6.157.20 ||
pātrāṇāmatha sarveṣāṃ sruvādīnāṃ yathākramam ||
tataḥ prakalpayāmāsa haviḥsthāne nijāṃ tanum || || 21 ||
nyāyaṃ tu devatāsthāne sa ācāryavidhānataḥ ||
grahaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caiva sūryāya tveti cottaram || 22 ||
ayaṃ ta idhma ātmeti japtvātha samidhaṃ tataḥ ||
agnisometi mantrābhyāṃ hutvā cājyāhutī tataḥ || 23 ||
kṛtvā vyāhṛtihomaṃ tu bhūrbhuvaḥ sveti bho dvijāḥ ||
ye te śateti mantrādyairhutvātraiva ca dāruṇam || 24 ||
āhvayāmāsa vahniṃ ca pratyakṣo bhava deva me ||
evaṃ mantreṇa kṛtvā taṃ saṃmukhaṃ jvalanaṃ tataḥ || 25 ||
kālīkarālikādyāśca saptajihvāśca yāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
tāsāmāhvānakaṃ kṛtvā tato dīpte havirbhuji || 26 ||
juhāva ca sa māṃsāni svāni cotkṛttya śastrataḥ ||
lomabhyaḥ svāheti vidiśo digbhyo dattvā tataḥ param || 27 ||
agnaye sviṣṭakṛtaiti yāvadātmānamākṣipet ||
tāvaddhṛtaḥ sa sūryeṇa svahastena samaṃtataḥ || 28 ||
dhṛtaśca sādaraṃ tena mā vipra kuru sāhasam ||
nedṛgghomaḥ kṛtaḥ kvāpi kadācitkenaciddvija || || 29 ||
tuṣṭo'haṃ ca mahābhāga brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ||
adeyamapi dāsyāmi yatte manasivartate || 6.157.30 ||
|| puṣpa uvāca || ||
yadi tuṣṭosi deveśa yadi deyo varo mama ||
taddeyaṃ guṭikāyugmaṃ yadarthaṃ prārthayāmyaham || 31 ||
vaidiśe nagare cāsti maṇibhadro mahādhanī ||
kubjāṃgaḥ kṣatriyo deva jarāvalisamanvitaḥ || 32 ||
abrahmaṇyo mahānīcaḥ kīnāśo janadūṣitaḥ ||
dvayorekāṃ yadā vaktre sadā caiva karomyaham || 33 ||
tadā me tādṛśaṃ rūpamavikalpaṃ bhavatviti ||
yadā punargṛhītvā tāṃ dvitīyāṃ prakṣipāmyaham || 34 ||
tataśca sahajaṃ rūpaṃ mama bhūyātsureśvara ||
vaidiśe nagare cāsti maṇibhadraḥ sureśvara || 35 ||
aparaṃ tasya yatkiṃciddhanadhānyādikaṃ gṛhe ||
tatsarvaṃ viditaṃ me syāttathā deva prajāyatām|| 36 ||
kiṃ vānena bahūktena tasya mitrāṇi bāṃdhavāḥ ||
vyavahārāstathā sarve prakaṭāḥ syuḥ sadaiva hi || 37 ||
na kaścijjāyate tatra vikalpaḥ kasyacitkvacit ||
mama tasyādhama syāpi sarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā || 38 ||
|| bhāskara uvāca || ||
gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mahābhāga guṭikādvitayaṃ śubham ||
śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca vaktrasthaṃ vibheda jananaṃ mahat || 39 ||
śuklayā tasya rūpaṃ ca tava nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
kṛṣṇayāpi punaḥ svaṃ ca saṃprāpsyasi mahādvija || 6.157.40 ||
|| puṣpa uvāca || ||
aparaṃ vada me deva saṃdehaṃ hṛdaye sthitam ||
yattvāṃ pṛcchāmi deveśa tava kīrtivivardhanam ||41||
mayā śrutaṃ suraśreṣṭha saptamyāṃ sūryavāsare ||
yaste pradakṣiṇānāṃ ca kuryādaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ||
tasya tvaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva phalahastasya siddhidaḥ || 42 ||
mūrkhasyāpi ca pāpasya sarvadoṣānvitasya ca ||
caturvedasya me kasmāttīrthayātrāparasya ca || 43 ||
saptarātre gate tuṣṭo homa evaṃvidhe kṛte || 44 ||
|| śrīsūrya uvāca|| ||
tāmasena tu bhāvena tvavā sarvamidaṃ kṛtam||
tena sarvaṃ vṛthā jātaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ ca yatkṛtam || 49 ||
yatkiṃcitkriyate vipra tāmasaṃ bhāvamāśritaiḥ ||
tatsarvaṃ jāyate vyarthaṃ kiṃ na vetti bhavā nidam || 46 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ sūryastasya gātrāṇyupāspṛśat ||
khaṃḍitāni svahastena nirvraṇāni kṛtāni ca || 47 ||
abravīcca punaḥ puṣpaṃ prasanna vadanaḥ sthitaḥ ||
anenaiva vidhānena yaḥ karoti kuśaṃḍikām || 48 ||
somyabhāvaṃ samāśritya samidbhiścārkasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
tilākṣatairviśeṣeṇa homaṃ yastu samācaret || 49 ||
chandaṛṣisamopetamekaṃ yāvatsahasrakam ||
tasya dāsyāmyahaṃ hṛtsthamadhikebhyo'dhikaṃ phalam ||6.157.50||
evamuktvā sahasrāṃśustatraivāṃ taradhīyata ||
dīpavallakṣito naiva kena mārgeṇa nirgataḥ || 51 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭake śvarakṣetramāhātmye sūryasakāśātpuṣpabrāhmaṇasya varalabdhivarṇanaṃnāma saptapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 157 || || dha ||

<6.158>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
puṣpo'pi guṭike labdhvā bhāskarādvāritaskarāt ||
cirādbhojanamāsādya prasthito vaidiśaṃ prati || 1 ||
tato vaidiśamāsādya sa puṣpo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||
śuklā tāṃ guṭikāṃ vaktre cakāradvijasattamāḥ || 2 ||
maṇibhadrasamo jātastatkṣaṇādeva sa dvijaḥ ||
haṭṭamārgaṃ gate so'tha tasmingatvā'tha maṃdire ||
praviṣṭaḥ sahasā madhye prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || 3 ||
tataścākārayāmāsa taṃ ṣaṃḍhaṃ dvāramāśritam ||
tasya dattvātha vastrāṇi paścātṣaṃḍhamuvāca saḥ || 4 ||
ṣaṃḍhakaścitpumānatra samyagveṣakaro hi saḥ ||
mama veṣaṃ samādhāya bhramate sakale pure || 5 ||
sāṃprataṃ madgṛhe so'tha lobhanāyāgamiṣyati ||
sa ca kṛtrima veṣeṇa niṣeddhavyastvayā hi saḥ ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya dvāradeśaṃ samāśritaḥ || 6 ||
puṣpo'pi cābravīdbhāryāṃ māhikākhyāṃ tataḥ param ||
māhikedya mayā dṛṣṭaḥ svatātaḥ svapuraḥ sthitaḥ || 7 ||
vīrabhadraḥ suduḥkhārto malināṃbarasaṃvṛtaḥ ||
abravīcca tataḥ kopānmāmevaṃ paruṣākṣaram || 8 ||
dhigdhikpāpa tvayā kanyātīva rūpavatī sadā ||
vaṃcayitvā janetāramudūḍhā sā sumadhyamā || 9 ||
na dattaṃ tatpituḥ kiṃcinna tasyā atha putraka ||
vidhavāṃ yādṛśīṃ tāṃ ca śvetāṃbaradharāṃ sadā || 6.158.10 ||
saṃdhārayasi pāpātmanneṣṭaṃ bhojyaṃ prayacchasi ||
tasmāttasyāḥ piturdehi tvaṃ suvarṇāyutaṃ dhruvam || 11 ||
bhūṣaṇaṃ vāṃchitaṃ tasyā yattadvai rucipūrvakam ||
yena saṃdhārayedbhāryā sā''naṃdaṃ paramaṃ gatā || 12 ||
nirānaṃdā yato nārī na garbhaṃ dhārayetsphuṭam ||
niḥsaṃtāno yato vaṃśaḥ svargādapi kṣitiṃ vrajet || 13 ||
sa patiṣyatyasaṃdigdhaṃ kulāṃgāreṇa ca tvayā ||
sā tvamānaya vastrāṇi gṛhamadhyācchubhāni ca || 14 ||
yāni dattāni bhūpena vyavahāraistadā mama ||
pañcāṃgaśca prasādo yo mayā prāptaśca taiḥ saha || 15 ||
tvaṃ saṃdhāraya gātraiḥ svaiḥ śīghraṃ rasavatīṃ kuru ||
bhojanāyaiva śīghraṃ tu tvayā sārdhaṃ karomyaham || 16 ||
ekasminnapi pātre ca tadādeśādasaṃśayam ||
sāpi sarvaṃ tathā cakre yaduktaṃ tena harṣitā || 17 ||
bhojanācchādanaṃ caiva nirvikalpena cetasā ||
tataḥ kāmāturaḥ puṣpo maithunāyopacakrame || 18 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāpto maṇibhadraḥ samutsukaḥ ||
kṣutkṣāmaḥ sa pipāsārto vyavahārotthalipsayā || 19 ||
praveśaṃ kurute yāvadgṛhamadhye samutsukaḥ ||
niṣiddhastena ṣaṇḍhena bhartsayitvā muhurmuhuḥ || 6.158.20 ||
haṭhādyāvatpraveśaṃ sa cakāra nijamaṃdire ||
tāvacca daṇḍakāṣṭhena mastake tena tāḍitaḥ || 21 ||
atha saṃpatito bhūmau mūrchayā saṃpariplutaḥ ||
kartavyaṃ naiva jānāti tatprahāraprapīḍitaḥ || 22 ||
tataḥ kolāhalo jātastasya dvāre gṛhasya ca ||
janasya saṃprayātasya hāhākāraparasya ca || 23 ||
papracchustaṃ janāḥ keci ddhikpāpa kimidaṃ kṛtam ||
vṛttibhaṃgaḥ kṛto'nena atha tvaṃ vyaṃtarārditaḥ || 24 ||
imāmavasthāṃ yannītaḥ saṃprāpto'si nṛpādvadham || 25 ||
|| ṣaṃḍha uvāca || ||
na vṛttirgarhitā tena nāhaṃ vyaṃtarapīḍitaḥ ||
maṇibhadro na caiṣa syādeṣa veṣakaraḥ pumān || 26 ||
māṇibhadraṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā saṃprāpto yācituṃ dhanam ||
haṭhātpraviśyamānastu sa mayā mūrdhni tāḍitaḥ || 27 ||
maṇibhadro gṛhasyāṃtarbhuktvā śayanamāśritaḥ ||
saṃtiṣṭhate na jānāti vṛttāṃtamidamā sthitam || 28 ||
tataḥ puṣpo'pi tacchrutvā taṃ ca kolāhalaṃ bahiḥ ||
maṇibhadrasya rūpeṇa dvāradeśaṃ samāgataḥ || 29 ||
abravīnnityamabhyeti mama rūpeṇa cādhamaḥ ||
eṣa veṣadharaḥ kaścidyācituṃ dhanameva hi || 6.158.30 ||
etenāpi ca ṣaṃḍhena na ca bhadramanuṣṭhitam ||
yatkubjo'yaṃ hato mūrdhni yācituṃ samu pasthitaḥ || 31 ||
etasminnantare so'pi cetanāṃ prāpya kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
vīkṣate purato yāvattāvadātmasamaḥ pumān || 32 ||
sarvataḥ sa tamālokya tato vacanamabravīt || 33 ||
kva coraḥ saṃpraviṣṭo me mama rūpeṇa maṃdire ||
bhedayitvā tu ṣaṇḍākhyamevaṃ dattvā ca vāsasī || 34 ||
yāvadbhūpagṛhaṃ gatvā tvāṃ ṣaṃḍhena samanvitam ||
vadhāya yojayāmyeva tāvaddrutataraṃ vraja || 35 ||
|| puṣpa uvāca || ||
mama rūpaṃ samādhāya tvamāyāto gṛhe mama ||
śūnyaṃ matvā tato jñātastvayā'haṃ gṛhasaṃsthitaḥ ||36||
tato nṛpāya dāsyāmi vadhārthaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ ||
no cedgaccha drutaṃ pāpa yadi jīvitumicchasi ||37|| ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamukttvā tatastau ca bāhuyuddhena vai mithaḥ ||
yudhyamānau narairanyaiḥ kṛcchreṇa tu nivāritau ||38||
tataste svajanā ye tu maṇibha drasya cāgatāḥ ||
parijānaṃti no dvābhyāṃ viśeṣaṃ māṇibhadrakam || 39 ||
vālisugrīvayoryuddhaṃ tārārthe yudhyamānayoḥ ||
evaṃ vivadamānau tu krodhatāmrā yatekṣaṇau || 6.158.40 ||
rājadvāraṃ samāsādya sthitau svajanasaṃvṛtau ||
dvāḥsthena sūcitau rājñe sabhātalamupasthitau || 41 ||
cauracaureti jalpantau para sparavadhaiṣiṇau ||
bhūbhujā vīkṣitau tau ca dvijau tu dvijasattamāḥ ||42 ||
na viśeṣo'sti viśleṣastayorekopikāyataḥ ||
tataśca vyavahāreṣu samatī teṣu vai tadā || 43 ||
pṛṣṭau guhyeṣu sarveṣu pratyakṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ||
vadatastau yathāvṛttaṃ pṛthakpṛthagvyavasthitam || 44 ||
tatastu svajanaiḥ sarvaireko nītva tha cānyataḥ ||
pṛṣṭo gotrānvayaṃ sarvaṃ dvitīyastu tataḥ param || 45 ||
teṣāmapi tathā sarvaṃ yathāsamyaṅniveditam ||
atha rājā bṛhatsenaḥ sarvāṃstāni damabravīt || 46 ||
patnī cānīyatāṃ tasya maṇibhadrasya vai gṛhāt ||
nijakāntasya vijñāne sā pramāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati || 47 ||
tato gatvā ca sā proktā puruṣairnṛpasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
āgaccha kāṃtaṃ jānīhi tvaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 48 ||
tataḥ sā vrīḍayā yuktā pracchāditaśirāstataḥ ||
nṛpāgre saṃsthitā proce viddhisamyaṅnijaṃ priyam || 49 ||
na vayaṃ niścayaṃ vidmo na caite svajanāstava || 6.158.50 ||
tataḥ sā cintayāmāsa nijacitte varāṃganā ||
maṇibhadreṇa dagdhāhamīrṣyāvahnigatā'niśam || 51 ||
vaṃcayitvā tu pitaraṃ gṛhītāsmi tataḥ param ||
na kiṃcitpāpmanā dattaṃ jalpayitvā dhanaṃ bahu || || 52 ||
dvitīyena tu me puṃsā martyaloke sukhaṃ kṛtam ||
dattvā vastrāṇi citrāṇi tathaivābharaṇāni ca || 53 ||
pradāsyati ca tātasya suvarṇaṃ kathitaṃ ca yat ||
yadgṛhṇāmi svahastena maṇibhadraṃ dvitīyakam || 54 ||
evaṃ niścitya manasā dṛṣṭvā raktapariplutam ||
prathamaṃ maṇibhadraṃ sā jagṛhe'tha dvitīyakam|| 55 ||
abravīcca tato vākyaṃ sarvalokasya śṛṇvataḥ ||
ahaṃ tātena dattāsya vivāhe agnisaṃnidhau ||56||
dvitīyo'yaṃ durācāro veṣakartā samā gataḥ ||
māṃ ca prārthayate guptāṃ nānācāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 57 ||
tatastu pārthivaḥ kruddhastasya śākhāvalaṃbanam ||
ādideśa dvijaśreṣṭhā maṇibhadrasya durmateḥ || 58 ||
etasminnaṃtare so'tha vadhakānāṃ samarpitaḥ ||
taṃ vṛkṣaṃ nīyamānastu ślokānetāṃstadāpaṭhat || 59 ||
nirdayatvaṃ tathā drohaṃ kuṭilatvaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
aśaucaṃ nirghṛṇatvaṃ ca strīṇāṃ doṣāḥ svabhāvajāḥ || 6.158.60 ||
antarviṣamayā hyetā bahirbhāge manoramāḥ ||
guñjāphalasamākārā yoṣitaḥ sarva daivahi || 61 ||
uśanā veda yacchāstraṃ yacca veda bṛhaspatiḥ ||
manvādayastathānye'pi strībuddhestatra kiṃca na || 62 ||
pīyūṣamadhare vāsaṃ hṛdi hālāhalaṃ viṣam ||
āsvādyate'dharastena hṛdayaṃ ca prapīḍyate || 63 ||
alaktako yathā rakto naraḥ kāmī tathaiva ca ||
hṛtasārastathā so'pi pādamūle nipā tyate || 64 ||
saṃsāraviṣavṛkṣasya kukarmakusumasya ca ||
narakārtiphalasyoktā mūlameṣā nitaṃbinī || 65 ||
kasya no jāyate trāso dṛṣṭvā dūrā dapi striyam|| 66 ||
saṃsārabhramaṇaṃ nārī prathame'pi samāgame ||
vahnipradakṣiṇanyāyavyājenaiva pradarśayet || 67 ||
etāstu nirghṛṇatvena nirdaya tvena nityaśaḥ ||
viśeṣājjāḍyakṛtyena dūṣayaṃti kulatrayam || 68 ||
kulatrayagṛhaṃ kīrtyā nijayā dhavalīkṛtam ||
kṛṣṇaṃ karotyakṛ tyena nārī dīpaśikheva tu || 69 ||
dharmavṛkṣasya vātālī cittapadmaśaśiprabhā ||
sṛṣṭā kāmārṇavagrāhī kena mokṣadṛḍhārgalā || 6.158.70 ||
kārā saṃtānakūṭasya saṃsāravanavāgurā ||
svargamārgamahāgartā puṃsāṃ strī vedhasā kṛtā || 71 ||
vedhasā baṃdhanaṃ kiṃcinnṛṇāmanyadapaśyatā ||
strīrūpeṇa tataḥ ko'pi pāśo'yaṃ sudṛḍhaḥ kṛtaḥ ||72||
ityevaṃ bahudhā so'pi vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ ||
strīcintāṃ bahudhā kṛtvā ātmānaṃ cāpyagarhayat || 73 ||
aho kubuddhinā naiva labdhaṃ saṃsārajaṃ phalam||
na kadācinmayā dattaṃ tṛṣṇāvyākulacetasā || 74 ||
aiśvarye'pi sthite bhūri na mayā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
kadācinnaiva japtaṃ ca na hutaṃ ca hutāśane || 75 ||
athavā satyamevoktaṃ kenāpi ca mahātmanā ||
kṛpaṇena samo dātā na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||
aspṛṣṭvāpi ca vittaṃ svaṃ yaḥ parebhyaḥ prayacchati || 76 ||
śaraṇaṃ kiṃ prapannānāṃ viṣavanmārayaṃti kim ||
na dīyate na bhujyaṃte kṛpaṇena dhanāni ca || 77 ||
dānaṃ bhogo nāśastisro gatayo bhavaṃti vittasya ||
yo na dadāti na bhuṃkte tasya tṛtīyā gatirbhavati || 78 ||
dhaninopyadānavibhavā gaṇyaṃte dhuri daridrāṇām||
nahi haṃti yatpipāsāmataḥ samudro'pi marureva || 79 ||
atyupayuktāḥ sadbhirgatāgatairaharahaḥ sunirviṇṇāḥ ||
kṛpaṇajanasaṃnikāśaṃ saṃprāpyārthāḥ svapaṃtīha || 6.158.80 ||
prāptānna labhaṃte te bhogānbhoktuṃ svakarmaṇā kṛpaṇāḥ ||
mukhapākaḥ kila bhavati drākṣāpāke balibhujānām || 81 ||
dātavyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ sati vibhave saṃcayo na kartavyaḥ ||
paśyeha madhukarīṇāṃ saṃcitamarthaṃ haraṃtyanye || 82 ||
yācitaṃ dvijavare na dīyate saṃcitaṃ kratuvare na yojyate ||
tatkadaryaparirakṣitaṃ dhanaṃ caurapārthivagṛheṣu bhujyate || 83 ||
tyāgo guṇo vittavatāṃ vittaṃ tyāgavatāṃ guṇaḥ ||
parasparaviyuktau tu vitta tyāgau viḍambanam || 84 ||
kiṃ tayā kriyate lakṣmyā yā vadhūriva kevalā ||
yā na veśyeva sāmānyā pathikairapi bhujyate || 85 ||
arthoṣmaṇā bhavetprāṇo bhavedbhakṣyairvinā nṛṇām ||
yataḥ saṃdhāryate bhūmiḥ kṛpaṇasyoṣmaṇā hi sā || 86 ||
kṛpaṇānāṃ prasādena śeṣo dhārayate mahīm ||
yataste bhūgataṃ vittaṃ kurvate tasya coṣmaṇā || 87 ||
evaṃ bahuvidhā vācaḥ pralapanmaṇibhadrakaḥ ||
nītvā taiḥ pārthivoddiṣṭaiḥ puruṣaiḥ paruṣākṣaram ||
bahudhā pralapaṃ ścaiva kṛtaḥ śākhāvalaṃbanaḥ || 88 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye maṇibhadro pākhyāne maṇibhadranidhanavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 158 || || cha ||

<6.159>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
puṣpo'pi tāṃ samādāya māhikākhyāṃ varāṃganām ||
sa tadā prayayau hṛṣṭo maṇibhadrasya maṃdiram || 1 ||
śaṃkhatūryaninādena sarvaistaiḥ svajanairvṛtaḥ ||
na kasya tatra saṃbhūto vikalpastatsamudbhavaḥ || 2 ||
bhāskarasya prasādena tathaivānyasya karhicit ||
so'pi maṃdiramāsādya yathātmapitṛsaṃbhavam || 3 ||
upaviśya tato madhye bandhūnsarvānsamāhvayat ||
adya tāvaddine mahyaṃ tulāgraṃ kamalā śritā || 4 ||
calitāpi punaścāsyāḥ supatnyā vākyataḥ sthitā ||
kiyaṃtaṃ caiva kālaṃ me kārpaṇyaṃ mahadāsthitam || 5 ||
jñātamadya calā lakṣmīstena tyaktaṃ sudūrataḥ ||
tasmādbaṃdhujanaiḥ sārdhaṃ devairvipraiśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
saṃvibhaktāṃ kariṣyāmi satyenātmānamālabhe || 6 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ sarvānsamāhūya pṛthakpṛthak ||
sa nāmabhirdadau vastraṃ bhūṣaṇāni yathārhataḥ || 7 ||
tato vedavido viprānsamāhūya sa nāmabhiḥ ||
ekaikasya dadau vittaṃ savastraṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || 8 ||
tatastu nartakebhyaśca dīnāṃdhebhyo viśeṣataḥ ||
dadau bhojyaṃ sami ṣṭānnaṃ savastraṃ ca dvijottamāḥ || 9 ||
tatastu svayamevānnaṃ bubhuje bhāryayā saha ||
visṛjya tānsamāyātānsvajanānbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 6.159.10 ||
evaṃ tena tadā prāptaṃ vittaṃ ca parasaṃbhavam ||
bubhuje svecchayā nityaṃ tadā bhāryāsamanvitaḥ || 11 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye puṣpavibhavaprāptivarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 159 || || dha ||

<6.160>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
anyasminnahani prāpte rahasyuktaḥ sa bhāryayā ||
rātrau prasuptaḥ pārśve ca pādau saṃspṛśya tatkṣaṇāt || 1 ||
tvaṃ tāvanmama bharttāsi yāvajjīvamasaṃśayam ||
tadvadasva vibho'smākaṃ tvadarthaṃ sa mayojjhitaḥ || 2 ||
indrajālamidaṃ kiṃ te kiṃ vā maṃtraprasādhanam ||
devānāṃ vā prasādo'yaṃ yattvaṃ caitādṛśaḥ sthitaḥ || 3 ||
mayā tvaṃ hi tadā jñātaḥ prathame'pi dine sthite ||
yadā saṃbhūṣitā vastraistathā vastuvibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 4 ||
yadyahaṃ tava vārtāṃ ca sarvāṃ kapaṭasaṃbhavām ||
kathayāmi dvitīyasya tatte pādau spṛśāmyaham || 5 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamukto vihasyoccaiḥ sa tadā brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||
tāmāliṃgya tataḥ prāha vacanaṃ madhurākṣaram || 6 ||
sādhu priye tvayā jñātaṃ sarvaṃ mama viceṣṭitam ||
ahaṃ sa vipraḥ subhage maṇibhadreṇa yaḥ purā || 7 ||
viḍaṃbito mukhaṃ paśyaṃstvadīyaṃ caṃdrasannibham ||
camatkārapuraṃ gatvā mayā cārādhito raviḥ ||
tena tuṣṭena me dattaṃ tadrūpaṃ jñānameva ca ||8||
|| māhikovāca || ||
tvadīyadarśanenāhaṃ kāmadevavaśaṃ gatā || 9 ||
tasmādārādhayiṣyāmi taṃ gatvā dinanāyakam ||
yena te tādṛśaṃ bhūyaḥ pratuṣṭo vidadhāti saḥ || 6.160.10 ||
kiṃ me caitena rūpeṇa tāruṇyenāpi ca prabho ||
yatte tathāvidhaṃ rūpaṃ saṃbhajāmi divāniśam || 11 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā guṭikāṃ puṣpa samādāya mukhāntataḥ ||
dadhāra tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ yādṛgdṛṣṭaṃ purā tayā || 12 ||
tataḥ sā harṣitā māhī pulakena samanvitā ||
tamāliṃgyābhajadgāḍhaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha || 13 ||
adya me saphalaṃ janma yauvanaṃ rūpameva ca ||
yattvaṃ hṛdvāṃchitaḥ kāṃtaḥ pralabdho madanopamaḥ || 14 ||
etāvaṃti dinānyeva na mayā kāmajaṃ sukham ||
api svalpataraṃ labdhaṃ kathaṃcidvṛddhasevayā || 15 ||
bhajasva svecchayā vipra dāsī te'haṃ vyavasthitā || 16 ||
|| puṣpa uvāca || ||
praviśāmi kimaṃgeṣu bhavantīṃ kiṃ milāmyaham ||
priye cireṇa labdhāsi na jāne kara vāṇi kim || 17 ||
evamuktvā tatastau ca maithunāya kṛtakṣaṇau ||
pravṛttau brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ kāmadevavaśaṃgatau || 198 ||
atha rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmudite sūryamaṇḍale ||
vaktre tāṃ guṭikāṃ kṛtvā sa puṣpastādṛśo'bhavat || 19 ||
evaṃ tasya sthitasyātra mahānkālo vyajāyata ||
putrāḥ pautrāstathā jātāḥ kanyakāśca tathaiva ca || 6.160.20 ||
sa vṛddhatvaṃ yadā prāpto jarāviplavatāṃ gataḥ ||
tadā sa cintayāmāsa mayā pāpaṃ mahatkṛtam || 21 ||
maṇibhadro varāko'sau mithyācāreṇa ghātitaḥ ||
tasya bhāryā hṛtā caiva prasūtiṃ ca niyojitā || 22 ||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ tasmādgatvā karomya ham ||
puraścaraṇasaṃjñaṃ ca yena śuddhiḥ prajāyate || 23 ||
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā puṣpaścitte nije tadā ||
asaṃkhyaṃ vittamādāya camatkārapuraṃgataḥ || || 24 ||
putrebhyo'pi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ dattvā caiva pṛthakpṛthak ||
prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa tasya sūryasya śobhanam || 25 ||
yasminsiddhiṃ gataḥ so'tra yājñavalkyapratiṣṭhite ||
tato madhyamamāhūya praṇipatyābhivādya ca ||
so'bravīdbrāhmaṇānāṃ me cātuścaraṇamānaya || 26 ||
yenāhamagrato bhūtvā prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye ||
puraścaraṇasaṃjñaṃ tu prārthayāmi yathāvidhi || 27 ||
iti skānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭa keśvarakṣetramāhātmye puṣpasya pāpakṣālanārthaṃ hāṭakeśvarakṣetragamanapuraścaraṇārthabrāhmaṇāmantraṇavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 160 || || a || ||

<6.161>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha tena dvijāḥ sarve brahmasthāne niveśitāḥ ||
cātuścaraṇasaṃjñāśca tatastasya niveśitāḥ || 1 ||
so'pi keśānparityajya sarvagātrasamudbhavān ||
nijapatnyā samopetaḥ praṇamya ca dvijottamān || 2 ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha ||
bhāskarasyāsya vihitaḥ prāsādoyaṃ mayā dvijāḥ || 3 ||
puṣpāditya iti khyātiṃ prayātu bhuvanatraye ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
na vayaṃ yājñavalkyasya kīrtiṃ neṣyāmahe kṣayam || 4 ||
prāyaścittaṃ pradāsyāmaścittasya hṛdayaṃgamam ||
anye ca brāhmaṇāḥ procuḥ kecinmadhyasthavṛttayaḥ || 5 ||
vṛttyarthamasya devasya lakṣaṃ home'tra kalpyatām ||
lakṣaṃ tu sarvaviprāṇāṃ prāyaścittaviśuddhaye || 6 ||
|| puṣpa uvāca || ||
tasmātsarve dvijaśreṣṭhā mannāmnā kīrtayaṃtvimam ||
puṣpādityamiti khyātiṃ kīrtayaṃtu tathāniśam || 7 ||
anayā bhāryayā mahyaṃ mānyā yā sthāpitā purā ||
durgā'syāścātra nāmnā vai bhūyātkhyātā'tra satpure || 8 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
duḥśīlena purā'kāri prāsādo harasaṃbhavaḥ ||
durvāsaḥsthāpitasyāpi bhavadbhistuṣṭa mānasaiḥ || 9 ||
tathāpyasya tu dīnasya prāsādaḥ kriyatāṃ dvijāḥ || 6.161.10 ||
nāmamātreṇa devasya duḥśīlena yayā purā ||
anenārādhitaḥ pūrvaṃ svamāṃsaireṣa bhāskaraḥ || 11 ||
tasmānna kṣatirasyātha datte nāmni yathā purā ||
nāmnā māhikayā nāma māhītyeva ca sā bhavet ||12||
|| sūta uvāca ||
puṣpeṇa dāne datte'tha saṃmatenāgrajanmanām ||
madhyamena kṛtaṃ nāma puṣpāditya iti śrutam || 13 ||
tatpatnyā cāpi yā tatra durgā devī dvijottamāḥ ||
nāmnā māhikayā nāma māhītyeva ca sā'bhavat || 14 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭosmi dvijottamāḥ ||
puṣpā dityo yathā jāto yājñavalkyapratiṣṭhitaḥ || 15 ||
adyāpi kalikāle sa dṛṣṭo bhaktyā sureśvaraḥ ||
nāśayeddinajaṃ pāpaṃ narāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || || 16 ||
tathā ca saptamīyukte ravervāre dvijottamāḥ ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃyāvatphalahastaḥ karoti yaḥ ||
pradakṣiṇāṃ ca sadbhaktyā sa labhedvāṃchitaṃ phalam ||17||
māhīkāmapi yo durgāṃ nityameva prapaśyati ||
na sa paśyati kaṣṭāni tasminnahani karhicit || 18 ||
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ yastāṃ pūjayate naraḥ |
tasya saṃvatsaraṃyāvannāpatsaṃjāyate kvacit || 19. ||
iti śrīskāṃdemahāpurāṇaekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramā hātmye puṣpādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 161 || || 9 ||

<6.162>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ nāmni kṛte tasya bhāskara syāṃśumālinaḥ ||
dvijānāṃ purataḥ puṣpaḥ kathayāmāsa ceṣṭitam || 1 ||
ātmīyaṃ kutsitaṃ teṣāṃ maṇibhadravadho yathā ||
vihito vihitā patnī tasya vyājena kṛtsnaśaḥ || 2 ||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ procustacchrutvā kopasaṃyutāḥ ||
sītkārānpracurānkṛtvā dhiktvāṃ pāpa pragamyatām || 3 ||
ātmīyaṃ hema cādāya na te śuddhirbhaviṣyati || 4 ||
brahmaghnastvaṃ yataḥ proktāstrayo varṇā dvijottamāḥ ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ smṛtiśāstraprapāṭhakaiḥ || 5 || ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatastu duḥkhitaḥ puṣpo bāṣpasaṃpūritekṣaṇaḥ ||
brahmasthānādvinirgatya praruroda suduḥkhitaḥ || 6 ||
rorūyamāṇamālokya tataste nāgarā dvijāḥ ||
dayāṃ ca mahatīṃ kṛtvā tataḥ procuḥ parasparam || 7 ||
nānāvidhāni śāstrāṇi smṛtayaśca pṛthagvidhāḥ ||
purāṇāni samastāni vīkṣadhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 8 ||
kutracitkvacidevāsya kathaṃcicchuddhirasti cet ||
na tacca vidyate śāstramasminsthāne na cāsti yat||9|| 
na smṛtirna purāṇaṃ ca vedāṃtaṃ vā dvijottamāḥ || 
na cāsti brāhmaṇaḥ so'tra sarvajñapratimo na yaḥ || 6.162.10 || 
tasmāccintayata kṣipramasya śuddhipradaṃ hi yat ||
tacca pramāṇatāṃ nītvā śuddhirasya pradīyate || 11 ||

mayā skāṃdapurāṇe'sminpuraścaraṇasaṃśritā ||12||

puraścaraṇataḥ pāpaṃ vihitaṃ tu yathā vrajet || 13 ||
samyaktathāpi vipreṃdrāstato yāti na saṃśayaḥ ||
tasmātkarotu tāmeṣa puraścaraṇasaptamīm || 14 ||
aparaṃ bhūbhujādeśānmaṇibhadro nipātitaḥ ||
vadhakaistasya tatpāpaṃ yadi pāpaṃ prajāyate || 15 ||
rājā bhūtvā na yaḥ samyagvicārayati vādinam ||
tasya tatpātakaṃ ghoraṃ rājñaścaiva prajāyate || 16 ||
tathāsya patnyāstatpāpaṃ jānaṃtyā yattayoditam ||
matpitrā brāhmaṇairdatto'yaṃ purā vahnisaṃnidhau || 17 ||
viḍaṃbitena cānena kṛtapratikṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
tasmānna cāsya doṣaḥ syādyataḥ proktaṃ munīśvaraiḥ || || 18 ||
kṛte pratikṛtaṃ kuryāddhiṃsane pratihiṃsanam ||
na tatra jāyate doṣo yo duṣṭe duṣṭamācaret|| 19 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
yadyevaṃ vada viprāsya puraścaraṇasaṃjñitām ||
saptamīmadya vipreṃdra varākasya viśuddhaye || 6.162.20 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
athāsya kathayāmāsa saptamīṃ tāṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
caṃḍaśarmābhidhānastu kṛtvā tasyopari kṛpām || 21 ||
tenāpi vihitā samyagyathā tasya mukhācchrutā ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte vipāpmā samapadyata || 22 ||
|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
puraścaraṇasaṃjñāṃ tu saptamīṃ vada sūtaja ||
vidhinā kena kartavyā kasminkāla upasthite || 23 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi rohitāśvasya bhūpateḥ ||
mārkaṃḍena purā proktā pṛcchayamānena bhaktitaḥ || 24 ||

rohitāśvena pṛṣṭaḥ sa hariścaṃdrātmajena ca || 25 ||
|| rohitāśva uvāca || ||
ajñānājjñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ ||
upāyaṃ tasya nāśāya kiṃcinme vada sanmune || 26 ||
|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || ||
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ ca tṛtīyakam ||
trividhaṃ pātakaṃ loke narāṇāmiha jāyate || 27 ||

|| rohitāśva uvāca || ||
sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ vihitānāṃ munīśvara ||

prāyaścittāni sarveṣāṃ kartuṃ śaktiḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 36 || ||
|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || ||

|| rohitāśva uvāca || ||

vidhinā kena kartavyā kasminkāle vada sva me || 6.162.40 ||
|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || ||
māghamāse site pakṣe makarasthe divākare ||

pataṃgāya namaḥ pādau mārtaṃḍāyeti jānunī || 45 ||

kaṃṭhaṃ padmadalābhāya śirastejomayāya ca ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivaddhūpaṃ karpūramādadet || || 47 ||

raktasūtreṇa dīpaṃ ca tathaivārārtikaṃ nṛpa || 48 ||

kukṛtaṃ yatkṛtaṃ kiṃcidajñānājjñānato'pi vā ||

tataḥ saṃpūjayadvipraṃ gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ||
dattvā tu bhojanaṃ tasmai dakṣiṇāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ ||
prāśanaṃ kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ pañcagavyasya cācaret | 51 ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā samudvīkṣya divākaram||

idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva gṛhītaṃ puratastava ||

kapilāyā mahāvīra sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ||
āṣāḍhe munipuṣpaiśca pūjayedbhāskaraṃ nṛpa || 6.162.60 ||
naivedye ghārikā proktā prāśanaṃ madhusarpiṣoḥ ||
dhūpaṃ caivāgaruṃ dadyātparayā śraddhayā yutaḥ || 61 ||

brāhmaṇāya nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ||

|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

suvarṇamaṇi ratnāni saṃkhyayā parivarjitam || 77 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha te nāgarāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tadvittabhājanam ||
na kenāpi grahītavyaṃ sarvānkāmānnirasya ca || 1 ||
tataste samayaṃ kṛtvā samānīya ca madhyagam ||
tasyāsyena tataḥ procurbrahmasthāne vyavasthitāḥ || 2 ||
anena lobhayuktena tiraskṛtya dvijottamān ||
puṣpavittamupādāya prāyaścittaṃ prakīrtitam || 3 ||
tathā caiva tu ṣaḍbhāgo gṛhīto vibhavasya ca ||
tasmādeṣa samastānāṃ bāhyabhūto bhaviṣyati || 4 ||
nāgarāṇāṃ dvijedrāṇāṃ yathānyaḥ prākṛtastathā || 5 ||
adyaprabhṛti cānena yaḥ saṃbaṃdhaṃ kariṣyati ||
so'pi bāhyastu sarveṣāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ bhaviṣyati || 6 ||
bhojanaṃ vātha pānīyaṃ yo'sya sadmani karhicit ||
kariṣyati sa cā'pyevaṃ patitaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 7 ||
evamuktvā tatastena dattaṃ tālatrayaṃ dvijāḥ ||
brahmasthāne dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛtvā puṣpasamaṃ ca tam || 8 ||
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve jagmuḥ svaṃsvaṃ niveśanam ||
caṃḍaśarmā sa codvignaḥ puṣpapārśvaṃ tadā gataḥ || 9 ||
eteṣāmeva sarveṣāṃ saṃmatena mayā tava ||
prāyaścittaṃ tadā dattaṃ tathā pi patitaḥ kṛtaḥ || 6.163.10 ||
tasmādahaṃ patiṣyāmi susamiddhe hutāśane ||
naiva jīvitumicchāmi svajanaiḥ parivarjitaḥ|| 11 ||
|| puṣpa uvāca || ||
na viṣādastvayā kāryaḥ kārye'smidvijasattama ||
vittārthaṃ dūṣitastvaṃhi yato brāhmaṇasattamaiḥ || 12 ||
nāgarāṃstoṣayiṣyāmi tānahaṃ vividhairdhanaiḥ ||
yācayiṣyaṃti yanmātraṃ tava gātraviśuddhaye || 13 ||

yuṣmābhirvittalobhena tadvittaṃ vo dadāmyaham||

patito'yaṃ kṛto 'smābhirnaiva vittasya kāraṇāt ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā dvijāḥ sarve jagmuḥ svaṃsvaṃ niketanam||

jagāmātha nijāvāsaṃ niḥśvasannurago yathā || 24 ||
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa yāvanno sāhasaṃ kṛtam ||
tāvatsiddhirmanuṣyāṇāṃ na kathaṃcitprajāyate || 25 ||
tasmādahaṃ kariṣyāmi caṇḍaśarmakṛte mahat ||
kṛtaghnatā yathā na syātproktaṃ caiva yato budhaiḥ || 26 ||
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate tathā ||
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ || 27 ||
evaṃ niścitya manasā sūryavāreṇa saptamī ||
yadā''yātā dvijaśreṣṭhāstadā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 28 ||
pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtāstena puṣpādityasya dhīmatā ||
tīkṣṇaṃ śastraṃ samādāya pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ ||
chittvāchittvā nijāṃgāni juhuyājjātavedasi || 29 ||

tāvatpratyakṣatāṃ gatvā sa prokto bhāsvatā svayam|| 6.163.30 ||
puṣpa mā sāhasaṃ kārṣīḥ parituṣṭo'smi te'nagha ||
bhūya eva mahābhāga brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham || 31 ||
|| puṣpa uvāca || ||
caṇḍaśarmā dvijendro'yaṃ madarthe patitaḥ kṛtaḥ ||

|| bhagavānuvāca || ||

vikhyātiṃ te'pi yāsyaṃti mānyāḥ pūjyā mahībhṛtām || 36 ||

iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgararakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye brāhmanāgarotpattivṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 163 || || cha ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| puṣpa uvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

sā śrutvā tasya tadvākyaṃ niṣkāmasya prajalpitam ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
gādhestu yā'tha patnī ca prāśanāccaru kasya vai ||
sāpi garbhaṃ dadhe tatra vāsare mantrataḥ śubhā || 1 ||

vedadhvanirbhavedyatra tatra harṣasamanvitā ||
pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgī sā śuśrāva ca sarvadā ||
tyaktvā rājyocitānsarvānalaṃkārānsukhāni ca || || 3 ||

|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||

|| rājovāca || ||
caturaṃgeṇa sainyena mṛgayāmahamāgataḥ || 21 ||

|| vasiṣṭha uvāca || ||

pātāyaṣyati māṃ nūnameṣa sthānānnṛpottamaḥ || 5 ||

viśvāmitraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ bhayena mahatā'nvitaḥ || 6 ||
|| iṃdra uvāca || ||
viśvāmitra pratuṣṭo'smi tapasānena pārthiva ||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yadabhīṣṭaṃ hṛdisthitam|| 7 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
brāhmaṇyaṃ dehi me śakra yadi tuṣṭo'si sāṃpratam ||
tadarthaṃ tapasaścaryāṃ jānīhi tvaṃ puraṃdara ||9||
|| iṃdra uvāca || ||
anenaiva śarīreṇa kṣatriyaḥ syātkathaṃ dvijaḥ ||
caturviṃśatisaṃskārairdviguṇairyaḥprajāyate ||
tadanyatprārthaya kṣipraṃ yatte'bhīṣṭataraṃ sthitam || 9 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
na brāhmaṇyātparaṃ kiṃcitprārthayāmi sureśvara|| 6.168.10 ||
api trailokyarājyaṃ te vastuṣvanyeṣu kā kathā ||
tasmādgaccha suraśreṣṭha svarājyaṃ paripālaya || 11 ||
parityakṣyāmyahaṃ dehaṃ yāsye vā'haṃ dvijanmatām ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya devarājo divaṃ gataḥ || 12 ||
tasya taṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā sarvadevasamāvṛtaḥ||
viśvāmitro'pi tadrūpaṃ cakāra duścaraṃ tapaḥ|| 13 ||
atha varṣasahasre tu vyatikrānte dvijottamāḥ ||
anyasminvāyubhakṣasya viśvāmitrasya bhūpateḥ || 14 ||
ājagāma svayaṃ brahmā puṇyairdevarṣibhiḥ saha ||
abravīttaṃ mahīpālaṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣam || 15 ||
|| śrībrahmovāca || ||
viśvāmitra pratuṣṭo'smi tapasānena sattama ||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te pradāsyāmyapi durlabham || 16 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama ||
brāhmaṇyaṃ dehi me deva nānyadiṣṭatamaṃ mahat || 17 || ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
kṣatriyeṇa prajātasya dvijatvaṃ jāyate katham ||
śrutismṛtiviruddhaṃ hi kimevaṃ vadasīpsitam || 189 ||
yanna jātaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe na bhaviṣyati karhicit || 19 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
gaccha tvaṃ devadeveśa brahmalokamanuttamam||
ahaṃ tyakṣyāmi vā prāṇānsaṃprāpsye vā dvijanmatām || 6.168.20 ||
atha devarṣimadhyastha ṛcīko vākyamabravīt ||
asya janmakṛte deva brāhmyairmaṃtrairmayā caruḥ || 21 ||
abhito brahmasarvasvaṃ tatra sayojitaṃ mayā |
tenaiva kṣatrajanmā'yaṃ brāhmaṇaścaturānana||22||
brahmarṣikīrtayasvainaṃ tasmāttvaṃ prapitāmaha||
rājyastho'pi dvijārhāṇi satkṛtyānya karodasau || 23 ||
brāhmamantraprabhāvena tasmādbrahmarṣimāhvaya ||
yena kīrtāmahe sarve viśvāmitraṃ dvijottamam|| 24 |
atha brahmā ciraṃ dhyātvā brāhmyai rmaṃtraiśca tejasā ||
samutpannaṃ tataḥ prāha brāhmaṇastvaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ || 25 ||
tyajedaṃ duṣkaraṃ ghoraṃ tapo madvacanāddrutam ||
sa yadā brahmaṇā prokto brahmarṣi stvamasaṃśayam|| 26 ||
ṛcīkādyaistataḥ sarvaiḥ prokto devarṣibhistathā || 27 ||
atha teṣāṃ madhyagato vasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ ||
so'bravītkopasaṃyukto nāhaṃ vakṣyāmi karhicit|| 28 ||
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyājjātaṃ jānannapi pitāmaha ||
ṛcīkasya ca dākṣiṇyāttathā tvaṃ vadasi prabho || 29 ||
procyamāno 'pi bahudhā vasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ ||
pitāmahena munibhirnāradādyairanekadhā ||
jagāmātha parityajya tānsarvāndvijasattamān || 6.168.30 ||
sa cāgatya muni śreṣṭho deśaṃ cānartasaṃjñitam ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre śaṃkhatīrthasamīpataḥ || 31 ||
yatra brahmaśilā puṇyā śvetadvīpasamanvitā ||
sarasvatī sthitā yatra nadī pāpaharā śubhā || 32 ||
tatrāśramapadaṃ kṛtvā cakāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ ||
viśvāmitro'pi sāmarṣastadvadhārthaṃ samāgataḥ || 33 ||
tasyāśramasya dūre sa yāmyāṃ diśi samāśritaḥ ||
kṛtvāśramapadaṃ tatra tasya cchidrāṇi cintayan || 34 ||
saṃsthitaḥ suciraṃ kālaṃ na ca paśyati kiṃcana ||
athābhicārikaṃ tena prārabdhaṃ tasya copari||35||
yaduktaṃ sāmavidhinā sāmavede vadhātmakam||
tasya tairdāruṇairmaṃtrairjuhvato jātavedasam||36||
niṣkrāṃtā dāruṇā śaktirmuktakeśī bhayānakā||
vānaraskaṃdhamārūḍhā kurvāṇā kilkilādhvanim||37||
nānāyudhasamopetā yamajihvā yathā parā||
sābravīdvada vipreṃdra kiṃ te kṛtyaṃ karomyaham||38||
trailokyamapi kṛtsnaṃ ca saṃharāmi tavājñayā||39||
viśvāmitra uvāca||
mama śatrurmānyo tra vasiṣṭhaḥ kumuniḥ sthitaḥ|
taṃ tvaṃ jahi drutaṃ gatvā tadarthaṃ ca mayā kṛtā||6.168.40||
evamuktā tu sā tena viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā|
vasiṣṭhāśramamuddiśya prasthitā cottarāmukhī||41||
etasminneva kāle tu vasiṣṭhasyāśrame dvijāḥ|
durnimittāni jātāni prabhūtāni mahāṃti ca||42||
papāta mahatī colkā nihatya ravimaṇḍalam||
tathā rudhiravṛṣṭiśca asthimiśrā vyajāyata||43||
dīptāṃ diśaṃ samāsādya ruroda ca tathā śivā|
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sumahotpātānvasiṣṭho munipuṃgavaḥ||44||
yāvadālokate rūpaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam||
tataḥ samyakparijñāya sarvaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā||45||
viśvāmitraprayukteyaṃ śaktirmama vadhāya ca||
kṛtyā rūpā sumaṃtraiśca sāmavedasamudbhavaiḥ||46||
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti tenoktā tataḥ sā niścalābhavat||
nijamaṃtraiśca sā tena staṃbhitātharvaṇodbhavaiḥ||47||
tataḥ strīrūpamādāya provāca munipuṃgavam||
sāmavedastu vedānāṃ prādhānyena vyavasthitaḥ||48|.
vidhinā tena saṃsṛṣṭā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā||
mā kurutvapramāṇaṃtu prahāraṃ saha me mune ||
rakṣayiṣyāmi te
prāṇānsvalpasparśena te mune || 49 ||
|| vasiṣṭha uvāca || ||
yadyevaṃ kuru me sparśaṃ na marma sparśanaṃ śubhe ||
mayā cātharvaṇā maṃtrāḥ saṃhṛtāḥ kṛpayā tava || 6.168.50 ||
tataḥ sā dāruṇā śaktirviśvāmitraprayojitā ||
tasyāṃgadeśaṃ spṛṣṭvātha nipapāta dharātale || 51 ||
tatastuṣṭo vasiṣṭhastu tāmāha madhuraṃ vacaḥ ||
adyaprabhṛti te pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti samāhitāḥ ||
janāḥ sarve mahābhāge bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ || 52 ||
caitramāse site pakṣe aṣṭamīdivase sthite ||
ye te pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ || 53 ||
te sarve vatsaraṃyāvadbhavi ṣyaṃti nirāmayāḥ ||
tasmādatraiva sthātavyaṃ sadaiva mama vākyataḥ || 54 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktā ca sā tena vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā ||
sthitā tatraiva sā devī tasya vākyena tatkṣaṇāt || 55 ||
prāpnoti paramāṃ pūjāṃ viśeṣānnāgaraiḥ kṛtām ||
dhārānāmeti vikhyātā bhaktalokasukha pradā || 56 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dhārotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭa ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 168 || || cha ||

<6.169>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
kasmātsā tuṣṭidā proktā nāgarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
dhārānāmeti vikhyātā kasmātsā dharaṇītale || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
camatkārapure pūrvaṃ dhārānāmeti viśrutā ||
āsīttapasvinī sādhvī nāgarī brāhmaṇottamā ||
tasyāḥ sakhyamarundhatyā āsītpūrvaṃ sumedhayā || 2 ||
arundhatī yadā prāptā camatkārapure śubhe ||
snānārthaṃ śaṃkhatīrthaṃ tu vasiṣṭhena samāgatā || 3 ||
tayā dṛṣṭātha sā tatra aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa saṃsthitā ||
vāyubhakṣā nirāhārā divyena vapuṣānvitā || 4 ||
tayā pṛṣṭā ca sā sādhvī kā tvaṃ kasya sutā śubhe ||
kimarthaṃ tu sthitā cogre tapasi brūhi me śubhe || 5 ||
|| dhārovāca || ||
devaśarmākhyaviprasya sutāhaṃ nāgarasya ca ||
bālatve vartamānāyā vaidhavyaṃ me vyavasthitam || 6 ||
śaṃkhatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śrutvā śaṃkheśvarasya ca ||
tato'haṃ saṃsthitā hyatra tasyaivārādhane sthitā || 7 || ||
|| arundhatyuvāca || ||
tavopari mahānsneho darśanātte vyavasthitaḥ ||
tasmādāgaccha gacchāvo mamāśramapadaṃ śubham || 8 ||
sarasvatyā staṭe śubhre sarvapātakanāśane ||
śāstragoṣṭhīratā nityaṃ tatra tiṣṭha mayā saha || 9 ||
tataḥ saṃprasthitā sā tu tayā sārdhaṃ tapasvinī ||
anujñātā svapitrā tu jananyā bāṃdhavaistathā || 6.169.10 ||
tasyāḥ sakhyaṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ tayā saha babhūva ha ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya sā śaktistatra cāgatā || || 11 ||
viśvāmitreṇa saṃsṛṣṭā vasiṣṭhasya vadhāya ca ||
sā staṃbhitā vasiṣṭhena kṛtā devīsvarūpiṇī ||
saṃpūjyā devamartyānāṃ sarvarakṣāpradā śubhā || 12 ||
tatastu dhārayā tasyāḥ kailāsaśikharopamaḥ ||
prāsādo nirmito viprā nānāratnavicitritaḥ || 13 ||
cakārātha tataḥ stotraṃ tasyāḥ sā ca tapasvinī || 14 ||
namaste parame brāhmi dhārayoge namonamaḥ ||
ardhamātre pare śūnye tasyārdhārdhe namostu te || 15 ||
namaste jagadādhāre namaste bhūtadhāriṇi ||
namaste padmapatrākṣi namaste kāṃcanadyute || 16 ||
namaste siṃhayānāḍhye namaste'stumahābhuje ||
namaste devatābhīṣṭe namaste daityasūdini || 17 ||
namaste mahiṣākrāṃtaśarīracchinnamastake ||
namaste viṃdhyanirate surāmāṃsabalipriye || 18 ||
tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ śacī gaurī tvaṃ siddhistvaṃ vibhāvarī ||
tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā tuṣṭistvaṃ puṣṭistvaṃ sureśvarī || 19 ||
śaktirūpāsi devi tvaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakā riṇī ||
tvayi dṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 6.169.20 ||
yathā tilesthitaṃ tailaṃ dadhisaṃsthaṃ yathā ghṛtam ||
havirbhujaśca kāṣṭhasthaḥ suguptaṃ labhyate na hi || 21 ||
tathā tvamapi deveśi sarvagāpi na lakṣyase || 22 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etena stotramukhyena smṛtā sā parameśvarī ||
bahūni varṣa pūgāni pūjayaṃtyā dinedine || 23 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya caitraśuklāṣṭamī sitā ||
tasminnahani devī sā nadyāṃ saṃsnāpya pūjitā || 24 ||
bali pūjāṃ tato dattvā stotreṇānena ca stutā ||
tataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gatvā tāmuvāca tapasvinīm ||25||
putri tuṣṭāsmi bhadraṃ te stotreṇānena cānaghe ||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te tava dāsyāmi vāṃchitam || 26 ||
|| dhārovāca || ||
yadi tuṣṭāsi me devi yadi deyo varo mama ||
tanme nāma tavāpyastu prāsāde'tra hi kevalam|| 27 ||
aparaṃ nāgaro yo'tra tvasminnahani saṃsthite ||
pradakṣiṇātrayaṃ kṛtvā tava dattvā phalatrayam || 28 ||
stotreṇānena bhavatīṃ stutvā ca kurute natim||
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadrogo rakṣyastvayā'khilaḥ ||29||
yā ca vaṃdhyā bhavennārī sā bhūyātputrasaṃyutā ||
durbhagā ca sasaubhāgyā kurūpā rūpasaṃbhavā ||
rogiṇī roganirmuktā sarvasaukhyasamanvitā || 6.169.30 ||
|| devyuvāca || ||
ahaṃ dhāreti vikhyātā prāsāde'tra tvayā kṛte||
bhaviṣyāmi na sandehastava kīrtikṛte sadā || 31 ||
atra yo nāgaro bhaktyā samāgatya tapasvini ||
pradakṣiṇātrayaṃ kuryāddattvā mama phalatrayam || 32 ||
so'pi saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadbhavitā rogavarjitaḥ ||
evamuktā tu sā devītataścādarśanaṃ gatā || 33 ||
dhārāpi saṃsthitā tatra arundhatyā samanvitā ||
adyāpi dṛśyate vyomni tasyāścāpi samīpagā || 34 ||
etaddhārodbhavaṃ yo'tra vṛttāṃtaṃ kīrtayiṣyati ||
śṛṇuyādvā dvijaśreṣṭhā mucyetpāpāddinodbhavāt || 35 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
śrotavyaṃ ca prabhaktyedaṃ nāgaraiśca viśeṣataḥ || 36 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dhārānāmotpattivṛttāṃta dhārādevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||169|| || cha || ||

<6.170>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyadapi saṃjātamāścaryaṃ yadabhūddvijāḥ ||
viśvāmitreṇa sā śaktirvasiṣṭhāya visarjitā || 1 ||
vadhārthaṃ tasya viprarṣervasiṣṭhena ca dhīmatā ||
staṃbhitā'tharvaṇairmantraiḥ prasvedaḥ samajāyata||2||
svedātsamabhavattoyaṃ śītalaṃ tadajāyata||
pādābhyāṃ nirgataṃ toyamatra dṛśyamajāyata ||3||
vidārya bhūmiṃ saṃjātā jaladhārā suśītalā ||
nirmalaṃ pāvanaṃ svacchaṃ gaṃgāṃbha iva niḥsṛtam || 4 || 
gaṃgā pratyakṣatāṃ yātā tīrthaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitā||
pūritaṃ vāriṇā kuṇḍaṃ nirmalaṃ śītalaṃ śivam || 5 ||
tasyāṃ yā kurute snānaṃ nārī vaṃdhyā dvijottamāḥ ||
sadyaḥ putravatī sā syādraudre kaliyuge dvijāḥ || 6 ||
anyo'pi kurute snānaṃ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet ||7||
snātvā tatra tu yo devīṃ paśyecca vidhinā naraḥ ||
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā putrānrājyotthaṃ ca sukhaṃ labhet || ||8||
yā nārī durbhagā vandhyā sā'pi putravatī bhavet ||
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ bhaktiyogasamanvitā ||
mahāniśāyāṃ tatraiva naivedyabalipiṃḍikām||9||
prasannayā kumāryā tu svayaṃ cā'tha karoti yā ||
gṛhṇāti yā ca vai nārī piṃḍikāṃ balisaṃyutām || 6.170.10 ||
śatavarṣā tu yā nārī piṃḍikāṃ bhakṣayeddvijāḥ ||
sā'pi putravatī ca syādyadi vṛddhatamā bhavet || 11 ||
kiṃ punaryauvanopetā saubhāgyena samanvitā ||
putrasaukhyavatī nārī devyā vai darśanena ca || || 12 ||
sarveṣāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ tu bhāvajā devatā smṛtā ||
sā sārdhāṣṭadvipaṃcāśadgotrāṇāṃ kuladevatā || 13 ||
etasmātkāraṇādyātrā nāgaraiḥ sukṛtā bhavet ||
na vinā nāgarairyātrāṃ tuṣṭiṃ yāti sureśvarī || 14 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭake śvarakṣetramāhātmye dhārātīrthotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ 170 || || || dha ||

<6.171>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
etasminneva kāle tu viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ||
tāṃ śaktiṃ vyarthatāṃ prāptāṃ jñātvā kopasamanvitaḥ || 1 ||
mumoca tadvadhārthāya brahmāstraṃ so'bhimaṃtritam ||
tasya saṃhitamātrasya prasvanaḥ samajāyata || 2 ||
tataścolkāḥ prabhūtāśca prayāṃti ca nabhastalāt ||
tataḥ kuntāḥ śaktayaśca tomarāḥ parighāstathā || 3 ||
bhiṃḍipālā gadāścaiva khaḍgāścaiva paraśvadhāḥ ||
bāṇāḥ prāsāḥ śataghnyaśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ||4||
vasiṣṭho'pi parijñāya preṣitaṃ gādhisūnunā ||
brahmāstraṃ mṛtyave tena śucirbhūtvā tataḥ param || 5 ||
iṣīkāṃ ca samādāya brahmāstraṃ tatra yojayan ||
abravīdgādhiputrāya svastyastu tava pārśvataḥ || 6 ||
hanyatāmastrametaddhimama vākyādasaṃśayam||
tatastena hataṃ tacca brahmāstraṃ tatsamudbhavam || 7 ||
vajrāstraṃ ca tato muktaṃ vajrāstreṇa vināśitam ||
yadyadastraṃ kṣipatyeṣa viśvāmitraḥ prakopitaḥ || 8 ||
tattaddhaṃti vasiṣṭhastu maṃtrasya ca prabhāvataḥ ||
etasminneva kāle tu kṣubhito makarālayaḥ || 9 ||
śīryaṃte giriśṛṃgāṇi raktavṛṣṭiḥ parā sthitā ||
pralayasyeva cihnāni saṃjātāni dharātale ||
kimakāle mahāneṣa pralayaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 6.171.10 ||
tataḥ pitāmahaṃ jagmuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ||
procuḥ pralayacihnāni yāni saṃti dharātale || 11 ||
tato brahmā ciraṃ dhyātvā tānuvāca divaukasaḥ ||
viśvāmitra vasiṣṭhābhyāṃ yuddhametadvyavasthitam || 12 ||
divyāstrasaṃbhavaṃ devāstenaitadvyākulaṃ jagat || 13 ||
tasmādgacchāmahe tatra yāvanno jāyate kṣayaḥ ||
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ divyāstrāṇāṃ prabhāvataḥ || 14 ||
tato'bhigamya te deśaṃ yatra tau munisattamau ||
vicāmitravasiṣṭhau tau yudhyamānau parasparam ||15||
tataḥ provāca tau brahmā sāmnā paramavalgunā ||
nivartyatāmidaṃ yuddhametaddivyāstrasaṃbhavam ||
yāvanna pralayo bhāvi samaste dharaṇītale || 16 || ||
|| vasiṣṭha uvāca || ||
nāhamastraṃ prayuṃjāmi viśvāmitravadhecchayā ||
ātmarakṣākṛte deva astramastreṇa śāmayan || 17 ||
ayaṃ mama vināśāya kevalaṃ cāstramokṣaṇam||
kurute nirdayo brahmaṃstaṃ nivāraya sāṃpratam || 18 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
viśvāmitra muniśreṣṭha vasiṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇottamam ||
tvaṃ rakṣa mama vākyena tathā sarvamidaṃ jagat || 19 ||
astramokṣavirāmaṃ tvaṃ brahmarṣe kuru satvaram || 6.171.20 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
na māmeṣa dvijaṃ brūte kathaṃcitprapitāmaha ||
tasmādeṣa prakopo me saṃjāto'sya vadhopari || 21 ||
tasmādvadatu deveśa māmeṣa brāhmaṇaṃ drutam ||
nivārayāmi yenāstraṃ yadasyopari saṃdhitam ||22||
|| brahmovāca || ||

|| vasiṣṭha uvāca || ||

|| brahmovāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

namaste krodhasaṃsthāya piṃgalāya namo'stu te || 77 ||
namaste vasurūpāya kṛṣṇāya ca namo'stu te ||
namaste raudradehāya namaste cāṃtakāya ca || 78 ||
namaste yamasaṃjñāya namaste sauraye vibho ||
namaste mandasaṃjñāya śanaiścara namo'sstu te || 79 ||
prasādaṃ kuru deveśa dīnasya praṇatasya ca ||6.174.80||
|| śanaiścara uvāca || ||
parituṣṭo'smi te vatsa stotreṇānena sāṃpratam||
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yena yacchāmi sāṃpratam || 81 ||
pippalāda uvāca || ||
adyaprabhṛti no pīḍā bālānāṃ sūryanandana ||
tvayā kāryā mahābhāga svakīyā ca kathaṃcana || 82 ||
yāvadvarṣāṣṭamaṃ jātaṃ mama vākyena sūryaja ||
stotreṇānena yo'tra tvāṃ stūyātprātaḥ samutthitaḥ || || 83 ||
tasya pīḍā na kartavyā tvayā bhāskaranandana ||
tava vāre ca saṃjāte tailābhyaṃgaṃ karoti yaḥ || 84 ||
dināṣṭakaṃ na kartavyā tasya pīḍā kathaṃcana ||
yastvāṃ lohamayaṃ kṛtvā tailamadhye hyadhomukham|| 85 ||
dhārayettena tailena tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||
tasya pīḍā na kartavyā deyo lābho mahībhujaḥ ||96 ||
adhyarddhāṣṭamikāyoge tāvake saṃsthite naraḥ ||
tavavāre tu saṃprāpte yastilām̐llohasaṃyutān || 97 ||
svaśaktyā rāti no tasya pīḍā kāryā tvayā vibho ||
kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ yastu viprāya tavoddeśena yacchati || 88 ||
adhyarddhāṣṭamajā pīḍā nā'sya kāryā tvayā vibho ||
śamī samidbhiryo homaṃ tavoddeśena yacchati || 99 ||
tathā kṛṣṇatilaiścaiva kṛṣṇapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ||
pūjāṃ karoti yastubhyaṃ dhūpaṃ vai guggulaṃ dahet ||
kṛṣṇavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya tyājyā tasya vyathā tvayā || 6.174.90 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktaḥ śanistena bāḍhamityeva jalpya ca ||
nāradaṃ samanujñāpya jagāma nijasaṃ śrayam|| 91 ||
nārado'pi tamādāya vālakaṃ kṛpayānvitaḥ ||
camatkārapuraṃ gatvā yājñavalkyāya cārpayat || 92 ||
kathayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ tasya saṃbhūti saṃbhavam||
yaddṛṣṭaṃ jñānadīpena tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat||93||
eṣa te vīryasaṃbhūto bālako bhaginīsutaḥ ||
mayā'śvatthatale labdhaḥ kānane'śvatthasaṃnidhau || 94 ||
vratabaṃdha kuruṣvāsya sāṃprataṃ cāṣṭavārṣikaḥ ||
nātra doṣosti vipreṃdra na bhaginyāstathā tava ||
tasmādgṛhāṇa putraṃ svaṃ bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || || 95 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā sa devarṣistataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
yājñavalkyo'pi tacchrutvā viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 96 ||
pāpaṃ tacciṃtayanneva na śāṃtimadhigacchati ||
ātmānaṃ garhayannityaṃ divānaktaṃ ca śocati || 97 ||
taṃ ca putraṃ parijñāya taistaiścihnairnijaiḥ sthitaiḥ ||
tatastu poṣayitvā taṃ vratena samayojayat || 99 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyā saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye pippalādotpattiva rṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 174 || cha ||

<6.175>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ saṃśocate yāvadātmānaṃ parigarhayan||

||yājñavalkya uvāca|| ||

|| brahmovāca|| ||

kalikāle tu saṃprāpte tīrthāni sakalāni ca ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evamuktvā caturvaktrastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
yājñavalkyo'pi tacchrutvā pitāmahavaco' khilam || 11 ||

aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yo liṃgaṃ māmakaṃ tvidam ||
snāpayiṣyati sadbhaktyā tasya pāpaṃ prayāsyati || 13 ||
paradārakṛtaṃ yacca mātrāpi ca samaṃ kṛtam||
kṣālayiṣyati tatpāpaṃ snāpitaṃ pūjitaṃ paraiḥ || 14 ||

tasminkṣetre dvijaśreṣṭhā hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñake || 16 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yājñavalkyeśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 175 || || cha ||

<6.176>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
dṛṣṭvā pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ yājñavalkyena dhīmatā ||
svamātuḥ śuddhihetoḥ sa tannāmnā liṃgamuttamam || 1 ||
sthāpayāmāsa vipreṃdrāḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ||
tataścānīya vipreṃdraṃ madhyagaṃ nāgarodbhavam || ||
gartātīrthasamudbhūtamāhitāgniṃ prayājinam ||
yathaitannagarasthānaṃ tathā tvamapi dīkṣitaḥ || 3 ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu gotrāṇāṃ nāyakatve vyavasthitaḥ ||

vartayiṣyaṃti kṛtyeṣu yāvaccandrārkatārakāḥ ||

pūjayā tasya liṃgasya vṛddhiṃ yāsyati te'nvayaḥ || 6 ||
apūjayā vināśaṃ ca yāsyatyatra na saṃśayaḥ ||
tava vaṃśodbhavā ye ca pūjayitvā prabhaktitaḥ || 7 ||
etalliṃgaṃ kariṣyaṃti kṛtyāni vividhānica ||
tāni siddhiṃ prayāsyaṃti prasādādasya dīkṣita || 8 ||
|| govardhana uvāca || ||
ahamarcāṃ kariṣyāmi liṃgasyāsya sadā dvija ||
bhaktiṃ ca prakariṣyāmi hetorasya hetorasya kṛte dvija ||
pūjārthaṃ caiva ye cānye mama vaṃśasamudravāḥ || 9 ||
|| pippalāda uvāca || ||
govardhana drutaṃ viprāṃstatra cānaya nāgarān||

tataścānāyayāmāsa viprāṃścaiva vicakṣaṇān ||
śrutādhyayanasaṃpannānyajñakarmaparāyaṇān || 11 ||

yuṣmadvākyātprasiddhiṃ ca prayātu dvijasattamāḥ || 13 ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yaścaitatsnāpayiṣyati ||
yājñavalkyeśvarotthaṃ ca sa vai śreyo hyavāpsyati || 14 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha tairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sarvaistasya nāma pratiṣṭhitam ||
kaṃsārīśvara ityevaṃ gauravāttasya sanmu neḥ || 15 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭho'smi dvijottamāḥ ||
kaṃsārīśvarasaṃjñastu yathā jātastu pāpahā ||
sthāpitaḥ pippalādena svayaṃ caiva mahātmanā || 16 ||
yaścaitatpuṇyamākhyānaṃ tasya devasya saṃnidhau ||
saṃpaṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi samyakchaktisamanvitaḥ || 17 ||
manasā ciṃtitaṃ pāpaṃ paradārakṛtaṃ ca yat ||
tasya tannāśamāyāti pippalāda vaco yathā || 18 ||
yastasya purato bhaktyā nīlarudrā nsadā japet ||
prāṇarudrānviśeṣeṇa bhavarudrasamanvitān || 19 ||
brahmahatyodbhavaṃ caiva api tasya praṇaśyati ||
paracakrabhaye jāte hyanā vṛṣṭibhaye tathā || 6.176.20 ||
atharvavede sādyaṃte paṭhite tasya cāgrataḥ ||
śatrurvilayamabhyeti vṛṣṭiḥ sañjāyate drutam || 21 ||
rājadauḥsthye samutpanne rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ||
sarvarogavinirmuktaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ || 22 ||
upasargabhaye jāte tasya doṣaḥ praśāmyati ||
śanaiḥ śanairasaṃdigdhaṃ pippalādavaco yathā || 23 ||
kiṃ vā te bahunoktena yatkiṃcidvyasanaṃ mahat ||
tattasya vyasanaṃ kiṃcidatharvaṇaḥ prakī rtanāt || 24 ||
asya devasya purato yāti nāśaṃ ca vai drutam || 25 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kaṃsāreśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 176 || || cha ||

<6.177>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyāpi ca tatrāsti gaurī vai pañcapiṃḍikā ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| lakṣmī ruvāca || ||

naivedyaiḥ paramānnaiśca gītairnṛtyaiḥ pravāditaiḥ ||
tato visṛjya tāṃ devīṃ taduddeśena vai tataḥ || 6.177.20 ||
dattvā dānāni bhūrīṇi gauriṇīnāṃ dvijanmanām ||

|| sapatnya ūcuḥ || ||

|| padmāvatyuvāca || || ||
