tatastu paṃcabhirmantraistaireva smṛtimāgataiḥ ||
paṃcabhirmuṣṭibhirdevī vālukotthaiḥ prapūjitā || 55 ||
tataḥ pañcatvamāpannā tatkāle'haṃ varāṃganāḥ ||
daśārṇādhipaterjātā sadane lokaviśrute || 56 ||
jātismaraṇasaṃyuktā tasyā devyāḥ prasādataḥ ||
bhavatīnāṃ kaniṣṭhāsmi jyeṣṭhā saubhāgyataḥ sthitā ||57 ||
eta smātkāraṇādgaurīṃ muktvaitānpañcapiṇḍakān||
karddamena vidhāyātha pūjayāmi dinedine || 58 ||
etadguhyaṃ mayā khyātaṃ bhavatīnāmasaṃśayam ||
satyenānena me gaurī manobhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu || 59 ||
|| lakṣmīruvāca || ||
tataḥ sarvāḥ sapatnyastāḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ ||
māmūcurvinayādvācā praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ||6.177.60||
prasādaṃ kuru cāsmākaṃ dīyatāṃ mantrapaṃcakam||
tadeva yena te devī tuṣṭā sā parameśvarī || 61 ||
mayā proktāśca tā sarvāḥ prārthayadhvaṃ yathecchayā ||
ahaṃ sarvaṃ pradāsyāmi tatsatyaṃ vacanaṃ mama || 62 ||
tato deva mayā proktaṃ tāsāṃ tanmaṃtrapaṃcakam ||
śiṣyatvaṃ gamitānāṃ ca vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ || 63 ||
|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||
mamāpi vada deveśi kīdṛktanmantrapañcakam ||
yattvayā'nuṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ tayā tāsāṃ nivedi tam|| 64 ||
|| lakṣmīruvāca || ||
namaḥ pṛthivyai kṣāṃtīśi nama āpomaye śubhe ||
tejasvini namastubhyaṃ namaste vāyurūpiṇi || 65 ||
ākāśarūpasaṃpanne paṃcarūpe namonamaḥ || 66 ||
ebhirmantrairmayā pūrvaṃ pūjitā parameśvarī ||
tena rājyaṃ mayā prāptaṃ sarvastrīṇāṃ sudurlabham || 67 ||
tataśca sthāpitā devī kṛtvā ratnamayī śubhā ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mayā tatra sureśvara || 68 ||
tāṃ yā pūjayate nārī sadyo'pi pativallabhā ||
jāyate nātra sandehaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitā || 69 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye pañcapiṃḍikotpatti māhātmya varṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 177 || || cha ||

<6.178>

|| lakṣmīruvāca || ||
evaṃ rājyaṃ mayā prāptaṃ gaurīpūjā kṛte vibho ||
saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ caiva durlabhaṃ sarvayoṣitām|| 1 ||
na cāpatyaṃ mayā labdhaṃ tathāpi parameśvara ||
tādṛśe'pi ca saubhāgye tāruṇye tādṛśe sthite || 2 ||
dahyāmi tena duḥkhena divānaktaṃ sukhaṃ na me ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya durvāsā munisattamaḥ || 3 ||
ānartādhipaterharmyaṃ saṃprāpto gauravāya saḥ||
cāturmāsyakṛte caiva mṛttikāgrahaṇāya ca || 4||
tataḥ saṃpūjito rājñā ānartena yathākramam||
dattvārghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca tataḥ proktaṃ praṇamya ca||5||
svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca te||
nānyo dhanyatamo loke bhūyo'sti sadṛśo mayā||6||
yau te pādau rajodhvastau keśairme nirmalīkṛtau||
tadbrūhi kiṃkaromyadya gṛhāyātasya te mune || 7 ||
api rājyaṃ prayacchāmi kā vārtānyeṣu vastuṣu || 8 ||
|| durvāsā uvāca || ||
cāturmāsīvidhānaṃ te kariṣye nṛpa maṃdire ||
mṛttikāgrahaṇaṃ tāvacchuśrūṣā kriyatāṃ mama ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya māmūce pārthivottamaḥ || 9 ||
śuśrūṣā cāsya kartavyā sarva daiva varānane ||
cāturmāsīvrataṃ yāvaddevatārcanapūrvakam || 6.178.10 ||
bāḍhamityevamuktvātha mayā sarvamanuṣṭhitam ||
śuśrūṣārhaṃ ca yatkarma duhiteva pituryathā || 11 ||
cāturmāsyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ yadā saṃprasthito muniḥ ||
tadā provāca māṃ tuṣṭaḥ putri kiṃ karavāṇi te || 12 ||
tataḥ sa bhagavānproktaḥ praṇipatya mayā muhuḥ ||
apatyaṃ nāsti me brahmaṃstena dahyāmyaharniśam || 13 ||
īdṛśe sati rājño'pi yauvane ca mahattare ||
tattvaṃ vada muniśreṣṭha yena syānmama saṃtatiḥ || 14 ||
vratena niyamenātha dānena ca hutena ca ||
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā māmuvāca smayanniva || 15 ||
anyadehāṃtare putri tvayā gaurī prapūjitā ||
taptābhirvālukābhiḥ sā mṛtyukāla upasthite || 16 ||
tadbhaktyā labdharājyāpi dāhena pariyujyase ||
gaurī yattāpasaṃyuktā bālukābhiḥ kṛtā tvayā || 17 ||
na devo vidyate kāṣṭhe pāṣāṇe mṛttikāsu ca ||
bhāveṣu vidyate devo mantrasaṃyogasaṃyutaḥ || 18 ||
bhāvabhaktisamā yuktā maṃtrasaṃyojanena ca ||
devī mantrasamāyātā tvayā vālukayā'rcitā || 19 ||
tvatkāye tena saṃtāpaḥ sarvadā'yaṃ vyavasthitaḥ||
tasmādratnamayīṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā tvaṃ paṃcapiṃḍikām ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre saṃsthāpaya śubhānane ||6.178.20||
vṛṣasthe bhāskare paścāttasyā upari srāvi yat ||
jalayantraṃ divārātraṃ dhārayasva prayatnataḥ || 21 ||
tato yathāyathā tasyāḥ śītabhāvo bhaviṣyati ||
tathātathā ca te dāhaḥ śāṃtiṃ yāsyatyaharniśam || 22 ||
dāhāṃte bhavitā garbhastataḥ putramavāpsyasi ||
rājyabhārakṣamaṃ śūraṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 23 ||
anyāpi kāminī yātra evaṃ tāṃ pūjayiṣyati ||
jyeṣṭhe māse tathā sāpi yathā tvaṃ prabhaviṣyati || 24 ||
|| lakṣmīruvāca || ||
tato mayā punaḥ prokto bhagavānsa munīśvaraḥ ||
mānuṣatve na me rāgo viraktirmahatī sthitā || 25 ||
nadīvegopamaṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvitaṃsarvadehinām ||
tanme vada mahābhāga yatkiṃcid vratamuttamam || 26 ||
mānuṣatvaṃ na yena syātsamyakcīrṇena saddvija ||
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā māmāha parameśvara || 27 ||
asti putri vrataṃ puṇyaṃ gaurī tuṣṭikaraṃ param ||
yena cīrṇena vai samyagyoṣiddevatvamāpnuyāt || 28 ||
gomayākhyā mahādevī kṛtā vai gomayena sā ||
tato golokamāpannāḥ sarvāstā varavarṇini || 29 ||
tāṃ tvaṃ kuruṣva kalyāṇi yena devatvamāpsyasi ||
tato mayā punaḥ proktaḥ sa muniḥ surasattama || 6.178.30 ||
kasminkāle prakartavyā vidhinā kena sanmune ||
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi yena tāṃ prakaromyaham || 31 ||
|| durvāsā uvāca || ||
nabhasye cāsite pakṣe tṛtīyādivase sthite||
prātarutthāya paścācca bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam||32||
tataśca niyamaṃ kṛtvā upavāsasamudbhavam||
gaurīnāmasamuccārya śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 33 ||
tato niśāgame prāpte kṛtvā gaurīcatuṣṭayam ||
mṛnmayaṃ yādṛśaṃ caiva tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu || 34 ||
ekā gaurī prakartavyā paṃcapiṃḍā yathoditā ||
prahareprahare prāpte tāsu pūjāṃ samācaret ||
yairmaṃtraistānnibodha tvamekaikasyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 35 ||
himācalagṛhe jātā devi tvaṃ śaṃkarapriye ||
menāgarbhasamudbhūtā pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namostu te || 36 ||
dhūpaṃ dadyāttataścaiva karpūraṃ śraddhayā saha ||
raktasūtreṇa dīpaṃ ca ghṛtena parikalpayet || 37 ||
jātipuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya naivedye modakānnyaset ||
raktavastreṇa saṃchādya arghyaṃ dattvā tataḥ param || 38 ||
yasya vṛkṣasya puṣpaṃ ca tasya syāddantadhāvanam ||
mātuliṃgena tasyāstu mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ || 39 ||
arghyaṃ dadyātprayatnena gandhapuṣpākṣatānvitam ||
śaṃkarasya priye devi himācalasute śubhe ||
arghyamenaṃ mayā dattaṃ pratigṛhṇa namo'stu te || 6.178.40 ||
tadeva prāśanaṃ kuryāttataḥ kāyaviśuddhaye ||
praharāṃte ca saṃpūjya ardhanārīśvaraṃ tataḥ || 41 ||
surabhyā pūjayedbhaktyā mantreṇānena pārvati ||
vāmamardhaṃ śarīrasya yā harasya vyavasthitā ||
sā me pūjāṃ pragṛhṇātu tasyai devyai namo'stu te || 42 ||
agaruṃ ca tato bhaktyā dhūpaṃ dadyāttathā śubhe ||
naivedye guṇakāṃścaiva nālikereṇa cārghakam || 43 ||
mantreṇānena dātavyaṃ tadeva prāśanaṃ smṛtam ||
ardhanārīśvarau yau ca saṃsthitau parameśvarau || 44 ||
arghyo me gṛhyatāṃ devau syātaṃ sarvasukhapradau ||
tṛtīye prahare prāpte śatapatryā prapūjayet || 45 ||
umāmaheśvarau devau maṃtreṇānena pūjayet || || 46 ||
umāmaheśvarau devau yau tau sṛṣṭilayānvitau ||
tau gṛhṇītāmimāṃ pūjāṃ mayā dattāṃ prabhaktitaḥ || 47 ||
guggulotthaṃ tato dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ ghārikātmakam ||
jātīphalena cārghyaṃ ca tadeva prāśanaṃ smṛtam || 48 ||
tataścārghyaḥ pradātavyo maṃtreṇānena bhaktitaḥ ||
graṃthicūrṇena dhūpaṃ ca arghyaṃ madanajaṃ phalam || 49 ||
tadeva prāśanaṃ kāryaṃ tataḥ kāyaviśuddhaye || 6.178.50 ||
umāmaheśvarau devau sarvakāmasukhapradau ||
gṛhṇītāmarghyametaṃ me dayāṃ kṛtvā mahattamām|| 91 ||
caturthe prahare prāpte tāṃ gaurīṃ paṃcapiṃḍikām ||
bhṛṃgarājena saṃpūjya maṃtreṇānena bhaktitaḥ || 52 ||
pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni yāni proktāni paṃca ca ||
paṃcarūpāṇi deveśi pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namo'stu te || 53 ||
naivedye ghṛtapūpāṃśca dadyāddevyāḥ prabhaktitaḥ ||
graṃthicūrṇena dhūpaṃ ca hyarghyaṃ madanajaṃ phalam ||
tadeva prāśanaṃ kāryamarghyamaṃtramidaṃ smṛtam || 54 ||
paṃcabhūtamayī devī paṃcadhā yā vyavasthitā ||
arghyamenaṃ mayā dattaṃ sā gṛhṇātu sure śvarī || 55 ||
evaṃ sarvā niśā sā ca gītavādyādiniḥsvanaiḥ||
tāsāṃ caivāgrato neyā naiva nidrāṃ samācaret | 56 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṇḍale ||
snātvā saṃpūjayedvipraṃ saha patnyā prabhaktitaḥ || 57 ||
vastrairābharaṇaiścaiva svaśaktyā nṛpanaṃdini ||
gauryai bhakṣyaṃ ca dātavyaṃ miṣṭānnena śucismite || 58 ||
tataḥ kareṇumānīya vaḍavāṃ vā sumadhyame ||
gaurīcatuṣṭayaṃ tacca samāropya tathopari || 59 ||
gītavāditraśabdena vedadhvaniyutena ca ||
nadyāṃ vā'tha taḍāge vā vāpyāṃ vātha parikṣipet || 6.178.60 ||
maṃtreṇānena sadbhaktyā tavedaṃ vacmi sundari || 61 ||
āhūtāsi mayā devi pūjitāsi mayā śubhe ||
mama saubhāgyadānāya yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāmiti || 62 ||
|| lakṣmīruvāca || ||
evaṃ mayā kṛtā deva sā tṛtīyā yathoditā ||
nabhasye māsi saṃprāpte bhaktyā paramayā vibho || 63 ||
dvitīye ca tathā prāpte tṛtīye ca viśeṣataḥ ||
yāvatpaśyāmi pratyūṣe tāvadgaurīcatuṣṭayam ||
jātaṃ ratnamayaṃ tacca mayā yatparipūjitam || 64 ||
prasthitāṃ māṃ nadītīramuddiśya ca visarjanam ||
kariṣyāmīti sā prāha vyaktībhūtā sureśvarī || || 65 ||
mā putri jalamadhye'tra mama mūrticatuṣṭayam ||
paribhāvaya madvākyaṃ śrutvā caiva vidhīyatām || 66 ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sthāpaya tvaṃ ca mā kṣipa ||
akṣayaṃ jāyate yena sarvastrīṇāṃ hitāya ca || 67 ||
tvaṃ prārthaya varaṃ sarvaṃ dadāmyahamihārcitā ||
abhyarcitā girisutā mayā proktā sureśvarī || || 68 ||
yadi yacchasi me devi varaṃ tuṣṭā sureśvari ||
tadahaṃ mānuṣe garbhe mā bhūyāsaṃ kathaṃcana || 69 ||
bharttā bhavatu me viṣṇuḥ śāśvatābhīṣṭadaḥ sadā ||
nānyatkiṃcidabhīṣṭaṃ me rājyaṃ tridivaśobhanam || 6.178.70 ||
anyāpi kurute yā ca vratametatsamāhitā ||
sarvairtratairyathātuṣṭistathā devi prajāyate ||71 ||
tathā tasyāḥ prakartavyamekenānena pārvati ||
tatheti gaurī māmuktvā tataścādarśanaṃ gatā || 72 ||
sā devī ca mayā tatra tacca gaurīcatuṣṭayam ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre śubhe saṃsthāpitaṃ vibho || 73 ||
tatprabhāvānmayā labdho bharttā tvaṃ parameśvara ||
śāśvataścākṣayaścaiva mukhaprekṣaśca sarvadā || 74 ||
etatta sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭāsmi sureśvara ||
satyenānena deveśa tava pādau spṛśāmyaham || 75 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ||
vihasyātha mahālakṣmīṃ tāmuvāca praharṣitaḥ ||
muhurmuhuḥ samāliṃgya vakṣasaścopari sthitām || 76 ||
sādhumādhu mahābhāge satyametattvayoditam ||
jānatāpi mayā pṛṣṭā bhavatīṃ varavarṇini || 77 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ||
caturbhujā yathā gaurī saṃjātā paṃcapiṃḍikā || 78||
yaścaitatpaṭhate bhaktyā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ ||
na sa lakṣmyā vimucyeta na ca daurbhāgyamāpnuyāt || 79 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena paṭhanīyamidaṃ śubham ||
ākhyānaṃ gaurikaṃ viprā yanmayā parikīrtitam || 6.178.80 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye paṃcapiṃḍikāgauryutpattimāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 178 || ||9||

<6.179>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyadapi tatrāsti puṣkaratritayaṃ śubham ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 ||
yasmindṛṣṭe'thavā spṛṣṭe kīrtite vā dvijottamāḥ ||
pātakaṃ nāśamāyāti bhāskareṇa tamo yathā || 2 ||
punaṃti sarvatīrthāni snānāddānādasaṃśayam ||
puṣkarālokanādeva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 3 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
śrūyate puṣkaraṃnāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ||
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ tatra yacca yojanamātrakam || 4 ||
uttare candrabhāgāyā nadyā yāvatsarasvatī ||
dakṣiṇe karatoyāyāḥ sīmeyaṃ puṣkaratraye || 5 ||
asmākaṃ tu purā sūta tvayoktaṃ viyati sthitam ||
etannaḥ kautukaṃ sūta tatkathaṃ hāṭakeśvare ||
tatra kṣetre samāyātaṃ tasmāttvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 6 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
satyametanmahābhāgā yadbhavadbhirudāhṛtam ||
tasminkṣetre dvijaśreṣṭhāstacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ || 7 ||
sarvato vistarādvacmi namaskṛtya svayaṃ bhuvam || 8 ||
brahmaloke nivasato brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ ||
devarṣirnāradaḥ prāpto bhrāṃtvā lokatrayaṃ muniḥ || 9 ||
sa natvā śirasā pādāvupaviṣṭasta dagrataḥ || 6.179.10 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
kasmādvatsa cirāddṛṣṭaḥ kutaḥ prāpto'dhunā bhavān||
kva bhrāṃtastvaṃ samācakṣva brūhi vatsātra kāraṇam || 11 || ||
|| nārada uvāca || ||
martyalokādvibho prāptaḥ sāṃprataṃ ca tvarānvitaḥ ||
tava pādaprapūjārthaṃ satyenātmānamālabhe || 12 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
kiṃvadantīṃ mamācakṣva martyalokasamudbhavām ||
kīdṛśāḥ pārthivāstatra kīdṛśā dvijasattamāḥ ||
kīdṛśā vyavahārāśca vartante tatra sāṃpratam || 13 || ||
|| nārada uvāca || ||
martyaloke kalirjātaḥ sāṃprataṃ surasattama || 14 ||
rājānaḥ satpathaṃ tyaktvā tathā lobhaparāyaṇāḥ ||
pīḍayaṃti ca lokāṃśca arthahetoḥ sunirghṛṇāḥ || 15 ||
śauryabhāvaparityaktāḥ paradāravimardakāḥ ||
pūjayanti na te viprānna devānna gurūnapi || 16 ||
vedavikraya kartāro brāhmaṇāḥ śaucavarjitāḥ ||
pāpapratigrahāsaktāḥ sandhyāhīnāḥ sunirghṛṇāḥ || 17 ||
kṛṣikarmaratā nityaṃ vaiśyavatpaśupālakāḥ ||
vaiśyāḥ sarve samucchedaṃ prayātā dharaṇītale || 18 ||
śūdrā nityaṃ dharmakāmāḥ śūdrāścaiva tapasvinaḥ ||
lokayātrākriyāḥ sarve prahasaṃti vyapatrapāḥ || 19 ||
yasya cāsti gṛhe vittaṃ taruṇyaśca tathā striyaḥ ||
tenatena samaṃ sakhyaṃ prakurvanti narā bhuvi || 6.179.20 ||
vidhavānāṃ vratasthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ liṃgināṃ tathā ||
hṛdi sthito mahānkāmo vratacaryābahiḥsthitāḥ ||21||
tīrthāni viplavaṃ yāṃtipāpalokaśritāni ca||
kalebhīṃtāni sarvāṇi pradravanti diśo daśa ||22||
ahaṃ tatra sthito yasmātkalikāle pitāmaha || 23 ||
kalikāle viśeṣeṇa svairiṇyo lalitaspṛhāḥ ||
bhartrā vivadamānāśca striyaḥ kārmaṇatatparāḥ||
vṛthā vratāni kurvaṃti tyaktvā tāḥ svapateḥ kathām || 24 ||
kalirbaliṣṭhaḥ sutarāṃ varadānena te kṛtaḥ ||
yadā martye bhavedyuddhaṃ kaṃḍūtirjāyate hṛdi || 29 ||
svarge vā mastake caiva pātāle cātha pādayoḥ ||
sāṃprataṃ martyaloke ca mayā dṛṣṭamanekaśaḥ || 26 ||
śvaśrūṇāṃ ca vadhūnāṃ ca tathā janakaputrayoḥ ||
bāṃdhavānāṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā ca svāmibhṛtyayoḥ || 27 ||
caurāṇāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca dampatyośca viśeṣataḥ ||
svalpodakāstathā meghāḥ svalpasasyā ca medinī || 28 ||
svalpakṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīre sarpirna vidyate ||
evaṃ yuddhāni teṣāṃ ca vīkṣamāṇo divāniśam || 29 ||
ahaṃ martye paribhrāṃtaścirāttena samāgataḥ ||
bhūyo yāsyāmi tatraiva kaṇḍūtirmahatīsthitā || 6.179.30 ||

somabhārārdditaścordhvaṃ sarvairdevaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||45||
|| sāvitryuvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
so'pi gatvā drutaṃ prāha somabhārārditaṃ vidhim||
naiṣābhyeti jagannātha prasaktā gṛhakarmaṇi || 6.181.50 ||
sā māṃ prāha ca devānāṃ patnībhiḥ sahitā makhe ||
ahaṃ yāsyāmi tāsāṃ ca naikādyāpi pradṛśyate || 51 ||
evaṃ jñātvā suraśreṣṭha kuru yatte surocate ||
atikrāmati kālo'yaṃ yajñayānasamudravaḥ ||
tiṣṭhate ca gṛhavyagrā sāpi strī śithilātmikā || 52 ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya pulastyasya pitāmahaḥ ||
samīpasthaṃ tadā śakraṃ provāca vacanaṃ dvijāḥ || 53 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
śakra nāyāti sāvitrī sāpi strī śithilātmikā ||
anayā bhāryayā yajño mayā kāryo'yameva tu || 54 ||

kanyakā gopajā tanvī caṃdrāsyā padmalocanā || 57 ||

|| kanyo vāca || ||

jyeṣṭhakuṇḍasya viprendrāḥ paridhāyya suvāsasī || 63 ||

|| śrīvāsudeva uvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| sadasyā ūcuḥ || ||

|| jālma uvāca || ||

|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||

|| ṛtvija ūcuḥ || ||

|| pitāmaha uvāca || ||

sūta uvāca||
dvitīye divase prāpte yajñakarmasamudbhave||
dvādaśyāmabhavattatra śṛṇudhvaṃ taddvijottamāḥ||
vṛttāntaṃ sarvadevānāṃ mahāvismayakārakam || 1 ||
makhakarmaṇi prārabdha ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ ||
jalasarpaṃ samādāya baṭuḥ kaścitsunarmakṛt || 2 ||
praviśyātha sadastatra taṃ sarpaṃ brāhmaṇāntike ||
cikṣepa prahasaṃścaiva sarvaduḥkhabhayaṃkaram || 3 ||
tatastu ḍuṇḍubhastūrṇaṃ bhramamāṇa itastataḥ ||
viprāṇāṃ sadasisthānāṃ saktānāṃ yajñakarmaṇi || 4 ||
aho hotuḥ sthite praiṣe dīrghasatrasamudbhave ||

na cacāla nijasthānātprāyaścittavibhīṣayā ||
novāca vacanaṃ so'tra cayananyastalocanaḥ || 6 ||

tasya putro vinītātmā maitrāvaruṇakarmaṇi || 9 ||

|| baṭuruvāca || ||

nirdoṣo brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha tasmācchāpātprarakṣa mām ||
tacchrutvā cyavanaṃ prāha kṛpāviṣṭo bhṛguḥ svayam ||16||
ayuktaṃ vihitaṃ tāta yacchapto'yaṃ baṭustvayā||
na māṃ dharṣayituṃ śakto viṣāḍhyo'pi bhujaṃgamaḥ ||17||
kiṃ punarjalasarpo'yaṃ nirviṣo rajjusaṃnibhaḥ ||
na māmuddiśya nirmuktaḥ sarpo'nena dvijanmanā ||
śāpamokṣaṃ kuruṣvāsya tasmācchīghraṃ dvijanmanaḥ || 19 ||
|| cyavana uvāca || ||
yadi tyajati maryādāmabdhiḥ śaityaṃ vrajedraviḥ ||
uṣṇatvaṃ ca kṣapānāthastanme syādanṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 19 ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya svayameva pitāmahaḥ ||
tatrāyātaḥ sthito yatra sa pautraḥ sarparūpadhṛk || 6.183.20 ||
provāca na viṣādaste putra kāryaḥ kathaṃcana ||
yatsarpatvamanuprāptaḥ śṛṇuṣvātra vaco mama || 21 ||
purā saṃsraṣṭukāmo'haṃ nāgānāṃ navamaṃ kulam ||
tadbhaviṣyati tvatpārśvātsamaryādaṃ dharātale || 22 ||
mantrauṣadhiyujāṃ puṃsāṃ na pīḍāmācariṣyati ||
saṃprāpsyati parāṃ pūjāṃ samaste jagatītale || 23 ||
atrā'sti suśubhaṃ toyaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñite ||
kṣetre tatra samāvāsaḥ putra kāryastvayā sadā || 24 ||
tatrasthasya tapasthasya nāgaḥ karkoṭako nijam ||
tava dāsyati satkanyāṃ tataḥ sṛṣṭirbhaviṣyati || 25 ||
navamasya kulasyātra samaryādasya bhūtale ||
śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇapakṣe tu saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine || 26 ||
saṃprāpsyati parāṃ pūjāṃ pṛthivyāṃ navamaṃ kulam ||
adyaprabhṛti tattoyaṃ nāgatīrthamiti smṛtam ||27||
khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūpṛṣṭhe sarvapātakanāśanam||
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ||28||
na teṣāṃ vatsaraṃyāvadbhaviṣyatyahijaṃ bhayam ||
viṣārdditastu yo martyastatra snānaṃ kariṣyati ||29||
tatkṣaṇānnirviṣo bhūtvā saṃprāpsyati paraṃ sukham ||
putrakāmā tu yā nārī paṃcamyāṃ bhāskarodaye ||6.183.30||
kariṣyati tathā snānaṃ phalahastā prabhaktitaḥ ||
bhaviṣyati ca sā śīghraṃ vaṃdhyā'pi ca suputriṇī ||31||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ pravadatastasya brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ||
anye nāgāḥ samāyātāstatra yajñe nimaṃtritāḥ || 32 ||
vāsukistakṣakaścaiva puṇḍarīkaḥ kṛśodaraḥ ||
kambalāśvatarau nāgau śeṣaḥ kāliya eva ca || 33 ||
te praṇamya vacaḥ procuḥ proccairdevaṃ pitāmaham ||
tavādeśādvayaṃ prāptā yajñe'tra prapitāmaha||34||
sāhāyyārthaṃ tadādeśo dīyatāṃ prapitāmaha||
yena kurmo vayaṃ śīghraṃ nāgarājye hyadhiṣṭhitāḥ ||35||
brahmovāca || sāhāyyametadasmākaṃ bhavadīyaṃ mahoragāḥ ||
gatvānena samaṃ śīghraṃ nāgarājena tiṣṭhata||36||
nāgatīrthe tataḥ stheyaṃ sarvaistatra samāsthitaiḥ ||37||
yaḥ kaścinmama yajñe'tra duṣṭabhāvaṃ samāśritaḥ ||
samāgacchati vighnāya rakṣaṇīyaḥ sa satvaram ||38||
rākṣaso vā piśāco vā bhūto vā mānuṣo'pi vā ||
etatkṛtyatamaṃ nāgā mama yajñasya rakṣaṇam || 39 ||
tathā yūyamapi prāpte māsi bhādrapade tathā ||
paṃcamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya tatra pūjāmavāpsyatha || 6.183.40 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
bāḍhamityeva te procya praṇipatya pitāmaham ||
sanātanasutopetā nāgatīrthaṃ samāśritāḥ || 41
tataḥprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ nāgatīrtha miti smṛtam ||
kāmapradaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ narāṇāṃ snānakāriṇām || 42 ||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ sakṛdbhaktyā samanvitaḥ ||
nānvaye'pi bhayaṃ tasya jāya te sarpasaṃbhavam || 43 ||
tatra yacchati miṣṭānnaṃ dvijānāṃ sajjanaiḥ saha ||
pūjayitvā tu nāgeṃdrānsanātanapuraḥsarān || 44 ||
saptajanmāṃtaraṃ yāvanna sa dauḥsthyamavāpnuyāt ||
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ śākinīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
na cchidraṃ na ca rogāśca nādhayo na riporbhayam || 45 ||
yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā vācyamānaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
so'pi saṃvatsaraṃ yāvatpannagairna ca pīḍyate || 46 ||
sarpadaṣṭasya yasyaitatpurataḥ paṭhyate bhṛśam ||
nāgatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ kāla daṣṭo'pi jīvati || 47 ||
pustake likhitaṃ caitannāgatīrthasamudbhavam ||
māhātmyaṃ tiṣṭhate yatra na sarpastatra tiṣṭhati || 48 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgatīrthotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 183 ||

<6.184>

|| || sūta uvāca || ||
tṛtīye ca dine prāpte trayodaśyāṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
prātaḥsavanamādāya ṛtvijaḥ sarva eva te ||
svesve karmaṇi saṃlagnā yajñakṛtyasamudbhave || 1 ||
tataḥ pravartate yajñastadā paitāmaho mahān ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhastu sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ || 2 ||
dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ tatra bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāmiti ||
ekaḥ saṃśrūyate śabdo dvitīyo dvijasaṃbhavaḥ || 3 ||
nānyastatra tṛtīyastu yajñe paitāmahe śubhe ||
yo yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ hemaratnasamudbhavam || 4 ||
sa tatprāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ vāṃchitācca caturguṇam ||
pakvānnasya kṛtāstatra dṛśyaṃte parvatāḥ śubhāḥ || 5 ||
ghṛtakṣīra mahānadyo dānārthaṃ vittarāśayaḥ ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptaḥ kaścijjñānī dvijottamāḥ || 6 ||
atītānāgatānvetti vartamānaṃ ca yaḥ sadā ||
sa brahmāṇaṃ namaskṛtya niviṣṭaśca tadagrataḥ || 7 ||
karmāṃtareṣu viprāṇāṃ sa sarveṣāṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
kathayāmāsa yadvṛttaṃ bālyātprabhṛti kṛtsnaśaḥ || 8 ||
tatasta ṛtvijaḥ sarve kautukāviṣṭacetasaḥ ||
papracchurjñāninaṃ taṃ ca vismayotphullalocanāḥ || 9 ||
vismṛtāni smaraṃtaste nijakṛtyāni vai tataḥ ||
proktāni garhaṇīyāni hyasaṃkhyātāni sarvaśaḥ || 6.184.10 ||
tataste punarevātha papracchurjñāninaṃ ca tam ||
lokottaramidaṃ jñānaṃ kathaṃ te saṃsthitaṃ dvija|| 11 ||
ko guruste samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ ||
ahojñānamaho jñānaṃ naitaddṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ ca na || 12 ||
yādṛśaṃ te dvijaśreṣṭha dṛśyate pārthasaṃsthitam ||
kiṃ brahmaṇā svayaṃ vipra tvamevaṃ pratibodhitaḥ || 13 ||
kiṃ vā hareṇa tuṣṭena kiṃ vā devena cakriṇā ||
nānyaprabodhitasyaivaṃ jñānaṃ saṃjāyate sphuṭam || 14 || ||
|| atithiruvāca || ||
piṃgalā kuraraḥ sarpaḥ sāraṃgaścaiva yo vane ||
iṣukāraḥ kumārī ca ṣaḍete guravo mama || 15 ||
eteṣāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ dṛṣṭvā jñānaṃ me samupasthitam|| 16 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
kathayasva mahābhāga kathaṃ te guravaḥ sthitāḥ ||
kīdṛśaṃ ca tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ teṣāṃ caiva viceṣṭitam || || 17 ||
kasmindeśe tvamutpannaḥ kasminsthāne vadasva naḥ ||
kiṃnāmā kiṃ nu gotraśca sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 18 ||
|| atithiruvāca || ||
āsannava pure viprāścatvāro ye vivāsitāḥ ||
śunaḥśepo'tha śākreyo bauddho dāṃtaścaturthakaḥ || 19 ||
teṣāṃ madhye tu yo bauddhaḥ śāṃto dāṃta iti smṛtaḥ ||
chandogagotravikhyāto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || 6.184.20 ||
nāgareṣu samutpannaḥ paścimevayasi sthitaḥ ||
tasyāhaṃ prathamaḥ putraḥ prāṇebhyo'pi suhṛtpriyaḥ || 21 ||
tato'haṃ yauvanaṃ prāpto yadā dvijavarottama| ||
tadā me dayitastātaḥ paṃcatvaṃ samupāgataḥ || 22 ||
etasminnaṃtare rājā hyānartādhipatirdvijāḥ ||
sutapāstena nirdiṣṭo'haṃ tu kaṃcukikarmaṇi || 23 ||
śāṃtaṃ dāṃtaṃ samālokya viśvastena mahātmanā ||
tasya cāṃtaḥpure hyāsītpiṃgalānāma nāyikā || 24 ||
daurbhāgyeṇa samopetā rūpeṇāpi samanvitā ||
athānyāḥ śataśastasya bhāryāścāṃtaḥpure sthitāḥ || 25 ||
tāḥ sarvā rajanīvaktre vyākulatvaṃ prayāṃti ca ||
āharaṃti parāngandhāndhūpāṃśca kusumāni ca || 26 ||
vilepanāni mukhyāni surabhīṇi tathā puraḥ || |
puṣpāṇi ca vicitrāṇi hyanyāḥ sūkṣmāṃbarāṇi ca ||27||
tāvadyāvatsthitaḥ kālaḥ śayanīyasamudbhavaḥ ||
manmathotsāhasaṃ yuktāḥ pulakena samanvitāḥ ||28||
ekā jānāti māṃ suptāṃ nūnamākārayiṣyati ||
anyā jānāti māṃ caiva parasparamamarṣataḥ ||29||
spardhayanti prayudhyanti virūpāṇi vadanti ca ||
tāsāṃ madhyāttataścaikā prayāti nṛpasaṃnidhau || 6.184.30 ||
śeṣā vai lakṣyamāsādya niḥśvasya prasvapanti ca ||
duḥkhārtā na labhanti sma tāśca nidrāṃ parābhavāt || 31 ||
kāmena pīḍitāṃgāśca bāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇāḥ sthitāḥ || 32 ||
āśā hi paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ nirāśā paramaṃ sukham ||
āśānirāśāṃ kṛtvā ca sukhaṃ svapiti piṃgalā || 33 ||
na karoti ca śṛṃgāraṃ na spardhāṃ ca kadācana||
na vyākulatvamāpede sukhaṃ svapiti piṃgalā||34||
tato mayāpi taddṛṣṭvā tasyāśceṣṭitamuttamam||
āśāḥ sarvāḥ parityaktāḥ svapimīha tataḥ sukhī||35||
ye svapaṃti sukhaṃ rātrau teṣāṃ kāyāgniridhyate|
āhāraṃ pratigṛhṇāti tataḥ puṣṭikaraṃ param||36||
tadetkāraṇaṃ jātaṃ mama tejo bhivṛddhaye||
gurutve piṃgalā jātā tena sā me dvijottamāḥ||37||
āśāpāśaiḥ parītāṃgā ye bhavanti naro rditāḥ||
te rātrau śerate naiva tadaprāptivicintayā||38||
naivāgnirdīpyate teṣāṃ jāṭharaśca tataḥ param||
āhāraṃ vāṃchate naiva tanna tejobhivardhanam||39||
sarvasya vidyate prāṃto na vāṃchāyāḥ kathaṃcana||6.184.40||
yathāyathā bhavellābho vāṃcitasya nṛṇāmiha||
haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva vṛddhiṃ yāti tathātathā||41||
yathā śṛṃgaṃ ruroḥ kāye vardhamānasya vardhate||
evaṃ tṛṣṇāpi yatnena vardhamānena vardhate||42||
evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāgaḥ puruṣeṇa vijānatā||
divā tatkarma kartavyaṃ yena rātrau sukhaṃ svapet||43||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye brahmayajñe tṛtīyadivase piṃgalopākhyānavarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||184||

<6.185>

atithiruvāca||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yathā me piṃgalā guruḥ||
saṃjātā kuraro jāto yathā tatpravadānyaham||1||
mamāsīddraviṇaṃ bhūri pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat||2||
ye'tha putrāśca dāyādā bāṃdhavā api||
te māṃ sarve prabādhante dravyasasyakṛte sadā||3||
yasyāhaṃ na prayacchāmi sa māṃ caiva prabādhate||
sīdamānastu subhṛśaṃ darśayanprāṇasaṃkṣayam||4||
eka sāmnā prayācaṃte vittaṃ bhedena cāpare ||
bhayadānena cānye'pi keciddaṃḍena ca dvijāḥ || 5 ||
evaṃ nāhaṃ kvacitsaukhyaṃ teṣāṃ pārśvāllabhāmi bhoḥ ||
cintayāno divānaktaṃ kleśasya pari saṃkṣayam ||
upāyaṃ na ca paśyāmi yena śāṃtiḥ prajāyate || 6 ||
anyasmindivase dṛṣṭaḥ kṛtamāṃsaparigrahaḥ ||
kuraraścaṃcunā vyomni gacchamānastvarānvitaḥ || 7 ||
hanyamānaḥ samaṃtācca māṃsārthe vividhaiḥ khagaiḥ ||
atha tena parikṣiptaṃ tanmāṃsaṃ pakṣijādbhayāt || 8 ||
yāvattāvatsukhī jātaste'pisarve samujjhitāḥ ||
mayāpi kliśyamānena tadvacca nijabāṃdhavaiḥ || 9 ||
sāmiṣaṃ kuraraṃ dṛṣṭvā vadhyamānaṃ nirāmiṣaiḥ ||
āmiṣasya parityāgātkuraraḥ sukhamedhate || 6.185.10 ||
evaṃ niścitya manasā sarvānānīya bāṃdhavān ||
putrānpautrāṃstataḥ sarvānpurasteṣāṃ niveditam || 11 ||
triḥsatyaṃ śapathaṃ kṛtvā nānyadastīti me gṛhe ||
vibhajyārthaṃ yathānyāyaṃ yūyaṃ gṛhṇīta bāndhavāḥ || 12 ||
tataḥprabhṛti tairmuktaḥ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ dvijāḥ ||
etasmātkāraṇājjāto mamāsau kuraro guruḥ|| 13 ||
arthasaṃpadvimohāya vimoho narakāya ca ||
tasmādarthamanarthaṃ taṃ mokṣārthī dūratastyajet || 14 ||
yathāmiṣaṃ jale matsyairbhakṣyate śvāpadairbhuvi||
ākāśe pakṣibhiścaiva tathā sarvatra vittavān||15||
doṣahīno'pi dhanavānbhūpādyaiḥ paritāpyate||
daridraḥ kṛtadoṣo'pi sarvatra nirupadravaḥ||16||
ālaṃbitāḥ parairyāṃti praskhalaṃti padepade ||
gadgadāni ca jalpaṃte dhanino madyapā iva||17||
bhakte dveṣo bahiḥ prītī rucitaṃ gurulaghvapi ||
mukhe ca kaṭutā nityaṃ dhanināṃ jvariṇāmiva ||18||
arthānāmarjane duḥkhamarjitānāṃ ca rakṣaṇe ||
nāśe duḥkhaṃ vyaye duḥkhaṃ dhigartho duḥkhabhājanam||19||
arthārthī jīva loko'yaṃ smaśānamapi sevate ||
janitāramapi tyaktvā niḥsvaṃ yāṃti sutā api || 6.185.20 ||
sutasya vallabhastāvatpitā putro'pi vai pituḥ ||
yāvannārthasya saṃbandhastābhyāṃ bhāvī parasparam ||
saṃbandhe vittaje jāte vairaṃ saṃjāyate mithaḥ || 21 ||
etasmātkāraṇādvittaṃ mayā tyaktaṃ tapodhanāḥ ||
tena saukhyena tiṣṭhāmi kurarasyopadeśataḥ || 22 ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ ca mahābhāgā yathā me'hirguruḥ sthitaḥ || 23 ||
yathā mayā gṛhaṃ tyaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarpaviceṣṭitam ||
gṛhāraṃbhaḥ suduḥkhāya sukhāya na kadācana || 24 ||
sarpaḥ parakṛtaṃ veśma praviśya sukhamedhate ||
uṣitvā tatra saukhyena bhūyo'nyattādṛśaṃ vrajet || 25 ||
mama tvaṃ kurute naiva mamedaṃ gṛhamityasau ||
na gṛhaṃ jāyate tasya na svayaṃ hi kṛtaṃ yataḥ || 26 ||
yaḥ punaḥ kurute harmyaṃ svayaṃ kleśaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||
na tasya yāti tatpaścānmṛtyukāle'pi saṃsthite || 27 ||
gṛhātsaṃjāyate bhāryā tataḥ putraśca kanyakā ||
teṣāmarthe karoti sma kṛtyākṛtyaṃ tataḥ param ||28||
kośakāramivātmānaṃ veṣṭayannāvabudhyate ||129 ||
putradāragṛhakṣetrasaktāḥ sīdaṃti jaṃtavaḥ ||
lobhapaṃkārṇave magnā jīrṇā vanagajā iva || 6.185.30 ||
ekaḥ pāpāni kurute phalaṃ bhuṃkte mahājanaḥ ||
bhoktāro vipramucyaṃte kartā doṣeṇa lipyate 31 ||
etasmātkāraṇāddharmyaṃ mayā tyaktaṃ dvijottamāḥ|
mokṣamārgārgalā bhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarpaviceṣṭitam || 32 ||
ekarātraṃ vasedgrāme trirātraṃ pattane vaset ||
yo yāti sa yatiḥ prokto yo'nyo yogaviḍaṃbakaḥ || 33 ||
vidhūme ca praśāṃtāgnau yastu mādhukarīṃ caret ||
gṛhe ca vipramukhyānāṃ yatiḥ sa netaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 34 ||
daṇḍī bhikṣāṃ ca vā kuryāttadeva vyasanaṃ vinā ||
yastiṣṭhati na vairāgyaṃ yāti naiva yatirhi saḥ || 35 ||
divā svapnaṃ vṛthānnaṃ ca strīkathā''lokyameva ca ||
śvetavastraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca yatīnāṃ patanāni ṣaṭ|| 36||
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanaḥ ||
suhṛtputra udāsīnaḥ sa yatirnetaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 37 ||
samau mānāpamānau ca svadeśe parikepi vā ||
yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi sa yatirnetaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 38 ||
yasmingṛhe viśeṣeṇa labhedbhikṣā ca vāśanam ||
tatra no yāti yo bhūyaḥ sa yatirnetaraḥ smṛtaḥ| || 39 ||
evaṃ jñātvā mayā vipra dṛṣṭvā sarpaviceṣṭitam ||
sarvasaṃgaparityāgo mokṣārthaṃ parikalpitaḥ || 6.185.40 ||
evaṃ mamāhiḥ saṃjāto gururbrāhmaṇasattamāḥ|
tatprabhāvānmahattejaḥ saṃjātaṃ vigrahe mama || 41 ||
yathā me bhramaro jāto gurustadvadvadāmi ca ||
kasminvṛkṣe mayā dṛṣṭo bhramaraḥ ko'pi saṃgataḥ ||42||
śākhāya tu samāśritya kṛtapūrvanibaṃdhanam ||
vasaṃtasamaye prāpte puṣpavaṃtaśca ye drumāḥ || 43 ||
sugandhaphalapuṣpāśca sugandhadalasaṃyutāḥ ||
teṣāmaṇuṃ samādāya śreṣṭhaśreṣṭhatamaṃ rasam || 44 |
niyojayati śākhāgre tarorasya sadaiva hi ||
anirviṇṇatayā hṛṣṭastadā samyaṅnirīkṣitaḥ || 45 ||
madhujālaṃ tato jātaṃ kālena mahatā mahat ||
yenānye madhunā tṛptiṃ prāptāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || 46 ||
tacceṣṭitaṃ mayā vīkṣya śāstrāṇyanyāni bhūriśaḥ ||
tatasteṣāṃ samādāya sārabhūtaṃ pṛthakpṛthak ||
kṛtāni bhūriśāstrāṇi vedāṃtāni ca kṛtsnaśaḥ || 47 ||
upajīvaṃti yānyanye yathā bhṛṅgāstathā dvijāḥ || 48 ||
evaṃ me madhupo jāto gurutve ca dvijottamāḥ ||
tenāhaṃ tejasā yukto nānyadastīha kāraṇam|| 49 ||
vedāṃtavādino ye'tra prabhavaṃti vratānvitāḥ ||
nirlobhā gatatṛṣṇāśca te bhavaṃti sutejasaḥ || 6.185.50 ||
ekenāpi vihīnā ye prabhavaṃti kubuddhayaḥ ||
lobhamohānvitāḥ pāpā jāyaṃte te vicetasaḥ ||51||
vedāṃtāni subhūrīṇi mayā dṛṣṭvā vicārya ca ||
samarūpāḥ kṛtā granthā martyalokahitārthinā || 52 ||
evaṃ me gurutāṃ prāpto madhupo dvijasattamāḥ ||
iṣukāro yathā jātastathā caiva bravīmi vaḥ||53||
ātmāvalokanārthāya mayā dṛṣṭāḥ sahasraśaḥ||
yogino jñānasaṃpannāstaiḥ proktaṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ||54||
ātmāvalokanaṃ bhāvi suśiṣyāya yathā tathā||
sa samādhijadvāreṇa caturāśītikena ca||55||
āsanaistatpramāṇaiśca padmāsanaprapūrvakaiḥ||
asaṃkhyaiḥ kāraṇaiścaiva hyadhyātmapaṭhanaistathā||
tatopi lakṣito naiva mayā'tmā ca kathaṃcana||56||
tato vairāgyamāpannaḥ prabhramāmi dharātale||
gurvarthe na ca lebhe'haṃ gurumātmāvalokane || 57 ||
anyasminnahani prāpte rājamārgeṇa gacchatā ||
mayā dṛṣṭo mahīpālaḥ sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 58 ||
tato'haṃ mārgamutsṛjya saṃmukhasya mahīpateḥ ||
uṭajadvāramāśritya kiṃcidūrdhvopi saṃsthitaḥ || 59 ||
tatrāpi ca sthitaḥ kaścitpuruṣaḥ kāṃḍakārakaḥ ||
ṛjukarmaṇi saṃyuktaḥ śarāṇāṃ nataparvaṇām|| 6.185.60 ||
tasmindūragate bhūpe tathānyaḥ sevako'bhyagāt || 61 ||
taṃ papraccha tvarāyuktaḥ śṛṇvato'pi mama dvijāḥ ||
kāṃḍakarmaṇi saṃsaktamṛjutvena sthitaṃ tadā ||62||
kiyatī vartate velā gatasya pṛthivīpateḥ ||
mārgeṇānena me brūhi yena gacchāmi pṛṣṭhataḥ||63||
so'bravīttaṃ tadā viprā adhovaktraḥ sthito naraḥ ||
anena rājamārgeṇa gacchamāno mahīpatiḥ || 64 ||
na mayā vīkṣitaḥ kaścididānīṃ rājasevaka ||
tadanyaṃ pṛccha cetkāryaṃ tavānena bravītu saḥ || 65 ||
śarakarmaṇi saṃsaktastvahamatra vyavasthitaḥ ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya svacitte cintitaṃ mayā||66||
ekacittatayā yogo brahmajñānasamudbhavaḥ ||
nānyathā bhavitā me sa tataścittanirodhanam ||
karomi brahmasaṃsiddhyai tato me'sau bhaviṣyati || 67 ||
tataḥprabhṛti citte sve dhārayāmi sadaiva tu ||
viśvarūpaṃ tathā sūryaṃ hṛtpaṃkajanivāsinam || 68 ||
tato dikṣu diganteṣu gagane dharaṇītale ||
tamekaṃ caiva paśyāmi nānyatkiṃciddvijottamāḥ || 69 ||
ahaṃ ca tejasā yuktastatprabhāveṇa saṃsthitaḥ || 6.185.70 ||
evaṃ me sa gururjātaḥ śarakāro dvijottamāḥ ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ kanyakā jātā gurutve me yathā purā || 71 ||
sarvasaṃgaparityāgī yadāhaṃ nirgato gṛhāt ||
mamānupṛṣṭhataścaiva tato bhāryā vinirgatā || 72 ||
śiśuṃ putraṃ samādāya kanyāmekāṃ ca śobhanām||
tato'haṃ bhāryayā prokto vānaprasthāśrame sthitaḥ||73||
kuru me vacanaṃ muktiratraiva hi bhaviṣyati||
brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho'thavā yatiḥ||
yadi syātsaṃyatātmā sa nūnaṃ muktimavāpnuyāt||74||
athavā māṃ parityajya yadi yāsyasi cānyataḥ||
tadahaṃ ca mariṣyāmi satyametadasaṃśayam||75||
mṛtāyāṃ mayi te bālāvetāvanumariṣyataḥ||
kumārī ca kumāraśca tasmānnātha dayāṃ kuru||76||
mā vrajasva paraṃ tīrthaṃ parijānannapi svayam||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetrametatpuṇyataraṃ smṛtam||77||
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ śrutametanmayā vibho||
vadatāṃ brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ tapasvinām||78||
śloko'yaṃ bahudhā nātha kīrtyamāno mayā vibho||
viśvāmitrasya vaktreṇa sanmuneḥ satyavādinaḥ||79||
punaṃti sarvatīrthāni snānadānādasaṃśayam||
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ smaraṇādapi pāvayet||6.185.80||
tataḥ kṛcchrātpratijñātaṃ mayāśramaniṣevaṇam||
vānaprasthodbhavaṃ vā syāttato'haṃ tatra saṃsthitaḥ||81||
tatrasthasya hi me kanyā krīḍate parataḥ sthitā||
valayāpūritābhyāṃ ca prakoṣṭhābhyāṃ tatastataḥ || 82 ||
yathāyathā sā kurute kandamūlaphalāśanam ||
tanutvaṃ yāti kāyena tathā caiva dinedine || 83 ||
tato me jāyate duḥkhaṃ teṣāṃ patana saṃbhavam ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya saṃjātaṃ valayatrayam ||
tasyā haste tatastābhyāṃ śabdaḥ saṃjāyate mithaḥ || 84 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā tābhyāmekaṃ vyavasthitam ||
na saṃgharṣo na śabdaśca tatrasthasya ca jāyate || 85 ||
tadvicintya mayā so'pi hyāśramaḥ parivarjitaḥ ||
cintitaṃ ca mayā citte kṛtvā caivaṃ suniścayam || 86 ||
bahubhiḥ kalaho nityaṃ dvābhyāṃ saṃgharṣaṇaṃ tathā ||
ekākī vicariṣyāmi kumārīvalayaṃ yathā || 87 ||
tataḥ suptāṃ parityajya tāṃ bhāryāṃ śiśusaṃyutām ||
gato'haṃ dūramadhvānaṃ yatra no vetti sā ca mām || 88 ||
yatrā'stamitaśāyī ca yalabdhakṛtabhojanaḥ ||
bhramāmi medinīpṛṣṭhe tyaktvā saṃsārabandhanam || 89 ||
tato me jñānamāpannamevaṃ viprāḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ ||
atītānāgataṃ caiva vartamānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 6.185.90 ||
evaṃ me kanyakā jātā gurutve dvijasattamāḥ || 91 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi guroḥ kṛte ||
na yuṣmākaṃ puro mithyā kīrtayāmi kathaṃcana|| || 92 ||
evaṃ me jñānamutpannaṃ prakāraiḥ ṣaḍbhireva ca ||
ebhirlokottaraṃ jñānaṃ yuṣmatpratyayakārakam || 93 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve papracchustaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
vānaprasthāśramaṃ tyaktvā bhāryāṃ śiśusamanvitām ||
kva gatastvaṃ tadācakṣva kiyatkālaṃ ca saṃsthitaḥ || 94 ||
|| atithiruvāca || ||
ahaṃ bhītaḥ sahasrāṇi grāmāṇāṃ ca śatāni ca ||
yatrāstamitaśāyī sannanekāni dvijottamāḥ ||
saṃkhyayā rahitānyeva varṣāṇāṃ ca śatāni ca || 95 ||
dṛṣṭāni mukhyatīrthāni tathaivāyatanāni ca ||
dṛṣṭāśca parvatāḥ śreṣṭhā nadyaśca vimalodakāḥ || 96 ||
svayameva mayā jñāto vārāṇasyāṃ sthitena ca ||
yajñaḥ paitāmaho bhāvī sthāne'sminmāmake yataḥ ||97||
tato'haṃ satvaraṃ prāptaḥ kautukena dvijottamāḥ ||
kīdṛśaḥ sa makho bhāvī yatra yajvā pitāmahaḥ || 98 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ||
vāsudevaṃ puraskṛtya tathā caiva maheśvaram||99||
kamāntaraṃ samāsādya pulastyādyāstathartvijaḥ ||
brahmāpi svayamāyāto mṛgacarmadharastathā||6.185.100||
tataste tuṣṭimāpannāstasya jñānena tena ca ||
procuśca varadāstubhyaṃ sarva eva divaukasaḥ || 101 ||
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te prārthayasva yathepsitam ||
avaśyaṃ tava dāsyāmo yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 102 || ||
|| atithiruvāca || ||
yadi tuṣṭāḥ surā mahyaṃ prayacchaṃti varaṃ mama ||
anenaiva śarīreṇa devatvaṃ prārthayāmyaham || 103 ||
yajñabhāgasamopetaṃ tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām||
viśeṣeṇa suraśreṣṭhāḥ sthānaṃ copari saṃsthitam || 109 ||
|| devā ūcuḥ || ||
nūnaṃ tvaṃ vibudho bhūtvā devaloke nivatsyasi ||
aneneva śarīreṇa yajñabhāgavivarjitaḥ || 105 ||
yacchāmo yadi te vipra yajñāṃśaṃ mānuṣasya bhoḥ ||
aprāmāṇyaṃ śruterbhāvi tava dattena tena ca || 106 ||
||atithiruvāca || ||
devatvena na me kāryaṃ yajñāṃśarahitena ca ||
tadahaṃ sādhayiṣyāmi yathā muktirbhaviṣyati || 107 ||
tacchrutvā padmajaḥ prāha sarvāndevānkṛtāṃjaliḥ ||
śṛṇvaṃtu devatāḥ sarvā yadbravīmi hitaṃ vacaḥ || 109 ||
mamāyaṃ brāhmaṇo yajñe dūrādeva samāgataḥ ||
nāgarastu viśeṣeṇa pātraṃ jñānasamudbhavam || 109 ||
pratijñātastathā sarvairvaro'sya vibudhairyataḥ ||
tasmātpradīyatāmasmai yadabhīṣṭaṃ surottamāḥ || 6.185.110 || ||
|| maheśvara uvāca || ||
yathā'sya jāyate tṛptiryajñabhāgādhikā sadā ||
tathāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇvaṃtu vibudhottamāḥ || 111 ||
ya eṣa kriyate yajñastasya nātho hariḥ smṛtaḥ||
etasmātkāraṇātproktaḥ sa devo yajñapūruṣaḥ || 112 ||
adyaprabhṛti yatkiṃcicchrāddhaṃ martye bhaviṣyati ||
daivaṃ vā paitṛkaṃ vā'pi tasya cāṃte vyavasthitaḥ || 113 ||
etasya nāma saṃkīrtya paścācca yajñapūruṣam ||
saṃkīrtya bhojanaṃ deyaṃ brāhmaṇasya dvijottamāḥ || 114 ||
tenāsya bhavitā tṛptiryajñāṃtā'bhyadhikā sadā ||
adattvāsya kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ yatkiṃcitprabhaviṣyati ||115||
tadyāsyatyakhilaṃ vyarthaṃ tathā bhasmahutaṃ yathā ||
vaiśvadevāṃtamāsādya yaścainaṃ pūjayiṣyati || 116 ||
viṣṇunāmasamopetaṃ bhaviṣyati tadakṣayam ||
dattaṃ svalpamapi prāyaḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 117 ||
śrāddhe vā vaiśvadeve vā yaścainaṃ nārcayiṣyati ||
saṃprāptaṃ vyarthatāṃ tasya tacca sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati ||118||
asmiṃstuṣṭiṃ gate sarve surā yāsyaṃti saṃmudam ||
pitaraśca tamāyāṃti vimukhe saṃmukhe tathā || 119 ||
tacchrutvā vibudhāḥ sarve maheśvaravacastadā ||
tatheti muditāḥ procurbrahmaviṣṇupurassarāḥ || 6.185.120 ||
tataḥprabhṛti saṃjātā pūjā cātithisaṃbhavā ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjā kāryā'titheḥ sadā ||
yajñe pūruṣayajñasya na caikasya kathaṃcana || 121 || ||
|| atithiruvāca || ||
atrāsti māmakaṃ tīrthaṃ mayā yatra tapaḥ kṛtam ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre purukāle dvijottamāḥ ||122||
aṃgārakeṇa saṃyuktā caturthī syādyadā tithiḥ ||
sāṃnidhyaṃ tatra kāryaṃ ca sarvairdevaiśca taddine || 123 ||
kuryāttatraiva yaḥ snānaṃ tasminnahani saṃsthite ||
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tasya jāyatāṃ vaḥ prasādataḥ || 124 ||
tathāstviti tataḥ sarve'tithiṃ procuḥ surottamāḥ ||
etasminnaṃtare prāha pulastyarṣiḥ pitāmaham ||125|| ||
pulastya uvāca || ||
ṛtvijaḥ sakalā devāḥ saṃsthitāḥ kautukānvitāḥ ||
uttiṣṭhaṃtu ca te śīghraṃ yajñakarmaprasiddhaye || 126 ||
etasminnaṃtare sarve tasya vākyapraṇoditāḥ ||
utthitā ṛtvijo ye ca svāni sthānāni bhejire ||
tataḥ pravavṛte yajñaḥ sapunardvijasattamāḥ ||
kurvatā yajñakarmāṇi homapūrvāṇi yāni ca || 127 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye tīrthotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nā
ma pañcāśītyuttaraśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ || 185 || || cha ||

<6.186>

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
bhūya eva mahābhāga vada māhātmyamuttamam ||
atitheḥ kṛtyamasmākaṃ vistareṇa ca sūtaja || 1 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
śṛṇvantu munayaḥ sarve māhātmyamidamuttamam ||
yena saṃśrutamātreṇa naśyetpāpaṃ dinodbhavam || 2 ||
yanmayā ca śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ sakāśātsvapituḥ śubham || 3 ||
gṛhasthānāṃ paro dharmo nānyo'styatithipūjanāt ||
atitherna ca doṣosti tasyātikramaṇena ca || 4 ||
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinivartate ||
sa dattvā duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati || 5 ||
satyaṃ śaucaṃ tapo'dhītaṃ dattamiṣṭaṃ śataṃ samāḥ ||
tasya sarvamidaṃ naṣṭamatithiṃ yo na pūjayet || 6 ||
dūrādatithayo yasya gṛhamāyāṃti nirvṛtāḥ ||
sa gṛhastha iti proktaḥ śeṣāśca gṛharakṣiṇaḥ || 7 ||
na purākṛtapuṇyānāṃ narāṇāmiha bhūtale ||
trīnetānpratihanyaṃte śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ śubhā giraḥ || 8 ||
tuṣṭe'tithau gṛhasthasya tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ||
vimukhe vimukhāḥ sarvā bhavaṃti ca na saṃśayaḥ 9 ||
tasmāttoṣayitavyaśca gṛhasthena sadā'tithiḥ ||
apyātmanaḥ pradānena yadīcchetpuṇyamātmanaḥ || || 6.186.10 ||
trividhastvatithiḥ prokto gṛhasthānāṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
tasyāhaṃ vacmi vaḥ kālaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 11 ||
śrāddhīyo vaiśvadevīyaḥ sūryoḍhaśca tṛtīyakaḥ ||
ye cānye bhojanārthīyāste sāmānyāḥ prakīrtitā || 12 ||
sāṃkalpe vihite śrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ bhojanodbhave ||
samāgacchati yaḥ kāle tasmiñchrāddhīya eva saḥ || 13 ||
dūrādhvānaṃ pathi śrāṃtaṃ vaiśvadevāṃta āgatam ||
atithiṃ taṃ vijānīyānnātithiḥ pūrvamāgataḥ || 14 ||
priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyo mūrkhaḥ paṃḍita eva vā ||
vaiśvadeve tu saṃprāptaḥ so'tithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ || 15 ||
na pṛcchedgotracaraṇaṃ na sthānaṃ vedameva ca ||
dṛṣṭvā yajñopavītaṃ ca bhojayettaṃ prabhaktitaḥ || 16 ||
śrāddhe vā vaiśvadeve vā yadyāgacchati nātithiḥ ||
ghṛtāhutiṃ tato dadyāttannāmnā ca havirbhuji || 17 ||
aśaktyā bhojyadānasya deyaṃ bhaktyā tataḥ param ||
tasyānnamapi tu stokaṃ yena tuṣṭiṃ pragacchati || 18 ||
tathānyaśca tṛtīyastu sūryoḍho'tithirucyate ||
kṛte tu bhojane yastu rātrau vā cādhigacchati||
tasya śaktyā pradātavyaṃ sasyaṃ ca gṛhamedhinā||19||
sūryoḍho yasya saṃprāpto gṛhātpūjāṃ vinā vrajet||
nirāśaḥ pātakaṃ tasya nijaṃ dattvā prayāti saḥ||6.186.20||
tṛṇāni bhūmirudakaṃ vākcaturthī ca sūnṛtā||
etānyapi satāṃ gehe nocchidyaṃte kadācana||21||
svāgatenāgnayastṛptiṃ gṛhasthasya prayāṃti ca ||
āsanena vrajettuṣṭiṃ svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ || 22||
argheṇa śaṃbhuḥ pādyena sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ||
bhojyadānena viṣṇuḥ syātsarvadevamayo'tithiḥ || 23 ||
tasmātpūjyaḥ sadā viprā bhojanīyo viśeṣataḥ ||
nāmāpyuccārya bhojyo'nyo brāhmaṇo gṛhamedhinā || 24 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭa keśvarakṣetramāhātmye'tithimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 186 || || cha ||

<6.187>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
caturthe divase prāpte tato yajñasamudbhave ||
ṛtvigbhiryājñikaṃ karma prārabdhaṃ tadanaṃtaram || 1 ||
somapānādikaṃ sarvaṃ paśorhiṃsādikaṃ tathā ||
paśorgudaṃ samādāya prasthātā ca vyadhārayat || 2 ||
ekāṃte sadaso madhye homārthaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
tasminvyākulatāṃ yāte brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidāgataḥ || 3 ||
yuvā tatra praviṣṭastu māṃsa bhakṣaṇalālasaḥ ||
tato gudaṃ paśordṛṣṭvā bhakṣayāmāsa cotsukaṃ || 4 ||
etasminnaṃtare prāptaḥ prasthātā tasya saṃnidhau ||
bhakṣamāṇaṃ samālokya taṃ śaśāpa tataḥ param || 5 ||
dhigdhikpāpasamācāra homārthaṃ yadgudaṃ dhṛtam ||
tattvayā dūṣitaṃ laulyādyajñavighnakaraṃ kṛtam || 6 ||
ucchiṣṭena mayā homaḥ kartavyo naiva sāṃpratam ||
rākṣasānāmidaṃ karma yattvayā samanuṣṭhitam || 7 ||
tasmāttvaṃ mama vākyena rākṣaso bhava mā ciram || 8 ||
etasminneva kāle tu hyūrdhvakeśo'bhavaddhi saḥ ||
raktākṣaḥ śaṃkukarṇaśca kṛṣṇadanto'tibhairavaḥ || 9 ||
lamboṣṭho vikarālāsyo māṃsamedovivarjitaḥ ||
tvagasthisnāyuśeṣaśca| cāmuṇḍākṛtireva ca || 6.187.10 ||
sa ca viśvāvasurnāma pulastyasya suto muniḥ ||
maṃtrapūtasya māṃsasya bhakṣaṇārthaṃ samāgataḥ || 11 ||
vedavedāṃgatattvajaḥ pautrastu parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasākāraṃ vitresuḥ sarvato dvijāḥ || 12 ||
rākṣoghnāni ca sūktāni jajapuścāpare tathā ||
keciccharaṇamāpannā viṣṇo rudrasya cāpare || 13 ||
pitāmahasya cānye tu gāyatryāḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
rakṣarakṣeti jalpanto bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ || 14 ||
so'pi dṛṣṭvā tadātmānaṃ gataṃ rākṣasatāṃ dvijāḥ ||
bāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇo dīnaḥ pitāmahamupādravat || 15 ||
sa praṇamya tato vākyaṃ kṛtāṃjaliruvāca tam || 16 || |
pautro'haṃ tava deveśa pulastyasya suto dvijaḥ ||
nīto rākṣasatāmadya prasthātrā kopato vibho || 17 ||
jihvālaulyena deveśa paśorgudamajānatā ||
bhakṣitaṃ tanmayā deva homārthaṃ yatprakalpitam || 18 ||
tasmānmānuṣatāprāptyai mama dehe dayāṃ kuru ||
rākṣasatvaṃ yathā yāti tathā nītirvidhīyatām || 19|| '

|| brahmovāca || ||
prāyaścittaṃ kariṣye'haṃ yajñasyāsya prasiddhaye ||

so'bravīcchītalo vahniryadi syāduṣṇaguḥ śaśī ||

|| rākṣasa uvāca || ||

|| brahmovāca || ||

yadvā māhiṣiko bhuṃkte śvitrī vā kunakho'pi vā ||
kuṣṭhī vātha dvijo bhuṃkte tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || 43 ||
hīnāṃgo vā'tha yadbhuṃkte'dhikāṃgo vātha niṃditaḥ ||
mahāvyādhigṛhīto vā cauro vārddhuṣiko'pi vā ||
yatra bhuṃkte'thavā śrāddhe tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || 44 ||

vinagno vātha yadbhuṃkte tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || 45 ||
yo yajño dakṣiṇāhīno yaścāśaucayutaiḥ kṛtaḥ ||
brahmacaryavihīnastu tatphalaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 46 ||
yasminnaivātithiḥ pūjyaḥ śrāddhe vā yajñakarmaṇi ||
saṃprāpte vaiśvadevāṃte tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati || 47 ||1
āvāhanātparaṃ yatra maunaṃ na śrāddhadaścaret||
brāhmaṇo vā'tha bhoktā ca tatte śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyati||48||
mṛnmayeṣu ca pātreṣu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ||
bhinnapātreṣu vā yacca tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati || 49 ||
pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ yatra takraṃ vā vikṛtaṃ bhavet ||
jātīpuṣpapradānaṃ ca tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati || 6.187.50 ||
yajamāno dvijo vātha brahmacaryavivarjitaḥ ||
tacchrāddhaṃ te mayā dattaṃ tripātreṇa vivarjitam || 51 ||
āyasena tu pātreṇa yatrānnaṃ ca pradīyate ||
tacchrāddhaṃ te mayā dattaṃ tathānyadapi hīyate || 52 ||
maṃtrakriyābhyāṃ yatkicidrātrau dattaṃ hutaṃ tathā ||
sakrāṃtisomaparvabhyāṃ vyati riktaṃ tu kutsitam || 53 ||
ityuktvā virarāmāśu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||
rākṣasaḥ so'pi tatrāpi lebhe sthānaṃ tu rākṣasam || 54 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye rākṣasaprāpyaśrāddhavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 187 || || ||

yājñikānāṃ tu viprāṇāṃ sumahāñchāstrasaṃbhavaḥ || 87 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mātṛgaṇagamanasāvitrīdatta mātṛgaṇaśāpavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||188|| cha ||

<6.189>

|| sūta uvāca || ||

sūta uvāca||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
sūtaputra tvayā proktaṃ sāvitrī nāgatā ca yat ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
sāvitrī vaśagaṃ kāṃtaṃ jñātvā viśvāsamāgatā ||
sthirā bhūtvā tadā sarvā devapatnīḥ samānayat || 4 ||
gaurī lakṣmīḥ śacī medhā tathā caivāpyarundhatī ||
svadhā svāhā tathā kītirbuddhiḥ puṣṭiḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ ||
tathā cānyāśca bahavo hyapsarobhiḥ samanvitāḥ || 5 ||
ghṛtācī menakā raṃbhā urvaśī ca tilottamā ||
apsarāṇāṃ gaṇāḥ sarve samājagmurdvijottamāḥ || 6 ||
sā tābhiḥ sahitā devīpūrṇahastābhireva ca ||
saṃprahṛṣṭamanobhiśca prasthitā maṇḍapaṃ prati || 7 ||
vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu gītadhvaniyuteṣu ca ||
gandharvāṇāṃ pramukhyānāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 8 ||
prasthitā sā mahābhāgā yāvattadyajñamaṇḍapam ||
tāvattasyāstadā cakṣuḥ prāsphuraddakṣiṇaṃ muhuḥ || 9 ||
apasavyaṃ mṛgāścakrustathānye'pi khagādayaḥ ||
viparyastena saṃyāti śabdānkurvaṃti cāsakṛt || 6.191.10 ||
dakṣiṇāni tathā'ṅgāni sphuramāṇāni vai muhuḥ||
tasyā manasi saṃkṣobhaṃ janayati nirargalam || 11 ||
tāśca devastriyaḥ sarvā nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca ||
gāyaṃti ca yathotsāhaṃ tasyāḥ pārśve vyavasthitāḥ || 12 ||
na jānaṃti ca saṃkṣobhaṃ tathā śakunajaṃ hṛdi ||
anyonyasparddhayā sarvā gītanṛtyaparāyaṇāḥ || 13 ||
ahaṃpūrvamahaṃpūrvaṃ praviśāmi mahāmakhe ||
ityautsukyasamopetāstā gacchaṃti tadā pathi || 14 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye sāvitryā yajñāgamanakālikotpātādyapaśakunodbhavavarṇanaṃnāmaikanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||191|| || cha ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha śrutvā mahānādaṃ vādyānāṃ samupasthitam ||
nāradaḥ sammukhaḥ prāyājjñātvā ca jananīṃ nijām || 1 ||
praṇipatya sa dīnātmā bhūtvā cāśrupariplutaḥ ||

|| gauryuvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
evaṃ gatāyāṃ sāvitryāṃ sakopāyāṃ ca sūtaja ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

paraṃ strīṇāṃ svabhāvo'yaṃ sarvāsāṃ surasattamāḥ||
api sahyo vajrapātaḥ sapatnyā na punaḥ kathā ||6||
matkṛte ye'tra śapitā sāvitryā brāhmaṇāḥ surāḥ ||
teṣāmahaṃ kariṣyāmi śaktyā sādhāraṇāṃ svayam || 7 ||
apūjyo'yaṃ vidhiḥ proktastayā maṃtrapuraḥsaraḥ ||
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ viprādīnāṃ suro ttamāḥ || 8 ||
brahmasthāneṣu sarveṣu samaye dharaṇītale ||
na brahmaṇā vinā kiṃcitkṛtyaṃ siddhimupaiṣyati || 9 ||
kṛṣṇārcane ca yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ liṃga pūjane ||
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sadā vai brahmadarśanāt ||
bhaviṣyati na sandeho viśeṣātsarvaparvasu || 6.193.10 ||
tvaṃ ca viṣṇo tayā prokto martyajanma yadā'psyasi ||
tatrāpi parabhṛtyatvaṃ pareṣāṃ te bhaviṣyati ||11||
tatkṛtvā rūpadvitayaṃ tatra janma tvamāpsyasi ||
yattayā kathito vaṃśo mamāyaṃ gopasaṃjñitaḥ ||
tatra tvaṃ pāvanārthāya ciraṃ vṛddhimavāpsyasi || 12 ||
ekaḥ kṛṣṇābhidhānastu dvitīyo'rjunasaṃjñitaḥ ||
tasyātmano'rjunākhyasya sārathyaṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi || 13 ||
tenākṛtye'pi raktāste gopā yāsyaṃti ślāghyatām ||
sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ devānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 14 ||
yatrayatra ca vatsyaṃti madvaṃ śaprabhavānarāḥ ||
tatratatra śriyo vāso vane'pi prabhaviṣyati || 15 ||
bhobhoḥ śakra bhavānukto yattayā kopayuktayā ||
parājayaṃ ripoḥ prāpya kārā gāre patiṣyati || 16 ||
tanmuktiṃ te svayaṃ brahmā madvākyena kariṣyati || 17 ||
tataḥ praviṣṭaḥ saṃgrāme na parājayamāpsyasi ||
tvaṃ vahne sarvabhakṣaśca yatprokto ruṣṭayā tayā || 18 ||
tadamedhyamapi prāyaḥ spṛṣṭaṃ te'rccirbhiragrataḥ ||
medhyatāṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ tataḥ pūjāmavāptyasi || 19 ||
svāhā nāma ca bhāryā yā devānsantarpayiṣyati ||
svadhā cā'pi pitṝnsarvānmama vākyādasaṃśayam ||6.193.20||
yadrudra priyayā sārdhaṃ viyogaḥ kathitastayā ||
tasyāḥ śreṣṭha tarā cānyā tava bhāryā bhaviṣyati ||
gaurīnāmeti vikhyātā himācalasutā śubhā || 21 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhenāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gāyatrīvarapradānonāma trinavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 193 || || a ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ sā tānvarāndattvā sarveṣāṃ śāpabhāginām ||
maunavrataparā bhūtvā niviṣṭā'tha dharātale || 1 ||

pūjayiṣyaṃti martye'tra sarve lokāḥ samāhitāḥ || 3 ||

pūjayiṣyaṃti ye martyāste tu yāṃti parāṃ gatim || 4 ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi vistareṇa dvijottamāḥ ||

uttaraṃ cāyanaṃ tatra dinaṃ rātristathā'param||

aṣṭāviṃśatibhiścaiva sahasraistu tathā paraiḥ ||
ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ caiva tadbha viṣyati saddvijāḥ || 16 ||

tretāyugaṃ samādiṣṭaṃ dvitīyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 17 ||
dvāparaṃ cāṣṭabhirlakṣaistṛ tīyaṃ parikīrtitam ||
catuḥṣaṣṭisahasraistu yathāvatparisaṃkhyayā || 18 ||
caturlakṣaṃ samādiṣṭaṃ yugaṃ kalisamudbhavam ||
dvātriṃśatā sahasraistu caturthaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ || 19||
caturyugasahasreṇa dinaṃ paitāmahaṃ bhavet ||
teṣāṃ triṃśaddinairmāso māsairdvādaśabhirvatsaro bhavet ||6.194.20||
brahmā teṣāṃ śataṃ yāvatsa jīvati pitāmahaḥ ||
sāṃprataṃ cāṣṭavarṣīyaḥ ṣaṇmāsaścaiva saṃsthitaḥ ||21||

anye'pi ye pragacchaṃti brahmajñānasamanvitāḥ ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
anādinidhanaḥ kālaḥ saṃkhyayā parivarjitaḥ ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
śūdrī ca brāhmaṇī cāpi ye tvayā parikīrtite ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tīrthadvayamanuttamam || 1 ||
tatkathaṃ tatra saṃjātaṃ kena vā tadvinirmitam ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
purāsīnnāgaro vipraśchāṃdogya iti viśrutaḥ ||
yasyā'nvaye'pi viprendrāśchāndogyā iti viśrutāḥ || 4 ||
sāmavedavidastasya gṛhasthāśramadharmiṇaḥ ||

saptaraktā trigaṃbhīrā pañcasūkṣmā'bṛhatkaṭiḥ || 6 ||
padmapatraviśālākṣī laṃbakeśī suśobhanā ||
biṃboṣṭhī hrasvalomā ca pūrṇacandrasamaprabhā || || 7 ||
tasyā nāma pitā cakre brāhmaṇīti dvijottamāḥ ||
yasmātsā brāhmaṇairdattā maṇḍapānte supūjitaiḥ || 8 ||
paścime vayasi prāpte apatyarahitasya ca ||
vavṛdhe sā ca tanvaṅgī candralekhā yathā tathā || 9 ||
śuklapakṣe tu saṃprāpte janalocanatuṣṭidā ||

ānartādhipatestasmiṃstādṛgrūpā sutā'bhavat || 6.195.10 ||

ruroda kaṇṭhamāśliṣya snehavyākulitendriyā || 17 ||
atha tadruditaṃ śrutvā mātā tasyā mṛgāvatī ||
sasaṃbhramā samāgatya vākyametaduvāca ha || 18 ||
kimarthaṃ rudyate putri kena te vipriyaṃ kṛtam ||
karomi nigrahaṃ yena tasyādyaiva durātmanaḥ || 19 ||
|| ratnavatyuvāca || ||
śṛṇu me supriyātīva brāhmaṇī prāṇasaṃmatā ||

anayā rahitāhaṃ ca na jīvāmi kathaṃcana ||
etasmātkāraṇāddevi prarodimi suduḥkhitā || 21 ||
|| mṛgāvatyuvāca || ||
yadyevaṃ putri yatra tvaṃ prayāsyasi patergṛhe ||
tasya rājñastu yo vipraḥ paurohitye vyavasthitaḥ || 22 ||

iyaṃ tava sutā brahmansutāyā mama supriyā ||

|| chāṃdogya uvāca || ||

|| brāhmaṇyuvāca || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye chāndogyabrāhmaṇakanyāvṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 195 || || cha ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
atha tāṃ yauvanopetāṃ svasutāṃ prekṣya pārthivaḥ ||
anaupamyena rūpeṇa saṃyuktāṃ varavarṇinīm ||
ānartaścintayāmāsa kanyakāṃ pradadāmyaham || 1 ||
anarhāya ca yo dadyā dvarāya nijakanyakām ||
kāryakāraṇalobhena narakaṃ sa pragacchati || 2 ||
evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya mahānkālo vyavasthitaḥ ||
na paśyati ca tadyogyaṃ kaṃcidvaramanuttamam || 3 ||
atha saṃpreṣayāmāsa sarvabhūtāśrayeṣu ye ||
citrakarmaṇi vikhyātānnarāṃścitrakarāṃstadā || 4 ||
gacchadhvaṃ mama vākyena sarvā nbhūmitale nṛpān ||
likhitvā paṭṭamadhye tu darśayadhvaṃ tataḥ param || 5 ||
sutāyā mama yenā'sau dṛṣṭvā'bhīṣṭaṃ narādhipam ||
patyarthaṃ varayetsādhvī mama doṣo bhavenna hi || 6 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve citrakarāstadā ||
prasthitā dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe pārthivānāṃ gṛheṣu ca || 7 ||

rūpaudāryaguṇopetāndarśayāmāsuragrataḥ ||
ratnavatyāḥ krameṇaiva tasya bhūpasya śāsanāt || 8 ||
atha teṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ madhye rājā vṛhadbalaḥ ||
daśārṇādhipatirbhavyaḥ patyarthaṃ ca vṛtastayā || 9 ||
tadā''nartādhipo hṛṣṭaḥ preṣayāmāsa taṃ prati ||
vivāhārthaṃ suvijñāya vākya metaduvāca ha || 6.196.10 ||
gacchadhvaṃ mama vākyena daśārṇādhipatiṃ prati ||
vācyaḥ sa vinayādgatvā vivāhārthaṃ mamāṃtikam || 11 ||
samāgaccha nijāṃ kanyāṃ yena yacchāmyahaṃ tava ||
nāmnā ratnavatīṃ khyātāṃ trailokyasyāpi sundarīm || 12 ||
gatvā sa satvaraṃ tatra yatra rājā bṛhadbalaḥ ||
provāca sakalaṃ vākyamānartādhipateḥ sphuṭam || 13 ||
so'pi tatsahasā śrutvā teṣāṃ vākyamanuttamam ||
paramāṃ tuṣṭimāsādya prasthitastatpuraṃ prati ||
sainyena mahatā yuktaścaturaṃgeṇa pārthivaḥ || 14 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye daśārṇādhipaterbṛhadbalasyānarteśapuraṃ pratyāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṇṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 196 || || cha ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
etasminneva kāle tu nāgaro dvijasattamāḥ ||

namaskṛtya kṣamasveti tvaṃ mātaḥ putravatsale || 117 ||
taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryamānarto vismayānvitaḥ ||
śaśaṃsa bhatṛyajñaṃ taṃ prāyaścittapradāyakam || 118 ||
aho'tīva subhā gyo'haṃ yasya me gṛhamāgatāḥ ||
īdṛśā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve camatkārapurodbhavāḥ || 119 ||
tathā caitādṛśī kanyā hyasāmānyapravartinī ||
ratnāvatī mahābhāgā satyaśaucasamanvitā || 6.197.120 ||
tathā'yaṃ naiva sāmānyo brāhmaṇaśca parāvasuḥ ||
yaścedṛśīṃ samāsādya kanyāṃ no vikṛtaḥ sthitaḥ || || 121 ||
evamuktvā visṛjyātha tānviprānpārthivottamāḥ ||
tāṃ ca kanyāṃ samādāya tataścāṃtaḥpuraṃ yayau || 122 ||
atha te nāgarāḥ sarve maryādāṃ cakrire tataḥ ||
adyaprabhṛti yā veśyā sthāne'sminvāsameṣyati || 123 ||
tayā naiva gṛhe dhāryaṃ surāmāṃsaṃ kathaṃcana ||
dūṣayaṃti sadā duṣṭā nāgarāṇāṃ sutāniha || 124 ||
atha vyavasthāmutkramya yā hi taddhārayiṣyati ||
sā daṇḍyāsmācca nirvāsyā pretya syātpāpabhāginī || 125 ||
audumbaryā madhyagena dattaṃ tālatrayaṃ tadā || 126 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye parāvasuprāyaścittavidhānavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma saptanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 197 || || cha || || ||

<6.198>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
etasminneva kāle tu daśārṇādhipatistadā ||
ratnavatyā vivāhārthaṃ tatra sthāne samāgataḥ || 1 ||
sa śrutvā tatra vṛttāṃtaṃ ratnavatyāḥ samudbhavam ||
viraktiṃ paramāṃ kṛtvā prasthitaḥ svapuraṃ prati || 2 ||
taṃ śrutvā prasthitaṃ bhūpamānartaḥ svapuraṃ prati ||
pṛṣṭhato'nuyayau tasya vyāgho ṭanakṛte tadā ||4 3 ||
athābravīcca taṃ prāpya kasmāttvaṃ prasthito nṛpa ||
pāṇigrahamakṛtvā tu mama kanyāsamudbhavam || 4 ||
|| daśārṇa uvāca || ||
dūṣiteyaṃ tava sutā kanyakātvavivarjitā ||
yasyāḥ pīto'dharo'nyena marditau ca tathā stanau || 5 ||
punarbhūriti saṃjñā sā sañjātā duhitā tava ||
punarbhūrjanayetputraṃ yaṃ kadācitkathaṃcana || 6 ||
sa pātayatyasaṃdigdhaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśāparān ||
ekaviṃśatimaṃ caiva tathaivātmānameva ca || 7 ||
na variṣyāmyahaṃ tena sutāṃ te'haṃ narasipa ||
nirdākṣiṇyamiti procya daśārṇādhipatistadā || 8 ||
chaṃdyamāno'pi vividhairhastyaśvarathapūrvakaiḥ ||
avajñāya mahīpālaṃ prasthitaḥ svapuraṃ prati || 9 ||
athānartto gṛhaṃ prāpya mṛgāvatyāḥ samākulaḥ ||
tadvṛttaṃ kathayāmāsa yaduktaṃ tena bhūbhujā ||
svabhāryāyāḥ sutāyāśca mantriṇāṃ duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ || 6.198.10 ||
te procuḥ saṃti bhūpālāḥ saṃkhyāhīnā mahītale ||
rūpāḍhyā yauvanopetā hastyaśvarathasaṃyutāḥ || 11 ||
teṣāmekatamasya tvaṃ dehi kanyāṃ nijāṃ vibho ||
mā viṣāde manaḥ kṛtvā duḥkhasya vaśago bhava || 12 ||
ānarto'pi ca tacchrutvā teṣāṃ vākyaṃ suduḥkhitam ||
tataḥ prāha prahṛṣṭātmā tānsarvānmantripūrvakān|| 13 ||
tāṃ ca kanyāṃ sthitāṃ tatra sāmnā paramavalgunā ||
putri dṛṣṭā mahīpālāḥ sarve citragatāstvayā || || 14 ||
teṣāṃ madhyānnṛpaṃ cānyaṃ kañcidvaraya śobhane ||
yaste cittasya santoṣaṃ kurute dṛkpathaṃ gataḥ || 15 ||
|| ratnāvatyuvāca || ||
na cāhaṃ varayiṣyāmi patimanyaṃ kathaṃcana ||
daśārṇādhipatiṃ muktvā śrūyatāmatra kāraṇam || 16 ||
sakṛjjalpaṃti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpaṃti ca dvijāḥ ||
sakṛtkanyāḥ pradīyaṃte trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt || 17 ||
evaṃ jñātvā na māṃ tāta tvamanyasminmahīpatau ||
dātumarhasi dharmo'yaṃ na bhavecchāśvato yataḥ ||18|| ||
|| ānarta uvāca || ||
vāṅmātreṇa pradattā tvaṃ daśārṇādhipatermayā ||
na te hastagrahaṃ prāpto viprāgnigurusannidhau || 19 ||
tatkathaṃ sa patirjātastavaḥ putri vadasva me || 6.198.20 ||
|| ratnāvatyuvāca || ||
manasā ciṃtyate kāryaṃ sakṛttātapurā yataḥ ||
vācayā procyate paścāt karmaṇā kriyate tataḥ || 21 ||
tanmayā manasā dattastasyātmā'yaṃ purā kila ||
tvayā ca vācayā cāsmai pradattāsmi tathā vibho ||
tatkathaṃ na patirme syādbrūhi vā yadi manyase||22||
sāhaṃ tapaścariṣyāmi kaumāravratadhāriṇī ||
nānyaṃ patiṃ kariṣyāmi niścayo'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ || 23 ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ raudraṃ mātā tasyā mṛgāvatī ||
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā vākyametaduvāca ha || 24 ||
mā putri sāhasaṃ kārṣīstapo'rthaṃ tvaṃ kathañcana ||
bālā tvaṃ sukumārāṃgī sadaiva sukhabhāginī ||25||
kathaṃ tapaḥ samarthāsi vidhātuṃ tvamaniṃdite ||
kandamūlaphalāhārā cīravalkaladhāriṇī ||26 ||
tasmānmukhyasya bhūpasya kasyacitvāṃ dadāmyaham|| || 27 ||
eṣā te brāhmaṇīnāma sakhī paramasaṃmatā ||
pratīkṣate vivāhaṃ te kaumāraṃ bhāvamāśritā || 28 ||
yasya bhūpasya tvaṃ harmye prayāsyasi vivāhitā ||
purodhāstasya yo rājño bhāryeyaṃ tasya bhāvinī || 29 ||
|| ratnāvatyuvāca || ||
na ca bhūyastvayā vācyaṃ vākyamevaṃvidhaṃ kvacit ||
madarthe yadi me prāṇāstvaṃ vāṃchasi sutaiṣiṇī || 6.198.30 ||
athavā tvaṃ haṭhārthaṃ ca tapovighnaṃ kariṣyasi || 31 ||
tatastyakṣyāmyahaṃ dehaṃ bhakṣayitvā mahadviṣam||
khaṃḍayiṣyāmyahaṃ jihvāṃ pravekṣyāmi ca vā jalam||32||
evaṃ sā niścayaṃ kṛtvā procya tāṃ jananīṃ tadā||33||
tataḥ provāca tāṃ kanyāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ saṃmatāṃ sakhīm||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭā bhūtvā samāliṃgya ca sādaram||34||
gaccha tvaṃ svapiturharmyaṃ preṣitāsi mayā śubhe||
yena te yacchati pitā nāgarāya mahātmane || 35 ||
kṣamasva yanmayā proktā kadācitparuṣaṃ vacaḥ ||
tvayāpi yanmama proktaṃ kṣāṃtaṃ caitanmayā dhruvam || 36 || ||
|| brāhmaṇyuvāca || ||
aṣṭavarṣā bhavedgaurī navavarṣā tu rohiṇī ||
daśavarṣā bhavetkanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā || 37 ||
kaumāryaṃ ca praṇaṣṭaṃ me tvatsaṃparkādvarānane ||
jātaṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ varṣaṃ strīdharmeṇa samanvitam || 38 ||
na me pāṇigrahaṃ kaścinnāgaro'tra kariṣyati ||
budhyamānastu smṛtyarthaṃ vakṣya māṇaṃ varānane || 39 ||
rajasvalāṃ ca yaḥ kanyāmudvāhayati nirghṛṇaḥ ||
tasyāḥ santānamāsādya pātayetpuruṣāndaśa || 6.198.40 ||
rajasvalā tu yaḥ kanyāṃ pitā yacchati nirghṛṇaḥ ||
sa pātayedasaṃdigdhaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśāparān || 41 ||
tasmādahaṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā sārdhaṃ tapaḥ śubhe ||
pitrā naiva hi me kāryaṃ na ca mātrā kathaṃcana || 42 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ te niścayaṃ kṛtvā kanyake dve dvijotamāḥ ||
gate yatra sthitaḥ sākṣādbhartṛyajño mahāmuniḥ || 43 ||
sthito vāstupade ramye sarvatīrthamaye śubhe ||
tasya tapaḥprabhāvena jātu kopo na dṛśyate || 44 ||
kasyacitkvāpi martyasya tiryagyoniga tasya ca ||
krīḍaṃti nakulāḥ sarpairmārjārāḥ saha mūṣakaiḥ || 46 ||
sāraṃgā dvīpibhiḥ sārdhaṃ kākāśca saha kauśikaiḥ ||
bhartṛyajñaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ tatra gatvā tu te śubhe ||
procaturvinayopete kṛtāṃjalipuṭe sthite || 46 ||
|| brāhmaṇyuvāca || ||
ahaṃ sakhyā samaṃ yātā hyanayā rājakanyayā ||
tapo'rthe tava pādāṃte tadbrūhi tapaso vidhim || 47 ||
vadasva yena tatkṛtsnaṃ prakaromi mahāmate || 48 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi tapaścaryāvidhiṃ pṛthak ||
yena saṃprāpyate mokṣaḥ ki punastridaśālayaḥ || 49 ||
cāṃdrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā sāṃtapanāni ca ||
ṣaṣṭhe kāle tathā bhojyaṃ dināṃtaritameva ca || 6.198.50 ||
brahmakūrcaṃ trirātraṃ ca ekabhaktamayācitam ||
tapodvārāṇi sarvāṇi kṛtānyetāni vedhasā || 51 ||
svaśaktyā caiva kāryāṇi rāgadveṣavivarjitaiḥ ||
vāṃchitavyaṃ phalaṃ caiva sarveṣāmeva putrike ||
tataḥ siddhimavāpnoti yā sadā manasi sthitā || 52 ||
samatvaṃ śatrumitrābhyāṃ tathā pā ṣāṇaratnayoḥ ||
yadā saṃjāyate citte tadā mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 53 ||
yo liṃgagrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kopaparo bhavet ||
tasya vṛthā hi tatsarvaṃ yathā bhasmahutaṃ tathā || 54 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
sā tathetipratijñāya brāhmaṇī sahitā tayā ||
ratnāvatyā jagāmātha kiṃciccaiva jalāśayam || 55 ||
svacchodakena saṃpūrṇaṃ padminīṣaṃḍamaṃḍitam ||
tataścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ cakre tapasaḥ prathamaṃ vratam || 56 ||
tataḥ kṛcchravrataṃ cakre tataḥ sāṃtapanaṃ ca sā ||
ṣaṣṭhānnakālabhojyā ca sā cābhūdvatsaratrayam || 57 ||
trirātropoṣaṇaṃ paścādyāvadvarṣatrayaṃ tathā ||
ekāntaropavāsaiśca sā'nayadvatsaratrayam || 58 ||
hemaṃte jalamadhyasthā sā babhūva tapasvinī ||
paṃcāgnisādhakā grīṣme sā babhūva yaśasvinī || 59 ||
nirāśrayā'bhavatsādhvī varṣākāla upasthite ||
dhyāyamānā divānaktaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam||6.198.60||
yadyadvrataṃ purā cakre brāhmaṇī sā ca suvratā ||
anyaṃ jalāśayaṃ prāpya sā taccakre nṛpātmajā ||
prītyā paramayā yuktā tadā sā dvijasa ttamāḥ || 61 ||
tato varṣaśataṃ sārdhaṃ phalāhārā babhūva sā ||
śīrṇaparṇāśanā paścāttāvanmātraṃ vyavasthitā || 62 ||
tataścaiva jalāhārā yāvadvarṣaśatāni ṣaṭ ||
vāyubhakṣā babhūvātha sahasraṃ parivatsarān || 63 ||
yathāyathā tapaścakre sā kumārī dvijottamāḥ ||
tathātathā'bhavattasyāstejovṛddhiranuttamā||64||
etasminneva kāle tu bhagavāñchaśiśekharaḥ || 65 ||
gauryā saha prasannātmā tasyā gocaramāgataḥ ||
meghagaṃbhīrayā vācā tatovacanamabravīt || 66 ||
vatse taponivṛttiṃ tvaṃ kuruṣva vacanānmama ||
prārthayasva mano'bhīṣṭaṃ yena sarvaṃ dadāmi te || 67 ||
|| brāhmaṇyuvāca || ||
abhīṣṭametadevaṃ me yattvaṃ dṛṣṭo'si śaṃkara ||
svapne'pi darśanaṃ deva durlabhaṃ te nṛṇāṃ yataḥ || 68 ||
|| bhagavānuvāca || ||
na me syāddarśanaṃ vyarthaṃ kathaṃcitsutapasvini ||
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te varaṃ yena dadāmyaham || 69 ||
|| brāhmaṇyuvāca || ||
eṣā me susakhī sādhvī rājaputrī yaśasvinī ||
khyātā ratnāvatīnāma prāṇebhyo'pigarīyasī || 6.198.70 ||
mama tulyaṃ tapaścakre śūdrayonāvapi sthitā ||
nivartate tu yadyeṣā tapasastu nivartanam ||
karomyadya jagannātha tadahaṃ saṃśayaṃ vinā || 71 ||
asyāḥ snehena saṃtyakto mayā bhartā sureśvara ||
tasmāddeva varaṃ dehi tvamasyā manasi sthitam || 72 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavāñchaśiśekharaḥ ||
abravīdrājaputrīṃ tāṃ meghagaṃbhīrayā girā ||
vatse madvacanādadya tapastvaṃ tyaktumarhasi || 73 ||
varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi nityaṃ manasi saṃsthitam ||
adeyamapi dāsyāmi sāṃprataṃ tava bhāmini || 74 ||
|| ratnāvatyuvāca || ||
etajjalāśayaṃ puṇyaṃ padminīṣaṇḍa maṇḍitam || 75 ||
yatraiṣā brāhmaṇī sādhvī nityaṃ ca tapasi sthitā ||
asyā nāmnā ca vikhyātiṃ tīrthametatprapadyatām || 76 ||
atra yaḥ kurute snānaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ||
tasya bhūyātsadā vāso devadeva triviṣṭape || 77 ||
madīyaṃ mama nāmnā tu śūdrāsaṃjñaṃ tu jāyatām ||
tasya tulyaprabhāvaṃ tu tīrthasya pratipadyatām || 78 ||
āvābhyāṃ nityaśaḥ kāryaṃ kumāratve mahattapaḥ ||
ārādhyastvaṃ suraśreṣṭho vāṅmanaḥkarmabhistathā || 79 ||
etasminneva kāle tu nirbhidya dharaṇītalam ||
liṃgaṃ māheśvaraṃ viprā niṣkrāṃtaṃ sūryasaṃnibham || 6.198.80 ||
tataḥ provāca te devaḥ svayameva maheśvaraḥ ||
tābhyāṃ sutapasā tuṣṭaḥ sādaraṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ || 81 ||
etattīrthadvayaṃ khyātaṃ trailokyepi bhaviṣyati ||
śūdrīnāma tvadīyaṃ tu brāhmaṇī ca sakhī tava || 82 ||
tīrthadvaye'pi yaḥ snātvā etasmiñchraddhayā'nvitaḥ ||
tvattaḥ padmāni saṃgṛhya asyāstoyaṃ ca nirmalam ||
etacca māmakaṃ liṃgaṃ snāpayitvā'rcayiṣyati || 83 ||
paścātpadmaiścaturdaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ somavāsare ||
caitre māsi ca saṃprāpte cirāyuḥ sa bhaviṣyati || 84 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto yadyapi syātsupāpakṛt || 85 ||
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
tatra nityaṃ ca tapasi sthite sakhyāvubhāvapi || 86 ||
yāvatkalpaśataṃ tāvajjarāmaraṇavarjite ||
adyāpi gagane te ca dṛśyete tārakātmake || 87 ||
tataḥprabhṛti tatkhyātaṃ tīrthayugmaṃ dharātale ||
āgatyātha naro dūrāttābhyāṃ kṛtvā nimajjanam || 88 ||
pūjayitvā tu talliṃgaṃ tato yāti divālayam ||
mahāpātakayukto'pi tatprabhāvādasaṃśayam || 89 ||
etasminnaṃtare martye naṣṭā dharmasya ca kriyā ||
yajñadānakṛtā yā ca devārcanasamudbhavā || 6.198.90 ||
vyāptastathākhilaḥ svargo mānavaiḥ spardhayānvitaiḥ ||
sārdhaṃ devairvimānasthairapsarogaṇasevitaiḥ || 91 ||
etasminneva kāle tu dharmarājaḥ samāyayau ||
yatra vedadhvanirbrahmā brahmalokaṃ samāśritaḥ || || 92 ||
abravīdduḥkhito dīnaḥ kṣiptvāgre patrakadvayam ||
ekaṃ pāpasamudbhūtamanyaddharmasamudbhavam || 93 ||
citreṇa likhitaṃ yacca vicitreṇa tathā param ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre devatīrthayugaṃ sthitam || 94 ||
śūdrākhyaṃ brāhmaṇīnāma tathānyatpadmamaṃḍitam ||
tathā tatrāsti liṃgaṃ ca puṇyaṃ māheśvaraṃ mahat || 95 ||
trayāṇāmatha teṣāṃ ca prabhāvātsarvamānavāḥ ||
api pāpasamāyuktāḥ prayāṃti tridaśālayam || 96 ||
śūnyā me narakā jātāḥ sarve te rauravādayaḥ || 97 ||
na kaścidyajanaṃ cakre na dānaṃ na ca tarpaṇam ||
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 98 ||
tasmānmukto mayā sarvo yo'dhikārastavodbhavaḥ ||
niyojayasva tatrānyaṃ kañcicchaktatamaṃ tataḥ || 99 ||
apramāṇaṃ sthitaṃ sarvametatpatradvayaṃ mama ||
tacchrutvā padmajaḥ prāha samānīya śatakratum || 6.198.100 ||
gatvā śīghratamaṃ martye tvaṃ śakra vacanānmama ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tīrthadvayamanuttamam || 101 ||
śūdryākhyaṃ brāhmaṇītyeva yacca liṃgamanuttamam ||
tatrasthaṃ nāśaya kṣipraṃ kṛtvā pāṃsupravarṣaṇam || 102 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā satvaraṃ śakro gatvā bhūmitalaṃ tataḥ ||
pāṃsubhiḥ pūrayāmāsa te tīrthe liṃgameva ca || 103 ||
adyāpi kalikāle'smindvābhyāṃ gṛhya sumṛttikām ||
snātvā ca tilakaṃ kāryaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye || 104 ||
caturdaśīdine prāpte somavāre ca saṃsthite ||
dvābhyāṃ yaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ||
gayāśrāddhena kiṃ tasya manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt || 105 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ||
yathā sā brāhmaṇī jātā śūdrī cāpi tathāparā||106||
yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā paṭhedvā dvijasattamāḥ ||
so'pi taddinajātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 107 ||
evaṃ naro na kaḥ siddhastasya liṃgasya pūjanāt||
cirāyuśca tathā jāto yathānyo nātra vidyate||108||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śūdrībrāhmaṇītīrthadvayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatyuttaraśatatamamo'dhyāyaḥ||

<6.199>

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
tisraḥkoṭyordhakoṭī ca tīrthānāmiha bhūtale||
śrūyate sūta kārtsnyena kīrtyamānā munīśvaraiḥ||1||
kathaṃ labhyeta sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ snānajaṃ phalam||
alpāyurbhirmahābhāga kalikāla upasthite||2||
||sūta uvāca||
kṣetratrayamihākhyātaṃ tathāraṇyatrayaṃ mahat||
purītrayaṃ vanānyeva trīṇi grāmāstathātrayaḥ || 3 ||
tathā tīrthatrayaṃ cānyatparvatatritayānvitam ||
mahānadītrayaṃ caiva sarvapātakanāśanam || 4 ||
martyalokesthitaṃ viprāḥ sarvatīrthaphalapradam ||
sarveṣveteṣu yaḥ snāti sa sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ labhet || 5 ||
caturviṃśatisaṃkhyānāmidamāha prajāpatiḥ ||
ya ekasmiṃstrike snāti sarva trikaphalaṃ labhet || 6 ||
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
trīṇi kṣetrāṇi kānīha tathāraṇyāni kāni ca ||
puryastisro mahābhāga kāḥkhyātāśca vanāni ca || 7 ||
ke grāmāḥ kāni tīrthāni ke nagāḥ saritaśca kāḥ ||
