mātā me saha tenaiva praviṣṭā havyavāhanam ||
tato vairāgyamāpanno niṣkrāṃto'haṃ nijālayāt || 136 ||
tīrthāni bhramamāṇo'tra saṃprāptastu puraṃ tava ||
adhunā saṃprayāsyāmi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam || 137 ||
yatra someśvaro devastyaktvā kailāsamāgataḥ ||
na mayā paṭhitā vedā na ca śāstraṃ nṛpottama||
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tena bhikṣāṃ carāmyaham || 138 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā cintayāmāsa cetasi ||
brāhmaṇo'yaṃ sudeśīyastathā bhavyatamākṛtiḥ ||
yadi gṛhṇāti me kanyāṃ tadasmai pradadāmyaham || 139 ||
yāvadrajasvalā naiva jāyate sā nirūpitā ||
kṛtsnaṃ dūṣayati kṣipraṃ naiva vaṃśaṃ mamādhamā || 6.199.140 ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ mlecchaṃ saṃmaṃtrya saha bhāryayā ||
yadi gṛhṇāsi me kanyāṃ tava yacchāmyahaṃ dvija || 141 ||
bharaṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ dvābhyāṃ kariṣyāmi sadaiva hi ||142||
tacchrutvā harṣitaḥ prāha soṃ'tyajo nṛpasattamam ||
tavādeśaṃ kariṣyāmi yaccha me kanyakāṃ nṛpa || 143 ||
tathetyuktvā gatastena tasmai dattā nijā sutā ||
gṛhyoktena vidhānena vivāho vihitastataḥ || 144 ||
tato dadau dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhaṃ kṣetraṃ ca godhanam ||
tasmai tuṣṭisamāyukto manyamānaḥ kṛtārthatām || 145 ||
atha so'pi ca tāṃ prāpya vilāsānakarodbahūn ||
khādyaiḥ pānaiḥ suvastraiśca gandhamālyairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 146 ||
paraṃ sa vrajati prāyo yena mārgeṇa kenacit ||
sārameyāḥ saśabdāśca pṛṣṭhato'nuvrajaṃti vai || 147 ||
anyeṣāmaṃtyajātyānāṃ yadvattasya viśeṣataḥ ||
vedābhyāsaparaścaiva yadi saṃjāyate kvacit ||
raktaṃ patati vaktreṇa tatkṣaṇāttasya durmateḥ || 148 ||
etasminnaṃtare lokaḥ sarva eva praśaṃkitaḥ ||
abravīcca mitho'bhyetya caṃḍālo'yamasaṃśayam || 149 ||
yadete pṛṣṭhato yāṃti bhaṣamāṇāḥ śunīsutāḥ ||
subhadro'pi ca tatteṣāṃ śrutvā cintāparo'bhavat || 6.199.150 ||
manyamānaśca tatsatyaṃ duḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ ||
nūnamaṃtyajajātīyo bhaviṣyati sutāpatiḥ || 151 ||
jñāyate ceṣṭitaiḥ sarvairyathā'yaṃ jalpate janaḥ || 152 ||
evaṃ rātriṃdivaṃ tasya cintayānasya bhūpateḥ ||
lokāpavādayuktasya kiyānkālo'bhyavartata || 153 ||
anyasminnahani prāpte ādyādyā dvijasattamāḥ ||
madhyagena samāyuktā brahmasthānaṃ samāgatāḥ ||
tasya śuddhikṛte procuryena śaṃkā praṇaśyati || 154 ||
athocustaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā brahmasthānasya madhyagam ||
madhyagasya tu vaktreṇa vivarṇavadanaṃ sthitam || 155 ||
kulaṃ gotraṃ nijaṃ brūhi pravarāṃśca viśeṣataḥ ||
sthānaṃ deśaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ yena śuddhiḥ pradīyate || 156 ||
athāsau vepamānastu prasvinnavadanastathā ||
adhodṛṣṭiruvācedaṃ gadgadaṃ vihitāñjaliḥ || 157 ||
garbhāṣṭame pitā mahyaṃ varṣe mṛtyuṃ gatastataḥ ||
tataḥ sā taṃ samādāya jananī me pativratā ||
māṃ tyaktvā duḥkhitaṃ dīnaṃ praviṣṭā havyavāhanam || 158 ||
ahaṃ vairāgyamāpannastīrthayātrāṃ samāśritaḥ ||
bālabhāve piturduḥkhāttāpasairaparaiḥ saha || 159 ||
na mayā paṭhito vedo na ca śāstraṃ nirūpitam||
tīrthayātrāparo'haṃ ca samāyāto bhavatpuram || 6.199.160 ||
abhadreṇa subhadreṇa śvaśureṇa durātmanā ||
etajjānāmyahaṃ viprā gotraṃ vāsiṣṭhameva vā || 161 ||
athaikapravaro deśo gauḍo madhupuraṃ puram ||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ procuryasya no jñāyate kulam ||
tasya śuddhiḥ pradātavyā dhaṭadvāreṇa kevalā ||162||
sa tvaṃ dhaṭaṃ samāruhya brāhmaṇyārthaṃ ca kevalam ||
śuddhiṃ prāpya tato bhogānbhuṃkṣvātrastho'pi kevalam || 163 ||
so'bravītsāhasaṃ kṛtvā sarvāneva ddvijottamān ||
pratigṛhṇāmyahaṃ kāmaṃ taptamāṣakameva ca||164||
praviśāmi hutāśaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ viṣam||165||
kiṃ punardhaṭadivyaṃ ca kriyamāṇe sukhāvaham ||
brāhmaṇasya kṛte viprāścitte no māmake ghṛṇā || 166 ||
atha te brāhmaṇāstasya dhaṭārohaṇasaṃbhavam ||
śuddhiṃ nirdiśya vāraṃ ca sūryasya ca tataḥ param ||
jagmuḥ svaṃsvaṃ gṛhaṃ sarve so'pi viproṃ'tyajo dvijāḥ || 167 ||
tataḥ prāha nijāṃ bhāryāṃ rahasye nṛpasattama||
jñāto'haṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvairaṃtyajātisamudbhavaḥ ||
deśātaraṃ gamiṣyāmi tvamāgaccha mayā saha || 168 ||
|| bhāryovāca || ||
ahamagniṃ pravekṣyāmi na yāsyāmi tvayā saha ||
pāpabuddhe patiṣyāmi na cāhaṃ narakāgniṣu || 169 ||
budhyamānā na seviṣye tvāmaṃtyajasamudbhavam ||
pāpa saṃdūṣitaṃ sarvaṃ tvayaitatsthānamuttamam || 6.199.170 ||
tathā mama piturharmyaṃ saṃvatsaraprayājinaḥ ||
tasmāddrutataraṃ gaccha yāvanno vetti kaścana || 171 ||
no cetpāpasamācāra saṃprāpsyasi mahā''padam || 172 ||
tato niśāmukhe prāpte kaupīnāvaraṇānvitaḥ ||
naṣṭo'bhīṣṭāṃ diśaṃ prāpya tadā jīvitajādbhayāt || 173 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgarāṣṭakulaśraiṣṭhyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 199 || || cha ||

<6.200>

|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
tataḥ prabhāte saṃjāte prodgate ravimaṇḍale ||
sā cāpi duhitā tasya dīkṣitasya mahātmanaḥ || 1 ||
rorūyamāṇā'bhyagamatpitaraṃ mātaraṃ prati ||
provāca gadgadaṃ vākyaṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanā || 2 ||
tātāmba kimidaṃ pāpaṃ yuvābhyāṃ samanuṣṭhitam ||
antyajasya pradattā'haṃ yatpāpasya durātmanaḥ || 3 ||
sa naṣṭo rajanīvaktre mamāvedya nijaṃ kulam||
tasmādahaṃ pravekṣyāmi pradīpte havyavāhane || 4 ||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā dīkṣitaḥ sa subhadrakaḥ ||
niśceṣṭaḥ patito bhūmau vātabhagna iva drumaḥ || 5 ||
tataḥ sa śītatoyena saṃsiktaśca punaḥpunaḥ ||
labdhvāśu cetanāṃ kṛcchrātsvajanaiḥ parivāritaḥ ||
pralāpānvividhāṃścakre tāḍayansvaśiro muhuḥ || 6 ||
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve tasya saṃparkadūṣitāḥ ||
bhartṛyajñaṃ samāsādya tenaiva sahitāstataḥ || 7 ||
procurvinayasaṃyuktāḥ proccaistatsutayā saha ||
subhadreṇa nije harmye sutāṃ dattvā niveśitaḥ || 8 ||
caṇḍālo dvijarūpotra caṃdraprabha iti smṛtaḥ || 9 ||
yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ sārdhaṃ daive pitrye ca yojitaḥ ||
pāpakarmā na vijñātaḥ so'dhunā prakaṭo'bhavat || 6.200.10 ||
subhadrasyānuṣaṃgeṇa sthānaṃ sarvaṃ pradūṣitam ||
antyajena mahābhāga tatkuruṣva vinigraham|| 11 ||
kaiścittasya gṛhe bhuktaṃ jalaṃ pītaṃ tathā paraiḥ ||
anyaiśca gṛhamānīya pradattaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā || 12 ||
kiṃ vā te bahunoktena na sa ko'sti dvijottama ||
saṃkaro yasya no jātastasya pāpasya saṃbhavaḥ || 13 ||
tvayā sthānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ mahāmate ||
sarveṣāṃ ca gurustvaṃ hi tasmācchuddhiṃ vadasva naḥ || 14 ||
tataḥ saṃcintya suciraṃ smṛtiśāstrāṇyanekaśaḥ ||
prāyaścittaṃ dadau teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ sa dvijanmanām || 15 ||
cāṃdrāyaṇaśataṃ prādātsubhadrāyāhitāgnaye ||
sarvabhaṃḍaparityāgaṃ punarādhānameva ca || 16 ||
lakṣahomavidhānaṃ ca gṛhamadhyaviśuddhaye ||
vahnipraveśanaṃ tasyāstatsutāyāḥ prakīrtitam || 17 ||
yena yāvaṃti bhojyāni tasya bhuktāni maṃdire ||
tasya tāvaṃti kṛcchrāṇi tenoktāni mahātmanā || 18 ||
yairjalāni prapītāni yāvanmātrāṇi tadgṛhe ||
prājāpatyāni dattāni tebhyastāvaṃti pārthiva || 19 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ tatra sthāne nivāsinām ||
tatsparśadūṣitānāṃ ca prājāpatyaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 6.200.20 ||
strīśūdrāṇāṃ tadardhaṃ ca tadardha bālavṛddhayoḥ ||
mṛnmayānāṃ ca bhāṃḍānāṃ parityāgo niveditaḥ || 21 ||
sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ rasatyāgastathaiva ca ||
koṭihomastu nirdiṣṭo brahmasthāne yathoditaḥ ||
sarvasthānaviśuddhyarthaṃ sthānavittena kevalam || || 22 ||
athovāca punarviprānsa kṛtvā cocchritaṃ bhujama ||
tāranādena mahatā sarvāṃstānnāgarodbhavān || 23 ||
subhadreṇa ca sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ viprebhya eva ca ||
caturthāṃśaśca yairbhuktaṃ tadgṛhe svadhanasya ca || 24 ||
aṣṭāṃśaṃ yairjalaṃ pītaṃ godānaṃ sparśasaṃbhavam ||
śeṣāṇāmapi lokānāṃ yathāśaktyā tu dakṣiṇā || 25 ||
dīkṣitena japaḥ kāryo lakṣagāyatrisaṃbhavaḥ ||
śeṣairviprairyathā vittaṃ tathā kāryo japo'khilaḥ || 26 ||
ahaṃ caiva kariṣyāmi prāṇāyāmaśatatrayam ||
nityameva dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ ṣaṣṭhakālakṛtāśanaḥ || 27 ||
yāvatsaṃvatsarasyāṃtaṃ tataḥ śuddhirbhaviṣyati ||
jana saṃparkasaṃjātā saivaṃ tasya durātmanaḥ || 28 ||
evamuktvā tato bhūyaḥ sa provāca dvijottamān ||
athā''dyānmadhyagāsyena brahmasthānasamāśrayān || || 29 ||
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ kanyāmaviditvā tu nāgaram ||
nāgaro dāsyati kvāpi patitaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ||6.200. 30 ||
aśrāddheyo hyapāṃkteyo nāgarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 31 ||
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ nāgaraṃ muktvā hyanyasmai saṃpradāsyati ||
vimukhāstasya yāsyaṃti pitaro vibudhaiḥ saha || 32 ||
nāgareṇa vinā yastu somapānaṃ kariṣyati ||
sa kariṣyatyasaṃdigdhaṃ madyapānaṃ tu nāgaraḥ ||
tanmatena vinā yastu śrāddhakarma kariṣyati 33 ||
tataḥ sarvaṃ vṛthā tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
viśuddhirahitaṃ yastu nāgaraṃ bhojayiṣyati || 34 ||
śrāddhe tasyāpi tatsarvaṃ vyarthatāṃ saṃprayāsyati ||
sarveṣāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ ca maryādeyaṃ kṛtā mayā || 35 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śuddhiḥ kāryā dvijottamaiḥ ||
varṣevarṣe tu saṃprāpte svasthānasya viśuddhaye || 36 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi nṛpottama ||
śrāddhārhā nāgarā yena nāgarāṇāṃ vyavasthitāḥ ||
bhartṛyajñena maryādā kṛtā teṣāṃ yathā purā || 37 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bhartṛyajñakṛtanāgarajñātimaryādāvarṇanaṃ nāma dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 200 || || cha ||

<6.201>

|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhartṛyajñaṃ mahāmatim ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭā bhūtvā stutiṃ kṛtvā vaco'bruvan || 1 ||
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ śodhito yo bhaveddvijaḥ ||
śrāddhasya kanyakāyāśca somapānasya so'rhati || 2 ||
kathaṃ śuddhiḥ prakartavyā tasya sarvaṃ bravīhi naḥ ||
nāgarasya samastasya deśāṃtaragatasya ca ||3||
deśāṃtaraprajātasya tatra jātasya vā punaḥ ||
ajñātapitṛvargasya sāmā nyaṃ padamicchataḥ || 4 ||
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate || 5 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brāhmaṇānāṃ nṛpottama ||
abravīdbhartṛyajñastu svābhiprāyaṃ susaṃmatam || 6 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
praśnabhāro mahāneṣa bhavadbhiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ||
tathāpi kathayiṣyāmi namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuvam|| 7||
ajñātapitṛvaṃśo yo dūrādapi samāgataḥ ||
sāmānyaṃ vāṃchate padyaṃ nāgaro'smīti kīrtayan || 8 ||
tasya śuddhiḥ pradā tavyā mukhyaiḥ śāṃtaiḥ śubhairdvijaiḥ ||
gartātīrthodbhavaṃ vipraṃ kṛtvā caiva puraḥsaram ||9 ||
viśuddhiṃ yācamānasya yadi yacchaṃti no dvijāḥ ||
kāmādvā yadi vā krodhātpradveṣādvā cyuterbhayāt || 6.201.10 ||
brahmahatyodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ sarveṣāṃ tatra jāyate ||
tasmādabhyāgato yastu dūrādapi viśeṣataḥ || 11 ||
tasya śuddhiḥ pradātavyā prayatnena dvijottamaiḥ ||
śuddhiṃ tu trividhāṃ prāpto mama vākyasamudbhavām || 12 ||
sa śuddho nāgaro jñeyo jāto deśāṃtareṣvapi ||
pūrvaṃ viśodhayedvaṃśaṃ tato mātṛkulaṃ smṛtam || 13 ||
tataḥ śīlaṃ tribhiḥ śuddhaḥ sāmānyaṃ padamarhati || 14 ||
sarveṣāmapi viprāṇāṃ varṣāṃte samupasthite ||
śuddhiḥ kāryā prayatnena svasthānasya viśuddhaye || 15 ||
tadarthaṃ śaradaścāṃte śubharttau brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||
cātuścaraṇasaṃpannāḥ saṃsthāpyāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu || 16 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ purataḥ sarve śāṃtā dāṃtā jiteṃdriyāḥ ||
garttātīrthodbhavaṃ vipraṃ teṣāṃ madhye niveśayet || 17 ||
tadagre pīṭhikā deyāścatasro lakṣaṇānvitāḥ ||
yāvatkārttikaparyaṃtaṃ cātuścaraṇakalpitāḥ || 18 ||
prathamā bahvṛcasyārthe yājuṣasya tathā'parā ||
sāmagasya tathaivānyā tathā''dyasya caturthikā || || 19 ||
mudrikārthaṃ tathaivānyā paṃcamī parikīrtitā ||
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānaṃ ca śākunaṃ viṣṇudaivatam|| 6.201.20 ||
pārāvataṃ tathā sūktaṃ jīvasūktena saṃyutam||
bahvṛcaḥ kīrtayettatra śāṃtikaṃ ca tathāparam || 21 ||
śāṃtikaṃ śivasaṃkalpamṛṣikalpaṃ caturvidham ||
maṃḍalaṃbrāhmaṇaṃ caiva gāyatrībrāhmaṇaṃ tathā || 22 ||
tathā puruṣasūktaṃ ca madhubrāhmaṇameva ca ||
adhvaryuḥ kīrtayettatra rudrānpaṃcāṃgasaṃyutān || 23 ||
devavrataṃ ca gāyatraṃ somasūryavrate tathā ||
ekaviṃśatiparyaṃtaṃ tathānyacca rathaṃtaram || 24 ||
sauvrataṃ saṃhitā viṣṇorjyeṣṭhasāma tathaiva ca ||
sāmavedoktarudrāṃśca bhāruṃḍaiḥ sāmabhiryutān || 25 ||
chaṃdogaḥ kīrtayettatra yaccānyacchāṃtikaṃ bhavet ||
garbhopaniṣadaṃ caiva skaṃdasūktaṃ tathāparam || 26 ||
nīlarudraiḥ samopetānprāṇarudrāṃstathāparān ||
navarudrāṃśca kṣurikānādyastatra prakīrtayet || 27 ||
tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa gītavāditranisvanaiḥ ||
śuklamālyāṃbaradharaḥ śuklacaṃdanacarcitaḥ 28 ||
śuddhikāmo vrajettatra yatra te brāhmaṇāḥ sthitāḥ ||
praṇamya śirasā teṣāṃ tatovācyastu madhyagaḥ || 29 ||
madarthaṃ prārthaya tvaṃ hi sarvānetāndvijottamān ||
yataḥ śuddhiṃ prayacchaṃti prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 6.201.30 ||
tatastu prārthayedviprāṃstadarthaṃ ca viśuddhaye ||
gartātīrthodbhavo vipro vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ || 31 ||
gocarmaṇi samālagnaḥ śuddhikāmasya tasya ca ||
praṣṭavyāstu tatastena sarva eva dvijottamāḥ || 32 ||
eṣa śuddhikṛte prāptaḥ sudūrānnāgaro dvijaḥ ||
asya śuddhiḥ pradātavyā yuṣmākaṃ rocate yadi || 33 ||
atha tairvedasūktena niṣedho vā pravartanam ||
vaktavyaṃ vacasā naiva mama vākyamidaṃ sthitam|| 34 ||
tataśca bahulāndṛṣṭvā ṛgadhvaryūṃstataḥ param ||
chādogyāṃśca tathādyāṃśca krameṇa tu dvijottamāḥ || 35 ||
yadi teṣāṃ manastuṣṭirjāyate dvijasattamāḥ ||
tataḥ sūktāni vākyāni saumyāni suśubhāni ca ||
vāruṇāni tathaiṃdrāṇi māṃgalyaprabhavāṇi ca || 36 ||
śreṣṭhāni maṃtraliṃgāni vṛddhituṣṭikarāṇi ca ||
yadi no mānasī tuṣṭi steṣāṃ caiva prajāyate || 37 ||
tadā raudrāṇi yāmyāni nairṛtyāni viśeṣataḥ ||
āgneyāni tvaniṣṭāni tathā nāśakarāṇi ca || 38 ||
atha ye tatra mūrkhāḥ syurna vedapaṭhane ratāḥ ||
puṣpadānaṃ tu vaktavyaṃ taiḥ saṃtuṣṭairdvijottamaiḥ || 39 ||
sītkāraḥ kupitaiḥ kāryaḥ saṃtoṣeṇa vivarjitaiḥ ||
evaṃ sarveṣu kṛtyeṣu na ca kāryo vinirṇayaḥ || 6.201.40 ||
prākṛtairvacanaiścaiva yathā kurvaṃti mānavāḥ ||
tathaiva nirṇayasyāṃte madhyagena vipaścitā || 41 ||
deyaṃ tālatrayaṃ samyaksarveṣāṃ nirṇayodbhave || 42 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgara praśnanirṇayavarṇanaṃnāmaikottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 201 || || cha ||

<6.202>

|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vinayāvanatāḥ sthitāḥ ||
taṃ papracchurnaraśreṣṭha kautukāviṣṭacetasaḥ || 1 ||
kasyacinnirṇayo deyo madhyasthasya dvijottamaiḥ ||
vedavākyena saṃtyajya vākyaṃ manujasaṃbhavam || 2 ||
kasmāttālatrayaṃ deyaṃ madhyagena mahātmanā ||
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 3 ||
tacchrutvā bhartṛyajñastu tānuvāca dvijottamān ||
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi yadetatkāraṇaṃ sthitam || 4 ||
nāsatyaṃ jāyate vākyaṃ nāgarāṇāṃ kathaṃcana ||
brahmaśālāsthitānāṃ ca śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham || 5 ||
vedokteḥ savanaistasmāddarśayaṃti dvijottamāḥ ||
iṣṭaṃ vā yadi vāniṣṭaṃ pṛcchamānasya cā rthinaḥ || 6 ||
bhūyobhūyastataḥ kuryānmadhyasthaḥ sa dvijanmanām ||
praśnaṃ tasya nimittaṃ ca yāvattasya vinirṇayaḥ || 7 ||
brahmaśālopaviṣṭānāṃ yadi vākyaṃ vṛthā bhavet ||
māhātmyaṃ naśyate teṣāṃ tataḥ krodhaḥ prajāyate || 8 ||
krodhātsañjāyate droho drohātpāpasya saṃgamaḥ ||
etasmātkāraṇādviprā madhyasthaḥ pṛcchyate muhuḥ || 9 ||
samudāyaḥ samastānāṃ yathā caiva prajāyate ||
tadā tālatrayaṃ yacca madhyasthaḥ saṃprayacchati || 6.202.10 ||
tāsāṃ tu pūrvayā kāmaṃ haṃti pṛcchāpradāyinām ||
dvitīyayā tathā krodhaṃ haṃti lobhaṃ tṛtīyayā || 11 ||
etasmātkāraṇāddeyaṃ tena tālatrayaṃ dvijāḥ || 12 || ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
ātharvaṇaścaturthastu brāhmaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
sa kasmātprathamaḥ praśno nāgarāṇāṃ prakīrtitaḥ || 13 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
ātharvaḥ prathamaḥ praśno yasmātprokto mayā dvijāḥ ||
tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 14 ||
nerṣyā caivātra kartavyā svasthānasya vināśanī ||
nirūpitaṃ mayā samyaksthānasthasya viśuddhaye || 15 ||
ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñākhyā agniṣṭomādikā makhāḥ ||
pāratrikāḥ pravartaṃte naihikāścābhicārikāḥ || 16 ||
atharvavede taccoktaṃ sarvaṃ caivābhicārikam ||
hitāya sarvalokānāṃ brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā || 17 ||
atharvavedaḥ prathamaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ kāryasiddhaye ||
etasmātkāraṇādādyaḥ sa caturtho'pi saṃsthitaḥ || 18 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ||
pṛcchā saṃbaṃdhajaṃ sarvamekaṃ kāryaṃ sadaiva hi || 19 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bhartṛyajñavākyanirṇayavarṇanaṃnāma dvyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 202 || || dha ||

<6.203>

|| ānarta uvāca || ||
evaṃ śuddhyarthamāyāto nāgarāṇāṃ puraḥ sthitaḥ ||
nāgaraḥ śuddhimāproti yathā tanme vada dvijaḥ || 1 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || 1 ||
evaṃ madhyasthavacanātsamudāye sthire sati ||

evaṃ tasyānvayaṃ jñātvā gotrapravarasaṃyutam || 3||

pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ||
śodhanīyāḥ prayatnena trayaścaite'pi tasya ca||6||
tathā pitāmahīpakṣe traya ete dvijottamāḥ||
mātāmahastatastasya pitā tasyāpi yaḥ pitā||7||

pitāmahyāśca yā mātā sāpi śodhyā sabhartṛkā || 8 ||

mūlavaṃśādadhiṣṭhānaṃ nyagrodhasyeva sarvataḥ || 9 ||
tataḥ śuddhiḥ pradātavyā sindūrati lakena tu ||
cātuścaraṇamaṃtraiśca dattvāśīrvacanaṃ kramāt || 6.203.10 ||
tato vācyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha madhyasthena tadagrataḥ ||
dattvā tālatrayaṃ rājañchuddho'yaṃ nāgaro dvijaḥ ||
sāmānyapadayogyaśca saṃjātaḥ sāṃprataṃ dvijaḥ || 11 ||
tato'gniśaraṇaṃ gatvā saṃtarpya ca hutāśanam ||
pañcavaktreṇa maṃtreṇa dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ||
viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsvaśaktyā bhojanānvitām || 12 ||
sindūratilake jāte brahmāgre dvijavākyataḥ ||
pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tuṣṭirvaṃśo no'dya pratiṣṭhi taḥ || 13 ||
yasya no jāyate śuddhiḥ śākhābhirmūlavaṃśagā ||
nigrahastasya kartavyo dvijārho dvijasattamaiḥ || 14 ||
yathā nānyo hi jāyeta śuddhi stasya prakalpitā||
evaṃ saṃśodhito vipraḥ śrāddhārho jāyate tataḥ||15||
api cāṣṭakulotpannaḥ sāmānyaḥ kiṃ punarhi yaḥ||
aśuddhena tu vipreṇa yaḥ śrāddhā dyaṃ karoti hi ||
tasya bhasmahutaṃ yadvatsarvaṃ tajjāyate vṛthā ||16||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śodhyo'yaṃ nāgaro dvijaḥ ||
svasthānasya viśuddhyarthaṃ tathaiva svaku lasya ca || 17 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgaraviśuddhiprakāravarṇanaṃnāma tryuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 203 || || cha ||

<6.204>

|| ānarta uvāca || ||
proktā'smākaṃ tvayā vipra śuddhirnāgarasaṃbhavā ||

sāṃprataṃ śīlajāṃ brūhi naṣṭavaṃśaśca yo bhavet ||
pitāmahaṃ na jānāti na ca mātāmahīṃ nijām ||

|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
etadarthaṃ purā pṛṣṭo bhartṛyajñaśca nāgaraiḥ ||
naṣṭavaṃśakṛte rājanyathā pṛṣṭo'smi vai tva yā || 3 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
naṣṭavaṃśastu yo brūyānnāgaro'smīti saṃsadi ||

sāmānyapadayogyaśca samaste sthānakarmaṇi || 7 ||

|| ānarta uvāca || ||

vidyodbhavo'thavā vipra kiṃ vā dānasamudbhavaḥ || 6.204.10 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
te sarve guṇasaṃpannā yathānye nāgarāstathā ||

|| ānarta uvāca || ||

kimarthaṃ ca vadāsmākaṃ vistareṇa mahāmate || 13 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
hiraṇyākṣa iti khyātaḥ purā''sīddānavo ttamaḥ ||

|| viṣṇuruvāca || || dhārātīrthamṛtānāṃ ca sanmukhānāṃ mahāhave ||

|| indra uvāca || ||

|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||

|| indra uvāca || ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

|| indra uvāca || ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

ddhakarmaṇi saṃjāte vinā śastrahataṃ janam || 36 ||

|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||

|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||

vṛddhiḥ saṃpatsyate teṣāṃ no cedvighnaṃ bhaviṣyati || 152 ||
māghamāse site pakṣe trayo daśyāṃ dine sthite ||
tadgrāmasaṃsthitā lokā ye'trāgatya samāhitāḥ || 153 ||
bālamaṇḍanake snātvā liṃgametatsamāhitāḥ ||
pūjayiṣyaṃti sadbhaktyā te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim || 154 ||
grāmāṇāṃ mama liṃgasya ye kariṣyaṃti pīḍanam ||
kālāṃtare'pi saṃprāptāste yāsyaṃti ca saṃkṣayam || || 155 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni hyāsamudrasarāṃsi ca ||
bālamaṇḍanake tīrtha āgamiṣyaṃti taddine || 156 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
etaduktvā sahasrākṣastataścāṣṭakulāndvijān ||
agrataḥ kopasaṃyuktastatovacanamabravīt || 157 ||
etaiḥ saptakulairviprairyatkṛtaṃ vacanaṃ na me ||
kṛtaghnaistā ñchapiṣyāmi kṛtaghnatvānna saṃśayaḥ || 158 ||
yasmādidaṃpurā proktaṃ manunā satyavādinā ||
svāyaṃbhuvena proddiśya kṛtaghnaṃ sakalaṃ janam || 159 ||
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavate śaṭhe ||
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ || 6.206.160 ||
avadhyā brāhmaṇā gāvaḥ striyo bālāstapasvinaḥ ||
tenā'haṃ na vadhāmyetāñchidre'pi mahati sthite || 161 ||
tatastoyaṃ samādāya sadarbhaṃ nijapāṇinā ||
śaśāpa tāndvijaśreṣṭhānkṛtaghnānpākaśāsanaḥ || 162 ||
mama vākyādapi prāpya ete lakṣmīṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
nirdhanāḥ saṃbhaviṣyaṃti nītvā yaddvārato 'khilam || 163 ||
bhaktānāṃ ca pīratyāgameteṣāṃ vaṃśajā dvijāḥ ||
kariṣyaṃti na sandeho yathā mama suniṣṭhurāḥ ||
dākṣiṇyarahitāḥ sarve tathā bahvāśinaḥ sadā || 164 ||
evamuktvā'tha tānviprānsaptavaṃśasamudbhavān ||
punaḥ provāca tānviprāñcheṣānnagarasaṃbhavān || 165 ||
mamātra dīyatāṃ sthānaṃ sthāne'traiva dvijottamāḥ ||
yena saṃvatsarasyāṃte paṃcarātraṃ vasāmyaham || 166 ||
devasyāsya prapūjārthaṃ martyalokasu khāya ca ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ prapūjārthaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhavatāmiha || 167 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve tadarthaṃ sthānamuttamam ||
darśayāmāsuḥ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ procuśca tadanaṃtaram || 168 ||
brahmasthāne tvayā śakra paṃcarātramupetya ca ||
sthātavyaṃ martyalokasya sukhamāsevyatāṃ prabho || || 169 ||
atra sthāne tavā'gre tu kariṣyāmo mahotsavam ||
gītavāditranirghoṣairgaṃdhamālyānulepanaiḥ ||
dvijānāṃ tarpaṇaiścaiva sarvakāmasamṛddhidam || || 6.206.170 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ||
pūjayitvā dvijānsarvāngato'tha tridivālayam || 171 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍa hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bālamaṇḍanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 206 || || cha ||

|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi narādhipa ||
bālamaṃḍanamāhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 ||

|| ānarta uvāca || ||
kasmācchakrasya saṃsthānaṃ paṃcarātraṃ dharātale ||
nādhikaṃ jāyate teṣāṃ yathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām || 3 ||
varṣāṃte kāni cāhāni yeṣu śakro dharātale ||
samāgacchati ko māsa etatsarvaṃ bravīhi me || 4 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi kathā menāṃ dharādhipa ||

atha tasya samācakhyau nārado munisattamaḥ ||

dadau śāpaṃ mahārāja kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ || 14 ||
yasmācchakra pāpakarma kṛtamīdṛgvigarhitam ||
bhāryā me dūṣitā sādhvī tasmādavṛṣaṇo bhava ||15||
sahasraṃ ca bhagānāṃ te vaktre bhavatu mā ciram ||
yena tvaṃ viplavaṃ yāsi trailokye sacarācare ||16||
aparaṃ martyaloke'tra yadyāgacchasi vāsava ||
pūjākṛte tato mūrdhā śatadhā te bhaviṣyati || 17 ||
evaṃ śaptvā ca taṃ śakraṃ tato'hilyāmuvāca saḥ ||
kopasaṃraktanetrastu bhartsayitvā muhurmuhuḥ || 18 ||
yasmātpāpe tvayā karma kṛtametadvigarhitam||
tasmācchilāmayī bhūtvā tvaṃ tiṣṭha vasudhātale || 19 ||
tataḥ sā tatkṣaṇājjātā tasya bhāryā śilātmikā ||
indro'pi ca parityakto vṛṣaṇābhyāṃ tathā'bhavat || 6.207.20 ||
sahasrabhagacihnastu vaktradeśe babhūva ha || 21 ||
atha meroḥ samāsādya kaṃdaraṃ vijanaṃ hariḥ ||
savrīḍaḥ sevate nityaṃ na jagāma nijāṃ purīm || 22 ||
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sodvegāstena varjitāḥ ||
no jānaṃti ca tatrasthaṃ kandarānveṣaṇe ratāḥ || 23 ||
pīḍyaṃte dānavai raudraiḥ svarge jāte virājake || 24 ||
etasminnantare jīvaḥ śakrāṇyā bhayabhītayā ||
sodvegayā paripṛṣṭaḥ kva gato'tha puraṃdaraḥ || 25 ||

provāca lajjayā yukto dīno bāṣpapariplutaḥ || 28 ||

prasādāttava sā nityaṃ yathā syāttadvidhīyatām || 54 ||

|| indra uvāca || ||

|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
evaṃ śakre divaṃ prāpte deveṣu sakaleṣu ca ||
gautamaḥ svāśramaṃ prāpatkopena mahatā jvalan || 1 ||
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ devaviceṣṭitam ||
varadānaṃ ca śakrāya śatā nandasya cāgrataḥ || 2 ||
tacchrutvā pitaraṃ prāha vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ ||
tātāṃbāyā na kasmāttvaṃ prasādaṃ prakaroṣi me || 3 ||
utthāpane na te kiñcidasādhyaṃ vidyate vibho ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yathā syānmama cāṃbayā || 4 ||
samāgamo muniśreṣṭha dīnasyotkaṇṭhitasya ca ||
tasmādutthāpya tāṃ tūrṇaṃ prāyaścittavidhiṃ tataḥ ||
tasmādādiśa me kṣipraṃ yena śuddhiḥ prajāyate || 5 ||
|| gautama uvāca || ||
madyāvaliptabhāṃḍasya yadi śuddhiḥ prajāyate ||
tatstrīṇāṃ jāyateśuddhiryonau śukrābhiṣecanāt || 6 ||
brāhmaṇastu surāṃ pītvā mauṃjīhomena śudhyati ||
tiṃginīṃ sādhayitvā ca na tu nārī vidharmitā || 7 ||
madyabhāṃḍamapi prāyo yathāvadvahniśodhitam||
viśudhyati tathā nārī vahnidagdhā viśudhyati ||
yasyā reto'tha saṃkrāṃta mudarāṃte'nyasaṃbhavam|| 8 ||
etasmātkāraṇānmātā mayā te putra sā śilā ||
vihitā na hi tasyāśca viśuddhistu kathañcana || 9 ||
|| śatānanda uvāca || ||
yadyevaṃ sādhayiṣyāmi tatkṛte'haṃ hutāśanam||
viṣaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmi patiṣyāmi jalāśaye || 6.208.10 ||
māturviyogatastāta satyametanmayoditam ||
dharmadroṇāḥ sthitāścānye manvādyā munayastathā || 11 ||

saṃciṃtya tāta sarvāṇi dehi śuddhiṃ mamāpi tām||
mama mātuḥ kariṣyāmi no cetprāṇaparikṣayam || 12 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca ||
tacchrutvā suciraṃ dhyātvā gautamaḥ prāha taṃ sutam||
pariṣvajya svabāhubhyāṃ mūrdhnyāghrāya tataḥ param ||13||
yadyevaṃ vatsa mā kārṣīḥ sāhasaṃ pāpasaṃbhavam||
ātmadehavighātena śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama || || 14 ||
medhyatve tava mātuśca śuddhirjñātā mayā purā ||
yayā sā mama harmyārhā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 15 ||
utpatsyate ravervaṃśe rāmarūpī janā rdanaḥ||
rāvaṇasya vadhārthāya mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ||
tasya pādasya saṃsparśādbhūyaḥ śuddhā bhaviṣyati|
tasmātpratīkṣya tāvattvamautsukyaṃ vraja putraka||
etatsamyaṅmayā jñātaṃ vatsa divyena cakṣuṣā||18||
etacchrutvā tathetyuktvā śatānandaḥ praharṣitaḥ||
sthitaḥ pratīkṣamāṇastu taṃ kālaṃ mātṛvatsalaḥ || 19 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā rāmarūpī janārdanaḥ ||
rāvaṇasya vadhārthāya jāto daśarathālaye || 6.208.20 ||
sa mayā bhagavā viṣṇurbālabhāvena saṃsthitaḥ ||
nijayajñasyarakṣārthaṃ samānītaḥ svamāśramam ||
rākṣasānāṃ vināśāya yajñakarmavināśinām || 21 ||
hataistai rākṣasai raudrairmama pūrṇo'bhavanmakhaḥ ||
ayodhyāyāḥ samānītaḥ sa mayā raghunaṃdanaḥ || 22 ||
sītāyāśca vivāhārthaṃ lakṣmaṇena samanvitaḥ ||
śrutvā svayaṃvaraṃ tasyāḥ pārthivānāṃ samāgamam || 23 ||
tato mārge mayā dṛṣṭā gautamasyāśrame śubhe ||
ahilyā sā śilā rūpā pramāṇena mahattamā || 24 ||
tataḥ prokto mayā rāmaḥ spṛśemāṃ vatsa pāṇinā ||
mānuṣatvaṃ labhedyena gautamasya priyā muneḥ ||
śāpadoṣeṇa saṃjātā śileyaṃ tasya sanmuneḥ || 25 ||
avikalpaṃ tato rāmo mama vākyena tāṃ śilām ||
pasparśa pārthivaśreṣṭha kautū halasamanvitaḥ || 26 ||
atha rāmeṇa saṃspṛṣṭā sahasaivāṃganā muneḥ ||
śuśubhe mānuṣī jātā divyarūpavapurdharā || 27 ||
tataḥ sā lajjayā''viṣṭā praṇipatya ca gautamam ||
smaramāṇā''tmanaḥ kṛtyaṃ yacchakreṇa samanvitam || 28 ||
prāyaścittaṃ mama svāmindehi sarvamaśeṣataḥ ||
yannarasya samāyoge parasyāha prajāpatiḥ || 29 ||
ahaṃ duṣkaramapyetatkariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||
yena śuddhirbhavenmahyaṃ puraścaraṇasevanāt || 6.208.30 ||
tataḥ saṃciṃtya suciraṃ provāca gautamastadā ||
kuru cāndrāyaṇaśataṃ kṛcchrāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam || 31 ||
prājāpatyāyutaṃ cāpi tīrthayātrāparāyaṇā ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu yāni tīrthāni bhūtale ||
teṣāṃ saṃdarśanātsamyaktataḥ śuddhimavāpsyasi || 32 ||
sā tathaiti pratijñāya nityaṃ vrataparāyaṇā ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭisu tīrtheṣu vārāṇasyādiṣu kramāt|| 33 ||
babhrāma tāni liṃgāni pūjayantī prabhaktitaḥ ||
krameṇaiva tu saṃprāptā hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhavam || 34 ||
yāvatpaśyati sā sādhvī tāvannāgabilo mahān ||
pūrito nāgareṇaiva mārgaḥ pātālasaṃbhavaḥ || 35 ||
gacchaṃti yena pūrvaṃ tu tīrthayātrāparāyaṇāḥ ||
hāṭakeśvaradevasya darśanārthaṃ munīśvarāḥ || 36 ||
atha sā cintayāmāsa na dṛṣṭe tu sureśvare ||
hāṭakeśvaradeve ca na hi yātrāphalaṃ labhet || 37 ||
tasmāttapaḥ kari ṣyāmi sthitvā caiva suduṣkaram ||
yenāhaṃ tatprabhāvena taṃ paśyāmi sureśvaram || 38 ||
evaṃ sā niścayaṃ kṛtvā tapastepe suduṣkaram ||
darśanārthaṃ hi devasya pātālanilayasya ca || 39 ||
paṃcāgnisādhakā grīṣme hemante salilāśrayā ||
varṣāsvākāśaśayanā sā babhūva tapasvinī || 6.208.40 ||
haraliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya svanāmnā cāṃtike tadā ||
trikālaṃ pūjayāmāsa gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ || 41 ||
evaṃ tapasi saṃsthāyāstasyāḥ kālo mahāngataḥ ||
na ca saṃdarśanaṃ jātaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhavam|| 42 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya śatānandaśca tatsutaḥ ||
sa tāmanveṣamāṇastu tasminkṣetre samāgataḥ ||
mātṛsneha parītātmā tīrthānveṣaṇatatparaḥ || 43 ||
atha tāṃ tatra saṃvīkṣya dāruṇe tapasi sthitām ||
praṇipatya sthito dīnaḥ saduḥkho vākyamabravīt || 44 ||
kimatra kliśyate kāyastapaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam||
saptaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu yāni liṃgāni teṣu ca || 45 ||
māheśvarāṇi liṃgāni tāni dṛṣṭāni ca tvayā ||
etatpātālasaṃsthaṃ ca hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam|| 46 ||
na paśyati naraḥ kaściddṛṣṭaṃ kṣetre na kenacit ||
tena śuddhiśca saṃjātā svabhartrā vihitā tu yā ||47 ||
tasmādāgaccha gacchāmastātāśrāmapade śubhe ||
tvanmārgaṃ vīkṣate tātaḥ karṣuko varṣaṇaṃ yathā || 48 |
|| āhilyovāca || ||
yāvatpaśyāmi no devaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ||
tāvadgacchāmi no gehaṃ yadā paśyāmi taṃ haram || 49 ||
tadā yāsye gṛhaṃ putra niścayo'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ || 6.208.50 ||
tacchrutvā so'pi tāṃ prāha hyeṣa cenniścayastava ||
mayā'pi tātapārśve tu pragaṃtavyaṃ tvayāpa || 51 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ sopi sthāpayāmāsa śāṃbha vam ||
liṃgaṃ ca pūjayāmāsa trikālaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ || 52 ||
śatānandastu rājarṣiḥ gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ||
naivedyairvividhaiḥ sūktairvedoktaiḥ paryatoṣayat || 53 ||
ṣaṣṭhānnakālabhojyasya vratacaryāratasya ca ||
evaṃ tasyā'pi saṃsthasya gataḥ kālo mahānmune ||
na ca tuṣyati deveśa stābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ kathañcana || 54 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā gautamo'pi mahāmuniḥ ||
ājagāma svayaṃ tatra putradarśanalālasaḥ || 55 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ putraṃ tapasi saṃsthitam ||
tutoṣa prathamaṃ tāvatpaścāduḥkhasamanvitaḥ || 56 ||
aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ putro me kṛśatāṃ gataḥ ||
tapasaḥ saṃprabhāvena nayāmi svagṛhaṃ katham ||
bhāryeyaṃ ca tathā mahyaṃ vivarṇā tu kṛśā sthitā || 57 ||
evaṃ saṃciṃtya manasā tāvubhau pratyabhāṣata ||
gamyatāṃ svagṛhaṃ kṛtvā tapasaḥ saṃnivartanam || 58 ||
|| śatānanda uvāca || ||
tātāṃbā bahudhā proktā tapasaḥ saṃnivartane ||
no gacchati tathā harmyamadṛṣṭe hāṭakeśvare || 59 ||
ahaṃ tayā vihīnastu naiva yāsyāmi niścitam ||
evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāga yadyuktaṃ tatsamācara || 6.208.60 ||
|| gautama uvāca || ||
yadyevaṃ niścayo vatsa tava mātuśca saṃsthitaḥ ||
ahaṃ te darśayiṣyāmi tapasā hāṭakeśvaram || 61 ||
evamuktvā tataḥ so'pi tapaścakre mahāmuniḥ ||
ekāṃtaropavāsastu sthito varṣaśataṃ muniḥ||
ṣaṣṭhānnakālabhojī ca tāvatkāle tato'bhavat||62||
trirātrabhojī paścācca sa babhūva munīśvaraḥ|
tāvatkālaṃ phalairninye tāvatkālaṃ jalāśanaḥ||
vāyubhakṣastato bhūyastāvatkālamabhūnmuniḥ||63||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte parame saṃvyavasthite||
prabhidya medinīpṛṣṭhaṃ niṣkrāṃtaṃ liṃgamuttamam || 64
dvādaśārkapratīkāśaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitama ||
etasminnaṃtare devaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || 65 ||
etasminneva kāle tu bhagavāñchaśiśekharaḥ ||
tasya dṛṣṭipathaṃ gatvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 66 ||
gautamā'haṃ pratuṣṭaste tapasā'nena suvrata || 67 ||
etacca māmakaṃ liṃgaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ||
pātālācca viniṣkrāṃtaṃ tava bhaktyā mahāmune ||68||
etadarthaṃ tapastaptaṃ sabhāryeṇa tvayā hi tat ||
saputreṇākhilaṃ jātaṃ phalaṃ tasya yathepsitam || 69 ||
etatpaśyatu te bhāryā ahilyā divyarūpiṇī ||
aṣṭaṣaṣṭyudbhavaṃ yena yātrāphalamavāpnuyāt || 6.208.70 ||
tvaṃ cāpi prārthaya varaṃ yena sarvaṃ dadāmi te || 71 ||
|| gautama uvāca ||
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñe tu sakṛddṛṣṭe ca yatphalam ||
pātālasthe ca yatpuṇyaṃ narāṇāṃ jāyate phalam ||
dṛṣṭenānena tatpuṇyaṃ pūjitena viśeṣataḥ || 72 ||
anye'pi ye janāstacca pūjayaṃti prabhaktitaḥ ||
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ te prayāṃtu triviṣṭapam || 73 ||
etalliṃgaṃ na jānaṃti narāḥ siddhyabhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||
viśaṃti vivaraṃ tena hāṭakeśvarakāṃkṣayā || 74 ||
api pāpasamopetā liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
paradārodbhavā tpāpādahilyeśvaradarśanāt || 79 ||
mucyaṃte mānavāstadvacchatānaṃdeśvarādapi ||
tasmindine vihitayā tābhyāṃ caiva prapūjayā || 76 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
etasminneva kāle tu vyāptaḥ svargo'khilo nṛpa ||
mānuṣairapi pāpāḍhyaiḥ sarvadharmavivarjitaiḥ || 77 ||
na kaścitkurute yajñaṃ tīrtha yātrāmathāparam ||
na vrataṃ niyamaṃ caiva dānasyāpi kathāmapi || 78 ||
tacca liṃgatrayaṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ || 79 ||
tato bhītāḥ surāḥ sarve saspardhairmānuṣairvṛtāḥ ||
procuḥ puraṃdaraṃ gatvā vyathayā prayā yutāḥ || 6.208.80 ||
martyaloke sahasrākṣa sarve dharmāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ||
api pāpasamācārā abhyetya puruṣā iha || 81 ||
asmābhiḥ saha garvāḍhyāḥ spardhāṃ kurvaṃti sarvadā ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre liṃgatrayamanuttamam || 82 ||
yatsthitaṃ sthāpitaṃ tatra gautamena mahātmanā ||
saputreṇa sadāreṇa tasya pūjāprabhāvataḥ || 83 ||
api pāpasamācārā ihāgacchaṃti te'khilāḥ ||
yamasya narakāḥ sarve sāṃprataṃ śūnyatāṃ gatāḥ || 84 ||
gautamena samānītaḥ pātālāddhāṭakeśvaraḥ ||
tapasā toṣayitvā tu tatra sthāne sureśvaraḥ || 85 ||
tatprabhāvādayaṃ jāto vyavahāro dharātale || 86 ||
evaṃ jñātvā pravartaṃte yathā yajñāstathā kuru ||
tairvinā naiva tṛptiḥ syādasmākaṃ ca kathaṃcana || 87 ||
tacchrutvā vāsavastatra samāhūya ca manmatham ||
krodhaṃ lobhaṃ tathā daṃbhaṃ matsaraṃ dveṣasaṃyutam || 98 ||
gatvā dharātalaṃ sarve mamādeśāddrutaṃ tataḥ ||
svaśaktyā vārayadhvaṃ bho gautameśvarapūjakān || 89 ||
ahilyeśvaradevasya śatānaṃdeśvarasya ca ||
śakrādeśaṃ tu saṃprāpya te gatā dharaṇītale || 6.208.90 ||
kāmādikā narānbhejurgautameśvarapūjakān ||
tathā'hilyeśvarasyāpi śatānaṃdeśvarasya ca || 91 ||
tato bhūyo makhā jātāḥ samagre dharaṇītale ||
saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāḥ sarve vatāni niyamāstathā || 92 ||
tīrthayātrā japo homo yāścānyāḥ sukṛtakriyāḥ ||
etatsarvaṃ mayā khyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dharādhipa || 93 ||
gayākūpyanuṣaṃgeṇa śakragautamaceṣṭitam ||
bālamaṇḍanamāhātmyaṃ śakreśvarasamanvitam || 94 ||
indrasya sthāpanaṃ martye ahilyākhyānameva ca ||
gautameśvaramāhātmyaṃ tathāhilyeśvarasya ca || 95 ||
yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ||
sa mucyetpātakātsadyaḥ paradārasamudbhavāt || 96 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gautameśvarāhilyeśvara śatānandeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 208 || || dha ||

<6.209>

|| ānarta uvāca || ||
sāṃprataṃ muniśārdūla śaṃkhatīrtha samudbhavam||
māhātmyaṃ vada me kṛtsnaṃ śraddhā me mahatī sthitā || 1 ||
aho tīrthamaho tīrthaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ||
kṣetraṃ yacca dharāpṛṣṭhe sarvāścaryamayaṃ śubham || 2 ||
nāhaṃ tṛptiṃ dvijaśreṣṭha pragacchāmi kathaṃcana ||
śṛṇvānastu sumāhātmyaṃ kṣetrasyāsya samudbhavam || 3 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
atra te kīrtayiṣyāmi pūrvavṛttaṃ kathāṃtaram ||
śaṃkhatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ yathājātaṃ dharātale || 4 ||
ānartādhipatiḥ pūrvamāsīdanyo mahīpatiḥ ||
yathā tvaṃ sāṃprataṃ bhūmau sarvalokaprapālakaḥ || 5 ||
so'kasmātkuṣṭhabhāgjāto vikalāṃgo babhūva ha ||
aputraḥ śatrubhirvyāptastrastaśca nṛpasattamaḥ || 6 ||
sa sarvairbhūmipālaiśca sarvataḥ paripīḍitaḥ ||
rājyabhraṃśasamopetaḥ prāpto raivatakaṃ girim || 7 ||
tatrāpi pīḍyate nityaṃ sarvatastu malimlucaiḥ || 8 ||
hastyaśvarathahīnastu kośahīno yadā'bhavat ||
sa tadā ciṃtayāmāsa kiṃ karomi ca sāṃpratam || 9 ||
kalatrāṇyapi sarvāṇi hriyaṃte taskarairbalāt || || 6.209.10 ||
sa evaṃ ciṃtayānastu gato vai nāradaṃ vibhum ||
draṣṭuṃ pārthivaśārdūla vaiṣṇave divase sthite || 11 ||
tatrāpaśyatsa saṃprāptaṃ nāradaṃ munisattamam ||
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena dāmodaradidṛkṣayā || 12 ||
taṃ praṇamyātha śirasā kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||
provāca vacanaṃ dīna upaviśya tadagrataḥ || 13 || ||
|| rājovāca || ||
śatrubhiḥ paribhūto'haṃ samatānmunisattama ||
tato rājyaparibhraṃśātsaṃprāpto'tra mahāgirau || 14 ||
vipine taskaraiḥ pāpaiḥ prapīḍye'haṃ samaṃtataḥ ||
yatkiṃcidaśvanāgādyaṃ mayā saha samāgatam || 15 ||
tatsarvaṃ taskarairnītaṃ kośā dārāstathā vasu ||
tasmādvada muniśreṣṭha vairāgyaṃ me mahatsthitam || 16 ||
anyajanmodbhavaṃ kiṃcinmama pāpaṃ sudāruṇam ||
yenemāṃ ca daśāṃ prāptaḥ sahasā munisattama || 17 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā munīśvaraḥ ||
provācā'tha nṛpaṃ dīnaṃ jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā || 18 ||
|| nārada uvāca || ||
na tvayā kutsitaṃ kiṃcitpūrva dehāṃtare kṛtam ||
mayā jñātaṃ mahārāja sarvaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā || 19 ||
tvamāsīḥ pārthivaḥ pūrvaṃ siddhapannagasaṃjñite ||
pattane somavaṃśīyaḥ sarva śatrunibarhaṇaḥ || 6.209.20 ||
tvayā ceṣṭaṃ mahāyajñaiḥ sadā saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥ ||
mahādānāni dattāni pūjitā brāhmaṇottamāḥ || 21 ||
tena karma vipākena bhūyaḥ pārthivatāṃ gataḥ || 22 ||
|| ānarta uvāca || ||
iha janmani no kṛtyaṃ saṃsmarāmi vibho kṛtam ||
tatkiṃ rājyapari bhraṃśaḥ sahasā me samutthitaḥ || 23 ||
lakṣmyā hīnasya lokasya loke'sminvyarthatāṃ vrajet ||
jīvitaṃ muniśārdūla vijñātaṃ hi mayā'dhunā || 24 ||
mṛto naro gataśrīko mṛtaṃ rāṣṭramarājakam ||
mṛtamaśrotriye dānaṃ mṛto yajñastvadakṣiṇaḥ || 25 ||
lakṣmyā hīnasya martyasya bāṃdhavo'pi vijāyate||
prārthayiṣyati māṃ nūnaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ cānyato vrajet || 26 ||
yathā māṃ sāṃprataṃ dṛṣṭvā ye mayā'pi pratarpitāḥ ||
te'pi dūrataraṃ yāṃti eṣa māṃ prārthayi ṣyati || 27 ||
dhanahīnaṃ naraṃ tyaktvā kulīnamapi cottamam ||
gacchati svajano'nyatra śuṣkaṃ vṛkṣamivāṃḍajāḥ || 28 ||
tatkāryakāraṇārthāya daridro' bhyeti cedgṛham ||
dhanino bhartsayaṃtyenaṃ samāgacchaṃti nāṃtikam || 29 ||
kṛpaṇo'pi dhanāḍhyaścedāgacchati hi yācitum ||
eṣa dāsyati me kiṃci diti citte nṛṇāṃ bhavet || 6.209.30 ||
mama tvaṃ pūrvavaṃśīyaḥ pitā te ca piturmama ||
sadā snehaparaścāsīttvaṃ ca snehavivarjitaḥ || 31 ||
evaṃ bruvaṃti loke'tra dhanināṃ purataḥ sthitāḥ ||
kulīnā api pāpānāṃ dṛśyaṃte dhanalipsayā ||
daridrasya manuṣyasya kṣitau rājyaṃ prakurvataḥ || 32 ||
praśoṣaḥ kevalaṃ bhāvī hṛdayasya mahāmune ||
dvāvimau kaṇṭakau tīkṣṇau śarīrapariśoṣiṇau ||
yaścādhanaḥ kāmayate yaśca kupyatyanīśvaraḥ || 33 ||
śmaśānamapi sevaṃte dhanalubdhā niśāgame ||
janetāramapi tyaktvā nityaṃ yāṃti sudūrataḥ || 34 ||
sumūrkhopi bhavedvidvānakulīno'pi satkulaḥ ||
yasya vittaṃ bhave ddharmye viparītamato'nyathā || 35 ||
nirviṇṇo'haṃ muniśreṣṭha jīvitasya ca sāṃpratam ||
tasmādbrūhi kimarthaṃ me dāridryaṃ samupasthitam || 36 ||
kuṣṭhaścāpi mamopetaḥ śatrubhiśca parābhavam ||
anyajanmāṃtaraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tvayā divyena cakṣuṣā || 37 ||
kukarmaṇā na saṃspṛṣṭaṃ svalpenāpi bravīṣi mām ||
etajjanmātaraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ smarāmi munisattama || 38 ||
na mayā kukṛtaṃ kiṃcitkadācitsamanuṣṭhitam ||
tatkiṃ rājyaparibhraṃśo jāto'yaṃ mama sanmune || 39 ||
atra me kautukaṃ jātaṃ tasmāddehi vinirṇayam ||
bhavenna vā bhavetkarma kṛtaṃ yacca śubhāśubham || 6.209.40 ||
|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā tu nāradaḥ ||
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭastataḥ provāca sādaram || 41 ||
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi yathā śuddhiḥ prajāyate ||
tava rājyasya saṃprāptiryathā bhūyo'pi jāyate || 42 ||
tava bhūmau mahāpuṇyamasti kṣetraṃ jagattraye ||
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu tīrthaṃ tatrāsti śobhanam ||
śaṃkhatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam|| 43||
yastatra kurute snānaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ||
aṣṭamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya saṃprāpte māsi mādhave || 44 ||
sūryavāre tu samprāpte bhāskarasyodayaṃ prati ||
sarvakuṣṭhavinirmukto jāyate sūryasaṃnibhaḥ || 45 ||
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyettaṃtaṃ sarveṣu durlabham ||
sa tadā''pnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkheśvaraṃ śubham|| 46 ||
kiṃ tvayā na śrutaṃ tatra svadeśe vasatā nṛpa ||
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ yattvamatra samāgataḥ ||47||
|| siddhasena uvāca || ||
kathaṃ śaṃkheśvaro devaḥ saṃjāto vada sanmune || 48 ||
|| nārada uvāca || ||
ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm ||
yathā śaṃkheśvaro jātaḥ śaṃkhatīrthaṃ tu pārthiva|| 49 ||
āsaturbrāhmaṇau pūrvaṃ likhitaḥ śaṃkha eva ca ||

|| || viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya devarṣernāradasya ca ||

yajamānahitārthāya sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ||
ajñānājjñānato vāpi kutāṃbūlaṃ prabhakṣitam || 87 ||
bhakṣayiṣyasi yaccānyatkadācinme prasādanāt ||
tasya doṣo na te bhāvī mama vākyādasaṃśayam || 88 ||
anena vidhinā dattvā tāṃbūlaṃ śuddhimāpnuyāt ||
kutāṃbūlasya doṣeṇa gṛhyate na naro nṛpa || 89 ||
tasmāttvaṃ hi mahārāja vratametatsamācara ||
bahu puṇyatamaṃ hyetanmahābhogavivarddhanam || 6.210.90 ||
yaḥ prayacchati rājendra vidhinānena bhaktitaḥ ||
janmajanmāntare vāpi na tāṃbūlena mucyate || 91 ||
tāṃbūlaṃ bhakṣayitvā yo naitaddānaṃ prayacchati ||
tāṃbūlavarjitaḥ so'tra bhavejjanmanijanmani || 92 ||
tāṃbūlavarjitaṃ yasya mukhaṃ syātpṛthivīpate ||
kṛpaṇasya daridrasya tadbilaṃ na hi tanmukham || 93 ||
tāṃbūlaṃ brāhmaṇendrāya yo dattvā prākprabhakṣayet ||
surūpo bhāgyavāndakṣo bhavejjanmanijanmani || 94 ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kutāṃbūlasya bhakṣaṇāt ||
yatphalaṃ jāyate puṃsāṃ yaddānena mahīpate || 95 ||
śaṃkhādityānuṣaṃgeṇa tāṃbūlasya ca bhakṣaṇe ||
ye doṣā ye guṇā rājandānaṃ caiva prabhakṣaṇe || 96 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye tāṃbūlotpatti tāṃbūlamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 210 || || || ||

<6.211>

|| viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
rājño dāridryadoṣasya kuṣṭhavyādheśca kāraṇam ||
kathayitvā punaḥ prāha nārado munisattamaḥ || 1 ||
|| nārada uvāca || ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ rājankuṣṭhasya kāraṇam ||
dāridryasya ca yatsamyagjñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā || 2 ||
adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi yathā tava parābhavaḥ ||
śatrubhyaḥ saṃprajāto'tra dvijānāmapamānataḥ || 3 ||
ānartādhipatiryo'tra kaścidrājye'bhiṣicyate ||
sa pūrvaṃ gacchati grāmaṃ nāgarāṇāṃ prabhaktitaḥ || 4 ||
tvayā tatkalpitaṃ rājannaiva dattaṃ pramādataḥ ||
parābhūtā dvijāste ca yācamānā muhurmuhuḥ || 5 ||
tathā kopavaśādyāni śāsanāni dvijanmanām ||
lopitāni tvayānyāni pitṛpaitāmahāni ca || 6 ||
tena te'tra parābhūtiḥ saṃjātā śatrusaṃbhavā ||
evaṃ jñātvā dvijedrāṇāṃ śāsa nāni prayaccha bhoḥ || 7 ||
gṛhītāni ca yānyeva teṣāṃ mokṣaṃ samācara ||
tacchrutvā pārthivaḥ so'tha śaṃkhatīrthe prabhaktitaḥ || 8 ||
snātvā viprānsamā hūya madhyagena samanvitān ||
śaṃkhādityasya purataḥ prakṣālya caraṇau nṛpa || 9 ||
dadau ca śāsanaśataṃ prakṣālya caraṇāṃstataḥ ||
ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaṃ rājā nāgarāṇāṃ mahātmanām || 6.211.10 ||
etasminnaṃtare tatra śatravo ye ca saṃsthitāḥ ||
sarve mṛtyuṃ samāpannā brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādataḥ || 11 ||
viśvāmitra uvāca || ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ śaṃkhatīrthasamudbhavam ||
prabhāvaṃ pārthivaśreṣṭha kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 12 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śaṃkhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||211|| || cha || ||

<6.212>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
śrutaṃ tīrthatrayaṃ puṇyaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñite ||
kṣetre'tra yattvayā proktamasmākaṃ sūtanaṃdana || 1 ||
viśvāmitrīyamāhātmyaṃ śrotu micchāmahe vayam||
sāṃprataṃ tatsamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 2 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
samudrasyāpi pāro'tra lakṣyate ca kṣiterapi ||
tārakāṇāṃ munestasya na guṇānāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 3 ||
lakṣyate kenacitpāro gādheḥ putrasya dhīmataḥ ||
kṣatriyo'pi dvijatvaṃ yaḥ saṃprāpto dvijasattamāḥ|| 4 || 
aṃtyajatvaṃ gatasyāpi triśaṃkoḥ pṛthivīpateḥ ||
yajñabhāgabhujo devāḥ pratyakṣeṇa vinirmitāḥ || 5 ||
brahmaṇaḥ spardhayā yena purā sṛṣṭirdvijottamāḥ ||
prārabdhā ca tato devaiḥ praṇipatya nivāritaḥ || 6 ||
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ sāprataṃ vadato mama ||
śrūyatāṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśa nam || 7 ||
tena tatra kṛtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ svahastena mahātmanā ||
śastraṃ vināpi bhūpṛṣṭhaṃ pravidārya samaṃtataḥ || 8 ||
tatra dhyātvā samānītā pātālājjāhnavī nadī ||
martyaloke samāyātaṃ yasyāstoyaṃ sunirmalam || 9 ||
susvādu ca tathā snānātsarvapātakanāśanam ||
tenāpi sthāpitastatra bhāskaro vārita skaraḥ || 6.212.10 ||
yaḥ saptamyāṃ sūryavāre snātvā tasya hṛde śubhe ||
māghamāse site pakṣe namasyati divākaram ||
sa kuṣṭhairmucyate sarvaistathā pāpairdvijo ttamāḥ || 11 ||
paścimottaradigbhāge tasyāsti jalasaṃbhavā ||
dhanvaṃtarikṛtā vāpī sarvarogavināśinī || 12 ||
tatra pūrvaṃ tapastepe dhanvaṃ tarirudāradhīḥ ||
vavande tapasā yukto dhyāyamānaḥ samāhitaḥ || 13 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā saṃtuṣṭastasya bhāskaraḥ ||
uvāca varado'smīti prārthayasva mahāmate || 14 ||
|| dhanvaṃtariruvāca || ||
atra kuṇḍe naro bhaktyā yaḥ snānaṃ kurute vibho ||
tasya syātsarvarogāṇāṃ saṃkṣayaḥ surasattama || 15 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
adya śaste dine yo'tra saptamyāṃ ravivāsare ||
sūryodaye naraḥ snānaṃ kariṣyati samāhitaḥ ||
vyādhigrastaḥ sa nīrogastatkṣaṇātsaṃbhaviṣyati || 16 ||
nīrogaścepsitānkāmānniṣkāmo mokṣameṣyati || 17 ||
evamuktvā suraśre ṣṭhoṃ'tardhānaṃ sa gato raviḥ ||
dhanvantariḥ prahṛṣṭātmā svasthānaṃ ca gatastataḥ || 18 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya ratnākṣo'tha mahīpatiḥ ||
ayodhyādhi patiḥ khyātaḥ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || 19 ||
kṛtajñaśca vadānyaśca svadāranirataḥ sadā ||
śūraḥ paramatejasvī sarvaśatruniṣūdanaḥ || 6.212.20 ||
pūrvakarmavipākena tasya bhūmipaterdvijāḥ ||
kuṣṭhavyādhirabhūdraudro duścikitsyo jagattraye ||21||
tadasti nauṣadhaṃ loke yattena na kṛtaṃ dvijāḥ ||
kuṣṭhagrastena vā dānaṃ yatra dattaṃ mahātmanā || 22 ||
yathāyathauṣadhānyeva sa karoti dadāti ca ||
tathātathā tasya kāyo vyādhinā kṣāmito bhṛśam || 23 ||
tato vairāgyamāpannaḥ sa nṛpo dvijasattamāḥ ||
putraṃ rājye'tha saṃsthāpya vāṃchayāmāsa pāvakam ||
niṣiddho'pi hi taiḥ sarvaiḥ kalatrairāptasevakaiḥ || 24 ||
dattvā dānāni viprebhyaḥ pūjayitvā surottamān ||
saṃbhāṣya ca suhṛdvargaṃ śāsayitvā nijaṃ sutam || 25 ||
etasminneva kāle tu bhramamāṇe yadṛcchayā ||
kaścitkārpaṭikaḥ prāpto divyarūpavapurdharaḥ || 26 ||
athāsau vyākulaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatsarvaṃ nṛpateḥ puram ||
apṛcchadvismayāviṣṭo dṛṣṭvā kañcinnaraṃ dvijāḥ || 27 || ||
|| kārpaṭika uvāca || ||
kimeṣā vyākulā bhadre sarvā jātā mahāpurī ||
nirānandā'śrupūrṇākṣairbālavṛddhairniṣevitā || 28 ||
so'bravīnnṛpatiścāyaṃ kuṣṭhavyādhisamanvitaḥ ||
sādhayiṣyati sandīptaṃ sunirviṇṇo hutāśanam || 29 ||
teneyaṃ nagarī kṛtsnā paraṃ duḥkhamupāgatā ||
guṇairasya samāviṣṭā nūnaṃ mṛtyuṃ prayāsyati || 6.212.30 ||
tacchrutvā satvaraṃ gatvā nṛpaṃ kārpaṭiko'bravīt || 31 ||
sarvaṃ janaṃ narendrasya mṛtaṃ jīvāpayanniva ||
mā nṛpānena duḥkhena vyādhijena hutāśanam ||
praviśa tvaṃ sthite tīrthe sarvavyādhikṣayāvahe || 32 ||
madīyo bhūpate deha īdṛgāsīdyathā tava ||
tatra snātasya sadyo'tha jāta īdṛkpunaḥ prabho || 33 ||
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa bhāskarasyodayaṃ prati ||

tathā pāpavinirmukto yathāhaṃ nṛpasattama ||35||
|| rājovāca || ||
kasmindeśe mahātīrthaṃ tādṛśaṃ vada me drutam || || 36 ||
|| kārpaṭikauvāca || ||
asti bhūmitale khyātaṃ nāgaraṃ kṣetramuttamam ||
kuṣṭhavyādhisamākrāṃto gato'haṃ tatra bhūpate || 37 ||

tatra māṃ dīnamālokya vyādhigrastaṃ suduḥkhitam||
kaścittatrāśrayaḥ prāha tapasvī kṛpayānvitaḥ || 38 ||

tīrthamasti mahāpuṇyaṃ viśvāmitrajalāvaham||39||
tatra gatvā kuru snānaṃ saptamyāṃ ravivāsare ||
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || 6.212.40 ||
yena niryāti te kuṣṭho bhāskarasyodayaṃ prati ||
tacchrutvā'haṃ ca tatprāptaḥ saptamyāṃ sūryasaṃyuji ||
tataśca kṛtavānsnānaṃ nirjhare tatra śāṃbhave ||41||
tatastasmādviniṣkrāṃto yāvatpaśyāmyahaṃ tanum||
tāvannṛpedṛśī jātā satyametattavoditam ||42||
tasmāttvamapi rājeṃdra tatra snānaṃ samācara ||
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa bhāskarasyodayaṃ prati ||43||
yena te naśyati vyādhirviśeṣamapi pātakam ||
tacchrutvā sa nṛpastūrṇaṃ tenaiva sahito yayau || 44 ||
cakāra sa tathā snānaṃ saptamyāṃ sūryavāsare ||
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte viśvāmitrajale śubhe || 45 ||
tataḥ kuṣṭhavinirmuktastatkṣaṇātsamapadyata ||
divyarūpavapurddhārī kāmadeva ivāparaḥ || 46 ||
atha tuṣṭo nareṃdrastu tasmai kārpaṭikāya ca ||
dadau koṭitrayaṃ hemnaḥ provāca sa tato vacaḥ || 47||
tvatprasādādvimukto'smi rogādasmātsudāruṇāt ||
tasmāttvaṃ gaccha gehaṃ svaṃ sthāsye'haṃ cātra nirbharam || 48 ||
kariṣyāmi tapo nityaṃ svakalatrasama nvitaḥ ||
rājye saṃsthāpitaḥ putraḥ samartho rājyakarmaṇi || 49 ||
ityuktvā prerayāmāsa taṃ tathānyānsamāgatān ||
sevakāsvagṛhāyaiva svayaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || 6.212.50 ||
kṛtvā''śramapadaṃ ramyaṃ svakalatrasamanvitaḥ ||

tasya nāmnā tataḥ khyātaṃ tīrtha metattriviṣṭape ||
sarvavyādhiharaṃ ramyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ||52||

ratnāditya iti khyāto nijanāmnā mahā tmanā || 53 ||
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa tatra snātvā prapaśyati ||

tadahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 55 ||
āsīttatra pumānkaściddeśe grāmyo jarātmakaḥ ||
kuṣṭhī tathāpi nityaṃ sa karoti paśu rakṣaṇam ||56||
ekadā rakṣatastasya paśūṃstatra gireradhaḥ ||
ekaḥ paśurviniṣkrāṃtaḥ satpathāttṛṇalobhataḥ ||57||
saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa patitastasya nirjhare ||
na ca saṃlakṣitastena gacchamānaḥ kathaṃcana || 58 ||

tāvattasya paśoḥ svāmī bhartsayansamupāgataḥ ||59||
nāyātaḥ sa paśuḥ kasmānmadīyo māmake gṛhe ||
tasmādānaya taṃ śīghraṃ no cetprāṇānharāmi te || 6.212.60 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā bhaya saṃtrastaḥ sa kuṣṭhī satvaraṃ yayau ||
tena mārgeṇa yenaiva divā bhrāṃto mahītale || 61 ||
atha dūrātsa śuśrāva tasya rāvaṃ paśostadā ||
patitasya mahāgarte niśāṃte tamasi sthite ||62||
tato gatvā'tha taṃ gartaṃ praviśya jalamadhyataḥ ||
cakarṣa taṃ paśuṃ kṛcchrātpaṃkamadhyātsudāruṇāt ||
samādāyātha taṃ harmyaṃ prajagāma śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 63 ||
arpayitvātha taṃ tasya svakīyaṃ tvāśramaṃ gataḥ || 64 ||
tataḥ supto mahābhāgāḥ sa prabuddhaḥ punaryadā ||
prabhāte vīkṣate gātraṃ yāvatkuṣṭhavivarjitam || 65 ||
śobhayā parayā yuktaṃ vismayotphullalocanaḥ ||
ciṃtayāmāsa kiṃ hyetadakasmādrogasaṃkṣayaḥ || 66 ||
nūnaṃ tasya prabhāvo'yaṃ tīrthasyādya niśāgame ||
mayāvagāhitaṃ yacca paśorarthaṃ sukarddamam || 67 ||
tataśca vīkṣayāmāsa tena gatvā sukautukāt ||
yāvatkaṃḍūvinirmuktastejasā parivāritaḥ || 68 ||
tatra sthāne svayaṃ gatvā jñātvā ca tīrthamuttamam ||
tapastepe sa tatraiva dhyāyamāno divākaram ||69||
araṇyavāsinaṃ samyagdivārātramataṃdritaḥ ||
gataśca paramāṃ siddhiṃ durlabhāṃ tridaśairapi || 6.212.70 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret || 71 ||
pūjayeccāpi taṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram ||
adyāpi kalikāle'pi tatra snāto naraḥ śuciḥ || 72 ||

<6.213>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
ratnādityasya māhātmyametadvaḥ parikīrtitam ||
sarvakuṣṭhaharaṃ yacca sarvapātakanāśanam ||
bhūyastathaiva māhātmyaṃ mahadvai śrūyatāṃ raveḥ || 1 ||
purāsīdbrāhmaṇaḥ kaścitkuṣṭhavyādhisamākulaḥ ||
tena cārādhitaḥ sūryastatrasthena dvijottamāḥ || 2 ||
pūrvadakṣiṇadigbhāge samāsādya tataḥ param ||
rakta candanajāṃ kṛtvā pratimāṃ bhāvitātmanā || 3 ||
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tuṣṭastasya divākaraḥ ||
varado'smīti taṃ prāha dṛṣṭigocaramāgataḥ || 4 || ||
|| brāhmaṇa uvāca || ||
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva kuṣṭhavyādhiṃ hara prabho ||
nānyena kāraṇaṃ me'sti rājyenāpi triviṣṭape || 5 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||

śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yāvatsnātvā puṇyahrade śubhe ||
phalahastaḥ pṛthaktvena tataḥ kuṣṭhena mucyase ||6||
anyo'tra gāṃ gato yo'pi vratametatkariṣyati ||
sarvarogavinirmukto mama lokaṃ sa gacchati || 7 ||
|| śrīsūrya uvāca || ||

vimuktaśca tadā kuṣṭhāddivyadehamavāptavān || 8 ||

kiṃ te priyaṃ karomyanyadvada brāhmaṇasattama || 9 ||
so'bravītsarvadaivātra sthātavyaṃ bhagavanvibho || 6.213.10 ||
|| śrībhagavānuvāca || ||
ataḥ paraṃ mamāvāsaḥ sthāne'tra ca bhaviṣyati ||
nāmnā kuharavāsākhyā saṃjñā mama bhaviṣyati || 11 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya viṣṇuputro babhūva ha ||
sāṃbonāma surūpāḍhyo jāṃbavatyāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 12 ||
kṣobhasaṃjananaḥ strīṇāṃ mātṝṇāmapi sa dvijāḥ |1
atha taṃ rājamārgeṇa gacchaṃtaṃ yadusattamam || 13 ||
puranāryo'pi saṃtuṣṭā vīkṣāṃcakruḥ sukautukāt ||
gṛhakāryāṇi saṃtyajya samārūḍhā gavākṣakān || 14 ||
tasya kāmātmadehasya darśanārthaṃ samutsukāḥ ||
kāścidardhānuliptāṃgyaḥ kāścidekāṃjitekṣaṇāḥ || 15
ardhasaṃyamitaiḥ keśaistathānyāstyaktabālakāḥ||
ekasmiṃścaraṇe kāścinniyojyopānahaṃ drutāḥ | 16 ||
pādukāṃ ca dvitīye tu paryadhāvannitaṃbinīḥ ||
vrajaṃtīṣu tathānyāsu vanitāsu gavākṣakān || 17 ||
vyākrośaṃti krudhāviṣṭāḥ śiśavo guravastathā ||
nīvībandhanaviśleṣasamākulitacetasaḥ || 18 ||
yayurevāparāḥ sveṣu gavākṣeṣu varāṃganāḥ ||
sa cakarṣa tadā tāsāṃ patitairnetraraśmibhiḥ || 19 ||
hṛdayāni dharāpṛṣṭhe kāmadevasamo yuvā ||
kāciddṛṣṭvaiva tadrūpaṃ tasya sāṃbasya kāminī || 6.213.20 ||
niścalā kāmataptāṃgī likhiteva vibhābyate ||
kācidagnisamānmuktvā niśvāsānkāmapīḍitā || 21 ||
ekāstaṃ ca samālokya rūpayauvanasaṃyutam ||
gavākṣātprapataṃti sma niśceṣṭā dharaṇītale || 22 ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
