yeṣāṃ yacchanti te naiva kiṃcitkiñcitsvavaṃśajāḥ ||
kṣutpipāsākulā ste ca dṛśyante bahuduḥkhitāḥ || 16 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya pitaraḥ surapūjitāḥ ||
agniṣvāttādayaḥ sarve tridaśendramupasthitāḥ || 17 ||
bhaktyā dṛṣṭā mahārāja sahasrākṣeṇa pūjitāḥ ||
tathānyairvibudhaiḥ sarvaiḥ prasthitāḥ sve niketane || 18 ||
pitṛlokaṃ mahārāja durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi ||
tāndṛṣṭvā prasthitānrājanpitaro martyasaṃbhavāḥ || 19 ||
kṣutpipāsārditā ye ca ta ūcurdainyamāśritāḥ ||
stutvā'tha sustavairdivyaiḥ pitṛsūktaiśca pārthiva || || 6.216.20 ||
vedoktairaparaiścaiva pitṛtuṣṭikaraiḥ paraiḥ ||
tataḥ procuśca saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pitarastānsurodbhavāḥ || 21 ||
prasannāḥ smo vayaṃ sarve yuṣmākaṃ śaṃsitavratāḥ ||
tasmādbrūta vayaṃ yena yacchāmo vo hṛdi sthitam || 22 ||
|| pitara ūcuḥ || ||
vayaṃ hi pitaraḥ khyātā manuṣyāṇāmihāgatāḥ ||
svarge svakarmaṇā nityaṃ nivasāma suraiḥ saha || 23 ||
vimāneṣu vicitreṣu saṃsthitāḥ sarvatodiśam ||
vāṃchiteṣu ca lokeṣu yāmo dhvajapatākiṣu || 24 ||
haṃsabarhiṇa juṣṭeṣu saṃsevyeṣvapsarogaṇaiḥ ||
gandharvairgīyamānāśca stūyamānāśca guhyakaiḥ || 25 ||
paraṃ santiṣṭhamānānāmasmākaṃ tridaśaiḥ saha ||
atyarthaṃ jāyate tīvrā kṣutpipāsā sudāruṇā || 26 ||
yasyā manyāmahe citte vahnimadhyagatā vayam ||
bhakṣayāmaḥ kimetānhi pakṣiṇo vividhānapi ||
haṃsādīnmadhurālāpānkiṃ vā cāpsarasāṃ gaṇān || 27 ||
yadi kaścitkṣudhāviṣṭaḥ kañcidādāya pakṣiṇam ||
gupto gṛhṇāti bhakṣārthaṃ hantuṃ śakto'pi so'pi na || 28 ||
ajarāścāmarāścaiva svarge ye svargagāḥ khagāḥ ||
tathā manoramā vṛkṣā nandanādi vaneṣu ca || 29 ||
phalitā ye pradṛśyaṃte prāpyāṃścāpi manoramāḥ ||
tatphalāni vayaṃ sarve gṛhṇīmaḥ pitaro yadi || 6.216.30 ||
na truṭaṃtyapi yatnena samākṛṣṭāni tānyapi ||
etallekhāpagātoyaṃ tṛṣārttā yadi yatnataḥ ||
prapibāmo na hasteṣu tacca toyaṃ punaḥ spṛśet || 31 ||
bhuṃjānaśca na ko'pyatra dṛśyate'tra pibannapi ||
tasmāttriviṣṭapāvāso hyasmākaṃ ghoradāruṇaḥ || 32 ||
ete suragaṇāḥ sarve ye cānye guhyakādayaḥ ||
dṛśyaṃte'tra vimānasthā sarve saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ || 33 ||
kṣutpipāsāparityaktā nānābhogasamāśrayāḥ ||
kadācicca vayaṃ sarve bhavāmastādṛśā iva || 34 ||
kṣutpipāsāparityaktāḥ satoṣaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ||
tatkiṃ kāraṇametadyatkṣutpi pāsā prajāyate || 35 ||
ākasmikī ca bādhā naḥ kadācinna praṇaśyati ||
tathā kuruta bhadraṃ vo yathā tuṣṭiḥ prajāyate || 36 ||
śāśvatī no yathā'nyeṣāṃ devānāṃ svargavāsinām ||
yūyaṃ hi pitaro yasmāddevānāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 37 ||
vayaṃ caiva manuṣyāṇāṃ tena vaḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || ||
|| pitara ūcuḥ || ||
asmākamapi caivaiṣā kaṣṭāvasthā prajāyate || 38 ||
śakrādyā vibudhā vyagrāḥ śrāddhaṃ yacchaṃti no yadā ||
tataścāgatya tānsarve devānsaṃprārthayāmahe || 39 ||
tatastṛptiṃ pragacchāmastairdevaistarpitā vayam ||
yuṣmākaṃ vaṃśajā ye ca prayacchaṃti samāhitāḥ || 6.216.40 ||
kathaṃ na tṛptimāyātāste sarve taiḥ pratarpitāḥ ||
yatra pramādibhirvaṃśyairna tarpyaṃte kathaṃcana || 41 ||
kṣutpipāsākulāḥ sarve te tadā syurna saṃśayaḥ ||
kiṃ punarnarakasthā ye dharmarājaniveśane || 42 ||
etaddhi kāraṇaṃ proktaṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca kathaṃcana ||
kṣutpipāsodbhavaṃ raudraṃ yuṣmābhiryadudīritam || 43 ||
tadasmākaṃ vibhāgaṃ cedyūyaṃ yacchata sattamāḥ ||
sarve kavyasya dattasya tatkurmo vai hitaṃ śubham || 44 ||
brahmāṇaṃ prārthayitvā ca svayaṃ gatvā tadaṃtikam||
bāḍhamityeva tairukte tata ādāya tānapi || 45 ||
divyāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ prāptā vidheḥ sadanamuttamam ||
nāṃdīmukhānpuraskṛtya pitṝnyāṃstarpayedvidhiḥ || 46 ||
sṛṣṭikāle tu saṃprāpte vṛddhikāmaḥ sureśvaraḥ ||
atha taiḥ saha te sarve stutvā taṃ kamalāsanam ||
praṇipatya sthitāḥ sarve pitaro vinayānvitāḥ || 47 ||
pitṝṃstānvinayopetānpraṇipātapuraḥsarān ||
vidhiḥ provāca rājeṃdra sāṃtvayañślakṣṇayā girā || 48 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
kimarthaṃ pitaraḥ sarve samāyātā mamāṃtikam ||
devatānāṃ mayā sārdhaṃ saṃpūjyāḥ sarvadā sthitāḥ || 49 ||
tathānye'pi ca dṛśyaṃte yuṣmābhiḥ saha saṃgatāḥ ||
ya ete mānavā kārāḥ svalpatejonvitāḥ sthitāḥ || 6.216.50 ||
|| pitara ūcuḥ || ||
pitaro mānavā hyete svargaṃ prāptāḥ svakarmabhiḥ ||
devānāṃ madhyasaṃsthāśca pīḍyaṃte kṣutpipāsayā || 51 ||
yadā yacchaṃti no vaṃśyāḥ kavyaṃ caiva pramādataḥ ||
tadā gacchaṃti no tṛptiṃ yānairyāṃti yathā surāḥ || 52 ||
tadaitaiḥ prārthanā'smākaṃ kṛtā śāśvatatṛptaye ||
na ca śaktā vayaṃ dātuṃ tena tvāṃ samupasthitāḥ || 53 ||
yathā syurdevatā vyagrāstadā'smākamapi prabho| ||
kavyaṃ vinā bhavedeṣā daśā kaṣṭā sureśvara || 54 ||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ naḥ samemetaiḥ sureśvara ||
yathā syācchāśvatī tṛptiḥ svasthānasthāyināmapi|| || 55 ||
ete'smākaṃ pradāsyaṃti kavyaṃ yannijavaṃśajaiḥ ||
pradattaṃ tena saṃprāptā vayaṃ deva tvadantikam || 56 ||
devānāṃ caiva yatkavyaṃ tannāsmākaṃ pratṛ ptaye ||
yataḥ kriyāvihīnaṃ tanna teṣāṃ vidyate kriyā || 57 ||
pitṝnuddiśya yatkavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradīyate ||
snātairdhautāṃbarairmartyaistadbhavettṛptidaṃ mahat || || 58 ||
pitṝṇāṃ sarvadeveśa ityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ ||
na snātasyādhikāro'sti devānāṃ ca dvijātivat || 59 ||
pīyūṣamapi tairdattaṃ tena naḥ syānna tṛptaye || 6.216.60 ||
tasmānmānuṣadattairno yathā kavye prajāyate ||
svargasthānāṃ parā tṛptiḥ samametaistathā kuru || 61 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā suciraṃ dhyātvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ||
tānuvāca tataḥ sarvānpitṝnpārthivasattama ||62||
|| brahmovāca || ||
asmiṃstretāyuge saṃjñā havyakavyasamudbhavā||
saṃprayātā yuge yugme kalau na prabhaviṣyati || 63 ||
yathāyathā yugānāṃ ca hrāsa eṣa bhaviṣyati ||
tathātathā janā duṣṭā bhaviṣyaṃtyanyabhaktikāḥ || || 64 ||
na dāsyaṃti yathoktāni te kavyāni kathaṃcana ||
tataḥ kaṣṭatarā'vasthā pitṝṇāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 65 ||
tasmādahaṃ kariṣyāmi sukhopāyaṃ śarīriṇām ||
yena santarpitā yūyaṃ parāṃ tṛptimavāpsyatha || 66 ||
pituḥ pitāmahasyaiva tatpituśca tataḥ param||
samuddeśena dattena brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prabhaktitaḥ || 67 ||
sarveṣāṃ syātparā tṛptiryāvanmāṃ pitaro'dhunā ||
tathā mātāmahānāṃ ca pakṣe nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 68 ||
tribhiḥ santarpitāste'pi tarpitāḥ syurmamāvadhi ||
yuṣmākaṃ tṛptaye yaśca sukhopāyo bhaviṣyati || 69 ||
taṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ mahābhāgā gadato mama sāṃpratam ||
pitṝnannena yenaiva samuddiśya dvijottamān|| 6.216.70 ||
tarpayiṣyaṃti tenaiva piṇḍāndāsyaṃti bhaktitaḥ ||
tannāmnā tena vastṛptiḥ śāśvatī saṃbhaviṣyati || 71 ||
tasmādgacchata santuṣṭāḥ svāni sthānāni pūrvajāḥ || 72 ||
tataste sahitāstaistu svāni sthānāni bhejire ||
vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃkāśairgatvā pārthivasattama || 73 ||
atha saṃgacchatā rājankālena mahatā tataḥ ||
taccāpi na daduḥ śrāddhaṃ martyāstripuruṣaṃ ca yat || 74 ||
nityaṃ pitṝnsamuddiśya bahavo'tra narādhipa ||
kavyabhāgānpunasteṣāṃ tathā pūrvaṃ yathā nṛpa || 75 ||
kṣutpipāsodbhavāpīḍā mahatī samajāyata ||
teṣāṃ ca daivikānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ nṛpasattama || 76 ||
sametyātha punaḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
procuśca praṇipatyoccaiḥ sudīnāḥ prapitāmaham|| 77 ||
bhagavanna prayacchaṃti nityaṃ no vaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ ||
śrāddhāni dauḥsthyamāpannāstena sīdāmahe vibho || 78 ||
yathā pūrvaṃ tathā deva tadupāyaṃ pracintaya ||
kaṃcidyena daridrā vai prīṇayaṃti ca te pitṝn ||79||
bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tānāha prapitāmahaḥ ||
kṛpāviṣṭo mahārāja sarvānpitṛgaṇāṃstathā || 6.216.80 ||
satyametanmahābhāgā dauḥsthyaṃ yāṃti dinedine ||
janā yathāyathā yāti yugaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ || 81 ||
tathāpi ca kariṣyāmi yuṣmadarthamasaṃśayam ||
upāyaṃ laghu santṛptiryena vo'tra bhavi ṣyati || 82 ||
amānāma rave raśmisahasrapramukhaḥ sthitaḥ ||
tasminvasati yenenduramāvāsyā tataḥ smṛtā || 83 ||
tasminnahani ye śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya cātmanaḥ ||
kariṣyaṃti narā bhaktyā te bhaviṣyaṃti susthitāḥ || 84 ||
dhanadhānyasamopetā sarvaśatruvivarjitāḥ ||
apamṛtyuparityaktā mama vākyāda saṃśayam|| 85 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā babhūvurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ||
pitaraḥ kavyamāsādya prahaṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || 86 ||
yayuḥ svāni niketāni preṣitāḥ padmayoninā ||
amāvāsyādinaṃ prāpya śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ svavaṃśajaiḥ || 87 ||
saṃtṛptā māsamātraṃ ca tasthuḥ saṃtuṣṭamānasāḥ ||
gacchatā tvathakālena dauḥsthyaṃ prāpya narā bhuvi ||
darśe'sminnapi no śrāddhaṃ prāyaḥ kurvaṃti kecana ||88||
tataḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sarveṃ ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ||
kṣutpipāsākulā bhūyo brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ||89||
procuśca praṇipatyoccaiste sametāḥpitāmaham||
paramaṃ dainyamāsthāya bāṣpagadgadayā girā ||6.216.90||
bhagavanniṃdukṣaye śrāddhaṃ proktaṃ māsaṃ tvayā vibho||
asmākaṃ prīṇanārthāya yatkariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ||91||
dauḥsthāttadapi no kuryuḥ prāyaśastu pitāmaha ||
tenāsmākaṃ parā pīḍā kṣutpipāsāsamudbhavā||92||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ no yathā pūrvaṃ sureśvara||
tathāpi duḥsthatābhājastarpayiṣyaṃti no'dhunā||93||
||bhartṛyajña uvāca|| ||
atha brahmāpi saṃcintya tānuvāca kṛpānvitaḥ ||
yuṣmadarthaṃ mayopāyaściṃtitaḥ pitaro laghuḥ || 94 ||
yena tṛptiṃ parāṃ yūyaṃ gamiṣyatha pitrīśvarāḥ ||
amāvāsyodbhavaṃ śrāddhamalabdhvāpi ca vatsaram|| 95 ||
yathā mama prasādena tacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ ||
āṣāḍhyāḥ paṃcame pakṣe kanyāsaṃsthe divākare || 96 ||
mṛtāhani punaryo vai śrāddhaṃ dāsyati mānavaḥ ||
tasya saṃvatsaraṃyāvatṛptāḥ syuḥ pitaro dhruvam || 97 ||
evaṃ jñātvā kariṣyaṃti pretapakṣe narā bhuvi ||
śrāddhaṃ yūyaṃ na saṃdeho bhaviṣyatha sutarpitāḥ || 98 ||
yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ tena ekenāpi tu sattamāḥ ||
tasminnapi ca yaḥ śrāddhaṃ yuṣmākaṃ na pradāsyati|| 99 ||
śākenā'pi daridro'sāvaṃtyajatvamupeṣyati ||
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ bhojyaṃ sparśaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tathā || 6.216.100 ||
ye kariṣyaṃti taiḥ sārdhaṃ te'pi pāpatamā narāḥ ||
na teṣāṃ saṃtatirvṛddhiṃ saṃprayāsyati karhicit ||101||
na sukhaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca teṣāṃ bhāvi kathaṃcana ||
tasmādgacchata cāvyagrāḥ svasthānaṃ pitaro drutam ||102||
kalikāle'pi saṃprāpte dāruṇe nirdhene jane ||
varṣāṃte śrāddhamekaṃ hi prakariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ||103||
yenākhilaṃ bhavedvarṣaṃ yuṣmākaṃ prītiruttamā ||104||
|| || bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā pitaro hṛṣṭā jagmuḥ svaṃsvaṃ niketanam ||
varṣāṃte'pi samāsādya śrāddhaṃ na syurbubhukṣitāḥ || 105 ||
atha ye'tra durātmāno niḥśaṃkāḥ kṛpaṇātmakāḥ ||
kalinā mohitāḥ śrāddhaṃ vatsarāṃte'pi no daduḥ ||106||
teṣāṃ tu pitaro bhūyo divyaiḥpitṛbhiranvitāḥ ||
brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ procuste dīnamānasāḥ || 107 ||
bhagavanvatsarāṃte'pi kanyāsaṃsthe divākare ||
nāsmākaṃ vaṃśajāḥ śrāddhaṃ prayacchaṃti durātmakāḥ||108||
tena saṃpīḍitā deva kṣutpipāsā samākulāḥ ||
vayaṃ śaraṇamāpannāstatpratīkāramācara || 109 ||
yathā pūrvaṃ mahābhāga vadopāyaṃ laghūttamam||
ekāhikena śrāddhena yenāsmākaṃ hi śāśvatī ||
prītiḥ saṃjāyate deva tvatprasādātsureśvara || 6.216.110 ||
vaṃśakṣaye'pi saṃjāte hyasmākaṃ patanaṃ bhavet || 111 || ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā pitāmahaḥ ||
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭastataḥ provāca sādaram || 112 ||
|| brahmovāca ||
anyo yuṣmatpratuṣṭyarthamupāyaściṃtito mayā ||
sa laghuryena vo'tyaṃtaṃ tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī ||113||
gayāśiraḥ samāsādya śrāddhaṃ dāsyaṃti ye'tra vaḥ ||
apyekaṃ tatprabhāvena divyāṃ gatimavāpsyatha || 114 ||
api pāpātmanaḥ puṃso brahmaghnasyāpi dehinaḥ ||
api rauravasaṃsthasya kumbhīpākagatasya ca ||115||
pretabhāvagatasyāpi yasya śrāddhaṃ pradāsyati ||
gayāśirasi vaṃśasthastasya muktirbhaviṣyati || 116 ||
etanmama vacaḥ śrutvā sāṃprataṃ bhuvi mānavāḥ ||
niḥsvā api kariṣyaṃti śrādamekaṃ hi tatra ca ||
gayāśirasi suvyaktaṃ yuṣmākaṃ muktidāyakam || 117 ||
bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā pitarastasya vacanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
anujñātāstatastena svāni sthānāni bhejire || 118 ||
tataḥprabhṛti śrāddhāni pravṛttāni dharātale ||
piṃḍadānasame tāni yāvadāpuruṣatrayam|| 119 ||
pūrvaṃ brahmāditaḥ kṛtvā ye kecitpuruṣā gatāḥ ||
paralokaṃ samuddiśya tānnarāñchaktito nṛpa || 6.216.120 ||
tatsaṃkhyānāṃ dvijeṃdrāṇāṃ dattavaṃto'pi vāṃchitam ||
adaivatyamidaṃ śrāddhaṃ daridrāṇāṃ sukhāvaham || 121 ||
pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ sutṛpti dam ||
tasmācchrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ puruṣeṇa vijānatā || 122 ||
pitṝṇāṃ vāṃchatā tṛptiṃ kāleṣveteṣu yatnataḥ||
gayāyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa lokadvayamabhīpsatā || 123 ||
na dadāti naraḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ candrasaṃkṣaye ||
kṣutpipāsāparītāṃgāḥ pitarastasya duḥkhitāḥ || || 124 ||
pretapakṣaṃ pratīkṣaṃte guruvāṃchāsamanvitāḥ ||
karṣukā jaladaṃ yadvaddivānaktamataṃdritāḥ || 125 ||
pretapakṣe vyatikrāṃte yāvatkanyāṃ gato raviḥ ||
tāvacchrāddhaṃ ca vāṃchaṃti dattaṃ svaiḥ pitaraḥ sutaiḥ || 126 ||
tatastulāgatepyeke sūrye vāṃchaṃti pārthiva ||
śrāddhaṃ svavaṃśajai rdattaṃ kṣutpipāsāsamākulāḥ || 127 ||
tasminnapi vyatikrāṃte kāle cāṃliṃ gate ravau ||
nirāśāḥ pitaro dīnāstato yāṃti nijālayam || 128 ||
māsadvayaṃ pratīkṣaṃte gṛhadvāraṃ samāśritāḥ ||
vāyubhūtāḥ pipāsārtāḥ kṣutkṣāmāḥ pitaro nṛṇām || 129 ||
yāvatkanyāgataḥ sūryastulāsthaśca mahīpate||
tathā darśadine tadvadbrahmaṇo vacanānnṛpa || 6.216.130 ||
tasmācchrāddhaṃ sadā kāryaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimicchatā ||
tilodakaṃ viśeṣeṇa yathā brahmavaco nṛpa ||131||
vittābhāve'pi darśāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ deyaṃ vipaścitā ||
tadabhāve ca kanyāyāṃ saṃsthite divasādhipe || 132 ||
tadabhāve gayāyāṃ ca sakṛcchrāddhaṃ hi nirvapet ||
yena nityaṃ pradattasya śrāddhasya phalamaśnute || 133 ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi narādhipa ||
yenaitatkriyate śrāddhaṃ janaiḥ pitṛ parāyaṇaiḥ || 134 ||
amāvāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa pretapakṣe ca pārthiva || 135 ||
yaścaitāṃ śṛṇuyātpuṇyāṃ śrāddhotpattiṃ paṭhecca vā ||
sa sarvadoṣanirmuktaḥ śrāddhadānaphalaṃ labhet || 136 ||
śrāddhakāle paṭhedyastu śrāddhotpattimimāṃ naraḥ ||
akṣayaṃ tadbhavecchrāddhaṃ sarvacchidravivarjitam|| || 137 ||
asaddravyeṇa vā cīrṇamanarhairbrāhmaṇairapi ||
abhuktaṃ kāmahīnaṃ vā mantrahīnamathāpi vā || 138 ||
sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti kīrtanātpārthivottama|
asyāḥ śrāddhasamutpatteḥ kīrtanācchravaṇādapi || 139 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭake śvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhotpattivarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 216 || || dha ||

<6.217>

|| ānarta uvāca || ||
vidhinā yena kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ munīśvara||
tamācakṣvā'dya kārtsnyena śraddhā me mahatī sthitā|| 1 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi śrāddhasya vidhimuttamam ||
pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭidaṃ nityaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām || 2 ||
svakarmopārjitairvittaiḥ śrāddhakāryāṇi cāharet ||
māyādibhirna cauryeṇa na cchalāptairna vaṃcanaiḥ||
svavṛttyopārjitairvittaiḥ śrāddhadravyaṃ samāharet||
supratigrahajairdravyairbrāhmaṇānāṃ viśiṣyate||4||
rakṣaṇāptairnarendrasya vaiśyasya kṣetra saṃbhavaiḥ||
śūdrasya paṇyalabdhaiśca śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ prayujyate||5||
evaṃ śuddhisamopete dravye prāpte gṛhāṃtikam||
pūrvedyuḥ sāyamāsādya śrāddhārhāṇāṃ dvijanmanām|| 6 ||
gṛhaṃ gatvā śucirbhūtvā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ||
āmaṃtrayedyatīnpaścātsnātakānbrahmakarmiṇaḥ||7||
tadabhāve gṛhasthāṃśca brahmajñānaparāyaṇān|| 
agnihotraparānviprānvedavidyāvicakṣaṇān||8||
śrotriyāṃśca tathā vṛddhānṣaṭkarmaniratānsadā||
bahubhṛtyakuṭumbāṃśca daridrānsaṃyutānguṇaiḥ||9||
avyaṃgānroganirmuktāñjitāhārāṃstathā śucīn ||
ete syurbrāhmaṇā rājañchrāddhārhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 6.217.10 ||
anarhā ye ca nirdiṣṭāḥ śṛṇu tānapi vacmi te ||
hīnāṃgānadhikāṃgāṃśca sarvabhākṣannirākṛtīn || 11 ||
śyāvadantānvṛthādantānvedavikrayakārakān ||
vedaviplavakānvāpi vedaśāstravivarjitān || || 12 ||
kunakhānrogasaṃyuktāndvirnagnānparahiṃsakān||
janāpavādasaṃyuktānnāstikānṛtakānapi || 13 ||
vārdhuṣikānvikarmasthāñchaucācāravivarji tān||
atidīrghānkṛśānvāpi sthūlānapi ca lomaśān || 14 ||
nirlomānvarjayecchrāddhe ya icchetpitṛgauravam||
paradāraratā ye ca tathā yo vṛṣalī patiḥ || 15 ||
vaṃdhyā vai vṛṣalī proktā vṛṣalī ca mṛtaprajā ||
aparā vṛṣalī proktā kumārī yā rajasvalā || 16 ||
ṣaṇḍho malimluco dambhī rājapai śunyavṛttayaḥ ||
sagotrāyāśca saṃbhūtastathaikapravarāsutaḥ || 17 ||
kaniṣṭhaḥ prākkṛtādhānaḥ kṛtodvāhaśca prāktu yaḥ ||
tathā prāgdīkṣito yaśca sa tyājyo gṛhasaṃyutaḥ || 18 ||
pitṛmātṛparityāgī tathāca gurutalpagaḥ ||
nirddoṣāṃ yastyajetpatnīṃ kṛtaghno yaśca karṣukaḥ || 19 ||
śilpajīvī pramādī ca paṇya jīvī kṛtāyudhaḥ ||
etānvivarjayecchrāddhe yeṣāṃ no jñāyate kulam || 6.217.20 ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi ye śastāḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi ||
ye brāhmaṇāḥ purā khyātāḥ pāpānāṃ paṃktipāvanāḥ || 21 ||
triṇāciketastrimadhustrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṃgavit ||
yaśca vidyāvratasnāto dharmadroṇasya pāṭhakaḥ|| 22 ||
purāṇajñastathā jñānī vijñeyo jyeṣṭhasāmavit ||
atharvaśiraso vettā kratugāmī sukarmakṛt || 23 ||
sadyaḥprakṣālako yaśca śuklo dauhitra eva ca ||
jāmātā bhāgineyaśca paropakaraṇe rataḥ || 22 ||
mṛṣṭānnādo mṛṣṭavākyaḥ sadā japaparāyaṇaḥ ||
ete ? brāhmaṇā jñeyā niḥśeṣāḥ paṃktipāvanāḥ || 25 ||
etairvimiśritāḥ sarve garhitā api ye dvijāḥ ||
pitṝṇāṃ te'pi kurvaṃti tṛptiṃ bhuktvā kulodbhavāḥ || 26||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kulaṃ jñeyaṃ dbijanmanām ||
śīlaṃ paścādvayo nāma kanyādānaṃ tataḥ param || 27 ||
śrutaśīlavihīnāya dharmajñāyāpi mānavaḥ ||
śrāddhaṃ dadāti kanyāṃ ca yastenāgniṃ vinā hutam || 28 ||
ūṣare vāpi taṃ sasyaṃ tuṣāṇāṃ kaṇḍanaṃ kṛtam||
kulācārasamopetāṃstasmācchrāddhe niyojayet || 29 ||
brāhmaṇānnṛpaśārdūla mandavidyādharānapi ||
evaṃ vijñāya tānviprāngṛhītvā caraṇau tataḥ || 6.217.30 ||
prayatnena tu savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu ||
yugmānatha yathāśaktyā namaskṛtya punaḥpunaḥ || 31 ||
dakṣiṇaṃ jānvathālabhya mantramenamudīrayet ||
āgacchaṃtu mahābhāgā viśvedevā mahābalāḥ || 32 ||
bhaktyāhūtā mayā caiva tvaṃ cāpi vratabhāgbhava ||
evaṃ yugmā nsamāmaṃtrya viśvedevakṛte dvijān || 33 ||
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitrarthaṃ cābhimaṃtrayet ||
brāhmaṇāṃstrīnyathāśaktyā ekaikasya pṛthakpṛthak || 34 ||
ekaikaṃ vā trayāṇāṃ vā ekamevaṃ nimaṃtrayet ||
brāhmaṇānmātṛpakṣe ca eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 35 ||
tataḥ pādau parispṛṣṭvā dvijasyedamudīrayet ||
śraddhā pūtena manasā pitṛbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 36 ||
pitā me tava kāyesmiṃstathā caiva pitāmahaḥ ||
svapitrā sahito hyetu tvaṃ ca vrataparo bhava || 37 ||
evaṃ pitṝnsamāhūya tathā mātāmahānatha ||
saṃmaṃtritāśca te viprāḥ saṃyamātmāna eva te || 38 ||
yajamānaḥ śāṃtamanā brahmacaryasamanvitaḥ ||
tāṃ rātriṃ samatikramya prātarutthāya mānavaḥ || 39 ||
tadahni varjayetkopaṃ svādhyāyaṃ karma kutsitam ||
tailābhyaṃgaṃ śramaṃ yānaṃ vāhanaṃ cātha dūrataḥ || 6.217.40 ||
tato madhyaṃ gate sūrye kāle kutapasaṃjñite ||
snātaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ||
santuṣṭāṃśca samāhūtāṃstānviprāñchrāddhamācaret || 41 ||
vivikte gṛhamadhyasthe manojñe dakṣiṇāplave ||
na yatra jāyate dṛṣṭiḥ pāpānāṃ krūrakarmiṇām || 42 ||
yacchrāddhaṃ vīkṣate śvā vā nārī vā'tha rajasvalā ||
patito vā varāho vā tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet || 43 ||
annaṃ paryuṣitaṃ yacca tailāktaṃ vā pradīyate ||
sakeśaṃ vā saniṃdyaṃ ca tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet || 44 ||
vibhaktirahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā maunavivarjitam||
dakṣiṇārahitaṃ yacca tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet || 45 ||
gharaṭṭolūkhalotthau ca yatra śabdau vyavasthitau ||
śūrpasya vā viśeṣeṇa tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet || 46 ||
yatra saṃskriyamāṇe ca kalahaḥ saṃprajāyate ||
paṃktibhedo viśeṣeṇa tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet ||47||
pūrvāhṇe kriyate yacca rātrau vā saṃdhyayorapi ||
paryākāśe tathā deśe tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajeta || 48 ||
brāhmaṇo yajamāno vā brahmacaryaṃ vinā yadi ||
bhuṃkte dadyācca yacchrāddhaṃ tadrājanvyarthatāṃ vrajet ||49||
tuṣadhānyaṃ saniṣpāvaṃ yaccocchiṣṭaṃ ca dīyate ||
ardhabhuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet ||6.217.50||
yeṣu kāleṣu yaddattaṃ śrāddhamakṣayatāṃ vrajet ||
tānahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa || 51 ||
manvādīrapi te vacmi tāḥ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa ||
pitṝṇāṃ vallabhā nityaṃ sarvapāpakṣayāvahāḥ || 52 ||
yāsu toyamapi kṣmāyāṃ pradattaṃ tilamiśritam ||
pitṛbhyo'kṣayatāṃ yāti śraddhāpūtena cetasā || 53 ||
aśvayukchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārtikasya ca ||
tṛtīyāpi ca māghasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca || 54 ||
amāvāsyā tapasyasya pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā ||
tathā''ṣāḍhasya daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī || 55 ||
śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathā''ṣāḍhī va pūrṇimā ||
tathā kārtikamāsasya yā cānyā phālgunasya ca || 56 ||
caitrasya jyeṣṭhamāsasya paṃcaitāḥ pūrṇimā nṛpa ||
manūnāmādayaḥ proktāstithayaste mayā nṛpa || 57 ||
āsu toyamapi snātvā tila darbhavimiśritam ||
pitṝnuddiśya yo dadyātsa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 58 ||
iha loke pare caiva pitṝṇāṃ ca prasādataḥ ||
kiṃ punarvividhairannai rasairvastraiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ || 59 ||
adhunā śṛṇu rājendra yugādyāḥ pitṛvallabhāḥ ||
yāsāṃ saṃkīrtanenāpi kṣīyate pāpasaṃcayaḥ || 6.217.60 ||
navamī kārtike śuklā tṛtīyā mādhave sitā ||
amāvāsyā ca tapaso nabhasyasya trayodaśī || 61 ||
tretākṛtakalīnāṃ tu dvāparasyādayaḥ kramāt ||
snāne dāne jape home viśeṣātpitṛtarpaṇe || 62 ||
kṛtasyākṣayakāriṇyaḥ sukṛtasya mahāphalāḥ ||
yadā syānmeṣago bhānustulāṃ vātha yadā vrajet || 63 ||
tadā syādviṣuvākhyastu kālaścākṣayakārakaḥ ||
makare karkaṭe caiva yadā bhānurvrajennṛpa || 64 ||
tadāyanābhidhānastu viṣuvo'tha viśiṣyate ||
raveḥ saṃkramaṇaṃ rāśau saṃkrāṃtiriti kathyate || 65 ||
snānadānajapaśrāddhahomādiṣu mahāphalāḥ ||
tretādyāḥ kramaśaḥ proktāḥ kālāḥ saṃkrāṃtipūrvakāḥ ||
naiteṣu vidyate vighnaṃ dattasyākṣayasaṃjñitāḥ || 66 ||
aśraddhayā'pi yaddattaṃ kupātrebhyo'pi mānavaiḥ ||
akāle'pi hi tatsarvaṃ sadyo hyakṣayatāṃ vrajet || 67 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhārhapadārthabrāhmaṇakālanirṇaya varṇanaṃnāma saptadaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 217 || || a ||

<6.218>

|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
etatsāmānyataḥ proktaṃ mayā śrāddhaṃ yathā naraiḥ ||
karttavyaṃ viprapūrvairyadvarṇaiḥ pārthivasattama || 1 ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi svaśākhāyāḥ smṛtaṃ nṛpa ||
svadeśavarṇajātīyaṃ yathā syādatra nirvṛtiḥ || 2 ||
śrāddhe śraddhā yato mūlaṃ tena śrāddhaṃ prakīrtitam ||
tattasminkriyamāṇe tu na kiṃcidvyarthatāṃ vrajet || 3 ||
aniṣṭamapi rājendra tasmācchrāddhaṃ samā caret ||
viprapādodakaṃ yattu bhūmau patati pārthiva || 4 ||
jātā ye gotrajāḥ kecidaputrā maraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
te yāṃti paramāṃ tṛptimamṛtena yathā surāḥ || ||
viprapādodakaklinnā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī||
tāvatpuṣkarapātreṣu pibanti pitaro jalam||6||
śrāddhe'tha kriyamāṇe tu yatkiṃcitpatati kṣitau||
puṣpagandhodakaṃ cānnamapi toyaṃ nareśvara||7||
tena tṛptiṃ parāṃ yāṃti ye kṛmitvamupāgatāḥ||
kīṭatvaṃ vāpi tiryaktvaṃ vyālatvaṃ ca narādhipa||8||
yaducchiṣṭaṃ kṣitau yāti pātraprakṣālanodbhavam||
tena tṛptiṃ parāṃ yāṃti ye pretatvamupāgatāḥ || 9 ||
ye cāpamṛtyunā kecinmṛtyuṃ prāptāḥ svavaṃśajāḥ ||
asaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ tyāgināṃ kulayoṣitām || 6.218.10 ||
ucchiṣṭabhāgadheyaṃ syāddarbheṣu vikiraśca yaḥ ||
vikireṇa pradattena te tṛptiṃ yāṃti cākhilāḥ || || 11 ||
yatkiṃcinmaṃtrahīnaṃ vā kālahīnamathāpi vā ||
vidhihīnaṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu tadbhavet || 12 ||
tasmānna dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ vipaścitā ||
ya icchecchāśvatīṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāmātmanaśca yaḥ || 13 ||
dakṣiṇārahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ yathaivoṣaravarṣitam ||
yathā tamasi nṛtyaṃ ca gītaṃ vā badhirasya ca || 14 ||
śrāddhaṃ dattvā ca yuktvā ca śrāddhe niṣkāmatāṃ vrajet ||
na svādhyāyaḥ prakartavyo na grāmāṃtarakaṃ vrajet || 15 ||
śrāddhabhugramaṇītalpaṃ tadaharyo'dhigacchati ||
taṃ māsaṃ pitarastasya jāyaṃte vīryabhojinaḥ || 16 ||
śrāddhabhukchrāddhadātā ca yaḥ sevayati maithunam ||
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvatpitaraḥ śukrabhojinaḥ ||
prabhavaṃti na saṃdeha ityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ || 17 ||
śrāddhe bhuktvātha dattvā vā yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurutelpadhīḥ ||
svādhyāyaṃ pitarastasya yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa ||
vyarthaśrāddhaphalāḥ saṃtaḥ pīḍyaṃte kṣutpipāsayā || 18 ||
śrāddhe bhuktvā'tha dattvā vā yaḥ śrāddhaṃ mānavādhamaḥ ||
grāmātaraṃ prayātyatra tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet || 19 ||
brāhmaṇena na bhoktavyaṃ samāyāte nimaṃtraṇe ||
atha bhuṃkte ca yo mohātsa prayāti hyadhogatim || 6.218.20 ||
yajamānena ca tathā na kāryaṃ bhojanaṃ param||
kurvaṃti ye narāḥ sarve te yāṃti narakaṃ dhruvam || 21 ||
śrāddhe bhuktvā'tha dattvā vā śrāddhaṃ yo yuddhamācaret||
asaṃdigdhaṃ hi tacchrāddhaṃ sa mando vyarthataṃ nayet || 22 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena doṣānetānparityajet ||
śrāddhabhugyajamānaśca viśeṣeṇa mahīpate || 23 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhaniyamavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 218 || || 9 ||

<6.219>

|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
kāmyāni te'dhunā vacmi śrāddhāni pṛthivīpate ||
yaiḥ kṛtaiḥ samavāpnoti martyo hṛdayasaṃsthitam ||1||
yo nārīṃ vāṃchate kṣmāpa rūpāḍhyāṃ śīlamaṇḍanām ||
iha loke pare caiva tasyārhaṃ prathamaṃ dinam || 2||
śrāddhīyapretapakṣasya mukhyabhūtaṃ ca yannṛpa ||
ya icchetkanyakāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ suśīlāṃ rūpasaṃyu tām ||
dvitīyādivase tena śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ mahīpate || 3 ||
yo vāṃchati naro'śvāṃśca vāyuvegasamāñjave ||
tṛtīyādivase śrāddhaṃ tena kāryaṃ vipaścitā || 4 ||
yo vāṃchati paśūnmukhyānkupyākupyadhanāni ca ||
caturthyāṃ tena kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ pitṛpratuṣṭaye || 5 ||
putrānvāṃchati yo'bhīṣṭānsuśīlānvaṃśamaṃḍanān ||
pañcamyāṃ tena kartavyaṃ sadā śrāddhaṃ narādhipa || 6 ||
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ vaṃśajairdattaṃ paralokagato nṛpa ||
vāṃchate tena kartavyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śrāddhaṃ vipaścitā || 7 ||
kṛṣisiddhiṃ ya iccheta graiṣmikīṃ śāradīmapi ||
saptamyāṃ yujyate tasya śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 8 ||
ya icchetpaṇyasaṃsiddhiṃ vyavahārasamudbhavām ||
aṣṭamyāṃ yujyate śrāddhaṃ tasya kartuṃ narādhipa || 9 ||
navamyāṃ śrāddhakṛnnānā catuṣpadagaṇāllam̐bhet ||
saubhāgyaṃ roganāśaṃ ca tathā vallabhasaṃgamam || 6.219.10 ||
daśamīdivase śrāddhaṃ yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ ||
tasya syādvāṃchitā siddhiḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā || 11 ||
ekādaśyāṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ śrāddhakartā labhennaraḥ ||
tathā bhūpaprasādaṃ ca yaccānyanmanasi sthitam || 12 ||
yaḥ karoti ca dvādaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
putrāṃstu pravarāṃścaiva sa paśūnvāṃchitāllam̐bhet || || 13 ||
yo vāṃchati naro muktiṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha cātmanaḥ ||
asaṃtānaśca yastasya śrāddhe proktā trayodaśī || 14 ||
saṃtānakāmo yaḥ kuryāttasya vaṃśakṣayo bhavet ||
na saṃtānavivṛddhayai ca tasya proktā trayodaśī || 15 ||
śrāddhakarmaṇi rājeṃdra śrutireṣā purātanī ||
api naḥ sa kule bhūyādyo no dadyāttrayodaśīm || 16 ||
pāyasaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca ||
maghātrayodaśīyoge pāyasena yajetpitṝn || 17 ||
pitarastasya necchaṃti tadvarṣaṃ śrāddhasatkriyām ||
puṇyātiśayabhītena piṃḍadānaṃ nirākṛtam || 18 ||
śakreṇa taddine putramaraṇaṃ darśitaṃ bhayam ||
yeṣāṃ ca śastramṛtyuḥ syādapamṛtyurathāpi vā || 19 ||
upasargamṛtānāṃ ca viṣamṛtyumupeyuṣām ||
vahninā tu pradagdhānāṃ jalamṛtyu mupeyuṣām || 6.219.20 ||
sarpavyālahatānāṃ ca śṛṃgairudbandhanairapi ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ prakartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa || 21 ||
teṣāṃ tasminkṛte tṛptistatastatpakṣajā bhavet || 22 ||
sarve kāmāḥ puraḥ proktā yuṣmākaṃ ye mayā nṛpa ||
amāvāsyādine śrāddhāttānāpnoti na saṃśa yaḥ || 23 ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kāmyaśrāddhaphalaṃ nṛpa ||
yacchrutvā vāṃchitānkāmānsarvānāpnoti mānavaḥ || 24 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe kāmyaśrāddhavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśottaradviśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ || 219 || || cha ||

<6.220>

|| ānarta uvāca || ||
trayodaśyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe kasmādvaṃśakṣayo bhavet ||
etanme sarvamācakṣva vistarāttvaṃ mahā mune||
bhartṛyajña uvāca||
eṣā medhyatamā rājanyugādiḥ kalisaṃbhavā||
snāne dāne jape home śrāddhe jñeyā tathā'kṣayā || 2 ||
asyāṃ cettu gajacchāyā tithau rājanprajāyate ||
tadā'kṣayaṃ maghāyoge śrāddhaṃ saṃjāyate dhruvam||3||
yaḥ kṣīraṃ madhunā yuktaṃ tasminnahani yacchati ||
pitṝnuddiśya yo māṃsaṃ dadyādvādhrīṇasaṃ ca yaḥ || 4 ||
vādhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī ||
triḥpibaṃtviṃdriyakṣīṇaṃ śvetaṃ vṛddhamajāpatim || 5 ||
taṃ tu vādhrīṇasaṃ vidyātsarvayūthādhipaṃ tathā ||
khaḍgamāṃsaṃ ca vā dadyāttṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī ||
saṃjāyate na saṃdehasteṣāṃ vākyaṃ na me mṛṣā || 6 ||
āsīdrathaṃtare kalpe pūrvaṃ pārthivasattamaḥ||
sitāśvo nāma pāṃcāladeśīyaḥpitṛbhaktimān||7||
madhunā kālaśākena khaḍgamāṃsena kevalam ||
sa hi śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ kuru te pāyasena ca || 8 ||
somavaṃśaṃ samuddiśya śrāddhaṃ yacchati bhaktitaḥ ||9||
atha tairbāhmaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sa bhūyaḥ kautukānvitaiḥ ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya pṛṣṭo bhuktvā yathecchayā || 6.220.10 ||
śrāddhādanaṃtaraṃ rājandṛṣṭvā taṃ śraddhayā'nvitam ||
pādāvamarddanaparaṃ praṇipātapuraḥ saram ||11||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ mahārāja pradātavyā'tha dakṣiṇā ||
brāhmaṇebhyastataḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ copatiṣṭhati || 12 ||
sā tvayā kalpitā'smākaṃ vitīrṇādyāpi no nṛpa|
kupyākupyaṃ parityajya tāṃ dehi nṛpa mā ciram || 13 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
tacchrutvā ca nṛpaḥ prāha saṃprahṛṣṭena cetasā ||
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi viprairadya na saṃśayaḥ || 14 ||
ye vāṃchaṃti mamābhīṣṭaṃ śrāddhe bhuktvā'tha paitṛke ||
tasmādbrūta mahābhāgā yuṣmabhyaṃ kiṃ dadāmyaham || 15 ||
vara nnāgānmadonmattānbhadrajātisamudbhavān ||
kiṃ vā saptipradhānāṃśca manomārutaraṃhasaḥ || 16 ||
kiṃ vā sthānāni citrāṇi grāmāṇi nagarāṇi ca ||
pitṝnuddiśya yatkiṃcinnādeyaṃ vidyate yataḥ || 17 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
nāsmākaṃ vājibhiḥ kāryaṃ na ratnairna ca hastibhiḥ ||
na deśairgrāmamukhyairvā nānyenāpi ca kenacit || 18 ||
yadarthena mahārāja pṛṣṭosmābhiryato bhavān ||
tasmānno dakṣiṇāṃ dehi saṃdehaghnāṃ tapottama || 19 ||
yāṃ pṛcchāmo vayaṃ sarve kautūhalasamāhitāḥ || 6.220.20 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
upadeśādhikāro'sti brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ||
dātuṃ naiva grahītuṃ ca nī cajātyasya vaidikāḥ || 21 ||
so'haṃ rājā na sarvajño yo yacchāmi dvijottamāḥ ||
upadeśaṃ hi yuṣmabhyaṃ sarvajñebhyo vicakṣaṇāḥ || 22 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
guruśiṣyasamuttho'yamupadeśo mahīpate ||
prārthayāmo vayaṃ kiṃcinmā bhayaṃ tvaṃ samāviśa || 23 ||
vayaṃ ca praśnamekaṃ hi pṛcchāmo yadi bhūpate ||
brūṣe kautukayuktānāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām || 24 ||
tasmādvada mahābhāga yadi jānāsi tattvataḥ ||
na cedguhyatamaṃ kiṃcitpṛcchāmastvāṃ kutūhalāt || 25 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
yadi vaḥ saṃśayo viprā yuṣmatpraśnamasaṃśayam ||
kathayiṣyābhi cedguhyaṃ tadvaddhvaṃ gapla? jvarāḥ || 26 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
anneṣu ca vicitreṣu lehyeṣu vividheṣu ca ||
amṛteṣveṣu sarveṣu tathā peyeṣu pārthiva || || 27 ||
tasmādadya dine brūhi madhu yacchasi garhitam ||
vartate ca yathā'bhakṣyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 28 ||
tathā vicitra māseṣu saṃsthiteṣu narādhipa ||
khaṅgamāṃsaṃ nirāsvādaṃ kasmādyacchasi kevalam || 29 ||
saṃti śākāni rājendra pāvanīyāni sarvaśaḥ ||
suṣṭhu svādu karāṇyatra vyañjanārthaṃ mahīpate || 6.220.30 ||
kālaśākaṃ sakaṭukaṃ mukhā''dhijanakaṃ mahat ||
kasmādyacchasi cāsmākaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ||
na śrāddhe pratiṣedhaśca prakartavyaḥ kathaṃcana || 31 ||
na ca tyājyaṃ samucchiṣṭaṃ tena bhuṃjāmahe tataḥ ||
tadatra kāraṇenaiva guruṇā bhāvyameva hi ||
yena tvaṃ yacchasi prāya etatsiddhirbhavetsthitā || 32 ||
tasmātkathaya naḥ sarvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ ||
niḥsvāditaṃ yathā dadyādīdṛkchrāddhe vigarhitam || 33 ||
yathā tvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla śraddhayā saṃprayacchasi || 34 ||
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ||
sa vailakṣyasmitaṃ prāha salajjaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 35 ||
guhyametanmahābhāgā asmākaṃ yadi saṃsthitam ||
avācyamapi vakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 36 ||
ahamāsaṃ purā pāpo lubdhakaścānya janmani ||
nihaṃtā sarvajaṃtūnāṃ tathā bhakṣayitā punaḥ || 37 ||
paryaṭāmi tadāraṇye dhanuṣā mṛgayārataḥ ||
siṃho vyāghro gajendro vā śarabho vā dvijo ttamāḥ || 38 ||
madbāṇagocaraṃ prāpto na jīvatyapi karhicit ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhramamāṇo mahītale || 39 ||
saṃprāpto'haṃ mahābhāgā agni veśasya sanmuneḥ ||
āśrame samanuprāpto niśīthe kṣutpipāsitaḥ || 6.220.40 ||
tāvattatra saśiṣyāṇāṃ śrāddhakarmavidhiṃ vadan||
saṃsthito veṣṭitaḥ śiṣyaiḥ samantāddvijasattamāḥ || 41 ||
|| agniveśa uvāca || ||
ṛkṣe pitrye yadā candro haṃsaścāpi kare vrajet ||
trayodaśī tu sā cchāyā vijñeyā kuñjarodbhavā || 42 ||
pitrye yadāsthitaścendurhaṃsaścāpi kare sthitaḥ ||
tithirvaiśravaṇī yā ca sā cchāyā kuñjarasya ca || 43 ||
saiṃhikeyo yadā caṃdraṃ grasate parvasaṃdhiṣu ||
hasticchāyā tu sā jñeyā tasyāṃ śrāddhaṃ samācaret || 44 ||
tasyāṃ yaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ jalairapi prabhaktitaḥ ||
yāvaddvādaśa varṣāṇi pitarastasya tarpitāḥ || 45 ||
vanaspatigate some yā cchāyā pūrvatomukhī ||
gajacchāyā tu sā jñeyā pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayam || 46 ||
sā bhavecca na sandehaḥ puṇyadā paitṛkī tithiḥ ||
tasyāṃ śrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhṛtāśca ye || 47 ||
prabhāte tu na sandehaḥ pitṝṇāṃ paritṛptaye ||
śākaistathaiṃgudairbilvairbadaraiścirbhaṭairapi || 48| ||
yadannaṃ puruṣo'śnāti tadannāstasya devatāḥ ||
bāḍhamityeva te procya gatāḥ svaṃsvaṃ niketanam || 49 ||
sarve śiṣyā mahābhāgāḥ nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ ||
agniveśyo'pi suṣvāpa samāmantrya dvijottamān|| 6.220.50 ||
tena saṃkathyamānaṃ ca rātrau tacca śrutaṃ mayā ||
ahaṃ cāpi kariṣyāmi prātaḥ śrāddhamasaṃśayam || 51 ||
nihatya khaḍgamādāya tasya māṃsaṃ supuṣkalam ||
tathā madhu samādāya kālaśākaṃ viśeṣataḥ || || 52 ||
svajātīyebhya ādāya tarpayiṣyāmi tānpitṝn || 53 ||
evaṃ niścitya manasā prasupto'haṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṇḍale ||54||
madhujālāni bhūrīṇi gṛhītāni mayā tataḥ ||
kālaśākaṃ tathā labdhaṃ svecchayā dvijasattamāḥ ||55||
tataḥ sarvaṃ samādāya śrapitaṃ tatkṣaṇānmayā ||
snātvā ca nijavargāṇāṃ pitṝnuddiśya cātmanaḥ ||
pradattaṃ lubdhakānāṃ ca bhaktipūrvaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 56 ||
evaṃ mayā purā dattaṃ pitṝ nuddiśya tānnijān ||
nānyatkiṃcinmayā dattaṃ kadācitkasyacidvijāḥ || 57 ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā mṛtyuṃ prāpto'smyahaṃ dvijāḥ ||
taddānasya prabhāvena pārthivīṃ yonimāśritaḥ || 58 ||
evaṃ jātismaratvaṃ ca sañjātaṃ me dvijottamāḥ ||
te ca me tarpitāstena khaḍgamāṃsena mākṣikaiḥ ||59 ||
saṃprāptāḥ paramāṃ prītiṃ tato dvāśavārṣikīm ||
etasmātkāraṇācchrāddhaṃ prakaromi dvijottamāḥ || 6.220.60 ||
khaḍgamāṃsena madhunā kālaśākena bhūriśaḥ ||
vidhihīnaṃ dvijairhīnaṃ tiladarbhairvivarjitam || 61 ||
mayā tadvihitaṃ śrāddhaṃ tasyaitatphalamāgatam ||
sāṃprataṃ vidhinā samyagbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ || 62 ||
upaviṣṭaiḥ karomyeva yacchrāddhaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ||
darbhaistilaiḥ samopetaṃ mantravacca dvijottamāḥ || 63 ||
no jānāmi phalaṃ kiṃ vā sāṃprataṃ ca bhaviṣyati ||
tasmādevaṃ parijñāya yūyaṃ caiva dvijottamāḥ || 64 ||
saṃtarpayadhvaṃ ca pitṝnnijāngajadine sthite ||
chāyāyāṃ caiva jātāyāṃ kuñjarasya dvijottamāḥ ||65||
yena saṃjāyate tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ dvādaśābdikī ||
yuṣmākaṃ ca gatiḥ śreṣṭhā yathā jātā mamādhunā || 66 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve te brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||
saṃtuṣṭāḥ sādhuvādāṃśca dadustasya mahīpateḥ || 67 ||
tataḥprabhṛti cakruste śrāddhāni dvijasattamāḥ ||
trayodaśyāṃ nabhasyasya kṛṣṇāyāṃ bhaktitatparāḥ || 68 ||
madhunā kālaśākena khaḍgamāṃsena tarpitāḥ ||
prāpnuvaṃti parāṃ siddhiṃ vimānavaramāsthitāḥ || 69 ||
spardhaṃte sahitā daivaiḥ pitaraśca viśeṣataḥ ||
vaṃśajena pradattasya prabhāvātsurasattamāḥ || 6.220.70 ||
śrāddhārthaṃ saṃparijñāya mantraṃ cakruḥ parasparam ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā nāsatyāvapi pārthiva || 71 ||
yathā na bhavati śrāddhaṃ tasminnahani bhūtale ||
yatprabhāvādvayaṃ sarve mānuṣaiḥ śrāddhamāśritaiḥ ||
na yāmo'bhibhavasthānaṃ tasmācchapsyāmahe ca tān || 72 |1
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ kariṣyati ||
kanyāsaṃsthe sahasrāṃśau tasya syādvaṃśasaṃkṣayaḥ ||73||
iti śāpena devānāṃ nirdagdheyaṃ mahātithiḥ || 74 ||
tataḥprabhṛti naitasyā kriyate śrāddhamuttamam ||
yaḥ pramādena kurute tasya syādvaṃśa saṃkṣayaḥ || 76 ||
yena bhītā na kurvaṃti cchāyāyāṃ kuñjarasya ca ||
viśeṣeṇa gajacchāye tatra piṇḍo'yamāhṛtaḥ || 73 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe gajacchāyāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatyuttaradviśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ || 220 || || cha ||

<6.221>

|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
etasmātkāraṇātkaścittasminnahani pārthiva ||
dadāti naiva ca śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya karhicit ||
vaṃśacchedabhayādrājansatyametanmayoditam || 1 ||
śrāddhaṃ vināpi dātavyaṃ taddine madhunā saha ||
pāyasaṃ brāhmaṇāgryebhyaḥ saghṛtaṃ tṛptikāraṇāt || 2 ||
khaḍgamāṃsaṃ kālaśākaṃ māṃsaṃ vādhrīṇasodbhavam ||
pradeyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaśca tatsamaṃtādudāhṛtam || 3 ||
triḥpibaśceṃdriyakṣīṇaḥ sarvayūthānugastathā ||
eṣa vādhrīṇasaḥ proktaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaḥ sadā || 4 ||
tasyābhāve'pi dātavyaṃ kṣīraudanamanuttamam ||
tasminnahani viprebhyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭaye nṛpa || 5 ||
tasyābhāve'pi dātavyaṃ jalaṃ tilavimiśritam||
sadarbhaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca hiraṇyaśakalānvitam || 6 ||
yacchreyo jāyate puṃsaḥ pakṣaśrāddhena pārthiva ||
kṛtena tatphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tasminnahani pārthiva || 7 ||
pitṝnuddiśya cā''jyena madhunā pāyasena ca ||
kālaśākena madhunā khaḍgamāṃsena vā nṛpa || 8 ||
śrāddhaṃ vināpi dattena śrutireṣā purātanī ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pitryarkṣye samupasthite ||
trayodaśyāṃ nabhasyasya hastage dinanāyake || 9 ||
daridreṇāpi dātavyaṃ hiraṇyaśakalānvitam ||
toyaṃ tilairyutaṃ rājanpitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭimicchatā || 6.221.10 || ||
|| ānarta uvāca || ||
māṃsaṃ vigarhitaṃ vipra yataḥ śāstre nigadyate ||
tasmāttatkriyate kena śrāddhaṃ kīrtaya me'khilam || 11 ||
svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayati nirdayaḥ ||
sa nūnaṃ narakaṃ yāti proktametanmaharṣibhiḥ || 12 ||
tvaṃ ca tasya prabhāvaṃ me prajalpasi dvijo ttama ||
viśeṣācchrāddhakṛtye ca tadevaṃ mama saṃśayaḥ || 13 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
satyametanmahābhāga māṃsaṃ sadbhirvigarhitam ||
śrāddhe prayujyate yasmāttatte'haṃ vacmi kāraṇam || 14 ||
yadā cāraṃbhitā sṛṣṭirbrahmaṇā lokakāriṇā ||
saṃpūjya ca pitṝndevānnāṃdīmukhapuraḥsarān||
tadā khaḍgaḥ samutpannaḥ pūrvaṃ vādhrīṇasaśca yaḥ || 15 ||
tato ye pitaro divyā ye ca mānuṣasambhavāḥ ||
jagṛhuste tataḥ sarve balibhūtamivātmanaḥ || 16 ||
tānuvāca tato brahmā etau tu pitaro mayā ||
yuṣmabhyaṃ kalpitau samyagbalibhūtau pragṛhyatām || 17 ||
etābhyāṃ paramā prītiryuṣmabhyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ parametau naro bhuvi || 18 ||
naiva saṃprāpsyate pāpaṃ yuṣmadarthaṃhanannapi ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 19 ||
khaḍgavādhrīṇasodbhūtaṃ māṃsaṃ śrāddhe sutṛptidam ||
tau cāpi paramau divyau svargaṃ lokaṃ gamiṣyataḥ || 6.221.20 ||
śrāddhadasya paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati sudurlabham ||
pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayā tṛptirbhaveddvādaśavārṣikī || 21 ||
etasmātkāraṇācchastaṃ māṃsamābhyāṃ narādhipa ||
tasminnahani nānyatra viniyogo'sya kīrtitaḥ || 22 ||
|| rohitāśva uvāca || ||
aprāptakhaḍgamāṃsasya tathā vādhrīṇasasya ca ||
kathaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavedvipra pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikā rakam || 23 ||
|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || ||
madhunā saha dātavyaṃ pāyasaṃ pitṛtuṣṭaye ||
tena vai vārṣikī tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ copajāyate || 24 ||
ājaṃ ca piśitaṃ rājañchiśumārasamudbhavam||
māṃsaṃ pratuṣṭaye proktaṃ vatsaraṃ māsavarjitam || 25 ||
tadabhāve varāhasya daśamāsapratuṣṭidam ||
māṃsaṃ proktaṃ mahārāja pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 26 ||
āraṇyamahiṣotthena tṛptiḥ syānnavamāsikī ||
ruroścaivāṣṭamāsotthā eṇasya saptamāsikā || 27 ||
śambarormāsaṣaṭkaṃ ca śaśakasya tu pañcakam ||
catvāraḥ śallakasyoktāstrayo vā taittirasya ca || 28 ||
māsadvayaṃ ca matsyasya māsamekaṃ kapiñjale ||
nānyeṣāṃ yojayenmāṃsaṃ pitṛkārye kathaṃcana || 29 ||
eteṣāmeva māṃsāni pāvanāni nṛpottama || 6.221.30 ||
|| ānarta uvāca || ||
kasmādete pavitrāḥ syuryeṣāṃ māṃsaṃ pracoditam ||
śrāddhe ca tanmamācakṣva yathāvaddvijasattama || 31 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
sṛṣṭiṃ prakurvatā tena paśavo lokakāriṇā ||
khaḍgavādhrīṇasādīnāṃ paścātsṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā || 32 ||
ekādaśapramāṇena tataścānye nṛpottama ||
ajaśca prathamaṃ sṛṣṭaḥ sa tathā medhyatāṃ gataḥ || 33 ||
tathaite prathamaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ paśavo'tra narādhipa ||
sasyāni sṛjatā tena tilāḥ pūrvaṃ ca nirmitāḥ || 34 ||
śrāddhārthaṃ vrīhayaḥ sṛṣṭā vanyeṣu ca priyaṃgavaḥ||
godhūmāśca yavāścaiva māṣā mudrāśca vai nṛpa || 35 ||
nīvārāścāpi śyāmākāḥ pravakṣyāmi yathākramam ||
tṛptiṃ māṃsena vāñchaṃti māṃsaṃ māṃsena varjitam || 36 ||
puṣpajātyo yadā sṛṣṭāstadā prākchatapatrikā ||
sṛṣṭā tena ca mukhyā sā śrāddhakarmaṇi sarvadā || 37 ||
dhātūni sṛjatā tena rūpyaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā ||
tena tadvihitaṃ śrāddhe dakṣiṇāyāṃ pratṛptaye||38||
rājateṣu ca pātreṣu yaddvijebhyaḥ pradīyate||
pitṛbhyastasya naivā'nto yugānte'pi prajāyate || 39 ||
abhāve rūpyapātrāṇāṃ nāmāpi parikīrtayet ||
tuṣyaṃti pitaro rājankīrtanādapi vai yataḥ || 6.221.40 ||
rasāṃśca sṛjatā tena madhu sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā ||
tena tacchasyate śrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭidāyakam || 41 ||
yacchrāddhaṃ madhunā hīnaṃ tadrasaiḥ sakalairapi ||
miṣṭānnairapi saṃyuktaṃ tatpitṝṇāṃ na tṛptaye || 42 ||
aṇumātramapi śrāddhe yadi na syāddhi mākṣikam ||
nāmāpi kīrtayettasya pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭaye yataḥ || 43 ||
śākāni sṛjatā tena brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinau ||
kālaśākaṃ puraḥ sṛṣṭaṃ tena tattṛptidāyakam || 44 ||
kālaṃ hi sṛjatā tena kutapaḥ prāgvinirmitaḥ ||
tasmātkutapa kāle ca śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā ||
ya icchecchāśvatīṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāmātmanaḥ sukham || 45 ||
vīrudhaḥ sṛjatā tena vidhinā nṛpasattama ||
darbhāstu prathamaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ śrāddhārhāstena te smṛtāḥ || 46 ||
śrāddhārhānbrāhmaṇāṃstena sṛjatā padmayoninā ||
dauhitrāḥ prathamaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ śrāddhārhāstena te smṛtāḥ || ||47 ||
api śaucaparityaktaṃ hīnāṃgādhikameva vā ||
dauhitraṃ yojayecchrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye || 48 ||
paśūnvisṛjatā tena pūrvaṃ gāvo vinirmitāḥ||
tena tāsāṃ payaḥ śastaṃ śrāddhe sarpirviśeṣataḥ || 49 ||
tasmācchrāddhe ghṛtaṃ śastaṃ pradattaṃ pitṛtuṣṭaye || 6.221.50 ||
prajāśca sṛjatā tena pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā dvijottamāḥ ||
tasmātpraśastāste śrāddhe pitṛtṛptikarāḥ sadā || 51 ||
devāṃśca sṛjatā tena viśvedevāḥ kṛtāḥ puraḥ ||
tena te prathamaṃ pūjyāḥ pravṛtte śrāddhakarmaṇi || 52 ||
te rakṣaṃti tataḥ śrāddhaṃ yathāvatparitarpitāḥ ||
chidrāṇi nāśayaṃti sma śrāddhe pūrvaṃ prapūjitāḥ || 53 ||
etairmukhyatamaiḥ sṛptaiḥ phūrā śrāddhaṃ vinirmitam ||
svayaṃ pitāmahenaiva tato devā vinirmitāḥ || 54 ||
tena te sarvalokeṣu gatāḥ khyātiṃ purā nṛpa || 55 ||
etacchrādsya satratvaṃ mayā te parikīrtitam ||
pitṝṇāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ dattasyākṣayakārakam || 56 ||
yaścaitatkīrtayecchrāddhe kriyamāṇe nṛpottama ||
viprāṇāṃ bhokttukāmānāṃ tacchrāddhaṃ tvakṣayaṃ bhavet ||57||
yaścaitackṛṇuyādrājansamyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
vihitasya bhavetpuṇyaṃ yacchrāddhasya tadāpnuyāt ||58||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakerakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe sṛṣṭyutpattikālikabrahmotsṛṣṭaśrāddhārhavastuparigaṇanavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 221 || || cha ||

<6.222>

|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
yeṣāṃ ca śastramṛtyuḥ syādapamṛtyurathāpi vā ||
upasargānmṛtānāṃ ca viṣamṛtyumupeyuṣām || 1 ||
vahninā ca pradagdhānāṃ jalamṛtyumupeyuṣām ||
sarpavyāghrahatānāṃ ca śṛṃgairudbandhanairapi || 2 ||
śrāddhaṃ teṣāṃ prakartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa ||
teṣāṃ tasminkṛte tṛptistatastatpakṣajā bhavet || 3 ||
|| ānarta uvāca || ||
kasmācchastrahatānāṃ ca proktā śrāddhe caturdaśī ||
nānyeṣāṃ divase tatra saṃśayo'yaṃ vadasva me || 4 ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ na śaṃsaṃti sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ param ||
kasmāttatra prakartavyaṃ vadaitanmama vista rāt || 5||
kasmānna pārvaṇaṃ tatra kriyate divase sthite ||
pretapakṣe viśeṣeṇa kṛte śrāddhe'khile'pi ca || 6 ||
|| bhartṛyajñauvāca|| ||
bṛhatkalpe purā rājanhiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ ||
babhūva balavāñchūraḥ sarvadevabhayaṃkaraḥ || 7 ||
brahmā pratoṣitastena vidhāya vividhaṃ tapaḥ ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa nabhasye māsi saṃsthite || 8 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
parituṣṭosmi te vatsa prārthayasva yathepsitam ||
adeyamapi dāsyāmi tasmātprārthaya mā ciram ||9 || ||
|| hiraṇyākṣa uvāca || ||
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ ||
bubhukṣitāḥ prayācaṃte māṃ nityaṃ padmasaṃbhava || 6.222.10 ||
pretapakṣe kṛte śrāddhe kanyāsaṃsthe divākare ||
ekasminnahani prāyastṛptiḥ syādvarṣasaṃbhavā || 11 ||
tattvamadya dinaṃ dehi tebhyaḥ kamalasambhava ||
tena tṛptiṃ gatāḥ sarve sthāsyaṃtyabdaṃ pitāmaha || 12 ||
|| śrībrahmovāca || ||
yaḥ kaścinmānavaḥ śrāddhaṃ svapitṛbhyaḥ pradāsyati ||
pretapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ nabhasye mā si saṃsthite||13||
pretānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca bhūtādīnāṃ bhaviṣyati||
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ ye cānye kīrtitāstvayā||14||
durmṛtyunā mṛtā ye ca saṃgrāmeṣu hatāśca ye ||
ekoddiṣṭe sutairdatte teṣāṃ tṛptirbhaviṣyati || 15 ||
evamuktvā tato brahmā tataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||
hiraṇyākṣo'pi saṃhṛṣṭaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ yayau || 16 ||
yacca śastrahatānāṃ ca tasminnahani dīyate ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ naraiḥ śrāddhaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi kāraṇam|| 17 ||
saṃkhye śastrahatā ye ca nirvikalpena cetasā ||
yudhyamānā na te martye jāyate manujāḥ punaḥ || 18 ||
parāṅmukhāśca hanyaṃte palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ ||
te bhavaṃti narāḥ pretā etadāha pitāmahaḥ ||19||
sammukhā api ye dainyaṃ hanyamānā vadaṃti ca ||
paścāttāpaṃ ca vā kuryuḥ prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ||6.222.20||
te'pi pretā bhavantīha manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt||
kadāciccittacalanaṃ śūrāṇāmapi jāyate || 21 ||
teṣāṃ bhrāṃtyā dine tatra śrāddhaṃ deyaṃ nijaiḥ sutaiḥ ||
apamṛtyumṛtānāṃ ca sarveṣāmapi dehinām || 22 ||
pretatvaṃ jāyate yasmāttasmācchrāddhasya taddinam ||
śrāddhārhaṃ pārthivaśreṣṭha viśeṣeṇa prakīrtitam || 23 ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ prakartavyaṃ yasmāttatra dine naraiḥ ||
sapiṃḍīkaraṇādūrdhvaṃ tatte vakṣyābhi kāraṇam || 24 ||
yadi pretatvamāpannaḥ kadācitsvapitā bhavet |
tṛptyarthaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatra dine nṛpa ||25||
pitāmahādyāstatrāhni śrāddhaṃ nārhaṃti kutracit ||
atha cedbhrāṃtito dadyāddhiyate(?) rākṣasaistu tat || 26 ||
brahmaṇo vacanādrājanbhūtapretaiśca dānavaiḥ ||
tenaikoddiṣṭamevātra kartavyaṃ na tu pārvaṇam || 27 ||
pitṛpakṣe caturdaśyāṃ kanyāsaṃsthe divākare ||
pitāmaho na gṛhṇāti pitrā tena samaṃ tadā || 28 ||
na ca tasya pitā rājaṃstathaiva prapitāmahaḥ || 29 ||
etasmātkāraṇādrājanpārvaṇaṃ na vidhīyate ||
tasminnahani saṃprāpte vyarthaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavedyataḥ || 6.222.30 ||
nānyasthānodbhavairvipraiḥ śrāddhakarmavratāni ca ||
nāgaro nāgaraiḥ kuryādanyathā tadvṛthā bhavet || 31 ||
anyasthānodbhavairviprairyacchrāddhaṃ kriyate dhruvam ||
saṃpūrṇaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti nāgarāṇāṃ kriyāparaiḥ || 32 ||
athācāraparibhraṣṭāḥ śrāddhārhā eva nāgarāḥ ||
valīvardasamāno'pi jñātīyo yadi labhyate ||
kimanyairbahubhirviprairvedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ || 33 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddha kalpe caturdaśīśastrahataśrāddhanirṇayavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 222 || ||9||

<6.223>

|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
śrāddhārhairbrāhmaṇaiḥ kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ darśe tu pārvaṇam||
viparītaṃ na kartavyaṃ śrāddhamekaṃ kathaṃcana || 1 ||
jārajātāpaviddhādyairyo naraḥ śrāddhamācaret ||
brāhmaṇaistu na saṃdehastacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet || 2 ||
|| ānarta uvāca || ||
bhayaṃ me sumahajjātamatra yatparikīrtitam ||
jārajātāpaviddhaistu yacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ vrajet || 3 ||
manunā dvādaśa proktāḥ kila putrā mahāmate ||
aputrāṇāṃ ca putratvaṃ ye kurvaṃti sadaiva hi || 4 ||
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścaiva krayakrītaśca pālitaḥ ||
pratipannaḥ sahoḍhaśca kānīnaścāpi sattama||5||
tathānyau kuṇḍagolau ca putrāvapi prakīrtitau ||6||
śiṣyaśca rakṣito mṛtyostathāśvattho vanāṃtigaḥ ||
kimete naiva kathitā yattvamevaṃ prajalpasi || 7 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
satyametanmahābhāga sarve te dharmataḥ sutāḥ ||
paraṃ yugatraye proktā na kalau kaluṣāpahāḥ || || 8 ||
tadarthaṃ teṣu santānaṃ tāvanmātraṃ yugeyuge ||
sattvāḍhyānāṃ ca lokānāṃ na kalau cālpamedhasām || 9 ||
kalāveva samākhyāto vyavahāraḥ prapā tadaḥ ||
alpasattvā yato lokāstena caiṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 6.223.10 ||
atra yaḥ saṃkaraṃ kuryādyonestasya phalaṃ śṛṇu ||
brāhmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇātputro brahmaghnaḥ saṃprajāyate || 11 ||
sarvādhamānāmadhamo yo vāraḍa iti smṛtaḥ || 12 ||
kṣatriyācca tathā sūto vaiśyānmāgadha eva ca ||
śūdrāttathāṃtyajaḥ proktastenaite varjitāḥ sutāḥ || 13 ||
eteṣāmapi nirdiṣṭāḥ sapta rājansuputrakāḥ ||
paṃca vaṃśavināśāya pūrveṣāṃ pātanāya ca || 14 ||
aurasaḥ pratipannaśca krītaḥ pālita eva ca ||
śiṣyaśca dattajīvaśca tathāśvatthaśca saptamaḥ || 15 ||
puṃnāmno narakādghorādrakṣaṃti ca sadā hi te ||
patantaṃ puruṣaṃ tatra tena te śobhanāḥ smṛtāḥ || 16 ||
kṣetrajaśca sahoḍhaśca kānīnaḥ kuṇḍagolakau ||
paṃcaite pātayaṃtisma pitṝnsvargagatānapi || 17 ||
etasmātkāraṇācchrāddhaṃ jārajātasya tadvṛthā || 18 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhārhānarhabrāhmaṇādivarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 223 || cha ||

<6.224>

|| ānartauvāca || ||
śrutā mayā mahābhāga śrāddhārhā brāhmaṇāśca ye ||
ye ca tyājyāstathā putrā bahavaścaiva suvrata || 1 ||
sāṃprataṃ kathayā'smākaṃ mantrapūrvaśca yo vidhiḥ ||
gṛhasthena sadā kāryaḥ pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye || 2 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
praṇamyāmaṃtritā ye ca śrādrārthaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||
ānīya kutape kāle tānsarvānprārthayedi dam || 3 ||
āgacchaṃtu mahābhāgā viśvedevā mahābalāḥ ||
ye yatra vihitāḥ śrāddhe sāvadhānā bhavaṃtu te || 4 ||
evamabhyarcya tānsarvāṃstataḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām||
jānunī bhūtale nyasya tataścārghaṃ pradāpayet || 5 ||
maṃtreṇānena rājeṃdra sapuṣpākṣatacaṃdanaiḥ ||
arghamenaṃ pragṛhṇaṃtu mayā dattaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
pādaprakṣālanārthāya prakurvaṃtu mama priyam|| 6 ||
evamuktvā mahīpṛṣṭhe anulipte tataḥ param ||
sākṣatānprakṣipeddarbhānviśvedevānprakīrtayan || 7 ||
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā darbhāṃstilasamanvitān ||
dviguṇānprakṣipedbhūmau pitṝnuddiśya cātmanaḥ || 8 ||
evaṃ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā daivikā savyapūrvikāḥ ||
paitṛkāścāpasavyena muktvā nāṃdīmukhānpitṝn || 9 ||
sarve pūrvāmukhāḥ sthāpyā yugmāśca śaktito nṛpa ||
pitaro mātṛpakṣīyāḥ sthāpyāścodaṅmukhāstathā || 6.224.10 ||
ekaikaṃ vā trayo vā'pi syurekaikaṃ vā pṛthakpṛthaka ||
paitṛkānsthāppa cakreṇa pitṝṇāṃ parituṣṭaye || 11 ||
ṣaṣṭhyā vibhaktyā tu teṣāmāsanaṃ ca pradāpayet ||
ṛjubhiḥ sākṣatairdarbhaiḥ sodakairdakṣiṇāṃgataḥ || 12 ||
viṣamau dviguṇairdarbhaiḥ satilairvāmapārśvataḥ ||
pāṇau toyaṃ parikṣipya na darbhāṃstu kathaṃ cana || 13 ||
yo haste cāsanaṃ dadyācceddārbhaṃ buddhivarjitaḥ ||
pitaro nāsane tatra prakurvaṃti niveśanam || 14 ||
āvāhanaṃ prakartavyaṃ vibhaktyā ca dvitīyayā ||
yenāgacchaṃti te sarve samāhūtāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 15 ||
anyayā ca vibhaktyā cetpitṝnāvāhayetkvacit ||
nāgacchaṃti mahābhāgā yadyapi syurbubhukṣitāḥ || 16 ||
viśvedevāsa āgata maṃtreṇānena pārthiva ||
teṣāmāvāhanaṃ kāryamakṣataiśca śiroṃ'tikāt || 17 ||
uśaṃtastveti ca tilaiḥ pitṝnāvāhayettataḥ ||
āyaṃtu na iti japettataḥ pārthivasattama || 18 ||
śanno devīti maṃtreṇa svāhākārasamanvitam ||
pitṝṇāmarghapātreṣu tathaiva ca jalaṃ kṣipet || 19 ||
yavo'si yavayāsmaddvetyakṣatāṃstatra nikṣipet ||
caṃdanaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpāṇi dhūpaṃ dadyādyathākramam ||
sapavitreṣu hasteṣu dadyādarghyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 6.224.20 ||
yā divyā iti mantreṇa svāhākārasamanvitam ||
pitṝṇāmarghapātreṣu tathaiva ca jalaṃ kṣipet || 21 ||
tilo'si somadaivatyo gosave devanirmitaḥ ||
pratnavadbhiḥ pṛktaḥ svadhayā pitṝnimām̐llokānprīṇāhi naḥ svadheti prakṣipettilān || 22 ||
yādivyeti ca mantreṇa tato hyarghyaṃ pradāpayet ||
pitṛpātre samādāya arghyapātrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ || 23 ||
adhomukhaṃ ca tatpātraṃ mantravatsthāpayettataḥ ||
āyuṣkāmastu tattoyaṃ locanābhyāṃ na vīkṣayet || 24 ||
tatastu candanādīni dīpāṃtāni samādadet ||
tataḥ pākaṃ samādāya pṛcchedviprāndvijo ttamān || 25 ||
ahamagnau kariṣyāmi homaṃ pitṛsamudbhavam ||
anujñā dīyatāṃ mahyamapasavyāśritasya bhoḥ || 26 ||
kuruṣveti ca taiḥ prokte gatvāgni śaraṇaṃ tataḥ ||
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svāheti prathamāhutiḥ || 27 ||
somāya pitṛmate svadheti ca tataḥ param ||
hutamannaṃ ca śeṣaṃ ca śrāddhārhebhyaḥ pradīyate || 28 ||
iṣṭamannaṃ tato dattvā pātramālabhya saṃjapet ||
viprāṃguṣṭhaṃ samādāya pākamadhye nidhāya ca || 29 ||
pṛthivī te pātramādāya vaiṣṇa vyā ca ṛcā tathā ||
svahastena na vai dadyātpratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā || 6.224.30 ||
svahastena ca yaddattaṃ pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ nṛpa ||
tacchrāddhaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti dhṛte datterddhabhuktake ||
tṛptāñjñātvā tato viprānagre tvannaṃ parikṣipet || 31 ||
agnidagdhāśca ye jīvā yepyadagdhāḥ kule mama ||
bhūmau dattena tṛpyaṃtu tṛptā yāṃtu parāṃ gatim || 32 ||
sakṛtsakṛjjalaṃ dattvā gāyatrītritayaṃ japet ||
madhuvāteti saṃkīrtya tataḥ pṛccheddvijottamān || 33 ||
tṛptāḥ stha iti rājendra anujñāṃ prārthayettataḥ ||
bandhūnāṃ bhojanārthāya śeṣasyānnasya bhaktimān || 34 ||
ucchiṣṭasannidhau paścātpitṛvediṃ samācaret ||
pitṛviprāsanasthānāṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ dvijasannidhau ||35 ||
tato vediṃ samādhāya paitṛkīṃ dakṣiṇāplavām ||
tasyāṃ darbhānsamādhāya kuryāccaivāvanejanam || 36 ||
vibhaktyā pūrvayā paścātpiṃḍāndadyādyathākramam ||
bhūyo'pyatra jalaṃ dadyātpitṛtīrthena pārthiva ||
sūtraṃ ca pratipiṇḍe vai dayātteṣu pṛthakpṛthak || 37 ||
yaḥ sūtraṃ pūrvapiṇḍeṣu satataṃ viniyojayet ||
sa virodhaṃ caretteṣāṃ troṭanācca parasparam || 38 ||
tataḥ saṃpūjayetsarvānpiṃḍānyadvaddvijottamān ||
ācamya prakṣālya tathā hastau pādau ca pārthiva || 39 ||
namaskṛtya pitṝnpaścātsuprokṣitaṃ tataḥ param ||
kṛtvā savyena rājendra yācayitvā varāśiṣaḥ || 6.224.40 ||
akṣayyasalilaṃ deyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā caiva tataḥ param ||
pavitrāṇi samādāya ūrdhvaṃ svadheti kīrtayet||
astu svadheti tairukte piṃḍopari parikṣipet || 41 ||
tato madhu samādāya pāyasaṃ ca tilodakam ||
ūrjasveti ca mantreṇa pitṝṇāmuparikṣipet o| 42 ||
uttānamarghapātraṃ tu kṛtvā dadyācca dakṣiṇām ||
hiraṇyaṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ rajataṃ tathā || 43 ||
tataḥ svastyudakaṃ dadyātpitṛpūrvaṃ ca savyataḥ ||
na strībhirna ca bālena nānye naiva ca kenacit || 44 ||
śrāddhīyaviprapātraṃ ca svayameva pracālayet || 45 ||
tataḥ kṛtāṃjalirbhūtvā prārthayetpārthivottama ||
aghorāḥ pitaraḥ santu asmadgotraṃ vivarddhatām || 46 ||
dātāro no'bhivardhaṃtāṃ vedāḥ santatireva naḥ ||
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamadbahudheyaṃ ca no'stviti || 47 ||
annaṃ ca no bahu bhavedatithīṃśca labhemaddi ||
yācitāraśca naḥ santu mā ca yāciṣma kaścana || 48 ||
etā evāśiṣaḥ santu viśvedevāḥ prīyaṃtāṃ tataḥ ||
svastyarthamudakaṃ dadyātpitṛpūrvaṃ ca savyataḥ || 49 ||
vājevājeti ca ṛcā visṛjecca tataḥ param ||
āmā vājasyeti pradakṣiṇīkṛtyopaveśayet ||6.224.50||
pādāvamardanaṃ kṛtvā āsīmāṃtamanuvrajet ||
baliṃ ca nikṣipettasmādbhojanaṃ ca samācaret || 51 ||
maunena dṛśyate sūryo yāvattāvannarādhipa || 52 ||
yaścaivāstamite sūrye bhuṃkte ca śrāddhakṛnnaraḥ ||
vyarthatāṃ yāti tacchrāddhaṃ tasmādbhuṃjīta no niśi || 53 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhavidhivarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 224 || || kṣa ||

<6.225>

|| ānarta uvāca || ||
ekoddiṣṭavidhiṃ brūhi mama tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara ||
pārvaṇaṃ tu yathā proktaṃ vistareṇa mahāmate || 1 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
trīṇi saṃcayanādarvāktāni tvaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam ||
yasminsthāne bhavenmṛtyustatra śrāddhaṃ tu kārayet ||2||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tato mārge viśrāmo yatra kāritaḥ ||
tataḥ saṃcayanasthāne tṛtīyaṃ śrāddhamiṣyate || 3 ||
prathame'hni dvitīyehni pañcame saptame tathā ||
navame daśame caiva nava śrāddhāni tāni ca || 4 ||
vaitariṇyāśca saṃprāptau pretastṛptimavāpnuyāt ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnamekārghaikapavitrakam || 5 ||
āvāhanaparityaktaṃ kāryaṃ pārthivasattama ||
tṛptipraśnastathā kāryaḥ svaditaṃ ca sakṛttataḥ || 6 ||
abhiramyatāmiti mantreṇa brāhmaṇasya visarjanam ||
acchinnāgramabhinnāgraṃ kuryāddarbhatṛṇadvayam ||
pavitraṃ tadvijānīyādekoddiṣṭe vidhīyate || 7 ||
sarvatraiva pitaḥ proktaṃ pitā tarpaṇakarmaṇi ||
pitrye saṃkalpakāle ca piturakṣayyadāpane || 8 ||
gotraṃ svarāṃtaṃ sarvatra gotre tarpaṇakarmaṇi ||
gotrāya kalpanavidhau gotrasyākṣayyadāpane || 9 ||
śarmannarghyādikartavye śarmā tarpaṇakarmaṇi ||
śarmaṇe sasyadāne ca śarmaṇo'kṣayyake vidhau || 6.225.10 ||
mātarmātre tathā māturāsane kalpane'kṣaye ||
gotre gotrāyai gotrāyāḥ prathamādyā vibhaktayaḥ || 11 ||
devi devyai tathā devyā evaṃ mātuśca kīrtayet ||
prathamā ca caturthī ca ṣaṣṭhī syācchrāddhasiddhaye || 12 ||
vibhaktirahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kriyate vā viparyayāt ||
akṛtaṃ tadvijānīyātpitṛṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhati || || 13 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇena vijānatā ||
vibhaktibhiryathoktābhiḥ śrāddhe kāryo vidhiḥ sadā || 14 ||
tataḥ sapiṃḍīkaraṇaṃ vatsarā dūrdhvataḥ sthitam ||
vṛddhirvā''gāminī cetsyāttadārvāgapi kārayet || 15 ||
pārvaṇoktavidhānena tridaivatyamadaivikam ||
pretamuddiśya kartavyameko ddiṣṭaṃ ca pārthiva || 16 ||
ekenaiva tu pākena mama caitanmataṃ smṛtam ||
arghapātraṃ samādāya yatpretārthaṃ prakalpitam || 17 ||
pitṛpātreṣu triṣveva tridhā tacca parikṣipet ||
evaṃ piṃḍaṃ tridhā kṛtvā pitṛpiṃḍeṣu ca triṣu || 18 ||
ye samāneti mantrābhyāṃ na syātpretastataḥ param ||
avanejanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṛpūrvaṃ yathākramam || 19 ||
gandhadhūpādikaṃ sarvaṃ punareva pradāpayet ||
pitṛpūrvaṃ samuccārya varjayecca caturthakam || 6.225.20 ||
keciccaturthaṃ kurvaṃti pretaṃ ca svapitustataḥ ||
pituḥ pūrvaṃ bhavecchrāddhaṃ paraṃ naitanmataṃ mama || 21 ||
sapiṇḍīkaraṇādūrdhvamekoddiṣṭaṃ na kārayet ||
kṣayāhaṃ ca parityajya śastrāhata caturdaśīm || 22 ||
yaḥ sapiṇḍīkṛtaṃ pretaṃ pṛthakpiṇḍe niyojayet ||
akṛtaṃ tadvijānīyātpitṛhā copajāyate ||23 ||
pitā yasya tu nirvṛtto jīvate ca pitāmahaḥ ||
pituḥ sa nāma saṃkīrtya kīrtayetprapitāmaham || 24 ||
pitāmahastu pratyakṣaṃ bhuktvā gṛhṇāti piṇḍakam ||
pitāmahakṣayāhe ca pārvaṇaṃ śrāddhamiṣyate || 25 ||
janakaṃ svaṃ parityajya kathaṃcinnāsya dīyate ||
tasyākṛtena śrāddhena na svalpaṃ pitṛto bhayam || 26 ||
amāvāsyāsu sarvāsu mṛte pitari pārvaṇam ||
nabhasyāparapakṣasya madhye caitadudāhṛtam|| 27 ||
yāvatsapiṃḍatā naiva na tāvacchrāddhamācaret || 28 ||
janake mṛtyumāpanne śrāddhapakṣe samāgate ||
pitāmahādeḥ kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ yannaikapiṃḍatā ||29||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭa keśvarakṣetramāhātmye sapiṃḍīkaraṇavidhivarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 225 || a ||

<6.226>

|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
yataḥ sapiṃḍatā proktā pitṛpiṇḍaiḥ samaṃtataḥ ||
yāvatsapiṇḍatā naiva tāvatpretaḥ sa tiṣṭhati || 1 ||
api dharmasamopetastapasā'pi samanvitaḥ ||
etasmātkāraṇātproktā munibhistu sapiṃḍatā || 2 ||
yasyayasya ca yo'nyatra yoniṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
tatrasthastṛptimāpnoti yaddattaṃ tasya vaṃśajaiḥ || 3 ||
|| ānarta uvāca || ||
ye dṛśyaṃte nijāḥ svapne cirātpitṛpitāmahāḥ ||
prārthayaṃti nijānkāmāṃstataḥ kiṃ syānmahāmune || 4 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
yeṣāṃ gatirna saṃjātā pretatve ca vyavasthitāḥ ||
darśayaṃti ca te sarve svayamātmānameva hi || 5 ||
svavaṃśyānāṃ na cānye tu satyametanmayoditam ||
yathā loke'tra saṃjātā ye ca kṛtyaiḥ śubhāśubhaiḥ || 6 ||
|| ānarta uvāca || ||
yasya no vidyate putraḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ katham ||
tasya kāryaṃ bhavedatra tanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || || 7 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
yasya no vidyate putra aurasaśca mahīpate ||
caturṇāṃ svapitṝṇāṃ tu kathaṃ sa syāccaturthakaḥ || 8 ||
prakarṣeṇa vrajedyasmāttasmātpretaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
putreṇa bhrātrā patnyā vā tasya kāryā sapiṃḍatā || 9 ||
caturtho yadi rājeṃdra jāyate na kathaṃcana ||
kṣetrajādīnsutānetānekādaśa yathoditān || 6.226.10 ||
putrapratinidhīnāhuḥ kriyālopānmanīṣiṇaḥ ||
kāle yadi na rājeṃdra jāyate'syottarakriyā || 11 ||
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryaḥ pretatvasya vināśakaḥ ||
yathānyeṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāmapamṛtyumupeyuṣām ||
kāryaścaivātmahaṃtṝṇāṃ brāhmaṇānmṛtyumīyuṣām || 12 ||
|| ānarta uvāca || ||
kathaṃ mṛtyumavāpnoti puruṣo'tra mahāmate || 13 ||
svargaṃ vā narakaṃ vāpi karmaṇā kena gacchati ||
mokṣaṃ vā'tha mahābhāga sarvaṃ me vista rādvada || 14 ||
|| bhartṛyajña uvāca || ||
dharmī pāpī tathā jñānī tisro'tra gatayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
dharmātsaṃprāpyate svargaḥ pāpānnaraka eva ca || 15 ||
jñānātsaṃprāpyate mokṣaḥ satyametanmayoditam ||
enamarthaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ tu bhīṣmaṃ śāṃtanavaṃ nṛpa || 16 ||
yudhiṣṭhiro mahārāja dharmaputro nṛpottamaḥ ||
kṛṣṇena saha rājeṃdra pitāmahamapṛcchata || 17 ||
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
kiyaṃto narakāḥ khyātā yamaloke pitāmaha ||
kena pāpena gacchaṃti teṣu sarveṣu jaṃtavaḥ || 18 ||
|| śrībhīṣma uvāca || ||
ekaviṃśatpramāṇāḥ syurnarakā yamamaṃdire ||
prāṇinasteṣu gacchaṃti nijakarmānusārataḥ || 19 ||
khyātau citravicitrau ca kāyasthau yamamaṃdire || 6.226.20 ||
citro'tha likhate dharmaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇisamudbhavam ||
vicitraḥ pātakaṃ sarvaṃ paramaṃ yatnamāsthitaḥ || 21 ||
yamadūtāḥ sadaivāṣṭau dharmarājasamudbhavāḥ ||
ye nayaṃti narānmṛtyulokātsvavaśagānsadā|| 22 ||

pāpaṃ janaṃ ca te sarve nayanti yamasādanam || 24 ||

dharmiṇaṃ te janaṃ sarvaṃ nayaṃti yamasādanam || 25 ||
vimānena samārūḍhamapsarogaṇasevitam || 26 ||
likhitasyānurūpeṇa pāpadharmodbhavasya ca ||
eteṣāṃ kiṃkarā ye ca teṣāṃ saṃkhyā na jāyate || 27 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ teṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ parikalpitam ||
sahāyārthaṃ yamenātra jvarayakṣmāṃtarasthitam || 28 ||
te gatvā vyādhayaḥ pūrvaṃ vaśe kurvaṃti mānavam || 29 ||
yamadūtāstato gatvā nābhimūlavyavasthitam||
vāyurūpaṃ samādāya janaiḥ sarvairalakṣitāḥ || 6.226.30 ||
gacchaṃti yamamārgeṇa dehaṃ saṃsthāpya bhūtale ||
ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yamamārgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || || 31 ||
tatra vaitaraṇīnāma nadī pūrvaṃ pariśrutā ||
srotobhyāṃ sā mahābhāga tatra saṃsthā sadaiva hi || 32 ||
tatra śoṇitamekasminsrotasyasyā vaha tyalam||
śastrāṇi ca sutīkṣṇāni tanmadhye bharatarṣabha || 33 ||
mṛtyukāle prayacchaṃti ye dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya vai ||
tasyāḥ pucchaṃ samāśritya te taraṃti ca tāṃ nṛpa||34||
svabāhubhistathaivānye śatayojanavistṛtam||
dvitīyaṃ caiva tatsroto vaitaraṇyā vyavasthitam||
tasyāstatsalilasrāvi gamyaṃ dharmavatāṃ sadā||35||
ye narā gopradātāro mṛtyukāle vyavasthite||
te gopucchaṃ samāśritya tāṃ taraṃti pṛthūdakām||
anye svabāhubhiḥ kṛtvā gopradānavivarjitāḥ||36||
gopradānaṃ prakartavyaṃ tasmāccaiva viśeṣataḥ|.
mṛtyukāle'tra saṃprāpte ya icchedgatimātmanaḥ||37||
tasyā anantaraṃ yāṃti pāpamārgeṇa pāpinaḥ||
dharmiṣṭhā dharmamārgeṇa vimānavaramāśritāḥ||38||
vaitaraṇyāḥ paraṃ pāre paṃcayojanamāyatam||
asipatravanaṃnāma pāpalokasya duḥkhadam||39||

yāni kṛntaṃti martyānāṃ śarīrāṇi samaṃtataḥ||6.226.40||
yairhṛtaṃ paravittaṃ ca kalatraṃ ca durātmabhiḥ||
nava śrāddhāni teṣāṃ cettasmānmuktiḥ prajāyate||41||
tasmātparataro jñeyo vikhyātaḥ kūṭaśālmaliḥ||
adhomukhāḥ pralaṃbaṃte tasminkaṃṭakasaṃkule||42||
adhastādvahninā caiva dahyamānā divāniśam||
viśvāsaghātakā ye ca sarvadaiva sunirdayāḥ||
tasmānmuktiṃ prayāṃti sma śrāddhe hyekādaśe kṛte||43||
yaṃtrātmakastataḥ prokto narako dāruṇākṛtiḥ||
brahmaghnāstatra pīḍyaṃte ye cā'nye pāpakarmiṇaḥ||44||
śrāddhena dvādaśotthena tebhyo dattena pārthiva||
tasmānmuktiṃ pragacchanti yantrākhyanarakātsphuṭam || 45 ||

āliṃgaṃti ca tānsarvānparadāraratāśca ye || || 46 ||
māsikotthe kṛte śrāddhe tebhyo muktimavāpnuyuḥ 47 ||

bhakṣayaṃti ca te pāpānpṛṣṭhamāṃsā śino narān ||
traipakṣike kṛte śrāddhe tebhyo muktimavāpnuyuḥ || 48 ||
lohacaṃcumayāḥ kākāḥ saṃsthitāstadanaṃtaram ||
sarāgairlocenairyaiśca īkṣitāḥ para yoṣitaḥ || 49 ||
teṣāṃ netrāṇi te ghnaṃti bhūyo jātāni bhūriśaḥ |
dvimāsikaṃ ca yacchrāddhaṃ tena muktiḥ prajāyate | 6.226.50 ||
tataḥ śālmalikūṭastu tathānye lohakaṇṭakāḥ ||

trimāsikaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tena muktiḥ prajāyate || 51 ||
rauravo'tha suvikhyāto dāruṇo narako mahān ||
brahmaghnānāṃ samādiṣṭaḥ sa mahākleśakārakaḥ || 52 ||
chidyaṃte vividhaiḥ śastraistatrasthā ye muhurmuhuḥ ||
caturmāsikaśrāddhena muktisteṣāṃ prajāyate || 53 ||
aparastu samākhyātaḥ kṣārodastu sudāruṇaḥ ||
kṛtaghnānāṃ samādiṣṭaḥ sadaiva bahuvedanaḥ || 54 ||
adhomukhā ūrdhva pādāḥ pīḍyaṃte yatra laṃbitāḥ ||
pañcamāsikadānena muktisteṣāṃ prajāyate || 55 ||
kumbhīpākastato jñeyo narako dāruṇākṛtiḥ ||

dṛśyaṃte janahaṃtāro bālahaṃtāra eva ca || 56 ||
pataṃti narake raudre narā viśvāsaghātakāḥ||
ṣaṇmāsikapradānena mucyaṃte tatra saṃkaṭāt || 57 ||

tatra ye dāṃbhikā loke te gacchanti narādhamāḥ ||
saptamāsikadānena teṣāṃ muktiḥ prajāyate || 58 ||
tathā saṃvartakonāma narako'nyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
vedaviplāvakāḥ sādhuniṃdakāśca durātmakāḥ || 59 ||
utpāṭyate tato jihvā sandaṃśairva hnisambhavaiḥ ||
svakārye ye'nṛtaṃ brūyustadgātraṃ khādyate śvabhiḥ || 6.226.60 ||
parārthe'pi ca ye brūyusteṣāṃ gātrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
aṣṭamāsikadānena teṣāṃ muktiḥ prajāyate || 61 ||

svāminaṃ cāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ ||

tataḥ saṃvatsarādūrdhvaṃ nijakarmasamudbhavam ||
śubhāśubhaṃ prapadyaṃte dharmarājasamīpagāḥ || 6.226.70 ||

|| bhīṣma uvāca || ||

iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe bhīṣmayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde tattadduritaprāpyaikaviṃśatinarakayātanātannivāraṇopāyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaradviśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ ||226 || || cha ||

|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
narakāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ ca śrutvā me bhayamāgatam ||
kathaṃ muktirbhavetteṣāṃ pāpānāmapi pārthiva ||
vratairvā niyamairvāpi homairvā tīrthasaṃśrayaiḥ || 1 ||
|| bhīṣma uvāca || ||
gaṃgāyāmasthipāto'tra yeṣāṃ saṃjāyate nṛṇām ||
na teṣāṃ nārako vahniḥ prabhavenmadhyavartinām || 2 ||
gaṃgāyāṃ kriyate śrāddhaṃ yeṣāṃ nāmnā svakaiḥ sutaiḥ ||
te vimānaṃ samāśritya prayāṃti narakopari || || 3 ||
pāpaṃ kṛtvā prakurvaṃti prāyaścittaṃ yathoditam ||
hema yacchaṃti vā bhūpa na teṣāṃ narako bhavet || 4 ||
śeṣāḥ svakarmaṇaḥ prāptyā sevaṃte ca yathocitam ||
svarga vā narakaṃ vāpi sevante te narādhipa || 5 ||
dhārātīrthe mriyaṃte ye svāminaḥ purataḥ sthitāḥ ||
te gacchaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ narakāṇāṃ sudūrataḥ || 6 ||
vārāṇasyāṃ kurukṣetre naimiṣe nāgare pure ||
prayāge vā prabhāse vā yastyajettanumā tmanaḥ ||
mahāpātakayukto'pi narakaṃ na sa paśyati || 7 ||
nīlo vā vṛṣabho yasya vivāhe saṃniyujyate ||
svaputreṇa na saṃpaśyennarakaṃ brahmahā'pi saḥ || 8 ||
prāyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā hṛdayasthe janārdane ||
yastyajetpuruṣaḥ prāṇānnarakaṃ na sa paśyati || 9 ||
prāyopaveśanaṃ yo ca citreśvaraniveśane ||
kurvanti narakaṃ naiva te gacchaṃti kadācana || 6.227.10 ||
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca pathiśramamupeyuṣām ||
tīrthayātrāparāṇāṃ ca yo yacchati sadā'śanam ||
kāle vā yadi vā'kāle narakaṃ na sa paśyati || 11 ||
jaladhenuṃ ca yo dadyāddhṛṣasaṃsthe divākare ||
tiladhenuṃ mṛgasthe ca narakaṃ na sa paśyati || 12 ||
some somagrahe caiva somanāthasya darśanāt ||
samudre ca sarasvatyāṃ snātvā na narakaṃ vrajet || 13 ||
sannihityāṃ kurukṣetre rāhugraste divākare ||
sūryavāreṇa yaḥ yāti narakaṃ na sa paśyati || 14 ||
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām ||
tripuṣkarasya maunena narakaṃ na sa paśyati || 15 ||
mṛgasaṃkramaṇe ye tu sūryavāreṇa saṃsthite ||
caṇḍīśaṃ vīkṣayaṃti sma na te narakagāminaḥ || 16 ||
gāṃ paṃkādbrāhmaṇīṃ dāsyātsādhūnstenāddvijaṃ vadhāt ||
mocayanti ca ye rājanna te narakagāminaḥ || 17 ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi narādhipa ||
yathā na narakaṃ yāti puruṣastu svakarmaṇā ||
yathā ca narakaṃ yāti svalpapāpo'pi mānavaḥ || 18 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe bhīṣmayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde narakayātanānirasanopāyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 227 || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyacca biladvāri śayanārthe vyavasthitam ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

|| indra uvāca || ||

<6.229>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
etasminnaṃtare śambhurgaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||
indrādyaiśca suraiḥ sarveḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ ||
jagāma vṛṣamāruhya purīṃ caivāmarāvatīm || 1 ||
aṃdhako'pi samālokya saṃprāptāṃ devavāhinīm ||
sagaṇāṃ ca mahādevaṃ paritoṣaṃ paraṃ gataḥ || 2 ||
niścakrāmātha yuddhāya balena caturaṃgiṇā ||

gaṇaiśca vikṛtākārairmṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam || 4 ||

brahmaṇo varamāhātmyānnaiva prāṇaiviryujyate || 7 ||

|| andhaka uvāca || ||

īdṛgvīryasamopetastadyuktaṃ bhavatā kṛtam || 16 ||

svavīryamadayuktasya viveka rahitasya ca || 17 ||

pāpo'haṃ pāpakarmā'haṃ pāpātmā pāpasaṃbhavaḥ ||

duḥkhito'haṃ varāko'haṃ dīno'haṃ śaktivarjitaḥ ||

tena buddhiriyaṃ jātā tavopari mamānagha || 21 ||
sarvapāpakṣaye jāte śive bhavati bhāvanā || 22 ||
nāmamātramapi tryakṣa yaste kīrtayati prabho ||

tasmānmocaya māṃ deva svāgataṃ kuru sāṃpratam ||

tyaktāḥ putrāśca pautrāśca patnyaśca vibhavaiḥ saha ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

||sūta uvāca||
vṛko'pi tatsamāsādya rājyaṃ trailokyasaṃbhavam||
yadṛcchayā jagatsarvaṃ samājñāpayattadā||1||
soṃ'dhakasya bale vīrye dhairye kope ca dānavaḥ||

atha yaḥ kurute dharmaṃ homaṃ vā japameva vā|
suguptasthānamāsādya karotyamaratuṣṭaye||4||
atha svargasthitā daityā yajñabhāgavivarjitāḥ||
tathā martyodbhavairbhāgaiḥ saṃdehaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ||5||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā preṣayāmāsa dānavaḥ||

yaḥ kaściddevatānāṃ ca pragṛhṇāti karoti ca||
