guptaścakre tatastasyāṃ gartāyāṃ channavarṣmakaḥ||
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ vṛkeṇa ca dvijāḥ purā||6.231.10||
atha te taṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā tadguhāyāṃ vyavasthitam||
bhartsamānāstapastacca procuśca paruṣākṣaraiḥ||11||
dṛṣṭvā tasyāgrataḥ saṃsthāṃ gandhapuṣpaiśca pūjitām||
vāsudevātmikāṃ mūrtiṃ caturhastāṃ dvijottamāḥ||12||
tataste śastramudyamya nirjaghnustaṃ krudhānvitāḥ||
na śekuste yadā haṃtuṃ saṃvṛtaṃ viṣṇutejasā||
kuṇṭhatāṃ sarvaśastrāṇi gatāni vimalānyapi||13||
atha vailakṣyamāpannā nirviṇṇāḥ sarva eva te||
tāṃ vārtāṃ dānavendrāya vṛkāyocuśca te tadā||14||
kaścidvipraḥ samādhāya vaiṣṇavīṃ pratimāṃ puraḥ||
tapastepe mahābhāga kṣetre vai hāṭakeśvare||15||
yatra tvayā tapastaptaṃ bhītyā sarvadivaukasām||
api cauryeṇa cāsmākaṃ tapastapati tādṛśam|| 16||
yena sarvāṇi śastrāṇi kuṇṭhatāṃ pragatāni ca||
tasya gātre prahāraiśca tasmātkuru yathocitam|| 17||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛkaḥ kopasamanvitaḥ||
jagāma satvaṃ tatra yatrāsau sāṃkṛtiḥ sthitaḥ||18||
sa gatvā vaiṣṇavīṃ mūrtiṃ tāmutkṣipya sudūrataḥ||
śvabhrādbahiḥ pracikṣepa bhartsamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ||19||
jaghāna pādaghātena dakṣiṇenetareṇa tam||
abravīnmama vadhyastvaṃ yanmacchatruṃ janārdanam||6.231.20||
saṃpūjayasi cauryeṇa tena prāṇānharāmyaham||
evamuktvātha khaḍgena taṃ jaghāna sa daityapaḥ||21||
tatastasya sa khaḍgastu tīkṣṇo'pi dvijasattamāḥ||
tasya kāye prahīṇastu śatadhā samapadyata||22||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā taṃ śaśāpa sa sāṃkṛtiḥ||23||
yasmātpāpa tvayāhaṃ ca pādaghātaiḥ pratāḍitaḥ ||
tasmātte patatāṃ pādau sadya eva dharātale || 24 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
uktamātre tatastena pādau tasya dvijottamāḥ ||
patitau medinīpṛṣṭhe paṃcaśīrṣāvivoragau || 25 ||
etasminneva kāle tu ākrandaḥ sumahānabhūt ||
vṛkasya sainikānāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || || 26 ||
atha devāḥ parijñāya taṃ tadā paṃgutāṃ gatam |
āgatya merupṛṣṭhaṃ ca nijaghnustatparigraham || 27 ||
hataśeṣāśca daityāste pātālāṃtaḥsamā gatāḥ ||
vṛko'pi paṃgutāṃ prāptastasthau tapasi susthiram || 28 ||
sarvairaṃtaḥpuraiḥ sārdhaṃ duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ ||
indro'pi prāptavānrājyaṃ tadā nihata kaṃṭakam || 29 ||
dharmakriyāḥ pravṛttāśca tato bhūyo rasātale || 6.231.30 ||
atha dīrgheṇa kālena tasya tuṣṭaḥ pitāmahaḥ ||
uvāca tatra cāgatya garttāmadhye dvijottamāḥ || 31 ||
vṛka tuṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ varaya suvrata ||
ahaṃ dāsyāmi te nūnaṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 32 ||
|| vṛka uvāca || ||
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama ||
pādadānaṃ tadā deva mama brahmansamācara ||
paṃgutā yāti śīghraṃ me yeneyaṃ te prasādataḥ || 33 ||
tacchrutvā taṃ samānīya sāṃkṛtiṃ tatra padmajaḥ ||
provāca sāṃtvapūrvaṃ ca vṛkasyāsya dvijottama || 34 ||
madvākyātpaṃgutā yāti yenāsya tvaṃ tathā kuru || 35 || ||
|| sāṃkṛtiruvāca || ||
anṛtaṃ noktapūrvaṃ me svaireṣvapi pitāmaha ||
jñāyate devadeveśa tatkathaṃ tatkaromyaham || 36 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
mama bhaktiparo nityaṃ vṛko'yaṃ daityasattamaḥ ||
pautrastvaṃ dayito nityaṃ tena tvāṃ prārthayāmyaham || 37 ||
tava vākyaṃ ca no mithyā kartuṃ śakromi sanmune || 38 ||
|| sāṃkṛtiruvāca || ||
eṣa daityaḥ suduṣṭātmā devānāmahite sthitaḥ ||
viśeṣādvāsudevasya purormama mahātmanaḥ || 39 ||
paṃgutāmarhati prāyaḥ pāpātmā dvijadūṣakaḥ ||
balena mahatā yukto jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ || 6.231.40 ||
purā kṛtastvayā deva sa cetpādāvavāpsyati ||
haniṣyati jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || 41 ||
tasmāttiṣṭhatu tadrūpo na kalpaṃ kartumarhasi ||
tvayāpi cintā kartavyā trailokyasya yataḥ prabho || || 42 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
prāvṛṭkāle tu sañjāte yānaṃ kartuṃ na yujyate ||
vijigīṣorviśeṣeṇa muktvā śītātapāgamam || 43 ||
tasmācca caturo māsānvārṣikānpādasaṃyutaḥ ||
agamyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ kuryātkarmāṇi dhairyataḥ || 44 ||
tadbhūyātpādasaṃyuktaḥ sa vṛko dāna vottamaḥ ||
yena kṣemaṃ ca devānāṃ dvijānāṃ jāyate dvija || 45 ||
evaṃ kṛte na mithyā te vākyaṃ vipra bhaviṣyati ||
phalaṃ ca tapasastasya na vṛthā saṃbhaviṣyati || 46 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
bāḍhamityeva tenokte sāṃkṛtena mahātmanā ||
utthitau sahasā pādau tasya gātrātpunarnavau|| 47 ||
punaśca dānavo raudraḥ paśutvaṃ samapadyata||
tasyāmeva tu gartāyāṃ saṃtiṣṭhati dvijottamāḥ||48||
māsānaṣṭau sa duḥkhena sakalatraḥ sabāṃdhavaḥ ||
smaramāṇo mahadvairaṃ daivaiḥ sārdhaṃ divāniśam||49||
anyāṃśca caturo māsānniṣkramya sa ruṣānvitaḥ||
sadā pīḍayate devānsaheṃdrānmānuṣānapi ||6.231.50||
vidhvaṃsayati sarvāṇi dharmasthānāni yāni ca ||51||
vidhvaṃsayati devānāṃ striyo māsacatuṣṭayam ||
udyānāni ca sarvāṇi sapurāṇi gṛhāṇi ca ||52||
tato devāḥ samabhyetya devadevaṃ janārdanam ||
kṣīrābdhau saṃsthitaṃ nityaṃ śeṣaparyaṃkaśāyinam||53||
caturo vārṣikānmāsāṃstatra sthitvā tadaṃtike ||
māsānaṣṭau punarjagmustridivaṃ prati nirbhayāḥ || 54 ||
tasminpaṃgutvamāpanne daitye paramadāruṇe ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya devarājo bṛhaspatim ||
provāca duḥkhasaṃtapta āṣāḍhāṃte suro ttamaḥ || 55 ||
guro sa māsaḥ saṃprāptaḥ prāvṛṭkālo bhayāvahaḥ ||
āgamiṣyati yatrāsau labdhapādo vṛkāsuraḥ ||56||
gantavyaṃ ca tato'smābhiḥ kṣīrode keśavālaye ||
maivaṃ dīnaistathā bhāvyaṃ parāśrayanivāsibhiḥ || 57 ||
svagṛhāṇi parityajya śayanānyāsanāni ca ||
vāhanāni vicitrāṇi yaccānya ddayitaṃ gṛhe || 58 ||
tasmātkathaya cāsmākamupāyaṃ kañcideva hi ||
vrataṃ vā niyamaṃ vātha homaṃ vā munisattama || 59 ||
aśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ yena svakalatreṇa jāyate ||
tathā na gṛhasaṃtyāgaḥ svakīyasya prajāyate || 6.231.60 ||
nirviṇṇo'haṃ nijasthānabhraṃśāddvijavarottama ||
varṣevarṣe ca samprāpte sthānakasya cyutirbhavet || 61 ||
punarbhūmau śayiṣyāmi yāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam ||
niṣkalatro bhayodvigno brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ || 62 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhayārtasya bṛhaspatiḥ ||
provāca suciraṃ dhyātvā tato devaṃ śatakratum || 63 ||
aśūnyaśayanaṃnāma vratamasti mahattapaḥ ||
viṣṇorārādhanārthāya tatkuruṣva samā hitaḥ || 64 ||
devo yatrāsti viṣṇuḥ sa kṣīrābdhau madhusūdanaḥ ||
jalaśāyī jagadyoniḥ sa dāsyati hitaṃ ca te || 65 ||
yathā na śūnyaṃ śayanaṃ gṛha bhaṃgaḥ prajāyate ||
sarvaśatruvināśaśca tatprasādena vāsava || 66 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tasminvrate tataścīrṇe hyaśūnyaśayanātmake ||
tutoṣa bhagavānviṣṇustataḥ provāca devapam || 67 ||
śakra tuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya suvrata ||
vratenānena cīrṇena cāturmāsyodbhavena ca ||
tasmātprārthaya devendra nityaṃ yanmanasi sthitam || 68 ||
|| indra uvāca || ||
kṛṣṇa jānāsi tvaṃ cāpi yaśca me'tra parābhavaḥ ||
kriyate dānavendreṇa vṛkeṇa sudurātmanā || 69 ||
mamāṣṭamāsikaṃ rājyaṃ trailokye'pi vyavasthitam ||
śeṣāṃśca caturo māsānvarṣevarṣe sameti saḥ || 6.231.70 ||
evaṃ jñātvā suraśreṣṭha dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ||
tathā kuru yathā rājyaṃ mama syātsārvakālikam || 71 ||
|| viṣṇuruvāca || ||
ajaraścāmaraścāpi sa kṛtaḥ padmayoninā ||
tatkathaṃ jīvamānena tena rājyaṃ bhavettava || 72 ||
paraṃ tathāpi devendra kariṣyāmi hitaṃ tava || 73 ||
kṣīrārṇavaṃ parityajya hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñite ||
kṣetre gatvā samaṃ lakṣmyā tasyopari tataḥ param || 74 ||
kariṣyāmi tvahaṃ śakra śayanaṃ yatnamāsthitaḥ ||
yāvacca caturo māsānyathā sa na caliṣyati || 75 ||
tasmātsthānātsahasrākṣa madbhāreṇa prapīḍitaḥ ||
varṣevarṣe sadā kāryaṃ mayā tatsuhitaṃ tava || 76 ||
tasmādgacchādhunā svarge kuru rājyamakaṃṭakam ||
prāvṛṭ kāle tu saṃprāpte na bhīḥ kāryā tadudbhavā || 77 ||
yo māṃ tatra śayānaṃ tu vratenānena devapa||
pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktyā tasya dāsyāmi vāṃchitam || 78 ||
|| sūta uvāca ||
evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśo visasarja śatakratum ||
niḥśeṣabhayanirmuktaṃ svarājyaparivṛddhaye ||79||
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣa ekādaśyā dine sadā||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tatrāgatya svayaṃ vibhuḥ || 6.231.80 ||
vṛkopari tataścakre śayanaṃ yatnamāsthitaḥ ||
tenākrāṃtastataḥ so'pi śaknoti calituṃ na hi || 81 ||
mṛtaprāyastato nityaṃ tadbhāreṇa prapīḍitaḥ ||
kārtikasya site pakṣa ekādaśyā dine sthite || 82 ||
utthānaṃ kurute viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaṃ prati gacchati ||
so'pi sāṃkṛtiśāpena vṛkaḥ paṃgutvamāpnuyāt || 83 ||
evaṃ ca caturo māsānna tyajecchayanaṃ hariḥ ||
bhayāttasyāsureṃdrasya dānavasya durātmanaḥ || || 84 ||
tatra martyaiḥ kriyā sarvāḥ kriyate na makhodbhavāḥ ||
yasmātsa yajñapuruṣo na supto bhāgamaśnute || 85 ||
tathā yajñāśca ye sarve ktvayādānādi kāḥ śubhāḥ ||
te sarve na kriyaṃte ca cūḍākaraṇapūrvakāḥ || 86 ||
muktvānnaprāśanaṃnāma sīmaṃtonnayanaṃ tathā ||
tasmātsupte jagannāthe tāḥ sarvāḥ syurvṛthā dvijāḥ || 87 ||
vrataṃ vā niyamaṃ vātha tasminyaḥ kurute naraḥ ||
prasupte devadeveśe tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||88||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃprasupte janārdane ||
vratasthairmānavairbhāvyaṃ tasya devasya tuṣṭaye || 89 ||
ekādaśyāṃ dine prāpte śayane bodhane hareḥ ||
yatkiṃcitkriyate karma śreṣṭhaṃ taccākṣayaṃ bhavet || 6.231.90 ||
kiṃvātra bahunoktena kriyate yadvrataṃ naraiḥ ||
tena tuṣṭiṃ parāṃ yāti daityopari sthito hariḥ ||91||
evaṃ sa bhagavānprāha suptastatra janārdanaḥ ||
kiṃ vā tasya jvaro jāto mahatī vedanāpi ca || 92 ||
tasminnahani pāpātmā yonnamaśnāti mānavaḥ ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃprāpte harivāsare || 93 ||
anyasminnapi bhoktavyaṃ na nareṇa vijānatā ||
kiṃ punaḥ śayanaṃ yatra kurute yatra bodhanam || 94 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijo ttamāḥ ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yasmācchete janārdanaḥ || 95 ||
kṣīrābdhiṃ saṃparityajya sadā māsacatuṣṭayam ||
śrūyatāṃ ca phalaṃ yatsyāttasminnārādhite vibho || 96 ||
caturo vārṣikānmāsānyastaṃ pūjayate vibhum ||
vratasthaḥ sa naro yāti yatra devaḥ sa saṃsthitaḥ || 97 ||
kiṃ dānairbahubhirdattaiḥ kiṃ vrataiḥ kimupoṣitaiḥ ||
tatra yaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ suptaṃ pūjayati dhruvam || 98 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśva rakṣetramāhātmye jalaśāyyupākhyāna ekādaśīvratamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ | 231 ||

<6.232>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
prasupte devadeveśe śaṃkhacakragadādhare ||
yaccānyadapi kartavyaṃ niyamo vratameva vā || 1 ||
homo vātha japo vātha dānaṃ vā tadvadasva naḥ ||
|| sūta uvāca ||
yaḥ kaścinniyamo viprāḥ prasupte garuḍadhvaje || 2 ||
anaṃtaphaladaḥ sa syādityuvāca pitāmahaḥ ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kaścidbāhyo vijānatā || 3 ||
niyamo vā japo homaḥ svādhyāyo vratameva vā ||
kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāstuṣṭyarthaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ || 4 ||
caturo vārṣikānmāsānekabhaktena yo nayet ||
vāsudevaṃ samuddiśya sa dhanī jāyate naraḥ || 5 ||
nakṣatrairbhoṃjanaṃ kuryādyaḥ prasupte janārdane ||
sa dhanī rūpasaṃpannaḥ sumatiśca prajāyate || 6 ||
ekāṃtaropavāsaiśca yo nayeddvijasattamāḥ ||
caturo vārṣikānmāsānvaikuṃṭhe sa sadā vaset || 7 ||
ṣaṣṭhānnakālabhojī syādyaḥ prasupte janārdane ||
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ sa kṛtsnaṃ phalamāpnuyāt|| 8 ||
trirātropoṣito yastu caturmāsānsadā nayet ||
na sa bhūyo'pi jāyeta saṃsāre'tra kathaṃcana || 9 ||
sāyaṃprātaḥ paro bhūtvā caturmāsānsadā nayet||
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya sa phalaṃ labhate naraḥ || 6.232.10 ||
ayācitaṃ caredyastu prasupte madhusūdane ||
na vicchedo bhavettasya kadācitsaha baṃdhubhiḥ || 11 ||
tailābhyaṃgaṃ ca yo jahyādghṛtābhyaṃgaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
caturo vārṣikānmāsānsa svarge bhogabhāgbhavet || 12 ||
brahmacaryeṇa yo māsāṃścaturo'pi nayennaraḥ ||
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ sa svarge svecchayā vaset || 13 ||
yaḥ snānaṃ caturo māsānkurute tailavarjitam ||
madhumāṃsaparityāgī sa bhavenmuktibhāksadā || 14 ||
varjayecchrāvaṇe śākaṃ dadhi bhādrapade ca yaḥ ||
kṣīramāśvayuje māsi kārtike ca sadāmiṣam|| 18 ||
na sa pāpena lipyeta saṃvatsarakṛte punaḥ ||
etatprāha dvijaśreṣṭhā manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo vacaḥ || 16 ||
śāke saṃkramate brahmā śrāvaṇe māsi saṃsthite ||
dadhni bhādrapade viṣṇuḥ kṣīre cāśvayuje haraḥ || 17 ||
trayo'pi kārtike māsi saṃkramaṃti tathā''miṣe ||
tasmādetānsa deveṣu sarvathā parivarjayet || 18 ||
yaḥ kāṃsyaṃ varjayenmartyaḥ prasupte garuḍadhvaje ||
sa phalaṃ prāpnuyātkṛtsnaṃ vājapeyātirātrayoḥ || 19 ||
akṣāralavaṇāśī ca yo bhavedbrāhmaṇottamaḥ ||
tasyāpi sakalāḥ pūrtāḥ prabhavaṃti sadā tataḥ || 6.232.20 ||
yo homaṃ caturo māsānprakaroti tilākṣataiḥ ||
svāhāṃtairvaiṣṇavairmaṃtrairna sa rogeṇa yujyate || 21 ||
yo japetpauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ snātvā viṣṇoḥ sthito'grataḥ ||
matistasya vivardheta śuklapakṣe yathoḍurāṭ || 22 ||
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yāvatphalahastaḥ pradakṣiṇām ||
karoti viṣṇormaunena na sa pāpena lipyate || 23 ||
miṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ yo dadāti svaśaktitaḥ ||
viśeṣātkārtike māsi so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet|| 24 ||
yaḥ svādhyāyaṃ caturvedairviṣṇorāyatane caret ||
caturo vārṣikānmāsānsa vidvānsarvadā bhavet || 25 ||
nṛtyagītādikaṃ yaśca kuryādviṣṇoḥ sadā gṛhe ||
apsaraso'sya kurvaṃti purataḥ svargatasya ca || 26 ||
yastu rātridinaṃ vipro nṛtyagītādikaṃ dadet ||
caturo vārṣikānmāsānsa gandharvatvamāpnuyāt || 27 ||
ete ca niyamāḥ sarve śakyaṃte yadi bho dvijāḥ ||
kartuṃ ca caturo māsānekasminvā'pi kārttike || 28 ||
tathāpi caiva kartavyaṃ lokadvayamabhīpsatā ||
kārtikyāṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā vaiṣṇavaiḥ puruṣairiha || 29 ||
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ kṣuraṃ kṣaudraṃ punarbhojanamaithune ||
kārtike varjayedyastu ya etānbrāhmaṇaḥ sadā || 6.232.30 ||
pūrvoktānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ niyamānāṃ phalaṃ labhet || 31 ||
atha yaḥ kārtike māsi prāsādasyopari dvijāḥ ||
jalaśāyyākhyadevasya kalaśe dīpakaṃ dadet||
pūrvoktaniyamānāṃ ca sa ṣaṇṇāṃ phalabhāgbhavet || 32 ||
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiṃci tsuprāpyaṃ caiva yadbhavet ||
niyamastasya kartavyaścāturmāsye śubhārthibhiḥ || 33 ||
niyame ca kṛte dadyādbrāhmaṇāya tadeva hi ||
niyamastu kṛto yasya svaśaktyā syātphalaṃ tataḥ || 34 ||
yo vinā niyamaṃ martyo vrataṃ vā jāpyameva vā ||
caturmāsānnayenmūrkho jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ ||35||
yathā kāka yavāḥ proktā yathāraṇyāstilodbhavāḥ ||
nāmamātraprasiddhāśca tathā te mānavā bhuvi || 36 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryo yatnena kārtike ||
eko'pi niyamaḥ kaścitsusūkṣmo'pi dvijottamāḥ || 37 ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ cāturmāsīsamudbhavam||
vratānāṃ niyamānāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ vistarāddvijāḥ ||38||
yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedvāpi samāhitaḥ ||
cāturmāsī kṛtātpāpātso'pi muktimavāpnuyāt || 39 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye jalaśāyyupākhyāne cāturmāsyavrataniyamavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśaduttaradviśatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||232 || ||

<6.233>

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||
sūta sūta mahābhāga śrotumicchāmahe vayam ||
cāturmāsyavratānāṃ hi tvatto māhātmyavistaram ||1||
tadasmākaṃ mahābhāga kṛpāṃ kṛtvā'dhunā vada ||
tvadvaco'mṛtapānena bhūyaḥ śraddhābhivardhate ||2||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve cāturmāsyavratodbhavam ||
māhātmyaṃ vistareṇaiva kathayiṣyāmi vo'grataḥ ||3||
purā brahmamukhācchrutvā nānāvratavidhānakam||
nāradaḥ paripapraccha bhūyo brahmāṇamādarāt ||4||
||nārada uvāca || ||
devadeva mahābhāga vratāni subahūnyapi ||
śrutāni tvanmukhādbrahmanna tṛptimadhigacchati || 5 ||
adhunā śrotumicchāmi cāturmāsyavrataṃ śubham|| 6 | ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
śṛṇu devamune mattaścāturmāsyavrataṃ śubham ||
yacchrutvā bhārate khaṃḍe nṛṇāṃ muktirna durlabhā || 7 ||
muktiprado'yaṃ bhagavānsaṃsārottārakāraṇam ||
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 8 ||
mānuṣye durlabhaṃ loke tatrā'pi ca kulīnatā ||
tatrāpi sadayatvaṃ ca tatra satsaṃgamaḥ śubhaḥ || 9 ||
satsaṃgamo na yatrāsti viṣṇubhaktirvratāni ca ||
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa viṣṇuvratakaraḥ śubhaḥ || 6.233.10 ||
cāturmāsye'vratī yastu tasya puṇyaṃ nirarthakam ||
sarvatīrthāni dānāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || 11 ||
viṣṇumāśritya tiṣṭhaṃti cāturmāsye samāgate ||
supuṣṭenāpi dehena jīvitaṃ tasya śobhanam || 12 ||
cāturmāsye samāyāte hariṃ yaḥ praṇamedbudhaḥ ||
kṛtārthāstasya vibudhā yāvajjīvaṃ varapradāḥ || 13 ||
saṃprāpya mānuṣaṃ janma cāturmāsyaparāṅmukhaḥ ||
tasya pāpaśatānyāhurdehasthāni na saṃśayaḥ || 14 ||
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ loke haribhaktiśca durlabhā ||
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa supte deve janārdane || 15 ||
cāturmāsye naraḥ snānaṃ prātareva samācaret ||
sarvakratuphalaṃ prāpya devavaddivi modate || 16 ||
cāturmāsye tu yaḥ snānaṃ kuryātsiddhimavāpnuyāt ||
tathā nirjharaṇe snāti taḍāge kūpikāsu ca || 17 ||
tasya pāpasahasrāṇi vilayaṃ yāṃti tatkṣaṇāt ||
puṣkare ca prayāge vā yatra kvāpi mahājale ||
cāturmāsyeṣu yaḥ snāti puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate || 18 ||
revāyāṃ bhāskarakṣetre prācyāṃ sāgarasaṃgame ||
ekāhamapi yaḥ snātaścāturmāsye na doṣabhāk || 19 ||
dinatrayaṃ ca yaḥ snāti narmadāyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
supte deve jagannāthe pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā || 6.233.20 ||
pakṣamekaṃ tu yaḥ snāti godāvaryāṃ dinodaye ||
sa bhittvā karmajaṃ dehaṃ yāti viṣṇoḥ salokatām || 21 ||
tilodakena yaḥ snāti tathā caivāmalodakaiḥ ||
bilvapatrodakaiścaiva cāturmāsye na doṣabhāk || 22 ||
gaṃgāṃ smarati yo nityamudapātrasamīpataḥ ||
tadgāṃgeyaṃ jalaṃ jātaṃ tena snānaṃ samācaret || 23 ||
gaṃgā'pi devadevasya caraṇāṃguṣṭhavāhinī ||
pāpaghnī sā sadā proktā cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ || 24 ||
yataḥ pāpasahasrāṇi viṣṇurdahati saṃsmṛtaḥ ||
tasmātpādodakaṃ śīrṣe cāturmāsye dhṛtaṃ śivam ||25||
cāturmāsye jalagato devo nārāyaṇo bhavet ||
sarvatīrthādhikaṃ snānaṃ viṣṇutejoṃśasaṃgatam||26||
snānaṃ daśavidhaṃ kāryaṃ viṣṇunāma mahāphalam ||
supte deve viśeṣeṇa naro devatvamāpnuyāt ||27||
vinā snānaṃ tu yatkarma puṇyakāryamayaṃ śubham ||
kriyate niṣphalaṃ brahmaṃstatpragṛhṇaṃti rākṣasāḥ ||28||
snānena satyamāpnoti snānaṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
dharmānmokṣaphalaṃ prāpya punarnaivāvasīdati||29||
ye cādhyātmavidaḥ puṇyā ye ca vedāṃgapāragāḥ ||
sarvadānapradā ye ca teṣāṃ snānena śuddhatā ||6.233.30||
kṛtasnānasya ca harirdehamāśritya tiṣṭhati ||
sarvakriyākalāpeṣu saṃpūrṇa phalado bhavet || 31 ||
sarvapāpavināśāya devatā toṣaṇāya ca ||
cāturmāsye jalasnānaṃ sarvapāpakṣayāvaham || 32 ||
niśāyāṃ caiva na snāyātsaṃdhyāyāṃ grahaṇaṃ vinā ||
uṣṇodakena na snānaṃ rātrau śuddhirna jāyate || 33 ||
bhānusaṃdarśanācchuddhirvihitā sarvakarmasu ||
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa jalaśuddhistu bhāvinī || 34 ||
aśaktyā tu śarīrasya bhasmasnānena śudhyati ||
maṃtrasnānena vipreṃdra viṣṇupādodakena vā || 358 ||
nārāyaṇāgrataḥ snānaṃ kṣetra tīrthanadīṣu ca ||
yaḥ karoti viśuddhātmā cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ || 36 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne cāturmāsyamāhātmye brahmanāradasaṃvāde gaṃgodakasnānaphalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyā yaḥ||233|| 

<6.234>

|| brahmovāca || ||
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryācchraddhāyuktena cetasā ||
snānāvasāne nityaṃ ca gupte deve mahāphalam ||1||
saṃgame saritostatra pitṝnsaṃtarpya devatāḥ ||
japahomādikarmāṇi kṛtvā phalamanaṃtakam ||2||
goviṃdasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā paścātkāryāḥ śubhāḥ kriyāḥ ||
eṣa eva pitṛdevamanuṣyādiṣu tṛptidaḥ || 3 ||
śraddhāṃ dharmayutāṃ nāma smṛtipūtāni kārayet ||
karmāṇi sakalānīha cāturmāsye guṇottare || 4 ||
satsaṃgo dvijabhaktiśca gurudevāgni tarpaṇam ||
gopradānaṃ vedapāṭhaḥ satkiyāsatyabhāṣaṇam || 5 ||
gobhaktirdānabhaktiśca sadā dharmasya sādhanam ||
kṛṣṇe supte viśeṣeṇa niyamo'pi mahā phalaḥ || 6 ||
|| nārada uvāca || ||
niyamaḥ kīdṛśo brahmanphalaṃ ca niyamena kim ||
niyamena haristuṣṭo yathā bhavati tadvada ||7 ||
|| brahmovāca || ||
niyamaścakṣurādīnāṃ kriyāsu vividhāsu ca ||
kāryo vidyāvatā puṃsā tatprayogānmahāsukham || 8 ||
etatṣaḍvargaharaṇaṃ ripunigrahaṇaṃ param ||
adhyātmamūlametaddhi paramaṃ saukhyakāraṇam || 9 ||
tatra tiṣṭhaṃti niyataṃ kṣamāsatyādayo guṇāḥ ||
vivekarūpiṇaḥ sarve tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 6.234.10 ||
kṛtvā bhavati yajñānyatkṛtakṛtyatvamatra tat ||
syāttasya tatpūrvajānāṃ yena jñātamidaṃ padam || 11 ||
tanmuhūrttamapi dhyātvā pāpaṃ janmaśatodbhavam||
bhasma sādyāti vihitaṃ niraṃjananiṣevaṇāt || 12 ||
pratyahaṃ saṃkucatyasya kṣutpipāsādikaḥ śramaḥ ||
sa yogī niyamī nityaṃ harau supte viśiṣyate || 13 ||
cāturmāsye naro bhaktyā yogābhyāsarato na cet ||
tasya hastātparibhraṣṭamamṛtaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 14 ||
mano niyamitaṃ yena sarvecchāsu sadāgatam||
tasya jñāne ca mokṣe ca kāraṇaṃ mana eva hi || 15 ||
manoniyamane yatnaḥ kāryaḥ prajñāvatā sadā ||
manasā sugṛhītena jñānāptirakhilā dhruvam || 16 ||
tanmanaḥ kṣamayā grāhyaṃ yathā vahniśca vāriṇā ||
ekayā kṣamayā sarvo niyamaḥ kathito budhaiḥ || 17 ||
satyamekaṃ paro dharmaḥ satyamekaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ ||
satyamekaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ satye dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 18 ||
dharmamūlamahiṃsā ca manasā tāṃ ca citayan ||
karmaṇā ca tathā vācā tata etāṃ samācaret || 19 ||
parasvaharaṇaṃ cauryaṃ sarvadā sarvamānuṣaiḥ ||
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa brahmadevasvavarjanam || 6.234.20 ||
akṛtyakaraṇaṃ caiva varjanīyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ ||
ahīnaḥ sarvakāryeṣu yaḥ sadā vipra vartate || 21 ||
sa ca yogī mahāprājñaḥ prajñācakṣurahaṃ nadhīḥ || ?
ahaṃkāro viṣamidaṃ śarīre varttate nṛṇām || 22 ||
tasmātsa sarvadā tyājyaḥ supte deve viśeṣataḥ ||
anīhayā jitakrodho jitalobho bhavennaraḥ || 23 ||
tasya pāpasahasrāṇi dehādyāṃti sahasradhā ||
mohaṃ mānaṃ parājitya śamarūpeṇa śatruṇā || 24 ||
vicāreṇa śamo grāhyaḥ santoṣeṇa tathā hi saḥ ||
mātsaryamṛjubhāvena niyacchetsa munīśvaraḥ || 25 ||
cāturmāsye dayādharmo na dharmo bhūtavidruhām ||
sarvadā sarva dāneṣu bhūtadrohaṃ vivarjayet || 26 ||
etatpāpasahasrāṇāṃ mūlaṃ prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryā bhūtadayā nṛbhiḥ || 27 ||
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ harirnityaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ ||
sa eva hi parābhūto yo bhūtadrohakārakaḥ || 28 ||
yasmindharme dayā naiva sa dharmo dūṣito mataḥ ||
dayāṃ vinā na vijñānaṃ na dharmo jñānameva ca || 29 ||
tasmātsarvātmabhāvena dayādharmaḥ manātanaḥ ||
sevyaḥ sa puruṣairnityaṃ cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ || 6.234.30 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye cāturmāsyamāhātmye śepaśāyyupākhyāne brahma nāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyaniyamavidhimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 234 || || 9 ||

<6.235>

|| brahmovāca || ||
dānadharmaṃ praśaṃsaṃti sarvadharmeṣu sarvadā ||
harau supte viśeṣeṇa dānaṃ brahmatvakāraṇam || 1 ||
annaṃ brahma iti proktamanne prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
tasmādannaprado nityaṃ vāridaśca bhavennaraḥ || 2 ||
vāridastṛptimāyāti sukhamakṣayyamannadaḥ ||
vāryannayoḥ samaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 3 ||
maṇiratnapravālānāṃ rūpyaṃ hāṭakavāsasām||
anyeṣāmapi dānānāmannadānaṃ viśiṣyate || 4 ||
annodakapradānaṃ ca gopradānaṃ ca nityadā ||
vedapāṭho vahnihomaścāturmāsye mahāphalam || 9 ||
vaikuṇṭhapadavāñchā cedviṣṇunā saha saṃgame ||
sarvapāpakṣayārthāya cāturmāsye'nnado bhavet || 6 ||
satyaṃsatyaṃ hi devarṣe mayoktaṃ tava nārada ||
janmāṃtarasahasreṣu nādattamupatiṣṭhate || 7 ||
tasmādannapradānena sarve hṛṣyaṃti jantavaḥ ||
devāśca spṛhayaṃtyenamannadānapradāyinam || 8 ||
ājyaṃ deyaṃ ca pātreṣu śraddhayā vajramiśritam ||
vajradānakaro martyaścāturmāsye na mānavaḥ || 9 ||
bhojanaṃ guruviprāṇāṃ ghṛtadānaṃ ca satkriyā ||
etāni yasya tiṣṭhanti cāturmāsye na mānavaḥ || 6.235.10 ||
saddharmaḥ satkathā caiva satsevā darśanaṃ satām ||
viṣṣupūjā ratirdāne cāturmāsyeṣu durlabhāḥ || 11 ||
pitṝnuddiśya yo martyaścāturmāsye'nnado bhavet ||
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā pitṛlokamavāmuyāt || 12 ||
devāḥ sarve'nnadānena tṛptā yacchanti vāṃchitam ||
pipīlikā'pi yadgehādbhakṣyamādāya gacchati || 13 ||
rātrau divā'niṣiddhānno hyannadānamanuttamam ||
harau supte hi pāpaghnaṃ vārya mapi śatruṣu || 14 ||
cāturmāsye dugdhadānaṃ dadhi takraṃ mahāphalam ||
janmakāle yena baddhaḥ piṃḍastaddānamuttamam || 15 ||
śākapradātā narakaṃ yamalokaṃ na paśyati ||
vastradaḥ somalokaṃ ca vasedābhūtasaṃplavam || 16 ||
supte deve yathāśakti hyanyāsu pratimāsu ca ||
puṣpavastrapradānena santānaṃ naiva hīyate || 17 ||
candanāgurudhūpaṃ ca cāturmāsye prayacchati ||
putrapautrasamāyukto viṣṇurūpī bhavennaraḥ ||18 ||
supte deve jagannāthe phaladānaṃ praya cchati ||
viprāya vedaviduṣe yamalokaṃ na paśyati || 19 ||
vidyādānaṃ ca godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ prayacchati ||
viṣṇuprītyarthameveha sa tārayati pūrvajān || 6.235.20 ||
guḍasaiṃdhavatailādimadhutiktatilānnadaḥ ||
devatāyāssamuddiśya tāsāṃ lokaṃ prayāti hi || 21 ||
cāturmāsye tilāndattvā na bhūyaḥ stanapo bhavet ||
yavapradātā vasate vāsavaṃ lokamakṣayam || 22 ||
hūyeta havyaṃ vahnau ca dānaṃ dadyāddvijātaye ||
gāvaḥ supūjitāḥ kāryāścāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ || 23 ||
yatkiṃcitsukṛtaṃ karma janmāvadhi susaṃcitam ||
cāturmāsye gate pātre vimukhe yanna dīyate || 24 ||
praṇaśyati kṣaṇādeva vacanā dyastu pracyutaḥ ||
divasedivase tasya varddhate ca pratiśrutam || 25 ||
tasmānnaiva pratiśrāvyaṃ svalpamapyāśu dīyate ||
tāvadvivarddhate dānaṃ yāvattanna prayacchati || 26 ||
yo mohānmanujo loke yāvatkoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||
tato daśaguṇā vṛddhiścāturmāsye pradātari || 27 ||
narake patanaṃ tasya yāva diṃdrāścaturdaśa ||
atastu sarvadā deyaṃ narairyattu pratiśrutam || 28 ||
anyasmai na pradātavyaṃ pradattaṃ naiva hārayet |
cāturmāsyeṣu yaḥ śayyāṃ dvijāgryāya prayacchati || 29 ||
vedoktena vidhānena na sa yāti yamālayam ||
āsanaṃ vāripātraṃ ca bhājanaṃ tāmrabhājanam || 6.235.30 ||
cāturmāsye prayatnena deyaṃ vittānusārataḥ ||
sarvadānāni viprebhyo dadatsupte jagadgurau || 31 ||
ātmānaṃ pūrvajaiḥ sārddhaṃ sa mocayati pātakāt ||
gaurbhūśca tilapātraṃ ca dīpadānamanuttamam || 32 ||
dadadvijātaye mukto jāyate sa ṛṇatrayāt || 33 ||
sa viśvakartā bhuvaneṣu goptā sa yajñabhuksarvaphalapradaśca ||
dānāni vastuṣvadhidaivataṃ ca yasminsamuddiśya dadāti muktaḥ || 34 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne cāturmāsyamāhātmye brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyadānamahimavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 235 || || cha ||

|| brahmovāca || ||
iṣṭavastuprado viṣṇurlokaśceṣṭaruciḥ sadā ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena cātumāsye tyajecca tat || 1 ||
nārāyaṇasya prītyarthaṃ tadevākṣayyamāpyate ||
martyastyajati śraddhāvānso'naṃtaphalabhāgbhavet || 2 ||
kāṃsyabhājanasaṃtyāgājjāyate bhūpatirbhuvi ||
pālāśapatre bhuñjāno brahmabhūyastvamaśnute || 3 ||
tāmrapātre na bhuñjīta kadācidvā gṛhī naraḥ ||
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa tāmrapātraṃ vivarjayet || 4 ||
arkapatreṣu bhuñjāno'nupamaṃ labhate phalam ||
vaṭapatreṣu bhoktavyaṃ cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ || 5 ||
aśvatthapatrasaṃbhogaḥ kāryo budhajanaiḥ sadā ||
ekānnabhojī rājā syātsakalaṃ bhūmimaṇḍale || 6 ||
tathā ca lavaṇatyāgātsubhago jāyate naraḥ ||
godhūmānnaparityāgājjāyate janavalabhaḥ || 7 ||
aśākabhojī dīrghāyuścāturmāsye'bhijāyate ||
rasatyāgānmahāprāṇī madhutyāgātsulocanaḥ || 8 ||
mudgatyāgādripumṛtī rājamāṣāddhanāḍhyatā ||
aśvāptistaṃḍulatyāgāccāturmāsye'bhijāyate || 9 ||
phalatyāgādbahusutastailatyāgātsurūpitā ||
jñānī tuvarisaṃtyāgādbalaṃ vīryaṃ sadaiva hi || 6.236.10 ||
mārgamāṃsaparityāgānnarakaṃ na ca paśyati ||
śaukarasya pīratyāgādbrahmavāsamavāpnuyāt || 11 ||
jñānaṃ lāvakasantyāgādājyatyāge mahatsukham ||
āsavaṃ samparityajya muktistasya na durlabhā || 12 ||
sabalaḥ kanakatyāgādrūpyatyāgena mānuṣaḥ || 69||
dadhidugdhaparityāgī goloke sukha bhāgbhavet || 13
brahmā pāyasasaṃtyāgātkṣiprātyāgānmaheśvaraḥ ||
kandarpo'pūpasaṃtyāgānmodakatyājakaḥ sukhī || 14 ||
gṛhāśramaparityāgī bāhyā śramaniṣevakaḥ ||
cāturmāsyaṃ hariprītyai na māturjaṭhare śiśuḥ || 15 ||
nṛpo marīcasaṃtyāgācchuṇṭhītyāgena satkaviḥ ||
śarkarāyāḥ parityāgājjāyate rājapūjitaḥ || 16 ||
guḍatyāgānmahābhūtistathā dāḍimavarjanāt ||
raktavastraparityāgājjāyate janavallabhaḥ || 17 ||
paṭṭakūlaparityāgādakṣayyaṃ svarga māpnuyāt ||
māṣānnacaṇakānnasya tyāgānnaiva punarbhavaḥ || 18 ||
kṛṣṇavastraṃ sadā tyājyaṃ cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ ||
sūryasaṃdarśanācchuddhirnīlavastrasya darśanāt || 19 ||
caṃdanasya pīratyāgādgāṃdharvaṃ lokamaśnute ||
karpūrasya parityāgādyāvajjīvaṃ mahādhanī || 6.236.20 ||
kusumbhasya parityāgānnaiva paśyedyamāla yam ||
keśarasya parityāgānmanuṣyo rājavallabhaḥ || 21 ||
yakṣakardamasaṃtyāgādbrahmaloke mahīyate ||
jñānī puṣpaparityāgācchayyātyāge mahatsu kham|| 22 ||
bhāryāviyogaṃ nāpnoti cāturmāsye na saṃśayaḥ ||
alīkavādasaṃtyāgānmokṣadvāramapāvṛtam || 23 ||
paramarmaprakāśaśca sadyaḥpāpasamā gamaḥ ||
cāturmāsye harau supte paranindāṃ vivarjayet || 24 ||
paranindā mahāpāpaṃ paranindā mahābhayam ||
paranindā mahadduḥkhaṃ na tasyāṃ pātakaṃ param || 25 ||
kevalaṃ nindane caiva tatpāpaṃ labhate guru ||
yathā śṛṇvāna eva syātpātakī na tataḥ paraḥ || 26 ||
keśasaṃskārasaṃtyāgāttāpatrayavivarjitaḥ ||

iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye tapo'dhikāraṣoḍaśopacāradīpamahimavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 239 || || cha ||

nityaṃpaddaivataṃ śrāddhaṃ hantakāro'gni tarpaṇam|| 28 ||
devadvijātibhaktiścanamaskāreṇasidyati ||
śūdro'pi prātarutthāya kṛtvā pādābhivaṃdanam || 29 ||
viṣṇubhaktimayāñślokānpaṭhanviṣṇutvamāpnuyāt||
vārṣikavratakṛnnityaṃ tithivārādhidaivataḥ || 6.242.30 ||

gacchakastantukāraśca cakrikaścarmakārakaḥ || 33 ||

aunāmikastu caṃḍālaḥ prakṛtyāṣṭādaśaiva te || 34 ||

kāḍukaḥ kumbhakāraśca prakṛtyā uttamāśca ṣaṭ || 35 ||
kharavāhyuṣṭravāhī hayavāhī tathaiva ca ||

rajakaścarmakāraśca naṭo buruḍa eva ca ||
kaivarttamedabhillāśca saptaite antyajāḥ smṛtāḥ ||37||
yo yasya hīno varṇena sa cāṣṭādaśamo naraḥ ||
sarvāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca uttamā madhyamāḥ samāḥ ||38||
bhedāstrayaḥ samākhyātā vijñeyāḥ smṛtinirṇayāt ||
śilpinaḥ sapta vijñeyā uttamāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ || 39 ||
svarṇakṛtkaṃbukaścaiva tandulīpuṣpalāvakaḥ ||
tāṃbūlī nāpitaścaiva maṇikāraśca saptadhā || 6.242.40 ||
na snānaṃ devatāhomastaponiyama eva ca ||
na svādhyāyavaṣaṭkārau na ca śuddhirvivāhitā || 41 ||
etāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca gurupūjā sadoditā ||
viprāṇāṃ prākṛto nityaṃ dānameva paro vidhiḥ || 42 ||
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ mahāmune ||
sarvāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca viṣṇubhaktiḥ sadā śubhā || 43 ||
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathāprakṛtisaṃbhavam ||
kathāṃ śṛṇu mahāpuṇyāṃ śūdraḥ śuddhimagādyathā || 44 ||
idaṃ purāṇaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ viśuddhadhī ryastu śṛṇoti vā paṭhet ||
vidhūya pāpāni purārjitāni sa yāti viṣṇorbhavanaṃ kriyāparaḥ || 45 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye'ṣṭādaśaprakṛtikathanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 242 || || cha ||

|| brahmovāca || ||

|| paijavana uvāca || ||
śāligrāmaśilāyāṃ ca jagadādiḥ sanātanaḥ ||

pūjitaśca stuto dhyātaḥ sarvaduḥkhavināśakaḥ || 14 ||
devastutyo devabījaṃ paraṃ yanmūrtaṃ brahma brahmavṛkṣatvamāptam ||
nityaṃ sevyaḥ śraddhayā sthāṇurūpaścāturmāsye sevitaḥ pāpahā syāt|| 15 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśā yyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye paijavanopākhyāne pālāśamahimavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 248 || ||9|| ||

<6.249>

|| vāṇyuvāca || ||
tulasī ropitā yena gṛhasthena mahāphalā ||
gṛhe tasya na dāridyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1 ||
tulasyā darśanādeva pāparāśirnivartate ||
śriye'mṛtakaṇotpannā tulasī harivallabhā || 2 ||
pibantyā ruciraṃ pānaṃ prāṇināṃ pāpahāriṇī ||
yasyā rūpe vasellakṣmīḥ skandhe sāgarasaṃbhavā || 3 ||
patreṣu satataṃ śrīśca śākhāsu kamalā svayam ||
indirā puṣpagā nityaṃ phale kṣīrābdhisaṃbhavā || 4 ||
tulasī śuṣkakāṣṭheṣu yā rūpā viśvavyāpinī ||
majjāyāṃ padmavāsā ca tvacāsu ca haripriyā || 5 ||
sarvarūpā ca sarveśā paramānandadāyinī ||
tulasī prāśako martyo yamalokaṃ na gacchati | 6 |
śirasthā tulasī yasya na yāmyairanubhūyate ||
mukhasthā tulasī yasya nirvāṇapadadāyinī || 7 ||
hastasthātulasīyasya sa tāpatrayavarjitaḥ ||
tulasī hṛdayasthā ca prāṇināṃ sarvakāmadā || 8 ||
skandhasthā tulasī yasya sa pāpairna ca lipyate ||
kaṇṭhagā tulasīyasyajīvanmuktaḥ sadā hi saḥ || 9 ||
tulasīsaṃbhavaṃ patraṃ sadā vahati yo naraḥ ||
manasā cintitāṃ siddhiṃ saṃprāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ || || 6.249.10 ||
tulasīṃsarvakāyārthasādhinīṃ duṣṭavāriṇīm ||
yo naraḥ pratyahaṃ siñcenna sa yāti yamālayam || 11 ||
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa vanditāpi vimuktidā ||
nārāyaṇaṃ jalagataṃ jñātvā vṛkṣagataṃ tathā || 12 ||
prāṇināṃ kṛpayā lakṣmīstulasīvṛkṣamāśritā ||
cāturmāsye samāyāte tulasī sevitā yadi || 13 ||
teṣāṃ pāpasahasrāṇi yāṃti nityaṃ sahasradhā ||
govindasmaraṇaṃ nityaṃ tulasīvanasevanam || 14 ||
tulasīsecanaṃ dugdhai ścāturmāsye'tidurlabham ||
tulasīṃ varddhayedyastu mānavo yadi śraddhayā || 15 ||
ālavālāṃbudānaiśca pāvitaṃ sakalaṃ kulam ||
yathā śrīstulasīsaṃsthā nityameva hi varddhate || 16 ||
tathātathā gṛhasthasya kāmavṛddhiḥ prajāyate ||
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā || 17 ||
tathā prakṛtayaḥ sarvāstulasīsevane ratāḥ ||
śraddhayā yadi jāyante na tāsāṃ duḥkhado hariḥ || 18 ||
eko hariḥ sakalavṛkṣagato vibhāti nānārasaistu paribhāvitamūrtireva ||
vṛkṣādhivāsamagamatkamalā ca devī duḥkhādināśanakarī satataṃ smṛtā'pi || 19 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇaekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha nāga rakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye paijavanopākhyāne tulasīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśaduttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||249||

<6.250>

|| vāṇyuvāca || ||
bilvapatrasya māhātmyaṃ kathituṃ naiva śakyate||
tavoddeśena vakṣyāmi mahendra śṛṇu tattvataḥ ||1||
vihāraśramamāpannā devī girisutā śubhā ||
lalāṭaphalake tasyāḥ svedabindurajāyata ||2||
sa bhavānyā vinikṣipto bhūtale nipapāta ca ||
mahātarurayaṃ jāto mandare parvatottame || 3 ||
tataḥ śailasutā tatra ramamāṇā yayau punaḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā vanagataṃ vṛkṣaṃ vismayotphullalocanā || 4 ||
jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva papraccha ca sakhīdvayam ||
ko'yaṃ mahātarurdivyo vibhāti vanamadhyagaḥ ||
dṛśyate rucirākāro mahāharṣakaro hyayam || 5 ||
|| jayovāca || ||
devi tvaddehasaṃbhūto vṛkṣo'yaṃ svedabindujaḥ ||
nāmā'sya kuru vai kṣipraṃ pūjitaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || 6 ||
|| pārvatyuvāca || ||
yasmātkṣoṇītalaṃ bhittvā viśiṣṭo'yaṃ mahātaruḥ || 7 ||
udatiṣṭhatsamīpe me tasmādbilvo bhavatvayam ||
imaṃ vṛkṣaṃ samāsādya bhaktitaḥ patrasaṃcayam || 8 ||
āhariṣyatyasau rājā bhaviṣyatyeva bhūtale ||
yaḥ kariṣyati me pūjāṃ patraiḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 9 ||
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyettasya siddhiḥ prajāyate ||
yo dṛṣṭvā bilvapatrāṇi śraddhāmapi kariṣyati || 6.250.10 ||
pūjanārthāya vidhaye dhanadā'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
patrāgraprāśane yastu kariṣyati mano yadi ||
tasya pāpasahasrāṇi yāsyaṃti vilayaṃ svayama || 11 ||
śiraḥ patrāgrasaṃyuktaṃ karoti yadi mānavaḥ ||
na yāmyā yātanā hyasya duḥkhadātrī bhaviṣyati || 12 ||
ityuktvā pārvatī hṛṣṭā jagāma bhavanaṃ svakam ||
sakhībhiḥ sahitā devī gaṇairapi samanvitā || 13 ||
|| vāṇyuvāca || ||
ayaṃ bilvataruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pavitraḥ pāpanāśanaḥ ||
tasya mūle sthitā devī girijā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 14 ||
skandhe dākṣāyaṇī devī śākhāsu ca maheśvarī ||
patreṣu pārvatī devī phale kātyā yanī smṛtā || 15 ||
tvaci gaurī samākhyātā aparṇā madhyavalkale ||
puṣpe durgā samākhyātā umā śākhāṃgakeṣu ca || 16 ||
kaṇṭakeṣu ca sarveṣu koṭayo navasaṃkhyayā |
śaktayaḥ prāṇirakṣārthaṃ saṃsthitā girijā''jñayā ||17 ||
tāṃ bhajaṃti supatraiśca pūjayaṃti sanātanīm ||
yaṃyaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ tasya siddhirbhaveddhruvam|| 18 ||
maheśvarī sā girijā maheśvarī viśuddharūpā janamokṣadātrī||
haraṃ ca dṛṣṭvātha palāśamāśritaṃ svalīlayā bilvavapuścakāra sā || 19 ||
iti śrīskāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cātu rmāsyamāhātmye paijavanopākhyāne bilvotpattivarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||250|| || a ||

<6.251>

|| gālava uvāca || ||
ityuktvā''kāśajāvāṇī virarāma śubhapradā ||
te'pi devāstadāścaryaṃ mahaddṛṣṭvā mahāvratāḥ || 1 ||
catuṣṭayaṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ cāturmāsye samāgate ||
apūjayaṃśca vidhivadaikyabhāvena śūdraja || 2 ||
cāturmāsye'tha saṃpūrṇe devo hariharātmakaḥ ||
prasannastānuvācātha bhaktyā pratyakṣarūpadhṛk || 3 ||
yūyaṃ gacchata deveśa mahā vrataparāyaṇāḥ ||
bhuṃkta svānsvāṃścādhikārānmayā te dānavā hatāḥ || 4 ||
ityuktvā devadeveśāvaikyarūpadharau yadā ||
gaṇānāṃ devatānāṃ ca buddhiṃ nirbhedatāṃ tadā || 5 ||
nayantau tau tadā ceśā babhūvaturarindamau||
te'pi devā nirābādhā hṛṣṭacittā hyabhedataḥ || 6 ||
prayayuḥ svāṃścādhikārānvimānagaṇa koṭibhiḥ ||
|| gālava uvāca || ||
tathā tatrāpi te devāḥ pārvatyāḥ śāpamohitāḥ || 7 ||
stutvā tāṃ bilvapatraiśca pūjayitvā maheśvarīm ||
prasannavadanāṃ stutvā praṇipatya punaḥpunaḥ || 8 ||
sā provāca tato devānviśvamātā tu saṃstutā ||
mama śāpo vṛthā naiva bhaviṣyati surottamāḥ || 9 ||
tathāpi kṛtapāpānāṃ karavāṇi kṛpāṃ ca vaḥ ||
svarge dṛṣanmayā naiva bhaviṣyatha surottamāḥ || 6.251.10 ||
martyalokaṃ ca saṃprāpya pratimāsu ca sarvaśaḥ ||
sarve devāśca varadā lokānāṃ prabhaviṣyatha || 11 ||
pāṇigraheṇa vihitā ye kumārāḥ kumārikāḥ ||
teṣāṃteṣāṃ prajāścaiva bhaviṣyatha na saṃśayaḥ || 12 ||
ityuktvā sā bhagavatī devatānāṃ varapradā ||
viṣṇuṃ maheśvaraṃ caiva provāca kupitā bhṛśam || 13 ||
devāstasyā bhayānnaṣṭā martyeṣu pratimāṃ gatāḥ ||
bhaktānāṃ mānasaṃ bhāvaṃ pūrayantaḥ susaṃsthitāḥ || 14 ||
yasmādviṣṇo maheśānastvayā'pi na niṣedhitaḥ ||
tasmāttvamapi pāṣāṇo bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 15 ||
haro'pyaśmamayaṃ rūpaṃ prāpya lokavigarhitam ||
liṃgākāraṃ vipraśāpānmahadduḥkhamavāpsyati || 16 ||
tacchrutvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ pārvatīmanukūlayan ||
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā harabhāryāṃ maheśvarīm || 17 ||
|| śrīviṣṇuruvāca || ||
mahāvrate mahādevi mahādevapriyā sadā ||
tvaṃ hi sattvarajaḥsthā ca tāmasī śaktiruttamā || 18 ||
mātrātrayasamopetā guṇatrayavibhāvinī ||
māyādīnāṃ janitrī tvaṃ viśvavyāpakarūpiṇī || 19 ||

arūpā sarvarūpā tvaṃ janasantānadāyinī || 6.251.20 ||
phalavelā mahākālī mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ||
oṃkāraśca vaṣaṭkārastvameva hi sureśvari || 21 ||
bhūtadhātri namaste'stu śivāyai ca namo'stu te ||
rāgiṇyai ca virāgiṇyai vikarāle namaḥ śubhe || 22 ||
evaṃ stutā prasannākṣī prasannenāṃtarātmanā ||
uvāca paramodāraṃ mithyāroṣayutaṃ vacaḥ || 23 ||
macchāpo nā'nyathā bhāvī janārdana tavāpyayam ||
tatrā'pi saṃsthitastvaṃ hi yogīśvaravimuktidaḥ || 24 ||
kāmapradaśca bhaktānāṃ cāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ ||

tasyāḥ suvimale nīre tava vāso bhaviṣyati || 26 ||

mukhe jāṃbūnadaṃ caiva śālagrāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 27 ||

sarvasāmarthyasaṃyukto yogināmapi mokṣadaḥ || 28 ||
ye tvāṃ śilāgataṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ||
teṣāṃ sucintitāṃ siddhiṃ bhaktānāṃ saṃprayacchasi || 29 ||
śilāgataṃ ca deveśaṃ tulasyā bhakti tatparāḥ ||
pūjayiṣyaṃti manujāsteṣāṃ muktirna dūrataḥ || 6.251.30 ||
śilāsthitaṃ ca yaḥ paśyettvāṃ viṣṇuṃ pratimāgatam ||

|| gālava uvāca || ||
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śālagrāmasya kāraṇam ||
yathā sa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ pāṣāṇatvamupā gataḥ || 32 ||
govindo'pi mahāśāpaṃ labdhvā svabhavanaṃ gataḥ ||
pārvatī ca maheśānaṃ kupitā praṇamayya ca || 33 |
evaṃ sa eva bhagavānbhavabhūta bhavyabhūtādikṛtsakalasaṃsthitināśanāṃkaḥ ||
so'pi śriyā saha bhavo'pi girīśaputryā sārddhaṃ caturṣu ca drumeṣu nivāsamāpa || 34 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye paija vanopākhyāne viṣṇuśāponāmaikapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 251 ||

|| śūdra uvāca || ||
mahadāścaryametaddhi yatsurā vṛkṣarūpiṇaḥ ||

bhagavanke surāste tu keṣukeṣu nivāsinaḥ ||

|| gālava uvāca || ||
amṛtaṃ jalamityāhuścāturmāsye tadicchayā ||
līlayā vidhṛtaṃ devaiḥ pibaṃti drumadevatāḥ || 3 ||
tasya pānānmahātṛptirjāyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ||
balaṃ tejaśca kāṃtiśca sauṣṭhavaṃ laghuvikramaḥ || 4 ||
guṇā ete prajāyante pānātkṛṣṇāṃśasaṃbhavāt ||
nityāmṛtasyapānena balaṃ svalpaṃ prajāyate || 5 ||
bhojanaṃ tatpraśaṃsaṃti nityametanna saṃśayaḥ ||
tasmāccaturṣu māseṣu pibanti jalameva hi || 6||
vṛkṣasthāḥ pitaro devāḥ prāṇināṃ hita kāmyayā ||

kṣīravṛkṣāḥ kṣīrayuktaistoyaiḥ siktāḥ śubhapradāḥ ||

cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa sarvakāma phalapradam ||

sāvitrīṃ tilamāsthāya pavitraṃ śvetabhūṣaṇam ||

prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve cūtavṛkṣamupāśritāḥ || 6.252.20 ||
gandharvā malayaṃ vṛkṣamaguruṃ gaṇanāyakaḥ ||
samudrā vetasaṃ vṛkṣaṃ yakṣā punnāgameva ca || 21 ||
nāgavṛkṣaṃ tathā nāgāḥ siddhāḥ kaṃkolakaṃ drumam ||

yaṣṭīmadhu samāśritya kandarpo'bhūdvyavasthitaḥ ||
raktāṃjanaṃ mahāvṛkṣaṃ vahnirāśritya tiṣṭhati || 23 ||

varuṇaḥ kharjurīvṛkṣaṃ pūgavṛkṣaṃ ca mārutaḥ || 24 ||

yadrātritritayenaiva vaṭā śokabhavena ca ||

sūryeṇārkaḥ pavitreṇa some nātha tripatrakaḥ || 35 ||
khadiro bhūmiputreṇa apāmārgo budhena ca ||

śamī śanaiścareṇātha svīkṛtā śūdrajātibhiḥ ||

pravarttaṃte hi māseṣu caturṣu ca na saṃśayaḥ ||
cāturmāsye devapatnyaḥ sarvā vallīsamāśri tāḥ || 42 ||
prayacchaṃti nṛṇāṃ kāmānvāṃchitānsevitā api ||
tasmātsarvātmabhāvena pippalo yena sevitaḥ || 43 ||
sevitāḥ sakalā vṛkṣā ścāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ ||
tulasī sevitā yena sarvavalyaśca sevitāḥ || 44 ||
āpyāyitaṃ jagatsarvamābrahmastaṃbasevitam ||
cāturmāsye gṛha sthena vānaprasthena vā punaḥ || 45||
brahmacāriyatibhyāṃ ca sevitā mokṣadāyinī ||
eteṣāṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ chedanaṃ naiva kārayet || 46 ||
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa vinā yajñādikāraṇam||
etaduktamaśeṣeṇa yatpṛṣṭo'hamiha tvayā || 47 ||
yathā vṛkṣatvamāpannā devāḥ sarve'pi śūdraja || 48 ||
aśvatthamekaṃ picumandamekaṃ nyagrodhamekaṃ daśa tittiḍīśca ||
kapitthabilvāmalakītrayaṃ ca etāṃśca dṛṣṭvā narakaṃ na paśyet || 49 ||
sarve devā viśvavṛkṣeśayāśca kṛṣṇā dhārā kṛṣṇamadhyāgrakāśca ||
yasmindeve sevite viśvapūjye sarvaṃ tṛptaṃ jāyate viśvametat ||6.252.50 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhenāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye vṛkṣamāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 252 || cha ||

<6.253>

|| śūdra uvāca || ||
pārvatīkupitā devī kathaṃ devena śūlinā ||
prasādaṃ ca gatā śaptvā yatkopātkṣubhyate jagat || 1 ||
kathaṃ sa bhagavānrudro bhāryāśāpamavāpa ha ||
vaikṛtaṃ rūpamāsādya punardivyaṃ vapuḥ śritaḥ || 2 ||
|| gālava uvāca || ||
devā rūpāṇyadṛśyāni kṛtvā devyā mahābhayāt||
manuṣyaloke sakale pratimāsu ca saṃsthitāḥ || 3 ||
teṣāmapi prasannā sā'nugrahaṃ samupākarot ||
viṣṇustutā mahābhāgā viśvamātā'ghanāśinī || 4 ||
teṣāṃ balācca pārvatyāḥ śāpabhāreṇa yantritaḥ ||
tāṃ nityamevānunayannṛce sovāca śaṃkaram || 5 ||
ete devā viśva pūjyā viśvasya ca varapradāḥ ||
matprasādādbhaviṣyaṃti bhaktitastoṣitā naraiḥ || 6 ||
tvāmṛte mama karmedaṃ kṛtaṃ sādhuvininditam ||
vedyāṃ vivāha kāle ca pratyakṣaṃ sarvasākṣikam || 7 ||
yatsaptamaṃḍalānāṃ ca gamanaṃ ca karārpaṇam ||
vahniśca varuṇaḥ kṛṣṇo devatāśca savallabhāḥ || 8 ||
caturdikṣvaṃga saṃyuktā devabrāhmaṇasaṃyutāḥ ||
eteṣāmagrato dibyaṃ kṛtvā tvaṃ janasaṃsadi || 9 ||
pramādātsattvamāpanno vyabhicāraṃ kathaṃ kṛthāḥ ||
guruvo'pi na sanmārge pravarttaṃte janaughavat || 6.253.10 ||
nigrāhyāḥ sarvalokeṣu prabuddhaiḥ śrūyate śrutau ||
putreṇāpi pitā śāsyaḥ śiṣyeṇāpi guruḥ svayam || 11 ||
kṣatriyairbrāhmaṇaḥ śāsyo bhāryayā ca patistathā ||
unmārgagāminaṃ śreṣṭhamapi vedāntapāragam || 12 ||
nīcairapi praśāsyeta śrutirāha sanātanī ||
sanmārga eva sarvatra pūjyate nāpathaḥ kvacit || 13 ||
yena svakulajo dharmastyaktaḥ sa patito bhavet ||
mṛtaśca narakaṃ prāpya duḥkhabhāreṇa yujyate || || 14 ||
dharmaṃ tyajati nāstikyājjñātibhedamupāgataḥ ||
sa nigrāhyaḥ sarvalokairmanudharmaparāyaṇaiḥ || 15 ||
kuladharmāñjñātidharmāndeśadharmānmaheśvara ||
ye tyajaṃti ca te'vaśyaṃ kulācca patitā janāḥ || 16 ||
agnityāgo vratatyāgo vacanatyāga eva ca ||
dharmatyāgo naiva kāryaḥ kurvanpatita eva hi || || 17 ||
na pitā na ca te mātā na bhrātā svajano'pi ca ||
paśyate tava vārtāṃ ca aspṛśyastvamadanviṣam || 18 ||
asthimālācitābhasma jaṭādhārī kucailavān ||
capalo muktamaryādastasthuṃ nārhasi me'grataḥ || 19 ||
abrahmaṇyo'vratī bhikṣurduṣṭātmā kapaṭī sadā ||
nārhasi tvaṃ mama puraḥ saṃbhāṣayitumīśvara || 6.253.20 ||
evaṃ sā rudatī devī bāṣpavyākulalocanā ||
mahāduḥkhayutaivāsīddeveśe'nunayatyapi || 21 ||
punareva prakupitā haraṃ provāca bhāminī ||
tavārjavaṃ na hṛdaye kāṭhinyaṃ vedmi nityadā || 22 ||
brāhmaṇaistvāsurairuktaṃ tanmṛṣā pratibhāti me ||
yasmānmayi mahāduṣṭabhāva eva kṛtastvayā || 23 ||
brāhmaṇā vaṃcitā yasmādbrāhmaṇaistvaṃ haniṣyase ||
evamuktvā bhagavatī punarāha na kiñcana || 24 ||
īśaḥ prasannavadanāmupacārairathākarot ||
śanairnītimayairvākyairhetumadbhirmaheśvaraḥ || 25 ||
prasannalocanāṃ jñātvā kiṃcitprāha harastataḥ ||
kopena kaluṣaṃ vaktraṃ pūrṇacandra samaprabham || 26 ||
kasmāttvaṃ kuruṣe bhadre yuktameva vaco na te ||
sarvabhūtadayā kāryā prāṇināṃ hi hitecchayā || 27 ||
yadyapīṣṭo hi yasyārtho na kāryaṃ parapīḍanam ||
jagatsarvaṃ sutaprāyaṃ tavāsti varavarṇini || 28 ||
jagatpūjyā tvamevaikā sarvarūpadharānaghe ||
mayā yadi kṛtaṃ karmāvadyaṃ deva hitāya vai || 29 ||
tathāpyevaṃ tava suto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
athavā mama sarvebhyaḥ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || 6.253.30 ||
yadicchasi tathā kuryāṃ tathā tava manorathān||
prasannavadanā bhūtvā kathayasva varānane || 31 ||
ityuktā sā bhagavatī punarāha maheśvaram ||
cāturmāsye ca saṃprāpte mahāvrata dharo yadi || 32 ||
devatānāṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ tāṃḍavaṃ nartase yadi ||
pārayitvā vrataṃ samyagbrahmacaryaṃ maheśvara || 33 ||
matprītyai yadi dehārthaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca prayacchasi ||
śāpasyānugrahaṃ kuryāṃ prasavavadanā satī || 34 ||
nānyathā mama cittaṃ tvāṃ viśvāsamanugacchati ||
tacchrutvā bhagavāṃstuṣṭastatheti pratyuvāca tām || 35 ||
sāpi hṛṣṭā bhagavatī śāpasyānugrahe vṛtā || 36 ||
idaṃ purāṇaṃ manujaḥ śṛṇoti śraddhāyukto bhedabuddhyā dṛḍhatvam ||
tasyā vaśyaṃ jīvitaṃ sarvasiddhaṃ martyāḥ satyāttacchrayatvaṃ prayāṃti || 37 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye śaṃkarakṛtapārvatyanunayo nāma tripaṃcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 253 || || dha || ||

śūdra uvāca || ||
idamāścaryarūpaṃ me pratibhāti vacastava ||
yadyapi syānmahākleśo vadatastava suvrata || 1 ||
tathāpi mama bhāgyena matpuṇyairmadgṛhaṃ gataḥ ||

|| gālava uvāca || ||

gālava uvāca || ||

evaṃ sa saṃstuto nīlo vipraistaiḥ somapāyibhiḥ || 69 ||
prasannavadano bhūtvā viprā npraṇatitatparaḥ ||

varaṃ dadurmaheśasya nīlarūpasya dharmataḥ ||

pretatvaṃ susthiraṃ tasya dattaiḥ śrāddhaśatairapi ||
punareva susarpaṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā nīlaṃ mahāvṛṣam || 72 ||
svalpakrodhasamāviṣṭaṃ dvijāścakrustamaṃ kitam ||
cakraṃ ca vāmabhāgeṣu śūlaṃ pārśve ca dakṣiṇe || 73 ||
utsasṛjurgavāṃ madhye taṃ devairgopitaṃ tadā ||
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve maharṣīṇāṃ gaṇāḥ punaḥ ||
svāni sthānāni te jagmurmunayo vītamatsarāḥ || 74 ||
evamṛṣīṇāṃ dayitāsu saktaḥ kāmārttacitto munipuṃgavānām ||
śāpaṃ samāsādya śivo'pi bhaktyā revājale'gātsuśilāmayatvam || 79 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇaekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye paijavanopākhyāne vṛṣastutirnāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamoadhyāyaḥ || 259 || || cha ||

|| gālava uvāca || ||

|| brahmovāca || ||

ślokaṃ vā sarvamapi ca tasya puṇyakṣayo na hi || 6.260.10 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsya māhātmye paijavanopākhyāne ṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 260 || || cha ||

jñātvā sarvagataṃ brahma sarvajña parameśvara||27||
nivarttaṃte kriyāḥ sarvā yasya taṃ yoginaṃ viduḥ||
viṣaye lubdhacittānāṃ vane'pi jāyate ratiḥ||28||
sarvatra samadṛṣṭīnāṃ gehe muktirhi śāśvatī||
jñānameva maheśāna manuṣyāṇāṃ sudurlabham||29||
labdhaṃ jñānaṃ kathamapi paṃḍito naiva pātayet||
nāhamasmi na mātā me na pitā na ca bāṃdhavaḥ||6.264.30||
jñānaṃ prāpya pṛthakbhāvamāpanno bhuvaneṣvaham||
prāpyaṃ bhāgamidaṃ daivātprabhāvāttava nārhasi||31||
vaktumevaṃvidhaṃ vākyaṃ mumukṣorme na saṃśayaḥ||
yadāgrahaparā devī punaḥpunarabhāṣata||32||
tadā tau pitarau natvā gato'sau krauñcaparvatam||
tatrāśrame mahāpuṇye cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ||33||
jajāpa paramaṃ brahma dvādaśākṣarabījakam||
pūrvaṃ dhyānena sarvāṇi vaśīkṛtyendriyāṇi ca||34||
mamatāṃ saṃviyujyātha jñānayogamavāptavān||
siddhayastasya nirvighnā aṇimādyā yadā''gatāḥ||35||
tadā tāsāṃ gaṇā kruddho vākyametaduvāca ha||
mamāpi duṣṭabhāvena yadi yūyamupāgatāḥ||36||
tadāsmatsamaśāṃtānāṃ nābhibhūtiṃ kariṣyatha||
evaṃ jñātvā maheśo'pi yato jñānamahodayam||37||
matto'pi jñānayogenaskando'pyadhikabhāvabhṛt||
vismayāviṣṭahṛdayaḥ pārvatīmanuśiṣṭavān||38||
putraśokaparāṃ comāṃ śubhairvākyāmṛtairharaḥ||
cāturmāsasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam||39||
maheśvaro vā madhukaiṭabhārirhṛdyāśrito dhyānamayo'dvitīyaḥ||
abhedabuddhyā paramārtihaṃtā ripuḥ sa evātipriyo bhavettataḥ||6.264.40||
sūta uvāca||
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ viprāścāturmāsyasamudbhavam||
māhātmyaṃ vistareṇaiva kimanyacchrotumicchatha||41||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śeṣaśāyyupākhyāne brahmanāradasaṃvāde cāturmāsyamāhātmye tārakāsuravadho nāma catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||264||

<6.265>

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
prabhūtāni tvayoktāni vratāni niyamāstathā||
prasupte puṃḍarīkākṣe yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate||1||
aśaktyā hi śarīrasya niyamānāṃ kathaṃ caret||
vrataṃ hi sukumārāṃgo dānairvāpi vadasva naḥ||2||
sūta uvāca||
aśakto niyamaṃ kartuṃ sukumāro bhavettu yaḥ||
tena tatra prakartavyaṃ vikhyātaṃ bhīṣmapaṃcakam||3||
kārttikasya site pakṣa ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ||
prātarutthāya vipreṃdra kartavyaṃ daṃtadhāvanam||4||
tatastu niyamaṃ kuryādvāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ||
pūrvoktānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ niyamānāṃ dvijottamāḥ||5||
upavāsaḥ prakartavyastasminnahani bhaktitaḥ||
aśaktyā vā śarīrasya hemaṃ dadyātsvaśaktitaḥ||6||
brāhmaṇāya haviṣyānnaṃ dātavyaṃ vaiṣṇavairnaraiḥ|
evaṃ pañcadinaṃ yāvatkartavyaṃ vratamuttamam||7||
pūjanīyo hṛṣīkeśo jalaśāyisvarūpadhṛk||
gaṃdhairdhūpaiśca naivedyai rātrijāgaraṇairapi||8||
ṣaṣṭhe'hani tato jāte pūjayedbrāhmaṇottamān||
tāṃśca vastrairhiraṇyena miṣṭānnena prabhaktitaḥ||9||
tataḥ kṛtāṃjalirbhūtvā yācayedbrāhmaṇottamān||
sarve me niyamāḥ prāptā yuṣmākaṃ ca prasādataḥ||6.265.10||
tatastairapi vaktavyaṃ caturmāsīsamudbhavam||
vratānāṃ niyamānāṃ ca vrataṃ bhūyāttavākhilam||11||
tato visarjya tānviprānbhojanaṃ svayamācaret||
sarvāhāreṇa rājeṃdra paṃcagavyaprapūrvakam||12||
yaḥ karoti vrataṃ tasya phalaṃ syādbahupuṇyadam||
yaḥ punarvratametaddhi kurute dinapaṃcakam||
upavāsaparastasya phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet||13||
ekādaśyāṃ hareḥ pūjāṃ jātipuṣpaiḥ samācaret||
dvādaśyāṃ bilvapatreṇa śatapatryā tataḥ param||
trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ surabhyā bhaktipūrvakam||14||
bhṛṃgarājena puṇyena paurṇamāsyāṃ prapūjayet||
pratipaddivase sarvaiḥ pūjanīyo janārdanaḥ||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam||15||
pratipaddivase sarvānprāśayetkāyaśuddhaye||
agaraṃ guggulaṃ caiva karpūraṃ tagaraṃ tvacā||16||
ekaikaṃ nirvapeddhūpaṃ pratipaddivase'khilam||
jalaśāyī jagadyoniḥ śeṣaparyaṃkamāśritaḥ||17||
arghaṃ gṛhṇātu me devo bhīṣmapaṃcakasiddhaye||
maṃtreṇānena dātavyo hyargho devasya bhaktitaḥ||18||
śaṃkhatoyaṃ samādāya sapuṣpaphalacaṃdanaiḥ||
naivedyaṃ paramānnaṃ ca svaśaktyā nirvapeddvijāḥ||19||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ vrataṃ vai bhīṣmapaṃcakam||
saṃprāpyate phalaṃ caiva vratānāṃ niyamaiḥ saha||6.265.20||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|| yadetadbhavatā proktamaśūnyaśāyinīvratam||
indreṇa yatkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tuṣṭyarthaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ||
prasuptasya mahābhāga phalaṃ caiva prakīrtitam||21||
kasminkāle prakartavyaṃ kenaiva vidhinā tathā||
tasmātsūta mahābhāga vidhānaṃ vistarādvada||22||
sūta uvāca||
śrāvaṇyāṃ samatītāyāṃ dvitīyādivase sthite||
prātarutthāya viprendrā nakṣatre viṣṇudaivate||
pāpiṣṭhaiḥ patitairmlecchaiḥ saṃbhāṣaṃ naiva kārayet||23||
tato madhyāhnasamaye snātvā dhautāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ||
jalaśāyinamāsādya maṃtreṇānena pūjayet||24||
śrīvatsadhāriñchrīkāṃta śrīdhāmañchrīpate'vyaya||
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadam||25||
pitaro mā praṇaśyaṃtu mā praṇaśyaṃtu cāgnayaḥ||
devatā mā praṇaśyaṃtu matto dāṃpatyabhedataḥ||26||
lakṣmyā viyujyase kṛṣṇa na kadācidyathā bhavān||
tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me praṇaśyatu||27||
lakṣmyā hyaśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ yathā te deva sarvadā||
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmani janmani|| 28||
evamarthaṃ nivedyātha tato vipraṃ prapūjayet||
yathāśaktyā dvijaśreṣṭhā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet||29||
evaṃ bhādrapade māsi āśvine kārtike tathā||
pūjayecca jagannāthaṃ jalaśāyinamacyutam||6.265.30||
akṣārabhojanaṃ kāryaṃ viśeṣāttailavarjitam||
samāptau ca tato dadyādbrāhmaṇeṃdrāya bhaktitaḥ||31||
phalavrīhisamopetāṃ śayyāṃ vastrasamanvitām||
suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ ca tathaiva ca phalaṃ labhet||32||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyagvratametatsamāhitaḥ||
tasya tuṣṭipathaṃ yāti jalaśāyī jagadguruḥ||33||
yathā śakrasya saṃtuṣṭaḥ pūrvameva dvijottamāḥ||
aśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ tasya bhavejjanmani janmani||34||
aṣṭamāsakṛtaṃ pāpamajñānājjñānato'pi vā||
aśūnyaśayanātsarvaṃ vratānnāśaṃ nayetpumān||35||
putrahīnā ca yā nārī kākavandhyā ca yā bhavet||
vidhavā yā karotyetadvratamevaṃ samāhitā||
tasyāstuṣṭo jagannāthaḥ kāyaśuddhiṃ prayacchati||36||
na tasyā jāyate buddhiḥ kadācitpāpasaṃbhavā||
na kāmopahatā buddhiḥ kathaṃcidapi jāyate||37||
kumārikāpi yā samyagvratametatsamācaret||
sā patiṃ labhate viprāḥ kulīnaṃ rūpasaṃyutam||38||
niṣkāmaḥ kurute yastu vratametatsamāhitaḥ||
cāturmāsyudbhavānāṃ ca niyamānāṃ phalaṃ labhet||39||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye jalaśāyyupākhyāne aśūnyaśayanavratamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||265||

<6.266>

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
śrutāni mukhyatīrthāni tatkṣetraprodbhavāni ca||
yeṣu snāto naraḥ smyaksarva tīrthaphalaṃ labhet||1||
liṃgāni ca mahābhāga tatra mukhyāni yāni ca||
yairdṛṣṭairlabhyate śreyaḥ sarveṣāṃ tāni no vada||2||
sūta uvāca||
tatra ca maṃkaṇākhyaṃ tu liṃgamasti suśobhanam||
tathā siddheśvaraṃ nāma gautameśvarasaṃyutam||3||
kapāleśvamanyacca caturthaṃ parikīrtitam||
ekaikaṃ sarvaliṃgānāṃ phalaṃ yacchatyasaṃśayam||
yathoktavidhinā samyagyathoktaṃ dvijasattamāḥ||4||
tatra tāvatpravakṣyāmi maṃkaṇeśvarajaṃ phalam||
makārākṣarayuktasya liṃgasyātra dvijottamāḥ||5||
śivarātriṃ samāsādya yastasya puruṣo dvijāḥ||
kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau nirāhāraḥ sthitaḥ śuciḥ||6||
sarvaliṃgodbhavaṃ caiva phalaṃ darśanasaṃbhavam||
jāyate nātra saṃdeha ityuvāca haraḥ svayam||7||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
śivarātrirmahābhāga kasminkāle tu sā bhavet||
vidhyānaṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ sarvaṃ no vistarādvada||8||
sūta uvāca|| māghasya kṛṣṇapakṣe yā tithiścaiva caturdaśī||
tasyā rātriḥ samākhyātā śivarātrisamudbhavā||9||
tasyāṃ sarveṣu liṃgeṣu sadā saṃkramate haraḥ||
viśeṣātsarvapuṇyeṣu khyāteyaṃ maṃkaṇeśvare||6.266.10||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
śivarātriḥ kathaṃ jātā kenaiṣā ca vinirmitā||
kasmādbahuphalā jātā sarvaṃ no vistarādvada||11||
sūta uvāca||
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi pūrvavṛttaṃ kathānakam||
bhartṛyajñasya saṃvādamaśvasenasya bhūpateḥ||12||
ānartādhipatiḥ pūrvamaśvasena iti smṛtaḥ||
āsīddharmaparo nityaṃ vedavedāgaṃpāragaḥ||13||
bhartṛyajñaḥ purā tena idaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ kutūhalāt||
kalikālaṃ samudvīkṣya vardhamānaṃ dinedine||14||
aśvasena uvāca||
kalikālakṛte kiṃcidvrataṃ me vada sanmune||
svalpāyāsaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam||15||
svalpāyuṣaḥ sadā martyā brahmankṛtayuge purā||
tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva kimu prāpte kalau yuge||16|
tasmādvarṣavrataṃ tyaktvā kiṃcidekāhnikaṃ vada||17||
śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikam||
na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ vāsya na vā kṛtam||18|
tasya tadvacaṃ śrutvā bhartṛyajña udāradhīḥ||
abravītsuciraṃ dhyātvā jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā|| 19||
asti rājanvrataṃ puṇyaṃ śivarātrītisaṃjñitam||
ekāhnikaṃ mahārāja sarvapātakanāśanam||6.266.20||
tatra yaddīyate dānaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ tathaiva ca||
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti rātri jāgaraṇe kṛte||21||
aputro labhate putrānadhano dhanamāpnuyāt||
svalpāyurdīrghamāyuṣyaṃ śatrūṇāṃ caiva saṃkṣayam||22||
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyanvratametatsamācaret||
taṃtaṃ samāpnuyānmartyo niṣkāmo mokṣamāpnuyāt||23||
kārpaṇyenātha vittena yadi kuryātprajāgaram||
tathā varṣakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ||24||
yāni kānyatra liṃgāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca||
teṣu saṃkramate devastasyāṃ rātrau yato haraḥ||25||
śivarātristataḥ proktā tena sā haravallabhā||
prārthitaḥ sa suraiḥ sarvairlokānugrahakāmyayā||26||
bhagavankalikāle'sminsarvapāpasamanvite||
varṣapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ dinamekaṃ kṣitau vraja||
yena tvatpūjayā pūtā martyāḥ śuddhimavāpnuyuḥ||27||
tato dattaṃ hutaṃ teṣāmasmākamupatiṣṭhati||
yaducchiṣṭaṃ narairdattaṃ tadvṛthā jāyate'khilam||28||
kalikāle na cāsmākaṃ kiṃcidevopatiṣṭhati||
aśuddhairmānavairdattaṃ prabhūtamapi śaṃkara||29||
śrībhagavānuvāca||
māghamāsasya kṛṣṇāyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ sureśvara||
ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhūpṛṣṭhe rātrau naiva divā kalau||6.266.30||
liṃgeṣu ca samasteṣu caleṣu sthāvareṣu ca||
saṃkramiṣyāmyasaṃdigdhaṃ varṣapāpaviśuddhaye||31||
tasyāṃ rātrau hi me pūjāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ||
maṃtrairetaiḥ suraśreṣṭha vipāpmā sa bhaviṣyati||32||
oṃ sadyojātāya namaḥ||
oṃ vāmadevāya namaḥ||
oṃ ghorāya namaḥ||
oṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ||
oṃ īśānāya namaḥ||
evaṃ vaktrāṇi saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ||
vastrairdīpaiśca naivedyaistato'rghaṃ saṃpradāpayet||
maṃtreṇānena saṃpūjya māṃ dhyātvā manasi sthitam||33|
gaurīvallabha deveśa sarvādya śaśiśekhara||
varṣapāpaviśuddhyarthamargho me pratigṛhyatām||34|
tataḥ saṃpūjayedvipraṃ bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ||
dattvātha dakṣiṇāṃ tasmai vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet||35||
dharmākhyānakathābhiśca salāsyaistāṃḍavaistathā||36||
evaṃ kariṣyate yo'tra vratametatsureśvara||
varṣapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ bhaviṣyati||37||
tacchrutvā tridaśāḥ sarve praṇamya śaśiśekharam||
saṃprahṛṣṭā naraśreṣṭha svāni sthānāni bhejire||38||
preṣayāmāsururvyāṃ ca nāradaṃ munisattamam||
prabodhanāya lokānāṃ śivarātrikṛte sadā||39||
so'pi gatvā dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ śrāvayāmāsa sarvataḥ||
śivarātrestu māhātmyaṃ yaduktaṃ śūlapāṇinā|| 6.266.40||
tataḥ prabhṛti saṃjātā śivarātrirdharātale||
sarvakāmapradā puṇyā sarvapātakanāśinī||41||
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ kathānakam||
yadvṛttaṃ naimiṣāraṇye lubdhakasyātra kasyacit||42||
tatrāsīllubdhakaḥ kaścijjātimātrānna karmataḥ||
vyasenānābhibhūtātmā paravittāpahārakaḥ||43|

māghamāse'sitepakṣe sarvapātakanāśinī||45||

nārībhirnaraśārdūla bhūṣitābhiḥ subhūṣaṇaiḥ||
athāsau ciṃtayāmāsa coro dṛṣṭvātha jāgaram||47||
gacchāmi yadi kāṃcitstrīṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ paribhūṣitām||
niṣkrāṃtāṃ bāhyataścāsya prāsādasyāpnuyāmaham||48||

evaṃ niścitya manasā gatastasya samīpataḥ|
karṇikāraṃ samāruhya sthito guptastato hi saḥ||6.266.50||
vīkṣamāṇo diśaḥ sarvā nārīniṣkrāmaṇodbhavāḥ||

alpāpi nidrā nāyātā na ca nārī vinirgatā||
tasyādhastāttato liṃgamabhavattu dharodbhavam||

asatīnāṃ ca caurāṇāṃ kāmināmasukhāvahaḥ|| 53||

so'pi cauro nirāśaśca kṣutkṣāmaḥ śītavihvalaḥ||
avatīrya drumāttasmādupāyaṃ kaṃcidāśritaḥ||55||

jāto jātismaraḥ so'tha daśārṇādhipatergṛhe||56||

śivarātrestathā tasya liṅgasyāpi prapūjayā||57||
tato rājyaṃ samāsādya pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat||
kārayāmāsa liṃgasya prāsādaṃ tasya śobhanam||58||
varṣevarṣe samāśritya śivarātrau prajāgarāt||
upavāsaparobhūtvā gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ||59||
dharmākhyānakathābhiśca gītadhvanibhireva ca||
pūrvoktamaṃtraiḥ saṃpūjya arghaṃ dattvā vidhānataḥ||
saṃtarpya brāhmaṇānkāmairjagāma nilayaṃ nijam||6.266.60||
kasyacittvatha kālasya śivarātrau samāgatāḥ||
prāsāde tatra munayaḥ prāptā śāṇḍilyapūrvakāḥ||61||
śāṃḍilyo'tha bharadvājo yavakrīto'tha gālavaḥ||
pulastyaḥ pulaho gārgyastathānye bahavo nṛpa||62||
so'pi rājā bṛhatseno daśārṇādhipateḥ sutaḥ||
saṃprāpto jāgaraṃ kartuṃ tasya liṃgasya cāgrataḥ||63||
pūjayitvā tato devaṃ praṇipatya munīśvarān||
upaviṣṭastasya cāgre hyanujñāto dvijottamaiḥ||64||
tatastasyāgrataścakruḥ kathāste bahudhā nṛpa||
rājarṣīṇāmatītānāṃ brahmarṣīṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ||65||
atha kasminkathāṃte sa taiḥ pṛṣṭo brahmavādibhiḥ||
kautukāviṣṭacittaiśca vismayotphullalocanaiḥ||66||
rājanpṛcchāmahe sarve vayaṃ kautūhalānvitāḥ||
yadi bravīṣi naḥ satyaṃ devatāyatane sthitaḥ||67||
rājovāca||
yadi jñāsyāmi vipreṃdrāḥ kathayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam||
devasyāgre ca saṃpṛṣṭaḥ satyenātmānamālabhe||68||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
puṣkalāni parityajya kasmāddānānyanekaśaḥ||
jāgaraṃ kartukāmo'tra svadeśādupatiṣṭhasi||69||
varṣevarṣe sadā prāpte nūnaṃ tvaṃ vetsi kāraṇam||
rahasyaṃ yadi te na syāttadbravīhi narādhipa||6.266.70||
sūta uvāca||
savailakṣyaṃ smitaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ prāha sa durmanāḥ||
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ hyetadavācyaṃ hi dvijottamāḥ||71||
tathāpi ca vadiṣyāmi pṛṣṭo devāgrato yataḥ||72||
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa pūrvadehasamudbhavam||
malimlucastato nūnaṃ śivarātrisamudbhavam||73||
cauryabhāvena devasya pūjanaṃ jāgarastathā||
upavāsaṃ vinā tena śivarātrau purā kṛtam||74||
jātismaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ janmajātaṃ yathātatham||
tataste munayaḥ sarve sādhuvādānpṛthagvidhān||75||
nṛpottamasya rājarṣerdattvāśīrbhiḥ samanvitān||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prajagmuste nijāśramān||76||
so'pi rājāsamabhyarcya taṃ devaṃ tāndvijottamān||
jagāma svapuraṃ paścātkṛtvā rātrau prajāgaram||77||
bhartṛyajña uvāca||
śivarātriḥ samutpannā evaṃ bhūmitale nṛpa||
evaṃvidhaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ tasyāste parikīrtitam||78||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryā sa nṛpasattama||
kalikāle viśeṣeṇa ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ||79||
eṣā kṛtā dilīpena nalena nahuṣeṇa ca||
māndhātrā dhuṃdhumāreṇa sagareṇa yuyutsunā||6.266.80||
tathānyaiśca viśeṣeṇa samyakchraddhāsamanvitaiḥ||
prāptāśca hṛdgatāḥ kāmā ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ||81||
tathā caiva tu sāvitryā śriyā devyā tu sītayā||
aruṃdhatyā sarasvatyā menayā raṃbhayā tathā||82||
iṃdrāṇyātha dṛṣadvatyā svadhayā svāhayā tathā||
ratyā prītyā prabhāvatyā gāyatryā ca nṛpottama||
sarvāḥ prāptāḥ priyānkāmānatisaubhāgyasaṃyutān||83||
yaścaitāṃ paṭhate vyuṣṭiṃ bhāvena śivasaṃnidhau|
dinajātpātakātso'pi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ||84||
nāsti gaṃgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti devo haropamaḥ||
śivarātreḥ paraṃ nāsti tapaḥ satyaṃ mayoditam||85||
sarvaratnamayo meruḥ sarvāścaryamayaṃ tapaḥ||
sarvadharmamayī rājañchivarātriḥ prakīrtitāḥ||86||
garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ yadvannadīnāṃ sāgaro yathā|
pradhānaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ śivarātristathottamā||87||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śivārātrimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||266||

<6.267>

sūta uvāca||
tasmādeṣā mahārāja śivarātrirvipaścitā||
kartavyā puruṣeṇātra lokadvayamabhīpsunā||1||
ānarta uvāca||
maṃkaṇeśvaramāhātmyaṃ mayā vistarataḥ śrutam||
śivarātrisamopetaṃ yattvayā parikīrtitam|| 2||
sāṃprataṃ vada me kṛtsnaṃ siddheśvarasamudbhavam||
vistareṇa mahābhāga paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me||3||
bhartṛyajña uvāca||
siddheśvara iti khyāto mahādevo mahīpate||
tasyotpattistvayā pūrvaṃ śrutātra vadato mama||4||
sāṃprataṃ tatphalaṃ vacmi tasmindṛṣṭe tu dānajam||
yatphalaṃ jāyate nṝṇāṃ cakravartitva saṃbhavam||5||
tulāpuruṣadānaṃ ca tatra rājanpraśaśyate||
ya iccheccakravartitvaṃ samaste dharaṇītale||6||
ānarta uvāca||
tulāpuruṣadānasya yo vidhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ||
taṃ me sarvaṃ samācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmune||7||
bhartṛyajña uvāca||
caṃdrasūryoparāge vā ayane viṣuve tathā||
tīrthe vā puruṣaśreṣṭha tulāpuruṣasaṃbhavam||8||
praśaṃsaṃti vidhiṃ samyakprāpte vā ceṃdusaṃkṣaye||
brāhmaṇānāṃ sudāṃtānāmanuṣṭhānavatāṃ satām||9||
vedādhyayanayuktānāṃ nirdoṣāṇāṃ ca pārthiva||
vibhajya sa bhaveddeyo naikasya ca kathaṃcana||6.267.10||
śucau deśe same puṇye pūrvottaraplave śubhe||
maṃḍapaṃ kārayedvidvānramyaṃ ṣaośahastakam||
tanmadhye kārayedvediṃ caturhasta pramāṇataḥ|
yajamānasya hastena hastaikena samucchritām||12||
caturhastāni kuṇḍāni caturdikṣu prakalpayeta ||
ekahastapramāṇāni āyāmavyāsavistarāt||
aiśānyāmaparāṃ vediṃ hastamātrāṃ nyasecchubhām||
ratnimātrotthitāṃ caiva grahāṃstatra prakalpayet|| 14||
yugmāṃśca ṛtvijaḥ kāryāścaturdikṣu yathākramam||
bahvṛco'dhvaryaścaiva cchaṃdogātharvaṇāvapi|| 15||
tūṣṇīṃ tu devatāhomastaiḥ kāryaḥ susamāhitaiḥ||
talliṃgairnṛpatemaṃtraiḥ svaśaktyā japa eva ca||16||
ekahastapraviṣṭaṃ tu caturhastocchritaṃ tathā||
staṃbhadvayaṃ tu kartavyaṃ vediyāmyottare sthitam||17||
tanmadhye suśubhaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ staṃbhajātyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ nyaset||
candanaḥ khadiro vātha bilvovā'śvattha eva vā|| 18||
tiṃduko devadārurvā śrīparṇī vā vaṭo'thavā||
aṣṭau vṛkṣāḥ śubhāḥ śastāḥ staṃbhārthaṃ nṛpasattam||19||
śikyadvaya samopetāṃ tanmadhye vinyasettulām||
snātaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ||6.267.20|
pūrayitvā samaṃtācca lokapālānyathākramam||
staṃbhānsaṃpūjayatpaścādgandhamālyānulepanaiḥ||21||
tulāṃ ca pārthivaśreṣṭha puṇyāhaṃ ca prakīrtayet||
yajamāno nijaiḥ sarvairāyudhaiḥ kāyasaṃsthitaiḥ||22||
paścimāṃ diśamāsthāya prāṅmukhaḥ śraddhayā'nvitaḥ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā imaṃ maṃtramudīrayet||23||
brahmaṇo duhitā nityaṃ satyaṃ paramamāśritā||
kāśyapī gotrataścaiva nāmato viśrutā tulā||24||
tvaṃ tule satyanāmāsi svabhīṣṭaṃ cātmanaḥ śubham||
kariṣyāmi prasādaṃ me sāṃnidhyaṃ kuru sāṃpratam||25||
tatastasyāṃ samāruhya svaśaktyā yatsamāhṛtam||
dānārthaṃ pūrvamāyojyaṃ śikyenyasminnarottama||26||
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vā'tha vastraṃ cānyadabhīpsitam||
yāvatsāmyaṃ bhavedrājannātmano'bhyadhikaṃ ca vā||27||
tato'bhīṣṭāṃ samāsādya devatāṃ śikyamāśritaḥ||
udakaṃ jalamadhye ca tadarthaṃ prakṣipeddrutam||28||
satilaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca sākṣataṃ vidhipūrvakam||
avatīrya tataḥ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet||29||
yatphalaṃ prāpyate paścāttadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu||6.267.30||
ajānatā jānatā vā yatpāpaṃ tu bhavetkṛtam||
tatsarvaṃ nāśayenmartyo dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ||31||
yāvanmātraṃ kṛtaṃ pāpamatītaṃ nṛpasattama||
tāvanmātraṃ kṣayaṃ yāti tulāpuruṣadānataḥ||32||
īśvarāṇāṃ samādiṣṭaṃ kāyakleśabhayātmanām||
puraścaraṇametaddhi dānaṃ taulyasamudbhavam||33||
etaddattaṃ dilīpena kārtavīryeṇa bhūpate||
pṛthunā purukutsena tathānyairapi pārthivaiḥ||34||
etatpuṇyaṃ praśasyaṃ ca sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām|
tulāpuruṣadānaṃ ca sarvopadravanāśanam||35||
ādhayo vyādhayo na syurna vaidhavyaṃ gadodbhavam||
saṃjāyate nṛpaśreṣṭha na viyogaḥ svabandhubhiḥ||
tulāpuruṣadānasya phalametadudāhṛtam||36||
tulāpuruṣadānasya pradattasya nṛpottama||
na śakyate kathayituṃ phalaṃ yatsyātkalau yuge||37||
dakṣiṇāmūrtimāsādya siddheśvaravibhoḥ puraḥ||
yaḥ prayacchati bhūpāla sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam||38||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena prāpya siddheśvaraṃ vibhum||
tulāpuruṣadānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ suvivekinā|39||
ekatra sarvatīrthāni sarvāṇyāyatanāni ca||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre kathitāni svayaṃbhuvā||6.267.40||
siddheśvaraḥ suraśreṣṭha ekatra samudāhṛtaḥ||
tasmindṛṣṭe tathā spṛṣṭe pūjite nṛpasattama||
sarveṣāṃ labhate martyaḥ phalaṃ yatparikīrtitam||41||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrīsiddheśvaramāhātmye tulāpuruṣadānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||267||

<6.268>

ānarta uvāca||
karmaṇā kena martye ca narāṇāṃ jāyate vada||
cakravartitvamakhilaṃ sarvaśatruvimardanam||1||
bhartṛyajña uvāca||
durlabhaṃ bhūmipālatvaṃ sarvapāpairnarādhipa||
tapobhirniyamairdānaistathānyaiśca śubhairvrataiḥ|| 2||
yaḥ punarbhūpatirbhūtvā pṛthvīṃ dadyāddhiraṇmayīm||
gautameśvaradevasya purataḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ||
cakravartī bhavennūnamevamāha pitāmahaḥ|| 3||
māṃdhātā dhundhumāraśca hariścaṃdraḥ purūravāḥ|
bharataḥ kārtavīryaśca ṣaḍete cakravartinaḥ||4|
pṛthvīdānaṃ purā kṛtvā gautameśvarasaṃnidhau|
dattvā hiraṇmayīṃ pṛthvīṃ sārvabhaumāstataḥ sthitāḥ||5||
ānarta uvāca||
bhagavankena vidhinā dātavyā sā vasundharā||
ahaṃ dāsyāmi tāṃ nūnaṃ śraddhā me mahatī sthitā||6||
bhartṛyajña uvāca||
kāryā palaśatenorvī vṛttākārā nṛpottama||
tadardhenāthavā śaktyā paṃcaviṃśatpalātmikā||7||
dharādāne mahārāja vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet||
naiva paṃcapalādarvākpradātavyā kathañcana||
lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalodbhavāḥ||
samudrāḥ sapta caitāṃstu kakṣāyāṃ tatra darśayet||9||
jaṃbūplakṣakuśakrauṃcaśākaśālmalipuṣkarāḥ|
samudrānsaritaḥ sapta dvaiguṇyena prakalpayet||6.268.10||
mahendro malayaḥ sahyo himavāngaṃdhamādanaḥ||
viṃdhyaḥ śṛṃgī ca saptaiva kalpayetkulaparvatān||11|.
madhye prakalpayenmeruṃ dikṣu viṣkambhaparvatān||
jaṃbūnyagrodhanīpāṃśca plakṣaścaiva tathā drumān||12||
gaṃgādyāḥ saritastatra prādhānyena prakalpayet||
evaṃ nirmāpya vasudhāṃ sarvāṃ hemamayīṃ nṛpa||13|.
maṃḍapaṃ kārayetpaścādyathāpūrvaṃ prakalpitam||14||
kuṇḍāni toraṇānyeva brāhmaṇagrahapūjane||
pūrvavatsakalaṃ kṛtvā madhye vediṃ prakalpayet||15||
tatra saṃsthāpayetpṛthvīṃ paṃcagavyena pārthiva||
yathoktamaṃtraistalliṃgaistataḥ śuddhodakena tu||16||
imaṃ me gaṃge yamune paṃcanadyastripuṣkaram||
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānaṃ ca haimīṃ ca tadanaṃtaram||17||
snānakarmaṇi yogyāṃśa svādiṣṭhāyanamuttamam||18||
evaṃ saṃsnāpya vidhivadvāsāṃsi paridhāpayet||
yuvā suvāsā maṃtreṇa sūkṣmāṇi vividhāni ca||19||
ye bhūtānāmadhītyevaṃ tataḥ procya prapūjayet||
dhūrasīti ca maṃtreṇa dhūpaṃ dadyātsamāhitaḥ||6.268.20||
agnirjyotīti maṃtreṇa kuryādārārtikaṃ tataḥ||
ahamasmīti maṃtreṇa saptadhānyaṃ prakalpayet||21||
evaṃ kṛtvā'khilaṃ tasyā yajamānaḥ sitāṃbaraḥ||
puraḥ sthitoṃjaliṃ baddhvā maṃtrānetānudāharet||22||
tvayā saṃdhāryate viśvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram||
tava dānaṃ kariṣyāmi sāṃnidhyaṃ kuru medini||23||
śarīreṣvapi bhūtānāṃ tvaṃ devi prathamaṃ sthitā||
tataścānyāni bhūtāni jalādīni vasundhare||24||
ye tvāṃ yacchaṃti te bhūyastvāṃ labhaṃte na saṃśayaḥ||
iha loke pare caiva pārthivaṃ rūpamāśritā||25||
evaṃ stutvā samādāya toyaṃ hemākṛtiṃ nṛpa||
vāsudevaṃ hṛdi sthāpya maṃtreṇānena kalpayet||26||
pātālāduddhṛtā yena pṛthvī sā lokakāriṇā||
asyā dānena ca sadā prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ||27||
evamuccārya tattoyaṃ toyamadhye parikṣipet||
na bhūmau naiva haste ca brāhmaṇasya nṛpottama||28||
tato visarjayeddevīṃ mantreṇānena bhāgaśaḥ||
āgatā ca yathānyāyaṃ pūjitā ca yathāvidhi||29||
asmākaṃ tvaṃ hitārthāya yatreṣṭaṃ tatra gamyatām||
usrā vedeti maṃtreṇa samuccārya tataḥ param||
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradātavyā saṃvibhajya narādhipa||6.268.30||
evaṃ te sarvamākhyātaṃ pṛthivīdānamuttamam|
śṛṇuyātpārthivo bhāvī dātā janmanijanmani||31||
yo rājā pṛthivīṃ dadyādvidhinānena pārthiva||
rājyabhraṃśo na vaṃśe'pi tasya saṃjāyate kvacit||32||
rājyabhraṃśasamopetā ye dṛśyaṃte mahībhujaḥ||
na tairvasundharā dattā brāhmaṇānāṃ dhṛtātmanām||33||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pṛthvīdānaṃ samācaret||
na haretparadattāṃ ca kathaṃcidapi medinīm||34||
etatpuṇyaṃ praśasyaṃ ca pṛthivīdānamuttamam||
śṛṇvatāmapi rājeṃdra taddehādyaghanāśanam||35||
āstāṃ tāvatpradānaṃ ca pṛthivyāḥ pṛthivīpateḥ||
dātuḥ saṃpreraṇaṃ yasyā ajñānaughavināśanam||36||
rūpavānsubhagaścaiva tathā ca priyadarśanaḥ||
ādhivyādhivinirmuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ||37||
medhāvī jāyate martyo dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ||
itthaṃbhūtā mahārāja kṛtvā rājyamakaṇṭakam||38||
prītā viṣṇoḥ padaṃ yāṃti śāśvataṃ yannirāmayam||
anyatrāpi dharādānātprakuryāccakravartitām||39||
ekajanmāṃtaraṃ yāvatsamyagdattaṃ nṛpottamaḥ||
gautameśvaradevasya yatpurā purataḥ kṛtam||6.268.40||
saptajanmāṃtaraṃ yāvatprakaroti na saṃśayaḥ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra deyā mahī nṛpa||41||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gautameśvaramāhātmye pṛthvīdānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||268||

<6.269>

sūta uvāca||
kapāleśasya māhātmyaṃ śrūyatāmadhunā dvijāḥ||
caturthasya mahābhāgāstatra kṣetre sthitasya ca||1||
śrutamātreṇa yenātra naraḥ pāpātpramucyate||2||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
trayāṇāṃ caiva liṃgānāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ mahāmate||
śrutāsmābhiḥ samutpattiḥkapāleśvaravarjitā||
kenāyaṃ sthāpito devaḥ kapāleśvarasaṃjñitaḥ|| 3||
tasmindṛṣṭe phalaṃ kiṃ syātpūjite ca vadasva naḥ||4||
sūta uvāca||
iṃdreṇa sthāpitaḥ pūrvameṣa devo dvijottamāḥ||
kapāleśvasaṃjñastu brahmahatyā vimuktaye||5||
tatprabhāvatsuraśreṣṭha stayā mukte dvijottamāḥ||
pāpaṃ pūruṣadānena ityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ||6||
anyo'pi yo narastaṃ ca pūjayitvā prabhaktitaḥ||
prayacchedbrāhmaṇendrāya śuddhaye pāpapūruṣam||
sa mucyetpātakādghorādbrahmahatyāsamudbhavāt||7||
dakṣiṇāmūrtimāsādya provācedaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre gatvā taṃ vīkṣya śaṃkaram||8||
yo dadāti śarīraṃ ca kṛtvā hemamayaṃ tataḥ||
mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ pātakaiḥ pūrvasaṃyutaiḥ||9||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
brahmahatyā kathaṃ jātā surendrasya hi sūtaja||
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ||6.269.10||
kapāleśvarasaṃjñastu kathaṃ devo'tra saṃsthitaḥ||
brahmahatyā kathaṃ naṣṭā tatprabhāvāddivaspateḥ||11||
sa pāpapūruṣo deyo vidhinā kena sūtaja||
kairmaṃtraiḥ sa hi deyaḥ kaiścaiva hyupaskaraiḥ||12||
darśanātpūjanāccāpi kiṃ phalaṃ jāyate nṛṇām||
adattvā svaśarīraṃ vā pūjayā kevalaṃ vada||13||
sūta uvāca||
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm||
yāṃ śrutvāpi mahābhāgā naraḥ pāpātpramucyate||14||
ajñānājjñānato vāpi vihitairanyajanmajaiḥ||
dṛṣṭamātreṇa yenātra pātakāttaddinodbhavāt||
mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyametanmayoditam||15||
purā tvaṣṭuḥ suto jajñe vṛtro hi dvijasattamāḥ||
pulomaduhituḥ pārśvādvibhāvaryāḥ suvīryavān||16||
sa bāla eva dharmātmā āsītsarvajanapriyaḥ||
dānavaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya dvijabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ||17||
sa gatvā puṣkarāraṇyaṃ parameṇa samādhinā||
toṣayāmāsa deveśaṃ padmajaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ||18||
tasya tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ brahmā dṛṣṭigocaramāgataḥ||
provāca varado'smīti kiṃ te kṛtyaṃ karomyaham||19||
vṛtra uvāca||
yadi tuṣṭosi me deva brāhmaṇatvaṃ prayaccha me|
brāhmaṇatvaṃ samāsādya sādhayāmi paraṃ padam||6.269.20||
tena kiṃcidasādhyaṃ na brāhmaṇyena bhavenmama||
brāhmaṇena samaṃ cānyanna kiṃcitpratibhāti me||21||
paramaṃ daivataṃ kiṃcinna viprādvidyate param||
tasmānme hṛtsthitaṃ nānyadapi rājyaṃ triviṣṭape||22||
sūta uvāca||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tuṣṭastasya pitāmahaḥ||
brāhmaṇatvaṃ svayaṃ dattvā tataḥ provāca sādaram||23||
mayā tvaṃ vihito vipra putra prakuru vāṃchitam||
prasādayasva satataṃ brāhmaṇānbrahmavittamān||24||
brāhmaṇaiḥ suprasannaiśca prīyaṃte sarvadevatāḥ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjanīyā dvijottamāḥ||25||
sūta uvāca||
evamuktastadā tena vṛtro'bhūdbrāhmaṇastataḥ||
brāhmyā lakṣmyā samopeto brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ||26||
tasmiṃstapasi saṃsthe tu hatā iṃdreṇa dānavāḥ||
vaṃśocchede samāpanne dānavānāṃ mahātmanām||27||
tataste dānavāḥ sarve parābhūtāḥ suraistataḥ||
svaṃ sthānaṃ saṃparityajya duḥkhaśokasamanvitāḥ||28||
tanmātaraṃ puraskṛtvā tatsakāśamupāgatāḥ||
sa ca tāṃ mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛtāṃ taiśca samanvitaḥ||29||
dānavaiśca parābhūtaistathābhūtāṃ ca mātaram||
kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ ca duḥkhitānāṃ mamāṃtike||6.269.30||
dānavā ūcuḥ||
vayaṃ devaiḥ parābhūtā bhavaṃtaṃ śaraṇāgatāḥ||
kva yāmo'nyatra cā'smākaṃ tvāṃ vinā nāsti saṃśrayaḥ||31||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛtraḥ provāca sādaram||
devānahaṃ haniṣyāmi gamyatāṃ tatra mā ciram||32||
tavāgamanakṛtyaṃ ca mātaḥ kathaya sāṃpratam||33||
mātovāca||
tathā kuru mahābhāga śīghraṃ dāraparigraham||
vaṃśavṛddhau pramāṇaṃ cedvākyaṃ tava mamodbhavam||34||

putrasya jananīvākyaṃ yatkaroti samāhitaḥ|| 35||

tatsarvaṃ viphalaṃ tasyā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ||37||

araṇye ruditānīva ūṣare vāpitāni ca||39||

tadvanmātṛmatādanyakṛtaṃ putrasya dharmajam||6.269.40||
sarvaṃ karma na saṃdehastenāhaṃ tvāmupāgatā||
baṃdhūnāṃ vacanātputra duḥkhārtā ca viśeṣataḥ||41||

ānṛṇyaṃ jāyate yadvatpitṝṇāṃ tattathā śṛṇu||42||
tava vatsa pramāṇaṃ cetkuruṣva ca vaco mama||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛtraḥ saṃciṃtya cetasi||43||
śrutismṛtyuktamārgeṇa na māturvidyate param||
sa tatheti pratijñāya ānināya parigraham||44||
tvaṣṭā tasmai dadau prītastato ratnānyanekaśaḥ||
saṃkhyāhīnāni tasyaiva kupyākupyamanaṃtakam||45||
hastyaśvayānakośāḍhyaṃ so'bhiṣiktaḥ pade nije||

śrutvābhiṣekaṃ saṃhṛṣṭāstasya vṛtrasya bāṃdhavāḥ||47||
dānavāśca samājagmurye tatrāsanpurogatāḥ||
pātālādgiridurgācca sthaladurgebhya eva ca||
kṛtavairāḥ samaṃ devaiḥ kopena mahatā vṛtāḥ|| 48||
tataḥ protsāhitaḥ sarvairdānavaiḥ sa mahābalaḥ||
prasthitaḥ śatrunāśāya mahendrabhavanaṃ prati||49||
śakro'pi vṛtramākarṇya samāyāṃtaṃ yuyutsayā||
sanmukhaḥ prayayau hṛṣṭaḥ sarvadevasamanvitaḥ||6.269.50||
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha||
merupṛṣṭhe suvistīrṇe nityameva divāniśam||51||
nityaṃ parājayo jajñe devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha||
tatrovāca guruḥ śakra mā yuddhaṃ kuru devapa||52||
vṛtro'yaṃ dāruṇo yuddhe baladvayasamanvitaḥ||
catvāraścāgrato vedāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ||53||
tena jeyatamo daityastavaiva ca mahāhave||
tasmātsaṃdhānametena tvaṃ kuruṣva śacīpate||54||
tato viśvāsamāyā taṃ jahi vajreṇa dānavam||
ṣaḍupāyai ripurvadhya iti śāstranidarśanam||55||
bhuṃjānaśca śayānaśca dattvā kanyāmapi svakām||
vipradānena saṃyojya kṛtvāpi śapathaṃ gurum||
māyāprapaṃcamāsādya tasmādevaṃ samācara||56||
indra uvāca||
yadyevaṃ ca svayaṃ gatvā tvaṃ viśvāse niyojaya||
tava vākyena viśvāsaṃ nūnaṃ yāsyati dānavaḥ||57||
sūta uvāca||
śakrasya matamājñāya pratasthe ca bṛhaspatiḥ||

vṛtro'pi taṃ samālokya svayaṃ prāptaṃ bṛhaspatim||
sadaiva dvijabhaktaḥ sa hṛṣṭātmā samapadyata||
viśeṣātpraṇipatyoccairvākyametadabhāṣata||59||
vṛtra uvāca||
svāgataṃ te dvijaśreṣṭha kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām||
priyā me brāhmaṇā yasmāttasmātkīrtaya sāṃpratam||6.269.60||
bṛhaspatiruvāca|| saṃdigdho vijayo yuddhe yasmāddaivena sattama||
tasmātkuru maheṃdreṇa vyavasthāṃ vacanānmama||61||
tvaṃ bhuṃkṣva bhūtalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śakraścāpi triviṣṭapam||
vyavasthayā'nayā nityaṃ vartitavyaṃ parasparam||62||
vṛtra uvāca||
ahaṃ tava vaco brahmankariṣyāmi sadaiva hi|
saṃgamaṃ kuru śakreṇa sāṃprataṃ mama saddvija||63||
sūta uvāca||
atha śakraṃ samānīya bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ||
vṛtreṇa saha saṃdhānaṃ cakre caiva parasparam||64||
ekārimitratāṃ gatvā tāvubhau daityadevapau||
prahṛṣṭau gatavantau tau tataścaiva nijaṃ gṛham||65||
atha śakracchalānveṣī sadā vṛtrasya vartate||
na cchidraṃ labhate kvāpi vīkṣamāṇopi yatnataḥ||66||
kathaṃcidapi so'bhyeti tatsakāśaṃ puraṃdaraḥ||
kiṃcicchidraṃ samāsādya tatpratāpena dahyate||67||
iṃdra uvāca||
na śaknomi ca taṃ daityaṃ vīkṣituṃ ca kathaṃcana||
tejasā sarvato vyāptaṃ tatkathaṃ sūdayāmyaham||68||
tasmātkaṃcidupāyaṃ me tadvadhārthaṃ prakīrtaya||
yathā śaknomi tatsoḍhuṃ tejastasya durātmanaḥ||69||
sūta uvāca||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā bṛhaspatiḥ||
tataḥ provāca taṃ śakraṃ vinayāvanataṃ sthitam||6.269.70||
bṛhaspatiruvāca||
tasya brāhmyaṃ sthitaṃ tejaḥ samyaggātre puraṃdara||
vīkṣituṃ naiva śaknoṣi tena tvaṃ tridaśādhipa||71||

vadhayiṣyasi yenātra taṃ tvaṃ dānavasattamam||72||
prācīsarasvatītīre puṣkarāraṇyamāśritaḥ||
dadhīcirnāma viprarṣiḥ śatayojanamucchritaḥ||73|.
tatra nityaṃ tapaḥ kurvanstauti nityaṃ pitāmaham|
sa nirviṇṇo muniśreṣṭhaḥ prāṇānāṃ dhāraṇe hare||74||
ciraṃtano muniḥ sa syājjarayātisamāvṛtaḥ||
taṃ prārthaya drutaṃ gatvā tasyāsthīni gurūṇi ca||75||
sa te dāsyastyasaṃdigdhaṃ tyaktvā prāṇānatipriyān||
tasyāsthibhiḥ praharaṇaṃ vajrākhyaṃ te bhaviṣyati||76||
amoghaṃ te tato nūnaṃ tvaṃ vṛtraṃ sūdayiṣyasi||
tasya vajrasya tattejo brahmatejo'bhibṛṃhitam||
tena vṛtrodbhavaṃ tejaḥ praśamaṃ saṃprayāsyati||77||
sūta uvāca||
tacchrutvā satvaraṃ śakraḥ sarvairdaivagaṇaiḥ saha||
jagāma puṣkarāraṇye yatra prācī sarasvatī||78||
trayastriṃśatsamopetā tīrthānāṃ koṭibhiryutā||
dadhīcerāśramaṃ tatra so'viśaccitrasaṃyutam||79||
krīḍaṃte nakulaiḥ sarpā yatra tuṣṭiṃ gatā mithaḥ||
mṛgāḥ paṃcānanaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛṣadaṃśāstathā''khubhiḥ||6.269.80||
ulūka sahitāḥ kākā mitho dveṣavivarjitāḥ||
prabhāvāttasya tapaso dadhīceḥ sumahātmanaḥ||81||
dadhīcirapi cālokya devāñchakrapurogamān||
samāyātānprahṛṣṭātmā satvaraṃ saṃmukhobhyagāt||82||
tataścārghyaṃ samādāya praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ||
śakramabhyāgataṃ prāha kiṃ te kṛtyaṃ karomyaham||83||
gṛhāyātasya deveśa tacchīghraṃ me nivedaya||84|.
iṃdra uvāca||
ātithyaṃ kuru vipreṃdra gṛhāyātasya sanmune||
tvadasthīni nijānyāśu mama dehyavikalpitam||85||
atadarthamahaṃ prāptastvatsakāśaṃ munīśvara||

sūta uvāca||
iṃdrasya tadvacaḥ śrutvā dadhīcistoṣasaṃyutaḥ||
tataḥ prāha sahasrākṣaṃ sarvairdevaiḥ samanvitam||87||

puṇyavānyasya deveśaḥ svayamarthī gṛhāgataḥ|88||

gṛhāṇa svecchayā'sthīni svakāryārthaṃ puraṃdara||6.269.90||

brahmaraṃdhreṇa niḥsārya prāṇamātmānamatyajat||91||

yena vyāpādayāmyāśu vṛtraṃ dānavasattamam||94||

yathāyudhaṃ tathā cakre vajrākhyaṃ dāruṇākṛti||95||

pradadau ca tatastasmai sahasrākṣāya dhīmate||96||
atha taṃ sa samādāya dvādaśārkasamaprabham||
samādhisthaṃ carairjñātvā vṛtraṃ saṃdhyārcane ratam||97||

śakropi hatamajñātvā bhayāttasyātha dudruve||99||
manuṣyarahite deśe viṣame gulmasaṃvṛte||
lilye śakrastadā sarvaṃ mene vṛtramayaṃ jagat||6.269.100||
etasminnaṃtare devāḥ paśyaṃtaḥ sarvato diśam||

nilīno bhayasaṃtrasto gulmamadhye vyavasthitaḥ||102||
devā ūcuḥ||
kiṃ tvaṃ bhītaḥ sahasrākṣa vṛtro'yaṃ ghātitastvayā||
parivāreṇa sarveṇa vīkṣito'smābhireva ca||103||

kuru trailokyarājyaṃ tvaṃ sāṃprataṃ hatakaṇṭakam||104||
tacchrutvā'tha viniṣkrāṃto gulmamadhyācchatakratuḥ||
hṛṣṭaromā hataṃ śrutvā vṛtraṃ dānavasattamam|| 105||
atha paśyaṃti yāvattaṃ devāḥ sarve śatakratum||
tāvattejovihīnaṃ tadgātraṃ durgaṃdhitāyutam||106||
dṛṣṭvā lokagururbrahmā devānsarvānuvāca ha||
śakro'yaṃ sāṃprataṃ vyāptaḥ pāpayā brahmahatyayā||107||
yadanena hato vṛtro brahmabhūtaśchalena saḥ||
tasmāttyājyaḥ sudūreṇa no cetpāpamavāpsyatha||108||
