darśanaṃ vāpi tasyāhuḥ sarvapāpapradaṃ nṛṇām||6.269.110||
sūta uvāca|.
tacchrutvā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ śakro dṛṣṭvā''tmanastanum||

śrībrahmovāca||

iṃdra uvāca||

vātopi tena vittena pratigrahakṛtena ca||
cakāra tatra prāsādaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ||145||
tataḥ provāca śakrastānbrāhmaṇānnagarodbhavān||
kapālamocane snātvā yo devaṃ hyarcayiṣyati||146||
brahmahatyodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ tasya naśyatyasaṃśayam||
mahāpātakayukto vā vipāpmā saṃbhaviṣyati||147||
sa tatheti pratijñāya brāhmaṇānnagarodbhavān||
tatraiva svāśramaṃ kṛtvā pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram||148||
tataḥprabhṛti yatkiṃcitteṣāṃ kṛtyaṃ prajāyate||
tadvākyena prakurvaṃti tatra ye nāgaraḥ sthitāḥ||149||
etasmātkāraṇājjāto madhyago dvitīyastviha||6.269.150||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātamākhyānaṃ pāpanāśanam||
kapāleśvaradevasya śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ nṛṇām||151||
yathā deveśvarasyātra pāpaṃ naṣṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ||
brahmahatyā yathā naṣṭā tasmiṃstīrthe dvijottamāḥ||152||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vātakeśvarakṣetrakapālamocaneśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||269||

<6.270>

ānarta uvāca||
mūrkhatvādvā pramādādvā kāmādbālasyato'pi vā||
yo naraḥ kurute pāpaṃ prāyaścittaṃ karoti na ||1||
tasya pāpakṣayakaraṃ puṇyaṃ brūhi dvijottama||
yena muktirbhavetsadyo yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho||2||
lobhamohaparo yo'sau pāpapiṃḍaṃ mahāmune||
pradadāti vidhiṃ brūhi yena yacchāmyahaṃ drutam||3||
bhartṛyajña uvāca||
dadyātsvapiṃḍaṃ sauvarṇaṃ paṃcaviṃśatpalātmakam||4||
vidhāyāparapakṣe tu snāpayitvā vidhānataḥ||
maṃḍapādyaṃ ca prākkṛtvā snātvā dhautāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ||5||
tadā svarūpaṃ pṛthvyādi pūjayetpāpakṛnnaraḥ||
tathā sa mucyate pāpāttatkṛtāddhi na saṃśayaḥ||6||
caturviṃśatitattvāni pṛthivyādīni yāni ca||
teṣāṃ nāmabhistatpiṃḍaṃ pūjayetannarādhipaḥ||7||
oṃ pṛthivyai namaḥ||
oṃ adbhyo namaḥ||
oṃ tejase namaḥ||
oṃ vāyave namaḥ||
oṃ ākāśāya namaḥ||
oṃ ghrāṇāya namaḥ||
oṃ jihvāyai namaḥ||
oṃ cakṣuṣe namaḥ||
oṃ tvace namaḥ||
oṃ śrotrāya namaḥ||
oṃ gandhāya namaḥ||
oṃ rasāya namaḥ||
oṃ rūpāya namaḥ||
oṃ sparśāya namaḥ||
oṃ śabdāya namaḥ||
oṃ vāce namaḥ||
oṃ pāṇibhyāṃ namaḥ||
oṃ pādābhyāṃ namaḥ||
oṃ pāyave namaḥ||
oṃ upasthāya namaḥ||
oṃ manase namaḥ||
oṃ buddhyai namaḥ||
oṃ cittāya namaḥ||
oṃ ahaṃkārāya namaḥ|
oṃ kṣetrātmane namaḥ||
oṃ paramātmane namaḥ||
dhūpaṃ dhūrasi maṃtreṇa agnirjyotīti dīpakam||
yuvā suvāseti ca tato vāsāṃsi paridhāpayet||8||
tato brāhmaṇamānīya vedavedāṃgapāragam||
prakṣālya caraṇau tasya vāsāṃsi paridhāpayet||9||
keyūraiḥ kaṃkaṇaiścaiva aṃgulīyakabhūṣaṇaiḥ|| 6.270.10||
bhūṣayitvā tanuṃ tasya tato mūrtiṃ samānayet||
maṃtreṇānena rājeṃdra brāhmaṇāya nivedayet||11||
eṣa ātmā mayā dattastava hemamayo dvija||
yatkiṃcidvihitaṃ pāpaṃ pūrvaṃ bhūyāttavākhilam||12||
iti dānamaṃtraḥ||
tatastu brāhmaṇo rājanmaṃtrametaṃ samuccaret||13||
yatkiṃcidvihitaṃ pāpaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃmayā hi tat||
gṛhītaṃ mūrtirūpaṃ tattatastvaṃ pāpavarjitaḥ||
iti pratigrahamaṃtraḥ|| 14||
evaṃ dattvā vidhānena tato vipraṃ visarjayet||
evaṃ kṛte tato rājaṃstasmai dattvātha dakṣiṇām||15||
yathā tuṣṭiṃ samabhyeti tataḥ pāpaṃ nayatyasau||
tasminkṛte mahārāja pratyayastatkṣaṇādbhavet|| 16||
śarīraṃ laghutāmeti tejovṛddhiśca jāyate||
svapne ca vīkṣate rātrau saṃtuṣṭamanasaḥ sthitān||17||
narānstriyaḥ sitairvastraiḥ śvetamālyānulepanaiḥ||
śvetāngovṛṣabhānaśvāṃstīrthāni vividhāni ca||18||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ pāpapiṃḍasya dāpanam||
śravaṇādapi rājeṃdra yasya pāpaiḥ pramucyate||19||
anyatrāpi mahādānaṃ pāpapiṇḍo harennṛpa||6.270.20|
ekajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nijakāyena nirmitam||
kapāleśvaradevasya sahasraguṇitaṃ haret||21||
pūrvavaccaiva kartavyo vedimaṃḍapayorvidhiḥ||
paraṃ homaḥ prakartavyo gāyatryā kevalaṃ nṛpa||22||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kapāleśvarakṣetramāhātmyaprasaṃgena pāpapiṃḍapradānavidhānavarṇanaṃnāma saptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||270||

<6.271>

sūta uvāca||
athānyadapi tatrāsti supuṇyaṃ liṃgasaptakam||
yenārcitena dṛṣṭena pūjitena viśeṣataḥ||1||
dīrghāyurjāyate martyaḥ sarvarogavivarjitaḥ||
mārkaṇḍeśvara ityuktastatra devo maheśvaraḥ||2||
indradyumneśvaro'nyastu sarvapāpaharo haraḥ||
pāleśvarastathā caiva sarvavyādhivināśanaḥ||3||
tato ghaṃṭaśivaḥ khyāto yo ghaṃṭena pratiṣṭhitaḥ||
kalaśeśvarasaṃjñastu vānareśvarasaṃyutaḥ||4||
īśāna śiva ityuktastatra kṣetreśvareśvaraḥ||
pūjito mānavairbhaktyā kāmānyacchatyamānuṣān||5||
vāṃchitānmanasā sarvānkalikāle'pi saṃsthite||6||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ||
ko'yaṃ mārkaṃḍasaṃjñastu yena liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam||
indradyumno mahīpālaḥ katamo vada sūtaja||7||
tathā pālakanāmā ca yenāyaṃ sthāpito haraḥ||
tathā yo ghaṇṭasaṃjñastu kasmiñjātaḥ sa cānvaye||8||
kalaśākhyastu yaḥ khyāto vānareṇa samanvitaḥ||
īśānopyakhilaṃ brūhi paraṃ naḥkautukaṃ sthitam|| 9|
yato'tra jāyate śreyaḥ punaḥ puṃsāṃ prakīrtaya||
yairetaiḥ sthāpitā devāḥ kṣetre'sminmānavottamaiḥ||6.271.10||
tathā teṣāṃ samācāraṃ prabhāvaṃ caiva sūtaja||
dānaṃ vāpi yathākālaṃ maṃtrāṃśca vistarādvada||11||
sūta uvāca||
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm||
kathitāṃ bhartṛyajñena ānartādhipateḥ svayam||12||
śrutayāpi yayā martyo dīrghāyurjāyatenaraḥ||
nāpamṛtyumavāpnoti kathaṃcittatprabhāvataḥ||13||
yo mārkaṃḍa iti khyātaḥ prathamaṃ parikīrtitaḥ|
saṃbhūtistasya saṃproktā yuṣmākaṃ pāpanāśinī||14||
iṃdradyumnaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ munisattamāḥ||
yadvaṃśo yatprabhāvaśca sarvabhūpālamānitaḥ||15|.
iṃdradyumno mahīpāla āsītpūrvaṃ dvijottamāḥ||
brāhmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca sādhulokaprapālakaḥ||
yajvā dānapatirdakṣaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ||16|
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirna ca caurakṛtaṃ bhayam||
tasmiñchāsati dharmajñe āsīllokasya kasyacit||17||
yathaiva varṣato dhārā yathā vā divi tārakāḥ||
gaṃgāyāṃ sikatā yadvatsaṃkhyayā parivarjitāḥ||18||
tadvattena kṛtā yajñāḥ sarve saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāḥ||
agniṣṭomo'tirātraśca ukthaḥ ṣoḍaśikāstathā||19||
sautrāmaṇyā'tha paśavaścāturmāsyā dvijottamāḥ||
vājapeyāśvamedhāśca rājasūyā viśeṣataḥ||6.271.20||
pauṇḍarīkāstathaivānye śraddhāpūtena cetasā||21|
tena dānāni dattāni tīrtheṣu ca viśeṣataḥ||
miṣṭānnāni dvijeṃdrāṇāṃ dakṣiṇāsahitāni ca||22||
na tadasti dharāpṛṣṭhe nagaraṃ pattanaṃ tathā||
tīrthaṃ vā yatra no tasya vidyate tridaśālayaḥ||23||
tena kanyāsahasrāṇi acyutānyarbudāni ca||
brāhamaṇebhyaḥ pradattāni brāhmaṇānāṃ dhanārthinām||24||
daśamīdivase tasya rātrau ca gajapṛṣṭhigaḥ||
dundubhistāḍyamānastu babhrāma sakalaṃ puram|| 25||
pratyūṣe vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāvi pāpahāri ca vāsaram||
upavāsaḥ prakarttavyo muktvā vṛddhaṃ ca bālakam||
anyathā nigrahiṣyāmi bhojanaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati||26||
iṃdradyumnaḥ sa rājarṣistadā viṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ||
tenaiva svaśarīreṇa brahmalokaṃ tadā gataḥ||27||
tatra kalpasahasrāṃte sa prokto brahmaṇā svayam||
iṃdradyumna dharāṃ gaccha na sthātavyaṃ tvayā'dhunā||28||
iṃdradyumna uvāca|
kasmāccyāvayase brahmannijalokāddrutaṃ hi mām||
apāpamapi deveśa tathā me vada kāraṇam||29||
śrībrahmovāca||
tava kīrtisamucchedaḥ saṃjāto'dya dharātale||
yāvatkīrtirdharāpṛṣṭhe tāvatsvarge vasennaraḥ||6.271.30||
etasmātkāraṇāllokāḥ svanāmāṃkāni cakrire||
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca||31||
tasmādgaccha dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ svāṃ kīrtiṃ nūtanāṃ kuru||
yadi vāṃchasi loke'sminmāmake vasatiṃ ciram|| 32||
athātmānaṃ sa rājeṃdro yāvatpaśyati tatkṣaṇāt||
tāvatprāptaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe kāṃpilya nagaraṃ prati||33||
atha papraccha lokānsa kimetannagaraṃ smṛtam||
ko'yaṃ deśaḥ ko'tra rājā kiṃ puraṃ nagaraṃ ca kim||34||
te tamūcuḥ paraṃ caitatkāṃpilyamiti viśrutam||
ānartanāmā deśo'yaṃ rājātra pṛthivījayaḥ||35||
ko bhavānkimihāyātaḥ kiṃcitkāryaṃ vadasva naḥ||36||
iṃdradyumna uvāca|| iṃdradyumno mahīpālaḥ purāsīdrocake pure||
deśe vaijaruke pūrvaṃ sa deśaḥ kva ca tatpuram|| 37||
janā ūcuḥ||
na vayaṃ tatpuraṃ vidmo na deśaṃ na ca bhūpatim||
indradyumnābhidhānaṃ ca yaṃ tvaṃ pṛcchasi bhadraka||38||
iṃdradyumna uvāca||
cirāyurasti ko'pyatra yastaṃ vetti mahīpatim||
deśaṃ vā tatpuraṃ vāpi tanme vadatha mā ciram||39||
janā ūcuḥ||
saptakalpasmaro nāma mārkaṃḍeyo mahāmuniḥ||
śrūyate naimiṣāraṇye taṃ gatvā pṛccha vetsyasi||6.271.40||
athāsau satvaraṃ gatvā vyomamārgeṇa taṃ munim||
papraccha praṇipatyoccairnaimiṣāraṇyamāśritam||41||
iṃdradyumneti vai bhūpastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto'tha vā||
cirāyustvaṃ śruto'smābhiḥ pṛcchāmastena sanmune||42||
śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca|| saptakalpāṃtare bhūpo na dṛṣṭo na mayā śrutaḥ||
iṃdradyumnābhidhāno'tra tatra kiṃ nu vadāmi te||43||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nirāśaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ||
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ||44||
tena cānīya dārūṇi prajvālya ca hutāśanam||
praveṣṭukāmaḥ sa prokta indradyumno mahīpatiḥ||45||
tvayā cātra na kartavyamahaṃ te mitratāṃ gataḥ||
nāśayiṣyāmi te mṛtyuṃ yadyapi syānmahattaram||46||
nīrogo'si subhavyo'si kasmānmṛtyuṃ pravāṃchasi||
vada me kāraṇaṃ mṛtyoḥ pratīkāraṃ karomi te||47||
iṃdradyumna uvāca||
cirāyurme bhavānproktaḥ kāṃpilyapuravāsibhiḥ ||
tenāhaṃ tava pārśve'tra samāyāto mahāmune||48||
iṃdradyumnodbhavāṃ vārtāṃ tvaṃ vadiṣyasi sanmune||
matkīrtirna parijñātā tato mṛtyuṃ vrajāmyaham||49||
sūta uvāca||
tasya taṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā dayāvānsa munīśvaraḥ||
vṛthāśramaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā dākṣiṇyādidamabravīt||6.271.50||
yadyevaṃ mā viśāgniṃ tvamahaṃ jñāsyāmi taṃ nṛpam||
nāḍījaṃgho bako nāma mamāsti paramaḥ suhṛt||51||
ciraṃtanaśca so'smākaṃ nūnaṃ jñāsyati taṃ nṛpam||
tasmādāgaccha gacchāvastasya pārśve himācale||52||
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ jātu na vṛthā jāyate kvacit||53||
evamuktvā tatastau tu prasthitau munipārthivau||
vyomamārgeṇa saṃtuṣṭau bakaṃ prati himācale||54||
bako'pi taṃ samālokya mārkaṇḍeyaṃ samāgatam||
saṃmukhaḥ prayayau tuṣṭaḥ svāgatenābhyapūjayat||55||
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtapuṇyo'haṃ yasya me tvatsamāgamaḥ||
bho bho brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭha ātithyaṃ te karomi kim||56||
śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca||
mattopi tvaṃ cirāyuśca yato mitraṃ vyavasthitaḥ||
indradyumno mahīpālastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto'thavā||57||
etasya mama mitrasya tena dṛṣṭena kāraṇam||
anyathā jāyate mṛtyustato'haṃ tvāṃ samāgataḥ||58||
baka uvāca|| saptadviguṇitānkalpānsmarāmyahamasaṃśayam||
na smarāmi kathāmeva iṃdradyumnasamudbhavām||59||
āstāṃ hi darśanaṃ tāvatsatyametanmayodim||6.271.60||
iṃdradyumna uvāca||
tapasaḥ kiṃ prabhāvo'yaṃ dānasya niyamasya ca||
yadāyurīdṛśaṃ jātaṃ bakatve'pi vadasva naḥ||61||
baka uvāca|| ghṛtakaṃbalamāhātmyāddevadevasya śūlinaḥ||
mamāyurīdṛśaṃ jātaṃ bakatvaṃ muniśāpataḥ||62||
ahamāsaṃ purā bālo brāhmaṇasya niveśane||
camatkārapure ramye pārāśaryasya dhīmataḥ||64||
nāmnā ca viśvarūpākhyo nāmnā 'nyena baka smṛtaḥ||
atīva capalatvena saṃyuktaḥ pitṛvallabhaḥ||64||
kasyacittvatha kālasya saṃkrāṃtau makarasya bhoḥ||
saṃprāpyātīva cāpalyālliṃgaṃ jāgeśvaraṃ mayā||
ghṛtakumbhe parikṣiptaṃ pūjitaṃ janakena yat||65||
atha rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ pṛṣṭo'haṃ janakena ca||
tvayā putra parikṣiptaṃ nūnaṃ jāgeśvaraṃ kvacit||
tasmādvada prayacchāmi tena te bhakṣyamuttamam||66||
tato mayājyakumbhācca tasmādādāya satvaram||
bhakṣyalaulyātpiturhaste vinyastaṃ ghṛtasaṃplutam||67||
kasyacittvatha kālasya paṃcatvaṃ ca samāgataḥ||
jātismarastato jātastatprabhāvānnṛpālaye||68||
ānartādhipaterharmye nāmnā khyātastvahaṃ bakaḥ||
camatkārapure devo haraḥ saṃsthāpito mayā||69||
tatprabhāveṇa vipreṃdra prāptaḥ paitāmahaṃ padam||6.271.70||
tato yāni dharāpṛṣṭhe suliṃgāni sthitāni ca||
ghṛtenacchādayāmyeva makarasthe divākare||
mayā yatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ camatkārapure śubham||71||
ārādhitaṃ divā naktaṃ rājye saṃsthāpya putrakam||
niyojya sarvato bhṛtyāndhanavastrasamanvitān||72||
tataḥkālena mahatā tuṣṭo me bhagavāñchivaḥ||
matsamīpaṃ samāsādya vākyametaduvāca saḥ||73||
parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te tava pārthivasattama||
ghṛtakaṃbaladānena saṃkhyayā rahitena ca|| 74||
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te varaṃ yanmanasi sthitam||
adeyamapi dāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham||75||
tato mayā haraḥ prokto yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho||
kuruṣva māṃ gaṇaṃ deva nānyatkiṃcidvṛṇomyaham||76||
śrībhagavānuvāca||
bakaihi tvaṃ mahābhāga kailāsaṃ parvatottamam||
mayā sārdhamanenaiva śarīreṇa gaṇo bhava||77||
anyo'pi martyaloketra yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ||
makarasthe ravau mahyaṃ saṃkrāṃtau rajanīmukhe|
sa nūnaṃ madgaṇo bhāvī sakṛtkṛtvā'tha kaṃbalam||78||
tvaṃ punarmāmakaṃ liṃgaṃ samaṃ kurvanbhaviṣyasi||
dharmaseneti vikhyāto vikṛtyā parivarjitaḥ||79||
evamuktvā sa bhagavānmāmādāya tataḥ param||
kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gatvā gaṇakoṭīśatāmadāt||6.271.80||
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhramamāṇo yadṛcchayā||
gato'haṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ himavaṃtaṃ mahāgirim||81||
yatrāste gālavo nāma sadaiva tapasi sthitaḥ||
tasya bhāryā viśālākṣī sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā|| 82||
saptaraktā trigaṃbhīrā gūḍhagulphā kṛśodarī||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manmathāviṣṭaḥ saṃjāto'haṃ munīśvara||83||
ciṃtitaṃ ca mayā citte kathametāṃ harāmyaham||
tasmācchiṣyatvamāsādya bhaktimasya karomyaham||84||
śuśrūṣānirato bhūtvā yena prāpnomi bhāminīm||85||
tato baṭukarūpeṇa saṃprāpto gālavo mayā||
saṃsārasya virakto'haṃ kariṣyāmi mahttapaḥ||86||
dīkṣāṃ yaccha vibho mahyaṃ yena śiṣyo bhavāmi te||87||
āhariṣyāmyahaṃ darbhāṃstathā sumanasaḥ sadā||
samidhaśca sadaivāhaṃ phalāni jalameva ca||88||
sa māṃ vinayasaṃpannaṃ jñātvā brāhmaṇarūpiṇam||
dadau dīkṣāṃ tato mahyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā||89||
atha dīkṣāṃ samāsādya toṣayāmi dinedine ||
taṃ caiva tasya patnīṃ tāṃ yathoktaparicaryayā||
aśuddhenāpi cittena chidrānveṣaṇatatparaḥ||6.271.90||
anyasmindivase prāpte sā strīdharmasamanvitā||
uṭajaṃ dūratastyaktvā rātrau suptā manasvinī||91|.
so'haṃ rūpaṃ mahatkṛtvā tāmādāya tapasvinīm||
sukhasuptāṃ suviśrabdhāṃ prasthito dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ||92||
athāsau saṃparityaktā saṃsparśānmama nidrayā||
caurarūpaṃ parijñāya māṃ śiṣyaṃ praruroda ha||93||
sābravīcca svabhartāraṃ gālavaṃ munisattamam||
eṣa śiṣyo durācāro harate māmitaḥ prabho||94||
tasmādrakṣa mahābhāga yāvaddūraṃ na gacchati||95||
tacchrutvā gālavaḥ prāha tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cāsakṛt||
pāpācāra suduṣṭātmangatiste staṃbhitā mayā||96||
tasya vākyāttato mahyaṃ gatistaṃbho vyajāyata||
yadvallikhita evāhaṃ pratiṣṭhāmi suniścalaḥ||97||
tatastena ca śapto'haṃ gālavena mahātmanā||
vaṃcito'haṃ tvayā yasmādbako bhava sudurmate||98||
tataḥ paśyāmi cātmānaṃ sahasā bakarūpiṇam||
bakatve'pi na me naṣṭā yā smṛtiḥ pūrvasaṃbhavā||99|
tataḥ sā'pi ca tatpatnī sacailaṃ snānamāśritā||
matsparśāduḥkhitāṃgī ca śāpāya samupasthitā||6.271.100||
yasmātpāpa tvayā spṛṣṭā prasuptāhaṃ rajasvalā||
bakadharmaṃ samāśritya bharttā me vaṃcitastvayā||
anyarūpaṃ samāsthāya tasmātsatyaṃ bako bhava||101||
evaṃ śaptastato dvābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ vai duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ||
caraṇābhyāṃ pralagnastu gālavasya mahātmanaḥ||102||
gaṇo'haṃ devadevasya trinetrasya mahātmanaḥ||
pālaketi ca vikhyāto gaṇakoṭiprabhuḥ sthitaḥ||103||
so'hamatra samāyātaḥ prabhoḥ kāryeṇa kenacit||
tava bhāryāṃ samālokya kāmadevavaśaṃ gataḥ||104||
kṣamāparādhaṃ tvaṃ mahyamevaṃ jñātvā munīśvara||
durvinītaḥ śriyaṃ prāpya vidyāmaiśvaryameva ca||105||
na tiṣṭhati ciraṃ sthāne yathāhaṃ madagarvitaḥ||
śiṣyarūpaṃ samāsthāya tataḥ prāptastavāṃtikam||106||
asyā haraṇahetośca mahāsatyā munīśvara||
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me dīnasya praṇatasya ca||107||
anugrahapradānena kṣamā yasmāttapasvinām||
kokilānāṃ svaro rūpaṃ nārīrūpaṃ pativratā||
vidyā rūpaṃ kurūpāṇāṃ kṣamā rūpaṃ tapasvinām||108||
sūta uvāca||
tasya tatkṛpaṇaṃ śrutvā sopi māheśvaro muniḥ||
jñātvā taṃ bāṃdhavasthāne dayāṃ kṛtvā'bravīdvacaḥ||109||
satyavāktiṣṭhate vipraścamatkārapure śubhe||6.271.110||
bharttṛyajña iti khyātastadā tasyopadeśataḥ||
bakatvaṃ yāsyate nūnaṃ mama vākyādasaṃśayam||111||
tataḥ paśyāmi cātmānaṃ bakatvena samāśritam||112||
evaṃ me dīrghamāyuṣyaṃ saṃjātaṃ śivabhaktitaḥ||
ghṛtakambalamāhātmyādbakatvaṃ muniśāpataḥ|| 113||
iṃdradyumna uvāca|| etadarthaṃ samānītastvatsakāśaṃ vihaṃgama||
iṃdradyumnasya vārtārthaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ||114||
sā tvayā naiva vijñātā mamābhāgyairvihaṃgama||
sevayiṣyāmyahaṃ tasmātpradīptaṃ havyavāhanam||115||
pratijñātaṃ mayā pūrvametanniścitya cetasi||
iṃdradyumne hyavijñāte saṃsevyaḥ pāvako mayā||116||
tasmāddehi mamādeśaṃ mārkaṃḍeyasamanvitaḥ||
praviśāmi yathā vahniṃ bhraṣṭakīrtirahaṃ baka||117||
mārkaṃḍeya uvāca||
vetsi cānyaṃ naraṃ kañcidvayasā cātmano'dhikam||
pṛcchāmi yena taṃ gatvā kṛte hyasya mahātmanaḥ|| 118||
śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ saṃprāpto'yaṃ mayā saha||
tatkathaṃ tyajati prāṇānsahāye mayi saṃsthite||119||
aparaṃ ca kṣamaṃ vākyaṃ yattvāṃ vacmi vihaṃgama||
ayaṃ duḥkhena saṃyuktaḥ sādhayiṣyati pāvakam||
ahamenamanuddhṛtya kasmādgacchāmi cāśramam||6.271.120||
sūta uvāca||
tayostaṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā bakaḥ paramadurmanā||
suciraṃ ciṃtayāmāsa kathaṃ syādetayoḥ sukham||121||
tato rājā muniścaiva dārūṇyāhṛtya pāvakam||
praveṣṭukāmau tau dṛṣṭvā bako vacanamabravīt||122||
mama vākyaṃ kuru prājña yadi jīvitumicchasi||
jñātaḥ so'dya mayā vyaktamindradyumnaṃ narādhipam||123||
yo jñāsyati mama jyeṣṭhaḥ sarvaśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ||
tattvamenaṃ samādāya maraṇe kṛtaniścayam|| 124||
niśvasantaṃ yathā nāgaṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanam||
samāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prati||125||
yatrāsti dayito mahyamulūkaścirajīvabhāk||
sa nūnaṃ jñāsyate taṃ hi mā vṛthā maraṇaṃ kṛthāḥ|| 126||
tato'sau tena saṃyukto bakena sumahātmanā||
mārkaṃḍeyena saṃprāptaḥ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam||127||
so'pi dṛṣṭvā bakaṃ prāptaṃ mitraṃ paramasaṃmatam||
samāgacchadasau hṛṣṭaḥ svāgatenābhyanandayat||128||
atha taṃ caiva viśrāntaṃ samāliṅgya muhurmuhuḥ||
prākāravarṇanāmāsau vākyametaduvāca ha||129||
svāgataṃ te dvijaśreṣṭha bhūpa susvāgataṃ ca te||
sakhye'dya yacca te kāryaṃ vadāgamanakāraṇam||6.271.130||
kāvetau puruṣau prāptau tvayā sārdhaṃ mamāṃtikam||
divyarūpau mahābhāgau tejasā parivāritau||131||
baka uvāca||
eṣa mārkaṃḍasaṃjño'tra prasiddho bhuvanatraye||
maheśvaraprasādena saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ||
dvitīyo'sau suhṛccāsya kaścinno vedmi tattvataḥ||
mārkaṃḍena samāyātaḥ suhṛdā va mamāṃtikam||132||
yadi jānāsi taṃ bhūpamindradyumnaṃ mahāmate||
tattvaṃ kīrtaya yenāsau maraṇādvinivartate||135||
cirāyustvaṃ mayā jñāto hyataḥ prāpto'smi teṃ'tikam||136||
ulūka uvāca||
aṣṭāviṃśatpramāṇena kalpā jātasya me sthitāḥ||
na dṛṣṭo na śrutaḥ kaścidiṃdradyumno mahīpatiḥ||137||
iṃdradyumna uvāca||
tava kasmādulūkatvaṃ śīghraṃ tanme prakīrtaya||
etanme kautukaṃ bhāvi yatte hyāyuranantakam||
ulūkatvaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ raudraṃ lokavigarhitam||138||
ulūka uvāca||
śṛṇu te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi dīrghāyurme yathā sthitam||
maheśvaraprasādena bilvapatrārcanānmayā||
ulūkatvaṃ mayā prāptaṃ bhṛgoḥ śāpānmahātmanaḥ||139||
ahamāsaṃ purā vipraḥ sarvavidyāsu pāragaḥ||
camatkārapure śreṣṭhe nāmnā khyātastu ghaṃṭakaḥ||
brahmacārī damopeto harapūjārcane rataḥ||6.271.140||
akhaṃḍitairbilvapatrairagrajātaistripatrakaiḥ||
trikālaṃ pūjitaḥ śaṃbhurlakṣamātraiḥ sadā mayā||141||
tato varṣasahsrāṃte tuṣṭo me bhagavānharaḥ||
provāca darśanaṃ gatvā meghagaṃbhīrayā girā||142||
ahaṃ tuṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ varaya suvrata||
akhaṃḍitairbilvapatraistrikāle yattvayārcitaḥ||143||
bilvasya prasavāgreṇa tripatreṇa prajāyate||
ekenāpi yathātuṣṭistathānyeṣāṃ na koṭibhiḥ||144||
puṣpāṇāmapi bhadraṃ te sugaṃdhānāmapi dhruvam||
sakhe mayā praṇamyoccaiḥ sa proktaḥ śaśiśekharaḥ||145||
yadi tuṣṭosi me deva yadi deyo varo mama||
tanmāṃ kuru jagannātha jarāmaraṇavarjitam||146||
sa tatheti pratijñāya mahādevo maheśvaraḥ||
kailāsaṃ prati deveśaḥ kṣaṇāccādarśanaṃ gataḥ||147||
tatohaṃ parituṣṭotha varaṃ prāpya maheśvarāt||
kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ ciṃtayāmi praharṣitaḥ||148||
etasminneva kāle tu bhārgavo munisattamaḥ||
kuśalaḥ sarvaśāstreṣu vedavedāṃga pāragaḥ||149||
tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī nāmnā khyātā sudarśanā||
prāṇebhyo'pi priyā tasya gālavasya muneḥ sutā||6.271.150||
tasya kanyā samabhavadrūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi||
sā mayā sahasā dṛṣṭā krīḍamānā yathecchayā||151||
madhyakṣāmā sukeśī ca biṃboṣṭhī dīrghalocanā||
tāmahaṃ vīkṣayitvā tu kāmadevavaśaṃ gataḥ||152||
tataḥ pṛṣṭā mayā kasya kanyeyaṃ cārulocanā||
vibhaktasarvāvayavā devakanyeva rājate||153||
sakhībhiḥ kīrtitā mahyaṃ bhārgavasya muneḥ sutā||
eṣā cādyāpi kanyātve vartate cāruhāsinī||154||
tato'haṃ bhārgavaṃ gatvā vinayena samanvitaḥ||
yayāce kanyakāṃ tā ca kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ|| 155|
savarṇaṃ māṃ parijñāya so'pi bhārgavanaṃdanaḥ||
dattavāṃstāṃ mahābhāga virūpasyāpi kanyakām||156||
atha sā kanyakā jñātvā pitrā dattāsmi dharmataḥ||
virūpāya tato gatvā mātaraṃ vākyamabravīt||57||
sulajjā sā'tiduḥkhārtā paśyāṃba janakena ca ||
virūpāya pradattāsmi nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe||158||
viṣaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmi pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam||
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā niṣiddhaḥ sa dvijastayā||159||
kasmānnātha pradattāsau virūpāya tvayā vibho||
kanyakeyaṃ surūpāḍhyā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā||6.271.160||
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhārgavo munisattamaḥ||
tatastāṃ garhayitvāsau dhiṅnārī puruṣāyate||161||
anena prārthitā kanyā mayā cāsmai pradīyate||
tatkiṃ niṣedhayasi māṃ dīyamānāṃ sutāmimām||162||
ityuktvā sa prasuṣvāpa patnyātha kanyayā samam||163||
tato'rddharātre cāgatya mayā suptā ca bhārgavī||
hṛtvā svabhavane nītā niśi supte jane tadā||164||
niyuktā kāmadharmeṇa hyanicchaṃtī balānmayā||
vipraḥ prātarjajāgāra pitā tasyāstataḥ param||165||
kvāsau sā duhitā kena hṛtā naṣṭā madīyikā||
athāsau vīkṣituṃ bāhye babhrāma svavanāṃtikam||166||
padasaṃhatimārgeṇa munibhirbahubhirvṛtaḥ||
tena dṛṣṭā'tha sā kanyā kṛtakautukamaṃgalā||167||
rudaṃtī sasvanaṃ tatra lajjamānā hyadhomukhī||
tataḥ kopaparītātmā māṃ provāca sa bhārgavaḥ|| 168||
niśācarasya dharmeṇa yasmādūḍhā sutā mama||
niśācaro bhavānastu karmaṇānena sāṃpratam|169||
ghaṃṭaka uvāca||
nirdoṣaṃ māṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kasmāttvaṃ śapasi drutam||
tvayaiṣā me svayaṃ dattā tena rātrau hṛtā mayā||6.271.170||
yo datvā kanyakāṃ pūrvaṃ paścādyacchenna durmatiḥ|
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam||171||
athāsau ciṃtayāmāsa satyametena jalpitam||
paścāttāpasamopeto vākyametaduvāca ha||172||
satyametattvayā proktaṃ na me vacanamanyathā||
ulūkarūpasaṃyukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ||173||
utpatsyate yadā cātra bhartṛyajño mahāmuniḥ||
tasyopadeśamāsādya bhūyaḥ prāpsyasi svāṃ tanum||174||
tataḥ kauśikarūpaṃ tu paśyāmyātmānameva ca||
tathāpi na smṛtirnaṣṭā mama yā pūrvasaṃbhavā||175||
atha yā tatsutā coḍhā mayā tasmingirau tadā||
sāpi māṃ saṃnirīkṣyātha tadrūpaṃ duḥkhasaṃyutā||
praviṣṭā havyavāhaṃ sā vidhavātvamanicchatī||176||
evaṃ me kauśikatvaṃ hi saṃjātaṃ tu mahādyute||
bhārgavasya tu śāpena kanyārthe yattavoditam||177||
akhaṃḍabilvapatreṇa pūjito yanmaheśvaraḥ||
cirāyustenasaṃjātaṃ satyametanmayoditam||178||
satyaṃ kathaya yatkṛtyaṃ gṛhāyātasya kiṃ tava||
prakaromi mahābhāga yadyapi syātsudurlabham||179||
indradyumna uvāca ||
indradyumnasya jñānāya prāpto'haṃ yattavāṃtikam||
nāḍījaṃghena cānīto maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ||6.271.180||
yadi no jñāsyati bhavāṃstaṃ kīrtyā ca kulena ca||
praviśāmi tato nūnaṃ pradīptaṃ havyavāhanam||181||
no cetkīrtaya me kañcidanyaṃ tu cirajīvinam||
pṛcchāmi tena taṃ gatvā yena vetti na vā ca saḥ||182||
baka uvāca||
yuktamuktamanenādya tatkuruṣva vadāsya bhoḥ||
yadi jānāsi kaṃcitvamātmanaścirajīvinam||183||
no cedahamapi kṣipraṃ praviśāmi hutāśanam||
mārkaṃḍenāpi sahitaḥ sāṃprataṃ tava paśyataḥ||184||
evam jñātvā mahābhāga cintayasva ciraṃtanam||
kaṃcidbhūmitale'nyatra yatastvaṃ cirajīvadhṛk||185||
āśayā parayā prāptastavāhaṃ kila maṃdire||
pumāneṣa viśeṣeṇa mārkaṃḍeyaḥ priyo mama ||186||
saṃtyatra parvataśreṣṭhāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ||
yeṣu santi mahābhāgāstāpasāścirajīvinaḥ||
nānyathā jīvitaṃ cāsya kathaṃcitsaṃbhaviṣyati||187||
iṃdradyumnasya rājarṣerhitaṃ paramakaṃ bhavet||
tathāvayordvayoścāpi tasmācciṃtaya satvaram||188||
tasya taṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā maraṇārthaṃ mahīpateḥ||
sa ulūkaḥ kṛpāṃ gatvā tato vacanamabravīt||189||
yadyevaṃ tu mahābhāga martukāmo'si sāṃpratam||
tadāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ gandhamādanaparvatam||6.271.190||
tatra saṃtiṣṭhate gṛdhraḥ sa ca me paramaḥ suhṛt||
ciraṃtanastathā samyaksa te jñāsyati taṃ nṛpam||
kathayiṣyatyasaṃdigdhaṃ mama vākyādasaṃśayam||191||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mārkaṃḍeyādibhistribhiḥ||
proktaḥ sarvairmahābhāga mā tvaṃ praviśa pāvakam||192||
vayaṃ yāsyāmahe sarve tvayā sārdhaṃ ca tatra hi||
kadācitso'pi jānāti iṃdradyumnaṃ mahīpatim||193||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā āśayā parayā yutaḥ||
sa rājā saha taiḥ sarvaiḥ prayayau gaṃdhamādanam||194||
gṛdhrarājo'pi tāndṛṣṭvā sarvāneva kṛtāṃjaliḥ||
ulūkaṃ purato dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭaḥ sanmukho yayau||195||
tato'bravītprahṛṣṭātmā svāgataṃ te dvijottama||
cirakālātpradṛṣṭo'si ka ete'nye'tra ye sthitāḥ||196||
ulūka uvāca||
eṣa me paramaṃ mitraṃ nāḍījaṃgho bakaḥ smṛtaḥ||
etasyāpi tu mārkaṇḍaḥ saṃsthitaḥ paramaḥ suhṛt||197||
asau trailokyavikhyātaḥ saptakalpasmaro bhuvi||
etasyāpi suhṛtkaścinnainaṃ jānāmi satvaram||198||
mriyamāṇo mayā hyeṣa samānī tastavāṃtikam||
ayaṃ jīvati vijñāta iṃdradyumne nareśvare||
no cetpraviśati kṣipraṃ pradīptaṃ havyavāhanam||199||
sa tvaṃ jānāsi cedbrūhi indradyumnaṃ mahīpatim||
ciraṃtano mayāpi tvaṃ tena praṣṭuṃ samāgataḥ||6.271.200||
gṛdhra uvāca||
indradyumneti vikhyātaṃ rājānaṃ na smarāmyaham||
na dṛṣṭo na śrutaścāpi indradyumno mahīpatiḥ||201||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā so'pi rājā sudurmanāḥ||
manasā cintayāmāsa maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ||202||
tatastu kautukāviṣṭastaṃ papraccha dvijottamam||
karmaṇā kena saṃprāptamāyuṣyaṃ cedṛśaṃ vada||203||
tataḥ saṃbhāvayiṣyāmi śrutvā te'haṃ vibhāvasum||204||
gṛdhra uvāca|| ahamāsaṃ camatkārapure markaṭakaḥ kila||
upatyakāyāṃ tatraiva raktaśṛṃgasya bhūbhṛtaḥ||205||
tatraivāsti mahacchaṃbhormaṃdiraṃ maṃdaropamam|
citreśvarābhidhānaṃ ca sarvapātakanāśanam||206||
vasaṃte tatra saṃprāpte paurajānapadaistathā||
āgatya caiva sumahānutsavo vihito'bhavat||207||
liṃgasya savidhai ramye sarvartuphalitadrume||
kānane kāminīlokakāṃte janamanohare||
liṃgamāropitaṃ cāru tarorāṃdolake mudā|| 208||
kṛtvā damanakenārcāṃ sthāpyāṃdole suyaṃtrite||
yayuste svagṛhaṃ paścādarcayitvā trilocanam||209||
tato'haṃ rajanīvaktre tāṃ dolāṃ sumanoharām||
kautukāviṣṭahṛdayo dolayāmi muhurmuhuḥ||6.271.210||
evaṃ saṃdolayānasya mama prāptā narāstadā||
kaiścittaistrāsito hatvā laguḍaiḥ sarvatodiśam||211||
tataḥ paṃcatvamāpannastatraivāyatane drutam||
tato jātismaro bhūtvā saṃjāto nṛpamaṃdire||212||
koṭīśvarasyavikhyāto nāmnā caiva kuśadhvajaḥ||
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ mayā prāptaṃ tataḥ kramāt|213||
koṭīśe samanuprāpte paralokaṃ svakarmaṇā ||
jāgeśvaraṃ mahābhāgaṃ dolayāmi yathecchayā||214||
śivasiddhāṃtajairmaṃtrairguruṇā saṃniveditaiḥ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭo devo haro mama||
bhavato varadaścāsmi vākyametaduvāca ha||215||
kuśadhvaja pratuṣṭo'smi śraddhayā parayā tava||
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yaḥ sadā manasi sthitaḥ||216||
tato mayā praṇamyoccaiḥ sa prokto bhagavānharaḥ||217||
yadi tuṣṭosi me deva tanmāṃ kuru nijaṃ gaṇam||
trailokyarājyamapi me nānyatsaṃprati rocate||218||
evamukto mayā devo vimāne māṃ nidhāya saḥ||
śivalokaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sahasā māṃ samānayat||219||
tataḥ prasādataścāhaṃ bhavānyāśca harasya ca||
krīḍāmi svecchayā tatra gaṇamadhye vyavasthitaḥ||6.271.220||
kasyacittvatha kālasya vimānavaramāśritaḥ ||
svecchayābhramamāṇastu prāpto'traiva mahāgirau || 221 ||
vasaṃtasamaye prāpte pravṛtte dakṣiṇānile ||
agniveśyasutā dṛṣṭā vivastrā jalama dhyagā || 222 ||
ālibhirbahubhiryuktā krīḍamānā yathecchayā ||
muṣṭigrāhyā tu madhye sā biṃboṣṭhī vārijekṣaṇā || 223 ||
bilvastanī śaśāṃkāsyā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā ||
tato'haṃ manmathāviṣṭaḥ samabhūvaṃ hi tatkṣaṇāt || 224 ||
avatīrya vimānāgryādgṛhītātha kare mayā ||
prakurvāṇātha karuṇaṃ pakṣiṇīkurarī yathā || 225 ||
tataḥ kanyā munīṃdrāṇāṃ yāḥ sthitāstatra vāriṇi ||
rudaṃtyaḥ saṃprayātāstā agniveśyasya saṃnidhau || 226 ||
nīyate tvatsutā brahmanvimānavaramāśritā ||
vaimānikena kenāpi krandamānā nirargalam ||227 ||
tacchrutvā kupitaḥ so'tha vyomamārgāvalokanaḥ ||
svāśramātsaṃprayātaḥ sa bhartsamāno muhurmuhuḥ||229||
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti ca procya staṃbhayāmāsa sarvataḥ ||
tapasogreṇa viprasya vimānaṃ mama saṃsthitam ||229||
abravīcca tato māṃ sa kopena mahatā'nvitaḥ ||
yasmātpāpa tvayā kanyā krīḍatī vihṛtādhunā || 6.271.230 ||
akāmā māṃsapeśīva yathā gṛdhreṇa durmate ||
tasmādgṛdhro bhavatvāśu mama vākyādasaṃśayam ||231||
evamuktastatastena lajjayā'haṃ pariplutaḥ ||
nivedya kanyakāṃ tasmai praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ || 232 ||
tataḥ prokto mayā viprastvagniveśyo mahātapāḥ ||
na mayā te sutā jñātā na kopayitumarhasi||233||
gṛdhratvaṃ me yathā na syāttathākuru munīśvara ||234||
tato'haṃ tena ca prokto na mithyāvacanaṃ mama ||
kathaṃcijjāyate tasmādgṛdhratvaṃ prabhaviṣyati || 235 ||
ānartasyopadeśena yadā yāsyasi bho'dhama ||
bhartṛyajñaṃ mahābhāgamupadeśakṛte tadā || 236 ||
tasmācca niṣkṛtiṃ prāpya gṛdhratvaṃ te prayāsyati ||
sa mayā'nveṣamāṇena na dṛṣṭo naiva ca śrutaḥ |
nirviṇṇo gṛdhrabhāvena śāpāṃto na ca me'bhavat || 237 ||
gṛdhra uvāca || ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ gṛdhatvasya ca kāraṇam ||
āyuṣyaṃ ca yathā jātaṃ mama saṃkhyāvivarjitam || 238 ||
indradyumna uvāca || ||
anujñāṃ dehi me śīghraṃ praviśāmi hutāśanam ||
yena vairāgyamāpanno na hi jīvitumutsahe || || 239 ||
evamuktaḥ sa tenātha ciṃtayāmāsa cetasi ||
mamāṃtikaṃ samāyāta evaṃ mitrasamanvitaḥ ||
tatkaromi yathāśaktyā svopakāraṃ sudurlabham || ||6.271.240||
tataḥ provāca taṃ prītyā dākṣiṇyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||
mā sādhaya cāgniṃ bhoḥ śṛṇu tāvadvaco mama ||241||
ahaṃ te kīrtayiṣyāmi matto yo'pi ciraṃtanaḥ ||242||
yo jñāsyati na saṃdeha iṃdradyumnaṃ mahīpatim ||242||
tadāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ tatsamīpaṃ mahātmanaḥ ||
sahāyaiḥ sahitaḥ sarvairmayā sārdhaṃ tathaiva ca ||243||
|| iṃdradyumna uvāca || ||
kastavāpyadhiko'pyasti jīvitavyena saddvija ||
etanme kautukaṃ bhūri tasmādvada mahāmate || 244 ||
gṛdhra uvāca ||
asti maṃtharakonāma kamaṭhaścirajīvitaḥ ||

tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mārkaṃḍādyāśca te trayaḥ ||
tamūcuḥ pārthivaśreṣṭhaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayam || 246 ||
yuktamuktaṃ mahābhāga gṛdharājena dhīmatā ||
tatra yāsyāmahe sarve yatrāsau kamaṭhaḥ sthitaḥ || 247 ||
anirvedaḥ śriyo mūlaṃ yataḥ śaṃsaṃti paṃḍitāḥ||
nītiśāstravidaḥ sarve tasmādāgaccha gamyatām || 248 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvākṛcchrānnirvartya pārthivaḥ ||
maraṇādbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 249 ||

paṃcāpi ca samādiśya mānasaṃ sara uttamam ||
atha prāptāḥ krameṇaiva gacchamānā vihāyasā || 6.271.250 ||
mānasaṃ tatsaro ramyaṃ kūrmastoyādvinirgataḥ ||
nidāghe sevamānastu saṃtiṣṭhati yadṛcchayā || 251 ||

parijñāya tataḥ sarvānpranaṣṭaḥ salilaṃ prati || 252 ||
atha taṃ kauśikaḥ prāha gacchamānaṃ parāṅmukham ||
bhobho mitrāya māṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃjāto'si parāṅmukhaḥ || 253 ||
sunīco'pi gṛhaṃ prāpto bhavetpūjya tamaḥ satām || 254 ||
athāsau toyamadhyasthaḥ śiromātraṃ bahirgataḥ ||
pratyuvācātha taṃ gṛdhraṃ vinayāddvijasattamāḥ || 255 ||
nāhaṃ parāṅmukho jāta stvāṃ dṛṣṭvā'naṃtarāvubhau||
paṃcamo'yaṃ samabhyeti yo yuṣmākaṃ mahāpumān || 256 ||
bhayāttasya praṇaṣṭo'hamiṃdradyumnasya bhūpateḥ ||
anena tu pradagdhā me purā pṛṣṭhirmakhāgninā ||
satataṃ yajamānena rocake satpurottame || 257 ||
etadīyaṃ punaḥ smṛtvā bhayaṃ me sumahatsthitam ||
iṃdradyumnasya rājarṣeḥ kīrti saṃśrayaṇaṃ mahat || 258 ||
ityevamukte vacane kamaṭhena tadā divaḥ ||
devadūtaḥ samāgacchacchāsanātparameṣṭhinaḥ || 259 ||
|| devadūta uvāca ||
āgacchāgaccha rājarṣe sāṃprataṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tikam ||
ukto'haṃ brahmaṇā rājankīrtiścāsya pṛthagvidhā || 6.271.260 ||
yadā prakāśatāṃ yāti svalpāpi jagatī tale ||
tadā''neyo drutaṃ rājā mama loke sudurlabhe || 261 ||
tasmādāgaccha gacchāmo vimānārohaṇaṃ kuru ||

||iṃdradyumna uvāca || ||
yadyete suhṛdo mahyaṃ bakakauśikakacchapāḥ ||

āgacchāmi tvayā sārdhaṃ tadahaṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tikam ||
anyathā nāgamiṣyāmi satyametanmayoditam || 264 || ||
|| devadūta uvāca || ||
ete haragaṇāḥ sarve śāpabhraṣṭā kṣitiṃ gatāḥ ||

|| iṃdradyumna uvāca || ||
yadyevaṃ gaccha te bhadraṃ nāhaṃ gaṃtā triviṣṭapam ||
tathātathā yatiṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi yathā gaṇaḥ || 267 ||
tatrasthasya dhruvaṃ bhāvi nityaṃ ca patanādbhayam ||

brahmalokaṃ gato dūto vailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||
iṃdradyumnopi prapaccha taṃ kūrmaṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 269 ||
ākhyāhi kūrma svaṃ karma yadīdṛktvaṃ ciraṃtanaḥ |
karmaṇā kena tatprāptaṃ kūrmatvaṃ śaṃsa me drutam || 6.271.270 ||
|| kūrma uvāca || ||
ahamāsaṃ purā vipro bālabhāve vyavasthitaḥ||
camatkārapure ramye śāṃḍilyo nāma viśrutaḥ || 271 ||
bālakrīḍāsu sarvāsu krīḍamāno yadṛcchayā ||
pakveṣṭikamayaṃ śaṃbhoḥ krīḍatā nirmitaṃ gṛham ||
tatra jāgeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ hṛtvā'tha viniveśitam || 272 ||

jātismaro hyahaṃ vipro jāto vai vaidiśe pure || 274 ||

tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭo me śaśiśekharaḥ ||

abravītpraṇipatyoccairduḥkhita stadanaṃtaram||289||

yo nirmitaḥ pratuṣṭena jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ||6.271.290||

samudrasalilaṃ prāpya saṃsthito duḥkhito'niśam || 298 ||

yajanārthaṃ samānītaḥ samudrasalilastvayā ||299||

kriyamāṇaiśca yairdagdhā mama pṛṣṭhiḥ samaṃtataḥ ||
dahyato'pi mahārāja tena yajñāgninā tadā ||

saṃprāptaḥ plavamānastu tato'haṃ mānasaṃ saraḥ || 303 ||

caturbhiraparairmokṣaḥ kūrmatvātsaṃbhaviṣyati || 304 ||

adyāpi ca prapaśyāmi tāṃ jvalaṃtīmiva sthitām || 307 ||

kasmāttvaṃ na gataḥ svargaṃ vimāne'pi samāgate ||
etasmātkāraṇāddharmaṃ prakurvaṃti narādhipāḥ || 308 ||
|| indradyumna uvāca || ||
svargasthāne ca lokānāṃ nityaṃ ca patanā dbhayam ||

|| kūrma uvāca || ||
lomaśo nāma viprarṣiḥ sa matto'sti ciraṃtanaḥ ||

|| indradyumna uvāca || ||

|| kūrma uvāca || ||

na jāyate nṛṇāṃ tatra yuge tu dvijasattamāḥ ||14||
tatastretāyugaṃ bhāvi dvitīyaṃ munisattamāḥ ||
pādenaikena pāpaṃ tu raudraṃ dharme tadāviśat || 15 ||
tato raktatvamabhyeti bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ ||
pāpāṃśe'pi ca saṃprāpte sasparddho jāyate janaḥ || 16 ||
svargamārgakṛte sarve cakruryajñāṃstataḥ param ||
agniṣṭomādikāṃstatra bahuhomādikāṃstathā || 17 ||
devalokāṃstato yāṃti mūlādyāvaccaturdaśa ||
brahmalokasya paryaṃtaṃ svakīyairya jñakarmabhiḥ ||19||
kiṃcitsvalpāyuṣastatra jāyante spardhayā'nvitāḥ ||
paraṃ tatrāpi no yāṃti mṛtyuṃ putrāḥ kathaṃcana || 19 ||
janake vidyamāne ca sva lpadoṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
kāmakrodhādayo ye ca bhavaṃti na bhavaṃti ca || 6.272.20 ||
ekayā velayā tatra vāpitaṃ sasyamuttamam ||
saptavārānpragṛhṇaṃti vaiśyāḥ kṛṣiparāyaṇāḥ || 21 ||
sarvā ghaṭasravā gāvo mahiṣyaśca caturguṇāḥ ||
prayacchaṃti tathā kṣīramuṣṭryastāsāṃ caturguṇam || 22 ||
ajāvikāstathā pādaṃ nāryaḥ sarvāstathaiva ca ||
vedādhyayanasaṃpannāḥ pratigrahavivarjitāḥ ||
śāpānugrahakṛtyeṣu samarthāḥ saṃbhavaṃti ca 23 ||
kṣatriyāḥ kṣātradharmeṇa pālayaṃti vasuṃdharām ||
na tatra dṛśyate cauro na ca jāraḥ kathaṃcana ||
svadharmaniratāḥ sarve varṇāścaiva vyavasthitāḥ || 24 ||
tacca dvādaśabhirlakṣairvatsarāṇāṃ prakīrtitam ||
ṣaṇṇavatyā sahasraistu dvitīyaṃ yugamuttamam ||25||
tataśca dvāparaṃ bhāvi tṛtīyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||
dvau pādau tatra pāpasya dvau ca dharmasya saṃsthitau||
bhagavānvāsudevaśca kapilastatra jāyate || 26 ||
taccāṣṭalakṣamānena vatsarāṇāṃ prakīrtitam ||
catuḥṣaṣṭibhiranyaistu sahasrāṇāṃ dvijottamāḥ || 27 ||
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho daṃbho matsara eva ca ||
ṣaḍete tatra jāyaṃte īrṣyā caiva tu saptamī||28||
atha saṃsevitāstaistu mānavāśca parasparam ||
viruddhāṃśca prakurvaṃti nāpnuvaṃti yathā divam || 29 ||
kecittatrāpi jāyaṃte śāṃtā dāṃtā jiteṃdriyāḥ ||
na sarve'pi dvijaśreṣṭhā yato'rddhaṃ pātakasya tu || 6.272.30 ||
tataḥ kaliyugaṃ proktaṃ caturthaṃ ca sudāruṇam ||
ekapādo vṛṣo yatra pāpaṃ pādaistribhiḥ sthitam || 31 ||
kṛṣṇatvaṃ yāti devo'pi tatra caiva caturbhujaḥ ||
eka pādo'pi dharmasya yāvattāvatpravartate || 32 ||
paścānnāśaṃ samabhyeti yāvattāvacchanaiḥśanaiḥ ||
pramāṇaṃ tasya nirdiṣṭaṃ lakṣāścatvāra eva hi || 33 ||
dvātriṃśacca sahasrāṇi yugasyaivāṃtimasya ca ||
kalinā tatra saṃpṛṣṭā martyāḥ sarve parasparam || 34 ||
vibudhaiste pravartaṃte rāgadveṣaparāyaṇāḥ ||
yasyayasya gṛhe vittaṃ tathā nāryo manoramāḥ ||36||
tenatena samaṃ maitrīṃ kalau kurvaṃti mānavāḥ ||
vidhavānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ca tapasvinām||36||
lokadvayavināśaḥ syādyataśceto na śudhyati ||
prāvṛṭkāle'pi saṃprāpte durbhikṣeṇa prapīḍitāḥ || 37 ||
bhramaṃti ca kalau lokā gaganāsaktadṛṣṭayaḥ||
jānāti cāpi tanayaḥ pitā cennidhanaṃ vrajet || 38 |
tatohaṃ gṛhapo bhūyāṃ bāṃdhavo hyapi bāṃdhavam ||
snuṣāpi vetti cittena yadi śvaśrūḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet || 39 ||
mama syādgṛha aiśvaryaṃ tatsarvaṃ nānyathā vrajet ||
kāvyairupahatā vedāḥ putrā jāmātṛkaistathā || 6.272.40 ||
śālakairbāṃdhavāścaiva hyasatībhiḥ kulastriyaḥ ||
śūdrāstapasvinaścaiva śūdrā dharmasya sūcakāḥ ||41||
brāhmaṇānāṃ tataḥ śūdrā upadeśaṃ vadaṃti ca ||
alpodakāstathā meghā alpasasyā ca medinī || 42 ||
alpakṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīre sarpistathā'lpakam |
sarvabhakṣāstathā viprā nṛpā niṣkaruṇāstataḥ ||
kṛṣyā lajjaṃti vaiśyāśca śūdrā brāhmaṇapreṣakāḥ || 43 ||
hetuvādaratā ye ca bhaṃḍaṃvidyāparāśca ye ||
tete syurbhūmipālasya sadā'bhīṣṭāḥ kalau yuge ||44||
śvaḥśvaḥpāpīyadivasāḥ pṛthivī gatayauvanā |
atikrāṃta śubhāḥ kālāḥ paryupasthitadāruṇāḥ ||45||
yathāyathā yugaṃ bhāvi vṛddhiṃ yāṃti striyo narāḥ ||
tathātathā prayāṃti sma laghutāṃ jaṃtubhiḥ saha ||46||
dvādaśame caiva kanyā syādbhartṛsaṃyutā ||47||
tataḥ ṣoḍaśame varṣe narāḥ palitayauvanāḥ ||
śaucācāraparityaktā nijakāryaparāstathā || 48 ||
bhaviṣyaṃti yugasyāṃte narāḥ aṃguṣṭhamātrakāḥ ||
gṛhaṃ ca te'tha kurvaṃti bilairākhusamudbhavaiḥ || 49 ||
tathā prāvaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ kṛmivastraṃ bhaviṣyati ||
ekavarṇā bhaviṣyaṃti varṇāḥ sarve tataḥ paraḥ ||
mlechībhūtā durācārā dharmakṛtyavidūṣakāḥ ||6.272.50||
evaṃ jāte tato loke brāhmaṇo haripiṃgalaḥ ||
kalkigotrasamutpannastānsarvā nsūdayettataḥ ||91||
paścātkṛtayugaṃ bhāvi bhūyo'pi dvijasattamāḥ ||52||
evaṃ yugasahasreṇa saṃprāptena tataḥ param ||
brahmaṇo divasaṃ bhāvi rātriścaiva tataḥ param || 53 ||
tataścānena mānena ṣaṣṭyā yuktaistribhiḥ śataiḥ ||
brahmaṇo vatsaraṃ bhāvi keśavasya ca taddinam || 54 ||
ātmīye jīvite brahma yāvadvarṣaśataṃ sthitaḥ ||
keśavo'pi svamānena varṣāṇāṃ jīvite śatam || 55 ||
varṣeṇa vāsudevasya dinaṃ māheśvaraṃ bhavet ||
nijamānena sopyatra yāva dvarṣaśataṃ sthitaḥ || 56 ||
tataḥ śaktisvarūpaḥ syātso'kṣayī kīrtyate yataḥ ||
sadāśivasya niḥśvāsaḥ śaivaṃ varṣaśataṃ bhavet ||
ucchvāsastu punastasya śaktirūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ || 57 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ śivaśaktisamudbhavam ||
yāvadāyuḥ pramāṇaṃ ca mānuṣāḍhyaṃ ca yadbhavet || || 58 ||
bhavadbhiḥ śāṃkaraṃ pṛṣṭo dvijā asmi dinaṃ purā ||
mayā punastu sarveṣāṃ martyādīnāṃ tu kīrtitam || 59 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yugasvarūpavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatyuttaradviśatatamoadhyāyaḥ || 272 || | cha || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
eteṣāṃ tu sahasreṇa bhavedgrāhyaṃ dinaṃ dvijāḥ ||
caturdaśa sahasrākṣā jāyaṃte tatra vāsare || 1 ||
saptamastu sahasrākṣaḥ sāṃprataṃ vartate'tra yaḥ ||
ekasaptatisaṃvartacaturdaśadine vidheḥ || 2 ||

caturyugasya saṃjāto gatesmiñcheṣamātrake ||

koṭayaḥ prabhaviṣyaṃti yathā caiva tathā purā || 7 ||

tasyānena pramāṇena jātaṃ saṃvatsarāṣṭakam || || 8 ||

paṃcaṣaṣṭyā'dhikaiścaiva dinānāṃ ca śataistribhiḥ ||
bhavetsaṃvatsaraṃ sauraṃ pañconaistaiśca sāvanam || 6.273.10 ||
cāṃdra ekādaśonastu triṃśaddhīna uḍūdbhavaḥ ||
śītātapau tathā vṛṣṭiḥ sauramānena jāyate || 11 ||
vṛkṣāṇāṃ phalaniṣpattiḥ sasyānāṃ ca tathā parā |
agniṣṭomādayo yajñā vartaṃte ye dharātale || 12 ||
utsāhāśca vivāhāśca sāvanena bhavaṃti ca ||
kusīdādyāśca ye kecidvyavahārāśca vṛttijāḥ || 13 ||

etadyugapramāṇaṃ tu yaḥ paṭhedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 16 ||
eteṣāmeva liṃgānāṃ saptānāṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||
nāpamṛtyu bhayaṃ tasya kathaṃcitsaṃbhaviṣyati || 17 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yugapramāṇavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 273 || || cha ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
tathānyadapi tatrāsti durvāsaḥsthāpitaṃ purā ||

|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||

te sarve ca parijñeyā yathā pāpa samāgamāḥ ||
tatsaṃsārasamudrasya tāraṇārthaṃ bravīhi me || 18 ||

tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā romāṃcita tanūruhaḥ ||
jñātvā māheśvaraḥ ko'yaṃ ciṃtāvānsamupasthitaḥ || 6.274.20 ||
yathā bravīṣi dhanyo'si yasya te matirīdṛśī ||
tāruṇye vartamānasya sukumārasya caiva hi || 21 |

dhātuṣu kṣīyamāṇeṣu śamaḥ kasya na jāyate || 22 ||

śūdro vā yadi vā vipro mlecho vā pāpakṛnnaraḥ ||

|| durvāsā uvāca || ||

dhenavo yo na śaktaḥ syādekā deyā prayatnataḥ ||
sarveṣāmeva rudrāṇāṃ bhartṛyajñavaco yathā || 13 ||
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye ekādaśarudrasamīpe dānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 277 || || dha ||

<6.278>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
ye cānye bhāskarā statra saṃti brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ||
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yājñavalkyapratiṣṭhitāḥ || 1 ||
yastānpūjayate bhaktyā hṛdi kṛtvā'bhivāṃchitān ||
saptamyāṃ caiva saptamyāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||
|| ṛṣaya ucuḥ || ||
eka eva sthitaḥ sūryo dṛśyate ca nabhastale ||
tatkathaṃ dvādaśaite ca tatra kṣetre pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
kasminkāle tathā kṛtye kimarthaṃ sūtanandana || 3 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
āsītpūrvaṃ kṛtirnāma śunaḥśepasamudbhavaḥ || || 4 ||
tasya putraḥ śunaḥ putro babhūva munisattamaḥ ||
cārāyaṇaḥ sutastasya vabhūva munisattamaḥ || 5 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya brahmā loka pitāmahaḥ ||
sāvitrīśāpanirdagdho hyavatīrṇo dharātale || 6 ||
gāyatrī ca yadā viprāstenoḍhā yajñakarmaṇi ||
prāksthitāṃ ca parityajya sarvadevasamāgame ||
kālātyayo bhavennaiva sāvitryāgamane sthire || 7 ||
tatastasya samādeśādgāyatrī gopakanyakā ||
śakreṇa ca samānītā divyalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 8 ||
gopakanyāṃ ca tāṃ jñātvā gośca vaktreṇa padmajaḥ ||
praveśyākarṣayāmāsa guhyena ca tataḥ param || 9 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva kulamekaṃ dvidhā sthitam ||
ekatra mantrāstiṣṭhaṃti havirekatra saṃsthitam || 6.278.10 ||
tena tāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ kṛtvā paścāttasyāḥ parigraham ||
gṛhyoktavidhinā cakre puraḥstho'pi pitāmahaḥ ||11||
patnīśālopaviṣṭāyāṃ tatastasyāṃ dvijottamāḥ ||
sāvitrī samanuprāptā devapatnībhirāvṛtā || 12 ||
tatastāṃ sā samālokya raśanāsamalaṃkṛtām ||
daurbhāgyaduḥkhamāpannā śaśāpa ca vidhiṃ tataḥ || 13 ||
|| sāvitryuvāca || ||
yasmāttvayā parityaktā nirdoṣāhaṃ pitāmaha ||
pitāmaho'si me nūnamadyaprabhṛti saṃgame || 14 ||
manuṣyāṇāṃ bhavetkṛtyamanyanārīparigrahaḥ ||
etattvayā kṛtaṃ yasmānmā nuṣastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 15 ||
kāmārtaśca viśeṣeṇa mama vākyādasaṃśayam|| 16 ||
evamuktvā tu sāvitrī tyaktvā taṃ yajñamaṃḍapam ||
gireḥ śikharamārūḍhā tapaścakre mahattataḥ || 17 ||
pitāmaho'pi tacchāpāccārāyaṇaniveśane |
avatīrṇo dharāpṛṣṭhe kālena mahatā tataḥ || 18 ||
sa yadā yauvanaṃ bheje mānuṣaṃ ca purā sthitaḥ ||
tathātathā ca tāpena kāmotthena prapīḍyate || 19 |
tato'sau vīkṣate nārīṃ kanyāṃ vātha tapasvinīm ||
avikalpamanā bheje rūpasaubhāgyagarvitaḥ || 6.278.20 ||
tatastaṃ byasanārtaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cārāyaṇo muniḥ ||
svayaṃ niḥsārayāmāsa prakopena nijāśramāt || 21 ||
sa ca pitrā parityakto bhramamāṇastatastataḥ ||
camatkārapuraṃ prāptaḥ śākalyo yatra tiṣṭhati || 22 ||
nāmnā brāhmaṇaśārdūlo nāgaro vedapāragaḥ ||
vṛtaḥ śiṣya sahasreṇa vedavidyāṃ pracārayan|| 23 ||
atha taṃ sa praṇamyoccaiḥ śiṣyatvaṃ samupāgataḥ ||
vedādhyayanasaṃpanno babhūvātha cirādapi || 24 ||
etasminneva kāle nu ānartādhipatiḥ svayam ||
āgatastiṣṭhate yatra jalaśāyī hariḥ svayam || 25 ||
cāturmāsyavrataṃ tena gṛhītaṃ tatpurastadā ||
prārthitastu tato viprāḥ śākalyastaina bhūbhujā || 26 ||
śāṃtikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ nityaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ mamālaye ||
yāvattiṣṭhāmyahaṃ cātra prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti || 27 ||
bāḍhamityeva sa proktvā dākṣiṇyena dvijottamāḥ ||
ekaikaṃ preṣayāmāsa svaśiṣyaṃ tasya maṃdire || 28 ||
sa śāṃtikaṃ vidhāyātha dattvāśīḥ pārthivasya ca ||
saṃprāpya dakṣiṇāṃ tasmātpunareti ca taṃ dvijam || 29||
śākalyāya ca tāṃ dattvā dakṣiṇāṃ nijamaṃdire ||
jagāma nityamevaṃ hi vyavahāro vyavasthitaḥ || 6.278.30 ||
anyasminnahani prāpte śākalyena visarjitaḥ ||
śāṃtyarthaṃ yājñavalkyastu pārthivasyaniveśanam || 31 ||
tasya bhūpasya rūpāḍhayā maṃtharāsti vilāsinī ||
rātrau ca kāmitā tena kāmāḍhayena sukāminī || 32 ||
bhāvairvātsyāyanaproktaiḥ samāliṃganapūrvakaiḥ ||
sa tayā vividhaiḥ kṛtto mayūrapadakādibhiḥ ||
śarīre cādhare caiva tathā maṇipravālakaiḥ || 33 ||
saṃprāpto'dhyayanārthāya yāvacchākalyasannidhau ||
tāvatsaṃpreṣitastena śāṃtyarthaṃ bhūpamaṃdire || 34 ||
so'pi saṃpreṣitastena gatvā taṃ pārthivālayam ||
śāṃtikaṃ ca tataścakre yathoktavidhinā dvijāḥ || 35 ||
śāṃtikasyāvasāne tu pragṛhya kalaśodakam ||
paṃcāṃgaiḥ kalpitaṃ rudraiḥ svayamevābhimaṃtritaiḥ || 36 ||
sākṣataṃ sumanoyuktaṃ samādāya gatastataḥ ||
saṃtiṣṭhate nṛpo yatra ānarto tratasaṃyutaḥ || 37 ||
dyāmālekhīti maṃtraṃ sa proccārya vidhipūrvakam ||
chaṃdarṣisahitaṃ caiva yāvatkṣipati mastake ||
tāvannirīkṣitastena nakhalekhāvikartitaḥ || 38 ||
khaṃḍitenādhareṇaiva tato'bhūddurmanā nṛpaḥ || 39 ||
viṭaprāyaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā malināṃbaradhāriṇam||
taṃ provāca vihasyoccai dehi viprā'kṣatāñjalam || 6.278.40 ||
maṃdurāyāṃ sthitaṃ yacca kāṣṭhametatpradṛśyate ||
yājñavalkyastato dṛṣṭvā sakopastamupādravat || 41 ||
kṣiptvā tatra jalaṃ viprāḥ sākṣataṃ gṛhamāgamat ||
agṛhya dakṣiṇāṃ tasya pārthivasya yathāsthitām || 42 ||
etasminnaṃtare tasya dhavakāṣṭhasya sarvataḥ ||
niṣkrāṃtā vividhāḥ śākhāḥ pallavaiḥ samalaṃkṛtāḥ || 43 ||
taddṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ so'tha ānartādhipatirnṛpaḥ ||
paścāttāpaṃ paraṃ cakre dhiṅmayaivamanuṣṭhitam || 44 ||
sa nūnaṃ vibudhaḥ ko'pi viprarūpeṇa saṃgataḥ ||
yenedṛśaḥ prabhāvo'yaṃ tasya maṃtrasya saṃsthitaḥ || 45 ||
yadyahaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi tasya mantroditaṃ jalam ||
jarāmaraṇahīnastu tadbhavābhi na saṃśayaḥ || 46 ||
evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya taddinaṃ vismitasya ca ||
pārthivasya dvijaśreṣṭhā jātaṃ varṣaśatopamam || 47 ||
divase tu samākrāṃte kathaṃcittasya bhūpateḥ ||
vibhāvarī kṣayaṃ yāti kathaṃcinnaiva śāradī || 48 ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye samutthāya mahīpatiḥ ||
āhvayāmāsa śākalyaṃ puruṣairāptakāribhiḥ ||49||
tataḥ provāca vinayātsādaraṃ prāṃjaliḥ sthitaḥ ||
kalye śiṣyaḥ samāyāto yastvadīyo mamāṃtikam || 6.278.50 ||
śāṃtyarthaṃ preṣaṇīyastu so'dyāpi ca dvijottama ||
tasyopari parā bhaktirmama jātā'dya kevalam || 51 ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya gatvā'tha nijamandiram ||
provāca yājñavalkyaṃ ca śāṃtyarthaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā || 582 ||
gaccha vatsa tvamadyaiva pārthivasya niveśanam ||
śāṃtyarthaṃ tena bhūyo'pi tvamevāśunimaṃtritaḥ || 53 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
nāhaṃ yāsyāmi taddharmye śāṃtyarthaṃ dvijapuṃgava ||
anādareṇa dṛṣṭo'haṃ nāśīrme ca samāhṛtā || 54 ||
kāṣṭhopari mayā dattā tasya vākyādasaṃśayam ||
tasmātpreṣaya cānyaṃ tvaṃ guro śiṣyaṃ vicakṣaṇam ||
ānartaṃ raṃjayedyastu vivekena samanvitam || 55 ||
|| śākalya uvāca || ||
rājā''deśaḥ sadā kāryaḥ puruṣairdeśavāsibhiḥ ||
yogakṣemavidhānāya tathā lābhāya kevalam ||56 ||

na tasya jāyate saukhyaṃ kathaṃciddvijasattama || 57 ||
ye jātyādi mahotsekānna nareṃdrānupāsate ||
teṣāmāmaraṇaṃ bhikṣā prāyaścittaṃ vinirmitam || 58 ||
evaṃ tayorvivadatostadā vai guruśiṣyayoḥ ||
bhūyo'pi tatra saṃprāptāḥ puruṣāḥ pārthiveritāḥ || 59 ||
procuśca tvarayā yuktāḥ śākalyaṃ prāṃjalisthitāḥ ||
śiṣyaṃ taṃ preṣaya kṣipraṃ rājā mārgaṃ pratīkṣate || 6.278.60 ||
asakṛtprocyamāno'pi yadā gacchati naiva saḥ ||
tadā saṃpreṣayāmāsa uddālakamathāruṇim || 61 ||
śiṣyaṃ vinayasaṃpannaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaṃ sthitam ||
gaccha vatsa samādeśātsāṃprataṃ nṛpamaṃdiram || 62 ||
śāṃtikarma vidhāyātha svādhyāyaṃ ca tataḥ kuru || 63 ||
sa tatheti pratijñāya gatvā taṃ pārthivālayam ||
cakāra śāṃtikaṃ karma vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 64 ||
tataḥ kalaśatoyaṃ sa sākṣataṃ sumanonvitam ||
gṛhītvopādravattatra yatra rājā vyavasthitaḥ || || 65 ||
|| rājovāca || ||
svakīyamantraliṃgena abhiṣekaṃ tu yaccha bhoḥ ||
kāṣṭhasyāsya yadagre te protthitaṃ tiṣṭhate dvija || 66 ||
tatastena śubhaṃ maṃtraṃ procyābhīṣṭaṃ jalaṃ svayam ||
abhiṣicya ca tatkāṣṭhaṃ tataśca svagṛhaṃ yayau || 67 ||
tāvadrūpaṃ ca tatkāṣṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā''narto mahīpatiḥ ||
viṣādasahitaścaiva paścāttāpasamanvitaḥ || 68 ||
bhūyastu preṣayāmāsa yājñavalkyakṛte tadā ||
anyaṃ dūtaṃ vidagdhaṃ ca śākalyasya dvijāśrayam|| 69 ||
vedanā kāyasaṃsthā me vartate dvijasattama ||
śāṃtyarthaṃ preṣayā kṣipraṃ taṃ śiṣyaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam || 6.278.70 ||
apamānaṃ kṛtaṃ tasya mayā kalye dvijottama ||

tenāpi vihitaṃ tacca yathoddālakanirmitam ||
āśīrvādo nṛpoddeśāddattaḥ kāṣṭhasya tasya ca || 74 ||
tadrūpamapi tatkāṣṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūyo'pi pārthivaḥ ||
anyaṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa yājñavalkyakṛte naram || 79 ||
asakṛtprocyamāno'pi yājñavalkyo vrajenna hi ||
yadā tadā bahuguṇamanyaṃ śiṣyaṃ pradiṣṭavān|| 76 ||
pracūḍaṃ bhāgavittiṃ ca so'pi gatvā yathā purā ||
cakāra śāṃtikaṃ karma yathā tābhyāṃ purā kṛtam|| 77 ||
tataḥ śāṃtyudakaṃ tasminprākṣipaccaiva dāruṇi ||

śāṃtyarthaṃ mama harmye tvaṃ kalye śiṣyaṃ samādiśa ||
yena me jāyate śāṃtiḥ śarīrasya dvijottama || 6.278.80 ||
tataḥ provāca śākalyo yājñavalkyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||

|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
nāhaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi guro maivaṃ bravīhi mām ||
apamānaḥ kṛto'nena guro mama mahībhujā || 83 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa kopaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||
abravīdbhartsamānastu yājñavalkyaṃ tataḥ param || 84 ||

yasmāttvaṃ śiṣyatāṃ gatvā mama vākyaṃ karoṣi na ||
tasmāttvāṃ yojayiṣyāmi brahma śāpena sāṃpratam || 86 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
anyāyena hi cecchāpaṃ guro mama pradāsyasi ||
ahamapyeva dāsyāmi pratiśāpaṃ tavādhunā || 87 ||
gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ ||
utpathe vartamānasya parityāgo vidhīyate || 88 ||
tasmāttvaṃ hi mayā tyaktaḥ sāṃprataṃ hi na me guruḥ ||
aviśaṣeṇa śiṣyārthaṃ yadādeśaṃ prayacchasi || 89 ||

tavādeśaṃ kariṣyāmi nocedyāsyāmi dūrataḥ || 6.278.90 ||
|| śākalya uvāca || ||
yadi gacchasi cānyatra tattvaṃ vidyāṃ parityaja ||
yāṃ mayā pāṭhitaḥ pāpa vraja paścātkuśiṣya bhoḥ || 91 ||
mayābhimaṃtritaṃ toyaṃ kṣurikāmuṇḍasaṃbhavam ||

provāca sundaraṃ prītyā vākyametanmuniṃ prati || 99 ||
yājñavalkya pratuṣṭo'haṃ tava brāhmaṇasattama ||
iṣṭaṃ dadāmi te brūhi yadyatsaṃprati vāṃchitam || 6.278.100 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
varaṃ dadāsi cenmahyaṃ vedapāṭhe niyojaya ||

|| āditya uvāca || ||
mayā paryaṭanaṃ kāryaṃ sadaiva dvijasattama ||

tasmāttvaṃ laghutāṃ gatvā mama mukhyahayasya ca ||
śravaṇe tiṣṭha madvākyāttejasā caiva yena me || 104 ||
na dahyasi mahābhāga tatra stho'dhyayanaṃ kuru ||

|| āditya uvāca || ||
yāni sūktāni ṛgvede madīyāni dvijottama ||

|| sūta uvāca || ||
evaṃ vedānpaṭhitvā sa pradattvā gurudakṣiṇām ||

|| śākalya uvāca || ||

|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
tadāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ yatra sūryāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||

brāhmaṇairyājñavalkyastu vedāntajñaiḥ pratoṣitaḥ || 122 ||

śrutādhyayanasaṃpannā yācasva gurudakṣiṇām || 123 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
eteṣāṃ bhāskarāṇāṃ ca madīyānāṃ puro dvijāḥ ||
kīrtayiṣyaṃti ye viprāsteṣāṃ yuṣmatprasādataḥ ||
bhūyā svargagatirviprā eṣā me guru dakṣiṇā || 124 ||
ye punarbhaktisaṃyuktāḥ kariṣyaṃti vicāraṇam ||
teṣāṃ turyapadaṃ yacca jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 125 ||
|| brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || ||
bhaviṣyati kalau viprā dausthyabhāvasamanvitāḥ ||
paṭhane naiva śaktāśca vyākhyānasya ca kā kathā || 126 ||
tasmātsārasvataṃ brūhi vedānāṃ dvijasattama ||
api dausthyasamāyuktā yena te kīrtayaṃti ca || 127 ||
|| yājñavalkya uvāca || ||
rathaṃ yuñjaṃti sūktaṃ yatprathamaṃ vittalakṣaṇam ||
triṣṭubheti ca yatsūktaṃ tathādyaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ || 1293 ||
citraṃ devānāmiti ca tathānyattasya vallabham ||
haṃsaḥ śuciṣadityuktaṃ tataścāpi praharṣadam || 129 ||
pāvamānaṃ tathā sūktaṃ ye paṭhiṣyaṃti bahvṛcaḥ ||
ityeṣāmādyamevaṃ tu te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim|| 6.278.130 ||
ekaviṃśatisāmāni ādityeṣṭāni yāni ca ||
sāmagāḥ kīrtayiṣyaṃti ye'trasthāḥ śucayaḥ sthitāḥ || 131 ||
niścayaṃ tu paraṃ dhṛtvā ye'pi stoṣyaṃti bhāskaram ||
tataste'pi prayāsyaṃti nirbhidya ravimaṃḍalam || 132 ||
kṣurikāsaṃpuṭaṃ caiva sūryakalpaṃ tathaiva ca ||
śāṃtikalpasamāyuktaṃ kīrtayiṣyaṃti ye dvijāḥ || 133 ||
atharvapāṭhakāste'pi prayāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim ||
mūrkhā api samāgatya saṃprāpte sūryavāsare || 134 ||
praṇāmaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ||
saptarātrakṛtātpāpānmuktiṃ prāpsaṃti te dvijāḥ || 135 ||
|| sūta uvāca || ||
tatheti taiḥ pratijñāte catuścaraṇasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
brāhmaṇairyājñavalkyastu vijñāto yena kena tu || || 136 ||
videhena tataḥ prāptaḥ śravaṇārthaṃ narādhipaḥ ||
vedāṃtānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ratnākhyena mahībhujā || 137 ||
tenāpi ca parijñāya māhātmyaṃ sūryasaṃ bhavam ||
tataḥ saṃsthāpitaḥ sūryastasminsthāne dvijottamāḥ || 138 ||
taṃ cāpi sūryavāreṇa yaḥ prapaśyati mānavaḥ ||
saptarātrakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 139 ||
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ māhātmyaṃ sūryasaṃbhavam ||
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 6.278.140 ||
saṃkrāṃtau yatpradānena sūrye vā śravaṇena tu ||
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti śrutvā māhātmyamutamam || 191 ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dvādaśārkotpattiratnādityotpattimāhātmye yājñavalkyavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ || 278 || || dha || 

<6.279>

|| sūta uvāca || ||
etatpurāṇamakhilaṃ purā skandenabhāṣitam ||
bhṛgave brahmaputrāya tasmāllebhe tathāṃgirāḥ ||1||
tataśca cyavanaḥ prāpa sa ṛcīkastato muniḥ ||
evaṃ paraṃparāprāptaṃ sarveṣu bhuvaneṣvapi ||2||
skāṃdaṃ purāṇametacca kumāreṇa puroddhṛtam ||
yaḥ śṛṇoti satāṃ madhye naraḥ pāpātpramucyate || 3 ||
idaṃ purāṇamāyuṣyaṃ varṇānāṃ ca sukhāvaham ||
nirmitaṃ ṣaṇmukheneha niyataṃ sumahātmanā || 4 ||
evametatpurā khyātamākhyānaṃ bhadramastu vaḥ || 5 ||
hāṭakeśvarakṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇute naraḥ ||
na tasya puṇyasaṃkhyānaṃ kartuṃ śakyeta kenacit || 6 ||
ya idaṃ dharmamāhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati ||
svargaloke vasettāvadyāvadakṣarasaṃkhyayā ||7||
yathā hi varṣato dhārā yathā vā divi tārakāḥ ||
gaṃgāyāṃ sikatā yadvattadvatsaṃkhyā na vidyate || 8 ||
yo naraḥ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā dināni ca kiyaṃti vai ||
sarvārthasiddho bhavati ya imāṃ paṭhate kathām | 9 ||
putrārthī labhate putrāndhanārthī labhate dhanam ||
labhate patikāmā yā patiṃ kanyā manoramam || 6.279.10 ||
samāgamaṃ labhaṃte ca vāṃdhavāśca pravāsibhiḥ ||
skāṃdaṃ purāṇaṃ śrutvā tu pumānā pnoti vāṃchitam || 11 ||
śṛṇvataḥ paṭhataścaiva sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām ||
mahīṃ vijayate rājā śatrūṃścāpyadhitiṣṭhati || 12 ||
puṇyaṃ śrutvā purāṇaṃ vai dīrghamā yuśca viṃdati ||
vedavicca bhavedvipraḥ kṣatriyo rājyamāpnuyāt || 13 ||
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt ||
yaḥ ślokapādaṃ śṛṇuyādviṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 14 ||
śrutvā purāṇametaddhi vācakaṃ yastu pūjayet ||
tena brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaiva prapūjitaḥ || 15 ||
ekamapyakṣaraṃ yastu guruḥ śiṣye nivedayet||
pṛthivyā nāsti taddravyaṃ yaddattvā hyanṛṇī bhavet ||16||
ataḥ saṃpūjanīyastu vyāsaḥ śāstropadeśakaḥ ||
gobhūhiraṇyavastrādyairbhojanaiḥ sārva kāmikaiḥ ||17||
ya evaṃ bhaktiyuktastu śrutvā śāstramanutamam ||
pūjayedupadeṣṭāraṃ sa śaivaṃ padamāpnuyāt || 18 ||
purāṇaśravaṇādeva anekabhavasaṃcitam ||
pāpaṃ praśamamāyāti sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet ||19||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye purāṇaśravaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||279|| ||9|| ||
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe ṣaṣṭhaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍaṃ samāptam || 6 ||
|| atha skānde mahāpurāṇe ṣaṣṭhaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍam || 6 ||
